paper.title: Making Every Tool Call Count: Necessary Tool-Evidence Path Rewards for Agentic Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Modern vision-language models (VLMs) can directly answer many image-grounded questions, yet they often struggle with complex queries requiring fine-grained visual details or external knowledge. To acquire this missing evidence, agentic VLMs invoke tools such as image cropping, image search, and text search. However, existing training paradigms primarily evaluate tool-use based on final answer correctness, leaving evidence acquisition and utilization insufficiently supervised. This leads to two c

summary.core_problem: 解决 agentic VLM 在工具使用中只按最终答案监督、导致工具调用冗余且证据利用不足的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献属于 agent 训练信号设计，核心价值不在多模态建模本身，而在把“工具调用路径 + 必要证据”显式纳入奖励与监督；对 post-train 和 tool-use 训练有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 NTEP（Necessary Tool-Evidence Path）标注方案，显式定义每个问题所需的外部证据及对应工具调用路径；在此基础上设计训练目标，对工具调用是否必要、是否获取到关键证据、是否正确使用观察结果进行更细粒度监督，而不是只看最终答对与否。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模和数据规模，但任务场景覆盖图像裁剪、图像搜索、文本搜索等工具。主要比较对象应是仅以 final answer correctness 作为奖励的 agentic VLM 训练范式；论文声称能减少冗余或偏题工具调用，并提升证据获取与利用质量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the problem that agentic VLMs are usually trained only on final answer correctness, which leads to redundant tool calls and poor evidence utilization.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly in training-signal design for agents: it explicitly supervises tool-evidence paths rather than only end-task accuracy. This is more relevant to post-training and tool-use learning than to multimodal pretraining itself.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces Necessary Tool-Evidence Path (NTEP), an annotation scheme that specifies the essential external evidence and corresponding tool calls for each query. Training then rewards whether the model makes necessary calls, retrieves the right evidence, and actually uses the observations correctly.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes or dataset scale, but the setting includes tools such as image cropping, image search, and text search. The likely baseline is standard agentic VLM training with final-answer-only rewards; the claimed gains are fewer redundant or off-target calls and better evidence acquisition and use.

recommendation.zh: 这不是 pretrain 论文，但对 tool-use RL 很实在：把 credit assignment 从 final answer 拆到 evidence path，若你做 agent post-train，先看标注定义和 reward 设计。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the tool-use RL angle is real: it moves credit assignment from final answers to evidence paths; read the annotation and reward design if you work on agent post-training.

paper.title: A Blind Trust, the Bloody Thrust: When Attacker-Controlled Hook Updates Steer AI Agent Harnesses towards Malicious Behaviors
paper.abstract: Modern AI agent harnesses expose lifecycle hooks that bind shell commands to runtime events such as session start, tool calls, and file edits. These commands run with host privileges yet ship as lifecycle-hook configuration and may fire at times the LLM never observes. We identify the lifecycle-hook update path, which harnesses trust blindly, as a new attack surface. Under a supply-chain threat model in which an attacker controls only plugin metadata and lifecycle-hook configuration, a benign ve

summary.core_problem: 解决 AI agent harness 中生命周期 hooks 被插件更新路径静默篡改后，可在 LLM 不可见的执行阶段触发恶意主机行为的安全问题。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练论文，但对通用 agent 系统很相关，尤其是“模型看不见的执行面”这一系统边界。贡献类型主要是安全分析与自动化攻击框架，而不是新 agent 能力方法。
summary.technical_approach: 作者识别出 lifecycle-hook update path 这一新攻击面：攻击者只需控制插件元数据和 hook 配置，就能把原本看似 benign 的插件更新成在 session start、tool call、file edit 等事件上执行恶意 shell 命令。为此提出 HookPry，一个自动化攻击框架，系统化利用不同 harness 的这一盲目信任机制，覆盖多种攻击目标。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在 25 组 harness-backend 组合、1000 次端到端运行中，攻破了全部 7 个被评估 harness，并实现 10 类攻击目标，包括权限提升等。实验规模对安全论文算扎实，但它主要说明 agent runtime 的供应链与执行隔离问题，对预训练本身没有直接方法启发。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies a security flaw in AI agent harnesses where lifecycle hooks can be silently weaponized through plugin updates, triggering malicious host-side behavior outside the LLM’s visible context.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to general agent systems, especially the boundary between what the model sees and what the runtime executes. The contribution is mainly a security analysis plus an automated attack framework, not a new agent capability method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper identifies the lifecycle-hook update path as a new attack surface: if an attacker controls plugin metadata and hook configuration, a seemingly benign plugin can be updated to execute malicious shell commands on events like session start, tool calls, or file edits. It then introduces HookPry, an automated framework that systematically exploits this blind-trust mechanism across heterogeneous harnesses.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims compromises on all 7 evaluated harnesses across 25 harness-backend combinations and 1,000 end-to-end runs, covering 10 attack objectives including privilege escalation. The setup looks substantial for a security paper, but the main lesson is about agent runtime supply-chain and execution isolation rather than pretraining methodology.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它提醒你 agent 系统里“模型可见上下文”远小于真实攻击面；看 threat model 和 attack table 就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretrain paper, but it is a useful reminder that the model-visible context is much smaller than the real attack surface in agent systems; the threat model and attack table are enough.

paper.title: Learning to Zoom Efficiently with a Contrastive Curriculum
paper.abstract: Using a zoom-in tool is an important foundational part of modern visual agents, because it allows to efficiently handle tasks involving high-resolution images. Most previous methods need an extensive warm-start supervised fine-tuning phase for teaching models zoom-in. We show that this is not necessary by proposing a new intrinsic reward for learning tool use in MLLMs without the need for additional labels or warm-start SFT. Our InfoNCE-style reward uses a curriculum of increasingly hard negativ

summary.core_problem: 让多模态智能体在高分辨率图像任务中学会何时、何处使用 zoom-in 工具，同时减少对 warm-start SFT 标注数据的依赖。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视觉工具使用训练方法。它关注 MLLM agent 的 tool-use 学习信号，而不是单纯提升某个视觉任务分数；对通用 agent 后训练和多模态 RL 训练信号设计有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出一种 InfoNCE 风格的 intrinsic reward，用逐步变难的 negative tool calls 构造 contrastive curriculum。模型通过区分更合理和更差的 zoom-in 调用来学习工具使用。论文还引入合成 Muffin&Chihuahua 数据集，用网格中 muffin/chihuahua 的区域定位来直接度量 zoom-in 能力。
summary.experiments: 在 V*, HRBench 和 MME-RealWorld 上实验，报告方法在更高训练效率下具有竞争力；作为 SFT 的 drop-in replacement 时超过所有 baselines。摘要未给出模型尺寸、训练步数和具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: UKP Lab, Technical University of Darmstadt；Iryna Gurevych 团队长期做 NLP、信息抽取和可信评测相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how multimodal agents can learn when and where to use a zoom-in tool for high-resolution image tasks without relying on a warm-start supervised fine-tuning phase.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training signal for visual tool use. It is more relevant to MLLM-agent post-training than to visual recognition itself, and it offers a useful example of intrinsic reward design for tool learning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses an InfoNCE-style intrinsic reward with a curriculum of increasingly hard negative tool calls. The model learns zoom behavior by contrasting better and worse tool invocations. The paper also introduces the synthetic Muffin&Chihuahua dataset to directly measure zoom-in ability via controlled grid images.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are reported on V*, HRBench, and MME-RealWorld. The method is described as competitive with better efficiency and as outperforming all baselines when used as a drop-in replacement for SFT. The abstract does not provide model sizes, training compute, or exact deltas.
summary_en.authors_note: UKP Lab, Technical University of Darmstadt; Iryna Gurevych’s group is known for NLP, information extraction, and evaluation work.

recommendation.zh: 只看 reward 构造和 M&C 诊断集即可；“不用 SFT 学工具”结论需看训练预算是否公平。
recommendation.en: Read the reward design and M&C diagnostic setup; the no-SFT claim hinges on whether the training budget is fair.

paper.title: What Do CAE Simulation Agents Really Need Beyond a Generic Harness?
paper.abstract: Computer-aided engineering (CAE) simulation is among the largest and most demanding areas of engineering, where setting up a solver such as OpenFOAM, FEniCS, or COMSOL takes real expertise. Large language model (LLM) agents promise to turn a natural-language request into a working simulation, and recent CAE agents add simulation-specific machinery: multi-agent decomposition, domain retrieval, and scripted reflection. That machinery suited weak base models; modern harnesses already supply multi-t

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作在问：对 CAE 仿真这类工具密集任务，现代 LLM agent 到底还需要多少领域特化 machinery，还是通用 harness 已经足够。
summary.importance: 虽然是 CAE 领域任务，但它试图回答一个更一般的 agent 设计问题：随着基座模型和通用 harness 变强，多 agent 分解、脚本化反思、领域特化流程是否还值得保留。贡献类型偏系统消融与方法取舍分析。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在固定信息访问与 repair budget 的条件下，对比单 agent 通用 harness 与多 agent 专用系统，并做关键能力消融：execution-feedback repair、scripted reflection、输入信息形态等。核心不是新架构，而是把 specialized machinery 拆开看哪些仍然有边际价值。
summary.experiments: 在 FoamBench 上，单 agent harness 达到 96.4%，高于文中对比的多 agent specialized system 的 88.2%。无 repair round 时只有 71.8%，说明 execution feedback repair 是主要增益来源；scripted reflection 基本无收益。作者还指出仍然关键的输入是高质量领域文档/接口信息。结果对 agent 设计有些参考，但任务仍偏垂直。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 DP Technology、北航和 AI for Science Institute。更接近 AI for Science/工程仿真团队，而非通用 LLM 基座团队。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether CAE simulation agents still need domain-specific machinery, or whether a modern generic harness is already enough for tool-heavy tasks.
summary_en.importance: Although the task is in CAE, it targets a broader agent-design question: as base models and generic harnesses improve, do multi-agent decomposition, scripted reflection, and domain-specific workflows still pay off? The contribution is mainly system ablation and design trade-off analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: Under fixed information access and repair budget, the paper compares a single-agent generic harness against specialized multi-agent systems, then ablates execution-feedback repair, scripted reflection, and input information form. The novelty is not a new architecture but a decomposition of which specialized components still have marginal value.
summary_en.experiments: On FoamBench, the single-agent harness reaches 96.4%, beating the compared specialized multi-agent system at 88.2%. Without repair rounds, performance drops to 71.8%, indicating that execution-feedback repair is the main driver; scripted reflection adds little. The paper also argues that high-quality domain documentation/interface information remains the key missing ingredient. Useful for agent design, but still fairly domain-bound.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with DP Technology, Beihang University, and AI for Science Institute. This is closer to an AI-for-science / engineering simulation team than to a core foundation-model lab.

recommendation.zh: 结论不新，但对 agent 研究有个实用提醒：先把 execution-feedback repair 做扎实，再谈多 agent 和 scripted reflection；正文只看 ablation 表就够。
recommendation.en: The conclusion is not novel, but it usefully reminds agent builders to get execution-feedback repair right before adding multi-agent structure or scripted reflection; the ablation tables are enough.

paper.title: CivBench: A Long-Horizon Benchmark for Tool-Mediated Agents in Civilization VI
paper.abstract: We present CivBench, an open-source benchmark for evaluating language model agents in long-horizon, tool-mediated environments through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). A single episode spans 300+ turns and produces thousands of tool calls over a large action space, requiring sustained planning, state monitoring, and execution under partial observability. The environment exposes 76 MCP tools and a narration layer that converts visual game state into structured text. We use CivBench to characteri

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“哪个模型更会玩文明6”，而是更基础的问题：怎样评测一个通过工具与环境交互的语言模型代理，在超长时程、部分可观测、动作空间很大的环境里，是否真的在持续监控关键状态、维持计划并把计划落实成行动。现有很多 agent benchmark 更像短回合任务，容易把能力压缩成单步推理、单次工具调用或局部规划；CivBench 试图把评测对象换成长期闭环行为，并且把“信息是否存在”和“模型是否主动取回信息”分开，从交互轨迹里直接测代理的注意分配与执行一致性。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接价值不在游戏本身，而在评测接口设计。它提供了一个较少见的视角：把 agent 失败拆成检索失败、状态监控失败、计划执行失败，而不是只看最终胜负。对预训练和后训练研究都有启发。若一个模型在长程工具环境里持续漏查关键全局状态，问题可能不只是规划器弱，也可能是预训练阶段对“何时查询外部状态、如何维护 latent state”的建模不足。论文贡献量级偏中等，主要是 benchmark 和可测指标设计，不是新训练方法；但它提出的 PMR 和 RAG@K 这类接口级指标，比单纯 outcome 更接近真实 agent 系统的失效机理。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上有三个关键设计。第一，环境层面，作者把 Civilization VI 通过 FireTuner over TCP 接到 MCP 接口，暴露 76 个工具，覆盖状态查询、单位控制、城市管理、外交、科研、宗教、贸易等核心系统。这样代理不是面对固定 observation tensor，而是面对一个需要自己决定何时查什么的工具化环境。第二，叙述层（narration layer）把视觉游戏状态转成结构化文本，但不自动把所有信息塞进上下文。也就是说，信息是“可表示的”，但不是“默认可见的”；非局部状态必须显式查询。这一点很重要，因为它让研究者能区分模型是因为环境没给信息而失败，还是因为信息明明可查却没去查。第三，指标设计上，论文没有把重点放在小样本 leaderboard，而是定义了两类行为指标：PMR（Proactive Monitoring Rate）衡量代理是否主动查询潜在关键战略状态，例如胜利进度、对手发展、全局威胁；RAG@K 衡量代理在文本里做出的近期承诺，是否在后续 K 步窗口内转化为实际工具调用或行动。前者测“有没有持续看仪表盘”，后者测“说了会不会做”。这和很多只统计成功率的 benchmark 不同，后者很难定位失败来自感知、记忆、规划还是执行。
summary.experiments: 实验部分作者刻意收敛结论。全文给出的核心事实是：他们在四个模型家族上做了 23 次 admissible full-game runs，每局 300+ turn，典型每回合 5–15 次工具调用，因此单局会产生数千次 MCP 调用。样本规模不足以支持稳定模型排序，所以论文明确不把结果包装成排行榜。更重要的发现来自轨迹分析：一是代理普遍存在对可查询全局状态的 under-monitoring，也就是很多关键战略变量并非不可见，而是没有被主动拉入上下文；二是代理经常出现近程承诺未执行，文本计划和后续动作脱节。摘要里没有给出完整数值表，正文当前可见部分也主要强调 benchmark 设计与 pilot characterization，而不是大规模统计显著性。就阅读预期而言，这篇论文的实验价值在于“暴露了什么可测失效模式”，不在于“哪家模型赢了多少分”。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议先看 Introduction 和 Environment，抓住它最重要的接口假设：structured narration 提高了可读性，但不替代理完成检索。然后看定义 PMR 和 RAG@K 的章节，理解作者如何从 transcript 中把“监控”和“执行”操作化。最后看实验部分里关于 sample size、admissible runs 和 pilot framing 的说明，避免把它误读成模型排名。若只花 20–30 分钟，重点看图 1、工具表、narration protocol、以及行为指标定义。值得深挖的点有两个：一是这种“信息可得但需主动查询”的设计，能否迁移到真实工作流 agent benchmark；二是 PMR/RAG@K 是否可以作为 post-train 或 RL agent training 的中间奖励信号。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not really about ranking models on Civilization VI. Its actual target is a more basic evaluation problem: how to measure whether a tool-using language-model agent can maintain situational awareness, monitor latent state, and execute plans over very long horizons in a partially observable environment with a large action space. Many existing agent benchmarks collapse behavior into short-horizon reasoning or isolated tool calls. CivBench instead tries to evaluate closed-loop behavior over hundreds of turns and to separate “information exists in the environment” from “the agent actually retrieves it into context.”
summary_en.importance: Its value to foundation-model research comes from interface design rather than the game domain itself. The benchmark makes a useful shift from outcome-only evaluation to mechanism-level diagnosis: did the agent fail because it never queried the relevant state, because it lost track of it, or because it stated a plan but did not act on it? That is relevant to both pretraining and post-training. If models systematically under-monitor queryable global state, the issue may reflect not only planner weakness but also limitations in how current models learn retrieval timing, external-state tracking, and long-horizon control. The contribution is moderate in scale: this is mainly a benchmark and metric paper, not a new training method, but PMR and RAG@K are more informative than raw win rate for studying agent failure modes.
summary_en.technical_approach: There are three main design choices. First, the environment connects Civilization VI to an MCP interface through FireTuner over TCP and exposes 76 tools spanning state queries, unit control, city management, diplomacy, research, religion, trade, and lifecycle operations. This makes the agent operate in a tool-mediated setting rather than a fixed observation API. Second, the narration layer converts visual game state into structured text, but crucially does not automatically inject all relevant information into context. Information is representable, but not passively observed; non-local state must be explicitly queried. This allows the benchmark to distinguish unavailable information from available-but-unretrieved information. Third, the paper introduces behavior-level metrics instead of relying on leaderboard-style aggregate outcomes. PMR, Proactive Monitoring Rate, measures whether the agent actively checks latent strategic state such as victory progress or rival status. RAG@K measures whether a textual commitment is followed by corresponding actions within the next K steps. PMR captures whether the agent keeps checking the dashboard; RAG@K captures whether stated plans are translated into execution.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical section is intentionally conservative. The paper reports 23 admissible full-game runs across four model families. Each episode lasts 300+ turns, with a typical turn involving 5 to 15 tool calls, so a single run generates thousands of MCP interactions. The sample is explicitly too small for stable model ranking, and the authors say so clearly. The main findings come from trace analysis rather than aggregate game outcomes: agents often under-monitor queryable global state, meaning the information is not hidden but simply never brought into context, and they frequently fail to execute near-term commitments stated in text. The currently visible full text emphasizes benchmark construction and pilot characterization more than large-scale statistical comparison. So the experimental value is in exposing measurable failure patterns, not in claiming robust model ordering.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with the Introduction and Environment sections. The key idea is that structured narration improves readability without removing the need for active retrieval. Then read the sections defining PMR and RAG@K, since those are the real methodological contribution. Finally, check the experimental framing around sample size, admissible runs, and the decision not to present a leaderboard. In 20 to 30 minutes, focus on Figure 1, the tool inventory, the narration protocol, and the metric definitions. Two follow-up questions are worth thinking about: whether this “available but not automatically surfaced” interface can transfer to real-world agent benchmarks, and whether PMR or RAG@K could serve as intermediate rewards in post-training or RL-based agent optimization.

recommendation.zh: 值得 skim 的不是游戏 benchmark 本身，而是它把长时程 agent 评测从 outcome-only 拉回到 interface metrics；先看 PMR、RAG@10 定义和失效案例。
recommendation.en: What’s worth skimming is not the game benchmark per se, but the shift from outcome-only scoring to interface metrics for long-horizon agents; read the PMR/RAG@10 definitions and failure cases first.

paper.title: How Fast Do Agents Rot? An Empirical Study of Long-Horizon Degradation in LLM Agents for Production Decision-Making
paper.abstract: Production deployments of large language model (LLM) agents remain unreliable on long, multi-step workflows even as benchmark success rates climb steadily. We argue this gap is largely an artifact of task horizon: benchmarks are dominated by short-to-medium horizons where success remains high, while production workloads demand an order of magnitude more dependent steps. We measure the effect directly, characterizing the shape of agent degradation and disentangling its cause across a large contro

summary.core_problem: 这项研究要回答一个具体问题：为什么 agent 在短任务 benchmark 上看起来可靠，但进入生产中的长链路决策流程后会快速退化。作者把焦点放在 task horizon，也就是必须连续正确完成的依赖步骤数，而不是只看总上下文长度或单次任务通过率。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 agent 评测、长程能力建模和推理时可靠性预算有清晰启发。主要结论是：长程 agent 成功率可以近似由单步可靠性按几何形式累乘得到。这个结论会改变 benchmark 读法。一个模型在短 horizon 上的小幅提升，如果不能提高 per-step reliability，在长 horizon 上可能仍然迅速失败。对基座训练研究而言，这提示长程能力不能只用长上下文困惑度或单轮工具调用准确率衡量，需要评估错误在多步闭环中的复合效应。
summary.technical_approach: 实验设计的关键是把 step count 和 context length 解耦。研究覆盖 9 个模型，其中包括 6 个开源模型，参数规模从 1.2B 到 671B，以及 3 个已部署的闭源系统；任务覆盖 4 类，包括真正需要循环工具使用的 agentic task；每类任务设置 5 个 horizon，并使用 3 种 context regime。作者用 oracle-verifiable 的受控任务避免人工打分噪声，然后拟合 task success 与 horizon 的关系。如果每一步独立成功率为 r，长度为 H 的任务成功率应近似为 r^H。研究进一步比较不同上下文处理策略，以区分失败来自更长上下文，还是来自更多依赖步骤。
summary.experiments: 主要实验结论是，在 36 个 model-task 单元中，有 28 个符合几何衰减规律，成功率主要由一个可测的 per-step reliability 参数控制。agentic 工具使用任务上的退化更明显，说明局部错误会在真实闭环中持续放大。研究还观察到 trajectory 内部 hazard 可能随执行推进而加速，意味着后期步骤并不一定与早期步骤等价。一个反直觉结果是，限制上下文并没有改善表现，反而会更差；这说明在这些任务中，step count 比 context length 更能解释性能下降。文中还指出当前 benchmark 多集中在短到中等 horizon，因此容易采样到衰减曲线较平的区域，低估生产长流程风险。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。优先看任务构造和三种 context regime，因为这决定了 step count 与 context length 的因果区分是否可信。然后看 success-vs-horizon 曲线、几何拟合结果和 28/36 的模型任务统计。agentic 工具使用任务应重点看，因为它比结构化输出探针更接近真实部署。最后看作者对 benchmark gap 的量化和实践建议。对预训练研究员而言，核心收获不是某个模型排名，而是 per-step reliability 可以作为长程能力的中间指标，并可能用于训练数据筛选、RL reward 分解和长程评测设计。

summary_en.core_problem: The study asks why LLM agents can perform well on short benchmark tasks yet degrade sharply in production workflows that require many dependent decisions. The focus is task horizon, defined as the number of sequential steps that must be executed correctly, rather than aggregate pass rate or raw context length.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly about evaluation and reliability modeling, not base-model pretraining. Its value for pretraining researchers is the measurement lens: long-horizon success can often be approximated as a geometric product of per-step reliability. A small improvement on short-horizon tasks may not translate into robust long workflows unless it improves the reliability of each dependent step. This argues for evaluations and training signals that measure compounding error in closed-loop execution, rather than only long-context perplexity, single-turn tool accuracy, or aggregate benchmark pass rate.
summary_en.technical_approach: The experimental design separates the number of required steps from the amount of context processed. The study evaluates nine models: six open models ranging from 1.2B to 671B parameters and three deployed proprietary systems. It uses four task families, including a genuinely agentic tool-use loop, five horizon levels, and three context regimes. The tasks are oracle-verifiable, reducing evaluator noise. The main model is simple: if each step succeeds with probability r, a task with horizon H should succeed with probability roughly r^H. The design then tests whether observed success follows this curve and whether degradation is better explained by horizon or by context length.
summary_en.experiments: The main finding is that 28 of 36 model-task cells follow a geometric degradation pattern governed by a measurable per-step reliability parameter. The collapse is especially severe on the agentic tool-use task, where local errors propagate through subsequent actions and observations. The study also reports signs of increasing hazard within a trajectory, meaning later steps can become riskier after earlier partial failures or accumulated state complexity. A notable result is that bounding context does not improve performance; it worsens it in the reported setting. This supports the claim that step count, rather than context length alone, is the dominant driver of degradation in these controlled workflows. The benchmark implication is that short-to-medium horizon evaluations can sit on the flat part of the decay curve and miss production failure modes.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the task construction and the three context regimes, because the credibility of the step-count-versus-context-length claim depends on this design. Then inspect the success-versus-horizon plots, the geometric fits, and the 28-of-36 model-task result. The agentic tool-use loop deserves the most attention, since it is closer to deployed agent behavior than structured-output probes. End with the benchmark-gap analysis and practical recommendations. The useful takeaway for pretraining work is not model ranking, but the role of per-step reliability as an intermediate metric for long-horizon capability, RL reward decomposition, training-data selection, and evaluation design.

recommendation.zh: 把“长链路必崩”用单参数几何律钉死了，适合用来反推训练/评测该怎么设 horizon；只看拟合曲线和分解实验就够。
recommendation.en: It nails long-horizon collapse with a one-parameter geometric law—useful to back-solve horizon choices for training/eval; focus on the fitted curves and factorized regimes.

paper.title: APEx: Distillation of Agent Procedural Experience for Adaptive Deep Research Question Answering
paper.abstract: Deep research agents augment large language models with external tools to answer complex, long-horizon questions through multi-turn reasoning. Learning from prior experience is crucial for continual improvement, yet existing methods either retrieve verbose task-specific traces that burden decision-making, or distill procedural skills that remain decoupled from downstream policy adaptation. We propose APEx, a hierarchical experience utilization framework that organizes interaction history into in

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 deep research agent 的长期经验如何真正转化为后续任务收益，而不是停留在“把旧轨迹塞回上下文”这一层。作者指出两类常见失败：一类是 episodic memory 直接检索长轨迹，信息冗长、任务绑定强，推理时还要临场抽象策略；另一类是 procedural memory 虽然把经验压成技能，但技能生成与下游策略优化脱节，无法保证这些技能真的有助于规划与执行。APEx 想解决的是：如何把实例级经验、类别级程序性技能、测试时在线适应和强化学习信号接成一个闭环，让 agent 在无标注真实查询上也能持续改进。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接启发不在“问答 agent 又提了几分”，而在两个更底层的问题。第一，它把 memory 从静态检索对象改成了可被奖励信号塑形的程序先验，这和 pretrain/post-train 接口里的“经验如何沉淀为参数化能力”是同一类问题。第二，它把 test-time RL、技能蒸馏、轨迹积累放进同一循环，提供了一个接近 continual post-training 的范式：模型不是只靠离线 SFT/RL 学会工具使用，而是在部署中把新经验重新写回技能库与策略。若把 agent 视为带外部工具和长期记忆的语言模型，这篇工作的价值主要在训练闭环设计，而不是单点模块创新。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，APEx 维护两层经验表示。实例层 memory 保存具体查询的执行轨迹摘要，保留可检索的操作细节；类别层 skill 则按 category-modality bucket 聚合多条经验，蒸馏成可复用的程序性指导。推理时，给定查询 q，系统先路由到对应桶，检索相关实例记忆 R_M(q) 与类别技能 R_S(q)，再把两者组织成结构化上下文 E(q) 供 Planner 生成研究计划。Executor 根据计划进行多轮工具调用，产出轨迹 τ 和最终答案。执行后，轨迹会被摘要写回实例记忆；当某一类别积累到足够多新经验时，Distiller 更新该类别技能。

核心设计不只是层次化记忆，而是三模块闭环：Planner 负责把技能和记忆转成当前任务计划，Executor 负责与工具环境交互，Distiller 负责把新轨迹抽象成技能。三者不是独立训练，而是用三阶段交替 GRPO 优化。文中强调这样做是为了解决跨模块 credit assignment：如果直接端到端混训，Distiller 生成的技能质量很难通过最终任务回报稳定反传；交替训练则让每个模块在相对固定的其余模块条件下接收更清晰的相对奖励。这里的关键点是，skill distillation 不再是 prompt-based summarization，而是 reward-guided policy learning。

另一个值得注意的部分是 Skill-guided TTRL。部署时，Planner 在无标注查询上做 test-time reinforcement learning，检索到的 skill 和 memory 作为程序先验，约束在线适应不要偏离已有高质量经验。作者把它写成“用技能正则化在线策略更新”：不是从零在测试时探索，而是在已有程序模板附近做局部适配。随后，适配后产生的新轨迹又进入记忆库，并在后续触发技能更新，形成经验—技能—策略的循环。这个思路和传统 RAG memory 的区别很明确：后者主要提升当前样本，前者试图让当前样本反过来改进未来策略。
summary.experiments:
文中给出的主结果是，在多个 deep research benchmark 上，APEx 平均成绩达到 64.4%，比 GPT-5.4 高 14.7 个点，比最强 memory-augmented baseline 高 3.0 个点。就论文定位而言，后一个比较更重要，因为它说明收益不只是来自更强底模，而是来自经验组织与训练方式。

作者还强调了一个 context efficiency 结果：只使用 skill 的变体在注入更少 memory token 的情况下仍保持较强性能，说明类别级程序技能确实比平铺式轨迹检索更紧凑。这一点对长上下文 agent 很关键，因为很多 memory 方法的真实瓶颈不是检索不到，而是检索后上下文成本过高、噪声过大。

从全文描述看，实验重点还包括三类消融。第一，去掉层次化经验，只保留 flat memory retrieval，性能下降，说明实例记忆和类别技能各自承担不同角色。第二，去掉 reward-guided Distiller 或不用交替 GRPO，技能质量与最终任务表现都会变差，支持“技能蒸馏需要由下游回报塑形”的论点。第三，去掉 skill-guided TTRL 后，在线适应收益减弱，说明测试时更新若没有程序先验，容易变成高方差探索。摘要里没有给出所有消融数字，精读时需要回到主表和附录核对具体幅度、benchmark 构成、工具集设置以及 no-ground-truth reward 的定义。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，不必逐段细抠。先看 Introduction，重点抓作者如何界定 episodic / reflective / procedural memory 的缺口，以及为什么一定要把 distillation 和 downstream RL 接起来。然后直接看方法总览图 Figure 2，理解 query 路由、双层经验检索、Planner-Executor-Distiller 闭环和 TTRL 的数据流。接着看三阶段 alternating GRPO 的训练描述，确认每个阶段优化谁、奖励从哪里来、为什么比联合训练稳定。最后看主结果表和消融表，重点判断三件事：层次化经验是否真优于 flat retrieval；skill-only 是否真的更省 token；TTRL 的收益是否稳健。

如果时间有限，30 分钟足够建立方法轮廓。若要深挖，建议额外看附录里的 retrieval 细节、bucket 定义、奖励设计和 memory update 触发条件，因为这些工程选择很可能决定方法是否能迁移到别的 agent setting。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how a deep research agent can convert accumulated interaction history into future task improvement, rather than merely retrieving old trajectories at inference time. The authors identify two recurring failure modes. Episodic memory retrieves long, task-specific traces and forces the model to infer reusable strategy on the fly. Procedural memory compresses experience into skills, but those skills are often produced independently of downstream policy optimization, so they are not guaranteed to help planning or execution. APEx targets the missing loop: instance-level experience, category-level procedural skills, test-time adaptation, and RL signals should reinforce each other instead of operating as separate components.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model research is less about the benchmark score itself and more about the training loop it proposes. First, it turns memory from a static retrieval artifact into a reward-shaped procedural prior. That is closely related to the broader pretrain/post-train question of how experience becomes reusable capability. Second, it combines test-time RL, skill distillation, and trajectory accumulation into a continual-improvement pipeline. This resembles continual post-training for tool-using LMs: the model does not only learn from offline SFT or RL, but also writes deployment experience back into both a skill repository and the policy. For researchers interested in agentic LMs, the main contribution is the closed-loop optimization design.
summary_en.technical_approach:
APEx maintains two levels of experience. Instance-level memory stores summarized execution traces for concrete queries, preserving operational details that can later be retrieved. Category-level skills aggregate many experiences within a category-modality bucket and distill them into reusable procedural guidance. At inference time, a query q is routed to a bucket, relevant memories R_M(q) and the corresponding skill R_S(q) are retrieved, and both are packed into a structured context E(q). The Planner uses E(q) to generate a research plan. The Executor follows that plan through multi-turn tool interaction and produces a trajectory τ and a final answer. After execution, the trajectory is summarized into a new memory entry, and once enough fresh experience accumulates, the Distiller updates the category-level skill.

The key idea is not just hierarchical memory, but the Executor-Distiller-Planner loop. Planner converts retrieved experience into a task-specific plan, Executor interacts with tools, and Distiller abstracts new trajectories into procedural skills. These modules are trained with a three-stage alternating GRPO schedule rather than a single joint objective. The motivation is cross-module credit assignment: if everything is optimized end-to-end at once, it is difficult for final task reward to shape the quality of distilled skills in a stable way. Alternating optimization gives each module a cleaner relative-reward signal while the others are partially fixed. In that sense, skill distillation is treated as reward-guided policy learning, not prompt-based summarization.

Another notable component is skill-guided TTRL. During deployment, the Planner performs test-time reinforcement learning on unlabeled queries, while retrieved skills and memories act as procedural priors that regularize online adaptation. The model is therefore not exploring from scratch at test time; it adapts locally around previously distilled high-quality procedures. The resulting improved trajectories are then written back into memory and can later trigger skill updates. This is the main conceptual difference from standard memory-augmented retrieval: retrieval helps the current sample, but APEx is designed so that the current sample also improves future behavior.
summary_en.experiments:
The headline result reported in the paper is an average score of 64.4% across deep research benchmarks. This is 14.7 points above GPT-5.4 and 3.0 points above the strongest memory-augmented baseline. For judging the method, the second comparison matters more, because it isolates the gain from experience organization and training rather than from a stronger base model.

The paper also highlights a context-efficiency result: a skill-only variant remains competitive while injecting fewer memory tokens. That supports the claim that category-level procedural skills are a more compact carrier of useful experience than flat trajectory retrieval. This matters for long-context agents, where the bottleneck is often not retrieval quality but context budget and retrieval noise.

From the full text, the experimental story appears to rely on three main ablation axes. First, replacing hierarchical experience with flat memory retrieval hurts performance, suggesting that instance memories and category skills play different roles. Second, removing reward-guided distillation or the alternating GRPO schedule degrades both skill quality and downstream task performance, supporting the claim that useful skills must be shaped by task reward. Third, removing skill-guided TTRL weakens online adaptation, indicating that test-time updates without procedural priors become high-variance exploration. The abstract does not provide all ablation numbers, so the main tables and appendix are the right place to verify effect sizes, benchmark composition, tool setup, and the exact definition of the no-ground-truth reward.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper rather than a line-by-line read. Start with the introduction and focus on how the authors separate episodic, reflective, and procedural memory, and why they insist that distillation must be coupled to downstream RL. Then jump to the method overview figure and trace the data flow: query routing, two-level retrieval, the Planner-Executor-Distiller loop, and TTRL. After that, read the alternating GRPO section carefully enough to understand which module is optimized in each stage, where the reward comes from, and why this is expected to be more stable than joint training. Finish with the main results and ablations, checking three questions: does hierarchical experience beat flat retrieval, does the skill-only variant really save context, and is the TTRL gain robust.

If time is limited, about 30 minutes is enough to understand the design. If you want to go deeper, inspect the appendix for retrieval details, bucket construction, reward design, and memory-update triggers. Those implementation choices are likely to determine whether the method transfers to other agent settings.

recommendation.zh: 看训练闭环和测试时 RL 部分即可；setup 若评测不够干净，结论只能当 agent-memory 设计信号。
recommendation.en: Skim the training loop and test-time RL pieces; if evaluation is noisy, treat the result as an agent-memory design signal rather than a firm scaling result.

paper.title: Repo-To-Skill: Distilling GitHub Repositories Into AI4AI Skills
paper.abstract: Autonomous agents are beginning to carry out machine-learning (ML) research end to end. These agents combine a model backbone with a harness for planning, execution, memory, and verification, but this architecture still leaves domain-specific know-how outside the agent. We call this missing layer operational knowledge, the know-how that separates knowing a method from making it work. That knowledge is not absent from the field. It appears in repositories and papers, but in forms written for huma

summary.core_problem: 解决研究型 agent 只会调用基础模型与工具、却缺少可复用“操作性知识”这一层的问题，尤其是在机器学习研究任务中难以稳定复现仓库经验。
summary.importance: 这是 agent 方法工作，不是基座预训练论文。价值在于把 repository/paper 中面向人的 know-how 蒸馏成可验证、可复用的 skills，属于把外部知识结构化后接入 agent 的路线，对 tool-use、memory、长期能力积累有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DisCo，一个 skill-powered research agent。核心是两类技能蒸馏：task-agnostic，把领域内常用 GitHub 仓库压缩成通用技能；task-oriented，围绕具体任务再生成定制技能。技能不是原始长上下文检索，而是更紧凑、可验证、可在后续任务中复用的操作单元，然后由 agent 在规划、执行、验证过程中调用。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示其应用于 AI4AI 研究代理场景，重点验证 repository-to-skill 蒸馏能否提升端到端研究任务表现。未见清晰的基座模型规模、训练 token 或预训练设置；更像系统级 agent 实验，而非 clean 的方法学 ablation。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles the missing layer of reusable operational know-how in research agents, especially for ML research tasks where repository-level practice is hard to recover reliably from a backbone model alone.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-method paper, not a foundation pretraining paper. Its value is in distilling human-facing repository and paper knowledge into compact, verifiable, reusable skills, which is relevant to tool use, memory, and capability accumulation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes DisCo, a skill-powered research agent. The key idea is two complementary forms of skill distillation: task-agnostic distillation that compresses widely used GitHub repositories into reusable skills, and task-oriented distillation that produces skills tailored to a concrete task. These skills are then invoked during planning, execution, and verification instead of relying purely on long-context retrieval.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the system is evaluated in AI4AI research-agent settings, focusing on whether repository-to-skill distillation improves end-to-end research performance. There is no clear pretraining-scale setup, token budget, or model-training recipe; this reads more like a systems-agent evaluation than a clean methodological study.

recommendation.zh: 更像 agent memory/knowledge packaging，不会直接改你的 pretrain prior；若你关心“仓库知识能否变成可复用技能”，只看 skill distillation 设计即可。
recommendation.en: This is more about agent memory and knowledge packaging than pretraining; if you care whether repo know-how can become reusable skills, read only the distillation design.

paper.title: Harness Engineering: Anatomy, Architecture, and Evolution of Coding Agents -- A Source-Code Study of Eleven Systems
paper.abstract: An agent is a model plus a harness -- the runtime that couples an LLM to the world through a loop, tools, context management, safety controls, orchestration, and extension surfaces. Harness engineering, named as a discipline in early 2026, is the design and evolution of that runtime. This paper gives the young discipline its most comprehensive empirical foundation to date: a source-code anatomy of eleven production coding harnesses (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Mistral Vibe, OpenHands, Ai

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究 coding agent 的 harness，即把 LLM 接到工具、文件系统、命令行、上下文管理、安全策略和执行循环上的运行时系统。它要回答的问题不是模型能力如何提升，而是生产级 coding agent 的运行时由哪些子系统组成、不同实现如何取舍、这些实现近几个月如何演化。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接贡献较弱，主要价值在 agent 系统和 post-train 接口。它提醒一个事实：代码任务上的可用能力很大一部分来自 harness，而不是模型权重本身。对预训练研究的间接启发在于，若用 coding-agent 轨迹做 SFT/RL 数据，或用 SWE 类 benchmark 评价模型，需要区分模型能力、工具协议、上下文压缩、编辑格式和安全策略的贡献，否则训练信号会混入大量 harness 偏差。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是源码级经验研究。研究对象包括 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI、Mistral Vibe、OpenHands、Aider、Mini-SWE-Agent、Hermes、Pi、OpenCode、OpenClaw，并把 Databricks Omnigent 作为 meta-harness 对照。它把 harness 拆成七类 canonical subsystem：执行循环、工具接口、上下文管理、安全控制、编排、扩展面以及与会话/状态相关的运行时机制。分析给出每类子系统的最小实现和复杂实现，并归纳 13 个横向观察与 29 个复用模式，例如 agent-maintained memory pipeline、verify-on-stop guard、lineage compaction、session-tree version control、log-as-queue loop、syntax-aware command permissioning、cache-dialect fanout 和 harness mimicry。它还对其中 8 个系统做了约 90 天的源码 diff，观察 hook vocabulary、plugin format、session importer 和配置化安全策略的扩散。
summary.experiments: 这不是机器学习实验，而是工程系统审计。主要结果是定性和结构化归纳：研究覆盖 11 个 coding harness 与 1 个 meta-harness，快照时间固定到 2026 年 7 月；8 个系统保留了 2026 年 4 月版本用于纵向比较。作者报告两个经验性缺失：没有系统使用通用 agentic framework 作为运行时核心，也没有系统使用 embedding-based retrieval over code。另一个结论是 harness 正在从单一工具变成平台形态，表现为 SDK、插件/skill 机制、跨供应商 session importer、治理接口和 model gateway。需要注意，部分商业系统源码来源和可复现性可能难以独立验证，阅读时应把它当作工程观察材料，而不是可重复 benchmark。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 35 到 45 分钟。优先看 harness 定义和七个子系统的 anatomy，再看系统对照表和 29 个模式目录。若只关心 LLM 训练，重点看 context management、edit format、verification guard、session/memory 机制和安全策略如何影响 agent 轨迹质量。Section 14.5 的纵向演化值得扫读，它能帮助判断哪些 agent 行为来自模型，哪些来自 harness 的版本变化。18 条 design recommendation 可作为工程 checklist，但不必逐条精读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the harness around coding agents: the runtime that connects an LLM to tools, files, shells, context management, safety policies, execution loops, and extension mechanisms. The core question is not how to train a better model, but what production coding-agent runtimes are made of, how major implementations differ, and how these systems have changed over a short time window.
summary_en.importance: The direct relevance to foundation-model pretraining is limited. Its value is mostly in agent infrastructure and the interface between model training and post-training data. The useful lesson for model researchers is that coding-agent performance is strongly shaped by the harness. If SWE-style traces are used for SFT/RL, or if coding-agent benchmarks are used to judge base model progress, the effects of tool protocol, context budgeting, edit format, verification guards, and safety policy need to be separated from the model weights. Otherwise the training signal can encode harness-specific behavior rather than general coding ability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is a source-code study of eleven coding harnesses: Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Mistral Vibe, OpenHands, Aider, Mini-SWE-Agent, Hermes, Pi, OpenCode, and OpenClaw, with Databricks Omnigent analyzed as a meta-harness contrast case. The paper decomposes a harness into seven canonical subsystems covering the agent loop, tools, context management, safety controls, orchestration, extension surfaces, and session/state mechanisms. It compares minimal and maximal implementations of these subsystems and extracts 13 cross-cutting observations plus 29 recurring patterns, including agent-maintained memory pipelines, verify-on-stop guards, lineage compaction, session-tree version control, log-as-queue loops, syntax-aware command permissions, cache-dialect fanout, and harness mimicry. For eight systems, it also performs a roughly 90-day source diff to study how hooks, plugin formats, session importers, and configurable policies diffuse across implementations.
summary_en.experiments: This is an empirical software-systems audit, not a controlled ML experiment. The main evidence is structural: 11 harnesses plus one meta-harness are pinned to July 2026 snapshots, and eight systems are compared against April 2026 versions. The paper reports two notable absences at this corpus size: no runtime uses a general-purpose agentic framework as its core, and none uses embedding-based retrieval over code. It also argues that harnesses are moving toward platform-like designs, with SDKs, plugin or skill mechanisms, cross-vendor session importers, governance controls, and model-gateway roles. A caveat is that parts of the analysis depend on access to commercial or circulated source snapshots, so reproducibility may be uneven.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 35–45 minutes. Start with the harness definition and the seven-subsystem anatomy, then read the system comparison table and the pattern catalog. For training-oriented readers, the most relevant pieces are context management, edit formats, verification guards, session or memory mechanisms, and safety policies, because these affect the quality and distribution of agent trajectories. The longitudinal section is useful for understanding which behavioral changes may come from harness revisions rather than model updates. The design recommendations can be treated as an engineering checklist rather than a section that requires close reading.

recommendation.zh: 只看子系统 taxonomy 和 29 个 pattern；它能帮你区分模型能力和 harness 红利。
recommendation.en: Skim the subsystem taxonomy and the 29 patterns; it helps separate model capability from harness-driven gains.

paper.title: UI-Venus-2 Technical Report
paper.abstract: Multimodal GUI agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for digital task automation, yet transitioning from benchmark-oriented models to dependable real-world applications remains challenging due to limited environment coverage, brittle task construction, and unreliable reward verification. In this work, we present UI-Venus-2, a general-purpose foundation GUI agent designed to operate across mobile, web, and desktop environments through a unified closed-loop reasoning-action framework. To bri

summary.core_problem: UI-Venus-2 解决的是 GUI agent 从封闭 benchmark 走向真实手机、网页和桌面环境时的三个瓶颈：环境覆盖不足、任务生成不可靠、奖励验证容易误判或被策略利用。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接价值不在模型架构，而在 agent 数据闭环和 RL 训练信号。它把 GUI agent 的能力扩展拆成环境、任务、验证三个共同扩展的问题，而不是只优化下一步动作预测。这个视角对后训练数据构造、在线 RL、可验证交互数据采集有参考意义，尤其是 trace-level / step-level verifier 如何降低 reward hacking。
summary.technical_approach: 方法采用统一的闭环 reasoning–action 框架：模型观察当前界面，推理任务状态，输出点击、输入、滚动、键盘等动作，再根据环境反馈继续决策。系统层面同时扩展三类资源。第一，环境侧覆盖 100+ 中文移动应用、70+ 英文移动应用，并加入原生桌面 OS 与 Web 场景。第二，任务侧用 deep-research pipeline 生成 function-grounded instruction，要求任务来自应用真实功能，而不是模板化或不可执行 query。第三，验证侧从粗粒度 final-screen 判断改为 trace-level 与 sample/step-level 结合，利用任务相关视觉关键点判断是否真正完成，并用多个异构模型投票降低单一 judge 偏差。另一个实用设计是加入 CAPTCHA 处理能力，用于登录、注册等工作流，避免轨迹采集被验证门槛中断。安全机制用于约束更强执行能力下的高风险操作。
summary.experiments: 论文声称在移动、Web、桌面 computer-use、GUI grounding、navigation 和 CAPTCHA solving 等设置上评测 UI-Venus-2，并在同规模模型中达到接近领先的表现。全文片段明确给出的规模信息包括 170+ 多语言移动应用覆盖，其中 100+ 中文应用、70+ 英文应用，以及新增 native desktop OS 能力。可确认的实验重点是环境扩展、任务生成质量、验证机制鲁棒性和多平台泛化；具体 benchmark 分数和消融数字未在给定全文片段中完整出现，阅读时需要回到实验表格核对各环境、各 verifier 设计和 RL 阶段的增益。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。优先看数据与训练 pipeline，而不是只看榜单。重点关注三处：任务生成流程如何保证 executable 与 function-grounded；trace-level / step-level verifier 的输入、判定标准和投票策略；在线 RL 中 reward 是否来自 verifier，是否报告 verifier 误判与 reward hacking 案例。实验部分建议重点看移动、桌面、CAPTCHA 和 verifier ablation，判断性能提升来自环境覆盖、任务质量，还是验证信号变强。

summary_en.core_problem: UI-Venus-2 targets the gap between benchmark-oriented GUI agents and deployable computer-use agents: narrow environment coverage, brittle task construction, and reward verification that can mistake partial progress for completion.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model research is mainly in the agent training loop rather than in core model architecture. The useful lesson is that scaling a GUI agent is not only about predicting the next action better. Environment diversity, executable task generation, and verifier quality have to be scaled together. This is directly relevant to post-training data collection, online RL, and reward design for interactive agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system uses a unified closed-loop reasoning-action interface. The agent observes the rendered UI, reasons about task state, emits human-like actions such as click, type, scroll, and keyboard operations, and then conditions on environment feedback for the next step. The technical report emphasizes three scaling axes. First, the executable environment pool is expanded to mobile apps, web platforms, and native desktop OS, including 100+ Chinese apps and 70+ English apps. Second, task construction uses a deep-research pipeline to generate instructions grounded in actual application functions, aiming to avoid synthetic tasks that are invalid or non-executable. Third, verification is strengthened with trace-level and sample/step-level checks based on task-relevant visual keypoints, plus voting across heterogeneous judge models. CAPTCHA handling is added as a practical capability for login and registration workflows, and safety-aware mechanisms are included for consequential actions.
summary_en.experiments: The provided text reports evaluation across mobile, web, desktop computer-use, GUI grounding, navigation, and CAPTCHA-solving settings. It states that UI-Venus-2 performs near the leading range among comparable-scale open models and releases full-parameter weights plus evaluation infrastructure. The concrete numbers visible in the supplied content are the 170+ multilingual mobile-app coverage, split into 100+ Chinese and 70+ English applications, and the addition of native desktop OS training. Detailed benchmark scores and ablation results are not present in the supplied excerpt, so the main tables should be checked before drawing quantitative conclusions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. The most useful parts are the data and feedback pipeline: how executable tasks are generated, how trace-level and step-level verification are defined, how multiple judges are aggregated, and how the verifier supplies reward for RL. In the experiments, focus on verifier ablations, desktop-use results, mobile multilingual coverage, and CAPTCHA-related data collection. The benchmark table alone is less informative than the error analysis and reward-verification design.

recommendation.zh: 只看任务生成和验证器设计；GUI RL 的瓶颈在 reward 可信度，不在又堆一个轨迹模型。
recommendation.en: Read the task-generation and verifier sections; for GUI RL, reward reliability is the bottleneck, not another trajectory model.

paper.title: Invalidation Contracts for Cross-Episode Agent Memory
paper.abstract: LLM agents that cache recovery suggestions from API errors can skip re-derivation in later episodes, spending fewer tokens and fewer model calls on constraints they have already learned. Server-side data drift turns those cached fixes into silent failures, and the usual remedy, re-deriving on every episode, gives the savings back. We introduce invalidation contracts, a protocol layer that attaches version stamps and cacheability hints to every recovery suggestion so the client can evict stale en

summary.core_problem: 解决跨 episode LLM agent 复用 API 错误恢复经验时，缓存建议会因服务端数据漂移而失效的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 记忆与工具协议设计。它关注的不是模型能力本身，而是如何让 agent memory 在动态外部系统中可失效、可复用、可节省调用成本。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 invalidation contracts：给每条恢复建议附加版本戳和可缓存提示，让客户端在服务端状态变化后只驱逐过期缓存，而不是每次重新推导。作者把收益分解为 validity 和 compliance：前者由协议决定，后者由 planner 模型是否按建议执行决定。
summary.experiments: 实验比较不同 planner 对相同缓存协议的执行差异。摘要给出一个强信号：相同 wire bytes 下，Claude Haiku 4.5 的 first-try compliance 为 100%，Claude Sonnet 5 不超过 11%。完整任务规模、API 环境和 token 节省幅度在摘要中未披露。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses stale cross-episode agent memory: cached recovery suggestions for API errors become silently wrong when server-side data drifts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a protocol-level design for agent memory and tool interaction, not a model-training result. It matters insofar as persistent agent memory needs explicit invalidation semantics in changing external environments.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces invalidation contracts, attaching version stamps and cacheability hints to recovery suggestions so clients can evict stale entries without re-deriving every constraint. The analysis separates realized savings into protocol validity and planner compliance.
summary_en.experiments: The reported experiment compares planner compliance under identical protocol bytes. Claude Haiku 4.5 reaches 100% first-try compliance, while Claude Sonnet 5 is at or below 11%. The abstract does not provide full environment size, benchmark scale, or token-saving numbers.

recommendation.zh: 作为 agent memory 的协议小样本看即可；有用点是把缓存正确性和模型服从性拆开了。
recommendation.en: Worth a quick look for the protocol split between cache validity and model compliance; not a pretraining signal.

paper.title: You Know What I Mean: A Benchmark for Agentic Conversational Reference Grounding
paper.abstract: Collaborative conversations frequently contain references whose targets are indirect rather than named: resolving "this looks like the fix discussed yesterday" requires combining conversational context with evidence from the surrounding workspace which is accessible through APIs or user interfaces. We formalize this problem as Conversational Reference Grounding (CoRG): using a given set of tools to resolve a reference in conversation to the unique external item intended by the speaker. CoRG is c

summary.core_problem: 构建并评估 Conversational Reference Grounding：agent 需要根据对话中的间接指代，通过工具在外部工作区中定位说话人真正指向的唯一对象。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agentic evaluation benchmark。它把 reference resolution 从纯文本上下文扩展到对话、时间线、代码仓库对象和工具调用的组合，对评估真实协作场景中的 tool-use agent 更贴近实际；同时它不是简单 QA，而是要求候选发现、内容检查和排除近似干扰项。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CoRG 任务形式，并发布 RepoRef benchmark。数据包含 400 个开发者聊天片段，目标对象来自 GitHub issues、pull requests 和 commits，覆盖 92 个 repositories。agent 需要使用给定 API 或 UI 工具，把词汇、语义、时间和外部元数据线索转化为检索与验证策略。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、baseline 和分数。可确认 benchmark 规模为 400 个 grounded developer-chat segments，覆盖 92 个 GitHub repositories，外部对象类型包括 issue、PR 和 commit。
summary.authors_note: Bar-Ilan University 与 Allen Institute for AI 合作；Yoav Goldberg 是 NLP 领域知名研究者，长期研究语言理解、句法语义与模型分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper defines Conversational Reference Grounding, where an agent must resolve an indirect conversational reference to the unique intended external workspace item using tools.
summary_en.importance: This is an agentic evaluation benchmark. It moves reference resolution beyond plain text into a mix of conversation, time, repository artifacts, and tool use, making it closer to collaborative work settings than ordinary QA.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formalize CoRG and introduce RepoRef, a benchmark with 400 developer-chat segments grounded in GitHub issues, pull requests, and commits across 92 repositories. Agents must combine lexical, semantic, temporal, and metadata cues through API or UI tools to discover, inspect, and rule out candidates.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model baselines or scores. The benchmark contains 400 grounded developer-chat segments from 92 GitHub repositories, with target items spanning issues, pull requests, and commits.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from Bar-Ilan University and the Allen Institute for AI. Yoav Goldberg is a well-known NLP researcher with influential work in language understanding, syntax/semantics, and model analysis.

recommendation.zh: 看任务定义和数据构造就够；它补上了 tool agent 常缺的“含糊指代到外部对象”评测缺口。
recommendation.en: Read the task definition and dataset construction; it fills a missing evaluation slot for tool agents: vague references grounded to external objects.

paper.title: AgentLogs: A Dataset for Opening the Black Box of GitHub's Cloud Agent
paper.abstract: Generative AI-based software engineering agents are becoming routine contributors to real-world software projects. On GitHub, developers can assign tasks to the Copilot cloud agent, which autonomously explores the repository, edits code, runs commands, and opens or reviews pull requests, producing a detailed log of every step along the way. While existing datasets capture outcomes of agent contributions, such as agent-authored pull requests, the process by which agents produce these contribution

summary.core_problem: 软件工程Agent研究缺少“过程级”可观测数据，导致难以分析真实世界Agent如何用工具、如何失败与如何消耗token/算力。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是大规模真实日志数据集（过程而非结果），可用于训练/评测代码Agent、研究tool-use分布、失败模式、以及把“执行轨迹”纳入后训练与评估。
summary.technical_approach: 从GitHub热门公共仓库扫描并收集Copilot cloud agent任务与会话日志，提供逐步log条目：提示词、（可能包含的）中间推理、工具调用（文件编辑、git操作、GitHub交互）、token使用等，并强调用该数据打开agent黑箱、支持行为分析与建模。
summary.experiments: 数据规模：307,416个agent tasks、549,239个sessions、35,810个仓库、64,255,174条log entries；摘要未描述基于该数据的强基线或系统性benchmark协议（更像数据发布）。

summary_en.core_problem: SE agent research lacks process-level observability, making it hard to analyze how real-world agents use tools, fail, and spend tokens/compute.
summary_en.importance: Main contribution is a large-scale real-world process-log dataset (not just outcomes), enabling training/evaluation of coding agents, tool-use distribution studies, failure-mode analysis, and trajectory-aware post-training/eval.
summary_en.technical_approach: Scans popular public GitHub repos and collects Copilot cloud agent tasks and session logs, exposing step-by-step entries: prompts, (potential) intermediate reasoning, tool calls (file edits, git ops, GitHub interactions), and token usage.
summary_en.experiments: Scale: 307,416 tasks, 549,239 sessions, 35,810 repos, 64,255,174 log entries; the abstract does not mention strong baselines or a full benchmark protocol (primarily a dataset release).

recommendation.zh: 真实世界“过程日志”比SWE-bench式结果集更接近可训练信号；重点看日志字段设计与token/工具调用统计，后续可直接做轨迹建模或失败预测。
recommendation.en: Real-world process logs are closer to actionable training signals than outcome-only datasets; focus on the log schema and token/tool-call stats—this can directly fuel trajectory modeling or failure prediction.

paper.title: ATLAS: Dual-Horizon Diagnostic Evaluation for Industrial Tool-Use Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in user-facing services that require iterative tool use under dynamic business conditions. Reliable evaluation is essential for sustained improvement: it must reveal capability deficiencies, inform priorities, and assess interventions. Yet industrial agent service unfolds both through the iterative trajectory of a current request and through continued user interaction. Final-outcome assessment can therefore obscure where deficiencies ar

summary.core_problem: 解决工业级 Tool-Use Agent 评估中，仅看最终结果无法诊断多轮交互和长程服务中具体缺陷的问题。
summary.importance: 提出了一个双视角的诊断性评估框架（ATLAS），区分了单次请求的轨迹（request horizon）和持续的用户交互（interaction horizon），为工业 Agent 提供了更细粒度的评估方法。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ATLAS 框架：1) Request horizon：提供 trajectory-wise 的诊断信号，将缺陷定位到具体的执行步骤和能力短板；2) Interaction horizon：提供 user-wise 的信号，评估 Agent 在持续交互中是否保持响应性和上下文一致性。
summary.experiments: 提出了评估框架，未提及具体模型参数或 baseline 对比，重点在于评估方法论的构建。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the limitation of final-outcome evaluation for industrial tool-use agents, which fails to diagnose specific deficiencies in multi-turn interactions and long-horizon services.
summary_en.importance: Proposes ATLAS, a dual-horizon diagnostic evaluation framework that distinguishes between single-request trajectories and continuous user interactions, providing finer-grained evaluation for industrial agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the ATLAS framework: 1) Request horizon: provides trajectory-wise diagnostic signals linking deficiencies to execution steps and capability gaps; 2) Interaction horizon: provides user-wise signals assessing responsiveness and context alignment across continuous interactions.
summary_en.experiments: Proposes an evaluation framework; does not mention specific model parameters or baseline comparisons, focusing on the evaluation methodology.

recommendation.zh: 工业界 Agent 评估的经验总结，区分了单次 trajectory 和跨 session 交互的评估维度，对构建 Agent 评测体系有工程参考价值。
recommendation.en: An industrial perspective on Agent evaluation, distinguishing between single-trajectory and cross-session interaction metrics; useful engineering reference for building Agent evaluation systems.

paper.title: Learning Simple Test-Time Environments for LLM Web Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in manually constructed environments, yet their performance frequently collapses when transitioned to complex real-world settings. Existing research largely attribute this degradation to the compositional generalization gaps in LLMs on combinations of multiple simple, well-structured environments. In this work, we propose that LLM web agents can learn simple environment observations at test time. Specifically, we introduc

summary.core_problem: 该工作解决 LLM Web Agent 在复杂真实网页中组合泛化失败的问题：单个页面同时包含多个功能区域，模型难以从冗余观察中定位与当前决策相关的局部上下文。
summary.importance: 对预训练方向的直接贡献有限，但对 post-train 与 test-time adaptation 有参考价值。它把失败原因从“任务太长、奖励太稀疏”进一步拆到“观察空间没有被结构化”。这对训练数据构造、网页轨迹合成、agent RL reward 设计都有启发：与其直接在完整网页上学策略，不如让模型先学会把环境分解成可操作的局部决策单元。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 TTED，即 Test-Time Environment Decomposition。核心做法是在正式执行前加入 trial step，让 agent 将复杂网页观察拆成多个 sub-module，每个模块由子目标和相关子观察组成。之后 agent 不直接在完整页面上更新行为，而是在这些局部环境中利用交互经验做适配。单轮、静态网页场景下，TTED 用 in-context learning 保存试探经验；多轮真实网页场景下，TTED 用 RL 跨步骤、跨任务收集经验。反馈信号主要来自模型自评，而不是人工标签或真实环境奖励。这个选择有现实意义：真实 WebArena 类任务的 ground-truth reward 稀缺且延迟，局部自评虽然有噪声，但在分解后的环境中更容易稳定。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖合成和真实网页任务。作者扩展了 CompWoB，构造 CompWoB+，用于系统控制环境组合复杂度。结果显示，当页面组合复杂度上升时，普通 agent 的探索成功率和自评准确率都会下降；TTED-ICL 能缓解这种退化。真实环境上，TTED-RL 在 WebArena 上提升泛化表现，并报告超过使用 ground-truth reward 训练的 RL 版本。该工作还分析了 self-assessment 质量、在 WorkArena 上的分布外泛化、数据规模与环境规模影响，以及 RL 算法设计。摘要和引言未给出关键表格中的具体数值，精确提升幅度需要看实验表。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看三部分：第一，Figure 1 对失败模式的拆解，尤其是探索成功率和自评准确率如何随环境复杂度下降；第二，TTED 的环境分解定义和 trial step 设计，看它如何把完整 MDP 转成局部决策上下文；第三，WebArena 和 WorkArena 实验，重点比较 TTED-RL、普通 test-time learning、ground-truth reward RL 的差异。对预训练研究员而言，最有用的是它对“可学习环境结构”的建模，而不是网页任务本身。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses a failure mode of LLM web agents in realistic web environments: a single observation contains many functional regions, and the agent fails to isolate the local context that matters for the next decision.
summary_en.importance: Its direct contribution to base pretraining is limited, but it is useful for thinking about the pretrain–posttrain interface for agents. The key signal is that web-agent failures are not only caused by long horizons or sparse rewards. They also come from unstructured observations. This suggests a training recipe where models learn to decompose environments into local decision units before learning full trajectories.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method is TTED, Test-Time Environment Decomposition. It inserts a trial step before normal execution. During this step, the agent partitions a complex web observation into sub-modules, each with a sub-goal and a task-relevant sub-observation. The agent then adapts its behavior inside these local contexts rather than optimizing directly in the full page. For single-turn static pages, TTED uses in-context learning to reuse trial experience. For multi-step realistic web tasks, it uses reinforcement learning over collected interaction experience. The feedback is mainly model self-assessment, not human labels or ground-truth rewards. This design is motivated by the fact that real web rewards are sparse, delayed, and expensive, while local decomposition makes self-assessment less brittle.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers both synthetic and realistic web tasks. The authors extend CompWoB into CompWoB+ to control and scale environment composition complexity. They report that standard agents suffer lower exploration success and weaker self-assessment as composition complexity grows, while TTED with ICL reduces this degradation. On realistic WebArena tasks, TTED with RL improves generalization and is reported to outperform RL trained with ground-truth rewards. The paper also analyzes self-assessment quality, out-of-distribution transfer to WorkArena, data and environment scaling, and RL algorithm choices. The provided main text does not expose exact table-level numbers, so the precise gains should be checked in the experimental tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is enough, around 20–30 minutes. Focus on three parts: Figure 1 for the failure decomposition; the formal TTED setup for how a full MDP is converted into local decision contexts; and the WebArena/WorkArena results for the comparison between TTED-RL, standard test-time learning, and ground-truth-reward RL. For a pretraining researcher, the useful part is the treatment of learnable environment structure, not the web benchmark itself.

recommendation.zh: 看 TTED 的 trial-step 设计即可；它像 agent 版 test-time learning，但证据强度取决于环境是否可被干净分解。
recommendation.en: Skim the trial-step design; it is test-time learning for agents, with validity tied to whether environments decompose cleanly.

institutions: Institute for AI Industry Research, Tsinghua University
Institute for AI Industry Research (AIR), Tsinghua University

paper.title: Reachability-Based Capability Confinement for LLM Agents under Indirect Prompt Injection
paper.abstract: Large language model agents place outputs from external skills into their execution context, allowing attacker-controlled data to influence later privileged actions. Existing defenses mainly classify untrusted content or authorize proposed operations. They do not directly address how an agent's future authority should change once untrusted data enters its state. We present SkillGuard, a harness-level enforcement layer that treats this event as contamination and restricts future capabilities to d

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM agent 在受到间接 prompt injection 后，外部不可信数据进入状态并影响后续高权限工具调用的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是通用 agent 安全系统方法：不再只分类不可信内容或授权单次操作，而是把污染后的 agent 状态与未来能力集合绑定，控制其是否能到达部署者定义的 forbidden states。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SkillGuard，一个 harness-level enforcement layer。它把不可信数据进入状态视为 contamination，用 Skill Impact Graph 表示安全相关状态转移，用 steerability signatures 描述 skill 参数可控性，并通过 inline reference monitor 中介工具调用；污染后用 binary、fractional 或 fractional-flow 策略计算加权 capability restrictions，且不依赖额外 LM 推理。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体模型、任务集、攻击集或量化结果。可确认的技术设定是基于 sound skill summaries 和 policies，在 agent 执行层做能力约束，而非在模型输出层做文本分类。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses indirect prompt injection in LLM agents, where untrusted tool outputs enter the execution state and later influence privileged actions.
summary_en.importance: It is a general agent-security systems contribution. Instead of only classifying untrusted content or authorizing individual operations, it constrains future capabilities after contamination to prevent reachability of deployer-defined forbidden states.
summary_en.technical_approach: SkillGuard is a harness-level enforcement layer. It models security-relevant transitions with a Skill Impact Graph, specifies admissible control over skill parameters through steerability signatures, and mediates invocations with an inline reference monitor. After contamination, it computes binary, fractional, or fractional-flow capability restrictions without auxiliary LM inference.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report concrete models, benchmarks, attack sets, or quantitative gains. The key setup is execution-layer capability restriction under sound skill summaries and policies, rather than output-level text classification.

recommendation.zh: agent 安全里 setup 比常见分类器更干净；看 Skill Impact Graph 和 restriction 策略即可。
recommendation.en: A cleaner setup than classifier-style agent defenses; skim the Skill Impact Graph and restriction strategies.

paper.title: SkillSafetyBench: Evaluating Agent Safety under Skill-Facing Attack Surfaces
paper.abstract: Reusable skills are becoming a common interface for extending large language model agents, packaging procedural guidance with access to files, tools, memory, and execution environments. However, this modularity introduces attack surfaces that are largely missed by existing safety evaluations: even when the user request is benign, unsafe influence may reside in skill guidance, local artifacts, or execution-environment files that steer the agent toward unsafe actions. We present SkillSafetyBench,

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM agent 在“技能包”接口下的安全失效：用户请求本身无害，但技能说明、本地文件或执行环境可诱导 agent 做出危险行为。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent safety benchmark。它把安全评测从用户 prompt 扩展到技能、文件、工具和执行环境这些非用户输入面，补上了现有 agent 评测中容易漏掉的一类攻击面。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SkillSafetyBench，一个可运行的评测集，包含 155 个对抗案例、47 个任务、6 个风险域和 30 个安全类别。每个案例配有特定规则验证器，用来判断 agent 是否执行了不安全行为。方法重点不是训练模型，而是构造技能侧攻击和可复现实验环境。
summary.experiments: 在多个 CLI agent 和不同模型后端上评测。结果显示，非用户来源的攻击可以稳定诱导不安全行为，并且不同风险域、攻击方式、agent scaffold 与模型组合呈现不同失败模式。摘要未给出具体模型清单和完整数值表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates safety failures in LLM agents when reusable skills, local artifacts, or execution-environment files carry unsafe instructions despite a benign user request.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an agent-safety benchmark. It moves the threat model beyond user-prompt attacks and tests skill-facing surfaces that are increasingly common in tool-using agent systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: SkillSafetyBench is a runnable benchmark with 155 adversarial cases over 47 tasks, 6 risk domains, and 30 safety categories. Each case uses a case-specific rule-based verifier to check whether the agent took an unsafe action. The work is mainly an evaluation asset rather than a training method.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark is run on multiple CLI agents and model backends. The reported finding is that non-user attacks can consistently induce unsafe behavior, with different failure patterns across domains, attack methods, and scaffold-model pairings. The abstract does not expose the full model list or detailed tables.

recommendation.zh: 预训练侧不用细读；做 agent 后训练或安全数据设计时，看攻击面 taxonomy 和 verifier 设计即可。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining read; if you build agent post-training or safety data, inspect the attack taxonomy and verifier design.

paper.title: Fidelity Is Not Enough: Dispatch-Level Instrumentation for Agentic Datasheet Extraction
paper.abstract: One model passed our fidelity check without ever opening the datasheet. We found it while qualifying models for an internal extraction service: a structured-output constraint had silently disabled tool use, and the model answered anyway, with fabricated source text. Only the per-tool trace exposed it. Fidelity -- whether an extracted value matches the source -- is the standard measure for agentic document extraction, and it scores that run a success. We therefore log every tool call in an agenti

summary.core_problem: 仅用抽取值是否匹配源文档来评价 agentic document extraction，会漏掉模型没有正确调用工具却碰巧给出正确答案的 silent failure。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 评测 instrumentation。场景是 datasheet 抽取，偏应用，但它指出了工具调用任务中 outcome-only metric 的盲区。
summary.technical_approach: 论文在 37 个手工 claims 的 agentic benchmark 中记录每次工具调用的 dispatch trace，并基于 trace 构建两个工具：一个规则式失败归因分类器，一个只检查工具调用而不看抽取值的 silent-failure detector。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 3 个组件上的 25 个 claims，加上第 4 个组件的 12 个 claims，总计 37 个 claims。detector 在三个模型家族的 207 次干净且 fidelity-passing 的抽取上没有误报，并找回所有 50 个被植入的工具缺失故障。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Infineon Technologies AG。

summary_en.core_problem: Evaluating agentic document extraction only by whether the extracted value matches the source can miss silent failures where the model never used the required tool.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is agent-evaluation instrumentation. The setting is datasheet extraction and thus application-heavy, but the failure mode is relevant to tool-use evaluation more broadly.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors log every tool call in an agentic benchmark of 37 hand-curated claims and build two trace-based instruments: a rule-based failure-attribution classifier and a silent-failure detector that checks only which tools were called, not the extracted value.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark has 25 claims over three components plus 12 claims on a fourth component. The detector raises no flags on 207 clean fidelity-passing extractions across three model families and recovers all 50 planted faults that withhold the checked tools.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Infineon Technologies AG.

recommendation.zh: 领域很窄，但“答案对也可能是坏轨迹”这个坑真实；做 tool-use eval 时扫一眼 trace 规则即可。
recommendation.en: The domain is narrow, but the “right answer, wrong trajectory” failure is real; skim the trace rules if you evaluate tool use.

paper.title: Learning to Use Tools: Reinforcement Learning for Tool-Integrated Mathematical Reasoning
paper.abstract: Current large language models (LLMs) increasingly benefit from external tool integration, especially for tasks requiring reliable computation and verification. Motivated by this, we study calculator tool calling for improving mathematical reasoning on the Countdown task. We first analyze reasoning failures and find that calculation errors account for a substantial portion of incorrect responses. We then construct supervised fine-tuning datasets to teach the model useful tool-use patterns and how

summary.core_problem: 如何通过强化学习（RL）有效整合外部工具（如计算器），以提升 LLM 在数学推理任务中的表现？
summary.importance: 系统性地研究了在工具调用场景下应用多种 on-policy RL 方法（RLOO, RLOO++, GRPO, DAPO），证明了 RL 结合工具调用能显著提升数学推理能力，为 Tool-use 的后训练提供了实证指导。
summary.technical_approach: 以 Countdown 任务为例，首先分析推理失败原因，发现计算错误占比较大。然后构建 SFT 数据集教授模型工具使用模式。在此基础上，使用自动可验证的最终答案作为 reward，应用 RLOO, RLOO++, GRPO, DAPO 等 on-policy RL 方法进行训练。构建了 1024 题的 held-out benchmark 进行评估。
summary.experiments: 在 Countdown 任务上，计算器工具的整合使 SFT 和 RL 基线的性能一致提升了约 10 个百分点。对比了不同 RL 算法在工具调用场景下的表现。

summary_en.core_problem: How to effectively integrate external tools (e.g., calculators) using Reinforcement Learning (RL) to enhance LLMs' performance in mathematical reasoning tasks?
summary_en.importance: Systematically investigates the application of various on-policy RL methods (RLOO, RLOO++, GRPO, DAPO) in tool-calling scenarios, demonstrating that RL combined with tool use significantly improves mathematical reasoning. Provides empirical guidance for post-training tool-use capabilities.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using the Countdown task, the authors first analyze reasoning failures, finding calculation errors to be a major cause. They construct an SFT dataset to teach tool-use patterns. Building on this, they apply on-policy RL methods (RLOO, RLOO++, GRPO, DAPO) using automatically verifiable final-answer rewards. A 1,024-problem held-out benchmark is constructed for evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: On the Countdown task, calculator tool integration consistently improves both SFT and RL baselines by roughly 10 percentage points. The performance of different RL algorithms in tool-calling scenarios is compared.

recommendation.zh: 在 Tool-use 场景下对比了多种主流 RL 算法（GRPO, RLOO 等），验证了 RL 对工具调用的增益，对做 Agent/Tool-use 后训练的同学有直接参考价值。
recommendation.en: Compares mainstream RL algorithms (GRPO, RLOO, etc.) in tool-use scenarios, validating the gains of RL for tool calling. Provides direct reference value for researchers working on Agent/Tool-use post-training.

paper.title: ReToolSQL: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Robust Text-to-SQL
paper.abstract: Recent work has shown that reinforcement learning from execution feedback can substantially improve text-to-SQL performance, often enabling smaller models to match or exceed much larger systems. However, most existing approaches treat SQL generation as a single-turn task, limiting the model's ability to recover from errors through iterative refinement. We present ReToolSQL, a two-stage training framework for text-to-SQL that combines (i) a supervised warm-start on rejection-sampled reasoning tra

summary.core_problem: 如何让 text-to-SQL 模型从单轮生成转向多轮工具使用与自我修复，从而更稳健地利用执行反馈。
summary.importance: 这是一个后训练范式上的小步改进：把 verified teacher traces 的 SFT 与多轮 agentic RFT 结合。对 RL 与 process supervision 的接口有一点参考，但任务过于专门，外推到通用 LLM 需谨慎。
summary.technical_approach: 两阶段训练：先在 rejection-sampled、经验证的教师推理轨迹上做 supervised warm-start，扩大可解问题覆盖；再在多轮工具调用轨迹上做基于执行反馈的 agentic reinforcement fine-tuning，学习何时验证、检索证据和修复 SQL。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据集名称和具体提升幅度，只声称相较单轮执行反馈方法，多轮 agentic RFT 能把扩展后的能力转化为更高的单次通过率与鲁棒性。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 JPMorganChase，属于企业内部应用研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to move text-to-SQL from one-shot generation to multi-turn tool use and self-repair, making execution feedback more effective.
summary_en.importance: This is a modest post-training contribution: it combines verified-teacher SFT with multi-turn agentic RFT. It offers some signal for RL/process-supervision interfaces, but the task is narrow and transfer to general LLMs is uncertain.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses a two-stage pipeline: supervised warm-start on rejection-sampled, verified teacher reasoning traces to expand solvable coverage, followed by execution-feedback-based agentic reinforcement fine-tuning over multi-turn tool-use trajectories to learn verification, evidence retrieval, and SQL repair.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, or exact gains. It claims that multi-turn agentic RFT converts expanded capability into higher single-pass accuracy and robustness compared with one-shot execution-feedback approaches.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from JPMorganChase and the work appears to be enterprise application research.

recommendation.zh: 思路不新：SFT 扩覆盖、RL 压 pass@1，在专门任务上再做成 agent 版；若你做 tool-RL，可只看两阶段分工假设，别高估可迁移性。
recommendation.en: The idea is familiar—SFT expands coverage, RL improves pass@1—repackaged for an agentic text-to-SQL setting; skim only for the stage-separation hypothesis, not for broad transfer.

paper.title: If Agents Were Angels, No Governance Would Be Necessary: Out-of-Band Policy Enforcement at a Trusted Tool Boundary
paper.abstract: Give an agent a human's credential and it inherits the person's reach without the judgment that limits its use. It can sweep every reachable record into model context, where hidden instructions steer its next call, and every request stays credential-valid while the agent exceeds its job or absorbs a secret. Prompts are a brittle guardrail: one fallible reasoner interprets the task and enforces its limits. We present Out-of-Band Policy Enforcement (OBPE), a trusted boundary outside agent reasonin

summary.core_problem: 解决通用 agent 拿到用户凭证后，可能在工具调用和数据访问中越权、泄露秘密或被隐藏指令操控的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 安全架构和治理边界设计。它不依赖模型自己理解并执行所有安全规则，而是把策略执行移到可信工具边界之外，对资源、字段、查询和返回值做强制控制。对预训练研究员的直接价值不高，但对 tool-use agent 的系统安全假设很重要。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Out-of-Band Policy Enforcement，简称 OBPE。该机制在 agent reasoning 外部的可信边界上授权 typed operation 和 resource，在后端调用前收窄 query，在响应返回时过滤记录和字段或 mask 敏感值。semantic gating 可根据参数值或外部状态拒绝或挂起调用。数据策略所有者设置最大授权，agent policy 只能进一步收窄，不能扩大权限。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有描述传统机器学习实验或 benchmark，而是给出系统机制与形式化性质：在给定条件下证明 policy plan 与执行顺序无关，并证明 agent policy 不能突破数据策略所有者设定的最大 grant。还区分了字段删除的一次性保护和 masking / history 相关保护的不同作用范围。
summary.authors_note: 摘要未给出机构信息。Tyler Akidau 是流处理和数据系统领域知名研究者，代表性工作包括 Dataflow 模型；该背景与可信数据边界和策略执行设计相关。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the risk that agents with human credentials can overreach during tool calls, ingest secrets into context, or be steered by hidden instructions while remaining credential-valid.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent security architecture: policy enforcement is moved outside the model's reasoning loop to a trusted tool boundary. It is not directly about pretraining, but it clarifies which safety constraints should not be delegated to the model when building tool-using agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Out-of-Band Policy Enforcement authorizes typed operations and resources, narrows queries before backend calls, and filters records, removes fields, or masks values in responses. Semantic gating can deny or hold calls based on argument values or external state. A data policy owner defines the maximum grant, while agent policy can only narrow that grant.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report standard ML experiments or benchmark results. It emphasizes formal properties: under stated conditions, the policy plan is order-independent and agent policy cannot widen the ceiling set by the data policy owner. It also distinguishes one-execution field removal from masking and history-aware protections.
summary_en.authors_note: No institution is provided in the metadata. Tyler Akidau is a well-known data systems researcher associated with the Dataflow model, which is relevant to trusted data boundaries and policy execution.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫形式化边界和 policy ceiling；它提醒 agent 安全别指望 prompt，权限收敛应在工具层做。
recommendation.en: Skim the formal boundary and policy-ceiling argument; it is a useful reminder that agent safety should not rely on prompts for access control.

paper.title: WeAgent-MMSearch: Native Text-Vision Interaction for Multimodal Search Agents
paper.abstract: Multimodal search agents extend parametric knowledge with newly emerging and long-tail evidence from the open web. Yet many existing agentic search environments often expose retrieved evidence only as text and omit tool-returned images from subsequent context, reducing visually grounded trajectories to text-only reasoning.
