Long-horizon interaction also compounds tool-call, response-length, timeout, and budget failures, which can discard salvageable trajectories, waste rollout computation, and di

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态搜索 Agent 往往把网页检索结果压成文本，无法在长轨迹中持续引用和处理图像证据，同时长程交互容易因工具调用、长度、超时和预算失败而浪费 rollout。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是通用多模态 Agent 系统与训练流程，而不是预训练方法。它有价值的地方在于把“工具返回的图像”作为可持久访问的上下文对象纳入 Agent 轨迹，并讨论运行时恢复对 agentic post-training 的影响。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 WeAgent-Harness，支持原生文本-视觉交互和 runtime recovery。检索到的图像被保存为持久磁盘引用，模型可以在后续步骤中检查、处理和引用这些图像。基于该 harness 构建 WeAgent-MMSearch，覆盖数据构造、Agent 后训练和多模态 rollout；数据构造部分使用强 MLLM 生成或筛选多模态搜索轨迹。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整模型规模、训练数据量和具体提升数字。可确认实验重点应围绕多模态搜索任务、长程工具调用成功率、轨迹恢复率以及相对 text-only search agent 的效果比较。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表包含 Fandong Meng，其长期参与腾讯机器翻译和大模型相关研究；具体机构信息需以论文正文为准。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing multimodal search agents often reduce web evidence to text, dropping tool-returned images from later reasoning steps, while long-horizon interaction suffers from tool-call, length, timeout, and budget failures that waste rollouts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly a general multimodal agent system and post-training pipeline rather than a pretraining method. Its useful signal is the treatment of retrieved images as persistent context objects and the explicit handling of runtime recovery during agentic rollouts.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces WeAgent-Harness for native text-vision interaction and runtime recovery. Retrieved images are stored as persistent disk references so the model can inspect, process, and cite them throughout a trajectory. WeAgent-MMSearch then combines data construction, agentic post-training, and multimodal rollout, with a strong MLLM used in the data construction loop.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, data scale, or exact gains. The evaluation likely focuses on multimodal search performance, long-horizon tool-use robustness, trajectory recovery, and comparison against text-only or image-dropping search agents.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Fandong Meng, known for work in machine translation and large-model research at Tencent-related groups; exact affiliations should be checked in the paper.

recommendation.zh: 预训练价值不在模型，而在 rollout 失败恢复和图像证据持久化；只看 harness 设计与数据构造部分即可。
recommendation.en: The pretraining-relevant signal is not the model but rollout recovery and persistent visual evidence; read the harness and data-construction parts.

paper.title: String: An Agentic OS Where Every App Is a Markdown File
paper.abstract: LLM agents have become a new class of software user, but every surface they work through was designed for someone else. Pages are built for human eyes, which can skim and ignore; tool schemas for programs, which pay nothing to carry definitions they never call. An agent has neither luxury: it re-reads, and pays again for, everything it is shown on every turn. We present String, an open-source runtime that gives this user an interface of its own and treats the job as an operating-systems problem.

summary.core_problem: 解决现有软件界面主要为人类或传统程序设计，而非为 LLM agent 设计，导致 agent 在每轮交互中重复读取冗余页面与工具定义、上下文成本过高的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 agent runtime / interface 设计工作。贡献不在模型本身，而在把 agent 使用软件的界面抽象成一种操作系统问题，提出面向 agent 的应用表示层。对 tool-use agent 和上下文工程有一定启发，但与基座预训练距离较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 String 运行时与 SFMD（String-Flavored Markdown）文档格式。核心思想是把工具知识从模型上下文移到公共运行层，由运行时按需渲染成 Markdown 视图；应用通过单个 SFMD 文件声明视图、typed actions、导航和凭证，底层统一处理发现、校验、执行、状态和 secrets，并暴露 /open 与 /act 两个核心动词。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出严格 benchmark 数字，更像系统与接口范式展示。主要卖点是同一架构既可渲染为浏览器 HTML，也可渲染为 agent 可消费的原始 Markdown，从而减少重复上下文负担。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the fact that current software interfaces are designed for humans or traditional programs, not for LLM agents, causing repeated reading of redundant pages and tool schemas at every turn.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent runtime and interface-design paper. The contribution is not in the model but in reframing agent-facing software as an operating-systems problem and proposing a dedicated application representation for agents. It is somewhat relevant for tool-use agents and context engineering, but only indirectly relevant to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work introduces the String runtime and SFMD (String-Flavored Markdown). The key idea is to move tool knowledge out of the model context into a shared runtime layer that renders only the needed Markdown view at each step. A single SFMD file declares views, typed actions, navigation, and credentials, while the runtime handles discovery, validation, execution, state, and secrets behind two verbs: /open and /act.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report rigorous benchmark numbers and reads more like a systems/interface proposal. The main claim is that the same architecture can render styled HTML for browsers and raw Markdown for agents, reducing repeated context overhead.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 agent-native interface，可以看它如何把工具描述移出上下文；但这是产品层抽象，不会直接改变 pretrain recipe。
recommendation.en: Worth a look only if you care about agent-native interfaces and context offloading; this is a product/runtime abstraction, not something that changes pretraining practice.

paper.title: Credo: Reusable Declarative Primitives for Agentic Workflows
paper.abstract: An LLM application depends on both a model and a harness: the program that determines what each call sees, how many calls to make, and which answers to trust. Coding agents can now discover strong harnesses by searching over candidate programs, but the resulting artifact is an opaque block of imperative code whose logical steps, runtime signals, physical execution decisions, and prompt strategies remain implicit and task-specific, forcing subsequent tasks to start the harness search process from

summary.core_problem: 如何把通过搜索得到的 agent harness 从不可复用的命令式代码，转成可检查、可迁移、可复用的声明式工作流原语。
summary.importance: 贡献偏 agent 系统工程：它试图把 harness search 的结果结构化，减少每个新任务都从头搜索脚手架的成本。对基座预训练本身关联较弱，但对 post-train/agent pipeline 的知识沉淀有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Credo，将搜索得到的 agentic workflow 恢复为带逻辑步骤、运行时信号、物理执行决策和 prompt 策略元数据的声明式表示，使 workflow 具备 provenance 和复用性，而不是一段黑盒 imperative code。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark、模型规模或量化提升。按设定推测，实验应比较声明式重构前后的复用效率、跨任务迁移能力或 harness search 成本。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Brown University 和 Northwestern University，偏数据库与系统方向。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to turn searched agent harnesses from opaque imperative code into inspectable, reusable declarative workflow primitives.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an agent-systems contribution: it tries to preserve and transfer knowledge discovered by harness search, reducing the need to restart from scratch on each task. It is only weakly connected to core pretraining, but somewhat relevant for post-training and agent pipeline design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Credo recovers a declarative representation from searched workflows, exposing logical steps, runtime signals, physical execution choices, prompt strategies, and provenance metadata instead of leaving them buried in black-box code.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete benchmarks, model sizes, or quantitative gains. The likely evaluation concerns reuse efficiency, cross-task transfer, or reduced harness-search cost.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Brown University and Northwestern University, with a systems/database flavor.

recommendation.zh: 更像 agent workflow 的 IR 设计，不直接改模型；若你在做 harness search 或 tool-use 平台，可看表示层抽象，其他人知道有这条线就够了。
recommendation.en: This is closer to an IR for agent workflows than a model contribution; read it only if you build harness-search or tool-use platforms, otherwise a citation-level awareness is enough.

paper.title: CrabOS: An Operating System for Human-AI Co-inhabitation
paper.abstract: AI agents are evolving into long-running computational entities that can invoke tools, maintain memory, and complete complex tasks across applications. In real-world settings, completing a task often requires humans and AI to take turns leading its execution. Such alternation depends on the seamless handoff of the work state of the task between humans and AI. Existing agent systems, however, provide humans and AI with separate work environments. AI agents must therefore rely on additional bridge

summary.core_problem: 当前 Agent 与人类通常运行在分离工作环境中，任务交接依赖截图、文本描述或定制接口，导致长程协作成本高、状态易丢失。
summary.importance: 贡献是面向人机共处的 Agent OS / HCI 系统概念。它不直接推进预训练，但对长期 Agent 的工作状态表示、权限边界和人机交接接口有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Human-AI Co-inhabitation 概念，并实现 CrabOS。核心思想是让人类和 AI 在同一个任务工作环境中轮流接管执行，而不是让 Agent 通过外部桥接读取状态。摘要提到 CrabOS 将工作状态表示为自然语言形式，具体状态同步、权限管理和系统接口需看正文确认。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出实验规模、用户研究人数、任务集合或定量效果。预计评估会围绕跨应用任务、人机交接成本、Agent 继续执行能力和用户操作负担展开。

summary_en.core_problem: Current agents and humans usually operate in separate work environments, making task handoff depend on screenshots, textual descriptions, or task-specific interfaces, which is costly and lossy for long-running collaboration.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent OS and HCI system concept for human-AI co-inhabitation. It does not directly advance pretraining, but it is relevant to work-state representation, permission boundaries, and handoff interfaces for long-running agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Human-AI Co-inhabitation and implements CrabOS. The key idea is to let humans and AI take turns operating in the same task environment instead of forcing agents to reconstruct state through external bridges. The abstract states that CrabOS represents work state in natural language; details on state synchronization, permissions, and OS interfaces need the full paper.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide user-study size, task set, or quantitative gains. The evaluation likely focuses on cross-application tasks, handoff cost, agent continuation ability, and user burden.

recommendation.zh: 这是 Agent 基础设施想法，不是模型论文；看系统抽象即可，别把 HCI demo 当成训练范式证据。
recommendation.en: This is agent infrastructure, not a model paper; read the system abstraction, but do not treat an HCI demo as evidence for training paradigms.

paper.title: MemToC: Benchmarking Memory-Tool Conflict Resolution in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Tool-augmented LLMs must arbitrate between two fallible sources when a tool return conflicts with their parametric memory, yet existing evaluations measure source preference without establishing source correctness. We introduce MemToC, a controlled benchmark for post-tool-return arbitration with executable tools. MemToC comprises 6,504 evaluation episodes constructed from 542 quality-controlled factual questions, independently elicited model-specific closed-book answers, and controlled tool retu

summary.core_problem: 在工具调用场景里，当“工具返回”和“模型参数记忆（closed-book）”发生冲突时，如何构造一个可控评测，使得每个 episode 都能明确知道哪一方是对的，从而真正评估模型的冲突仲裁能力（而不是仅统计它更偏向工具还是更偏向记忆）。
summary.importance: 这是评测资产而非预训练方法论文，但对 post-train（SFT/DPO）与 agent 可靠性有直接价值：它把“工具是否正确”作为可控变量注入，解决了以往冲突评测里 correctness 不可知导致的指标混淆。对基座研究的启发点在于：当训练/对齐信号来自外部工具或检索时，必须把“来源正确性”显式建模，否则模型学到的可能只是固定偏好（永远信工具/永远不信工具），而不是条件化的仲裁策略。
summary.technical_approach:
MemToC 的关键设计是把冲突从“自然发生”改为“实验干预（intervention）”：
- 数据来源：ToolHop（多跳分解问题、可本地执行的 tool call、可验证中间答案）。作者取其中可独立查询的子问题，构造成短答案事实问答。
- 先固定 benchmark 工件：问题 q、可执行调用、verified gold answer g、以及至少一个同类型且可信的 distractor（用于构造错误返回）。两名标注者独立审核，做自包含性、答案泄露、distractor 合理性等质检。
- 对每个模型、每个 prompt 变体，先测 closed-book 回答 m，并据此判定“模型记忆是否正确”（m 是否等于 g）。
- 再在同一问题上提供被控制的工具返回 r，分四类：correct return、incorrect return（用经验证答案与人工校验的 distractor 注入）、error payload、no return。因为 r 是作者注入的，所以工具侧正确性在回答前已知。
- 这样每个 episode 的“正确行为”是可判定的：当工具对且记忆错，应跟随工具；当工具错且记忆对，应抵抗工具；再加上工具 error/no-tool 作为控制组。
- 评测细节：采用 extraction-first 的答案匹配；提供三种指令措辞变体但固定问题文本，以测提示敏感性。
- 缓解方法对比：prompting vs SFT vs DPO；并用 cross-fitting（按 ToolHop chain 划分/持出）保证每个报告的微调预测都在训练未见问题上得到，减少泄漏。
summary.experiments:
规模与设置：542 个质检后的事实问题；结合 4 种工具条件与 3 种指令措辞，形成 6,504 个固定评测 episodes；评测 5 个开源 7–9B 模型。
构建统计：从 ToolHop 3,912 子问题扁平化去重到 1,948；筛到 605 个可独立检索事实；质检后得到 575 池；最终 542。443/542 具备 far distractor。
结果层面：提供了 prompting、SFT、DPO 的对比，并强调该基准能分别度量“正确工具返回的利用”与“错误工具返回的抵抗”。（提供的全文片段未包含具体分数表，因此无法在此复述各模型在四象限上的数值差异。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45 分钟）：
- 先读 Introduction 里对“source preference ≠ arbitration”的动机与 Figure 1/2 的设定。
- 精看 Benchmark construction：问题筛选标准（可独立查询 vs 需要链式计算）、distractor 的 near/far 定义、以及两人质检流程与拒绝率来源。
- 看 Evaluation protocol：closed-book m 的获取方式、四种工具条件的注入、以及为什么要加 tool-error/no-tool 控制。
- 如果关心训练信号：读 Mitigation methods（SFT/DPO）与 cross-fitting 的划分方式，确认没有链级泄漏。

适合带着的问题：
- 指标是否区分“拒答/不确定”与“给出错误答案”？基准要求 closed-book 不可 abstain，但 tool 条件下是否允许。
- 错误返回的分布是否过于“同类型但容易识别为假”（例如罕见实体），从而高估抵抗能力。
- 该设置固定了 tool selection，只评估 post-tool-call 仲裁；若用于端到端 agent，还需要与 tool 选择错误耦合的评测。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate tool–memory conflict resolution in LLM agents under controlled source correctness, so that each episode has a known “right arbitration decision” rather than merely measuring whether the model tends to follow tools or its parametric memory.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an evaluation contribution (not a pretraining method), but it matters for post-training and agent reliability: by intervening on tool returns, it disentangles source preference from correct arbitration. For foundation-model training, the key lesson is that when external tools/retrieval are used as supervision or inference-time evidence, correctness must be explicitly controlled/measured; otherwise models can be rewarded for a fixed bias (always trust tools / always distrust tools) instead of learning conditional arbitration.
summary_en.technical_approach:
MemToC is built as a controlled post-tool-call benchmark derived from ToolHop.
- Data pipeline: start from ToolHop sub-questions with locally executable tool calls and verified intermediate answers; keep only self-contained facts with short verifiable answers.
- Pre-construct benchmark artifacts before evaluating any model: question q, verified gold g, executable call, and curated distractors to synthesize plausible incorrect tool returns. Two annotators independently review for self-containedness, answer leakage, answer validity, and distractor plausibility.
- For each model and each prompt wording variant, first elicit a closed-book answer m (forced to answer, no abstention) and score it against g to determine whether the model’s memory is correct.
- Then present the same question with an injected tool return r under four conditions: correct return, incorrect return (built from verified answers and human-validated distractors), error payload, and no return. Because r is injected, tool correctness is known a priori.
- This yields a source-correctness matrix where the “correct behavior” is well-defined (use correct tools, resist incorrect tools), with tool-error/no-tool as controls.
- Evaluation details include extraction-first answer matching and three instruction-wording variants with fixed question text.
- Mitigations: compare prompting vs SFT vs DPO, using cross-fitting over ToolHop chains so that each reported fine-tuned prediction is on held-out questions.
summary_en.experiments:
Benchmark size: 542 quality-controlled factual questions; with 4 tool conditions and 3 instruction variants, 6,504 fixed evaluation episodes. Models: five open-weight 7–9B LLMs.
Construction stats: ToolHop 3,912 sub-questions → 1,948 unique candidates → 605 independently retrievable facts → QC pool 575 → final 542. Far distractors exist for 443/542.
Outcome reporting: the benchmark enables separate measurement of (i) appropriate deference to correct tool returns and (ii) resistance to incorrect returns, and compares prompting/SFT/DPO. (The provided excerpt does not include the final score tables, so per-model numeric results cannot be reproduced here.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the motivation carefully: why “following tools” is not the same as correct arbitration.
- Focus on benchmark construction: the criteria for independently retrievable facts, near vs far distractors, and the two-annotator QC process.
- Study the evaluation protocol: how closed-book correctness is measured per model, how tool returns are intervened upon, and why tool-error/no-tool controls are necessary.
- If you care about training signals, read the mitigation section for the cross-fitting setup to rule out leakage.

Questions to keep in mind:
- How does the benchmark treat abstention/uncertainty under tool conditions?
- Are incorrect returns “too clean” or systematically detectable, potentially inflating resistance?
- Since tool selection is fixed, what additional evaluation is needed for end-to-end agents where tool choice itself can be wrong?

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，因为它把“会用工具”拆成“会不会盲从工具”；若你做 tool-use post-train，先复现这套控制实验，再谈 agent 能力。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it separates tool use from tool obedience; if you work on tool-use post-training, reproduce this control setup before claiming agent capability.

paper.title: Invocation-Level Reliability of Tool-Using Agents
paper.abstract: Tool-using agents fail two ways: choosing the wrong tool, or forming wrong arguments, and an early failure of either kind can silently corrupt everything downstream. We measure a correct-invocation rate that separates the two, under both a clean teacher-forced context and the model's own free-running context, on five open-weight models over contamination-free multi-step tasks (depths 1-8). By depth 6, roughly 70% of a model's own clean-context capability is lost to its own earlier mistakes (L6 =

summary.core_problem: 在多步工具调用任务中，模型早期的错误（选错工具或参数错误）会污染后续上下文，导致任务失败。现有的聚合成功率指标无法区分是单次调用能力不足，还是早期错误导致的级联失效，且在精确匹配（exact-match）评分下，传统的错误严重程度和恢复率模型无法被正确估计。
summary.importance: 揭示了工具调用评测中的一个核心陷阱：在精确匹配评分规则下，错误传播的严重程度参数被评分规则本身固定，而非由模型数据决定。这解释了为什么基于固定黄金轨迹的评测无法真实反映模型在自由运行状态下的错误传播情况，对 Agent 评测基准的设计有重要启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出了一种调用级别的可靠性测量方法，区分了两种上下文条件：1）干净的 teacher-forced 上下文（测量纯粹的上下文长度衰减）；2）模型自身的自由运行上下文（测量错误传播）。设计了路由任务（工具选择依赖于上一步输出）和线性任务（控制组），并引入了“条件状态评分”（conditional-on-state scoring），即根据模型当前实际持有的状态来评估下一步操作是否正确，从而解耦了选择错误和参数错误。
summary.experiments: 在 5 个开源模型（深度 1-8）上进行了测试。结果显示，到深度 6 时，模型在干净上下文下的能力有约 70% 因自身早期错误而丧失。更关键的发现是，在精确匹配评分下，严重程度参数被强制为 1，证明了该评分规则的局限性。应用条件状态评分后，能够有效分离出语法错误和语义错误的影响。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读 Section 5.3 关于精确匹配评分如何固定严重程度参数的理论分析，这是本文最核心的 negative result。其次关注 Section 3 提出的条件状态评分机制，了解如何通过改变评分规则来正确测量错误传播。

summary_en.core_problem: In multi-step tool-use tasks, early errors (wrong tool or arguments) pollute the subsequent context, leading to task failure. Existing aggregate success metrics cannot distinguish between single-call incompetence and cascading failures from early mistakes. Furthermore, under exact-match scoring, traditional models of error severity and recovery cannot be correctly estimated.
summary_en.importance: Exposes a critical pitfall in tool-use evaluation: under exact-match scoring, the error propagation severity parameter is fixed by the scoring rule itself, not by the model's data. This explains why evaluations based on fixed gold trajectories fail to reflect true error propagation in free-running states, offering significant insights for the design of Agent evaluation benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes an invocation-level reliability measurement distinguishing two context conditions: 1) clean teacher-forced context (measuring pure context-length decay); 2) the model's own free-running context (measuring error propagation). Designs routing tasks (tool selection depends on previous output) and linear tasks (control), and introduces 'conditional-on-state scoring'—evaluating the next step based on the state the model actually holds—to decouple selection errors from argument errors.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on 5 open-weight models (depths 1-8). Results show that by depth 6, roughly 70% of a model's clean-context capability is lost to its own earlier mistakes. The crucial finding is that under exact-match scoring, the severity parameter is forced to 1, proving the limitation of this scoring rule. Applying conditional-on-state scoring effectively separates the impact of syntactic and semantic errors.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 5.3 for the theoretical analysis of how exact-match scoring fixes the severity parameter; this is the core negative result. Then, look at Section 3 for the conditional-on-state scoring mechanism to understand how changing the scoring rule enables correct measurement of error propagation.

recommendation.zh: 做 tool-use 训练的人该看；它提醒你很多“不可恢复”的结论其实是 metric 造出来的，先看测量协议再谈 agent 能力，重点读 propagation analysis 那部分。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you train tool-use models: many “no recovery” conclusions may be artifacts of the metric, so inspect the measurement protocol before drawing capability claims; focus on the propagation analysis.

paper.title: SpeechGym: An Audio-Native Gym for Training Voice Agents via Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Voice agents must call tools and hold multi-turn dialogue entirely through speech, yet the dominant paradigm trains them in text. Existing frameworks either cascade TTS and ASR around a proprietary voice API, where gradients cannot flow and per-call cost makes on-policy reinforcement learning prohibitive, or stay in text: they measure voice agents but cannot improve them. We present SpeechGym, an audio-native agentic environment in which two omni-modal models converse in native audio, with no ex

summary.core_problem: 现有的语音 Agent 训练框架要么依赖闭源 API 导致无法进行端到端 RL 训练，要么只能在文本模态下训练，无法解决从文本到语音模态转换时出现的感知和规划错误（如听错槽位值、过度行动等）。
summary.importance: 提出了首个支持端到端 RL 训练的原生音频 Agent 环境 SpeechGym，证明了文本到语音的性能差距并非模态固有的不可逾越的鸿沟，而是可以通过闭环 RL 训练显著缓解的具体能力缺陷（如听力准确性、确认机制等）。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了 SpeechGym 环境，包含一个冻结的用户模型（模拟来电者）和一个可训练的 Agent 模型。两者直接在原生音频空间进行多轮对话，无需外部 ASR/TTS。Agent 在每一步可以选择调用结构化工具（与数据库交互）或生成语音回复。针对音频任务成功率极低导致 GRPO 难以提供有效梯度的问题，引入了回合级别的过程奖励（dense shaping）来提高训练效率。
summary.experiments: 在 30B 原生多模态模型上进行实验。基线模型在语音环境下的槽位听错率高达 32%（文本仅为 2%），导致 42% 的工具错误率。使用 SpeechGym 训练后，在独立的 τ-Voice 评测基准上，pass@1 从 24% 提升至 53%，超越了级联基线，并显著减少了交互轮数、未授权写入和死循环现象。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Section 3 中 SpeechGym 的架构设计，特别是如何实现无 API 依赖的原生音频交互。其次，阅读 Section 4.3 关于在低基础成功率下如何设计过程奖励以使 GRPO 生效的训练技巧。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing voice agent training frameworks either rely on closed-source APIs, preventing end-to-end RL training, or train only in text, failing to address perception and planning errors (e.g., mishearing slot values, over-action) that occur when transitioning from text to speech.
summary_en.importance: Introduces SpeechGym, the first audio-native agent environment supporting end-to-end RL. It demonstrates that the text-to-speech performance gap is not an insurmountable inherent modality cost, but rather specific capability deficits (e.g., hearing accuracy, confirmation mechanisms) that can be significantly mitigated through closed-loop RL training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs the SpeechGym environment, comprising a frozen user model (simulating the caller) and a trainable agent model. They converse directly in native audio without external ASR/TTS. At each step, the agent chooses between calling a structured tool (interacting with a database) or generating a speech response. To address the issue of GRPO failing to provide effective gradients due to extremely low audio task success rates, a turn-level process reward (dense shaping) is introduced to improve training efficiency.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments on a 30B omni-modal model. The baseline model has a 32% slot mishearing rate in speech (vs. 2% in text), leading to a 42% tool error rate. After training with SpeechGym, pass@1 on the independent τ-Voice benchmark doubled from 24% to 53%, outperforming the cascaded baseline and significantly reducing interaction turns, unauthorized writes, and dead loops.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the architectural design of SpeechGym, particularly how API-free native audio interaction is achieved. Next, read Section 4.3 for training techniques on designing process rewards to make GRPO effective under low base success rates.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 speech LM 或 omni agent，这篇值得扫一遍；不是方法突破，但它把“语音误差主要是感知而非推理”这个分界讲得很清楚，适合拿来设计后续 ablation。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming if you care about speech LMs or omni-agents; not a paradigm shift, but it cleanly separates speech failures as perceptual rather than reasoning-driven, which is useful for follow-up ablations.

paper.title: Verify Smarter, Evolve Further: Efficient Harness Evolution through Behavior-Aware Verification
paper.abstract: Agent harnesses shape how language-model agents use instructions, tools, and runtime components, but adapting these harnesses requires costly verification. Existing propose-and-verify methods typically score every candidate on a fixed task set, wasting rollouts on unrelated behaviors and allowing aggregate scores to obscure specific regressions. We introduce HarnessLens, a budget-aware framework for automated harness evolution. HarnessLens jointly explores the task space and user-configurable co

summary.core_problem: 在 agent harness（指令、工具描述、权限、记忆、技能等运行时组件）持续演化时，如何在有限 rollout 预算下做更“对症”的验证：既避免对每个候选修改都用同一套固定任务集全量评测造成浪费，又能更可靠地发现特定行为的提升与回归。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接关联较弱，更偏 agent 系统与评测/优化流程。但它提供了一个可迁移的思想：把“验证集选择”从静态变成与修改目标绑定的动态过程，并把轨迹证据复用为后续迭代的资产。这种“行为归因驱动的选择性评测”在 pretrain/posttrain 中也有类比空间，例如：针对特定数据混合或对齐改动，动态挑选最敏感的探针任务/切片来做回归测试，从而降低迭代成本并减少 aggregate 指标掩盖回退的风险。
summary.technical_approach:
HarnessLens 是一个预算感知的 propose-and-verify 框架，核心不是提出更强的 harness 修改器，而是把验证阶段做成“行为感知（behavior-aware）”：
- Context Exploration：刻画任务空间与 harness 中可配置组件（指令、技能、工具、角色、运行时扩展等）以及它们的更新接口，目标是明确“能改什么”。
- Trajectory Diagnosis：从执行轨迹中抽取可复用的经验与缺陷，形成后续提出修改与选择验证任务的证据。
- Harness Evolution：基于轨迹证据生成候选修改，并用 attributable-evidence gate 做选择性验证：只在与该修改相关、且能覆盖潜在回归风险的任务子集上花 rollout 预算；同时把新 rollout 继续沉淀为证据，形成闭环。
论文批评传统方法的点很明确：固定任务集会引入大量与修改无关的评测噪声，且 aggregate 分数会掩盖特定行为回归。HarnessLens 用“任务-行为-组件-证据”的绑定关系来分配验证预算。
summary.experiments:
在三个 agent harness、四个基准上评测：τ³-bench Banking Knowledge、τ²-bench Retail、Terminal-Bench 2.0、BIRD Mini-Dev（Challenging 子集）。在给定预算下，相比固定任务集验证的演化方法，平均 held-out 性能提升 7.6–13.6%。引言里还给出按不同设置的提升幅度示例：OpenCode 上最高 +13.6%，Codex 上 +7.6%，Pi 上 +9.2%。
节选未包含更细的消融（例如：仅任务自适应选择 vs 仅轨迹诊断、gate 的阈值敏感性、不同回归风险建模方式），需要在全文实验部分核对其统计显著性与预算口径（rollout 数、token 成本、工具调用成本）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 40–70 分钟）：
- 先读 Introduction + Figure 1，抓住它要解决的“固定验证集浪费且掩盖回归”的具体失败模式。
- 再读 Problem Formulation，明确 harness space、modification、budget 约束的定义，避免把它误读成通用 agent 学习算法。
- 重点看方法部分对 attributable-evidence gate 的定义：它如何把候选修改与任务子集关联、如何处理回归风险。
- 最后看实验设置里“预算”的口径与对比基线：如果预算定义不一致，7.6–13.6% 的提升含义会被放大或缩小。

summary_en.core_problem: When evolving an agent harness (instructions, tool specs, permissions, memory, skills, runtime components), how can we verify candidate changes under a tight rollout budget in a way that is targeted to the affected behaviors, instead of scoring every candidate on the same fixed task set that wastes rollouts and hides regressions behind aggregate metrics?
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an agent-systems optimization/verification paper rather than a foundation-model pretraining paper. Its transferable value to pretrain/post-train workflows is the verification philosophy: make evaluation adaptive to the intended behavioral change, and reuse trajectory evidence across iterations. In large-scale training pipelines, a similar idea can reduce iteration cost by dynamically selecting the most sensitive slices/probes for regression testing after data-mixture or alignment changes, instead of relying on a static benchmark bundle.
summary_en.technical_approach:
HarnessLens is a budget-aware propose-and-verify framework with behavior-aware verification:
- Context Exploration identifies the task space and the user-configurable harness components and their update mechanisms.
- Trajectory Diagnosis mines execution trajectories to extract reusable evidence about deficiencies and behavior patterns.
- Harness Evolution proposes candidate harness modifications from the evidence and verifies each candidate only on behavior-relevant tasks via an attributable-evidence gate, explicitly accounting for regression risks.
The key departure from prior work is not the proposal mechanism but the verification allocation: tasks are selected per modification based on evidence and affected behaviors/components, and each rollout both evaluates the current candidate and becomes evidence for future evolution.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on three harnesses across four benchmarks: τ³-bench Banking Knowledge, τ²-bench Retail, Terminal-Bench 2.0, and the Challenging subset of BIRD Mini-Dev. Under fixed budgets, HarnessLens reports average held-out improvements of 7.6–13.6% over fixed-set verification baselines; the introduction highlights up to +13.6% (OpenCode), +7.6% (Codex), and +9.2% (Pi) in their settings. The excerpt does not show deeper ablations (e.g., gating vs diagnosis vs task selection) or budget normalization details, which should be checked in the full experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (40–70 minutes):
- Read the Introduction and Figure 1 to internalize the failure mode of fixed-set verification (wasted rollouts, diluted signals, hidden regressions).
- Read the Problem Formulation to understand what is optimized (component configurations under a fixed base model and harness framework) and what “budget” means.
- Focus on the attributable-evidence gate: how it links a modification to a verification task subset and how regression risk is handled.
- In experiments, verify budget accounting (number of rollouts, token/tool costs) and baseline parity; otherwise the reported 7.6–13.6% gains are hard to interpret.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和消融就够；它把 agent harness 调参从全量回归测试改成归因式验证，工程味重但问题是真问题。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and ablations; it turns harness tuning from full regression testing into attribution-guided verification, engineering-heavy but aimed at a real bottleneck.

paper.title: PILOT in the Loop: Live Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Agents
paper.abstract: Long-horizon agent runs generate experience that can improve both the current run and future work. Most self-improvement methods process this experience only after execution ends, so they cannot redirect the active run or immediately apply and validate lessons learned from it. We argue that self-improvement should instead be live, using emerging experience both to redirect the active run and to update the persistent harness. Existing agent architectures do not fully support this goal. Single-age

summary.core_problem: 解决长时程 agent 在执行过程中无法利用新产生经验即时纠偏、也无法把经验立刻沉淀到后续运行中的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个 agent harness 层的方法创新，不是预训练工作本身，但它触及在线自改进、经验蒸馏和执行期监督这些与 post-train 闭环相关的主题。对做基座模型的人，价值主要在于观察在线反馈信号如何被组织，而不是方法本身会直接改变预训练范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PILOT 这一 supervisor-worker 架构，用两个耦合机制做 live self-improvement：一是 live steering，由独立 supervisor 在 worker 执行中途进行重定向或中止；二是 live self-evolution，把执行中暴露出的程序模式和失败模式提炼成可复用技能，更新持久化 harness。核心点在于把执行、评估、纠偏、经验沉淀从串行后处理改成在线闭环。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据规模或完整基线列表。可确认的是，论文围绕长时程 agent 任务比较了传统单 agent 自纠错、常见 subagent delegation 与其 supervisor-worker 在线改进框架，主张其方法既能改善当前运行，也能提升后续任务表现。由于缺少摘要级别的量化结果，结论强度需要看正文中的任务设置是否足够干净、是否控制了额外 compute 和上下文预算。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles the inability of long-horizon agents to use emerging experience during execution to redirect the current run and immediately improve future runs.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an agent-harness contribution rather than a pretraining paper, but it touches online self-improvement, experience distillation, and execution-time supervision. For foundation-model researchers, the value is in how feedback signals are organized online, not in a direct change to pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes PILOT, a supervisor-worker architecture with two coupled mechanisms for live self-improvement: live steering, where a separate supervisor can redirect or abort an active worker mid-run, and live self-evolution, which distills procedures and failure modes discovered during execution into reusable skills that update a persistent harness. The key shift is from post-hoc correction to an online closed loop.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, training data, or a full baseline table. What is clear is that the paper compares standard single-agent self-correction and subagent delegation against its supervisor-worker online-improvement setup on long-horizon agent tasks, claiming gains for both the active run and future runs. The strength of the claim depends on whether the full paper cleanly controls for extra compute and context budget.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练关系不深，但如果你关心 RL/agent 反馈怎样回流成训练信号，可只看架构图和在线蒸馏部分；先别把它当成可直接迁移到基座训练的证据。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but worth a quick look if you care about how agent feedback may become training signal; read the architecture and online distillation parts, not as direct evidence for foundation training.

paper.title: Daydreaming: Stealing Hidden Agent Skills through Black-Box Task Interaction
paper.abstract: Agent skills bundle instructions, reference data, and executable helpers that let a general agent perform specialized tasks. Hosted providers can keep these files secret while selling access to task results, making the skill itself a valuable target. Existing disclosure defenses can block requests that ask for the skill or reproduce its text, but they cannot block customers from submitting the ordinary tasks the service is built to complete. We present Daydreaming, an execution-only attack that

summary.core_problem: 研究托管式 agent skill 在仅允许正常任务交互、不给源码和评分接口的黑盒条件下，是否仍会被系统性窃取。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练论文，但对 agent 产品化和 tool-use 系统安全有现实意义。贡献类型是攻击方法与威胁模型，而不是基座模型能力提升。对预训练研究员的启发主要在于：把技能、工具和执行轨迹暴露给用户时，行为接口本身就可能泄漏可蒸馏的程序结构。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Daydreaming，一种 execution-only 的黑盒技能窃取攻击。方法不要求受害者显式泄露 skill 文本，也不依赖受害者对重建结果打分，而是自适应构造任务，通过输出差异区分隐藏行为；再借助攻击者控制的 shadow agents 选择设计，并结合历史受害者结果与本地执行检查逐步补全多文件 skill。论文还形式化了 Differential、Trace、Output 三种嵌套威胁级别。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多文件 skill 场景下可通过普通任务交互完成窃取，并强调现有 disclosure defenses 无法阻止这类攻击。摘要未给出具体 agent 基座、任务数、成功率或与现有攻击 baseline 的量化差距，因此更适合作为安全风险信号，而不是能力结论。
summary.authors_note: 作者中有 Raluca Ada Popa，长期做系统安全、隐私与可信 AI；这提高了安全建模部分的可信度。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks whether hosted agent skills can still be systematically stolen under black-box access when the attacker is only allowed to submit ordinary tasks and never sees the underlying files.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it matters for agent productization and tool-use security. The contribution is an attack method and threat model, not a foundation-model capability improvement. For pretraining researchers, the takeaway is that exposing skills, tools, and execution behavior can leak enough structure to distill the hidden program.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Daydreaming, an execution-only black-box skill-stealing attack. It does not ask the victim to reveal the skill text or grade reconstructions. Instead, it adaptively crafts tasks whose outputs distinguish hidden behaviors, uses attacker-controlled shadow agents to choose candidate designs, and reconstructs each file using stored victim outputs plus local execution checks. It also formalizes three nested threat levels: Differential, Trace, and Output.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims successful theft of multi-file skills through ordinary task interaction and argues that existing disclosure defenses cannot stop this attack class. It does not provide concrete model families, task counts, success rates, or quantitative baselines in the abstract, so this is more useful as a security signal than as a clean capability result.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Raluca Ada Popa, well known for systems security, privacy, and trustworthy AI, which adds credibility to the threat-modeling side.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但做 agent/tool-use 的团队该看：它提醒你行为接口本身就是蒸馏通道；先看 threat model 和 attack assumptions，别急着信成功率。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but relevant if you build agents/tool use: it shows the behavior interface itself can be a distillation channel; read the threat model and assumptions before trusting the attack strength.

paper.title: When Tool Outputs Become Commands: Separating Action Induction from Runtime Authorization in Tool-Augmented LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Tool-augmented LLM agents must rely on untrusted runtime Observations to complete open-ended tasks; however, when tool outputs no longer merely provide data but begin to specify concrete actions, they effectively become ``commands'' that can drive real-world side effects beyond user intent. We argue that this risk arises from conflating action induction with execution authorization. To address this distinction, we propose SARA, which treats action induction and execution authorization as distinc

summary.core_problem: 在工具增强的 LLM Agent 中，当工具输出包含具体行动指令（变成“命令”）时，可能导致超出用户意图的现实副作用（安全风险）。
summary.importance: 指出了 Agent 工具调用中的一个关键安全漏洞：行动诱导（action induction）与执行授权（execution authorization）的混淆，并提出了分离这两者的架构。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SARA 架构，将行动诱导和执行授权作为不同的运行时角色分离。在观察端，使用上下文隔离的 Action Probe 暴露行动语义并记录来源；在执行端，仅在满足用户目标和授权证据的情况下才授权实际的工具调用，确保目标、执行链和参数级别的支持。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，主要描述了安全架构的设计。

summary_en.core_problem: In tool-augmented LLM agents, when tool outputs contain concrete action instructions (becoming 'commands'), they can drive real-world side effects beyond user intent, posing a security risk.
summary_en.importance: Identifies a critical security vulnerability in agent tool use: the conflation of action induction and execution authorization, and proposes an architecture to separate them.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the SARA architecture, which treats action induction and execution authorization as distinct runtime roles. On the observation side, a context-isolated Action Probe exposes action semantics and records provenance; on the execution side, tool calls are authorized only against the user objective and audited evidence, ensuring goal, execution-chain, and argument-level support.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract does not provide specific experimental data; focuses on the design of the security architecture.

recommendation.zh: Agent 安全/防御机制研究，提出了分离行动诱导和执行授权的概念，对构建安全的 Agent 系统有工程参考价值，但对预训练本身启发有限。
recommendation.en: Agent security/defense mechanism research proposing the separation of action induction and execution authorization; has engineering reference value for building secure Agent systems but limited inspiration for pretraining itself.

paper.title: LLMs Can Design Near-Optimal OR Algorithms
paper.abstract: We ask whether large language models (LLMs) can design effective algorithms for well-specified operations research (OR) problems. We study inventory control, queueing network control, and assortment optimization. We evaluate two levels of LLM use: at level 1, the model receives one problem instance and returns a solution for that instance; at level 2, it receives only the problem class description and broad parameter ranges, and returns an algorithm that maps instance parameters to solutions. Hu

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM 是否能在低人工干预下，为明确形式化的运筹优化问题设计接近最优的求解算法，而不只是解单个实例。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是能力分析和 agentic algorithm design 评估。它把 LLM 的作用区分为实例级求解和问题类级算法生成，后者更接近“模型能否抽象出可复用策略”。对预训练研究的价值在于观察前沿模型在工具环境中做算法发现的能力边界。
summary.technical_approach: 作者使用一个固定、未调参的提示，让模型访问带固定计算预算的 Python sandbox。Level 1 输入单个问题实例并返回解；Level 2 只输入问题类描述和参数范围，要求模型生成从实例参数到解的算法。测试问题包括库存控制、排队网络控制和 assortment optimization。
summary.experiments: 摘要称最强模型 gpt-5.6-sol 在几乎所有评估实例上达到或超过已有最佳方法，即使在 Level 2 中算法先于测试实例固定也成立。不同发布时间相隔不到 8 个月的模型之间性能提升明显。摘要未给出具体样本规模、基线细节和置信区间。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLMs can design near-optimal algorithms for well-specified operations-research problems, rather than merely solving individual instances.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is primarily a capability study for agentic algorithm design. The useful distinction is between instance-level solving and class-level algorithm synthesis, where the latter tests whether the model can produce reusable policies. For pretraining researchers, the value is a signal about frontier-model abstraction under tool use.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setup uses one untuned prompt and a Python sandbox with a fixed compute budget. At Level 1, the model receives one instance and returns a solution. At Level 2, it receives only the problem-class description and broad parameter ranges, then returns an algorithm that maps future instance parameters to solutions. The studied domains are inventory control, queueing network control, and assortment optimization.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that the strongest tested model, gpt-5.6-sol, matches or beats the best existing method on almost all evaluated instances, including the Level-2 setting where the algorithm is fixed before seeing test cases. It also reports sharp progress across model releases less than eight months apart. The abstract does not expose detailed sample sizes, baselines, or confidence intervals.

recommendation.zh: 可看作前沿模型“生成算法而非答案”的弱信号；先读实验设置，别把 OR 小任务外推到通用推理。
recommendation.en: A useful weak signal on models producing reusable algorithms rather than answers; read the setup first and avoid overgeneralizing from small OR domains.

paper.title: LifePlanner: Evaluating LLM Agents for Geo-spatial Planning with Social Media Data
paper.abstract: Geo-spatial planning, like trip design, is a realistic testbed for LLM agents because it requires grounded tool use, noisy evidence retrieval, and multi-constraint reasoning. Most benchmarks, however, only provide clean geospatial data and tools, missing the open-ended social signals that people use in daily planning. We introduce LifePlanner, a benchmark that enriches map data with large-scale local social media posts and provides access through an MCP toolset. LifePlanner provides an evaluatio

summary.core_problem: 如何用更接近真实用户决策的信息源（带噪声、时效性强、指代含混的本地社媒内容）来评测 LLM agent 的地理空间规划能力，并把失败原因从“答错了”细化到“证据没找全/约束没整合好/工具调用不可靠”等可诊断层面。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，但对“预训练↔后训练闭环”里的评测与数据形态有启发：1）把开放域、弱结构的社媒证据引入规划评测，能更真实地暴露 agent 的检索-证据整合短板；2）提供了一个可复现的 MCP 工具环境与结构化输出评分框架，适合用作 tool-use / evidence-grounded planning 的对齐与数据合成靶场；3）从结果归因上强调“失败更多来自证据获取不全而非纯幻觉”，这会影响后续训练信号设计（例如把探索/覆盖率作为奖励或过程监督）。整体更像 agent-eval 资产，而不是预训练方法论文。
summary.technical_approach:
LifePlanner 的方法核心是“环境 + 协议”两件事。
1）环境（database + tools）：在约 10km^2 城市区域内构建地理空间骨架（高德 API + OSM），清洗去重后得到约 3,600 个地点（spatial anchor）。然后为每个地点抓取本地社媒证据（小红书 RedNote）：按地点名检索最多 20 条 note，每条 note 取最多 10 条评论；保留标题、正文、发布时间、互动指标、tag 等，形成约 200,000 条 notes/comments 的弱结构语料。关键点是：证据允许歧义、冗余、无关信息存在，逼迫 agent 做交叉验证与消歧。
2）属性蒸馏（用于构造题目而非给模型看）：用 Gemini-2.5-Flash 从社媒抽取静态属性（设施/供给）与动态属性（短期状态如临时关闭、新品等），这些“dynamic memory fields”只用于生成/筛选测试用例，评测时不暴露给 agent，避免把答案泄露成结构化字段。
3）访问隔离与工具箱：评测时 agent 只能通过 MCP 工具检索原始 posts/comments 与地图信息、做基础空间分析/路径规划；不能直接读取蒸馏属性。这样把难点锁定在“工具检索→证据阅读→约束整合→规划输出”。
4）评测协议：667 条合成但贴近日常的查询，覆盖四类任务（Place Perception / Nearby Discovery / Routing / Trip Design），每类三档难度：L0 单次检索即可；L1 多次检索+计算；L2 在证据基础上做决策并满足额外用户约束。模型输出结构化 JSON，便于多视角打分与错误归因。
summary.experiments: 论文给出的关键信号是难度分层下的性能断崖：前沿模型在简单检索类任务表现较好，但在复杂规划（尤其 L2）显著退化，整体 Pass Rate 下降到 40.2%（文中描述为复杂规划场景的显著下滑）。作者的诊断结论是：主要失败来自不完整的证据获取与薄弱的约束整合，而不是典型的无中生有式幻觉；同时，单纯扩大模型规模或让模型写更长的推理轨迹不足以解决问题，暗示瓶颈在“探索/检索策略 + 证据覆盖率 + 约束一致性检查”而非纯语言推理长度。由于你提供的全文片段在实验细节处截断，具体到各模型（18 个模型/具体型号）与各子任务分数、消融（如工具可用性、检索次数上限、是否给路线工具等）的数字需要以论文实验章节为准。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
1）先看任务分层定义（四类任务 + L0/L1/L2），理解作者如何把“检索/计算/决策”拆开；这决定了它能否用于训练信号设计。
2）重点看数据库构建与“访问隔离”设计：蒸馏属性只用于出题、不用于评测输入，这一点决定 benchmark 是否会被“结构化字段投机”。
3）看失败归因部分：作者把问题归到 evidence acquisition 与 constraint integration，适合映射到后训练（过程奖励、检索覆盖率、工具调用可靠性）而不是继续堆 CoT。
4）如果要用于训练：关注 MCP 工具接口与 JSON 输出 schema，评估能否直接做轨迹数据收集与 verifier 设计。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate LLM agents on geo-spatial planning with realistic, noisy, time-sensitive local evidence (social media posts/comments), and to diagnose failures at the level of evidence acquisition and constraint integration rather than only final-answer correctness.
summary_en.importance: Limited direct impact on pretraining recipes, but useful as an evaluation asset that stresses a data regime closer to real-world agent use: weakly-structured social evidence + tool-mediated retrieval + multi-constraint planning. The paper’s main takeaway for training is the diagnosis that many failures come from incomplete evidence gathering and weak constraint integration (not pure hallucination), which suggests training signals around exploration/coverage, tool-use reliability, and evidence-grounded verification. It is primarily an agent-eval benchmark rather than a pretraining-method contribution.
summary_en.technical_approach:
LifePlanner is built around (1) a realistic environment and (2) a structured evaluation protocol.
1) Environment: a ~10 km^2 urban region with ~3,600 deduplicated places (spatial anchors) built from AMap API + OpenStreetMap. Each anchor is enriched with weakly-structured local social media evidence from RedNote: up to 20 notes per place via name search, and up to 10 comments per note, retaining full text, timestamps, engagement stats, and tags—yielding ~200k notes/comments. Ambiguity and irrelevant content are intentionally preserved.
2) Attribute distillation for case construction: Gemini-2.5-Flash extracts static tags (facilities/offerings) and dynamic states (temporary closures/new arrivals). Crucially, these distilled “dynamic memory” fields are used to construct tasks but are hidden from evaluated agents to prevent leakage.
3) Access separation + MCP tools: during evaluation, agents must retrieve and interpret raw posts/comments through an MCP toolset, alongside map/routing utilities.
4) Evaluation protocol: 667 synthetic yet realistic queries across four task families (Place Perception, Nearby Discovery, Routing, Trip Design) and three difficulty tiers: L0 single retrieval; L1 multi-retrieval + calculation; L2 decision-making under additional user constraints. Agents output structured JSON for multi-aspect scoring and analysis.
summary_en.experiments: The headline result is a sharp performance cliff from simple retrieval to complex constrained planning: models do reasonably on easier tiers but degrade substantially on harder planning, with pass rate reported to drop to 40.2% in complex settings. The paper attributes failures mainly to incomplete evidence acquisition and weak constraint integration, and argues that scaling models or producing longer reasoning traces is not sufficient—pointing to bottlenecks in retrieval/exploration strategy and grounded verification. The provided full-text excerpt is truncated before detailed tables; model-by-model breakdowns and any ablations should be taken from the experiments section of the paper.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Read the task taxonomy and L0/L1/L2 definitions first; this is the core design that makes errors diagnosable.
- Focus on the dataset construction and the “distill-for-construction, hide-for-eval” access separation; it determines whether agents can game the benchmark.
- Check the failure analysis: how they operationalize evidence acquisition vs constraint integration.
- If you want to reuse it for training, inspect the MCP tool API and the JSON output schema to see whether trajectories can be collected and verified cleanly.

recommendation.zh: 一个结合社交媒体数据的 Agent 规划 Benchmark，揭示了当前模型在复杂约束和噪声检索下的短板，可作为 Agent 评测的参考。
recommendation.en: An agent planning benchmark incorporating social media data, revealing current models' shortcomings in complex constraints and noisy retrieval; useful reference for agent evaluation.

paper.title: EVOMAL: Self-Poisoning in Self-Evolving Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Self-evolving LLM coding agents write their own tools by imitating retrieved skills from shared skill libraries. We identify a vulnerability in this loop: during authoring, a retrieved malicious skill can become the template for a new skill that preserves the payload. We call this self-poisoning: the agent authors, stores, and runs the resulting malicious skill. We exploit it through EvoMal, an attack that amplifies self-poisoning by wrapping an interchangeable payload in a banner, a set of beni

summary.core_problem: 自进化 coding agent 会从共享 skill library 检索并模仿技能写新工具，这一闭环可能被恶意技能诱导产生自我投毒。
summary.importance: 贡献是 coding agent 安全中的新攻击面：恶意技能即使不被直接调用，也能作为模板被模仿、复制、入库并继续传播；对训练 agentic coding model 和构建工具库治理有实际警示。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 EvoMal 攻击，把可替换 payload 包在一组看似无害的结构元素 banner 中，使 agent 在 authoring 新 skill 时复现其中代码。论文定义 Agent Self-Poisoning Rate，衡量任务中新增恶意 skill 的比例。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、任务集和成功率数值；声称攻击者只需向 skill library 植入恶意技能，无需触发执行，随后 agent 会创作并运行带 payload 的新技能，且副本可重新进入库形成持久传播。

summary_en.core_problem: Self-evolving coding agents retrieve and imitate skills from shared libraries to write new tools, creating a loop that can be exploited for self-poisoning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a new attack surface for coding agents: a malicious skill can be copied as a template even when it is not directly invoked, then stored, executed, and propagated. This matters for training agentic coding models and governing shared tool libraries.
summary_en.technical_approach: EvoMal wraps an interchangeable payload inside a benign-looking structural banner that induces the agent to reproduce the enclosed code when authoring new skills. The paper defines Agent Self-Poisoning Rate as the fraction of tasks that add newly authored malicious skills.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide exact models, task sets, or attack success rates. It claims the attacker only needs to plant malicious skills in the library; the agent can then author and execute new payload-carrying skills, and copies can re-enter the library to persist after the original planted skills are removed.

recommendation.zh: 读威胁模型和 ASPR 定义即可；它不是 pretrain 论文，但会影响 coding agent 数据闭环设计。
recommendation.en: Read the threat model and ASPR definition; not a pretraining paper, but it matters for coding-agent data-loop design.

paper.title: Previewing the Model Hardware Standard
paper.abstract: We’re opening a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a shared specification for AI agents to safely operate physical devices, to a first group of scientific research labs and advanced manufacturers.

summary.core_problem: MHS 解决的是 AI agent 操作真实实验室和制造设备时缺少统一硬件接口的问题。现有设备通常有各自的驱动、厂商软件和隐性操作知识，导致多设备编排需要大量定制集成，也难以把安全边界和设备语义稳定暴露给模型。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值不在语言模型训练算法，而在把 agent 从“调用软件工具”推进到“控制物理实验流程”所需的接口层。对预训练研究有两个具体影响。第一，它可能改变未来科研数据的产生方式：模型可以编排实验、观察结果、调整参数、写入可复现脚本，从而形成高密度的实验轨迹数据。第二，它给 tool-use 和 embodied agent 训练提供了更清晰的监督界面：设备能力、可调参数、安全限制、观测流和长任务脚本都被结构化表达。相比让模型直接读厂商手册或调用零散 API，这种标准化接口更适合做安全评测、轨迹收集和后训练数据构造。
summary.technical_approach: MHS 的核心是一个 model-agnostic 的硬件标准驱动。驱动把不同设备的接口翻译成简单原语，例如 read 用于读取温度、图像、曲线等状态，write 用于设置温度、位置、激光参数等可控量。设备以标准格式 discoverable，使 agent 和设备可以跨网络发现和通信，不必为每种设备写单独的转换程序。另一个关键设计是自然语言 tags。许多硬件知识不在代码里，例如机械臂重量、设备安全边界、可测量量、可调节量、操作约束。MHS 允许用户直接写入这些信息，也可以让 agent 通过访谈方式收集。驱动随后自动生成 reference file，给 agent 提供设备能力和约束说明。控制层有三种入口：MCP、命令行接口和代码文件 API。在线推理适合高层监督、异常处理和参数更新；长时或高频操作则被模型写成确定性代码文件执行，避免模型在每个低级动作上反复推理。这一点很重要，因为真实硬件控制常常要求低延迟、可复现和可审计。
summary.experiments: 内容是 research preview 和合作案例，不是封闭 benchmark，也没有公开的系统性消融。报告给出的数字和案例包括：MHS 将实验室或制造设施的硬件集成时间从通常的数周或数月降低到数小时或数分钟；CMU 在 serial dilution dose-response 实验中，用 agent 编排液体处理器、plate reader、机械臂和监控摄像头，速度约为此前的 3 倍；QuEra 将 MHS 用于量子计算机中激光系统的部分控制，agent 开发的 controller 在无需人工介入的情况下恢复 laser lock 的成功率为 99.3%。其他案例包括 Genentech 自动化 BCA protein assay，协调液体处理器、机械臂和 plate reader；华盛顿大学 Baker 和 Pinglay labs 构建远程仪器监控 dashboard、agent-supervised qPCR，并实现机械臂和液体处理器之间的无碰撞 plate handoff；HHMI Janelia 将原本依赖七个厂商程序的显微系统统一编排；Tetsuwan 将 MHS 接入 ResearchOS，编排 qPCR workflow。需要注意的是，这些结果主要来自早期合作伙伴部署，缺少统一任务定义、失败率分解、模型对照和安全事件统计。
summary.reading_guide: 精读时重点看四处。第一，标准驱动和 read/write 原语，这是把复杂硬件降到 agent 可操作接口的核心。第二，自然语言 tags 到 reference file 的链路，这决定模型是否能正确理解新设备的能力和安全边界。第三，MCP、CLI、代码文件三种控制面如何分工，尤其是“模型探索后写确定性脚本”这一模式，它比持续在线控制更适合可复现实验。第四，合作案例中的故障恢复、实时监控和多设备编排，这些会影响 future agent training data 的形态。值得深挖的问题是：reference file 的 schema 是否足够严格；安全限制由驱动强制还是由模型遵守；多设备并发时如何处理状态一致性；硬件操作轨迹能否形成可训练、可评测的数据集。
summary.authors_note: Anthropic 发起的 research preview，最初与 HHMI Janelia Research Campus 合作开发。早期合作方包括 Genentech、University of Washington Baker 和 Pinglay labs、Carnegie Mellon University、HHMI Janelia Research Campus、QuEra、Tetsuwan 等。具体作者名单未在提供内容中确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The Model Hardware Standard addresses the missing interface layer between AI agents and real-world laboratory or manufacturing hardware. Today, devices expose heterogeneous vendor APIs, local software, manuals, and tacit operating knowledge. This makes multi-device orchestration slow to integrate and hard to expose to models with clear safety constraints.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is not a new language-model training algorithm. Its significance is that it defines an interface for moving agents from software tool use to physical experimental control. For pretraining and post-training research, that matters in two ways. First, it can change how scientific and engineering data is produced: agents can orchestrate experiments, observe results, update parameters, and package successful procedures into reproducible scripts. Second, it creates a cleaner supervision surface for tool-use and embodied-agent training: device capabilities, adjustable parameters, observations, safety limits, and long-running procedures become structured rather than scattered across manuals and bespoke APIs.
summary_en.technical_approach: MHS is built around a model-agnostic standardized hardware driver. The driver translates device-specific interfaces into simple primitives such as read, for retrieving temperature, images, curves, or other state, and write, for setting temperature, positions, laser parameters, or other controllable values. Devices are made discoverable in a standard format so that agents and instruments can find and communicate with each other across networks without custom translators. A second important design is the use of natural-language tags. Many hardware-relevant facts are not visible from code alone, such as the weight of a robot arm, operating limits, what the device can measure, and what can be safely adjusted. MHS lets users enter this information directly, or have an agent interview them about the setup. The driver then produces a reference file describing the device’s capabilities and enforced safety limits. Control is exposed through MCP, command-line interfaces, and code-file APIs. Online model reasoning is used for high-level supervision, monitoring, fault handling, and parameter updates, while long-running or fast operations can be compiled into deterministic scripts. This separation is important because physical control often needs low latency, reproducibility, and auditability.
summary_en.experiments: The blog reports a research preview and partner deployments rather than a controlled benchmark with ablations. The reported integration claim is that MHS can reduce setup work from weeks or months to hours or minutes. Carnegie Mellon used MHS for serial dilution dose-response experiments and reports roughly a 3x speedup, with an agent orchestrating a liquid handler, plate reader, robotic arm, and monitoring cameras across three computers with incompatible interfaces. QuEra used MHS to give an agent control over parts of the laser system in neutral-atom quantum machines; the agent-developed controller recovered laser lock 99.3% of the time without human intervention. Other deployments include Genentech automating a BCA protein assay across a liquid handler, robotic arm, and plate reader; University of Washington work on remote monitoring, agent-supervised qPCR, and collision-free plate handoffs; HHMI Janelia unifying a microscopy rig that previously depended on seven vendor programs; and Tetsuwan integrating MHS with ResearchOS for a qPCR workflow. The evidence is promising but incomplete: there is no public standardized task suite, failure taxonomy, model comparison, or detailed safety incident analysis in the provided material.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the architecture details closely. The key pieces are the standardized driver and read/write primitives, the natural-language tag to reference-file pathway, and the three control surfaces: MCP, CLI, and code-file APIs. The most important behavioral pattern is that the model can explore a device, observe the effects, and then write a deterministic script for repeated execution. That is more relevant to reproducible autonomous experimentation than continuous low-level reasoning. The partner examples are useful for understanding real deployment constraints: multi-device orchestration, live monitoring, fault recovery, and incompatible vendor stacks. The main questions to investigate further are whether the reference-file schema is strict enough, which safety limits are enforced by the driver rather than left to the model, how concurrent device state is managed, and whether hardware-operation traces can become trainable and evaluable datasets.
summary_en.authors_note: Anthropic research preview, initially developed in collaboration with HHMI Janelia Research Campus. Early partners mentioned include Genentech, the University of Washington Baker and Pinglay labs, Carnegie Mellon University, HHMI Janelia Research Campus, QuEra, and Tetsuwan. The provided content does not identify individual authors.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做 tool-use/embodied agent，知道 MHS 这件事有必要；但它不是训练方法论文，读标准边界定义即可，不必深挖。
recommendation.en: If you work on tool-use or embodied agents, you should know MHS exists; but this is not a training-method paper, so just read the interface and safety boundary definitions.

paper.title: JIT-Agent: Scaling Harness Intelligence via Just-in-Time Harness Evolution
paper.abstract: Agent capability is not determined by the model alone. The agent harness, encompassing memory management, planning strategy, action protocol, and tool/skill orchestration, can dominate the contribution of the underlying foundation model. Yet harness design remains manual, task-specific, and fundamentally unscalable. We present JIT-Agent, a harness intelligence model trained to synthesize task-adaptive agent harnesses on the fly for arbitrary off-the-shelf agentic LLMs. We formalize the agent har

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文关注 agent 能力不只由底座模型决定，还强烈依赖 harness，即记忆、规划、动作协议、工具和技能编排。它要解决的问题是：能否训练一个元模型，在看到具体任务时即时生成可执行的 task-specific harness，而不是提前人工设计或离线搜索一个通用 harness。
summary.importance: 这不是 LLM 预训练方法论文，但对通用 agent 研究有一定参考意义。它把 harness 作为可生成、可修复、可演化的程序化对象，并提出专门训练一个 harness intelligence model。对基座研究员的启发主要在两个层面：一是模型能力评估不能只看权重，还要控制执行外壳；二是 agent post-training 数据可以来自 harness 生成、失败修复和执行反馈，而不只是轨迹模仿。
summary.technical_approach: JIT-Agent 将 agent harness 约束为四个模块：memory、planning、action、capability orchestration。作者构建 HarnessFactory，把不同 scaffold 统一到同一接口，使模型生成的是结构化、可执行模块，而不是任意 agent 程序。训练分三阶段：Stage I 用 teacher 生成的协议合规样例学习任务条件化定制；Stage II 把编译错误、接口不匹配、运行时失败转成 bounded repair trajectories，训练模型做可靠修复；Stage III 使用 Evolutionary Group-Decoupled Policy Optimization，让模型提出能超过当前 archive frontier 的 harness，并对 reward、latency、cost 分别归一化。推理时，JIT-Agent 接收任务、协议、工具/技能注册表和检索到的历史 harness，生成一个外壳来驱动任意 off-the-shelf agentic LLM。
summary.experiments: 给定全文片段说明作者训练了 JIT-Agent-27B，并声称它能提升高效 backbone，也能结合更强 backbone；但片段未提供 benchmark 名称、任务数量、胜率、成本、延迟或消融数字。应重点验证三组实验：即时生成 harness 是否优于固定 AOT harness；repair stage 是否显著降低不可执行率；Evo-GDPO 是否在 reward、latency、cost 之间带来稳定收益，而不是只通过更复杂外壳增加调用成本。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。优先看 harness 四模块协议、HarnessFactory 的接口定义、三阶段训练数据构造，以及 Evo-GDPO 的目标函数。实验部分若可获得，先看不同 backbone 下的增益和成本，再看不可执行 harness 的修复率，最后看 archive evolution 的消融。需要保持警惕的是任务分布是否足够多样，生成 harness 是否真的泛化到新工具和新模型，以及性能提升是否来自更多调用预算。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper argues that agent capability is determined by the model-harness pair, not by the foundation model alone. It asks whether a trained meta-agent can generate an executable, task-specific harness at inference time, instead of relying on manually designed or ahead-of-time optimized scaffolds.
summary_en.importance: This is not a base pretraining paper, but it is relevant to general agent methodology. The main contribution is to treat the agent harness as a machine-generatable artifact that can be customized, repaired, and evolved from feedback. For foundation-model researchers, the useful implication is that agent evaluation and post-training data quality depend heavily on the execution harness; trajectories are not independent of memory design, planning protocol, tool exposure, and recovery logic.
summary_en.technical_approach: JIT-Agent represents a harness as a four-module protocol covering memory, planning, action, and capability orchestration. HarnessFactory provides a shared interface and a library of representative scaffolds, so the generator emits structured executable modules rather than unconstrained programs. Training has three stages. Stage I teaches task-conditioned harness customization from teacher-generated, protocol-compliant examples. Stage II turns compiler errors, interface mismatches, and runtime failures into bounded repair trajectories. Stage III introduces Evolutionary Group-Decoupled Policy Optimization, where the model learns to propose harnesses that improve over an archive frontier while normalizing reward, latency, and cost separately. At inference time, the generated harness wraps an arbitrary off-the-shelf agentic LLM.
summary_en.experiments: The provided excerpt reports the training of JIT-Agent-27B and claims improved execution when paired with both efficient and stronger backbones. It does not provide the full benchmark suite, task counts, win rates, latency, cost, or ablation numbers. The critical experiments to inspect are comparisons against fixed ahead-of-time harnesses, the failure-rate reduction from the repair stage, and the contribution of Evo-GDPO under controlled inference budgets.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is appropriate. Read the four-module harness protocol, the HarnessFactory abstraction, the data construction for the three training stages, and the Evo-GDPO objective. In the experiments, first check gains across different backbone models, then inspect repair success rates and cost-normalized performance. The main risks to evaluate are distribution narrowness, hidden extra tool-call budget, and whether generated harnesses generalize to new tools, new task families, and different agentic LLMs.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改 pretrain 方法，但会改你看 agent 结果的口径：先看 harness ablation 再看底模排名，重点读 protocol 设计和 archive self-evolution 是否真能跨任务复用。
recommendation.en: It does not change pretraining directly, but it should change how you read agent results: inspect harness ablations before trusting base-model rankings, especially the protocol design and whether archive-driven self-evolution really transfers.

paper.title: Tunable Tool-Call Rates in LLM Agents via Representation Steering
paper.abstract: Deciding whether to call a tool is a core competence of an LLM agent, and a costly one to get wrong: needless calls add latency, accrue cost, and may trigger irreversible side effects, while missing calls leave the model confidently wrong on questions it could only answer through tool-calls. Models manage this balance poorly, both over-using and under-using tools. Existing methods such as post-training and prompt engineering are expensive and difficult to modify at inference time. We show that w

summary.core_problem: LLM Agent 在决定是否调用工具时往往表现不佳（过度使用或使用不足），而现有的微调或 Prompt 工程方法成本高昂且难以在推理时动态调整。
summary.importance: 揭示了 LLM 内部存在一个控制“是否调用工具”的单一线性表示方向，提供了一种无需训练、无需修改 Prompt 的轻量级推理期干预手段，为 Agent 的成本-准确率权衡提供了连续可调的旋钮。
summary.technical_approach: 提出一种基于表示引导（Representation Steering）的免训练方法。首先，在多工具环境中，利用模型自身工具调用格式的特殊 Token（如 `<tool_call>`）的对数概率作为工具使用倾向的代理指标。然后，基于该指标对查询进行排序，提取高倾向和低倾向样本在特定层的残差流表示的均值差（Difference-of-Means, DIM），得到控制工具调用倾向的单一方向向量。在推理时，将该向量按一定强度加回到残差流中，实现对工具调用频率的连续控制。
summary.experiments: 在开放域问答任务中，通过调整干预强度，模型展现出清晰的成本-准确率帕累托前沿。在平均每个问题调用约一次搜索的情况下，QA 准确率从 0.29 提升至 0.56。实验还表明，该方向具有知识选择性和工具通用性，能泛化到提取时未见过的工具，且独立于控制“选择哪个工具”的方向。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Method 部分关于如何利用 `<tool_call>` Token 概率提取倾向指标的巧妙设计，以及如何通过 DIM 提取方向向量。实验部分关注成本-准确率帕累托前沿的图表，理解干预强度对实际效果的影响。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM agents struggle to balance tool usage (often over-using or under-using tools), and existing mitigation methods like fine-tuning or prompt engineering are expensive and inflexible at inference time.
summary_en.importance: Reveals the existence of a single linear direction in the residual stream that controls the binary decision of whether to call a tool, providing a lightweight, training-free, and prompt-independent intervention for continuous control over the cost-accuracy tradeoff in agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a training-free representation steering method. It first uses the log-probability of a tool-exclusive special token (e.g., `<tool_call>`) in a multi-tool environment as a proxy for tool-use propensity. It then ranks queries based on this proxy and extracts a Difference-of-Means (DIM) vector from the residual stream representations of high- and low-propensity sets. During inference, adding this vector to the residual stream with varying strengths provides continuous control over the model's tendency to call tools.
summary_en.experiments: In open-domain QA, varying the intervention strength traces a clear cost-accuracy Pareto frontier. Accuracy increased from 0.29 to 0.56 at roughly one search call per question. The extracted direction is shown to be knowledge-selective, tool-general (transferring to held-out tools), and distinct from the direction controlling which specific tool is selected.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Method section detailing the clever use of the `<tool_call>` token probability as a propensity proxy and the DIM extraction process. In the experiments, pay attention to the Pareto frontier charts to understand the practical impact of the intervention strength.

recommendation.zh: 这不是 pretrain 论文，但它把 tool policy 压成单一线性方向这件事很值得警惕；只看方法和 ablation，若结果稳，说明后训练行为控制可能比想象中更低维。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the claim that tool policy collapses to a single steerable direction is worth checking; read the method and ablations only—if it holds, post-training control may be much lower-dimensional than assumed.

paper.title: CaSKG: Counterfactual-Causal Skill Graphs for Scalable Agent Skill Retrieval
paper.abstract: Reusable skill libraries allow large language model (LLM) agents to reuse procedural knowledge across tasks, but they also turn memory access into a challenging retrieval problem. Full-library prompting preserves coverage at high context cost, vector retrieval returns compact neighborhoods but treats skills as independent text, and graph-based retrieval can recover workflow context only when the edges that carry relevance are reliable. We propose CaSKG, a counterfactual-causal skill graph framew

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM agent 在复用大型技能库时，如何低成本、可靠地检索与当前任务相关的过程性技能和技能依赖关系。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent memory / skill retrieval 方法。它关注技能库从简单文本检索走向图结构和因果校准，对长生命周期 agent 的记忆访问有一定方法参考，但距离预训练研究较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CaSKG，即 Counterfactual-Causal Skill Graphs。方法先用语义、词法、输入输出和结构证据构建高召回有向候选图，再用 repair evidence 和可选 LLM judge 调整候选边分数。随后对技能对进行方向条件的文本反事实 probe，包括移除、替换和重排，并用 Bayesian smoothing 聚合证据，最终发布按任务状态过滤的加权技能图用于检索扩展。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark、agent 环境、LLM backbone、技能库规模或数值结果。可确认的是论文比较了 full-library prompting、vector retrieval 和 graph-based retrieval 这几类基线设定。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自吉林大学人工智能学院和蚂蚁集团。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how LLM agents can retrieve relevant procedural skills and dependencies from a large reusable skill library with low context cost.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent memory and skill-retrieval method. It moves beyond flat vector search toward graph-structured procedural memory with causal calibration, which is relevant to long-lived agents but not directly to base-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: CaSKG first builds a high-recall directed candidate graph using semantic, lexical, input-output, and structural evidence, optionally refined by repair evidence and an LLM judge. It then runs direction-conditioned textual counterfactual probes over skill pairs through removal, substitution, and reordering, aggregates evidence with Bayesian smoothing, and exposes a state-filtered weighted graph for task-conditioned retrieval.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete benchmarks, environments, backbone LLMs, skill-library size, or quantitative results. It frames the comparison against full-library prompting, vector retrieval, and graph-based retrieval.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Jilin University and Ant Group.

recommendation.zh: agent 记忆检索里有一点干净的因果味道；若做技能库，只看反事实 probe 设计。
recommendation.en: There is a cleaner causal flavor than typical agent-memory papers; if building skill libraries, read only the counterfactual probe design.

institutions: Affiliation:School of Artificial Intelligence,Jilin University,Ant Group

paper.title: Auto-Policy, not Auto-Skill: Compiled Agent Skills for the Physical World
paper.abstract: Self-evolving Skill harnesses (AutoSkills, Hermes Agent) generate more advisory orchestration automatically; their reported gains are efficiency, not safety. This misses the actual gap: a Skill describes how an agent should behave; a Policy decides which behavior is allowed to become an action. Today's format covers the first with markdown and scripts; the second is left to the model. Generating more Skills scales the gap, not the safety, especially when a wrong invocation can unlock a door or m

summary.core_problem: 解决自动生成 Agent Skills 时只扩展行为能力、不约束动作授权的问题，尤其关注物理世界和高风险操作。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 安全架构 / policy enforcement；它把 Skill 的“如何做”与 Policy 的“是否允许做”分开，指出自演化 Skill harness 带来的主要缺口不是效率，而是权限边界。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Auto-Policy 而不是 Auto-Skill 的设计立场，并引入 Edge Skillguard：从摘要可见，它意在为接收 Agent 提供类型化的拒绝机制，避免恶意或误用的 Skill 通过附带权限声明驱动物理执行。
summary.experiments: 摘要主要给出威胁模型和相邻攻击证据：恶意 skills 破坏云软件、越狱 LLM 控制机器人造成物理伤害；未提供明确模型规模、数据集、baseline 或定量效果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the gap between automatically generated agent skills and explicit action authorization, especially for physical-world actuation.
summary_en.importance: It is an agent safety and policy-enforcement contribution. The key distinction is between a Skill describing how to behave and a Policy deciding whether that behavior may become an action.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper argues for Auto-Policy rather than Auto-Skill and proposes Edge Skillguard. From the abstract, the mechanism appears to provide typed rejection of inter-agent permission claims so that malicious or misused skills cannot directly drive actuation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract frames two adjacent attack classes: malicious skills compromising cloud software and jailbroken LLM-controlled robots causing physical harm. It does not report model scale, datasets, baselines, or quantitative results.

recommendation.zh: 这是 Agent 安全边界设计，不是基座训练；扫一下 Borrowed Authority 威胁模型即可，方法效果等正文再确认。
recommendation.en: This is agent safety boundary work, not base-model training; skim the Borrowed Authority threat model and treat the proposed mechanism as unvalidated until the full setup is checked.

paper.title: From General Agents to RCA Experts: A Self-Evolving Harness for Root Cause Analysis
paper.abstract: Automated root cause analysis (RCA) with large language models (LLMs) has drawn growing attention. Today, SREs typically automate RCA with LLMs in one of two ways: directly using a general-purpose agent (e.g., Codex or Claude Code) for diagnosis, or building a specialized RCA agent from scratch. As mainstream general agents grow more capable and iterate quickly, our quantitative study finds that the former now often surpasses the latter. Its accuracy, however, still falls short of production nee

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 在生产环境根因分析中的适配问题：通用 agent 已经很强，但离可用性仍差一层外部 harness。
summary.importance: 贡献在于 agent 系统设计与经验积累机制，而不是基座模型本身；对 pretrain 研究员的价值主要在于理解“外部脚手架”与“模型内能力”的边界。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先做定量比较，认为现代通用 agent 往往已超过从零构建的专用 RCA agent；随后提出 OpsHarness，把重点放在 agent 外部 harness 的自演化能力上，通过积累历史诊断经验持续改进系统特定适配层。
summary.experiments: 摘要声称通过定量研究发现通用 agent 常优于专用 RCA agent，但未给出具体 benchmark、样本规模、模型名称和提升幅度；更像系统论文而非干净的方法学实验。
summary.authors_note: 作者包含 Michael R. Lyu，长期从事软件工程与系统可靠性研究；该工作更接近 SRE/SE 场景下的 agent harness 设计。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses adaptation for LLM-based root cause analysis in production: general-purpose agents are already strong, but the remaining gap largely sits in the external harness.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is in agent-system design and experience accumulation rather than the base model itself; for pretraining researchers, the value is mainly in clarifying the boundary between model capability and external scaffolding.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper first presents a quantitative comparison suggesting modern general agents often outperform specialized RCA agents built from scratch. It then proposes OpsHarness, a self-evolving external harness that accumulates past diagnostic experience to improve system-specific adaptation over time.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims quantitative evidence that general agents often beat specialized RCA agents, but gives no concrete benchmark, sample size, model list, or effect size. It reads more like a systems paper than a clean methodological study.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Michael R. Lyu, known for software engineering and system reliability research; the work is closer to SRE/SE-oriented agent harness design.

recommendation.zh: 有个可记的判断：别重复造专用 agent，先把 harness 做厚；但这是垂直 RCA 场景，结论外推到通用 agent 要很谨慎。
recommendation.en: One useful takeaway is to stop rebuilding specialized agents and invest in the harness first, but the evidence is rooted in RCA and should not be over-generalized.

paper.title: PeakBench: Benchmarking Resource-Aware Tool Invocation in LLM Agents
paper.abstract: LLM agents increasingly solve tasks by invoking multiple tools, where parallel execution is essential for low latency but difficult to manage safely. Existing agent benchmarks primarily evaluate tool selection, argument generation, and end-to-end success under mostly serial execution, largely overlooking valid parallelization and resource-constrained scheduling. This missing scheduling dimension creates a practical failure mode: serial execution is safe but slow, while resource-agnostic parallel

summary.core_problem: 现有 LLM agent benchmark 主要评估工具选择和最终成功率，但基本忽略了并行调用中的资源约束与调度正确性，导致无法衡量“安全但慢”和“快但会爆资源”之间的真实能力差异。
summary.importance: 这是一个评测贡献。它补上了 agent tool-use 里很实际但常被漏掉的一维：资源感知的并行调度。对做通用 agent 系统、tool planner、execution policy 的研究有参考价值，但对基座预训练本身的直接牵引较弱。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 PeakBench：由可执行的多工具工作流组成，带有基于执行的依赖标注和实测资源画像。核心设计是两段式评估，把失败归因拆成依赖规划错误与资源约束调度错误，避免只看端到端成功率而掩盖具体短板。
summary.experiments: 从摘要可知，实验重点不是更大模型或训练，而是 benchmark 构建与评测协议验证。主要比较对象应是现有 agent 在串行执行、资源无感并行执行以及资源约束调度下的表现差异；摘要未给出具体模型规模、样本量和数值结果。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM-agent benchmarks mostly test tool selection and end-task success, but largely miss the scheduling dimension of parallel tool execution under resource constraints.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation contribution. It adds a practically important axis—resource-aware parallel scheduling—to tool-use benchmarks. Useful for agent-system research, but only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces PeakBench, a benchmark of executable multi-tool workflows with execution-grounded dependency annotations and measured resource profiles. Its key design is a two-part evaluation framework that disentangles dependency-planning errors from resource-constrained scheduling errors.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the emphasis is on benchmark construction and protocol validation rather than model scaling or training. The likely comparisons are serial execution, resource-agnostic parallelism, and resource-aware scheduling, though the abstract does not provide model sizes or full quantitative tables.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 关系不深，但如果你在看 tool-use agent 的真实瓶颈，只读任务定义和 failure attribution 设计就够了，别把它当能力提升论文。
recommendation.en: Not very pretrain-relevant, but if you care about real tool-use bottlenecks, read the task design and failure attribution only; this is an eval paper, not a capability advance.

paper.title: Contrastive Branch Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) enables language models to learn multi-turn interaction with external tools, yet its sparse outcome rewards provide no signal for identifying which intermediate decisions are responsible for success. Branch sampling induces local comparisons among alternative continuations, but existing methods tend to conflate two distinct problems: allocating a fixed rollout budget and translating branch outcomes into token-level credit. We introduce Contra

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 tool-augmented RLVR 里一个很具体但长期存在的问题：只有终局可验证奖励时，模型知道哪条完整轨迹好坏，却不知道中间哪些决策真正决定了结果。已有 branch/tree 方法尝试通过共享前缀后的不同续写来做局部比较，但常把两个问题混在一起：一是有限 rollout 预算该分配到哪里去 branch，二是 branch 结果如何回写成局部 credit。CBPO 的核心就是把这两件事拆开。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，更偏 post-train / agent RL；但对理解“如何从稀疏结果奖励中提取更细粒度训练信号”有启发。这个问题和 reasoning RL、tool-use RL、甚至某些 test-time search 训练都相通。文章最有价值的点不是又提出一个树搜索变体，而是明确区分 exploration signal 与 credit signal：entropy 用来找可能值得分叉的位置，reward contrast 用来判断这些位置对最终结果是否敏感。这个拆分比把 entropy 直接当 advantage proxy 更干净，也更容易分析失败模式。
summary.technical_approach: CBPO 有两条主线。第一条是 branch allocation。作者不只在工具调用边界后找分叉点，而是在整段响应上扫描局部 generation entropy，用 fixed-interval windows 暴露候选位置。然后用 path-level decay 和 node-level decay 在固定 branch budget 下做分配，避免预算塌缩到少数轨迹或相邻 token 上。这里的直觉是：高熵位置说明模型对续写有分歧，适合探索；但如果不加衰减，分叉会扎堆，导致信息冗余。第二条是 local credit assignment。作者定义 exact-prefix group：父轨迹和若干分支在某个位置之前 token 完全相同，只在该点之后分化。组内 reward variation 被用来构造 Contrastive Branch Value, CBV，作为该局部决策对最终 outcome 敏感度的估计。CBV 会经过标准化和有界化处理，只改变 continuation advantage 的幅度，不改变符号。与此同时，shared prefix token 不接收 branch gradient，多分叉节点把父轨迹切成不重叠的 credit segment，避免同一段前缀被重复归因。整体上，它是在 GRPO 这类 trajectory-level update 之上，加了一层 outcome-contrastive 的局部调制：不是给整条轨迹统一 advantage，而是让真正发生分歧且影响结果的后缀拿到更强更新。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两个模型规模、十个 benchmark，分成五个工具增强数学任务和五个知识检索任务。作者声称在这两类任务的 macro average 上都优于现有 policy optimization 与 branch-based baseline。更值得看的不是总分，而是消融。文章把收益归因到两部分：一，branch allocation 更均衡，说明 fixed-window entropy candidate + 双重 decay 确实减少了预算集中和相邻节点冗余；二，CBV 式的 contrastive credit 比把 branch outcome 粗暴平均回写更有效，说明 exact-prefix 对照能更准确定位关键决策。按引言描述，作者还做了 cross-scale ablation，表明这些收益不是某个单一模型尺寸下的偶然现象。给到的全文片段没有完整表格和具体数值，因此不宜编造绝对提升幅度；但可以确定，实验设计的重点是把“探索位置选择”和“局部 credit 估计”分别拆出来验证。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议先看 Introduction 和 Preliminaries，明确作者是在批评哪类现有方法：不是 branch sampling 无效，而是 branch placement 与 token credit 被混成一个问题。然后直接看方法部分里关于 entropy candidate discovery、path/node decay、exact-prefix group、CBV、prefix masking、non-overlapping segmentation 这几个定义。只要这几个部件的职责分清楚，整篇文章就读顺了。实验部分重点看 ablation，而不是只看总榜，因为这篇文章的说服力主要来自“拆分后每个模块各自带来什么”。预计 25–40 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读。若时间更少，只看方法图和两张关键消融表也够判断是否值得深入。
