Counterfactual tests are run offline to create labels, and lightweight readouts are trained to predict those labels from the policy’s own representations. At rollout time, the reward can therefore be computed cheaply, without process supervision or extra model calls.

The trajectory reward is correctness-first and normalization-aware. Correct searched trajectories receive reliance credit only when retrieval was necessary. Correct direct-answer trajectories receive credit for closed-book sufficiency. Repeated search incurs a bounded penalty. This directly addresses a practical issue in group-relative RL such as GRPO: when all trajectories in a group are correct, pure outcome reward yields near-zero advantage and cannot separate efficient grounded search from redundant search. Search-G1 restores reward variation inside these tied groups.

A second important component is periodic refitting. Because the readouts depend on policy representations, and RL changes those representations over time, a frozen estimator will drift out of alignment. The paper treats training as a measurement-credit-adaptation loop: regenerate trajectories from the latest checkpoint, recalibrate the intervention targets, and refit the readouts so the reward remains aligned with the evolving policy boundary.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation spans four QA benchmarks and two model scales. The paper is not mainly about maximizing raw accuracy; it studies the trade-off among grounding, search usage, and task performance. A few setup numbers in the paper are already informative: on held-out NQ, a base Qwen2.5-3B answers 14% of questions correctly without retrieval, which means redundant search is a real issue; in HotpotQA, 79.9% of questions are bridge-type, and MuSiQue consists entirely of 2- to 4-hop questions, showing that evidence dependence is structurally common but still policy-relative.

Empirically, Search-G1 improves operational grounding and shortens trajectories while keeping accuracy competitive across benchmarks. The most useful part of the experimental section is the diagnostics. The paper checks estimator fidelity, asking whether the necessity and reliance readouts match the intervention-derived targets; reward tie-breaking, asking whether shaped rewards recover non-zero advantage in all-correct groups; and representation drift, showing that readout quality degrades without periodic refitting. The value is less in one headline metric and more in the fact that the paper closes the loop from measurement to credit assignment to adaptation.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and the main method figure to separate retrieval necessity from evidence reliance; that distinction is the conceptual center of the work. Second, read the reward definition and the normalization-aware credit assignment, especially how it handles zero-advantage all-correct groups under GRPO-style updates. Third, read the periodic refitting experiments to understand how quickly the readouts drift and why static reward estimators are insufficient.

If time is limited, prioritize Figure 1, Figure 2, the calibration procedure for the two readouts, and the diagnostics on estimator fidelity, tie-breaking, and drift. Around 30 minutes should be enough to extract the main ideas. Read the appendix only if you care about benchmark-specific trajectory construction or implementation details.

recommendation.zh: 看 readout 校准实验；若干净成立，它比“让 judge 打分”更像可扩展的 agent RL 信号。
recommendation.en: Read the readout-calibration experiments; if clean, this is a more scalable agent-RL signal than asking a judge to score everything.

paper.title: LLM within MCP Matters: Measuring Inefficient Resource Utilization Driven by LLMs
paper.abstract: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) standardizes how servers expose data and tools to Large Language Models (LLMs). A common server design embeds frequently used reference data, such as identifier lookup tables, directly in the server instructions: the system-prompt text a server hands to the host application. When a query concerns an entry of the embedded table, the model can act on it immediately instead of re-discovering the same information through a search tool. We test whether client LLMs act

summary.core_problem: MCP 服务器常将参考数据嵌入 system prompt，但客户端 LLM 是否真正消费这些嵌入数据、还是偏向调用搜索工具？
summary.importance: 大规模行为研究（54k 试验、24 个模型），揭示 LLM 在工具可用时会主动忽略已嵌入上下文的信息，失败主因是行为偏好而非能力缺失。
summary.technical_approach: 在生产级法律信息 MCP 服务器上设置对照实验：移除搜索工具的诊断条件 vs 搜索工具存在的条件；2^3 因子分析拆解影响因素。
summary.experiments: 24 个模型（9 Claude、6 Gemini、9 GPT），54,000 次试验。无搜索工具时 23/24 模型嵌入数据命中率≥98%；有搜索工具时 9 个模型命中率降至 15% 以下。

summary_en.core_problem: Do client LLMs actually consume reference data embedded in MCP server system prompts, or do they prefer invoking search tools instead?
summary_en.importance: Large-scale behavioral study (54k trials, 24 models) showing that LLMs ignore embedded context when a search tool is present; failures stem from behavioral preference, not capability gaps.
summary_en.technical_approach: Controlled experiment on a production legal-information MCP server: diagnostic condition with search removed vs. condition with search present; 2^3 factorial analysis to isolate factors.
summary_en.experiments: 24 models (9 Claude, 6 Gemini, 9 GPT), 54,000 trials. Without search, 23/24 models achieve ≥98% hit ratio on embedded data; with search merely present, 9 models drop below 15%.

recommendation.zh: 结论干净：模型不是读不到上下文，而是工具在场时偏不去读。做 agent 训练或 prompt 设计时值得知道，但对 pretrain 无直接动作。
recommendation.en: Clean finding: models can read embedded context but choose not to when a tool is present. Useful for agent/prompt design, no direct pretrain action.

paper.title: MemeMind: Reference-Guided Trace Construction for Offline Context Optimization
paper.abstract: Offline context optimization improves an agent by revising its instructions and examples while keeping the model frozen. This approach learns from rollouts on an adaptation set, but some queries produce only failed rollouts. In these cases, the optimizer sees no successful example of how the available tools can reach the correct answer. We introduce MemeMind, which uses an offline reference answer to recover this missing experience. TraceBuilder identifies the evidence required by the reference,

summary.core_problem: 解决离线 context optimization 中失败轨迹缺少可学习成功示例的问题，尤其是在多工具、多模态 meme 理解任务里。
summary.importance: 贡献是 agent 指令和示例的离线优化方法，模型保持冻结；价值在于把参考答案转成可验证工具轨迹，但任务域偏窄。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MemeMind。TraceBuilder 从离线参考答案反推所需证据，调用文本搜索、图像检索和视觉定位工具，并验证工具轨迹后写入 adaptation buffer；ToolGuide 再把轨迹归纳成共享 guide 和各工具专属指令。参考答案只在适配阶段使用，推理阶段只使用学到的 guide。
summary.experiments: 实验场景是 Anime、Comic 和 Game meme interpretation。摘要未给出底座模型、适配集规模、工具配置、baseline 或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses failed-rollout cases in offline context optimization, where an agent has no successful trace to learn from, with a focus on multimodal meme interpretation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an offline instruction/example optimization method for frozen agents. Its useful idea is converting reference answers into verified tool traces, though the application setting is narrow.
summary_en.technical_approach: MemeMind has two components. TraceBuilder uses offline reference answers to infer required evidence, executes text search, image retrieval, and visual grounding, verifies the resulting tool trace, and stores it in an adaptation buffer. ToolGuide then summarizes collected traces into a shared guide and per-tool instructions. References are used only during adaptation.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation is conducted on Anime, Comic, and Game meme interpretation. The abstract does not report model scale, adaptation-set size, tool details, baselines, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 可看作“用答案反推工具轨迹”的 prompt 优化小技巧，读方法框架即可，meme 任务不必深究。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a small prompt-optimization trick that backsolves tool traces from answers; read the method sketch, not the meme-specific setup.

paper.title: Science Edge Evaluation: SEE the Missing Step Toward Real Scientific Discovery
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly involved in scientific discovery, yet it remains unclear whether they can support complex real laboratory science. Here we introduce Science Edge Evaluation (SEE), a multimodal benchmark of expert-curated questions grounded in peer-reviewed literature and experimental practice in chemistry, biology, and materials science. Evaluation of 19 multimodal large language models (MLLMs) shows that even the best-performing model reaches only 48.7% accuracy. M

summary.core_problem: 评估当前多模态大模型是否真的能支持接近真实实验室场景的科学发现，而不是只会回答教科书式科学问题。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是一个专家策划的科学多模态 benchmark，覆盖化学、生物、材料，并把文献证据、实验实践和 visual-agent tool use 放进同一评测框架。对预训练研究员的价值主要在于：它暴露了通用 MLLM 在高证据约束科学推理上的短板，以及工具使用并不自动带来可靠性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Science Edge Evaluation (SEE)，题目来自同行评审文献与实验实践，强调模型必须在原始实验依据边界内推理；同时设计 visual-agent 评测，测试工具调用带来的信息扩展是否真正转化为更可靠的科学判断。
summary.experiments: 评测 19 个 MLLM，最佳模型准确率仅 48.7%；加入工具后 visual-agent 最好到 52.7%。一个值得注意的结果是，通用模型平均优于 science-specialized 模型，说明领域微调并未解决证据约束下的科学推理问题。作为 benchmark 论文，重点是误差画像而非训练 recipe。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether current multimodal LLMs can support realistic laboratory-style scientific discovery rather than only answer textbook-like science questions.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an expert-curated multimodal benchmark spanning chemistry, biology, and materials science, grounded in papers and experimental practice. For pretraining researchers, the value is diagnostic: it exposes weaknesses of general MLLMs under evidence-constrained scientific reasoning and shows that tool use does not automatically yield reliability.
summary_en.technical_approach: Science Edge Evaluation (SEE) builds questions from peer-reviewed literature and lab practice, emphasizing reasoning within the boundary of original experimental evidence. It also includes a visual-agent setting to test whether tool-augmented information actually improves scientific decision quality.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark evaluates 19 MLLMs. The best model reaches only 48.7% accuracy, and tool use raises the best visual-agent score to 52.7%. A notable finding is that general-purpose models outperform science-specialized ones on average, suggesting domain specialization alone does not solve evidence-bounded scientific reasoning.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文，但结论有用：通用模型胜过 science-tuned 模型、工具增信息不增可靠性，这两点会直接影响你怎么看领域继续预训练与 agent 评测。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the signal matters: general models beat science-tuned ones, and tools add information without adding reliability—both should update how you think about domain continued pretraining and agent eval.

paper.title: Long-Horizon Agent Trajectory Attribution: A Unified Benchmark and Fine-Grained Annotation Framework
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate through long-horizon trajectories involving user instructions, tool use, external observations, and memory. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate behavioral outcomes but provide limited support for fine-grained attribution analysis. We introduce trajectory attribution and develop a benchmark and annotation framework for this task. The benchmark organizes heterogeneous trajectories under a unified component schema and provides annotations of

summary.core_problem: 为长程 LLM Agent 轨迹提供细粒度归因评测，定位成功、失败或安全拒答主要由哪个轨迹组件触发。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 评测数据与标注框架。现有 Agent benchmark 多评估最终行为结果，缺少对用户指令、工具调用、外部观察、记忆等组件的细粒度归因；该工作补上了 failure analysis 和 safety analysis 所需的标注层。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 trajectory attribution 任务，并构建统一 component schema 来组织异构 Agent 轨迹。基于 AgentDojo 以及 Agent3Sigma 的 Stage、Canary 设置，标注 primary attribution component，并在适用场景中标注 attack chain 与 execution chain。定义两个评测任务：primary attribution localization 和 attribution-chain recovery，并提供基于增量轨迹贡献的参考 baseline。
summary.experiments: 数据集包含 1300 多条已标注轨迹，覆盖任务一致动作、不安全动作和安全拒答。摘要未报告使用的模型、baseline 结果、人工一致性指标或各任务数值表现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds fine-grained attribution evaluation for long-horizon LLM-agent trajectories, identifying which component is primarily responsible for an outcome.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-evaluation dataset and annotation-framework contribution. Existing agent benchmarks mostly score final behavior, while this work adds annotations needed for failure analysis and safety attribution across instructions, tool calls, observations, and memory.
summary_en.technical_approach: It defines trajectory attribution and introduces a unified component schema for heterogeneous agent trajectories. Using trajectories from AgentDojo and the Stage and Canary settings of Agent3Sigma, it annotates primary attribution components and, where applicable, attack and execution chains. It defines primary attribution localization and attribution-chain recovery with reference baselines based on incremental trajectory contribution.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains more than 1,300 annotated trajectories covering task-aligned actions, unsafe actions, and safety refusals. The abstract does not report model baselines, agreement statistics, or numerical performance.

recommendation.zh: 这是 Agent 安全归因数据，不是训练方法；若做工具 RL 的 reward debugging，看 schema 和标注样例就够。
recommendation.en: This is safety-attribution data rather than a training method; for tool-use RL reward debugging, the schema and annotation examples are the useful parts.

paper.title: WebRider: Persona-Conditioned Intent Controllers for Live-Web Assistance
paper.abstract: Delegating a web task involves more than asking a question; it requires transferring a policy: what to verify, how to handle uncertainty, which preferences matter, and when to stop. Yet, current live-web agents are evaluated solely on the final answer, ignoring the policy constraints that define the delegation. A plausible final answer can conceal violations of that policy. Our full live audit reveals this critical gap: a strong controller completes 99.2% of tasks but honors all policy constrain

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的不是“网页任务能否做完”，而是“代理是否沿着用户委托的方式把任务做完”。作者指出，现有 live-web agent 评测几乎都只看最终答案或任务完成率，忽略了执行过程中的策略约束：要核验哪些证据、遇到不确定性时是否该追问、哪些偏好必须进入排序、什么时候应该停止而不是继续猜。问题的难点在于，这类委托策略不是静态标签，而是会贯穿浏览、点击、检索、澄清、停止、回答整个闭环；而且 live web 页面持续变化，最终答案即便看起来合理，也可能是在违反用户 policy 的情况下得到的。作者把这类可审计的委托策略形式化为 intent contract，并把核心问题定义为：如何在动态网页环境中，让 agent 在每一步都保持对 contract 的忠实执行，而不是只在终点上“看起来答对了”。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身，这篇论文不是训练范式或数据配比层面的工作，相关性偏间接；但它对 agent 训练信号设计和过程监督有一个清楚的提醒：只用 outcome supervision 会系统性掩盖 policy violation。论文给出的结果很直接：一个强 controller 在 99.2% 的 contract 上都能终止，但只有 38.8% 真正满足全部 contract gate。这个差距说明，若训练或评测只看 final success，会把大量“路径错但答案像对”的轨迹当成正样本。对做 post-train、tool-use、web agent 数据合成的人，这意味着需要把可验证的中间控制状态、证据义务和 stopping policy 显式写进训练对象，而不是只收集问答对。对 pretrain 研究员的启发主要在接口层：如果未来想把 agentic behavior 更早地纳入 continual pretrain 或 mid-train，监督对象不能只有文本结果，还要有结构化的过程约束。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，WebRider的关键设计是把“长期委托控制”和“当前页面动作实现”硬性拆开，而不是让一个单体 LLM 在同一上下文里同时负责计划、证据判断、动作生成和终止决策。顶层 controller 维护一个显式状态，里面包含 goal、hard constraints、soft preferences、blocking conditions、evidence ledger、progress 和 next intention。它只负责高层决策：继续浏览、发起澄清、停止、标记外部阻塞、还是给出答案；如果继续浏览，它会发出一个紧凑的 intention，例如“核验该商品的退货政策”或“为兼容性再找一个来源”。

中层不允许判断“证据是否足够”或“是否可以最终回答”，它只根据当前 observation、顶层 intention、persona state 和近期历史，生成一个且仅一个可执行的 JSON Action AST，动作空间包括 Click、Type、Scroll、Search、Maps、Back、Wait 以及安全回退。这里的重点不是让模型自由生成文本动作，而是通过确定性的 compiler 和 guard 把动作约束成可执行、可校验的局部目标：语法错误、非法 target、重复状态、阻塞状态都会被拦截，并附带恢复动作。训练时监督的不是原始模型文本，而是 guard 之后最终真正执行的 action。这样做的好处是，中层 policy 的学习目标被压缩成一个局部、可验证、可替换的 action realization 问题，而 CAPTCHA、访问策略、证据充分性、最终回答等复杂控制仍由 guard 或顶层负责。

另一条主线是 persona-conditioned intent contract。作者强调 persona 不是人口统计属性，也不是长期记忆，而是任务局部的控制策略，决定证据收集、排序偏好、不确定性处理和 stopping 规则。contract 由 goal、硬约束、软偏好、阻塞条件、证据义务、答案 schema 等组成，并且除非用户显式澄清，否则在执行期间保持稳定。这个设计让同一个 request 在固定 hard constraints 下可以配不同 persona，形成 counterfactual setting，用来测“同一个任务，不同委托 policy 下 agent 是否真的走了不同且正确的路径”。
summary.experiments:
实验部分最有信息量的是评测设置和误差分解，而不是模型规模。作者构建了 RiderBench：从 768 个审计过的请求扩展到 4,096 个 persona-conditioned contracts，覆盖 42 个网站，并且支持同一请求在不同 persona 下的配对比较。核心指标不是单一 success，而是 contract gates 和人工配对审计，检查完成轨迹与可见步骤是否同时满足委托 policy。

最关键的数字是：强基线 Full-Pro 在 99.2% 的 contract 上都能终止，但只有 38.8% 通过全部 contract gate。也就是说，终止率和 delegation fidelity 明显脱钩。论文还做了 paired human study，结论是 final-trace success 与 stepwise acceptability 存在显著偏离：最终答案可能被人类判为“看起来可接受”，但逐步检查时会发现它没有按要求核验证据、没有在该追问时追问，或者在 persona 指定的风险偏好下做了不该做的扩展搜索。

机制实验主要围绕 persistent intention 的价值。作者比较了仅给 persona、仅给 intention 文本、以及显式持久 intention 状态等设置，结论是持续维护的 intention 对控制质量更关键，不是简单把 persona 描述塞进 prompt 就能替代。另一个重要点是 guarded middle traces 的可训练性：由于每一步都有 post-guard 的可执行 action 作为局部监督目标，中层 policy 可以在固定顶层 controller、guard 和 executor 的条件下单独训练与替换。这说明作者不是只提出一个评测框架，而是在尝试把 agent 过程控制切成可学习、可审计的模块。
summary.reading_guide:
如果只是泛读，先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，抓住论文真正要解决的不是网页导航成功率，而是 delegation fidelity。接着看 Hierarchical Controller，重点理解为什么顶层和中层必须强分离，以及为什么训练目标要定义成 post-guard executable action，而不是自由文本动作。这里是整篇工作的结构支点。

然后看 Persona-Conditioned Intent Contracts，注意 contract 里哪些字段是稳定的，哪些只能通过显式 user clarification 更新。作者想解决的是“执行中 policy 漂移”，所以 contract 的稳定性假设很关键。

实验部分优先看 RiderBench 的构造方式、contract gates 的定义、99.2% vs 38.8% 这组 headline 数字，以及 paired human study。这里能看清作者为什么说“完成不等于忠实”。如果时间够，再看 persistent intention 的消融和 guarded middle traces 的训练分析，这两部分决定这篇工作是否只是评测包装，还是对 agent 训练接口有实质贡献。

预计阅读时间 25–35 分钟。对做 pretrain 的读者，不必在网页执行细节上停留太久，重点看监督对象如何从 final answer 改写为结构化过程状态，以及这种改写如何产生更干净的训练信号。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not about whether a web agent can finish a task, but whether it can preserve the user’s delegated policy while doing so. Current live-web evaluation mostly scores final answers or completion, which misses a central failure mode: the agent may produce a plausible answer after ignoring the user’s verification requirements, uncertainty policy, ranking preferences, or stopping criteria. This is especially problematic on the live web, where evidence arrives incrementally, pages change, and browsing, grounding, clarification, and stopping are tightly coupled. The paper formalizes this missing object as an intent contract and asks a sharper question: how can an agent maintain contract fidelity at every visible step, rather than merely ending with an acceptable-looking answer?
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, and its relevance to foundation-model pretraining is indirect. Still, it makes an important point for training-signal design: outcome-only supervision systematically hides policy violations. The headline number is the reason to care: a strong controller terminates on 99.2% of contracts, but only 38.8% satisfy all contract gates. That gap means many trajectories that look successful at the endpoint are actually bad supervision if one cares about delegated behavior. For post-training, tool-use, and web-agent data generation, the implication is clear: intermediate control state, evidence obligations, and stopping policy need to be explicit training targets. For pretraining researchers, the value is at the pretrain↔post-train interface: if agentic behavior is ever pushed earlier into continual pretraining or mid-training, final text alone is too weak a target.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main design choice is a hard separation between long-horizon delegation control and page-local action realization. Instead of letting one monolithic LLM jointly decide plans, evidence sufficiency, browser actions, and stopping, WebRider uses a hierarchy.

The top layer maintains an explicit state containing the goal, hard constraints, soft preferences, blocking conditions, evidence ledger, progress, and next intention. It decides whether to continue browsing, ask for clarification, stop, flag an external blocker, or answer. If browsing continues, it emits a compact intention such as “verify the return policy for this candidate” or “find a second source for compatibility.”

The middle layer is deliberately narrower. Given the current observation, the top-layer intention, persona state, and recent history, it emits exactly one JSON Action AST from a constrained action space: Click, Type, Scroll, Search, Maps, Back, Wait, or a safe fallback. Crucially, it is not allowed to decide whether evidence is sufficient or whether the task is ready for final answer. A deterministic compiler plus guards enforce executability: malformed targets, invalid terminals, repeated states, and blocked states are intercepted, with recovery actions attached when needed. Training supervision is defined on the final post-guard executable action, not on raw model text. That turns the middle policy into a local, verifiable action-realization problem, while harder issues such as CAPTCHA, access policy, evidence sufficiency, and final answering remain with the guards or the top layer.

The second core contribution is the persona-conditioned intent contract. Persona here is not demographic identity or long-term memory; it is a task-local control policy governing evidence gathering, uncertainty handling, ranking, interaction, and stopping. The contract includes the goal, hard constraints, soft preferences, blockers, evidence obligations, and answer schema, and remains stable unless the user explicitly clarifies. This lets the benchmark create counterfactual variants of the same request under different personas, so the evaluation can test whether the agent truly follows different delegated policies under fixed hard constraints.
summary_en.experiments:
The most informative part of the empirical section is the evaluation design and the failure decomposition, not model scaling. The paper introduces RiderBench, expanding 768 audited requests into 4,096 persona-conditioned contracts across 42 sites. The setup supports paired comparisons: the same request can be evaluated under different personas while keeping hard constraints and evidence obligations fixed.

The key result is the gap between completion and fidelity. The strong baseline controller, Full-Pro, terminates on 99.2% of contracts, but only 38.8% pass all contract gates. In other words, finishing the task and honoring the delegated policy are very different things. The paired human study reinforces this point: final-trace success and stepwise acceptability diverge significantly. A trajectory may look acceptable from the final answer alone, yet fail under stepwise audit because it skipped required evidence checks, failed to ask when uncertainty should have triggered clarification, or violated the persona’s risk policy.

The mechanism studies focus on persistent intention. The paper compares settings such as persona-only prompting, intention text alone, and explicit persistent intention state, and finds that maintaining intention as a state variable matters more than merely including persona text in the prompt. Another useful result concerns trainability of the middle layer: because each step yields a guarded executable action as a local target, the middle policy can be trained and swapped while holding the top controller, guards, and executor fixed. That makes the proposal more than an evaluation wrapper; it is also a modular training interface for process-level control.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the Introduction and Figure 1. The central claim is that web-agent evaluation is missing delegation fidelity, not just task success. Then read the Hierarchical Controller section carefully. The key question is why the top and middle layers must be structurally separated, and why supervision is placed on post-guard executable actions rather than free-form action text. That is the architectural core.

Next, read the intent contract section with attention to what is stable and what can change only through explicit user clarification. The paper is trying to prevent policy drift during execution, so the stability of the contract is not a minor detail.

In the experiments, prioritize the RiderBench construction, the definition of contract gates, the 99.2% vs 38.8% result, and the paired human study. Those pieces establish why endpoint-only evaluation is insufficient. If time remains, read the ablations on persistent intention and the analysis of guarded middle traces. Those sections determine whether the work is merely a benchmark proposal or a meaningful training interface for agent control.

A reasonable skim takes about 25–35 minutes. For a pretraining-oriented reader, the main value is not browser mechanics but how the supervision target is shifted from final answers to structured process state.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 的 99.2/38.8 缺口和 intent contract 设计即可；它会影响 agent reward 怎么写。
recommendation.en: Read the 99.2/38.8 completion-fidelity gap and the intent-contract design; it matters for how agent rewards should be specified.

paper.title: Agent Memory Distillation: Empowering Small LLM Agents with Hierarchical Teacher Memory
paper.abstract: Memory systems have shown promise for improving agent performance, but their potential remains largely unexplored for small language models, which struggle to generate sufficient successful trajectories on their own. We propose Agent Memory Distillation (AMD), a training-free framework that transfers structured knowledge from a large teacher agent to a small student agent through hierarchical memory. AMD constructs three complementary memory types from successful teacher trajectories: Workflow m

summary.core_problem: 小语言模型agent自身任务成功率低，生成的成功轨迹数量少，自建记忆库以失败轨迹为主，记忆利用效果受限。直接将大模型teacher的原始记忆迁移给小模型student收益极低，原因是师生能力存在差距，且小模型的上下文学习能力和指令跟随能力较弱，无法有效理解和应用teacher的知识。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，分层知识迁移的设计思路可借鉴到模型蒸馏、合成数据构造等场景，尤其适用于需要向小模型做参数高效或免训练能力注入的场景；迁移质量依赖师生兼容性的结论，也对学生模型预训练和蒸馏流程设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Agent Memory Distillation（AMD）免训练框架，从teacher agent的成功轨迹中构造三类互补的分层记忆：Workflow记忆编码任务级的分解与高层规划策略，Subtask记忆提供子任务粒度的具体行为示例，Function记忆记录工具调用的schema、约定和常见问题。Workflow和Subtask记忆在任务开始时主动注入给student，Function记忆则在推理过程中student遇到工具调用错误时被动检索使用。
summary.experiments: 以GPT-5-mini为teacher，4个4B/8B参数的小模型为student，在3个基准上验证效果。AMD相比零样本基线，在AppWorld上平均准确率提升27.2个百分点，BFCL V3上提升11.2个百分点，ToolSandbox上提升3.4个百分点，优于所有非蒸馏设计的记忆基线；同时减少了交互轮数，生成的轨迹更接近teacher。消融实验显示三类记忆各有独立贡献，迁移质量同时取决于teacher准确率和师生兼容性，4B规模的student收益最大。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点看引言中关于朴素记忆迁移失效的观察（图1），第3章的三层记忆设计与注入机制，实验部分的消融结果与师生兼容性分析。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Small LLM agents have low task success rates and produce few successful trajectories, so their self-built memory repositories are dominated by failed experiences, limiting the utility of memory-based methods. Naive transfer of raw memory from a stronger teacher agent brings only marginal gains, as the capability gap between teacher and student, combined with limited in-context learning and instruction-following ability of small models, prevents effective comprehension and application of teacher knowledge.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, the hierarchical knowledge transfer design offers a useful reference for distillation pipelines and synthetic data construction, especially for scenarios requiring parameter-efficient or training-free capability injection into small models. The finding that transfer quality depends on teacher-student compatibility also informs student model pretraining and distillation recipe design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Agent Memory Distillation (AMD) is a training-free framework that constructs three complementary hierarchical memory types from successful teacher agent trajectories. Workflow memory encodes task-level decomposition and high-level planning strategies. Subtask memory provides concrete action examples at intermediate subtask granularity. Function memory captures tool calling schemas, conventions, and common pitfalls. Workflow and Subtask memories are proactively injected into the student at the start of each task, while Function memory is retrieved reactively when the student encounters tool calling errors during inference.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated with GPT-5-mini as the teacher and 4 small models (4B or 8B parameters) as students across 3 benchmarks. AMD achieves average accuracy improvements of 27.2 percentage points on AppWorld, 11.2 percentage points on BFCL V3, and 3.4 percentage points on ToolSandbox over zero-shot baselines, outperforming all non-distillation memory baselines. It also reduces interaction turns and produces trajectories more similar to the teacher. Ablations show each memory type contributes uniquely, transfer quality depends on both teacher accuracy and teacher-student compatibility, and 4B-scale students gain the largest benefit.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction for the observation of naive memory transfer failure (Figure 1), Section 3 for the three-layer memory design and injection mechanism, and the experiment section for ablation results and teacher-student compatibility analysis. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 一种 test-time 的知识蒸馏（通过 prompt/memory 注入），展示了如何结构化地利用大模型的轨迹来辅助小模型，对构建 Agent 系统有一定参考价值，但非预训练核心。
recommendation.en: A test-time knowledge distillation approach (via prompt/memory injection) demonstrating how to structurally utilize large model trajectories to assist small models; offers reference value for building Agent systems, though not core to pretraining.

paper.title: The Optimizer Is the Agent: Reasoning-Driven Search across Prompts, Programs, and ML Workflows
paper.abstract: Recent systems for optimizing prompts, programs, and ML workflows typically rely on explicit outer-loop controllers such as evolutionary search, bandits, or textual-gradient methods. We ask a fundamentally different question: how much of this search policy can be internalized by a single tool-using agent? We present ReASearch, a unified framework for reasoning-driven optimization in which the agent autonomously decides what to evaluate, how to diagnose failures, which edits to make, and when to

summary.core_problem: 研究能否把 prompt、程序和 ML workflow 的搜索策略交给一个长期运行的工具使用 agent，而不是依赖手写的外层搜索控制器。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是通用 agent 优化框架。它把过去分散在 prompt optimization、program search、workflow tuning 里的外层循环，改写成一个带推理、诊断、记忆和预算分配的 agent loop，对自动化实验和自动调参有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ReASearch。核心做法是让 agent 自主决定评估什么、如何诊断失败、怎么编辑候选方案、何时验证或重启；同时用 persistent memory 支持长程优化。框架本身共享同一个 agent scaffold，只替换面向 prompt、program 或 ML workflow 的领域工具。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在 14 个任务上评测，覆盖 prompt、program 和 ML workflow 优化；结果与专用优化系统相比有竞争力，并在多数场景更好。摘要未给出具体模型参数、工具集、预算规模、baseline 名称和提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Yuxiong He、Zhangyang Wang、Qiang Liu 等在系统、优化和机器学习方法上有代表性工作的研究者；具体机构信息无法仅从给定信息确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether the search policy for prompts, programs, and ML workflows can be internalized by a single long-horizon tool-using agent instead of being controlled by handcrafted outer-loop optimizers.
summary_en.importance: This is a general agent-optimization framework. Its main contribution is to recast prompt optimization, program search, and workflow tuning as one reasoning-driven agent loop with diagnosis, memory, and budget allocation, which is mildly relevant to automated experimentation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed ReASearch framework lets the agent decide what to evaluate, how to diagnose failures, which edits to apply, and when to verify or restart. It uses persistent memory for long-horizon refinement and reuses the same scaffold across domains by swapping domain-specific tools.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments on 14 diverse tasks covering prompt, program, and ML-workflow optimization. ReASearch is described as competitive with and mostly better than specialized optimization systems, but the provided abstract does not specify model size, budget, baselines, or numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Yuxiong He, Zhangyang Wang, and Qiang Liu, who are known for work in systems, optimization, and machine learning methods; affiliations cannot be confirmed from the provided metadata alone.

recommendation.zh: 自动化实验方向可扫一眼；核心风险是 agent loop 是否只是更贵的外层搜索，先看任务预算和失败分析。
recommendation.en: Worth a quick scan for automated experimentation; the key risk is whether the agent loop is just a more expensive outer-loop search, so check budgets and failure analysis first.

paper.title: EnvACE: Internalizing Environment Dynamics via World Rehearsal for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Training large language model agents for long-horizon tool use typically relies on interactions with real or synthesized executable environments, whose construction and verification are costly, or on external simulators that are difficult to ground. We introduce EnvACE, an agentic reinforcement learning method that replaces external environment interaction during training with world rehearsal. The policy alternates between acting and rehearsal: it first generates a tool call, then plays the role

summary.core_problem: 训练LLM Agent进行长程工具使用时，现有方法依赖外部可执行环境（构建和验证成本高）或独立的LLM模拟器（难以grounding），环境建模始终在行动策略之外，策略无法内化动作与环境响应之间的因果关系。
summary.importance: 提出了将世界模型内化进单一策略的world rehearsal机制，让策略在不依赖外部环境交互的条件下进行RL训练，降低了对昂贵环境基础设施的依赖。测试时的多次rehearsal也为推理前的内部推演提供了轻量方案。方法本身属于Agent后训练范畴，但"让模型自己扮演环境"的思路与统一建模范式存在关联，对思考预训练中模型如何内化世界动态有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 单个策略同时承担actor和environment两个角色：每个交互轮次，策略先生成tool call，然后切换角色生成该tool call引发的环境响应（即world rehearsal），再基于这个自生成的响应决定下一步动作。整条trajectory由策略自身展开，而非与外部环境交互产生。两个角色通过task-success reward端到端联合优化。测试时可进行多次rehearsal尝试，在内部推演候选动作的结果后再选择实际执行。
summary.experiments: 在BFCL-v4、τ²-Bench、VitaBench、FinMCP-Bench四个Agent基准上一致优于强基线。消融实验显示：测试时适度的rehearsal预算（多次内部推演）能进一步提升性能；联合学习acting和rehearsal在不同模型规模上均有效，而非单独训练环境模型再与策略配合。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注world rehearsal的训练流程设计——acting和rehearsal如何交替展开、reward如何传播到两个角色，以及测试时rehearsal的具体实现。方法部分的POMDP形式化和实验部分的rehearsal次数消融是核心图表。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Training LLM agents for long-horizon tool use relies on external executable environments (costly to build and verify) or separate LLM simulators (difficult to ground), keeping environment dynamics external to the acting policy and preventing the policy from internalizing action-response relationships.
summary_en.importance: Introduces world rehearsal, a mechanism that absorbs the world model into a single policy, enabling RL training without external environment interaction and reducing dependence on expensive environment infrastructure. Test-time rehearsal provides a lightweight form of internal deliberation before action execution. While the method sits in post-training agent RL, the idea of a model playing both actor and environment resonates with unified modeling paradigms relevant to thinking about how pretrained models internalize world dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach: A single policy alternates between two roles: at each turn, it first generates a tool call as the actor, then switches to produce the environment response induced by that call (world rehearsal), and conditions subsequent actions on this self-generated response. Full trajectories unfold from the policy itself rather than from external environment interaction. Both roles are jointly optimized end-to-end using task-success rewards. At test time, multiple rehearsal attempts can be run to internally simulate candidate action outcomes before selecting the actual action.
summary_en.experiments: Consistently outperforms strong baselines across BFCL-v4, τ²-Bench, VitaBench, and FinMCP-Bench. Ablations show that a moderate test-time rehearsal budget further improves performance, and that joint optimization of acting and rehearsal is effective across model scales, compared to training a separate environment model.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the training procedure for world rehearsal—how acting and rehearsal interleave within a trajectory, how rewards propagate across both roles—and the test-time rehearsal mechanism. The POMDP formulation in the method section and the rehearsal-budget ablation in experiments are the key sections. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: Agent RL训练的新范式，用自扮演环境替代外部交互，核心思路可迁移到推理模型RL训练，重点看§3方法设计
recommendation.en: Novel paradigm for agent RL training replacing external interaction with self-played environment; core idea transfers to reasoning model RL, focus on §3 method design.

paper.title: Skill-Use: Can LLMs Actually Use Skills in Agentic Harnesses?
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on skills, structured documents that specify when to act, which procedure to follow, and which tools are allowed. Existing evaluations mostly judge the quality of a skill or its contribution to task success, leaving unexamined whether an agent can recognize a relevant skill and apply it on its own. We introduce Skill-Use, a benchmark that evaluates skill use under progressive disclosure, where an agent sees only a skill's name and short descrip

summary.core_problem: 在“渐进披露（progressive disclosure）”的 agent harness 里，技能（skill）通常只以“名称+短描述”先暴露给模型，完整步骤需要模型主动检索后才能执行。现有评测多看最终任务成败或技能文档质量，无法回答一个更基础的问题：模型是否能自己判断该用哪个技能、主动触发检索、并按技能步骤执行且不越界。该论文要评测的就是这种端到端的“技能使用能力”，并把失败拆成可定位的三个环节。
summary.importance:
对预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，但对“posttrain/agent harness 设计如何反向塑造能力表征”很有信息增益：
1) 把 skill-use 从“技能好不好”转成“模型能不能用”，并把检索触发与程序遵循拆开量化，能更清楚地暴露模型在工具/流程化知识上的薄弱点；
2) 证明 skill-use 不是模型的静态属性，而是强烈依赖 harness（提示、工具接口、文件系统交互方式等）的条件能力，这对做可复现实验、做 mid-train/agentic data 合成、以及评估对齐/安全约束（forbidden ops）都很关键；
3) 任务在可执行 sandbox 中评分，强调轨迹级可验证信号，这类评测资产往往会反过来影响后续训练数据与训练目标（例如用轨迹 rubric 做偏好学习/过程监督）。
summary.technical_approach:
核心设计是把“技能使用”形式化为一个四元组实例 x=(s,q,E,R)：技能 s=(m,p) 由元信息 m（名称、短描述、路径）和完整流程 p 组成；任务 q 在可执行环境 E（Docker sandbox，含文件与工具）中运行；评分用隐藏 rubric R 对完整交互轨迹打分。
关键机制是 progressive disclosure：模型初始只看到 (q,E,m)，必须先决定技能相关并通过读取 skill 文件等动作取回 p，然后再执行。
评测指标分三块：
- Trigger：是否在仅见 m 的情况下触发并检索到正确技能（识别/检索阶段）。
- Compliance：拿到 p 后是否按步骤执行（过程遵循，而不是输出格式）。
- Boundary：是否避免技能明确禁止的操作/捷径（约束遵循/越权）。
并给出 gated 的总分 SU：只有 Trigger 通过后，后续执行才计入（避免“没触发技能但碰巧做对了”污染度量）。
数据构建强调可验证：从社区仓库挑选真实技能，围绕技能设计“可观察痕迹”的可执行任务，同时设计“诱人但被禁止”的捷径来测 Boundary；再用轨迹式 rubric 评分；最后做端到端验证。还引入 masked-skill screening 去掉过于泛化的要求，并用多 agent 对抗式 review 审核任务范围与 rubric 可判定性。
summary.experiments:
基准规模：79 个真实技能、177 个可执行任务、覆盖 9 个领域；每个任务在隔离 Docker 环境中运行，记录完整轨迹并按多项 rubric 打分。
模型与设置：在两个不同 agent harness 下评测 8 个前沿模型（论文强调 harness 改变会显著影响绝对分数与模型排序）。
主要结果：最强配置的 gated SU 仅 0.613，说明“可靠技能使用”仍未达标。更重要的诊断结论是：Trigger 与 Compliance 是相互独立的瓶颈——能识别技能的不一定能严格按流程做；能按流程做的也可能根本没触发检索。论文还报告 Boundary（避免禁用操作）作为单独维度，展示模型在“诱人捷径”面前的越界倾向（具体数值需以正文表格为准）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
1) 先看基准定义与协议：Skill-Use Benchmark 的形式化输入/输出、progressive disclosure 设定、以及 gated SU 的计分逻辑（理解为什么要 gate）。
2) 重点看三维度指标的 rubric 如何落到“轨迹可验证”：哪些动作/文件改动算遵循步骤，哪些算 forbidden shortcut（这决定了评测信号是否干净）。
3) 看主结果表：对比不同 harness 下 Trigger/Compliance/Boundary 的分解结果与模型排序变化，理解“能力是条件性的”这一结论是怎么被数据支撑的。
4) 如果要复用：关注三阶段构建流程（技能筛选→任务与诱饵设计→rubric 与端到端验证）以及 masked-skill screening / adversarial review 的具体操作细节。

summary_en.core_problem: In progressive-disclosure agent harnesses, an LLM initially sees only a skill’s name and short description; the full procedure is available only if the agent explicitly retrieves it. Existing evaluations largely measure task success or the intrinsic quality of skill documents, but do not test whether the agent can (i) recognize that a skill is relevant, (ii) trigger retrieval on its own, and (iii) execute the prescribed procedure while avoiding forbidden shortcuts. This paper targets that end-to-end “skill use” capability and decomposes it into measurable failure points.
summary_en.importance:
This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is informative for foundation-model researchers because it isolates a capability that often gets conflated with general agent performance. Key takeaways:
1) It operationalizes skill use as a process (recognition → retrieval → procedural execution → restraint), producing diagnostics that can guide agentic data generation and post-training objectives.
2) It shows skill use is strongly harness-dependent: absolute scores and even model rankings shift across harnesses, which matters for reproducible evaluation and for interpreting improvements from mid-training / tool-use fine-tuning.
3) The benchmark is trajectory-scored in executable sandboxes, pushing evaluation toward verifiable process signals—assets that can later be repurposed for preference learning or process supervision.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Each instance is formalized as x=(s,q,E,R): a skill s=(m,p) with metadata m (name/short description/path) and full procedure p; a user task q; an executable environment E (Docker sandbox with tools/files); and a hidden scoring rubric R applied to the full interaction trajectory.
The key constraint is progressive disclosure: the agent starts with (q,E,m) and must decide to retrieve the skill file to access p.
Metrics are decomposed into:
- Trigger: whether the agent retrieves the relevant skill given only metadata.
- Compliance: whether it follows the procedure after retrieval (procedure-level adherence, not output formatting).
- Boundary: whether it avoids explicitly forbidden operations/shortcuts.
A gated aggregate SU score credits execution only if Trigger succeeds, preventing “accidental success without using the skill” from inflating results.
Benchmark construction emphasizes verifiability: real skills curated from community repositories; tasks designed to leave observable traces; tempting but forbidden shortcuts to stress Boundary; trajectory-based rubrics; end-to-end validation; plus masked-skill screening to remove overly generic requirements and multi-agent adversarial review to audit scope and rubric checkability.
summary_en.experiments:
Scale: 79 real-world skills paired with 177 executable tasks across 9 domains; all run in isolated Docker sandboxes with full trajectory logging and multi-item rubric scoring.
Evaluation: 8 frontier models tested under two different agent harnesses.
Main findings: the best configuration reaches only SU=0.613, indicating reliable skill use is still not achieved. Trigger and Compliance emerge as distinct bottlenecks: models that correctly recognize/retrieve a skill often deviate from the procedure, while models capable of compliance may fail to trigger retrieval. Rankings and absolute scores change across harnesses, supporting the claim that skill use is a conditional capability rather than a fixed model property. (Per-dimension Boundary numbers should be taken from the main tables in the paper.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~30–45 minutes):
1) Read the benchmark formalization and protocol, especially progressive disclosure and the rationale for the gated SU score.
2) Inspect how rubrics map to trajectory-verifiable signals (what counts as compliance vs. shortcut/violation).
3) Focus on the main results table(s) with Trigger/Compliance/Boundary breakdowns and the harness comparison to understand where failures originate and why rankings shift.
4) If you want to build similar assets, study the three-stage construction pipeline and the concrete practices behind masked-skill screening and adversarial review.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 metric 定义；它把 agent skill failure 拆得更干净，读 §benchmark/score 即可，不必期待预训练结论。
recommendation.en: Skim the metric definitions; it cleanly decomposes skill-use failures, but read it as an evaluation asset rather than a pretraining result.

institutions: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: ToolArtist: Tool-Using Unified Multimodal Models for Agentic Image Generation
paper.abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) models can produce visually compelling images, yet they remain limited on open-world tasks that require complex semantic understanding, multi-step reasoning, and the integration of external world knowledge. Existing efforts introduce agent capabilities into image generation, but they either prescribe a fixed workflow or place only a subset of the open-world image generation process under agent control. Consequently, reasoning, tool invocation, and image generation are not coo

summary.core_problem: 让统一多模态模型在单一策略下协调推理、外部工具调用与原生图像生成，解决现有 agentic T2I 工作流固定或控制范围不全的问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新：把 agentic tool use 与原生图像生成统一进一个 UMM policy，是多模态生成 + agent 结合的一次具体尝试。
summary.technical_approach: 对 Unified Multimodal Model 做 post-training；SFT 阶段让 teacher agent 同时使用搜索工具和图像生成工具，将轨迹转成 UMM 兼容格式，把图像生成工具调用与原生生成能力对齐，再用统一策略动态编排。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据量或对比数值。
summary.authors_note: 作者含 Shuicheng Yan（颜水成），曾在 Sea AI Lab、昆仑万维等主导多模态与基础模型工作。

summary_en.core_problem: Unify reasoning, external tool use and native image generation under one policy in a multimodal model, since prior agentic T2I systems use fixed workflows or only partially agentize the pipeline.
summary_en.importance: Methodological contribution: an early attempt to couple agentic tool use with native image generation inside a single UMM policy.
summary_en.technical_approach: Post-trains a Unified Multimodal Model; at SFT, a teacher agent uses search tools plus an image-generation tool, trajectories are converted into a UMM-compatible format that aligns the image-generation tool call with native generation, enabling a single policy to orchestrate reasoning, tools and generation.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract gives no model size, data scale or quantitative comparisons.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Shuicheng Yan, known for leading multimodal and foundation-model efforts at Sea AI Lab and Kunlun.

recommendation.zh: 思路是把 tool call 当作 UMM 里的可学习动作，对统一多模态 post-train 有参考；摘要无数据，先看方法图即可。
recommendation.en: Treats tool calls as learnable actions inside a UMM—relevant for unified multimodal post-training; abstract lacks numbers, just skim the method figure.

paper.title: EvolveNet: Collaborative Harness Evolution for Agent Self-Improvement
paper.abstract: The capabilities of an LLM agent depend not only on its model but on the harness: the executable program that constructs context, invokes tools, verifies results, and recovers from failure. Recent work shows that evolving the harness yields persistent improvements without updating model weights. Existing approaches, however, assume that all execution experience can be routed to a single optimizer, which evolves one harness along a sequential trajectory. Real agent ecosystems violate that assumpt

summary.core_problem: 现有Agent的harness（即构建上下文、调用模型/工具、验证中间结果、处理故障的可执行程序层）演化方法依赖集中式经验池，无法适配真实场景中用户、组织、环境产生的隔离、不可集中的执行经验流，且单轨迹串行演化的搜索广度和串行效率均受限。
summary.importance: 该工作提出的“跨系统边界传输演化后的程序工件而非原始经验”的范式，为联邦式Agent能力迭代、甚至避免原始数据集中的分布式预训练流程提供了参考；将harness作为无需更新模型权重的持久适配层的思路，也补充了预训练与后训练阶段之间的轻量化适配路径。
summary.technical_approach: 提出EvolveNet协作式harness演化范式，将传统的“先聚合数据再演化”流程替换为“先本地演化再聚合程序”的循环：每轮从共享harness出发，广播给多个持有本地数据的客户端，各自在本地工作负载上独立演化出专用harness；服务端通过证据引导、带作用域类型的程序聚合机制合并各客户端的程序增量（delta）——由于所有客户端均基于同一基础harness分支，服务端可基于共同基准对比增量，结合每个增量附带的行为变化测量结果，区分全局可迁移的适配与应保留域条件的专用适配，合并前还会进行行为验证以避免冲突、冗余或能力退化；客户端被鼓励在各自的工作负载切片上特化，保证并行搜索的互补性，整个协作通过共享harness这个工件介导，客户端之间无需轮内通信。
summary.experiments: 提供的全文片段未披露完整实验指标，仅提到设计了配对评估协议，用于将聚合算子的贡献与本地harness演化的随机性、路径依赖效应分离，以便公平对比不同聚合规则的效果。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点看引言中集中式与分布式harness演化的动机分析（第1-2页）、聚合机制的设计（程序增量的作用域分类、证据引导合并、行为验证逻辑）以及配对评估协议的设计思路；实现细节和冗余推导可跳过，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agent harness evolution methods (the executable layer for context construction, model/tool invocation, intermediate result verification, and failure handling) rely on centralized experience pooling, which cannot adapt to isolated, non-centralizable execution experience streams generated by real-world users, organizations and environments, and their single-trajectory sequential evolution suffers from limited search breadth and poor serial efficiency.
summary_en.importance: The paradigm of transmitting evolved program artifacts rather than raw experience across system boundaries provides reference for federated agent capability iteration and even distributed pretraining pipelines that avoid centralizing raw data. The idea of treating the harness as a persistent adaptation layer without updating model weights also supplements the lightweight adaptation path between pretraining and post-training stages.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes EvolveNet, a collaborative harness evolution paradigm that replaces the conventional "aggregate-data-then-evolve" pipeline with an "evolve-locally-then-aggregate" cycle. Each round starts from a common shared harness broadcast to multiple data-local clients, which independently evolve specialist harnesses on their local workloads. The server performs evidence-guided, scope-typed program aggregation: since all clients branch from the same base harness, it compares program deltas against the common baseline, uses measured behavioral changes attached to each delta to distinguish globally transferable adaptations from domain-specific ones, and validates candidate merges behaviorally to avoid conflicts, redundancy or capability regression. Clients are encouraged to specialize in their workload slices to ensure complementary parallel search; collaboration is mediated by the shared harness artifact with no intra-round client-to-client communication.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full-text fragment does not disclose complete experimental metrics. It only introduces a paired evaluation protocol designed to isolate the contribution of the aggregation operator from the stochasticity and path dependence of local harness evolution, for fair comparison of different aggregation rules.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the motivation analysis of centralized vs. distributed harness evolution in Introduction (pp.1-2), the design of the aggregation mechanism (scope classification of program deltas, evidence-guided merging, behavioral validation logic), and the paired evaluation protocol. Implementation details and redundant derivation can be skipped. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: Agent 论文里少数关心“经验不能集中”的设定；读方法和合并策略即可，指标缺失前先别外推到训练闭环。
recommendation.en: One of the more relevant agent papers because it treats non-centralizable experience seriously; read the method and merge strategy, but do not extrapolate without metrics.

paper.title: Screenshots or Tools? Eliciting Tool Use and Managing Multimodal Context in Hybrid GUI-MCP Computer-Use Agents
paper.abstract: Hybrid computer-use agents can act through screenshots or call text tools. We find that having a tool available does not settle which way the effect goes. Under one identical GUI-MCP harness on the OSWorld-MCP benchmark (309 tasks), the same MCP tools improve a reasoning model by +4.0pp and degrade a non-reasoning model by -5.9pp (5 runs each, both beyond 2 SE). What separates the two is tool-decision behavior. The non-reasoning policy ignores, misnames, or falsely terminates around tools. The r

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究混合 GUI-MCP computer-use agent 中的一个具体失配：工具已经暴露给模型，但模型是否真的会选择工具，而不是继续走截图点击路径。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值有限，更偏 agent 行为诊断和部署 recipe。但它给多模态 agent 训练提供了一个有用信号：工具可用性、工具注入和工具使用能力不是一回事。模型如果没有在训练中学到工具语义和何时切换观察通道，推理时加入工具可能降低性能，也可能只降低成本而不提升成功率。
summary.technical_approach: 论文在同一个 OSWorld-MCP harness 下比较 Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking 和 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct。GUI primitive actions 和 MCP tools 被放在同一个 tool_call 接口里，模型每步必须在截图操作和文本工具调用之间自行选择。工具通过 BM25 按当前应用检索 top-18，工具库包含 9 个应用 namespace、120 个工具。作者把问题拆成两层：action level 关注是否调用工具；context level 关注工具调用成功后是否还保留下一帧截图。这个设计比单纯比较“有无工具”更清楚，因为它能区分工具注入、工具选择、工具能力和观察压缩几个因素。
summary.experiments: 核心实验使用 OSWorld-MCP test_all_no_internet 的 309 个任务，每个设置 5 次 greedy decoding 运行，max_steps=50。相同工具和 harness 下，Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking 加入 MCP 后提升 +4.0 pp；Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 下降 -5.9 pp，差异均超过 2 个标准误。非 reasoning 模型常见错误包括忽略工具、工具名写错、围绕工具误终止。reasoning 模型更少出现这些错误，但仍只在 55/309 个任务上调用工具，只覆盖 tool-reachable 任务的 23.9%。VLC 子集里 16/17 个任务可由工具触达，但模型一次也没有调用工具。RL probe 显示，给工具调用加 dense post-normalization bonus 可以把 adoption 提高一个数量级，并且迁移到 greedy decoding；但 held-out accuracy 没有跟随提升，说明奖励能推动“选择工具”，不能补上“会用工具”。context-level 实验显示，工具成功后下一帧截图经常冗余；按部署时的观察规则重新训练，可以在约一半输入成本下保持精度，不再出现 observation rule mismatch 带来的分布外损失。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Section 3.1–3.2 的条件性工具效果和 adoption gap，Section 5.2 的 RL probe，以及 Section 4.2/5.3 关于工具成功后截图压缩的实验。对基座研究员而言，值得带走的是训练信号问题：工具调用不是靠推理时注入自然涌现出来的能力，尤其不是低成本路径已经存在时模型就会自动采用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a concrete mismatch in hybrid GUI-MCP computer-use agents: tools may be available, but the model may still prefer the screenshot-and-click route.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is indirect. The useful signal is about multimodal agent training rather than foundation-model pretraining itself. Tool availability, tool injection, and tool competence are separated cleanly. Without training signals that teach tool semantics and when to switch observation channels, adding tools at inference time can hurt accuracy or only reduce cost without improving task success.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors evaluate Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking and Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct under the same OSWorld-MCP harness. GUI primitives and MCP tools share one tool_call interface, so the model must choose between visual interaction and textual tools at every step. The tool inventory contains 120 tools across 9 application namespaces, retrieved with BM25 top-18 conditioned on the active application. The analysis separates two decisions: at the action level, whether to call a tool; at the context level, whether to keep the next screenshot after a successful tool call. This is stronger than a simple with-tools versus without-tools comparison because it isolates injection, adoption, competence, and observation compression.
summary_en.experiments: The main benchmark is OSWorld-MCP test_all_no_internet with 309 tasks, five greedy runs per setting, and max_steps=50. With the same tools and harness, MCP improves Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking by +4.0 percentage points but degrades Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct by -5.9 percentage points, both beyond 2 standard errors. The non-reasoning model often ignores tools, emits invalid tool names, or terminates incorrectly around tools. The reasoning model avoids many of these failures, but still calls a tool on only 55 of 309 tasks, covering 23.9% of tool-reachable tasks. On VLC, where 16 of 17 tasks are tool-reachable, it never calls a tool. An RL probe with a dense post-normalization bonus increases tool adoption by roughly an order of magnitude and survives greedy decoding, but held-out accuracy does not improve. This suggests the reward reaches the tool-choice policy but not tool competence. A context-level probe shows that the screenshot after a successful tool call is often redundant; retraining with the deployment-time observation rule yields a half-cost operating point without out-of-distribution accuracy loss.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Read Sections 3.1–3.2 for conditional tool effectiveness and the adoption gap, Section 5.2 for the RL probe, and Sections 4.2/5.3 for screenshot compression after successful tool calls. The main lesson for foundation-model researchers is that inference-time tool injection does not by itself create reliable low-cost tool use. The missing piece is a training signal that teaches when and how the tool path should replace the visual path.

recommendation.zh: 工具使用的行为-能力分离是关键发现，直接修正后训练RL的设计思路，重点看§4的RL探针实验结果
recommendation.en: The behavior-competence disentanglement in tool use is a key finding that revises post-training RL design; focus on §4 RL probe results

paper.title: GUI-Lens: Coarse-to-Fine Cropping for GUI Grounding with General-Purpose VLMs
paper.abstract: GUI grounding maps natural-language instructions to click locations and is essential for reliable GUI agents. The task remains difficult on high-resolution, densely populated interfaces because a vision-language model (VLM) may recognize a requested control without locating it precisely enough for interaction. Most existing methods provide various forms of localization assistance, but still rely on a direct click prediction, allowing visual ambiguity or an inaccurate initial estimate to propagat

summary.core_problem: 解决通用 VLM 在高分辨率、密集 GUI 界面上能看懂控件但点不准的问题。
summary.importance: 这属于 GUI agent 感知-定位链路的方法改进，不是预训练工作，但对“主动视觉观察 + 多步决策”式 agent 设计有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GUI-Lens 的 coarse-to-fine grounding 框架：先抽取 OCR 文本和 UI 组件及其坐标作为参考，再让通用 VLM 迭代选择下一步裁剪区域与缩放尺度，通过多轮局部放大逐步逼近最终点击位置，而不是一次性直接回归坐标。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模，但核心实验应是在 GUI grounding 基准上，对比直接点击预测和带定位辅助的方法，验证多步裁剪观察能提升高分辨率界面的定位精度与鲁棒性。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles the failure mode where general-purpose VLMs can recognize a GUI target but cannot localize it precisely enough to click on dense high-resolution interfaces.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-side perception/localization improvement rather than a pretraining paper, but it is still relevant for active visual observation and iterative decision-making in GUI agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: GUI-Lens introduces a coarse-to-fine grounding loop: OCR text and detected UI elements are exposed as coordinate references, and the VLM repeatedly chooses the next crop region and zoom level, refining the view before making the final click instead of predicting coordinates in one shot.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, but the key evaluation is likely on GUI grounding benchmarks against direct-click baselines and localization-assisted methods, showing gains from iterative crop-and-zoom reasoning.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但把“先找区域再精定位”做成了可执行闭环；只看方法图和主表，判断这类主动观察是否该进 GUI agent 基座。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the coarse-to-fine observation loop is a clean design pattern; read the method figure and main table to decide whether active zooming belongs in your GUI-agent stack.

paper.title: Formal Verification of Agentic Systems over Operational Data
paper.abstract: Agentic systems driven by large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world workflows where they act on persistent operational data. Before deployment, these systems need to be verified against business requirements that govern workflow execution and data evolution. However, existing approaches do not provide such system-level guarantees, as they mainly constrain or analyse behaviour at the agent's interface level. We study here the verification of agentic systems comprising a

summary.core_problem: 为带工具调用和持久化关系数据的 LLM agent 系统建立形式化语义，并研究这类系统能否按业务约束被验证。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是通用 agent 系统的形式化建模和可验证性分析。它不直接服务预训练，但对 agent deployment 的系统边界、工具状态、数据演化约束有清晰的问题刻画。
summary.technical_approach: 论文定义 Stateful Tool-Enabled Agentic Deployments，将单个 LLM、工具编排脚手架和关系型 operational data 组合为带状态系统；用 FO-CTL 描述跨时间和一阶数据属性；证明一般验证问题不可判定，并给出在有限域限制下保持 FO-CTL 规格的充分条件，此时验证复杂度为 PSPACE-complete。
summary.experiments: 这是偏形式化理论工作。摘要给出的结果主要是语义定义、不可判定性证明、有限域精确保真条件和 PSPACE-complete 复杂度结论，未涉及模型参数量、训练数据或常规 benchmark 数值。
summary.authors_note: Alessio Lomuscio 团队长期研究多智能体系统、形式化验证和模型检查；该工作延续其形式化方法路线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper formalizes LLM agent deployments that call tools over persistent relational operational data, and studies whether such systems can be verified against business constraints.
summary_en.importance: This is a formal-methods contribution for general agent systems. It does not improve pretraining directly, but it gives a clean framing of state, tools, and data evolution in deployed agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors define Stateful Tool-Enabled Agentic Deployments, combining a single LLM, a tool orchestration harness, and relational operational data. They specify requirements in FO-CTL, prove that general verification is undecidable, and identify sufficient conditions under which finite-domain restriction exactly preserves FO-CTL specifications, yielding PSPACE-complete verification.
summary_en.experiments: This is mainly a theoretical paper. The reported results are semantic definitions, undecidability, finite-domain preservation conditions, and PSPACE-completeness, rather than model-scale experiments or benchmark scores.
summary_en.authors_note: Alessio Lomuscio is known for work on multi-agent systems, formal verification, and model checking; this paper follows that formal-methods line.

recommendation.zh: 读抽象和定理陈述即可；它给 agent 状态验证划了硬边界，但离训练方法还有一层。
recommendation.en: Read the formalism and theorem statements; it draws hard boundaries for stateful agent verification, but it is one layer away from training.

paper.title: Stateful Governance for Concurrent Agentic Systems
paper.abstract: AI agents are moving from advisory interfaces into systems that execute consequential operations: issuing refunds, reserving scarce inventory, provisioning cloud resources, and initiating financial transfers. These workflows require governance over effects, not only over model outputs. Existing safeguards often decide whether an action is allowed from the information available when the action is requested. For stateful policies, that request-time view may be incomplete: budgets, inventory, appro

summary.core_problem: 为并发 agent 系统中的真实副作用提供状态化治理，避免请求时批准在执行时已经过期的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是通用 agent runtime 的正确性条件和系统架构；对预训练本身没有直接影响，但对 tool-use agent、权限控制和执行语义有工程参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 识别 stale authorization 作为核心故障模式；定义 policy-state serializability，要求已提交副作用可解释为在副作用发生前一刻基于最新 policy state 被授权；提出 Provenact runtime，将 policy 作为可变状态管理，并在并发执行下约束副作用提交。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出定量实验、系统吞吐、延迟开销或案例数量；可确认的信息主要是形式化条件和 runtime 设计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses stateful governance for concurrent agentic systems, preventing request-time approvals from becoming stale before real-world effects are committed.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a correctness condition and runtime architecture for general agent systems; it does not affect pretraining directly, but is relevant to tool-use agents, authorization, and execution semantics.
summary_en.technical_approach: It identifies stale authorization as the key failure mode, defines policy-state serializability so committed effects must be explainable as authorized against the policy state immediately before execution, and introduces Provenact as a runtime for managing policies as state under concurrency.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report quantitative experiments, throughput or latency overhead, or the number of evaluated cases; the available information is mainly the formal condition and runtime design.

recommendation.zh: 只看定义和故障模型即可；它把 agent safety 从输出审核拉到 effect commit，方向对但离 pretrain 较远。
recommendation.en: Read only the definition and failure model; it moves agent safety from output checks to effect commits, useful but far from pretraining.

paper.title: Getting the Parameters Right: A Difficulty-Graded Benchmark and Probe-Guided Training for LLM Tool Calls
paper.abstract: Large language model agents derive much of their capability from tool use. Existing research on tool use has largely focused on selecting the right tool and orchestrating the order of calls. However, correctly filling the parameters of a tool call is equally critical for successful execution and has received far less attention. In domains such as cloud networking, even frontier models correctly complete fewer than half of tool calls. Inspired by recent analyses showing that LLM hidden states enc

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM工具调用研究普遍聚焦工具选择和调用顺序编排，忽视参数填充的正确性，导致复杂场景下前沿模型工具调用成功率不足一半。
summary.importance: 指出工具调用中参数填充的能力短板，发现参数生成过程中隐状态存在可被线性探针捕捉的正确性信号，配套提出探针引导的训练和推理方案。
summary.technical_approach: 构建难度分级的工具调用参数填充测试基准；训练线性探针读取参数生成阶段的隐状态，预测当前参数值的正确性；基于探针实现两个模块：探针过滤的自举训练（筛选高置信度自生成样本做微调）、探针引导重排（推理时选择探针预测正确率高的候选）。
summary.experiments: 云网络场景下前沿模型的参数填充正确率不足50%；线性探针可准确预测参数生成的正确性；所提框架在测试基准上提升了参数填充正确率（完整结果摘要截断）。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM tool use research focuses primarily on tool selection and call orchestration, neglecting parameter filling correctness, leading to below 50% tool call success rate for frontier models in complex domains.
summary_en.importance: Identifies parameter filling as a critical bottleneck for reliable tool use, discovers a linear-probe-accessible correctness signal in hidden states during parameter generation, and proposes a corresponding probe-guided training and inference framework.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds a difficulty-graded benchmark for tool call parameter filling; trains a linear probe over hidden states during parameter generation to predict output correctness; implements two components: Probe-filtered Bootstrapped Training which filters high-confidence self-generated samples for fine-tuning, and Probe-guided Reranking which selects high-correctness candidates at inference time.
summary_en.experiments: Frontier models achieve below 50% parameter correctness in cloud networking tool use scenarios; the linear probe accurately predicts parameter correctness; the proposed framework improves parameter filling accuracy on the benchmark (full results truncated in abstract).

recommendation.zh: 方法是线性探针思路在tool call场景的直接迁移，增量性强；知道参数填充是tool call短板即可，无需细读正文。
recommendation.en: Linear probe approach directly transferred to the tool call scenario with limited novelty; only note parameter filling as a tool call bottleneck, no deep read required.

paper.title: Towards Robust Tool Use in Agents via Experience-Driven Adaptive Guidance
paper.abstract: The performance bottleneck of agents is increasingly shifting from model capability to the robustness of their execution processes. Tools play a central role as the primary interface through which agents interact with external environments, yet existing methods rarely focus on ensuring robust tool use across diverse runtime conditions. To address this problem, we propose ExpG, a mechanism that builds and refines adaptive guidance capturing each tool's capability boundaries and best practices, th

summary.core_problem: 智能体的工具调用在不同运行条件下不够鲁棒，现有方法较少刻画每个工具的能力边界与最佳实践。
summary.importance: 通用 Agent 工具使用的方法改进，核心是从历史轨迹中沉淀经验并生成自适应指导，但创新性偏增量。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ExpG，分三阶段：从历史执行轨迹做多方面归因以获取结构化经验；通过过滤、等价类选择和摘要蒸馏经验池；将经验转化为可复用的自适应指导以提升工具调用鲁棒性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量、训练数据、基线或量化提升，实验细节缺失。

summary_en.core_problem: Agent tool use is not robust across diverse runtime conditions, and existing methods rarely capture each tool's capability boundaries and best practices.
summary_en.importance: A method for improving general agent tool-use robustness by distilling experience from execution trajectories, though the contribution appears incremental.
summary_en.technical_approach: ExpG has three phases: experience acquisition via multi-aspect attribution on historical trajectories; experience distillation through filtering, equivalence-class selection, and summarization; and conversion of experience into adaptive guidance for tool use.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract provides no model size, training data, baselines, or quantitative improvements.

recommendation.zh: 工具调用鲁棒性的经验池方案，思路常规且摘要无实验；知道即可，暂不值得细读。
recommendation.en: A standard experience-pool approach to tool-use robustness with no experiments in the abstract; worth knowing about but not a close read.

paper.title: Deep Research Pretraining via Predictive Navigation
paper.abstract: Deep research agents are often trained on expensive, environment-grounded tool-use trajectories that require repeated retrieval, document inspection, and report evaluation. We introduce Deep Research Pretraining (DRP), an offline framework that derives predictive navigation supervision from naturally occurring evidence structures. Given a citation-bearing or hyperlinked passage, DRP constructs a proxy research objective, recovers linked evidence and graph-related alternatives, and converts them

summary.core_problem: 深度研究（deep research）类 agent 训练通常依赖昂贵的环境交互轨迹：反复检索、打开文档、筛证据、写报告，还要做结果评估。论文要解决的是：能否不跑环境、不做 teacher rollout，仅利用语料中“天然存在的证据结构”（论文引用、网页超链接）构造可用于预训练的监督信号，从而提升后续 agent SFT/RL 的样本效率？
summary.importance: 对预训练/持续预训练的贡献点很明确：把“图结构证据关系”转成一种可规模化的 continual pretraining 阶段（1B tokens），在不引入真实交互成本的前提下，让 base 模型学到更像研究员的导航决策（搜什么、看什么、如何逐步写）。它提供了一个可复用的接口：用离线图与文档内容合成 action-conditioned 轨迹格式数据，作为 agent post-training 之前的初始化。对做 mid-train / continual pretrain 的团队，这类工作比直接堆 SFT 轨迹更便宜，也更容易扩到新域。
summary.technical_approach:
DRP（Deep Research Pretraining）是一个离线“反向合成”框架。
- 数据来源：带证据图的文档集合（citation graph 或 Wikipedia hyperlink graph）。边表示自然关系（引用/链接）。
- 核心构造：从一个 anchor 文档中抽取带引用/链接的段落 r 作为 target report；恢复其证据集合 Er（被引用/被链接且对段落内容有实质贡献的文档）；再从图拓扑邻域采样“相关但未被选中”的 alternatives，形成候选集。
- 代理目标与动作空间：把段落内容归纳成 proxy research objective u（要研究/回答的问题），然后把监督渲染成统一的 search–open–write 轨迹。模型在给定 objective 与已观察证据历史的条件下，学习预测下一步该 search 什么、open 哪些文档、以及如何 write/整合证据。作者把这个训练目标称为 predictive navigation。
- 关键取舍：不执行真实检索环境与 policy rollout；候选集与文档内容完全离线组装。这样牺牲了“真实交互分布”，换来极低的数据构造成本与可控的监督结构。
- 两个实例化：DRP-Paper（学术引用图，Related Work 段落为 target report；引用论文为 evidence；邻近未引用论文为 alternatives）与 DRP-Web（Wikipedia 段落；过滤掉仅是顺带提及的链接，保留实质贡献链接为 evidence；邻近页面为 alternatives）。
summary.experiments:
实验设置与结论（来自你提供的正文段落）：
- 模型与训练：从 Qwen3-14B-Base 出发，分别做 1B tokens 的 DRP-Paper 或 DRP-Web continual pretraining，然后在 DR Tulu 的 13K GPT-5 生成 deep-research 轨迹上做 agent SFT；用不同数据预算评估样本效率。
- 样本效率：在 DeepResearch Bench 上，低数据预算下（多次独立抽样的子集）DRP-Paper/DRP-Web 相比“无 DRP 的同等 SFT”稳定更好；用 1/4 轨迹时，DRP-Web 还能超过一个固定的 full-data Base checkpoint。
- 迁移：低数据增益可迁移到 ResearchQA、WebWalkerQA、SimpleQA；在更大模型 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上，1/16-SFT 的收益仍存在。
- 与 RL 结合：从匹配的 1/16-SFT 起点出发，DRP-Web 在 80 steps 的 ARPO 风格 agentic RL 过程中始终领先 Base。
- 归因控制：做了 source-matched raw-document continual pretraining 与 evidence-mismatch 控制，支持收益来自“证据条件化的导航学习”，而不是仅仅多看了同域文本或学了 agent 格式。
（注：你提供的片段未包含具体分数提升幅度、误差条、以及 DRP 数据的 token/样本构成细节；这些通常在实验表格与附录里。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45 分钟）：
- 先读 Introduction 里对“为什么 rollout 贵、为什么证据图能替代部分监督”的论证，明确 DRP 的定位是 pretrain 初始化而非替代 RL/SFT。
- 重点看 Method：证据集合 Er 的抽取规则、alternatives 的采样策略、以及 search–open–write 的具体序列化格式（这决定了信号质量）。
- 直接看样本效率曲线：不同 SFT 预算（1/16、1/4 等）下的提升是否稳定、方差多大。
- 必看控制实验：source-matched raw-CPT 与 evidence-mismatch，判断它是否真的在学“导航决策”而不是“领域暴露”。

summary_en.core_problem: Deep-research agents are typically trained with expensive environment-grounded tool-use trajectories (search, open documents, gather evidence, write reports, evaluate outcomes). The paper asks whether naturally occurring evidence structures in corpora (citations, hyperlinks) can be converted into rollout-free supervision for a pretraining stage that improves downstream agent SFT/RL sample efficiency.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a practical continual-pretraining interface for agentic capabilities: use offline evidence graphs to synthesize action-conditioned trajectories at scale (1B tokens) without running a retrieval environment or collecting teacher rollouts. For teams working on mid-train/continual pretrain, this is a cheaper way to inject navigation-and-evidence-selection priors before costly trajectory SFT or agentic RL, and it is easier to port across domains where citation/link graphs exist.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Deep Research Pretraining (DRP) is an offline reverse-synthesis pipeline.
- Inputs: a document corpus plus an evidence graph (citation graph or Wikipedia hyperlink graph).
- Construction: pick a citation-bearing / link-bearing passage as the target report r; recover its evidence set Er (linked/cited documents that substantively support the passage); sample graph-neighborhood alternatives that are related but not selected.
- Proxy objective: infer a research objective u whose answer is expressed by r.
- Rendering: convert (u, evidence, alternatives) into standardized search–open–write trajectories.
- Training objective (predictive navigation): conditioned on the objective and the evidence observed so far, predict what to search, which documents to open, and how to synthesize/write grounded text.
- Key trade-off: no live retrieval environment and no executed policy rollouts; candidate sets and document contents are assembled offline, prioritizing scale and controllability over perfect interaction realism.
- Instantiations: DRP-Paper (citation graphs, Related Work passages) and DRP-Web (Wikipedia hyperlinks with filtering to keep substantive links).
summary_en.experiments:
Setup and reported findings from the provided excerpt:
- Starting point: Qwen3-14B-Base.
- Continual pretraining: 1B tokens on DRP-Paper or DRP-Web.
- Downstream: agent SFT on controlled fractions of 13K GPT-5-generated deep-research trajectories (DR Tulu), measuring performance vs number of expert trajectories.
- Results: consistent gains over no-DRP SFT at low-data budgets on DeepResearch Bench across multiple independently sampled subsets; with 1/4 trajectories, DRP-Web exceeds a fixed full-data Base checkpoint.
- Transfer: improvements carry to ResearchQA, WebWalkerQA, SimpleQA; the 1/16-SFT gain persists on Qwen3-30B-A3B.
- RL continuation: from matched 1/16-SFT checkpoints, DRP-Web stays ahead of Base through 80 steps of ARPO-style agentic RL.
- Controls: source-matched raw-document CPT and evidence-mismatch controls suggest the benefit comes from evidence-conditioned navigation rather than domain exposure or merely imitating agent formatting.
(The excerpt does not include exact score deltas or detailed data composition; those would come from the results tables/appendix.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the motivation carefully: what costs DRP is trying to remove, and what it intentionally does not model.
- Focus on the Method section details that determine signal quality: how Er is extracted/filtered, how alternatives are sampled, and how trajectories are serialized.
- Inspect the sample-efficiency plots/tables across SFT budgets (1/16, 1/4, etc.) and variance across subset resampling.
- Do not skip the controls (source-matched raw-CPT, evidence-mismatch); they are the main evidence that DRP teaches navigation decisions rather than just adding in-domain text.

recommendation.zh: 值得看数据构造细节；若离线 citation/hyperlink 监督能迁移，internal CPT 可直接加一条 research-navigation mixture。
recommendation.en: Read the data-construction details; if citation and hyperlink supervision transfers, it is an actionable CPT mixture for research navigation.

paper.title: AOSpec: Action and Observation Co-Speculation for Low-Latency Agent Serving
paper.abstract: Large language model agents increasingly act through stateful tools, yet model generation and environment execution remain serialized at every step. As decoding accelerates, tool execution becomes a growing bottleneck. Existing action- or observation-only speculation leaves much of this latency exposed: value is concentrated in a few slow calls, some outcomes emerge only through execution, and longer lookahead typically requires an increasingly unlikely chain of action predictions. We present AO

summary.core_problem: AOSpec 解决的是 LLM agent serving 中模型生成与工具执行被逐步串行化的问题。随着解码变快，端到端延迟越来越多地由外部工具、终端环境、文件系统或运行时状态决定。已有 action speculation 或 observation speculation 只覆盖循环的一侧，难以处理慢调用集中、观察依赖隐藏环境状态、长距离提前执行需要连续预测动作链这三个问题。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练本身的直接影响有限，但对 agent 模型的系统侧评估和推理效率有参考价值。它把 agent 延迟拆成模型生成时间和环境执行时间，并指出 hit rate 不是合适的 speculation 指标，因为少量慢工具调用贡献了绝大多数工具时间。这个观察会影响 agent benchmark、工具调用数据采样、以及训练时是否需要让模型显式暴露可提前执行的动作结构。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是同时推测动作和观察，但保持 lossless，即最终语义与串行执行一致。第一，Expected Value Decoding 不按观察预测命中率排序，而按候选观察概率与可隐藏工具时间的乘积排序，优先覆盖高延迟收益的分支。第二，对于只能通过真实执行得到的 observation，系统在隔离 sandbox fork 中提前执行预测动作，避免错误动作污染 committed state。第三，Joint Action-State Verification 将长距离 action speculation 从“预测完整中间动作链”改成“验证目标动作和起始状态是否匹配”。这样可以提前启动远处的慢工具调用，而不要求模型把中间每一步都预测对。与单侧 speculation 相比，AOSpec 的关键差异是把 agent-environment loop 当成联合对象处理，并用状态验证保证精确回退。
summary.experiments: 实验基于 Terminal-Bench，并在 4 个 harness、5 个模型上测试。动机分析使用 1,921 条训练集轨迹，发现超过 1 秒的调用只占 17%，却贡献 97% 的工具执行时间，说明慢调用预测比平均命中率更重要。系统结果显示，AOSpec 带来 11.8% 到 32.5% 的端到端延迟下降，p99 延迟最多下降 42.8%。论文还强调，随着模型解码加速，工具执行占比上升，AOSpec 的收益会更明显。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 分钟。优先看 Motivation 中 Figure 2，它解释了为什么 agent speculation 不能只看命中率。然后看 Method 中 EVD、sandboxed action execution、JASV 三个模块，重点理解 JASV 如何避免完整动作链预测。实验部分主要看 Terminal-Bench 设置、端到端 latency、p99 latency，以及与 action-only / observation-only speculation 的对比。

summary_en.core_problem: AOSpec targets the serialized agent loop where an LLM must finish generating an action before the environment can execute it and return an observation. As decoding becomes faster, tool execution becomes a larger fraction of end-to-end latency. Prior action-only or observation-only speculation leaves substantial latency exposed, especially when slow calls are rare but dominant, observations depend on hidden runtime state, and long-horizon speculation requires an unlikely chain of correct action predictions.
summary_en.importance: The work is not directly about pretraining, but it is useful for understanding agent serving bottlenecks and the system assumptions behind tool-use models. A key lesson is that speculation hit rate is a poor metric for agent latency: a small number of slow tool calls can dominate total runtime. This has implications for agent evaluation, tool-use trace collection, and training formats that make future actions and executable states easier to expose.
summary_en.technical_approach: AOSpec jointly speculates actions and observations while preserving serial semantics. Expected Value Decoding ranks speculative observations by expected hidden time, combining probability with estimated tool latency rather than optimizing hit rate. For observations that cannot be inferred from the model context, AOSpec launches predicted actions in isolated sandbox forks so that environment-dependent results can be obtained early without corrupting the committed state. Joint Action-State Verification changes long-range speculation from predicting the full intervening action chain to verifying whether a target action and its origin state match the actual emitted action and committed state. This enables longer overlap with tool execution while retaining exact verification.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on Terminal-Bench with 4 harnesses and 5 models. A profiling study over 1,921 training trajectories shows that calls longer than one second account for only 17% of calls but 97% of total tool time. This supports the latency-aware design of EVD. End-to-end experiments report 11.8% to 32.5% latency reduction and up to 42.8% p99 latency reduction. The gains increase as decoding becomes faster, because tool execution then occupies a larger share of the total loop.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 minutes. Start with the motivation figures, especially the latency concentration analysis in Figure 2. Then read the method sections for EVD, sandboxed execution, and JASV. The most useful part is the verification design: it explains how to speculate far ahead without requiring a fully correct predicted action chain. In the experiments, focus on end-to-end latency, p99 latency, and comparisons against action-only and observation-only baselines.

recommendation.zh: 读 §系统设计和 EVD 即可；它不改模型训练，但把 agent latency 目标从 hit-rate 拉回 wall-clock。
recommendation.en: Read the system design and EVD parts; it does not affect training, but it reframes agent speculation around wall-clock latency.

paper.title: OpenART: Scaling Agent Red Teaming via Open-Ended Environment Evolution
paper.abstract: AI agents operate in persistent environments where early state changes can influence decisions far into the future. Unlike conventional language-model interactions, agent behavior is mediated through a shared state that is repeatedly modified and reused across long-horizon workflows. Current safety benchmarks often fail to capture these cumulative risks because they focus on short, static tasks. To address these limitations, we introduce OpenART, an open-ended arena for scalable agent red teamin
