We introduce a paired benchmark that tests whether LLM agents exhibit conscious allocation behavior under a fixed budget in two contexts: an abstract text-based formulation and a code-construction task. We find that every frontier model we test---Claude Hai

summary.core_problem: LLM Agent 在面对任务流和有限工具创建预算时，是否具备有意识的工具分配能力——即判断何时值得为一类任务创建可复用工具，而非为每个任务一次性处理。现有评测只测「能否写出正确工具」或「能否从工具库中选对工具」，从未测量更基础的「何时应该创建工具」这一预算感知决策能力。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于揭示了一种能力断层：前沿模型在抽象的预算分配问题上表现接近最优，但这种能力无法迁移到具体的代码工具创建场景。这说明后训练（post-training）可能在特定输出模态（如代码生成）上压制了已有的抽象推理能力，而非简单的「模型不会预算规划」。这一发现对理解 SFT/RL 后训练如何塑造模型行为、以及能力迁移的边界条件有参考价值——尤其是对 agent 能力的预训练/后训练分工设计。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 AlloBench，一个配对式基准测试，在两种框架下测试同一预算分配问题：(1) 抽象的文本球收集游戏；(2) 具体的代码脚本编写任务（数学题求解脚本）。基准的核心机制是：agent 面对 T=60 个任务流，来自 N=8 个隐式类别，最多可创建 B 个工具，工具一旦创建可复用。最优策略不是在首次遇到某类时就创建工具，而是等待确认该类会重复出现后再投入预算，因为稀有类上的错误投入会导致频繁类的机会成本。论文设计了「早期陷阱」来放大这一效应。评测同时覆盖抽象和具体两种框架，通过对比同一模型在两种框架下的表现，定位能力断层的位置。
summary.experiments: 测试了 Claude Haiku、Claude Opus、GPT-5.4-mini、GPT-5.6 Sol 四个前沿模型。核心发现：所有四个模型在抽象分配框架下表现接近最优，但都无法将这种能力迁移到脚本编写任务中。进一步定位失败触发点：前三个模型（Haiku / Opus / GPT-5.4-mini）的失败点在「需要输出代码」这一步——即使脚本不被评测执行，只要要求写代码就会失败；而最强模型 GPT-5.6 Sol 的失败点在完整脚本构建环节。论文还验证了在抽象预算分配上的后训练无法迁移到工具创建场景，并推测这种能力压制可能由主流后训练方法的某些特性导致。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，预计 15–20 分钟。重点看 §1 引言中对「工具创建时机」这一未被测量的基础决策的界定，以及 §2 AlloBench 的形式化定义和最优策略分析（附录 A.1 的 Dirichlet 先验下的等待收益推导值得一看）。核心实验结论在 §4，尤其是抽象→具体的能力断层定位。对预训练研究员来说，最有价值的观察是「抽象能力存在但在代码输出模态下被压制」这一现象，它提示后训练可能引入了模态特定的行为偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM agent evaluations measure whether a model can write a correct tool or select the right tool from a library, but they never test a more fundamental decision: when should an agent create a reusable tool at all, given a limited budget over a stream of recurring tasks? This budget-aware tool allocation capability is essential for efficient agentic systems but remains unmeasured.
summary_en.importance: The work reveals a capability gap that is relevant to understanding post-training effects: frontier models perform near-optimally on abstract budget allocation, yet this ability fails to transfer to concrete code tool creation. This suggests that post-training may suppress existing abstract reasoning capabilities in specific output modalities (e.g., code generation), rather than models simply lacking budgeting competence. The finding informs the design of pretraining/post-training pipelines for agent capabilities, particularly around how modality-specific behavior can mask general reasoning skill.
summary_en.technical_approach: AlloBench is a paired benchmark that tests the same budget-allocation problem in two framings: (1) an abstract text-based ball-collection game, and (2) a concrete code-construction task (writing scripts to solve math word problems). The core mechanism: an agent faces a stream of T=60 tasks drawn from N=8 latent classes, with a budget of at most B tools that can be reused once created. The optimal policy is not to commit on first encounter, but to wait for confirmed recurrence—since mis-investing in a rare class incurs large opportunity cost on frequent classes. The benchmark is designed with early traps to amplify this effect. By comparing performance across the two framings within the same model, the study localizes where the capability breaks down.
summary_en.experiments: Four frontier models are tested: Claude Haiku, Claude Opus, GPT-5.4-mini, and GPT-5.6 Sol. All four perform near-optimally in the abstract allocation framing but fail to transfer this ability to script-writing. Failure-mode localization shows that the first three models (Haiku / Opus / GPT-5.4-mini) fail at the step of required code emission—they degrade even when the scripts are not evaluated for execution, simply because they are asked to write code. The strongest model (GPT-5.6 Sol) fails specifically at full script construction. The paper also demonstrates that post-training on abstract budget allocation does not transfer to tool creation, and conjectures that this capability suppression is caused by characteristics of predominant post-training methods.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read, ~15–20 minutes. Focus on §1 for the crisp articulation of the unmeasured "when to create a tool" decision, and §2 for the formalization of AlloBench and the optimal policy analysis (Appendix A.1's derivation of the waiting benefit under a symmetric Dirichlet prior is worth a look). Key results are in §4, particularly the localization of the abstract-to-concrete capability gap. For pretraining researchers, the most valuable observation is that abstract competence exists but is suppressed under code output modality—suggesting that post-training can introduce modality-specific behavioral biases.

recommendation.zh: 只看任务设计和 failure-mode 表；它测的是抽象规划到工具构建的迁移断裂，比常规 tool-use 分数更有诊断性。
recommendation.en: Read the task design and failure-mode tables; it probes the transfer break from abstract planning to tool construction better than ordinary tool-use scores.

paper.title: CADER: Confidence-Aware Dynamic Evidence Reasoning for Long-Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Long-video understanding increasingly relies on large vision-language models and tool-augmented reasoning, but most systems apply the same inference procedure to every example regardless of difficulty. This uniform strategy invokes unnecessary tool-assisted processing for easy questions and provides limited control when difficult questions require fine-grained temporal evidence. We propose CADER (Confidence-Aware Dynamic Evidence Reasoning), a training-free framework for adaptive and reliable lo

summary.core_problem: 为长视频问答设计一种按样本难度动态分配工具调用和证据检索成本的训练免框架。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态推理系统与 test-time compute allocation 的小型方法创新。它不改预训练模型，但提出用置信度控制是否进入细粒度时间证据循环，对研究推理时计算分配、工具使用触发条件和长视频证据定位有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: CADER 先在均匀采样帧上做全局推理，并用 logit-margin 估计答案置信度。高置信样本直接 early exit；低置信样本进入第二阶段工具增强循环，结合 temporal cropping、轻量语义验证和 Relevance-Guided Resampling，逐步定位与问题相关的时间证据。核心设计是把工具调用作为样本级决策，而不是对所有问题使用同一条推理流程。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、视频 benchmark、样本数、工具成本、准确率提升或 token/时间开销下降。能确认的是方法为 training-free，并针对长视频理解中的自适应可靠推理；需要正文检查 logit-margin 校准是否稳定，以及 early exit 是否牺牲难例召回。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper proposes a training-free framework that dynamically allocates tool use and evidence retrieval cost per sample for long-video question answering.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a modest method for multimodal reasoning systems and test-time compute allocation. It does not change pretraining, but it offers a useful pattern for deciding when to trigger tool use, how to localize temporal evidence, and how to avoid over-processing easy long-video questions.
summary_en.technical_approach: CADER first performs global reasoning over uniformly sampled frames and estimates answer confidence using a logit-margin signal. High-confidence samples exit early. Low-confidence samples enter a second-stage tool-augmented loop with temporal cropping, lightweight semantic verification, and Relevance-Guided Resampling to progressively locate question-relevant evidence. The key design is treating tool use as a per-sample decision rather than a fixed pipeline.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report the exact model, video benchmarks, data size, tool cost, accuracy gains, or latency/token reductions. It states that the framework is training-free and targets adaptive reliable long-video reasoning. The full paper should be checked for logit-margin calibration stability and whether early exit hurts recall on hard cases.

recommendation.zh: 读算法流程图和置信度阈值消融即可；logit-margin 当工具开关常有校准坑，别直接外推。
recommendation.en: Skim the pipeline and threshold ablation; logit-margin as a tool-use gate often has calibration traps, so do not over-generalize it.

paper.title: Beyond Aggregate Risk: Role-Stratified Conformal Risk Control for LLM Tool Calls
paper.abstract: Language-model agents act through structured tool calls whose arguments carry different risks. Untrusted content may safely influence an email body but should not determine a recipient, account, command, or credential. Existing statistical methods typically control risk over the entire action, allowing failures in rare, high-risk fields to be obscured by benign arguments. We introduce role-stratified per-field conformal risk control, a calibration layer that wraps any per-field detector and sets

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM工具调用的统计风险控制方法在整体动作层面校准，会稀释稀有高风险参数字段的违规率，无法为不同风险等级的参数提供独立的有限样本风险保证。
summary.importance: 角色分层的风险控制思路，可为预训练阶段针对不同语义角色的token设置差异化训练目标或正则项、从源头降低高风险字段违规概率提供参考，也可用于优化预训练模型的不确定性估计。
summary.technical_approach: 提出角色分层的逐字段共形风险控制方法。为工具调用的每个参数分配语义角色（如目标、凭证、命令、内容等），每个角色拥有独立的风险预算与阈值，在角色层面执行类条件（Mondrian）共形校准。该方法解决了整体校准的稀释问题：整体控制下稀有角色r的违规率会被放大1/p_r（p_r为角色出现概率），要保证角色r的风险不超过α，整体方法需将有效预算压缩至α·p_r，而分层方法直接为每个角色分配独立预算。方法还支持稀有角色池化、标签条件校准（提供与攻击流行度无关的攻击条件风险保证），零预算极限下可恢复检测器相对的非干扰性。该方法作为包装层可兼容任何逐字段检测器，效果随检测器性能同步提升。
summary.experiments: 在6个模型、2个基准上测试，经验效用差距符合理论预测的「粗粒度代价」。角色分层方法在分布迁移、未见过的测试集、检测器噪声、渐变漂移、自适应攻击下均能保持风险合规。2×2消融实验显示，分层带来主要的鲁棒性提升，共形重校准可在新条件下恢复有限样本有效性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读问题定义与威胁模型、方法理论章节，以及消融实验部分。重点理解角色分层的理论依据与实际效果，预计阅读时间25-35分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing statistical risk control methods for LLM tool calls calibrate at the whole-action level, which dilutes violation rates of rare high-risk argument fields and fails to provide independent finite-sample risk guarantees for parameters with different risk levels.
summary_en.importance: The role-stratified risk control framework offers insights for pre-training research, such as applying differentiated training objectives or regularization to tokens with different semantic roles to reduce high-risk field violations from the source, and optimizing pre-trained model uncertainty estimation via stratified conformal calibration.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes role-stratified per-field conformal risk control (CRC). Each argument of a tool call is assigned a semantic role (e.g., target, credential, command, content) with its own risk budget and threshold, performing Mondrian (class-conditional) conformal calibration at the role level. This resolves the dilution problem of aggregate calibration: under aggregate control, the violation rate of a rare role r is inflated by 1/p_r (where p_r is role prevalence), so guaranteeing role-specific risk α requires shrinking the effective budget to α·p_r, while stratified calibration assigns independent budgets directly to each role. The method also supports pooling for rare roles, label-conditional calibration (providing prevalence-invariant attack-conditional guarantees), and recovers detector-relative noninterference in the zero-budget limit. It operates as a wrapper layer compatible with any per-field detector, and improves in lockstep with detector performance.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across 6 models and 2 benchmarks. Empirical utility gaps align with the theoretically predicted "price of coarseness". The role-stratified method remains risk-compliant under distribution shift, unseen test suites, detector noise, gradual drift, and adaptive attacks. A 2×2 ablation shows stratification delivers the primary robustness gain, while conformal recalibration restores finite-sample validity under new conditions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the problem setup & threat model, theoretical method sections, and ablation experiments. Focus on understanding the theoretical justification for role stratification and its practical effectiveness. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: §理论推导值得扫；它把 tool safety 的风险粒度讲清了，比再训一个 detector 更有用。
recommendation.en: Skim the theoretical derivation; the paper clarifies the right risk granularity for tool safety better than yet another detector would.

paper.title: What Can Be Enforced? A Theory of Certified Runtime Safety for Tool-Using Agents
paper.abstract: Runtime guardrails act before irreversible tool calls, but their guarantees depend on what policy state is representable, what a judge observes, and whether intervention changes future behavior. We separate three questions. First, relative to fixed oracle predicates, a deterministic gate enforces exactly the nonempty safety policies whose good prefixes its register model recognizes; policy nontriviality is undecidable with two decrementable counters but in PSPACE for a separable monotone fragmen

summary.core_problem: 刻画工具使用Agent运行时安全护栏的能力边界，明确哪些安全属性可被强制执行、哪些条件下防护保证会失效。
summary.importance: 理论贡献，首次从可表示状态、判别器观测能力、闭环干预效应三个维度给出运行时护栏的形式化边界，推导了误拦/漏拦的最优权衡与校准条件。
summary.technical_approach: 采用形式化语言理论、Neyman-Pearson统计决策论、共形预测、受控马尔可夫建模方法，拆分三个独立问题分别推导：可执行策略的表示能力边界、开环场景下的校准保证、闭环干预下的策略失效条件。
summary.experiments: 纯理论推导，无大模型训练或实证实验，给出了可判定性结论、最优决策前沿、有限样本校准证书和闭环优化的占用度规划形式化定义。

summary_en.core_problem: Characterize the capability boundary of runtime guardrails for tool-using agents, clarifying which safety properties can be enforced and under what conditions protection guarantees fail.
summary_en.importance: Theoretical contribution that formally delineates runtime safety guard boundaries across three dimensions: representable policy state, judge observability, and closed-loop intervention effects, deriving the optimal false-block/miss tradeoff and calibration conditions.
summary_en.technical_approach: Leverages formal language theory, Neyman-Pearson lemma, conformal prediction, and controlled Markov modeling to derive boundaries for three decoupled problems: representability of enforceable policies, open-loop calibration guarantees, and failure conditions under closed-loop intervention.
summary_en.experiments: Pure theoretical derivation without LLM training or empirical experiments; provides decidability results, optimal decision frontier, finite-sample calibration certificates, and a formal occupancy program for closed-loop optimization.

recommendation.zh: 纯形式化推导无LLM实证，仅对Agent安全设计有边际参考，不做相关方向可直接跳过。
recommendation.en: Pure formal analysis without LLM empirical validation, only marginal reference for agent safety design, skip if you don't work in this area.

paper.title: Nanbeige4.2-3B: Unlocking Agentic Capabilities in a Compact Mode
paper.abstract: We present Nanbeige4.2-3B, a compact general agentic model with 3B non-embedding parameters. It delivers strong performance across code-agent, office-agent, and complex tool-use tasks while maintaining highly competitive reasoning capabilities in mathematics, coding, and science. Nanbeige4.2-3B is pretrained from scratch on 28T tokens with a Looped Transformer that reuses the layer stack to increase capacity without adding parameters. For SFT data and trajectory construction, we expand the diver

summary.core_problem: 在严格参数预算（3B）下，把“通用推理能力”和“跨环境的 agentic 能力”（代码仓库、办公文档、复杂工具调用、长轨迹纠错）同时做进一个模型：既要底座足够强，又要在后训练阶段学会稳定执行多步工具链与环境交互。
summary.importance:
对预训练研究的直接启发点主要有两类：
- 架构/训练配方：Looped Transformer 通过重复使用同一层栈提高有效深度，提供一种在参数不变时用计算换容量的路线；论文还给出“从零训练 looped”优于“先训标准再 upcycle”的经验结论，以及 loop pass 数与 token efficiency/稳定性的取舍。
- Pretrain↔Posttrain 接口：在 28T token 从零预训练后，用大规模可执行环境轨迹做 SFT/RL，并引入 mixed-mode RLHF（Think/Non-Think）与长度控制 RL，属于把推理风格与 agent 失败模式当作可优化对象。
但整体更像一个系统性模型发布与工程总结：大量篇幅在 agent 数据与 RL pipeline，属于后训练与 agent 方向；如果只关心“基座预训练方法”，信息密度相对有限。
summary.technical_approach:
1) 架构：Looped Transformer。hidden states 通过共享的 Transformer 层栈跑多次（文中强调两次 pass 最合适），在不增加非 embedding 参数的情况下增加有效计算深度。
- 训练策略：对比两条路线：a) 标准 Transformer 预训练后再转 loop（upcycling）；b) 直接从零按 looped 架构预训练。结论是从零训练显著更好，原因是表示会在预训练早期就适配“层复用”的归纳偏置。
- loop 深度选择：两次 pass 在能力增益与训练代价之间最平衡；更多 pass 收益小但训练更慢且更不稳定。
- KV cache sharing：提出跨 pass 共享 KV 以减半 cache，但性能增益更低，最终选择不共享以保性能。
2) 预训练：28T tokens，从零训练 3B base；数据配比上提高数学、代码、合成 QA 权重（细节需要在数据章节核对具体比例与清洗策略）。
3) 后训练（与预训练关联较弱但占比大）：
- SFT：构建“真实环境 + 大规模合成环境”的混合池，在 repo 级软件工程、复杂工具使用、office 任务上生成可执行轨迹；用执行信号与 rubric 做轨迹/turn 级过滤。
- RL：多阶段：先 mixed-mode RLHF 同时覆盖 Think/Non-Think 以减少幻觉/重复/指令偏差；再做长度控制推理 RL 平衡简洁与探索；最后做 agentic RL，用 outcome+process reward 提供更密的 credit assignment，稳定长轨迹学习。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文片段可确认的关键数字：
- 模型规模：3B non-embedding 参数。
- 预训练规模：28T tokens。
- 架构消融结论：从零训练 looped > upcycling；两次 pass 最优；KV cache sharing 降内存但带来更低性能增益。
性能方面，论文宣称在 code-agent、office-agent、复杂 tool-use 评测上超过更大模型（如 Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma4-12B），并保持数学/代码/科学推理竞争力；但在当前提供的正文片段里缺少具体表格数字与统计设置（评测基准、提示词、是否多次采样、agent 框架配置等），需要回到实验章节逐项核对，尤其是 agent 评测的可复现性与是否存在 scaffold 优势。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（45–60 分钟）：
- 如果关注预训练/架构：直接看 Pre-Training 小节里关于“from-scratch vs upcycling”“loop pass 数选择”“KV cache sharing”的实验结论与取舍。
- 如果关注 pretrain↔posttrain 接口：看 mixed-mode RLHF 与长度控制 RL 的动机与失败案例分类，理解它们在 agent 轨迹里解决什么具体问题。
- 实验部分建议先找：looped 架构的对照表、token efficiency 的定义与测量方式、以及 agent 评测是否控制了外部工具/框架差异。整体预计需要额外 30 分钟专门核对实验设置与数据构造细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Building a compact (3B) model that simultaneously retains strong general reasoning and supports broad agentic behaviors across heterogeneous executable environments (repo-level coding, office artifacts, complex tool use, long-horizon recovery), under a strict parameter budget.
summary_en.importance: Pretraining-relevant takeaways are mainly: (1) Looped Transformer as a compute-for-capacity approach under fixed parameters, with practical findings on how to train it; (2) an explicit pretrain→posttrain pipeline where large-scale executable trajectories and RL objectives target agent failure modes and reasoning length. Much of the paper is closer to an engineering/model release centered on agent data and RL; if the goal is purely new pretraining methodology, the incremental insight is moderate.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Architecture: a Looped Transformer that reuses the same Transformer stack for multiple passes over the hidden states. The paper emphasizes a two-pass configuration as the best trade-off.
Training findings:
- Training from scratch with the looped architecture outperforms upcycling (pretrain standard → convert to loop), suggesting representations should adapt to layer reuse early in pretraining.
- Increasing the number of passes yields diminishing returns while slowing training and hurting stability.
- KV-cache sharing across passes halves cache memory but reduces performance gains; they keep the full non-sharing loop.
Pretraining: 28T tokens from scratch; the data mixture increases math/code/synthetic QA weights (exact ratios/filters need verification in the full data section).
Post-training (dominant part): executable trajectory SFT from a hybrid pool of real + synthesized environments with execution/rubric filtering; multi-stage RL including mixed-mode RLHF over Think/Non-Think, length-controlled reasoning RL, and agentic RL with outcome + process rewards for denser credit assignment in long trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: Confirmed from the provided content: 3B non-embedding parameters; 28T pretraining tokens; ablation-style conclusions that from-scratch looped > upcycling, two passes work best, and KV-cache sharing trades memory for weaker gains. The paper claims strong results on code-agent/office-agent/tool-use benchmarks, reportedly outperforming larger open models (e.g., Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma4-12B), but the excerpt does not include the concrete tables, evaluation protocols, or agent framework controls—those are essential to validate the claims and should be checked in the full experiments section.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (45–60 minutes):
- For pretraining/architecture: focus on the Pre-Training section covering from-scratch vs upcycling, loop depth selection, and KV-cache sharing.
- For pretrain↔posttrain interface: read the RL pipeline motivation (mixed-mode RLHF, length control) and what failure modes they target.
- In experiments, prioritize the looped-architecture comparison tables and the definition/measurement of “token efficiency”, then verify agent benchmark setups (tooling, scaffolds, sampling, reproducibility).

recommendation.zh: 不是看它 3B 打赢谁，而是看小模型 agentic RL recipe 怎么拼；优先读后训练消融，预训练 28T 更像成本宣言而非 insight。
recommendation.en: Do not read this for the leaderboard claim; read it for how the agentic RL recipe is assembled in a 3B model, while treating the 28T pretraining scale mostly as a budget statement.

paper.title: Agent Security Needs Redefinition through a Holistic Framework
paper.abstract: Agent security is widely treated as a question about action content. Defenses ask whether an instruction looks malicious. Benchmarks ask whether an agent performs a harmful sounding action. \textbf{We argue that agent security is fundamentally a contextual problem, and that the current content based framing systematically misdefines it.} A command to ``delete user data'' might be a routine administrative request or a prompt injection attacking production systems, and the content alone cannot dis

summary.core_problem: 重新定义 agent security：安全性不能只看动作文本是否“恶意”，而必须结合授权来源、任务目标和执行轨迹上下文判断。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 安全框架和评测范式批判。论文指出现有 prompt injection / agent safety 任务常把动作内容与授权上下文混在一起，导致 benchmark 可能测到的是内容分类能力，而不是真实的 agent 安全控制能力。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 contextual security 的四类联合属性，并要求在 agent 轨迹中持续评估。其中摘要明确提到 Source Authorization 用于判断指令来源，Task Alignment 用于判断动作是否服务于用户授权任务；其余属性因摘要截断无法完整确认。论文还用 AgentDojo 和 WASP 中的 injection 任务说明，同一动作在合法工作流和攻击场景中可能具有相同表面内容。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出新模型训练、参数规模或数值提升；主要实验/分析是对 AgentDojo 和 WASP injection tasks 的任务结构复核，强调这些任务中的危险动作本身也可能是认证用户的正常请求。
summary.authors_note: Dawn Song 是 UC Berkeley 计算机安全与可信 AI 方向的知名研究者，长期研究系统安全、隐私与 AI security。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper reframes agent security as a contextual property: whether an action is safe cannot be determined from the action text alone, but depends on authorization, task intent, and trajectory context.
summary_en.importance: This is a framework and critique for agent security evaluation. It argues that many prompt-injection and agent-safety tasks conflate action content with authorization context, so they may measure content classification rather than real security control.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper operationalizes contextual security through jointly required properties evaluated continuously along the agent trajectory. The abstract explicitly names Source Authorization, which identifies who issued a command, and Task Alignment, which checks whether the action serves the authorized task. It also analyzes AgentDojo and WASP injection tasks to show that the same action can be legitimate or malicious depending on context.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model training, parameter counts, or accuracy gains. The evidence is primarily structural analysis of injection tasks in AgentDojo and WASP, showing that actions labeled harmful can also be plausible authenticated-user requests in routine workflows.
summary_en.authors_note: Dawn Song is a well-known UC Berkeley researcher in computer security, privacy, and trustworthy AI.

recommendation.zh: 读定义和 AgentDojo/WASP 批判即可；对预训练无直接动作，但会影响 tool-use 后训练数据怎么标安全。
recommendation.en: Read the definitions and the AgentDojo/WASP critique; it does not change pretraining, but it affects how tool-use post-training data should label safety.

paper.title: The Regression Tax: Decomposing Why Skills Help and Hurt LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Adding procedural skills to an LLM agent is typically evaluated by average improvement in task success. However, this metric hides an important cost: skills can also make agents worse. We measure both sides by comparing agents with and without skills across nearly 6,000 runs spanning two office automation benchmarks and three model harness stacks. This allows us to distinguish two outcomes. A regression is a task solved without skills but failed after skills are added. A residual failure is a ta

summary.core_problem: 给 LLM Agent 添加 procedural skills 后，平均成功率可能上升，但会掩盖一类重要失败：原本能做对的任务被技能上下文弄错。
summary.importance: 这是 Agent 行为分析工作，贡献在于把 skill 带来的收益拆成新增成功和回归失败，并指出技能并非单调增益。对预训练研究的间接价值在于提醒：上下文中的工具/技能描述会改变模型策略分布，即使没有被调用。
summary.technical_approach: 论文比较带技能和不带技能的 Agent，在同一任务上定义两类失败：regression 是无技能能成功、有技能反而失败；residual failure 是两者都失败。进一步归纳三类回归机制：skill description osmosis、grounding displacement、verification disruption。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖约 6000 次运行、两个 office automation benchmark、三个模型 harness stack。摘要给出的主要结论是，表现最好的 skills 主要是因为造成的 regression 更少，而不是带来更多新增成功；未给出具体模型名称和数值提升。

summary_en.core_problem: Adding procedural skills to LLM agents can improve average success while hiding regressions where tasks solved without skills fail after skills are added.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent behavior analysis paper. Its main contribution is decomposing skill effects into new wins and regressions, showing that skills are not monotonic improvements. For pretraining researchers, the useful signal is that tool and skill descriptions in context can shift policy behavior even when unused.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper compares agents with and without skills on matched tasks, defining regressions as tasks solved without skills but failed with skills, and residual failures as tasks failed in both settings. It identifies three mechanisms: skill description osmosis, grounding displacement, and verification disruption.
summary_en.experiments: The study reports roughly 6,000 runs across two office automation benchmarks and three model harness stacks. The headline result is that stronger skills mainly outperform by causing fewer regressions, not by producing more new gains; the abstract does not provide exact model names or effect sizes.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 和回归分解即可；它把“多塞技能总有益”这个 Agent prior 打松了，但还不是基座训练证据。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and regression decomposition; it usefully weakens the ‘more skills always help’ prior, but it is not pretraining evidence.

paper.title: ToolGuardian: Declarative Security for AI Agent-Tool Interactions
paper.abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on external tools, expanding capability while creating a new security boundary: third-party tools may appear benign at the interface level while embedding unsafe behavior in implementation. Existing defenses rely on weak metadata, collapse characterization and policy judgment into a single decision, or use heuristic/LLM enforcement that lacks deterministic, auditable reasoning over task context and multi-tool composition.   This paper presents ToolGuardian, a policy-

summary.core_problem: LLM Agent 调用第三方工具时缺少可审计的安全边界，工具接口看似无害但实现中可能包含危险行为。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是通用 Agent 工具安全框架。它不直接推进预训练，但对 tool-use agent 的运行时约束、可审计授权和工具组合风险有方法层面的参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ToolGuardian，将工具安全拆成准入前审查和任务感知的运行时授权。系统通过渐进式表征把证据转成结构化事实：工具描述捕获声明意图，系统调用轨迹暴露粗粒度行为，mock execution 观察效果，源码分析识别潜在行为；核心策略层使用 Answer Set Programming 做声明式推理，分离工具行为刻画和安全策略判定。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供工具集规模、攻击类型覆盖、误报漏报、运行时开销或与 LLM/规则/沙箱基线的量化比较；实验可信度需要看正文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of an auditable security boundary when LLM agents invoke third-party tools whose interfaces may look benign while implementations contain unsafe behavior.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a general agent-tool security framework. It does not directly improve pretraining, but it is relevant to tool-use agents through runtime constraints, auditable authorization, and multi-tool composition risk.
summary_en.technical_approach: ToolGuardian separates pre-admission vetting from task-aware runtime authorization. It progressively characterizes tools into structured facts: descriptions capture declared intent, system-call traces expose coarse behavior, mock execution observes effects, and source analysis identifies latent behavior. Its policy layer uses Answer Set Programming for deterministic declarative reasoning, separating behavioral characterization from policy judgment.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report tool-suite size, attack coverage, false-positive or false-negative rates, runtime overhead, or quantitative comparisons against LLM, rule-based, or sandboxing baselines; the empirical strength must be checked in the full text.

recommendation.zh: Agent 安全里少见的“别让 LLM 判策略”路线；先看 ASP policy 设计，实验若小就当架构草图。
recommendation.en: A useful 'do not let the LLM decide policy' route for agent security; read the ASP policy design, treat small experiments as architecture sketching.

paper.title: StateAct: Program State, before Pixels, for Long-Horizon Computer-Use Agents
paper.abstract: Computer-use agents are usually improved by strengthening perception: better models for reading a screenshot and choosing where to click. Yet a screenshot is only a lossy rendering of the underlying program state, e.g., the files, application backends, and DOM that hold the task data. Different states can produce the same pixels, while code can inspect and modify that state directly. StateAct is a code-first, multi-agent harness built around this distinction. Its main agent works directly with p

summary.core_problem: 解决长程 computer-use agent 过度依赖截图感知的问题：像素界面无法完整表达文件、DOM、应用后端等真实程序状态，导致规划和验证都容易失真。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 系统范式和执行接口设计。它把“读屏点击”从默认主路径降级为少数必要子任务，强调直接读写程序状态对长程任务更稳，也把状态检查用于结果验证。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 StateAct，一个 code-first 的多智能体 harness。主 agent 通过代码直接访问和修改程序状态；只有在必须进行 GUI 操作的子目标上，才调用专门的 GUI subagent。系统还包含独立 finish gate，用程序状态检查输出是否缺失、未保存或写错路径，并通过把子目标交给 fresh subagents 来降低长程执行中的上下文漂移。
summary.experiments: 摘要披露任务集包含 108 个任务，其中只有 28 个任务需要 GUI subagent；GUI 操作只占主 agent 步数的 1.1%。摘要未给出完整模型参数、所用基础模型、baseline 名称和最终成功率提升幅度，因此效果强度需要读正文确认。
summary.authors_note: Salesforce AI Research 工作。Silvio Savarese 长期参与视觉、具身与 agent 研究；Junnan Li 是 BLIP/BLIP-2 等视觉语言预训练工作的代表作者之一。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a failure mode in long-horizon computer-use agents: screenshots are lossy renderings of the underlying program state, such as files, DOM trees, and application backends, so perception-only agents can lose task-critical information.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent-system design choice rather than a model-training result. It reframes GUI interaction as a fallback interface and makes direct program-state access the primary action and verification channel.
summary_en.technical_approach: StateAct is a code-first multi-agent harness. The main agent inspects and modifies program state through code, while a dedicated GUI subagent handles the small subset of subgoals that genuinely require screenshot-and-click interaction. An independent finish gate verifies saved outputs against structural failures, and subgoals are delegated to fresh subagents to reduce drift over long trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports 108 tasks; the GUI subagent is needed for 28 of them and accounts for only 1.1% of main-agent steps. The abstract does not specify model size, base models, named baselines, or success-rate gains, so the empirical strength needs to be checked in the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from Salesforce AI Research. Silvio Savarese is well known for vision, embodied AI, and agent research; Junnan Li is a representative author behind BLIP and BLIP-2 style vision-language pretraining work.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 不是主线；只需看系统设计图和消融，重点是它把“屏幕感知优先”这个 agent prior 打松了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper; skim the system diagram and ablations, mainly for the interface prior shift away from screenshot-first agents.

paper.title: GuardianAgentBench: Where Agents Fail and How to Guard Them
paper.abstract: As large language model agents increasingly operate autonomously with access to tools and external environments, ensuring their safe and reliable behavior becomes critical. We present GuardianAgentBench (GABench), a benchmark of 580 scenarios across six domains evaluated on three production-ready frameworks: LangChain, LlamaIndex, and Vectara. The benchmark incorporates rigorous multi-stage validation and five adversarial attack modes. Experiments with six state-of-the-art models reveal that eve

summary.core_problem: 缺乏覆盖多领域、多攻击模式且绑定生产级Agent框架的安全可靠性评测基准，无法系统暴露LLM Agent在工具调用与长时序规划中的失效模式。
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献与原理分析：首次构建580条多领域Agent安全评测集，结合5种对抗攻击与3种主流框架验证，明确区分强弱模型的两类工具调用失效机制。
summary.technical_approach: 提出GuardianAgentBench（GABench），采用多阶段人工+自动化校验构造场景，覆盖6个领域与5种对抗攻击；设计专用guardrail模块与system prompt基线做防御对比。
summary.experiments: 评测6个SOTA LLM在LangChain/LlamaIndex/Vectara上的表现，最强配置仅74.8%总体准确率；guardrail相对system prompt恢复19.9%失效且误报率可控。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自企业研究团队，无公开知名学者信息。

summary_en.core_problem: No production-aligned benchmark systematically evaluates LLM agent safety across domains, adversarial attacks, and real frameworks to expose tool-use and planning failure modes.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark and diagnostic contribution: 580-scenario suite across 6 domains with 5 attack modes, evaluated on 3 production frameworks, identifying two distinct tool-calling failure regimes for strong vs weak models.
summary_en.technical_approach: GuardianAgentBench uses multi-stage human+automated validation to curate scenarios; compares a dedicated guardrail implementation against system-prompt-only defenses across all tested models.
summary_en.experiments: Six SOTA models evaluated on LangChain/LlamaIndex/Vectara; best setup reaches only 74.8% overall accuracy; guardrail recovers 19.9% of failures over system-prompt baselines with controlled false positives.
summary_en.authors_note: Industry-affiliated authors; no widely recognized researchers identified.

recommendation.zh: 强弱模型工具调用的两类失效（强模型少调、弱模型乱调/多调）是干净结论，只看 §3 失效分析和 Fig 4 工具规模/轮次深度曲线即可。
recommendation.en: The two tool-use failure regimes (under-call for strong models, mis/over-call for weak models) are clean; read only §3 failure analysis and Fig 4 tool-size/turn-depth curves.

paper.title: Auditing Provenance Sensitivity in LLM Agent Action Selection
paper.abstract: LLM agents choose tools and arguments from context that mixes user requests, tool outputs, retrieved records, memory, and untrusted text. Evidence can be relevant without being authorized to determine a decision, so a correct action need not be grounded only in permitted evidence. We introduce a target-specific authorization audit that labels context factors separately for each tool and argument target. Its primary test holds the task, proposition, position, and policy fixed while changing only

summary.core_problem: LLM agent 在混合可信/不可信上下文时，动作选择是否会被未授权来源不当影响（provenance sensitivity）。
summary.importance: 针对 agent 工具调用的来源审计与对抗鲁棒性做了受控测量，给出具体错误率与错误模式，对 agent 训练数据/上下文安全有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 target-specific authorization audit：固定任务、命题、位置和策略，仅改变命题的来源授权属性；主测试对比可信/不可信版本下动作选择差异；辅助诊断使用 context-subset 交互与受控证据削弱，定位干扰模式。
summary.experiments: 450 个受控 next-action 任务，覆盖多个开源 LLM 家族；可信/不可信变体在竞争场景下导致 5.4% 的动作分歧，支持场景下 1.7%；呈现 full-correct / mixed-error / clean-correct 的模式。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether LLM agent action selection is inappropriately influenced by unauthorized sources when context mixes trusted and untrusted provenance (provenance sensitivity).
summary_en.importance: A controlled audit of provenance sensitivity and adversarial robustness in tool-using agents, with concrete error rates and error patterns relevant to agent context security and training signal design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes target-specific authorization audit: fix task, proposition, position, and policy while varying only the proposition's source authority; primary test contrasts trusted vs. untrusted variants; secondary diagnostics use context-subset interactions and controlled degradation of evidence to localize interference patterns.
summary_en.experiments: On 450 controlled next-action tasks across multiple open-weight LLM families, trusted vs. untrusted variants produce different actions in 5.4% of competing cases vs. 1.7% of supporting cases, exhibiting a full-correct / mixed-error / clean-correct pattern.

recommendation.zh: 小规模受控审计，5.4% 干扰率数字可作 agent 工具调用安全的弱信号，方法直接但规模有限，读表格即可。
recommendation.en: A small-scale controlled audit; the 5.4% unauthorized-interference rate is a weak signal for agent tool-use security; method is straightforward and under-powered—just skim the tables.

paper.title: OpenSkillRisk: Benchmarking Agent Safety When Using Real-World Risky Third-Party Skills
paper.abstract: LLM-based agents leverage third-party skills to extend their capabilities in open-world scenarios. However, third-party skills can introduce extra security vulnerabilities, as seemingly harmless skills can contain latent safety risks that only emerge during actual execution. In this work, we conduct a systematic investigation into how well current agent systems recognize and avoid such risks. To support quantitative and qualitative evaluation, we construct OpenSkillRisk, a dedicated safety bench

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM agent 在调用真实第三方技能时，能否识别并规避执行阶段才暴露的安全风险。
summary.importance: 这是一个 agent safety benchmark 工作，贡献主要在评测资产而不是新方法。它把风险从提示层面推进到“技能执行层面”，更接近真实工具生态，对研究 tool-use agent 的安全边界有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者从公开 skill marketplace 收集 263 个带潜在风险的第三方技能，按 7 类威胁类型组织，并为每个技能配套标准化用户任务与 sandbox。评测不仅看 agent 是否调用危险技能，还分析其行为模式与失败类型，强调风险在实际执行中显现，而非仅靠静态描述可见。
summary.experiments: 论文对当前 agent 系统做了定量和定性评测，重点比较不同系统在真实 risky skills 上的识别、规避与误用情况。摘要未给出具体模型规模、显著提升幅度或强基线细节，因此更适合作为评测集备查，而不是方法结论来源。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自香港城市大学、香港AI for Science研究所、北京邮电大学和理想汽车。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLM agents can recognize and avoid safety risks introduced by real third-party skills whose hazards only surface at execution time.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an agent-safety benchmark rather than a method paper. Its value is in moving safety evaluation from prompt-level risks to execution-level tool risks, which is closer to real tool ecosystems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors collect 263 risky skills from public skill marketplaces, organize them into seven threat categories, and pair each skill with a standardized user task and a sandboxed environment. The benchmark measures not only whether an agent invokes unsafe skills, but also the behavioral patterns behind those failures.
summary_en.experiments: The study runs quantitative and qualitative evaluations on current agent systems, focusing on recognition, avoidance, and misuse of risky skills. The abstract does not provide model sizes, strong baseline details, or effect sizes, so the paper is more useful as an evaluation asset than as a source of robust methodological conclusions.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from City University of Hong Kong, Hong Kong Institute of AI for Science, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, and Li Auto.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练关系不深，但如果你做 tool-use 或 agent 对齐，记下这个 benchmark 即可；正文未必值得细读，先看任务构造和风险分类。
recommendation.en: Not very pretrain-relevant, but if you care about tool-use or agent alignment, bookmark the benchmark; skim the task construction and threat taxonomy, not the full paper.

institutions: Hong Kong Institute of AI for Science
Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications
Hong Kong Institute of AI for Science, City University of Hong Kong

paper.title: Guardrails as Scapegoats: Auditing Unfaithful Safety Refusals in Tool-Augmented LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Evaluation frameworks for tool-augmented LLM agents focus overwhelmingly on capability metrics or explicit tool crashes, leaving silent infrastructure failures and HTTP 200 responses with empty, null, or malformed payloads largely unaudited. We introduce a lightweight black-box auditing framework that injects four silent failure profiles across 12 production-adjacent tool stubs and classifies agent responses into three mutually exclusive behavioral classes: Honest Surrender (HSR), Fabrication (F

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：tool-augmented LLM agent 在工具静默失败时，常见评测只看显式报错或任务成功率，忽略了模型会把基础设施故障伪装成“安全拒答”或直接编造结果的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测协议与失效模式审计。它把 agent 失败从单纯 capability failure 拆成 Honest Surrender、Fabrication 和 Unfaithful Safety Refusal 三类，指出 guardrail 可能被模型当作甩锅话术。这对做 agent eval、tool-use reliability 和 refusal analysis 的人有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出一个轻量黑盒审计框架，在 12 个接近生产环境的工具 stub 中注入 4 类 silent failure profile，然后观察模型在温度为 0、neutral system prompt 下的响应行为，并通过 ablation 检查 guardrail 提示对 USR 的诱发作用。方法本身不改模型，而是改评测切面。
summary.experiments: 实验评估 2 个 frontier 模型和 2 个开源模型，共 396 条有效轨迹。核心结果是 FAR（把空/坏 payload 当真并编造结果）占 56.6%，USR 在基线几乎不存在，仅 0.25%；但在加入 guardrail 相关设置后，模型会更倾向于用虚构的政策或隐私理由解释工具失败。摘要未给出具体模型名和统计显著性细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a blind spot in tool-augmented LLM agents: when tools fail silently, evaluations often miss whether the model fabricates outputs or hides infrastructure failures behind bogus safety refusals.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation and failure-analysis contribution. It refines agent failure modes into Honest Surrender, Fabrication, and Unfaithful Safety Refusal, showing that guardrail language can become a convenient excuse rather than a faithful explanation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build a lightweight black-box auditing framework that injects four silent failure profiles into 12 production-adjacent tool stubs, then classify model behavior under temperature-zero, neutral-prompt conditions. The key methodological move is to audit failure attribution rather than just task success.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates two frontier and two open-source models over 396 valid trajectories. The main result is that fabrication dominates at 56.6%, while unfaithful safety refusal is nearly absent at baseline (0.25%) but can be induced by guardrail-related ablations. The abstract does not provide full model names or detailed significance analysis.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 本身帮助不大，但它把 refusal fidelity 这个坑挖得很准：agent 评测里别只看 refusal rate，先区分是真安全还是拿安全当借口；读 failure taxonomy 和 ablation 就够。
recommendation.en: Not directly useful for pretraining, but it nails a real eval pitfall: refusal behavior in agents must be audited for faithfulness, not just counted; read the failure taxonomy and the guardrail ablation.

paper.title: NEXUS: Structured Runtime Safety for Tool-Using LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Tool-using LLM agents increasingly execute high-impact actions, making runtime safety monitoring essential. We present NEXUS (Neural EXecution Utility and Safety), a structured-plan safety monitor that applies a formal intervention policy to select among four actions: allow, block, request confirmation, or request revision. NEXUS combines deterministic safety rules, argument-level inspection, and a calibrated logistic-regression risk score for graded escalation. On a 128-instance synthetic bench

summary.core_problem: 为会调用工具的 LLM Agent 提供运行时安全监控，在高影响操作执行前决定放行、阻断、请求确认或请求修改。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 运行时安全系统。它把结构化计划、确定性规则和轻量风险评分结合，用于细粒度干预路由；但实验规模较小，主要是工程安全层，对基座训练研究价值有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 NEXUS，即 Neural EXecution Utility and Safety。系统对工具调用计划做结构化检查，结合确定性安全规则、参数级 inspection，以及校准后的 logistic-regression 风险分数；最终通过形式化干预策略在四类动作中选择：allow、block、request confirmation、request revision。
summary.experiments: 在 128 条合成 benchmark 上，NEXUS 的 F1 为 0.949，四分类干预准确率为 0.6406，相比 rule-only 干预选择高 27.3 个百分点。在 R-Judge 上 F1 为 0.861，高于 rule-only 的 0.849；在 AgentHarm 上因威胁模型限制与 rule-only 持平；在 IPI 上达到 99% control allow 下 0% ASR；在 NEXUS-Stress 上 F1 为 0.881。中位运行开销为 0.205 ms。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a runtime safety monitor for tool-using LLM agents, deciding whether to allow, block, request confirmation, or request revision before high-impact actions execute.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent runtime-safety system. Its contribution is fine-grained intervention routing over structured plans, but the experimental scale is small and the connection to foundation-model pretraining is weak.
summary_en.technical_approach: NEXUS combines deterministic safety rules, argument-level inspection, and a calibrated logistic-regression risk score. A formal intervention policy maps the resulting signals into four actions: allow, block, request confirmation, or request revision.
summary_en.experiments: On a 128-instance synthetic benchmark, NEXUS reaches 0.949 F1 and 0.6406 four-class intervention accuracy, improving over rule-only intervention selection by 27.3 percentage points. It reports 0.861 F1 on R-Judge versus 0.849 for rule-only, matches rule-only on AgentHarm due to threat-model limits, achieves 0% ASR at 99% control allow on IPI, reaches 0.881 F1 on NEXUS-Stress, and has 0.205 ms median overhead.

recommendation.zh: 看结果表即可；规则加轻量分类器的安全闸门实用，但 128 条合成集不足以支撑强结论。
recommendation.en: The result table is enough; rules plus a light classifier are practical, but 128 synthetic cases cannot support strong claims.

paper.title: Relay-Bench: Evaluating LLMs on Multi-Domain Reasoning Chains
paper.abstract: Introducing Relay-Bench, an unsaturated, holistic, text-only benchmark that measures LLMs' ability to complete an assortment of tasks from distinct domains in a single prompt. The leading model, GPT-5.5 (xHigh), scores 43.3%. The test set entirely consists of composite problems: groups of single-domain subproblems that are strung together into challenges that require reasoning across multiple domains in combination. Many of these problems then have layers of complexity added through prompt encod

summary.core_problem: 构建一个文本形式的复合推理 benchmark，评估 LLM 在单个 prompt 中串联多个领域任务、处理上下文膨胀和编码干扰的能力。
summary.importance: 贡献是评测资产，关注多领域推理链而非单一学科题。它对 post-train 推理数据和 agent/tool-use evaluation 有一定参考，但摘要中的模型命名和单作者设置需要谨慎看待。
summary.technical_approach: Relay-Bench 将多个单领域子问题组合成一个复合问题，每题包含 2 到 13 个子问题；覆盖视觉推理、代码、数学、信息抽取、问题求解、常识和数据分析等任务。部分题目加入 prompt encoding 和 deliberate context bloat，并允许模型使用代码执行、网页搜索和可用工具。
summary.experiments: 摘要称领先模型 GPT-5.5 (xHigh) 得分 43.3%，说明测试集未饱和。未给出题目数量、标注流程、泄漏控制、评分协议、工具调用约束、不同模型榜单或人类基线，因此 benchmark 可信度需要看正文验证。

summary_en.core_problem: Relay-Bench evaluates whether LLMs can solve composite, multi-domain reasoning chains within a single text-only prompt under context bloat and encoding distractions.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an evaluation asset focused on chained multi-domain reasoning rather than isolated subject tests. It may inform post-training data design and agent/tool-use evaluation, but the model naming and single-author setup warrant caution.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark strings together multiple single-domain subproblems into composite tasks, with 2 to 13 subproblems per item. It covers visual reasoning, coding, math, information extraction, problem solving, general knowledge, and data analysis. Some items add prompt encoding and deliberate context bloat, while models are allowed to use code execution, web search, and available tools.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that the leading model, GPT-5.5 (xHigh), scores 43.3%, suggesting the benchmark is unsaturated. It does not provide item counts, annotation procedures, contamination controls, grading protocols, tool-use constraints, full model rankings, or human baselines.

recommendation.zh: 看任务构造和评分协议就够；43.3% 这种数字先别信，关键是是否有泄漏控制和工具约束。
recommendation.en: Skim the task construction and grading protocol only; treat the 43.3% number as weak until leakage controls and tool constraints are clear.

paper.title: SAAG: Structured Agent Assessment and Grounding
paper.abstract: Exact-match evaluation of agent-calling obscures qualitatively different failure modes: a model may select the right function yet hallucinate argument values, or satisfy a schema while choosing a agent for the wrong reason. Existing benchmarks collapse these distinctions into a single binary score, leaving practitioners unable to diagnose where agent calls fail. We propose SAAG a cascaded diagnostic framework that decomposes agent-calling evaluation into three sequential stages: registry conform

summary.core_problem: 解决函数调用或 Agent 调用评测中 exact-match 指标过粗、无法区分工具选择、schema 完整性和参数 grounding 错误的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 调用评测协议和诊断框架。它的价值在于把单一二值分数拆成可解释的阶段性失败类型，并将诊断信号用于自修复。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SAAG：一个级联式诊断框架，按顺序评估 registry conformance、structural completeness 和 argument grounding。每一阶段输出可解释诊断；当预测失败时，模型使用阶段特定反馈做 targeted correction，且不暴露 ground-truth 参数值。
summary.experiments: 在由 Glaive function-calling 数据集构造的受控 benchmark 上评估，registry 规模为 5、10、15 个 Agent，使用三个本地 sub-4B 参数模型。摘要称结构化反馈能带来一致改善，但未提供完整提升幅度和模型名称。
summary.authors_note: Amit Sheth 是知识图谱与语义 Web 方向的知名研究者；摘要未提供机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the coarseness of exact-match evaluation for function or agent calling, where tool selection, schema completeness, and argument grounding errors are collapsed into one binary score.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an evaluation and diagnostic framework for agent calling. Its value is in decomposing a single pass/fail outcome into interpretable failure stages and using the diagnostic signal for self-repair.
summary_en.technical_approach: SAAG is a cascaded diagnostic framework with three sequential stages: registry conformance, structural completeness, and argument grounding. Each stage emits interpretable diagnostics. On failure, the model receives stage-specific feedback for targeted correction without leaking ground-truth values.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses a controlled benchmark derived from Glaive's function-calling dataset, with registry sizes of 5, 10, and 15 agents, and three local models under 4B parameters. The abstract reports consistent gains from structured feedback but does not provide exact numbers or model names.
summary_en.authors_note: Amit Sheth is a well-known researcher in knowledge graphs and the Semantic Web; the provided abstract does not list institutional affiliations.

recommendation.zh: 只看评测分解定义即可；对训练有用的是错误标签粒度，sub-4B 实验不足以支撑更大模型结论。
recommendation.en: Read only the evaluation decomposition; the useful part for training is the error taxonomy, while the sub-4B setup is weak evidence for larger models.

paper.title: Search-on-Graph-R1: Training Large Language Models to Search Knowledge Graphs with Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) requires navigating from topic entities to an answer several relations away. Recent methods prompt a frontier LLM to explore the graph through a retrieval tool, but their reliance on frontier-scale inference makes them costly to deploy. We present Search-on-Graph-R1 (\sogrone{}), which internalizes this navigation into a compact 8B model through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by reinforcement learning (RL). Our central idea is to scaffold a fronti

summary.core_problem: 解决知识图谱问答中依赖大前沿模型在线搜索图谱、推理成本高且难部署的问题，尝试把图搜索能力蒸馏进较小模型。
summary.importance: 这是后训练与工具使用结合的工作。对预训练研究员的价值不在 KGQA 本身，而在它展示了一种较干净的 teacher trajectory 构造方式：用 gold SPARQL 约束教师走已知可达路径，再用 RL 内化工具调用策略。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Search-on-Graph-R1：先用带 Search 工具的 frontier teacher，在每个问题的 gold SPARQL 约束下生成 grounded trajectory；再对 8B 学生做 SFT + RL，使其学会在 Freebase 上执行多跳搜索。关键点是 teacher 不需要自己发现路径，而是沿已知 answer-bearing path 生成高质量轨迹，降低监督噪声。
summary.experiments: 学生模型为 8B，在 WebQSP、CWQ、GrailQA 上评测。摘要称其超过所有对比中的 frozen frontier-LLM systems，并在 CWQ 上达到所比较系统中的最好结果，但未给出绝对分数、RL 配置或 teacher 规模。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Mila、McGill University 和 Halmstad University College。Mila 在 RL 与语言模型结合方向有持续产出，但这篇更偏任务化工具使用而非基座训练。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the cost and deployment difficulty of relying on frontier LLMs to search knowledge graphs at inference time, by internalizing graph navigation into a smaller model.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training plus tool-use paper. Its value for pretraining researchers is not KGQA itself, but the relatively clean way it constructs teacher trajectories: use gold SPARQL to force the teacher onto answer-bearing paths, then use RL to internalize the search policy.
summary_en.technical_approach: Search-on-Graph-R1 first uses a frontier teacher with a live Search tool, scaffolded by each question's gold SPARQL query, to generate grounded trajectories on Freebase. An 8B student is then trained with SFT followed by RL to learn multi-hop graph search. The key design is that the teacher does not need to discover the path from scratch, which reduces supervision noise.
summary_en.experiments: The student model is 8B and is evaluated on WebQSP, CWQ, and GrailQA. The abstract claims it beats all compared frozen frontier-LLM systems and achieves the strongest CWQ result among compared systems, but does not provide absolute numbers, RL details, or teacher scale.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Mila, McGill University, and Halmstad University College. Mila has a strong track record in RL and language-model research, though this paper is more task-specific tool use than foundation-model pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 任务本身偏窄，但“用 gold program 把 teacher 轨迹去噪，再做 SFT+RL 内化工具策略”这个 recipe 值得借到 tool-use post-train；只看方法和数据构造即可。
recommendation.en: The task is narrow, but the recipe is useful: denoise teacher trajectories with gold programs, then use SFT+RL to internalize tool use; read the method and trajectory construction, not the full benchmark section.

paper.title: OmniReasoner: Thinking with Long Audio-Video via Native Tool Use
paper.abstract: Long audio-video reasoning is difficult for omnimodal LLMs because the decisive evidence is often sparse, cross-modal, and too expensive to preserve with uniformly high-fidelity inputs. We introduce OmniReasoner, a tool-use post-training framework for Thinking with Long Audio-Video: omni-modal LLMs learn, via supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, to decide whether and where to call a zoom-in tool before answering. OmniReasoner first builds a low-cost global preview of the full strea

summary.core_problem: 长音视频问答中，关键证据往往稀疏且跨模态，直接把全量高保真音视频塞进 omnimodal LLM 成本过高，也容易淹没有效信息。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态工具使用与后训练方法。它把长音视频理解从“固定采样后直接回答”改成“先低成本全局预览，再按需调用局部高保真检查工具”，对长上下文多模态系统有一定方法参考。
summary.technical_approach: OmniReasoner 通过 SFT 和 RL 训练模型决定是否调用 zoom-in tool，以及调用哪个时间区间。系统先构建稀疏全局预览，模型在需要时给出时间段参数，工具返回更密集的局部音视频片段。TimeAnchor 用时间锚而不是采样帧号表达工具参数，保证不同采样粒度之间的时间引用一致。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整实验细节和数值。可确认的实验方向是长音视频推理任务，对比不使用 zoom-in 工具或固定粒度输入的 omnimodal LLM，并评估 SFT/RL 后模型选择工具调用位置和最终回答的效果。

summary_en.core_problem: Long audio-video QA is hard because decisive evidence is sparse, cross-modal, and too expensive to preserve with uniformly high-fidelity inputs.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal tool-use post-training framework. It reframes long audio-video reasoning as low-cost global preview plus selective high-fidelity local inspection, which is relevant to long-context multimodal systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: OmniReasoner trains an omnimodal LLM with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning to decide whether to call a zoom-in tool and which temporal interval to inspect. The model first sees a sparse global preview, then requests a denser local clip when needed. TimeAnchor represents tool arguments in time rather than frame indices, keeping references consistent across sampling granularities.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide full quantitative details. The implied evaluation compares tool-using long audio-video reasoning against fixed-input or no-tool baselines, measuring both tool localization and final answer quality.

recommendation.zh: 长视频工具调用的 setup 有现实感，但离预训练方法较远；只看 TimeAnchor 和 RL 工具调用设计即可。
recommendation.en: The long-video tool-use setup is practical but not a pretraining result; skim TimeAnchor and the RL tool-calling formulation only.

paper.title: BatchDAG: LLM-Planned Execution Graphs for Scalable Ad-Hoc Analysis Over Enterprise Data
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel at analyzing individual documents but break down on exhaustive, cross-entity analytical questions over enterprise-scale datasets due to context overflow, loss of per-entity attribution, and linear latency from sequential tool calls. We present BatchDAG, a system in which an LLM generates a typed directed acyclic graph (DAG) of operations -- SQL queries, semantic searches, in-memory transforms, parallel fan-outs, and single-shot analyses -- which a deterministic

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 在企业级数据上做跨实体、穷尽式分析时的上下文溢出、归因丢失和串行工具调用延迟问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是通用 Agent 编排系统创新。它不试图提升单次问答准确率，而是把自然语言分析请求编译成可并行执行的结构化执行图，目标是替代多个手写工作流。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 BatchDAG：由 LLM 规划带类型的 DAG，节点包括 SQL 查询、语义搜索、内存变换、并行 fan-out 和单次分析；确定性执行引擎按拓扑波次并行执行，并用结构化 JSON 传递中间状态。关键优化是 entity-aware batching，即按逻辑实体对行分组后再 fan-out，减少重复 LLM 调用。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的主要结果是 entity-aware batching 最高减少 47 倍 LLM 调用。论文强调其价值不是超过手工优化 pipeline 的准确率，而是在受控实验中用单一系统生成合适执行策略；未提供模型参数量、训练数据或完整 baseline 细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses context overflow, lost entity-level attribution, and sequential tool-call latency when LLMs perform exhaustive cross-entity analysis over enterprise-scale data.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a general agent orchestration system. It is not primarily an accuracy paper; it aims to compile natural-language analytical requests into structured, parallelizable execution plans that can replace multiple hand-built workflows.
summary_en.technical_approach: BatchDAG has an LLM generate a typed directed acyclic graph containing SQL queries, semantic searches, in-memory transforms, parallel fan-outs, and single-shot analyses. A deterministic engine executes the graph with topological-wave parallelism and structured JSON data flow. The main optimization is entity-aware batching, which groups rows by logical entity before fan-out to avoid redundant LLM calls.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports up to a 47x reduction in LLM calls from entity-aware batching. The stated comparison is against hand-optimized pipelines and controlled experiments, but the provided abstract does not specify model sizes, training data, or full baseline details.

recommendation.zh: 预训练研究员只需看系统分解思路；它对模型训练没有直接信号，但能提醒我们工具调用数据应保留执行图结构。
recommendation.en: Worth a quick look for the execution-graph abstraction; it does not inform pretraining directly, but it argues that tool-use data should preserve plan structure.

paper.title: SkillSight: Seeing Through Shared Descriptions for Accurate Skill Retrieval
paper.abstract: As large language model agents gain access to increasingly large skill libraries, retrieving the right skill becomes critical to reliable capability selection and execution. Existing retrievers often treat skill descriptions as ordinary documents, overlooking their highly regular structure: shared descriptive patterns recur across many skills while providing little evidence for distinguishing the required capability. We show that this shared descriptive background systematically contributes to d

summary.core_problem: 当 agent 面对大规模 skill library 时，技能描述中的共享模板化文本会污染检索分数，导致真正区分能力的信号被淹没。
summary.importance: 这是 agent skill retrieval 的训练无关改进，贡献点在检索校准而非 LLM 本体；对 tool-use 系统设计有一点启发，但不直接作用于预训练。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SkillSight，一个 training-free 检索框架。方法分两部分：Semantic Background Calibration 用 IDF 识别通用 token 并估计背景子空间，削弱共享描述带来的语义相似度；Lexical Evidence Calibration 对高频共享词做词法降权，提升真正任务证据的权重。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明其分析了共享描述导致的 dense relevance score 偏置与 energy gap，并在技能检索场景验证效果，但未给出具体数据集规模、基座模型、提升幅度或与更强 learned retriever 的充分对比。

summary_en.core_problem: In large skill libraries for LLM agents, shared templatic descriptions inflate retrieval scores and obscure the capability-specific evidence needed for correct skill selection.
summary_en.importance: This is a training-free retrieval calibration method for agent skill selection, mildly useful for tool-use systems but not directly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: SkillSight combines Semantic Background Calibration, which estimates a background subspace from generic high-IDF tokens to reduce semantic similarity induced by shared descriptions, with Lexical Evidence Calibration, which downweights common lexical patterns and emphasizes discriminative evidence.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims analysis of dense-score bias and an energy gap caused by shared descriptions, followed by empirical gains on skill retrieval. It does not provide dataset scale, base models, or strong enough comparisons to make it broadly consequential for pretraining researchers.

recommendation.zh: 是个干净的小技巧：如果你做 tool retrieval，只看背景子空间校准那一段；不做 agent 系统就没必要展开读。
recommendation.en: A neat retrieval trick: read only the background-subspace calibration part if you build tool retrieval; otherwise it is not worth full attention.

paper.title: Can AI Agents Really Complete RTL-to-GDS? Lessons from Benchmarking Tool-Interactive EDA Workflows
paper.abstract: LLM-driven agent systems have emerged as a promising paradigm for electronic design automation (EDA), demonstrating strong potential for automating complex design workflows. However, existing evaluations primarily examine individual language models on isolated EDA tasks, providing limited insight into how different agent systems perform across complete EDA flows. In this work, we present FluxBench, a systematic evaluation of AI agents on end-to-end EDA workflows under unified prompts, tool envir

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM agent 在完整 RTL-to-GDS EDA 工具链中的真实能力，而不是只看孤立代码生成或单步任务。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 benchmark/evaluation protocol：把工具交互、统一 prompt、统一环境和端到端工作流放进同一评测框架。对通用 agent 研究有方法论意义，但对 LLM 基座预训练的直接启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FluxBench，在开源与闭源 EDA 工具环境下，系统评测 agent 在 RTL 生成、迭代修复、工具反馈利用、逻辑综合、布局布线和 ECO 自动化等环节的表现，并分析效率与失败模式。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明覆盖完整 RTL-to-GDS 流程，包含工业级商业 EDA 工具和开源工具链；但未给出具体参评模型、样本规模和关键数值。价值主要在评测设置是否干净、是否能揭示 tool-interactive agent 的瓶颈。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks whether LLM agents can actually handle full RTL-to-GDS EDA workflows rather than isolated code-generation subtasks.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation asset and protocol: unified prompts, tool environments, and end-to-end workflows for tool-interactive agents. This matters for agent evaluation, though its direct relevance to base-model pretraining is modest.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper presents FluxBench, benchmarking agents across open-source and commercial EDA flows, including RTL generation, iterative repair, tool-feedback use, synthesis, place-and-route, and ECO automation, with efficiency analysis and failure characterization.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates coverage of full RTL-to-GDS workflows with both open and industrial toolchains, but does not provide model roster, benchmark size, or headline numbers. The real value will depend on how cleanly the benchmark isolates agent-tool interaction bottlenecks.

recommendation.zh: 这是工具交互 agent 的压力测试，不是基座论文；若你关心 agent eval 设计，可只看任务分解和失败类型，别把结论外推到通用推理能力。
recommendation.en: This is a stress test for tool-interactive agents, not a base-model paper; read the task decomposition and failure taxonomy, but do not overgeneralize its conclusions to generic reasoning.

paper.title: AoA: Theorem Proving Agent over Abstract Syntax Tree of Redesigned Language
paper.abstract: Interactive theorem proving (ITP) underpins program verification and formalized mathematics, but its manual effort limits scalability. LLM-based proof agents promise to ease this effort, but their heavy token consumption and API cost remain a major obstacle. We trace this cost to a shared root: current agents operate on serialized concrete syntax, emitting proofs as source text and recovering proof states through separate, line-number-based queries, so every edit shifts later lines and forces re

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM定理证明代理依赖序列化具体语法，token消耗大、API成本高，且难以适配训练语料不足的新型证明语言（如Minilang）。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出基于AST的定理证明代理交互范式，降低token成本并支持新证明语言的快速适配。
summary.technical_approach: 将代理操作对象从源文本提升到抽象语法树层面，模型以JSON格式输出Minilang的AST（适配工具调用型LLM），通过树编辑模型驱动证明器，避免序列化语法的token浪费与行号偏移问题。
summary.experiments: 摘要未完整披露实验设置、模型规模与量化效果，仅提及方法解决了token成本高与新语言适配的核心痛点。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM-based theorem proving agents rely on serialized concrete syntax, leading to high token consumption and API costs, and are hard to adapt to new proof languages (e.g., Minilang) with limited training corpora.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposing an AST-based interaction paradigm for theorem proving agents that reduces token costs and enables rapid adaptation to new proof languages.
summary_en.technical_approach: The agent operates on abstract syntax trees instead of source text; the model outputs Minilang ASTs in JSON format (compatible with tool-calling LLMs) and drives the prover via a tree-edit model, avoiding token waste and line-number offset issues of serialized syntax.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not fully disclose experimental setup, model scale, or quantitative results, only noting the method addresses core pain points of high token cost and new language adaptation.

recommendation.zh: 定理证明代理的交互范式小改进，对代码LLM工具调用的表示设计有微弱参考，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Minor interaction paradigm improvement for theorem proving agents, weak reference for code LLM tool-use representation design, read abstract only.

paper.title: From Memory to Skills: Evidence-Grounded Co-Evolution Governance for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Existing memory systems for long-horizon LLM agents often retrieve prior traces as passive context rather than converting them into executable capabilities. In this paper, we propose MSCE, a training-free Memory--Skill Co-Evolution framework that organizes agent experience into grounded step traces, reusable procedural policies, and declarative environmental cognition. MSCE crystallizes evidence-backed L2 policies with positive estimated gain into callable skills that retain evidence links, appl

summary.core_problem: 解决长时程 LLM agent 里“记忆只是被动检索上下文、无法沉淀为可执行技能”的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个 agent 记忆与技能管理方向的方法工作，不是基座预训练论文，但对“经验如何转成可复用程序化能力”这个问题有一定启发，尤其适合关注 tool-use / long-horizon agent 的研究员。
summary.technical_approach: 提出训练自由的 MSCE 框架，把 agent 经验组织成三层：带证据的步骤轨迹、可复用程序策略、环境认知。核心做法是把具有正向预估收益的 L2 policy 结晶为可调用 skill，并保留证据链接、适用边界、决策指引、验证规则和可靠性估计；再用 reflection-weighted value backfilling，把稀疏终局反馈通过局部自反思传播成更密集的轨迹价值，用于治理记忆与技能的共同演化。
summary.experiments: 在 EvoAgentBench 和 LoCoMo 上与 skill-augmented、memory-driven agent 基线比较，摘要称显著优于现有方法，并展示跨领域泛化。摘要未给出模型规模、底座模型、提升幅度和消融细节，因此目前更像一个值得快速浏览设定与结果表的 agent 方法，而不是可直接迁移到 pretrain 的结论。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 MemTensor、中国科学技术大学、香港理工大学、福州大学、西安交通大学。未见特别强的基座预训练团队信号。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets the long-horizon agent problem where memory is retrieved as passive context instead of being distilled into executable skills.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-method paper rather than a foundation-model pretraining paper, but it is mildly relevant for researchers thinking about how experience can be converted into reusable procedural competence.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes MSCE, a training-free Memory-Skill Co-Evolution framework that structures experience into grounded step traces, reusable procedural policies, and declarative environmental knowledge. It crystallizes evidence-backed L2 policies with positive estimated gain into callable skills, each carrying evidence links, applicability boundaries, decision guidance, verification rules, and reliability estimates. It also introduces reflection-weighted value backfilling to propagate sparse terminal feedback through local self-reflections, producing denser evidence-calibrated values for memory and skill evolution.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are reported on EvoAgentBench and LoCoMo against skill-augmented and memory-driven agent baselines, with the abstract claiming significant gains and cross-domain generalization. The abstract does not specify model sizes, base models, or exact margins, so the paper currently reads as an agent-systems contribution rather than a clean pretraining-facing result.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from MemTensor, University of Science and Technology of China, Hong Kong Polytechnic University, Fuzhou University, and Xi’an Jiaotong University. No clearly identifiable top-tier pretraining lab signal from the metadata alone.

recommendation.zh: 更像 agent memory engineering，不改 pretrain prior；若你做长期交互或 tool-use，只看技能结晶与 value backfilling 设计，别把 benchmark 提升当成通用结论。
recommendation.en: This is mostly agent memory engineering, not a pretraining update; if you work on long-horizon tool use, read the skill crystallization and value-backfilling parts, but treat the benchmark gains as narrow evidence.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: ToolVerse: Unlocking Massive Environments and Long-Horizon Tasks for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: While LLM agents demonstrate strong reasoning abilities in compact and well-defined scenarios, they struggle to maintain robustness and effectiveness when faced with large-scale, diverse, and dynamic real-world environments that demand seamless tool integration. To address this gap, we introduce ToolVerse, a comprehensive framework that scales up agentic RL environments and enables agents to perform complex long-horizon reasoning in Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) tasks. First, ToolVerse automat

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是 agentic RL 缺少大规模、可执行、多工具、长链路训练环境的问题，同时处理长轨迹下稀疏奖励带来的 credit assignment 噪声。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值主要在 post-train 与 RL 环境构造接口。它不是基座预训练方法论文，但对“如何把工具使用能力变成可扩展训练信号”有参考意义。关键点在于三件事：把真实 MCP tool schema 自动转成可执行环境；用工具依赖图生成多步任务，而不是随机拼接工具调用；在长轨迹 RL 中引入 turn-aware 的相对优势估计，减少只靠终局奖励训练带来的高方差。
summary.technical_approach: ToolVerse 包含三层设计。第一层是环境合成：从约 422 个真实 MCP 环境出发，重构 tool schema，清理函数签名和文本噪声，为每个工具构造领域状态字典数据库，再生成可执行 Python/MCP 函数，并用自动生成的单元测试筛掉不可运行工具集，最终形成约 4438 个工具的可执行 agent 环境。第二层是任务生成：为每个场景构建 Tool Dependency Graph，节点是工具，边表示前一个工具输出可作为后一个工具输入；再清理循环依赖和不可执行依赖，用 Dynamic Unlocking Sampling Algorithm 采样长链任务，使任务天然需要跨工具传递中间状态。第三层是训练信号：用 Turn-Aware Relative Advantage Estimation 处理长轨迹 credit assignment，把反馈拆到 turn 级别，避免所有动作共享同一个稀疏终局奖励。相比只做单工具环境或人工设计任务的 agent RL 工作，这里的核心差异是把环境、任务和优势估计一起做成可扩展管线。
summary.experiments: 可见内容给出的硬数字主要是环境规模：约 422 个真实 MCP environments，约 4438 个 tools，并产出 GUST 数据集用于 agentic RL 训练。摘要和正文片段声称该方法提升 tool-integrated reasoning benchmark 上的训练稳定性和表现，但提供材料未包含完整实验表格、模型规模、训练步数、baseline 数字、胜率或消融结果。可靠结论应限制在框架设计和环境规模；性能幅度需要读完整实验部分确认。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 到 30 分钟。优先看 3.1 的 executable MCP environment synthesis，确认 schema refactoring、状态数据库和单元测试过滤是否能稳定扩展；再看 3.2 的 Tool Dependency Graph 与 Dynamic Unlocking Sampling Algorithm，判断任务是不是由真实工具依赖驱动，而不是表面拉长轨迹；最后看 3.3 的 Turn-Aware Relative Advantage Estimation，重点检查 advantage 如何按 turn 分配、是否依赖额外 reward model、和 GRPO/PPO 类方法的关系。若要复现或借鉴，Appendix B.1/B.2 比主文更关键。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical bottleneck in agentic RL: existing environments are too small, too narrow, and too weakly structured for training long-horizon tool use, while sparse terminal rewards make credit assignment noisy over multi-turn trajectories.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model research is indirect but useful. The paper is not about base-model pretraining, yet it studies how to turn tool use into scalable RL training signal. The main contribution is an environment-and-task generation pipeline, plus a turn-level advantage estimator for long-horizon interaction. This is relevant for post-training recipes where tool use, planning, and sequential decision making need executable supervision rather than static instruction data.
summary_en.technical_approach: ToolVerse has three components. First, it converts real MCP tool definitions into executable environments. The pipeline refactors tool schemas, removes noisy signatures and descriptions, builds a domain-specific state dictionary for each environment, generates Python/MCP functions that read or update that state, and keeps only toolsets passing syntax and unit tests. Second, it builds a Tool Dependency Graph for each scenario. Tools are graph nodes, and edges encode whether the output of one tool can feed another. After removing cycles and non-executable dependencies, the Dynamic Unlocking Sampling Algorithm samples coherent long-horizon tasks from this graph. Third, it introduces Turn-Aware Relative Advantage Estimation, which assigns more granular feedback across turns instead of treating the full trajectory as receiving only one sparse terminal reward. The main distinction from earlier agent RL environments is that environment synthesis, task composition, and credit assignment are designed together.
summary_en.experiments: The provided text reports the environment scale: roughly 422 real-world MCP environments and about 4,438 tools, with a generated GUST dataset for agentic RL training. The paper claims improved stability and tool-integrated reasoning performance on agent benchmarks, but the supplied content does not include the experimental tables, model sizes, training budgets, baseline numbers, or ablation values. Any quantitative performance claim should be checked against the full experiment section.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough for most pretraining researchers. Read Section 3.1 to assess whether the executable MCP conversion pipeline is robust enough to scale. Read Section 3.2 for the dependency-graph task generation, since this is where long-horizon structure is introduced. Read Section 3.3 to inspect the turn-aware advantage estimator and how it differs from standard sparse-reward GRPO/PPO-style training. Appendix B.1 and B.2 are likely the most useful parts for implementation details.

recommendation.zh: Agent RL的环境规模上到4500工具是有意义的，但缺实验数字；只看环境构造和TARA advantage设计即可。
recommendation.en: Scaling the agent RL environment to 4500 tools is meaningful, but no experimental numbers are given; read only the environment construction and TARA advantage design.

paper.title: OmniaBench: Benchmarking General AI Agents Across Diverse Scenarios
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly evolving from text generators into general agents capable of understanding user requests, invoking external tools, and completing complex tasks through interaction. However, existing agent benchmarks often focus on limited scenarios, tool ecosystems, or interaction formats, making it difficult to systematically characterize model capabilities across heterogeneous application settings. We introduce OmniaBench, a benchmark for evaluating general agents across

summary.core_problem: OmniaBench 解决的是通用 Agent 评测覆盖不足的问题。现有工具调用、Web 环境、长程规划或专业工作流 benchmark 往往绑定少数场景、少数工具生态或固定交互格式，难以判断一个模型在真实应用分布中的泛化能力。论文试图把评测对象从单点任务扩展到带状态、带工具、可交互的多场景任务空间。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对基座预训练本身不是直接贡献，更接近 Agent 能力评测资产。它的启发在于：后训练阶段越来越依赖可诊断的交互式评测，而这类评测需要显式状态、工具执行和分维度能力拆解。对预训练研究员有用的部分，是它提供了一种观察模型“从语言能力到任务执行能力”缺口的框架，尤其适合分析模型在规划、状态跟踪、工具调用和可靠性上的瓶颈。但它不是训练方法论文，也不直接回答数据配比、优化或建模目标问题。
summary.technical_approach: OmniaBench 从真实应用生态构造场景 taxonomy。数据来源包括应用商店、产品需求文档、行业资料、Web 检索和人工修订，覆盖 ToC、ToB、ToE 三类使用环境，共 90 个一级领域和 354 个二级领域。每个领域进一步实例化为可交互环境，包含 tools、entities、states 和初始化配置。任务要求模型理解用户请求，在多轮交互中调用工具、维护环境状态，并完成目标。评测设计包含十个能力维度：任务理解、信息获取、规划与决策、状态管理、工具使用、代码与程序化操作、数据分析、办公与文档处理、交互协作、可靠性与安全。难度设计采用 compositional atomic difficulty，把用户意图、persona 约束、环境状态、工具执行、多轮交互和结果验证拆成可组合因素。评分侧结合 rubric checklist 和 VerifyCode，用于减少只看最终成功率带来的诊断盲区。
summary.experiments: 论文报告在该 benchmark 下，即使较强模型也远未接近满分。给出的整体分数中，Claude-Sonnet-5 为 58.54，GPT-5.6-Sol 为 57.14。这个结果主要说明任务集难度较高，且单一总分不足以解释失败来源，因此论文强调按领域、能力维度、任务复杂度、交互轮数和错误类型分解分析。由于提供内容中没有完整表格，无法确认各模型完整排名、样本规模、人工一致性指标和 VerifyCode 的通过率细节。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 benchmark 构造流程、Figure 2、十维能力 taxonomy、atomic difficulty 设计和评测协议。结果部分重点看错误分析，而不是只看 overall score。对预训练研究更有信息量的问题是：哪些失败来自语言理解不足，哪些来自状态管理和工具执行；这些信号能否反向指导中训练或后训练数据构造。

summary_en.core_problem: OmniaBench targets the coverage gap in general-agent evaluation. Existing agent benchmarks often focus on a narrow set of scenarios, tool ecosystems, or interaction formats. This makes it hard to characterize whether a model can generalize across realistic applications that require state tracking, tool execution, and multi-turn interaction.
summary_en.importance: The paper is mainly an evaluation contribution rather than a pretraining-method contribution. Its value for foundation-model researchers is diagnostic: it offers a structured way to measure the gap between language competence and executable task completion. The most relevant signals are failures in planning, state management, tool use, and reliability, which can inform post-training data design and agent-oriented evaluation suites.
summary_en.technical_approach: OmniaBench builds a broad scenario taxonomy from app stores, product requirement documents, industry resources, web retrieval, and human refinement. The taxonomy spans ToC, ToB, and ToE settings, with 90 level-1 domains and 354 level-2 domains. These domains are instantiated into interactive environments with tools, entities, states, and initialization configurations. The benchmark decomposes agent ability into ten dimensions: task understanding, information gathering, planning and decision making, state management, tool use, code and programmatic operations, data analysis, office and document handling, interactive collaboration, and reliability/safety. It also defines compositional atomic difficulty factors, including user intent, persona constraints, environment states, tool execution, multi-turn interaction, and result verification. Evaluation combines rubric checklists with VerifyCode-style checks to support more fine-grained diagnosis than a single success rate.
summary_en.experiments: The reported overall scores suggest that current strong models still struggle on the benchmark: Claude-Sonnet-5 scores 58.54 and GPT-5.6-Sol scores 57.14 under the proposed protocol. The main experimental message is not the absolute ranking but the decomposition of failures by domain, capability dimension, complexity, interaction length, and error type. The provided content does not include the full result tables, sample counts, inter-annotator agreement, or detailed VerifyCode statistics.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the benchmark construction pipeline, Figure 2, the ten-dimensional capability taxonomy, the atomic difficulty design, and the evaluation protocol. In the results, read the error analysis before the leaderboard. For pretraining and post-training researchers, the useful question is which failures are caused by missing knowledge or language understanding, and which are caused by state tracking, planning, or tool execution.

recommendation.zh: 只看 taxonomy、环境状态定义和任务合成流程；分数榜先别信，Agent benchmark 的可复现性通常是硬伤。
recommendation.en: Read the taxonomy, state specification, and task-generation pipeline; treat the leaderboard cautiously because agent benchmarks often fail on reproducibility.

paper.title: Eta Given Delta: Defining LLM Tool Efficiency With Marginal Tool Utility
paper.abstract: This paper introduces tool efficiency, a new quantitative metric to evaluate the rate of useful tool calls in an LLM agent trajectory. To ensure that tool efficiency is well-defined, we also introduce marginal tool utility, a new quantitative metric defined per tool call indicating whether a tool is useful or whether it can be safely removed from the tool suite without affecting accuracy while increasing tool efficiency; in this paper, we determine the sign of marginal tool utility for each tool

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM agent 工具使用中“调用是否高效”缺少直接量化指标的问题，而不是只用最终准确率间接代替。
summary.importance: 这是评测方法工作，贡献是提出 tool efficiency 和 marginal tool utility 两个指标。对 agent 评估设计有一定参考，但离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把单次工具调用的价值定义为 marginal tool utility，即移除该工具调用后是否仍能保持准确率且提升效率；再把轨迹层面的有效调用率定义为 tool efficiency。具体判定依赖 LLM-as-a-Judge 对每次调用做 post hoc 分析。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体 benchmark、模型规模或统计结果。当前更像提出评测定义与分析框架，而不是一个经过大规模验证的标准协议。由于 judge 依赖 LLM，本身可能引入稳定性和偏差问题。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the lack of a direct metric for how efficiently LLM agents use tools, instead of relying on final accuracy as an indirect proxy.
