summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-method paper. Its contribution is the definition of tool efficiency and marginal tool utility. It may be useful for agent evaluation design, but it is fairly far from core pretraining concerns.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper defines marginal tool utility at the level of each tool call: whether removing that call would preserve accuracy while improving efficiency. Tool efficiency is then the trajectory-level rate of useful tool calls. The sign of marginal utility is determined post hoc using an LLM-as-a-Judge setup.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide benchmark details, model scales, or quantitative validation. At this stage it reads more like a metric proposal than a broadly validated evaluation standard. The reliance on LLM judges may itself introduce variance and bias.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做 tool-use eval，可以知道这个指标长什么样；但它离 pretrain 很远，而且 judge 依赖太重，先看定义别急着采纳。
recommendation.en: Useful to know if you design tool-use evals, but it is far from pretraining and heavily judge-dependent; read the metric definition, not the whole paper.

paper.title: SEED: Self-Evolving On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly trained as interactive agents for long-horizon tasks involving multi-turn interaction, tool use, and environment feedback. Outcome-based reinforcement learning (RL) provides a practical optimization paradigm, but its sparse trajectory-level rewards offer limited guidance on intermediate decisions, leaving a supervision gap between episode-level outcomes and token-level policy learning. We propose SEED (SElf-Evolving On-Policy Distillation), a self-evolving

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 agentic RL 中一个很具体的监督缺口：环境通常只给 trajectory-level 的 outcome reward，但策略学习发生在 token/action 级别，长时程交互里很难把“最后成没成功”有效分配到中间每一步。论文想解决的不是再造一个更强的 RL 算法，而是把 on-policy 轨迹在事后暴露出的结构化信息——哪些观察关键、哪些工具调用有用、哪里偏离了有效流程——转成可训练的密集监督，并且让这套监督随着策略演化而持续更新。
summary.importance: 它属于 post-train/agent RL 范畴，不是预训练论文，但对基座研究有两个启发。第一，长时程 agent 学习里，单靠 outcome reward 的信息密度太低，必须引入更细粒度的训练信号；这和预训练里讨论 token-level loss 是否足够表达复杂能力是同一类问题。第二，论文把“hindsight skill”做成参数化蒸馏信号，而不是部署时外挂 memory 或 reflection prompt，这对 pretrain↔posttrain 接口有参考意义：很多看似 inference-time 的策略知识，最终都可以回流成模型内部参数。贡献量级上，它更像一个训练框架设计，而不是基础算法突破；价值主要在于把 on-policy distillation、trajectory hindsight 和 self-improving agent 这三件事接到一起。
summary.technical_approach:
方法名 SEED，核心是 self-evolving on-policy distillation。整体分两阶段。

第一阶段是 hindsight-skill SFT。作者先让模型学会分析完整轨迹，并把轨迹压缩成自然语言 skill，内容包括可复用 workflow、关键观察、失败规避规则等。这里 skill 不是给用户看的总结，而是训练期的 privileged signal。这样做的目的，是把原本分散在长轨迹里的后见之明提炼成一个更紧凑、可条件化的表示。

第二阶段是自演化的 OPD 训练循环。当前策略先在环境中按 on-policy 方式采样轨迹；同一个模型随后扮演 analyzer，对这些已完成轨迹生成 hindsight skills。接着，作者固定采样得到的原始动作序列，不重新搜索动作，而是分别在“普通上下文”和“skill 增强上下文”下对这些已发生动作重新打分。两者的概率差异被解释为 skill 对行为的偏好修正，并转成 token-level 的 distillation 信号。最终优化目标是 outcome-based RL loss 与这个 OPD loss 的联合。

这里有几个设计点值得注意。其一，为什么强调 on-policy：因为 skill 的价值依赖当前策略会访问哪些状态、会犯哪些错，离线静态 skill 库很快就会失配。其二，为什么用同一个模型同时做 actor 和 analyzer：不是为了省模型，而是为了让“会做事”和“会复盘”一起进化，避免 teacher 固定不动。其三，为什么不把 skill 直接放到推理时：作者希望把 hindsight 变成参数内化的能力，而不是额外的 inference-time memory 机制。

从方法关系上看，它和 verbal reflection、episodic memory、self-distillation 有亲缘性，但区别在于：SEED 不把反思文本当外部记忆长期挂在上下文里，而是把 skill 仅作为训练期 privileged context，通过概率重打分产生密集监督；也不同于纯 outcome RL，因为它提供了 decision-level credit signal；也不同于传统 teacher-student distillation，因为 teacher 不是外部更强模型，而是同一策略在更有 hindsight 的条件下的“增强视角”。
summary.experiments:
论文在 embodied interaction、web navigation、search-based 等长时程 agent 环境上做评测，目标是验证 SEED 是否能比只用 outcome reward 的 RL 学得更稳、更快。虽然给出的全文片段没有完整表格数字，但从实验设计可以看出作者主要验证四件事。

第一，联合 OPD 后，任务成功率相对纯 RL 基线有稳定提升，说明 hindsight skill 确实提供了额外可学习信号，而不是只增加训练噪声。第二，这种提升不是来自 inference-time 提示增强，因为 skill 只在训练时使用，测试时不需要额外 memory 或 prompt。第三，自演化机制优于静态 skill 或一次性蒸馏：随着策略变强，后续生成的 skills 也更贴近当前分布，能继续提供有效监督。第四，token-level 重打分比只在轨迹级别做偏好学习更有效，因为它把 trajectory hindsight 下沉到了具体决策位置。

如果看消融，最值得关注的通常是：去掉 skill analyzer 只做 RL；使用固定 analyzer 或离线 skill 数据；把 skill 当作测试时外部提示而不是训练期蒸馏；以及只做 sequence-level distillation 不做 token-level probability shift。论文的主张成立，依赖的是这几项对照能把收益来源拆清楚。

从研究判断上，这类结果更应关注增益是否跨环境稳定、训练成本增加多少、以及 analyzer 生成的 skill 质量是否会在策略早期阶段成为瓶颈。若全文表格里有 sample efficiency、success rate 曲线、以及不同 horizon 任务上的收益差异，这些比单点平均分更值得看。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction，明确作者要补的是 sparse outcome reward 与 token-level policy learning 之间的监督缺口。然后直接看方法图和 OPD 目标定义，弄清楚 skill 是如何从 completed trajectory 生成、又如何通过重打分变成密集监督的。这里是整篇工作的核心。

实验部分建议优先看三类内容：主结果表，确认相对纯 RL 和其他 hindsight/reflective baselines 的提升；消融，确认 self-evolving、on-policy、token-level distillation 各自的必要性；案例分析，看看生成的 skills 到底是泛化的 workflow 还是只是对单条轨迹的复述。预计 35-45 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读。

更值得深挖的问题有两个。第一，skill 生成质量是否会受模型当前能力上限约束，导致早期自举不稳。第二，OPD 的概率差分是否会引入偏置：skill-augmented context 下更高概率的动作，未必总是因果上更优，只是更符合 analyzer 的语言解释。若要复现，这两点需要重点盯。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a specific supervision gap in agentic reinforcement learning. In long-horizon interactive environments, the agent often receives only sparse trajectory-level outcome rewards, while policy learning happens at the token or action level. That makes credit assignment extremely weak: a final success or failure says little about which intermediate observations, tool calls, or local decisions should be reinforced. The paper does not propose a new RL optimizer. Instead, it asks how to convert hindsight information from completed on-policy trajectories into dense training signals that can guide token-level policy updates.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training and agent-RL paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is relevant for foundation-model researchers for two reasons. First, it highlights a general issue: coarse end-level supervision is often too weak for learning complex sequential behavior, so denser internal training signals matter. Second, it shows a concrete way to turn what would otherwise be inference-time reflection or memory into parametric supervision. That is useful for thinking about the pretrain-posttrain interface: some forms of external reasoning support can be distilled back into the model rather than carried forever as prompts or memory. The contribution is best understood as a training framework that combines hindsight skill extraction, on-policy data, and self-distillation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SEED stands for Self-Evolving On-Policy Distillation. The framework has two stages.

Stage one is hindsight-skill supervised fine-tuning. The model is trained to analyze completed trajectories and produce natural-language skills that summarize reusable workflows, decisive observations, and failure-avoidance rules. These skills are not meant as user-facing summaries. They are privileged training-time signals that compress trajectory-level hindsight into a compact, conditionable representation.

Stage two is the self-evolving OPD loop. The current policy collects trajectories on-policy in the environment. The same model then acts as an analyzer and generates hindsight skills for those completed trajectories. Next, the sampled action sequence is kept fixed. The model re-scores those already-taken actions under two contexts: the original context and a skill-augmented context. The probability shift between the two is treated as a dense token-level distillation signal that indicates how hindsight would have changed the policy’s preference over the observed decisions. Training then jointly optimizes the standard outcome-based RL objective and this OPD objective.

Three design choices are central. First, the method is on-policy because useful hindsight depends on the states and failure modes induced by the current policy; a static offline skill bank would quickly become mismatched. Second, the actor and analyzer are the same evolving model, so decision-making ability and trajectory-analysis ability improve together instead of relying on a frozen teacher. Third, skills are used only during training, not at inference time, because the goal is to internalize hindsight into the policy parameters rather than depend on external memory or extra prompts.

Relative to nearby work, SEED is related to verbal reflection, episodic memory, and self-distillation, but it differs in a precise way. It does not keep reflection text as persistent inference-time context. It uses hindsight text only as privileged context during training to produce dense supervision. It also differs from pure outcome-based RL by providing decision-level credit signals, and from standard teacher-student distillation by using the same policy under a more informed hindsight-conditioned view rather than an external stronger teacher.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper evaluates SEED on long-horizon agent settings including embodied interaction, web navigation, and search-based tasks. The main empirical question is whether hindsight-skill distillation improves learning beyond outcome-only RL. The full excerpt provided here does not include the complete result tables, but the experimental structure makes the intended claims clear.

First, adding OPD on top of outcome-based RL improves task success over pure RL baselines, suggesting that hindsight skills provide learnable supervision rather than just extra noise. Second, the gains are not due to inference-time prompting, because the skills are used only during training and are not required at test time. Third, the self-evolving loop outperforms static skills or one-shot distillation, which supports the claim that hindsight supervision should track the current policy distribution. Fourth, token-level re-scoring is more effective than staying at the trajectory level, because it pushes hindsight information down to concrete decision points.

The most informative ablations are likely the following: removing the skill analyzer and keeping only RL, replacing the evolving analyzer with a fixed analyzer or offline skill dataset, using skills as test-time prompts instead of training-time distillation, and replacing token-level probability-shift supervision with sequence-level distillation only. Those comparisons are what establish where the gains actually come from.

From a research perspective, the most important things to inspect are whether the gains are stable across environments, how much extra training cost the analyzer loop adds, and whether skill quality becomes a bottleneck early in training when the policy is still weak. If the paper reports sample-efficiency curves, success-rate trajectories, and breakdowns by task horizon, those are more informative than a single averaged score.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with the introduction to pin down the exact problem: sparse trajectory-level rewards are too coarse for token-level policy learning. Then go straight to the method figure and the OPD objective. The key is to understand how a completed trajectory is turned into a hindsight skill, and how that skill is converted into dense supervision through action re-scoring. That is the conceptual center of the paper.

In the experiments, prioritize three things: the main result table against pure RL and other hindsight or reflection baselines, the ablations that isolate self-evolving, on-policy, and token-level components, and the qualitative examples of generated skills. Those examples matter because they reveal whether the model is extracting reusable workflows or merely paraphrasing individual trajectories. A useful skim should take about 35-45 minutes.

Two deeper questions are worth tracking. One is whether skill generation quality is limited by the current policy’s own capability, which could make early self-bootstrapping unstable. The other is whether the probability shift under skill-augmented context introduces bias: an action can become more likely because it matches the analyzer’s verbal explanation, not necessarily because it is causally better. Those are the main points to watch if you plan to reproduce or extend the method.

recommendation.zh: 值得看训练环路而不是结果表；若 on-policy 自解释不塌缩，内部 Agent RL 可复现 skill 蒸馏消融。
recommendation.en: Read the training loop more than the score table; if on-policy self-analysis does not collapse, the skill-distillation ablation is worth reproducing internally.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: Multi-Head Latent Control: A Unified Interface for LLM Agent Decision Making
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as agents, but reliable agentic behavior requires more than next-token prediction. At inference time, it is preferred that an agent can decide whether to proceed with its current reasoning, defer to a stronger model, request additional information, invoke external tools, or abstain under the given setup. Existing approaches address these decisions through prompt-level routing, external orchestration, or task-specific fine-tuning, which primarily re

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM agent 在推理过程中何时继续、何时转交更强模型、何时检索、调用工具或拒答的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是 agent 控制接口上的方法创新：不再只依赖 prompt routing、外部 orchestrator 或任务微调，而是从冻结模型的隐藏状态轨迹中读取部署时控制信号。对预训练研究员的价值在于观察 hidden states 是否携带可用的能力、自信和需求信息。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Multi-Head Latent Control，在冻结 LLM 或 VLM 上增加轻量控制头，读取生成过程中的 hidden-state trajectories。Capability Head 判断当前模型是否能解题或应 defer 到更强 collaborator；摘要还提到其他头用于 retrieval、工具调用或 abstention 等部署控制。核心是 latent-side control，而不是输入侧规则或 prompt 模板。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数、训练数据、任务集合和量化结果。可确认的实验方向包括在冻结 LLM/VLM 上训练多个控制头，并比较其对 agent 决策的预测能力与传统 prompt-level routing 或外部 orchestration。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Alberta。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how an LLM agent should decide at inference time whether to continue reasoning, defer to a stronger model, retrieve information, call tools, or abstain.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a method-level innovation for agent control: extracting deployment-time control signals from hidden-state trajectories of a frozen model, instead of relying only on prompt routing, external orchestration, or task-specific fine-tuning. For pretraining researchers, the interesting question is whether hidden states already encode usable capability and uncertainty signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: Multi-Head Latent Control adds lightweight heads on top of a frozen LLM or VLM and reads hidden-state trajectories during generation. A Capability Head predicts whether the current model can solve an instance or should defer to a stronger collaborator; other heads are intended for retrieval, tool use, or abstention-style control decisions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, or quantitative improvements. The empirical setup appears to train control heads over frozen LLM/VLM representations and compare their decision quality against prompt-level routing or external orchestration baselines.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the University of Alberta.

recommendation.zh: 读 hidden trajectory 设计和 control-head 训练即可；若结果干净，它给 latent confidence probing 提供了比 prompt routing 更稳的接口。
recommendation.en: Read the hidden-trajectory and control-head setup; if the results are clean, it is a better latent probing interface than prompt routing.

paper.title: ToolAnchor: Anchoring Counterfactual Context to Boost Agentic Tool-use Capability
paper.abstract: Tool-augmented large language model agents excel at long-horizon tasks, yet they are typically post-trained on fixed toolsets. When tasks demand new tools, these agents struggle to incorporate them effectively, and retraining from scratch is often impractical. We identify the core obstacle in such toolset expansion problem as behavioral inertia: the tendency of agents to fall back on familiar tools and established reasoning patterns despite having access to new ones. We demonstrate that injectin

summary.core_problem: 经过agentic RL后训练的工具增强LLM Agent，在新增工具扩展场景下存在行为惯性：策略收敛后会默认复用熟悉的旧工具和固化推理模式，即便新工具可用也不会主动尝试，导致直接RL探索时奖励稀疏、效率极低，而从零重训的成本过高，仅靠模型原有泛化能力无法解决该问题。
summary.importance: 该工作明确识别了Agent策略收敛后能力扩展的具体失败模式，给出了低成本注入新工具能力的实操流程，属于Agent后训练方向的实用方法，对基座预训练的直接启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出三阶段ToolAnchor框架破解行为惯性：第一阶段为反事实锚点假设，用多个异构教师模型审计学生模型的失败轨迹，定位关键决策轮次，生成可将轨迹导向成功的替代思考-动作对，重点覆盖未正确调用新工具的节点；第二阶段为锚点验证，让学生模型从修改后的锚定上下文重新rollout，仅保留同时满足任务级成功、锚点本身对轨迹转向有实质作用的样本，过滤教师的错误提案；第三阶段为锚点内化，先用验证通过的轨迹做agentic SFT让模型吸收新行为，再用少量agentic RL将新行为与原有策略对齐，避免直接RL的探索低效问题。
summary.experiments: 在GAIA通用助理、BrowseComp文本搜索、VDR-Bench视觉搜索三个基准上测试，基础工具集包含网页搜索、浏览器、Python解释器、学术搜索、文件解析器，新增视觉类工具（图像描述、边界框提取、以图搜图）。ToolAnchor不仅让模型有效掌握了新视觉工具的使用，还小幅提升了原有工具集场景下的推理和调用准确率，效果优于直接RL、零样本工具泛化两类基线。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第3章的行为惯性动机分析、锚点验证环节的筛选标准设计，具体实验细分和消融可跳过，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Tool-augmented LLM agents post-trained with agentic RL exhibit behavioral inertia when adapting to expanded toolsets: after policy convergence, agents default to familiar tools and established reasoning patterns even when new tools are available, leading to sparse rewards and extremely low efficiency when applying direct RL fine-tuning. Full retraining is prohibitively costly, and zero-shot tool generalization alone cannot resolve this bottleneck.
summary_en.importance: This work identifies a concrete failure mode for continual agent capability expansion after policy convergence, and provides a practical recipe for bootstrapping new tool use at low cost. It is primarily relevant to agent post-training, with limited direct implications for base LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: ToolAnchor uses a three-stage pipeline to break behavioral inertia. First, in the counterfactual anchor hypothesis stage, diverse teacher models audit failed student rollouts to locate key decision rounds, generating alternative thought-action pairs that can redirect trajectories toward success, with a focus on rounds where newly added tools were incorrectly ignored. Second, in the anchor verification stage, the student model rolls out from the modified anchored context; only anchors that satisfy both task-level success and measurable anchor-level utility are retained, filtering out invalid teacher proposals. Third, in the anchor internalization stage, verified trajectories are used for agentic SFT to let the model absorb new behaviors, followed by a small phase of agentic RL to align new behaviors with the agent's existing policy, avoiding the low exploration efficiency of direct RL.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on GAIA (general AI assistance), BrowseComp (textual web search), and VDR-Bench (visual search). The base toolset includes web search, browser, Python interpreter, scholar search, and file parser; new visual tools (image descriptor, bounding box extractor, reverse image search) are added for the expansion task. ToolAnchor not only enables effective adoption of the new visual tools, but also slightly improves reasoning and tool invocation accuracy on tasks that only require the original toolset, outperforming direct RL and zero-shot tool generalization baselines.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 3 for the behavioral inertia motivation study and anchor verification filter design; detailed experimental breakdowns and ablations can be skipped for most pretraining researchers. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 可读失败轨迹分析和 rollout 验证部分；“行为惯性”是有用诊断，收益别和新工具描述增强混在一起看。
recommendation.en: Read the failed-trajectory analysis and rollout verification; behavioral inertia is a useful diagnosis, but separate it from gains due to richer tool descriptions.

paper.title: Set-shifting Behavioral Test for Harnessed Agents
paper.abstract: What happens to an LLM agent's tool choice when the reliable tool silently changes within an ongoing session? We borrow set-shifting from cognitive psychology to study how well agents adapt to hidden reliability shifts. Our benchmark mounts tool-skill libraries with redundancies, where many tools solve the same task but differ in hidden reliability. In our evaluation framework, a branched schedule shifts the reliable tool group at hidden boundaries and pairs every shift with a no-shift control.

summary.core_problem: 评测 agent 在会话中工具可靠性悄然变化时，是否能像 set-shifting 一样及时调整工具选择，而不是固化在早期形成的调用惯性里。
summary.importance: 这是一个 agent 评测工作，不直接服务于基座预训练，但对 tool-use agent 的行为诊断有一定新意：它不只看任务是否完成，而是看在隐藏分布切换下，策略是否能重新分配工具调用。
summary.technical_approach: 作者借用认知心理学中的 set-shifting 概念，构造带冗余工具库的 benchmark：多个工具都能完成任务，但隐藏可靠性不同；在分支式日程中，可靠工具组会在会话中途切换，并配对 no-shift 对照。论文定义 set-shifting accuracy，衡量每个 post-shift 窗口都路由到目标工具组的联合概率，并在开源 agent harness 中测试开源模型。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示，agent 往往在每个边界后几轮内收敛到少数重复 routine，工具调用份额集中在少数离散值；不同模型在同一组 routine 上表现出不同失败模式。实验更像行为剖面而非能力上限测试。未见与预训练直接相关的模型或数据分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLM agents can adapt their tool choice when hidden tool reliability changes mid-session, rather than getting stuck in early routines.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-evaluation paper, not a foundation-model pretraining contribution. Its value is the behavioral diagnostic: it measures adaptation under hidden distribution shifts instead of only end-task success.
summary_en.technical_approach: Borrowing the notion of set-shifting from cognitive psychology, the benchmark builds redundant tool libraries where multiple tools solve the same task but differ in hidden reliability. A branched schedule changes the reliable tool group at hidden boundaries and pairs each shift with a no-shift control. The main metric is set-shifting accuracy, defined over post-shift routing windows.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that agents quickly settle into a small recurring routine after each boundary, with tool-call shares concentrating on a few discrete values. Different open-weight models exhibit distinct failure modes over the same routines. The setup is more diagnostic than capability-maximizing.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做 tool-use agent eval，可以记下这个“隐藏可靠性切换”设定；否则和基座研究距离较远，看 metric 定义即可，不必读正文。
recommendation.en: If you work on tool-use agent evaluation, keep the hidden-reliability-shift setup; otherwise this is far from core foundation-model work and the metric definition is enough.

paper.title: Compaction as Epistemic Failure: How Agentic LLM Tools Fabricate Confirmed Results from Killed Processes
paper.abstract: Agentic LLM coding tools compress long session histories into compaction summaries that subsequent sessions inherit as ground truth. This paper documents a failure mode in Claude Code where partial standard output from timed-out commands (exit code 143) is recorded in compaction summaries as confirmed results, propagating false positives across sessions and model versions without re-verification. The underlying mechanism is a conflation of observation and persistence, where information that appe

summary.core_problem: 指出 agentic LLM 编程工具在压缩长会话历史时，可能把被杀死进程的部分输出错误写成已确认结果，并在后续会话中传播。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 可靠性失败模式分析。它不涉及基座训练，但对长上下文压缩、工具执行记录、agent memory 和自动化科研/编程流程的可信性有直接警示。
summary.technical_approach: 论文以 Claude Code 为案例，分析 compaction summary 如何把 timed-out command 的部分 stdout，即 exit code 143 的未完成进程输出，记录成后续会话继承的事实。核心机制是混淆了“终端观察到的信息”和“持久化存储中确认完成的信息”。
summary.experiments: 摘要描述的是案例式故障记录，而非大规模 benchmark。关键现象是 false positives 会跨 session 和 model version 传播，且后续 agent 可能不重新验证这些继承结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper identifies a failure mode in agentic LLM coding tools where compaction summaries turn partial output from killed processes into confirmed results that persist across sessions.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent reliability failure analysis. It does not concern base-model training, but it is relevant to long-session compaction, tool-execution logging, agent memory, and trustworthy automated coding or scientific workflows.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using Claude Code as the case study, it analyzes how partial stdout from timed-out commands with exit code 143 can be written into compaction summaries as factual results. The key mechanism is a conflation between observed terminal text and durable, verified execution artifacts.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract describes a documented failure case rather than a large benchmark. The central observation is that false positives can propagate across sessions and model versions without re-verification.

recommendation.zh: 值得记住这个 failure mode；长会话压缩若不区分 observation 和 durable state，会污染 agent 记忆。
recommendation.en: Remember this failure mode: session compaction that blurs observation and durable state can poison agent memory.

paper.title: SPyCE: Skill-Policy Co-evolution for Multimodal Agents
paper.abstract: Multimodal agents that think with images iteratively manipulate visual evidence and invoke tools across many steps. Existing reinforcement learning methods reduce trajectories to scalar rewards, forcing the policy to discover reusable tool-use patterns from scratch on every new task; memory-based alternatives retain past experience, yet they rely on test-time retrieval, without updating the policy to absorb reusable patterns from that experience. Our key insight is that multimodal reasoning traj

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态 agent 在长轨迹工具使用中，如何把 RL 产生的经验沉淀为可复用技能，而不是只依赖标量奖励或测试时检索的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个 agent 训练范式问题，不是单纯任务调参。贡献点在于把轨迹蒸馏成分层技能库，并让技能与策略共同演化，试图改善多步视觉推理中的样本效率与可迁移性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SPyCE 框架，将训练轨迹提炼为两层技能：局部执行技能负责视觉操作与工具调用，高层工作流技能负责多步编排。训练过程中，策略不仅接收 RL 信号，还持续从技能库吸收可复用模式；技能库也随新轨迹更新，形成 co-evolution。核心想法介于 policy learning、trajectory distillation 和 memory augmentation 之间，但重点是把经验写回参数化策略，而不是停留在外部记忆。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，实验重点应是多模态、多步工具使用场景下，与纯 RL 和基于记忆/检索的方法比较鲁棒性与泛化。摘要未给出模型规模、数据规模和具体 benchmark，也未给出提升幅度，因此目前更适合作为训练思路参考，而不是直接采信结论。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自浙江大学与北京邮电大学。未见可确认的业界头部实验室背景或该方向的代表性作者信息。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles how multimodal agents can internalize reusable tool-use patterns from RL trajectories, instead of relying only on scalar rewards or test-time retrieval.
summary_en.importance: This is a training-paradigm question for agents rather than a task-specific tweak. The contribution is a hierarchical skill library that co-evolves with the policy, aiming to improve sample efficiency and transfer in long-horizon visual reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: SPyCE distills trajectories into two levels of skills: execution skills for local visual operations and tool calls, and workflow skills for high-level orchestration. During training, the policy is updated not only from RL rewards but also from the evolving skill library; the library itself is refreshed from new trajectories. The idea sits between policy learning, trajectory distillation, and memory augmentation, with the key move being to write experience back into the policy rather than leaving it in an external store.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the evaluation likely compares against pure RL and memory/retrieval-based baselines on multimodal multi-step tool-use tasks. The abstract does not provide model size, data scale, benchmark names, or effect sizes, so the paper is more useful as a training idea than as a settled empirical result.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Zhejiang University and Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications. No clearly identifiable top-lab affiliation or widely known author signal can be confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 本身帮助有限，但“把轨迹蒸馏成可写回策略的技能”这个接口值得记一下；先看方法图和 ablation，别急着信泛化结论。
recommendation.en: Limited direct value for pretraining, but the idea of distilling trajectories into skills that are written back into the policy is worth noting; read the method figure and ablations first, not the headline generalization claim.

institutions: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications

paper.title: Self-Improvements in Modern Agentic Systems: A Survey
paper.abstract: Self-improving autonomous agents are moving from research prototypes to deployed systems. The primary goal is controllable evolution, or adaptation, from experience with minimal or even no human input. This survey frames modern self-improving agents as adaptive systems that convert experience into accumulated capability gains. We offer a system-level framework that represents a modern agent as a configuration coupling a foundation model with an operational scaffold of prompts, memory, tools, and

summary.core_problem: 梳理现代 agentic systems 如何从自身经验中产生可控更新，实现 prompts、memory、tools、control logic 或模型参数层面的自我改进。
summary.importance: 贡献是综述和分类框架，不是新方法或新实验。它对理解 agent scaffold 与 foundation model 的接口有帮助，但对基座预训练的直接增益有限。
summary.technical_approach: 把现代 agent 表示为 foundation model 与 prompts、memory、tools、control logic 等 operational scaffold 的组合，并将 self-improvement 形式化为 self-induced update operator；按更新目标和驱动信号组织已有工作。
summary.experiments: 作为 survey，摘要未报告新模型训练、数据集构建或统一 benchmark 结果；附带维护 self-improving agents 相关工作的 GitHub 列表。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Jilin University、KAUST、University of Alberta、The Swiss AI Lab IDSIA/USI/SUPSI 等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The survey reviews how modern agentic systems convert experience into controlled updates to prompts, memory, tools, control logic, or model parameters.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a taxonomy and system-level framing rather than a new method or experiment. It is useful for understanding the interface between foundation models and agent scaffolds, but has limited direct value for base-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper models an agent as a configuration coupling a foundation model with an operational scaffold of prompts, memory, tools, and control logic, and formalizes self-improvement as a self-induced update operator. Prior work is organized by update target and learning signal.
summary_en.experiments: As a survey, it does not report new model training, datasets, or benchmark results in the abstract. It also maintains a GitHub list of self-improving agent papers.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Jilin University, KAUST, University of Alberta, and The Swiss AI Lab IDSIA/USI/SUPSI, among others.

recommendation.zh: 作为 agent self-improvement 索引留存即可；没有新实验，读图表比读正文划算。
recommendation.en: Keep it as an index for agent self-improvement; there are no new experiments, so tables and taxonomy are enough.

institutions: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology
King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)

paper.title: SAFETY SENTRY: Context-Aware Human Intervention via EXECUTE-ASK-REFUSE Routing
paper.abstract: LLM agents act on real-world environments through tool calls, and a single misjudged action can cause irreversible harm. The standard safeguard is a guard model that labels each proposed action as safe or unsafe, but this binary view conflates two distinct decisions: whether the action is harmful in itself, and whether it is appropriate given the user's context. It also operates at the granularity of action categories rather than individual instances, producing routine interruptions that erode a

summary.core_problem: LLM agent 调用工具时，传统二分类安全守卫无法区分“动作本身有害”和“在当前上下文中是否合适”，容易造成误拦或漏拦。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent safety 方法改进。它把工具调用安全从 safe/unsafe 标签改成 EXECUTE、ASK、REFUSE 三路决策，更贴近真实部署中的风险分级与人工介入策略。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Safety Sentry，一个轻量级 guard model。推理时通过一次 decoding call 输出三路路由结果，并用单一 decoding-time threshold 调整风险偏好，使同一 checkpoint 能适配不同部署场景而不需要重新训练。
summary.experiments: 摘要称该方法优于多种开源权重模型和闭源前沿模型，但未给出具体模型规模、数据集规模、评测集构成和提升幅度。关键实验应关注三路路由相对二分类 guard 的误拒、漏拒和 ASK 频率。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses safety routing for LLM agents, where binary guardrails fail to separate intrinsically harmful actions from actions that are inappropriate only under a specific user context.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-safety method contribution. It reframes tool-call safety as a three-way routing problem over EXECUTE, ASK, and REFUSE, which better matches deployment-time tradeoffs between autonomy and human intervention.
summary_en.technical_approach: Safety Sentry is a lightweight guard model whose inference is reduced to a single decoding call. A decoding-time threshold lets one fixed checkpoint move across different risk-tolerance regimes without retraining.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports gains over a broad set of open-weight and closed frontier models, but does not provide model sizes, dataset details, or effect sizes. The useful experimental signal is likely in the tradeoff between false refusals, missed refusals, and ASK frequency.

recommendation.zh: 预训练侧不用细读；看三路路由定义即可，安全信号设计比具体 guard 模型更有参考价值。
recommendation.en: No need to read deeply for pretraining; the useful part is the three-way routing formulation, not the guard model itself.

paper.title: CAVA: Canonical Action Verification and Attestation for Runtime Governance of Agentic AI Systems
paper.abstract: Agentic AI systems increasingly act through heterogeneous runtimes: local coding hooks, SDK tools, browser automation, managed-agent traces, API gateways, and workflow engines. A single operational act such as publishing code, changing identity state, moving money, or exporting data may therefore be represented by many incompatible runtime records. This makes a basic governance question difficult to answer: what action was actually approved, what evidence binds the approval to execution, and can

summary.core_problem: 解决 agent 在不同 runtime 中执行同一操作时记录格式不一致，导致审批、执行和第三方验证难以绑定的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent runtime 治理和可审计语义层。它对 LLM 基座训练没有直接帮助，但对高权限 agent 的安全部署、审计和责任追踪有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 CAVA，即 Canonical Action Verification and Attestation，将本地代码 hook、SDK 工具、浏览器自动化、API gateway、workflow engine 等异构活动转换成 canonical runtime action object。CAVA 被放在 Proof-Carrying Agent Actions 之下，负责定义被治理流程引用的稳定 action identity。
summary.experiments: 摘要主要描述形式化和系统设计，没有提供模型实验、benchmark、吞吐、误报率或真实部署规模结果。重点是 canonical action identity、审批与执行证据绑定、后续独立验证可复现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the problem that the same operational act by an agent can appear as incompatible records across heterogeneous runtimes, making approval, execution, and independent verification hard to bind.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a runtime governance and auditability layer for agentic systems. It is not directly relevant to LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to deployment safety for high-privilege agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: CAVA converts heterogeneous activity from local hooks, SDK tools, browser automation, API gateways, and workflow engines into canonical runtime action objects. It is positioned below Proof-Carrying Agent Actions, defining the stable action identity that governance processes can review and attest.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract emphasizes formalization and system design rather than empirical model evaluation. No benchmark, model scale, latency, or deployment-scale results are visible from the provided text.

recommendation.zh: 这是 agent 治理语义层，不是模型论文；只需知道 canonical action 这个接口设想。
recommendation.en: This is an agent governance semantics layer, not a model paper; just note the canonical-action interface idea.

paper.title: Policy-Conditioned Constrained Decoding for Column-Level Access Control in Text-to-SQL
paper.abstract: Text-to-SQL is increasingly deployed across trust boundaries between data providers and users. Such deployment must balance three competing requirements: policy compliance, answer coverage, and bounded cost. Existing approaches typically decide refusal based on which columns a query mentions and enforce it stochastically. Whether a query is compliant, however, depends not only on which columns appear but on how they are used, and stochastic enforcement cannot deterministically rule out violation

summary.core_problem: 在 Text-to-SQL 系统中，按列级访问控制策略约束生成过程，避免模型生成违反权限的 SQL。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 constrained decoding / 安全执行方法。它把访问策略从后验拒答或随机约束前移到 token-level decoding mask，能给数据库工具调用和 agent 安全提供一个干净的工程范式；但它仍是 Text-to-SQL 专项系统工作，对基座预训练启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 论文形式化 column-use policy，把列的语义使用区分为 output、filter condition、aggregation argument。PCC-SQL 将这些角色与 SQL grammar production 对齐，在解码时维护语法状态，并对每个 token 施加 logits mask，从而在单次解码中排除受支持 SQL 片段内的列级违规。
summary.experiments: 在三个 benchmark 和三个开源模型上评测。摘要明确报告 PCC-SQL 达到 0% Leakage Rate；未给出 answer coverage、执行准确率、延迟或成本的完整数值。
summary.authors_note: Waseda University.

summary_en.core_problem: The paper enforces column-level access-control policies during Text-to-SQL generation so that the model cannot emit policy-violating SQL.
summary_en.importance: This is a constrained-decoding and secure tool-use contribution. It moves policy enforcement from post-hoc refusal or stochastic checks into token-level masking, which is relevant to database agents and controlled generation, but only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method formalizes column-use policies over semantic roles: output, filter condition, and aggregation argument. PCC-SQL aligns these roles with SQL grammar productions tracked by the decoder and applies a per-token logits mask to eliminate violations within the supported SQL fragment in a single decoding pass.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on three benchmarks and three open-source models. The abstract reports 0% Leakage Rate, while full details on answer coverage, execution accuracy, latency, and cost are not provided in the prompt.
summary_en.authors_note: Waseda University.

recommendation.zh: 预训练侧不用细读；做 tool-use 安全的人看 grammar-mask 设计即可，0% leakage 要看覆盖率代价。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining read; tool-use safety people should inspect the grammar-mask design and verify the coverage cost behind 0% leakage.

paper.title: PalmClaw: A Native On-Device Agent Framework for Mobile Phones
paper.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have moved beyond generating responses to executing multi-step tasks by calling tools, observing the results, and iteratively deciding the next action. Most agent systems run on desktops or servers, which support tool use and task automation. Mobile devices are also important agent environments because they are widely accessible and contain users' data, sensors, and daily-use applications. Existing mobile agents mainly operate smartphones through graphical user

summary.core_problem: 解决移动端 LLM agent 过度依赖 GUI 点击、滑动、输入导致执行链条长、边界不清、难以直接调用设备能力的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是通用 agent 执行框架与系统工程。它把手机从被远程 GUI 操控的对象，改成可在设备内原生运行 agent loop、工具、记忆和技能的环境；对移动 agent 产品化有意义，但对基座预训练方法的直接信息量有限。
summary.technical_approach: PalmClaw 在手机本地管理 session、memory、skills、tools 和 agent loop，并将设备能力暴露为带显式参数、结构化结果和清晰调用边界的 device tools。方法重点不是训练新模型，而是把 GUI action space 改造成更稳定的工具调用接口。
summary.experiments: 摘要中未给出模型规模、任务集、baseline 或定量结果。可确认的是该工作强调开源框架和原生端侧执行，而非预训练或后训练实验。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自香港理工大学。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the brittleness of mobile LLM agents that operate phones through long GUI action sequences rather than direct access to device capabilities.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent framework and systems design. It turns the phone into a native execution environment for sessions, memory, skills, tools, and the agent loop, which matters for mobile agents but has limited direct value for base-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: PalmClaw runs on-device and exposes phone capabilities as structured device tools with explicit arguments and results. The main move is replacing fragile GUI-only control with bounded tool calls, not changing model training.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not report model sizes, benchmark tasks, baselines, or quantitative gains. The emphasis is on an open-source native mobile framework rather than pretraining experiments.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from The Hong Kong Polytechnic University.

recommendation.zh: 作为移动 agent 执行栈备查即可；预训练研究员只需看工具抽象，不必读实验。
recommendation.en: Useful as a reference for mobile-agent execution stacks; a pretraining researcher only needs the tool-abstraction idea.

paper.title: Critic Experience Bank: Self-Evolving Step-Level Confidence Estimation for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: LLM agents act in external environments where each action changes the state that later decisions condition on, and where a single wrong step can waste interaction budget or trigger irreversible side effects long before the final failure is observed. Reliable deployment therefore requires \emph{step-level confidence estimation}: a calibrated probability that each proposed action is productive, available \emph{before} the action is executed. Existing LLM confidence estimators are designed to score

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM agent 在执行前无法可靠判断某一步动作是否值得做、从而在外部环境中因单步错误造成预算浪费或不可逆副作用的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 agent 可靠性与 step-level confidence estimation 工作。贡献点在于把置信度估计从“只看当前 prompt 的回答质量”扩展到“结合执行后果的动作生产性判断”，但离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Critic Experience Bank，一个自演化 critic 框架。系统在每条轨迹结束后，用 hindsight LLM 结合完整执行反馈给每一步投票，判断该步是否 productive；这些带后验标签的经验被积累进经验库，供后续 critic 在相似状态-动作情境下估计执行前置信度。核心思想是把环境后果回流为 step-level calibration 信号。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark、模型规模和数值提升，但强调方法针对 agent 场景中“动作价值依赖环境反馈”的设定，优于只基于 prompt-response 的传统 confidence estimator。实验重点应是 step-level calibration、任务成功率或交互预算节省。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles the problem that LLM agents cannot reliably estimate, before execution, whether a proposed action is likely to be productive, leading to wasted budget or irreversible side effects.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent reliability paper on step-level confidence estimation. Its main contribution is to extend confidence estimation from prompt-only response scoring to action productivity prediction conditioned on execution consequences, but it is not very close to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Critic Experience Bank, a self-evolving critic framework. After each trajectory, a hindsight LLM uses full execution feedback to vote on whether each step was productive; these hindsight-labeled experiences are stored and later reused so the critic can estimate pre-execution confidence for similar state-action situations. The key idea is to recycle environment consequences into step-level calibration signals.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide benchmark names, model sizes, or exact gains, but the setup is aimed at agent environments where action quality depends on downstream state transitions. The likely evaluation focuses on step-level calibration, task success, and interaction-budget savings relative to prompt-only confidence estimators.

recommendation.zh: 更像 agent reliability trick，不会直接改你的 pretrain prior；若在做 tool-use 安全阈值，只看 hindsight labeling 这一个点即可。
recommendation.en: This is mostly an agent reliability trick, not a pretraining insight; only the hindsight-labeling idea is worth a quick look if you care about tool-use gating.

paper.title: Isolation as a First-Class Principle for LLM-Agent System Safety: Concepts, Taxonomy, Challenges and Future Directions
paper.abstract: The capability of LLM agents to function as the ``brain'' of a system fundamentally expands the scope of analysis beyond a standalone model. Consequently, safety is no longer only about input--output content alignment. It also concerns system behavior and real-world execution outcomes. However, the current literature is fragmented across attack types, applications, and benchmarks. This makes it hard to explain why failures such as prompt injection, tool misuse, and memory poisoning often share t

summary.core_problem: 如何用“隔离（isolation）”这一系统原则，统一解释并缓解 LLM-agent 工作流中的安全失败（提示注入、工具滥用、记忆投毒等）。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是概念框架/分类学：把碎片化的 agent 安全文献按“边界”组织，帮助工程团队在设计与审计时有一套可复用的威胁建模坐标系，而不是按攻击名词堆列表。
summary.technical_approach: 提出以边界为中心的 taxonomy：user-agent、agent-tool、agent-execution、agent-agent、system-environment 五类边界；把攻击与失效模式映射到边界穿透/污染传播路径，并讨论隔离实现的挑战（上下文分区、权限最小化、通道分离、跨代理通信约束、环境输入的信任分级等）。
summary.experiments: 综述/概念论文，未见可复现的系统实验或统一基准上的定量对比（从摘要信息判断）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to use “isolation” as a unifying system principle to explain and mitigate safety failures in LLM-agent workflows (prompt injection, tool misuse, memory poisoning, etc.).
summary_en.importance: A conceptual/taxonomy contribution: reorganizes fragmented agent-safety literature around boundaries, giving practitioners a reusable threat-modeling lens rather than a list of attack names.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a boundary-centric taxonomy with five boundaries (user–agent, agent–tool, agent–execution, agent–agent, system–environment), mapping failures to boundary breaches and contamination propagation; discusses implementation challenges such as context partitioning, least privilege, channel separation, constrained inter-agent comms, and trust-tiering environment context.
summary_en.experiments: Survey/concept paper; no clear reproducible system experiments or quantitative benchmark results based on the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 当作安全威胁建模的“术语表+检查清单”即可；对预训练没直接增益，读 taxonomy 那几段就够。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a threat-modeling glossary/checklist; little direct pretraining value—skim the boundary taxonomy sections only.

paper.title: Evidence-Grounded Verified Agentic Reasoning: A Path Toward Eliminating LLM Hallucination in Empirical Inference via Tool-Attested Kernel Proofs
paper.abstract: Tool access alone does not make LLM empirical reasoning governable: accepted outputs need not descend from attested evidence, and accepted deductions need not hold up under formal scrutiny. We present EG-VAR (Evidence-Grounded Verified Agentic Reasoning), a Lean 4-based tool-calling architecture in which the Lean kernel is the sole minter of Verified claims via tool-attestation axioms and declared source lifts. Every verified output structurally descends from an attested tool call (Thm. 3.1) and

summary.core_problem: 现有工具调用LLM无法保证输出严格源自可信工具证据、推理链逻辑严谨，存在幻觉与结论不忠实于来源的问题。
summary.importance: 提出结合形式化验证内核的Agent推理架构，从结构上保证可验证输出的证据溯源性和推理有效性，不可验证结果可审计弃权。
summary.technical_approach: 基于Lean4构建工具调用框架，将工具返回结果作为经认证的公理注入，所有输出必须经过Lean内核完成推理链有效性检查，保证每个有效结论都溯源到可信工具调用+有效推理步骤，不满足条件时返回带可复现审计轨迹的弃权结果。
summary.experiments: 在TableBench数值推理子集（120个样本）上达到100%准确率，同等工具访问条件的普通LLM baseline为95%；5个领域的反事实压力测试中保持100%源忠实度，同工具baseline为80-90%，无工具baseline为50-80%；语义到形式化的转换错误率Claude Sonnet为3.3%，Opus为1.7%。

summary_en.core_problem: Tool-augmented LLMs cannot guarantee outputs strictly derive from attested tool evidence and follow logically valid inference chains, leading to hallucinations and unfaithful conclusions.
summary_en.importance: Proposes an agentic reasoning architecture integrated with a formal proof kernel that structurally enforces evidence traceability and inference validity for verified outputs, with auditable abstention for unverifiable claims.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds a tool-calling framework on Lean 4, injecting tool-returned results as attested axioms. All valid outputs must pass Lean kernel checks on inference chain validity, ensuring every sound conclusion traces back to attested tool calls plus valid deduction steps; failing cases return abstain results with replayable audit trails.
summary_en.experiments: Achieves 100% accuracy on a 120-sample subset of TableBench numerical reasoning, compared to 95% for standard LLM baselines with identical tool access. On 5-domain counterfactual stress tests, it maintains 100% source faithfulness, versus 80-90% for tool-augmented baselines and 50-80% for no-tool baselines. Semantic-to-formal translation error is 3.3% for Claude Sonnet and 1.7% for Opus.

recommendation.zh: 外挂形式化内核做agent验证的工程尝试，未涉及模型训练层面改进，作为思路备查即可，无需读全文。
recommendation.en: An engineering attempt to bolt a formal proof kernel onto agents with no modeling improvements; keep as a reference, no need to read the full paper.

paper.title: Beyond the Eye: Efficient Multimodal Reasoning via Self-Regulated Implicit Visual Tools
paper.abstract: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made remarkable progress on fine-grained perception tasks under the "Thinking with Images" (TwI) paradigm by iteratively performing various visual tool operations. However, this paradigm relies heavily on frequent external tool calls and repeated image re-encoding, which leads to substantial computational overhead and inference latency. To address these issues, we propose Beyond the Eye (BEE), a novel implicit visual tool paradigm centered on

summary.core_problem: 解决现有多模态大模型Thinking with Images范式依赖频繁外部视觉工具调用、重复图像编码导致推理开销和延迟过高的问题。
summary.importance: 多模态推理范式的效率改进，将显式工具调用内化到模型内部，属于MLLM后训练方法的增量创新。
summary.technical_approach: 提出BEE隐式视觉工具范式，通过两阶段训练：1) 构造形式化思维链SFT数据，将视觉工具调用行为融入训练目标；2) 自调节训练，鼓励模型自适应平衡内部知识与隐式工具调用，避免冗余工具使用。
summary.experiments: 未给出具体模型参数量和数据集规模，仅说明在细粒度感知任务上显著降低推理延迟，同时保持性能。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the high computational overhead and latency in MLLM 'Thinking with Images' paradigms caused by frequent external visual tool calls and repeated image re-encoding.
summary_en.importance: Efficiency-oriented improvement of multimodal reasoning paradigm that internalizes explicit tool calls; incremental innovation in MLLM post-training methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes BEE, an implicit visual tool paradigm with two-stage training: (1) formalized CoT SFT that encodes visual tool invocation behaviors into the training objective; (2) self-regulated training that adaptively balances internal knowledge and implicit tools to avoid redundant usage.
summary_en.experiments: Specific model size and dataset scale not provided; only claims significantly reduced inference latency while maintaining performance on fine-grained perception tasks.

recommendation.zh: MLLM工具调用内化的思路可参考，但实验细节不足，作为后训练范式的弱信号备查即可。
recommendation.en: The idea of internalizing tool calls in MLLMs is worth noting, but experimental details are insufficient; keep as a weak signal for post-training paradigm reference.

paper.title: UNIBROWSE: A Data-to-Agent Framework for Multimodal BrowseComp
paper.abstract: Multimodal BrowseComp tasks require agents to combine perception, tool use, and long-horizon reasoning over dynamic web content, challenging their ability to handle compositional structure, open-world uncertainty, and multimodal integration across extended interactions. Crucially, real-world multimodal browsing involves three distinct information-flow patterns: text-only, image-to-text, and text-to-image, yet existing data construction methods cover only the text-only and image-to-text patterns,

summary.core_problem: UniBrowse 解决的是多模态 BrowseComp 训练数据覆盖不足的问题，尤其是现有方法偏重 text-only 和 image-to-text，缺少 text-to-image 这类先文本检索、再视觉验证或视觉定位的信息流。
summary.importance: 这篇不是基座预训练论文，主要价值在 post-train 数据合成和长程工具使用训练。对预训练研究的启发在于：复杂 agent 能力的训练信号不能只看最终 QA，对轨迹的可探索性、证据链结构、模态流向也需要显式建模。它把知识图谱的可控结构和实时网页证据结合，用来降低纯随机网页漫游的噪声，也避免只依赖静态图谱导致覆盖面窄。这个思路可迁移到更一般的 tool-use SFT/RL 数据构造：先控制任务骨架，再引入开放环境证据，最后按轨迹多样性过滤。
summary.technical_approach: UniBrowse 包含一个数据构造管线和一个由该数据训练出的多模态 browsing agent。管线从文本知识图谱出发，为 seed entity 构造连通的文本证据子图，并通过多跳关系扩展形成可组合的推理骨架。随后接入 live web retrieval，为图谱骨架补充真实网页证据，缓解纯图谱数据过于封闭的问题。任务被组织成三类信息流：text-only，即答案来自多段文本证据组合；image-to-text，即先解析图像线索，再通过文本浏览定位答案；text-to-image，即先通过文本证据确定目标，再进行图像搜索、视觉确认或视觉检索。训练数据选择上引入 exploration degree，用成功轨迹的多样性衡量样本是否提供足够的长程决策学习信号，并过滤低探索度样本。模型训练采用冷启动工具使用轨迹做 SFT，再进行 exploration-aware RL。
summary.experiments: 论文从管线生成 8K 条冷启动 tool-use trajectories 和 10K 个 QA pairs，并训练一个 35B 规模的 UniBrowse agent。实验声称该 agent 在多模态 BrowseComp benchmarks 上超过既有开源基线。提供内容中没有完整列出各 benchmark 的具体分数和消融表，但可以确认的实验主线是三部分：三种信息流覆盖带来的任务多样性，KG skeleton 加 live web retrieval 对证据可靠性和真实感的影响，以及 exploration degree 过滤对 RL 训练效率的影响。最值得关注的消融应是去掉 text-to-image、去掉 web augmentation、去掉 exploration-aware filtering 后的性能与训练效率变化。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。重点看 data construction pipeline 和 exploration degree 的定义，判断它是否只是启发式过滤，还是能稳定预测 RL 训练收益。Figure 2 应该能快速说明从 KG 到网页证据再到三类任务的生成流程。实验部分主要看三组消融：信息流覆盖、web retrieval 增强、exploration-aware data selection。若只关心基座预训练，可跳过 agent 部署细节；若关心 post-train 数据工程，这篇的样本选择标准值得记录。

summary_en.core_problem: UniBrowse addresses a data construction gap for multimodal BrowseComp agents: existing pipelines mostly cover text-only and image-to-text cases, while text-to-image workflows, where textual browsing determines what should later be visually searched or verified, remain underrepresented.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a post-training data and agent-training paper rather than a base pretraining contribution. Its relevance comes from the way it structures training signals for long-horizon tool use. The paper treats browsing data not just as final QA pairs, but as trajectories with modality flow, evidence structure, and exploration diversity. The combination of a controllable knowledge-graph skeleton with live web retrieval is a useful design pattern: it avoids the narrowness of purely graph-based generation while reducing the noise of unconstrained web random walks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework has two parts: a data pipeline and a multimodal browsing agent trained on its output. Starting from a textual knowledge graph, UniBrowse builds connected evidence subgraphs around seed entities through multi-hop expansion. These graph-derived skeletons provide controllable reasoning paths. The pipeline then augments them with live web retrieval, adding open-web evidence and making the generated tasks closer to real browsing. It explicitly generates three information-flow patterns: text-only composition over textual evidence, image-to-text resolution from an initial visual clue into textual browsing, and text-to-image workflows where textual evidence guides later visual retrieval or verification. For data selection, the paper introduces exploration degree, a metric intended to capture the diversity of successful reasoning trajectories. Low-exploration instances are filtered out so that RL focuses on tasks with richer long-horizon decision signals. Training uses SFT on cold-start tool-use trajectories followed by exploration-aware RL.
summary_en.experiments: The pipeline produces 8K cold-start tool-use trajectories and 10K QA pairs, which are used to train a 35B-scale UniBrowse agent. The reported result is stronger performance than prior open-source baselines on multimodal BrowseComp benchmarks. The provided content does not include full numeric tables, so the most important experimental claims are structural: coverage of all three modality-flow patterns, web-augmented grounding over KG skeletons, and exploration-degree filtering for more efficient RL. The most informative ablations to inspect are removal of text-to-image data, removal of live web augmentation, and removal of exploration-aware filtering.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim should be sufficient. Read the data pipeline first, especially how graph skeletons are converted into web-grounded tasks and how the three flow patterns are instantiated. Then inspect the definition of exploration degree and the filtering procedure; the key question is whether it reliably predicts useful RL signal or only acts as a coarse heuristic. Figure 2 should give the fastest view of the generation pipeline. For base-model researchers, the agent implementation details are secondary; the data selection mechanism is the part worth retaining.

recommendation.zh: 只读数据生成和 exploration degree；若指标真能预测 RL 信号质量，值得迁移到内部 agent 数据筛选。
recommendation.en: Read the data pipeline and exploration-degree metric; if it predicts RL signal quality, it is worth porting to internal agent-data filtering.

institutions: Key Laboratory of Computational Linguistics, MOE, Peking University

paper.title: ToolAtlas: Learning Once, Reusing Everywhere with Tool-Side Memory
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external tools served by shared providers and accessed by heterogeneous downstream agents. Existing approaches improve tool use on the agent side through parameter updates, prompt refinement, or agent-side memory, making tool knowledge difficult to share and limited to behaviors observed in past tasks. We argue that reusable tool knowledge should instead be maintained by the tool provider. We introduce ToolAtlas, a graph-based framework that

summary.core_problem: LLM agents 使用共享外部工具时，工具知识通常存放在单个 agent 的参数、prompt 或私有记忆中，难以跨 agent、跨任务和跨环境复用。
summary.importance: 这是通用工具使用 agent 的系统方法创新。核心贡献不是训练更强的 agent，而是把工具能力、失败边界和组合关系维护在工具提供方，改变了工具知识应存放在 agent 侧的默认工程假设。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ToolAtlas，一个 provider-side tool memory 框架。它通过 execution-verified probing 主动探索工具，构建图结构记忆，节点和边表示工具能力、调用失败边界以及跨工具组合；推理时 agent 通过自适应图遍历查询该记忆，用于选择和组合工具。方法更像外置知识层和工具索引层，而不是参数更新或 prompt tuning。
summary.experiments: 在两个基于 MCP 的 benchmark 上评估，覆盖 8 个服务。相对 tool-side optimization 和 agent-side memory baseline，ToolAtlas 在 pass@1 上最高提升 21.61%，在 pass@4 上最高提升 18.61%。摘要还声称同一份工具记忆可跨环境实例和 agent 框架迁移。
summary.authors_note: 作者名单包括 Qingwei Lin、Saravan Rajmohan、Dongmei Zhang 等微软长期从事软件工程、智能运维和 LLM agent 系统研究的研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM agents increasingly use shared external tools, but tool knowledge is often stored in agent parameters, prompts, or private memories, making it hard to reuse across agents, tasks, and environments.
summary_en.importance: This is a systems-oriented method for general tool-using agents. The main contribution is to move reusable knowledge about tool capabilities, failure boundaries, and compositions to the tool-provider side, rather than improving each agent separately.
summary_en.technical_approach: ToolAtlas builds a persistent provider-side tool memory through execution-verified probing. The memory is represented as a graph over tool capabilities, failure regions, and cross-tool compositions. At inference time, agents query it through adaptive graph traversal. The method is closer to an external tool knowledge layer than to parameter updates or prompt optimization.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on two MCP-based benchmarks spanning eight services. ToolAtlas improves over tool-side optimization and agent-side memory baselines by up to 21.61% in pass@1 and 18.61% in pass@4. The same memory is reported to transfer across environment instances and agent frameworks.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Qingwei Lin, Saravan Rajmohan, and Dongmei Zhang, researchers associated with Microsoft work on software engineering, AIOps, and LLM agent systems.

recommendation.zh: 只看框架图和迁移实验；对预训练的信号是工具知识可外置共享，不必急着塞进参数。
recommendation.en: Read the framework diagram and transfer tables; the useful signal is that tool knowledge can live outside model weights.

paper.title: Agora: Enhancing LLM Agent Reasoning Via Auction-Based Task Allocation
paper.abstract: Enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language model (LLM) agents requires effective orchestration of diverse expert models and tools. However, existing frameworks typically call APIs based on coarse-grained matching between tasks and the functions of expert models or tools, while overlooking critical factors such as performance variability and cost efficiency among functionally similar alternatives. To address this, we propose Agora, a framework that introduces an incentive-compatible a

summary.core_problem: 解决多专家模型与工具协同时的任务分配问题：不仅按功能匹配，还要同时考虑能力波动、过度自信和成本。
summary.importance: 这是通用 agent 编排方法，不是基座预训练工作。贡献点在于把 auction mechanism 引入 LLM agent 的步骤级路由，用激励兼容的方式做 cost-quality 权衡。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Agora，把推理过程拆成可交易的 reasoning steps，由候选专家模型或工具基于“校正后的能力”出价，系统再用拍卖机制分配任务。核心意图是避免把关键步骤交给最自信但未必最强的 solver，并显式暴露成本—质量可控曲线。
summary.experiments: 在五个 benchmark 上与单模型、routing、cascade 等基线比较，摘要称在相近候选池下取得更好结果，并能控制成本与质量权衡。摘要未给出模型规模、工具集合、拍卖规则细节和显著提升幅度，因此更适合作为 agent orchestration 备查，而不是深入阅读对象。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Birmingham。论文关注多 agent / 多工具编排，机构与作者不属于当前基座模型主流实验室。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses task allocation across expert models and tools in LLM agents, aiming to account not only for functional matching but also for competence variability, overconfidence, and cost.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent orchestration paper rather than a foundation-model pretraining paper. Its contribution is to introduce an auction mechanism for step-level routing with an explicit cost-quality trade-off.
summary_en.technical_approach: Agora decomposes reasoning into tradable steps. Candidate expert models or tools bid using rectified competence estimates, and an auction mechanism assigns each step. The goal is to avoid routing critical reasoning to the most overconfident solver and instead favor the most capable one under budget constraints.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on five benchmarks against single-model, routing, and cascade baselines, claiming gains under comparable candidate pools and a controllable cost-quality trade-off. The abstract does not provide model sizes, tool sets, auction details, or effect sizes, so this is better treated as agent-orchestration literature rather than a deep-read item.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Birmingham. The work focuses on multi-agent and multi-tool orchestration rather than mainstream foundation-model pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 有点意思，但更像 agent 调度工程；如果你关心 tool routing，可只看“校正能力+拍卖”这层抽象，其余对预训练帮助不大。
recommendation.en: Interesting, but mostly an agent scheduling paper; if you care about tool routing, just read the 'rectified competence + auction' abstraction and move on.

paper.title: Shared Selective Persistent Memory for Agentic LLM Systems
paper.abstract: Agentic LLM systems that generate code through multi-turn tool use face a fundamental context problem: each session starts from zero, discarding the configuration choices, domain constraints, data schemas, and tool-use patterns that made previous sessions productive. Naively persisting entire conversation histories is token-inefficient and counterproductive: irrelevant context degrades generation quality. We introduce shared selective persistent memory, an architecture that identifies and retain

summary.core_problem: 多轮工具调用的Agent系统每次会话从零开始，无法复用历史配置与约束上下文，而全量保存对话历史token效率低且会引入无关内容降低生成质量。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出面向Agent系统的共享选择性持久记忆架构，实现可复用上下文的跨会话、跨用户协作复用。
summary.technical_approach: 识别并保留四类可复用上下文（任务规范、数据模式、工具配置、输出约束），丢弃会话专属推理轨迹；记忆以工作空间形式封装，支持基于角色访问控制的跨用户共享。
summary.experiments: 在已部署的协作工作空间平台上实现，Agent可生成、编辑和维护git版本化工件，未给出量化基线对比结果。

summary_en.core_problem: Agentic LLM systems with multi-turn tool use start each session from scratch and cannot reuse prior context, while full history persistence is token-inefficient and degrades quality with irrelevant content.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: a shared selective persistent memory architecture for agent systems enabling cross-session and cross-user collaborative reuse of valuable context.
summary_en.technical_approach: Identifies and retains four categories of reusable context (task specs, data schemas, tool configs, output constraints) while discarding session-specific reasoning traces; memory is packaged in workspaces with role-based access control for cross-user sharing.
summary_en.experiments: Implemented on a deployed collaborative workspace platform where agents produce, edit, and maintain git-versioned artifacts; no quantitative baseline comparison is provided.

recommendation.zh: Agent记忆架构的小增量创新，对预训练研究员仅作领域常识了解即可，无需深读。
recommendation.en: Minor incremental innovation in agent memory architecture, only useful for general domain awareness for pretrain researchers.

paper.title: DeepSearch-World: Self-Distillation for Deep Search Agents in a Verifiable Environment
paper.abstract: Training tool-use agents to improve from their own experience remains challenging, as supervised fine-tuning relies on fixed teacher-distilled trajectories, while sparse-reward reinforcement learning provides weak supervision for long-horizon interactions. We present DeepSearch-Evolve, a self-distillation framework for web agents built on DeepSearch-World, a deterministic and verifiable environment with reproducible search and page-reading tools. DeepSearch-World contains 420K multi-hop QA tasks

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的是长程搜索型工具 Agent 的自我改进问题：SFT 只能模仿已有成功轨迹，容易被基座模型能力和轨迹多样性限制；RL 只有最终答案奖励，难以告诉模型是查询、读页、证据抽取还是答案合成出了问题。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不高，但对 post-train 与可验证环境构造有参考意义。它把 Agent 训练中的关键矛盾从“有没有更多轨迹”推进到“能不能获得可复现、可验证的过程监督”。这类环境和数据闭环会影响未来 tool-use / search agent 的 SFT、RL 和自蒸馏 recipe，尤其是如何在不依赖强闭源教师模型的情况下扩展训练信号。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构建了 DeepSearch-World，一个基于 Wikipedia 的离线确定性搜索环境，包含 search 和 page-reading 工具，以及 420K 个通过实体级随机游走构造的多跳 QA 任务。确定性环境的作用是让同一个查询、同一个页面读取动作产生可复现观察，避免 live web 或 LLM simulator 带来的噪声。DeepSearch-Evolve 在这个环境上做迭代式自蒸馏：先由教师策略生成带 scaffold 的轨迹，显式记录计划、进度、证据、失败尝试、反思和恢复；再用验证信号筛选成功轨迹；随后把 scaffold 轨迹转成标准 ReAct 格式，让学生模型学习可执行的 tool-use 行为；最后循环生成、筛选、混合和 SFT 更新。与普通 self-training 的区别在于，它不是只保留最终正确答案轨迹，而是利用环境验证把中间搜索过程也变成训练信号。
summary.experiments: 论文报告了 DeepSearch-World-9B 在开放模型搜索 Agent 中达到有竞争力的表现，且没有依赖强闭源模型蒸馏。分析显示，模型能维持更长的工具交互，工具调用更有效，并从两个关键设计中获益：一是基于验证信号的轨迹过滤，减少错误行为进入训练集；二是 scaffold-to-ReAct 转换，把带有显式状态和反思的教师轨迹压缩成学生可学习的标准交互格式。给出的全文片段中没有包含完整 benchmark 名称、分数表和消融数字，因此不宜补充具体提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看方法部分中 DeepSearch-World 的任务生成、工具接口和验证信号设计，以及 DeepSearch-Evolve 的四步训练循环。实验部分优先看轨迹过滤、scaffold-to-ReAct、数据混合和迭代轮次相关消融。若只关心基座预训练，可跳过大部分 Agent benchmark 细节，保留对“可验证环境如何产生过程监督”的理解。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets self-improvement for long-horizon search agents. SFT on successful traces quickly saturates, while sparse RL rewards do not identify whether failures come from query formulation, tool choice, evidence extraction, or final answer synthesis.
summary_en.importance: Its main relevance is to post-training rather than base pretraining. The useful idea is the training-signal design: a deterministic and verifiable environment can turn agent rollouts into process-level supervision, not just final-answer labels. This matters for tool-use training recipes that aim to scale without relying on stronger proprietary teacher models.
summary_en.technical_approach: DeepSearch-World is an offline Wikipedia-grounded environment with reproducible search and page-reading tools. It contains 420K multi-hop QA tasks built from entity-level random walks. The deterministic setup makes intermediate actions verifiable, which is hard to obtain from live web environments or LLM-based simulators. DeepSearch-Evolve then performs iterative self-distillation: a teacher policy generates scaffolded trajectories with planning, progress tracking, evidence, failed attempts, reflection, and recovery; verification signals filter the trajectories; the scaffolded traces are converted into standard ReAct-format supervision; the student is updated with SFT and used for the next round. The key difference from ordinary self-training is that the environment exposes dense behavioral supervision over tool-use decisions, rather than only accepting or rejecting final answers.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports that DeepSearch-World-9B is competitive among open-source search agents without distillation from stronger proprietary models. The analyses indicate longer tool-use interactions, more effective tool usage, and gains from verified trajectory filtering and scaffold-to-ReAct conversion. The provided full-text content does not include the complete benchmark tables or numeric deltas, so exact score improvements should be checked in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the environment construction, the verification mechanism, and the DeepSearch-Evolve training loop. In the experiments, prioritize ablations on trajectory filtering, scaffold-to-ReAct conversion, data mixing, and iterative updates. Readers focused on base-model research can skip most benchmark details and retain the design pattern for creating verifiable process supervision.

recommendation.zh: 读环境构造和过滤准则即可；它对预训练的价值在于展示“可验证经验池”怎样替代昂贵教师轨迹。
recommendation.en: Read the environment construction and filtering rules; the useful signal is how a verifiable experience pool can replace expensive teacher trajectories.

paper.title: TTHE: Test-Time Harness Evolution
paper.abstract: The behavior of an LLM agent is determined not only by the underlying model, but also by its harness: the executable program that constructs context, invokes tools, verifies intermediate results, and recovers from failures. Existing approaches optimize such harnesses before deployment, searching training or development data for a fixed agent workflow that is then frozen at test time. This limits adaptation when the test distribution, failure modes, or tool interactions differ from those seen dur

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文关注一个较具体但有实际意义的问题：LLM agent 的测试时适配不一定只能改模型参数或改单次输出，也可以改包在模型外面的可执行 harness。harness 包括上下文构造、工具调用、校验逻辑、失败恢复、控制流等。作者要解决的是：在没有标签、没有人工修复、没有额外 repair model、模型权重冻结的条件下，能否只利用测试输入产生的执行轨迹，在评测过程中持续修改 agent 的 harness。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 post-train 与 agent 系统评测有启发。它把“测试时适配”的状态从文本记忆或反思，移到可执行程序层面。这个角度值得关注，因为大模型能力在 agent 场景里经常被 harness 放大或限制。对于基座研究员，更有价值的是它暴露了一个接口问题：同一个 frozen model 在不同外部控制程序下会表现出不同能力边界，评测结果不再只反映模型权重，也反映 scaffold 的自适应能力。它也提醒后续做 agent benchmark 时，需要区分模型能力、固定 harness 能力、测试时 harness 搜索能力。
summary.technical_approach: TTHE 将 harness 作为测试时适配的状态变量。每个未标注测试 batch 上，系统维护一组候选 harness，并对它们进行带 instrumentation 的执行，记录模型调用、工具行为、中间输出、运行错误、测试结果、恢复路径等轨迹。随后由 agentic proposer 基于这些无标签轨迹和代理信号提出 harness 修改，例如调整上下文构造、增加多样本生成、加入工具校验、加入确定性 contract check，或添加条件式 recovery 分支。再由一个 judge 根据执行侧信号选择一个候选 harness 提交，选中的程序会持久化，用于后续输入。solver、proposer、judge 都由同一个冻结 LLM 扮演不同角色，不引入额外训练模型，也不更新权重。与反思式方法相比，它不是只改当前回答或存一段经验；与离线 prompt/workflow search 相比，它把搜索放到评测过程内；与源码级修复工作相比，它不依赖外部强模型或人工标签。
summary.experiments: 作者在多类 execution-grounded 任务上比较 TTHE 与固定 ReAct-style baseline harness。结果显示 TTHE 在所评估设置中能稳定改进固定 harness，并生成可检查的 grounding、verification、repair 策略。更有信息量的现象是，搜索预算增加并不保证单调提升：当 proxy 信号不完整时，judge 可能选择执行上看似合理但答案错误的 harness。错误分析把剩余失败主要归因于两个瓶颈：代理信号质量不足，以及 agentic judge 在不完备证据下的选择可靠性。摘要和引言没有给出具体任务列表、绝对分数和提升幅度，精读时需要到实验表格确认。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看方法部分中 harness 表示、population 更新、proposer/judge 分工、proxy 信号设计；再看实验表格，确认它在哪些任务上有效、每个测试 batch 的搜索成本是多少；最后看 error analysis 和 search-budget ablation。最值得深挖的是两个问题：第一，judge 的选择准则是否会泄漏 benchmark-specific proxy；第二，测试时 harness evolution 与普通 self-reflection、tool-use retry、offline workflow search 的边界是否清楚。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies test-time adaptation for LLM agents at the level of the executable harness rather than model weights or individual responses. The harness is the program that builds context, calls tools, checks intermediate states, and handles failures. The central question is whether an agent can adapt during evaluation using only its own unlabeled execution traces, with frozen model weights, no gold labels, no human repair signal, and no separate repair model.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to how model capability is measured and exposed in agentic settings. The useful idea is to treat the scaffold around a frozen model as a persistent adaptive state. The same base model can show different behavior under different harnesses, so agent evaluation may reflect the interaction between model capability, scaffold design, and test-time scaffold search. For foundation-model research, the paper is mainly useful as a reminder that downstream agent performance is not a clean property of the model alone.
summary_en.technical_approach: TTHE maintains a population of candidate harnesses on unlabeled test batches. Each candidate is executed under instrumentation, producing traces that include model calls, tool actions, intermediate outputs, runtime errors, test results, and recovery decisions. Agentic proposers inspect these traces and proxy-indicated weaknesses to propose edits to the executable harness. A judge then commits one candidate using execution-derived signals, and the selected program persists for later inputs. The solver, proposers, and judge are implemented as different roles and harnesses around the same frozen LLM. Compared with self-reflection, the adaptation target is not a single answer or textual memory. Compared with offline prompt or workflow search, the search happens during evaluation. Compared with source-level repair using a stronger external coding model, it does not introduce an extra adaptation model.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports improvements over fixed ReAct-style harnesses across several execution-grounded tasks. The adapted harnesses produce inspectable policies for grounding, verification, and repair. A key empirical finding is that performance is not monotonic in search budget: more search can lead the judge to select a plausible but wrong program when proxy signals are incomplete. The trace audits identify proxy quality and judge reliability as the main bottlenecks. The provided text does not include exact task names, absolute scores, or improvement magnitudes, so those need to be checked in the experimental tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Focus on the method section for the harness representation, population update rule, proposer/judge decomposition, and proxy signals. Then check the main result tables for task coverage and compute cost per test batch. The most useful parts are likely the search-budget ablation and trace-based error analysis, because they show when test-time harness evolution helps and when it overfits weak execution proxies.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和实验设定即可；若无标签轨迹真能稳定改 harness，这比又调 prompt 更接近可复用的 agent test-time adaptation。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and setup; if unlabeled traces reliably improve the harness, this is closer to reusable agent test-time adaptation than another prompt-tuning loop.

paper.title: WebSwarm: Recursive Multi-Agent Orchestration for Deep-and-Wide Web Search
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based web search agents are transforming information seeking from simple factoid question answering into complex, deep-and-wide search and research-oriented tasks. A single ReAct-style agent is constrained by one long trajectory and limited context, making it difficult to handle depth and coverage simultaneously. Existing multi-agent systems improve search coverage through parallel execution and aggregation, but still exhibit clear limitations in recursive depth, colla

summary.core_problem: 解决单个 ReAct 式网页搜索 agent 在复杂深度研究任务中同时兼顾搜索深度、覆盖面和证据组织能力不足的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个通用 web agent 编排方法，而不是预训练工作；价值主要在于展示递归委派和多 agent 协作如何改善长链搜索任务，对研究 test-time scaling、agentic inference 和工具使用有间接参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 WebSwarm，一个递归式多 agent 编排框架。系统把任务表示为动态扩展的搜索节点，每个节点绑定局部目标和搜索模式；节点既可自行求解，也可继续委派子节点。框架在推理时联合进行任务分解、递归扩展和协作搜索，并在回收子节点结果后做证据汇总与上层整合。
summary.experiments: 从摘要可见，论文主打 deep-and-wide web search 场景，对比对象应包括单 agent ReAct 和已有并行多 agent 搜索系统，重点考察复杂研究型任务中的覆盖率、深度和证据支撑质量。摘要未给出明确模型规模、数据规模和具体增益数字，因此目前更适合作为方法思路参考，而非可直接迁移的 clean empirical evidence。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自中国人民大学高瓴人工智能学院与快手。Ji-Rong Wen 是信息检索与搜索方向的知名学者，这使论文在 web search 任务设定上有一定可信度，但其核心仍偏 agent 系统而非基座模型。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the inability of a single ReAct-style web-search agent to jointly achieve depth, breadth, and evidence organization on complex research-oriented search tasks.
summary_en.importance: This is a general web-agent orchestration paper rather than a pretraining paper; its value is mainly in showing how recursive delegation and multi-agent collaboration improve long-horizon search, which is indirectly relevant to test-time scaling and agentic inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes WebSwarm, a recursive multi-agent orchestration framework. It represents the task as dynamically expanded search nodes, each with a local objective and a search mode. A node can solve the objective itself or delegate to child nodes, while the system jointly performs decomposition, recursive expansion, collaboration, and evidence aggregation during inference.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the target setting is deep-and-wide web search, likely compared against single-agent ReAct baselines and prior parallel multi-agent search systems. The focus appears to be coverage, depth, and evidence-groundedness on complex research tasks. The abstract does not provide model sizes, data scale, or concrete gains, so it is more useful as a systems idea than as clean empirical evidence for foundation-model research.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Renmin University of China and Kuaishou. Ji-Rong Wen is a well-known researcher in information retrieval and search, which adds credibility to the task setup, though the work is still primarily an agent systems paper rather than a foundation-model paper.

recommendation.zh: 偏 agent 编排，不会直接改你的 pretrain prior；若关心 test-time scaling，只看递归委派设计和失败模式，别花太多时间在任务包装上。
recommendation.en: This is mostly agent orchestration, not something that changes pretraining priors; if you care about test-time scaling, read the recursive delegation design and failure analysis, not the task packaging.

institutions: Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China

paper.title: ChatGPT is now a partner for your most ambitious work
paper.abstract: ChatGPT Work is an agent that can take action across your apps and files, stay with a project for hours if needed, and turn a goal into finished work.

summary.core_problem: 介绍 ChatGPT Work：一个可跨应用和文件执行操作、长时间保持项目上下文、把高层目标推进到可交付结果的产品型 Agent。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是产品发布和行业信号，不是技术论文。它说明 OpenAI 正在把通用模型能力包装成长期任务执行、文件/应用操作和工作流自动化能力，这对理解后训练目标和 agentic serving 需求有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 公开摘要没有给出模型架构、训练目标、工具调用协议、长期记忆机制或安全控制细节。可确认的信息是系统强调跨应用执行、项目级持久上下文和从目标到成品的端到端任务完成。
summary.experiments: 未披露模型参数、训练数据、agent benchmark、人工评测或与既有 ChatGPT/Operator 类产品的量化对比。
summary.authors_note: OpenAI Research 官方博客；未列出个人作者。

summary_en.core_problem: The post introduces ChatGPT Work, an agentic product intended to act across apps and files, maintain project context for hours, and turn high-level goals into finished work.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a product and industry signal rather than a technical contribution. It indicates OpenAI’s push toward long-running workplace agents, which matters indirectly for post-training targets, tool-use reliability, and serving constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: The abstract does not disclose architecture, training objectives, tool protocols, memory design, or safety mechanisms. The visible design points are cross-app action, persistent project context, and end-to-end task completion.
summary_en.experiments: No model size, training data, benchmark results, human evaluation, or quantitative comparison with prior ChatGPT/Operator-style systems is provided.
summary_en.authors_note: Official OpenAI Research blog post; no individual authors are listed.

recommendation.zh: 只看产品边界和任务形态即可；没有训练 recipe，但能反推长期 agent 对记忆和工具可靠性的压力。
recommendation.en: Skim only for product boundaries and task shape; there is no training recipe, but it hints at memory and tool-reliability pressure for long-running agents.

paper.title: Beyond Attack-Success Rate: Action-Graded Severity Scale for Tool-Using AI Agents
paper.abstract: Agentic red-teaming benchmarks report whether an injected agent was compromised as a single bit: the attack succeeded, or it did not. We argue that this binary attack-success rate discards the information a defender most needs, namely how harmful the resulting action was. We introduce an action-graded harm rubric that scores an agent's tool-call trajectory on a seven-level ordinal scale (L0 to L6) according to whether the executed action was reversible, whether it crossed scope to reach another

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的是 tool-using agent 安全评测里一个过粗的指标问题：二元 attack-success rate 无法区分“被攻破后到底造成了多大伤害”。
summary.importance: 贡献属于评测协议改进。它提出按行动后果分级的严重度量表，而不是只看是否成功入侵。对做 agent 安全、工具调用约束和 judge 设计的人有参考价值，但对基座预训练本身的直接启发有限。
