summary.technical_approach: 作者设计了一个七级 ordinal harm rubric（L0-L6），依据工具调用轨迹中的三个维度打分：行为是否可逆、是否越权影响到第三方、是否扩大权限。评分有两种实现：一个读取轨迹和攻击目标的 deterministic oracle，以及三个 frontier LLM judges 在去标签叙述上的 panel 评审。
summary.experiments: 实验在 AgentDojo workspace suite 上，对四个 victim models 和两种 defenses 进行评测。结果显示，severity grading 能揭示二元 attack-success rate 看不到的情况，例如某些 defense 报告 0 攻击成功率，但仍允许对外可见且不可逆的有害动作。摘要未给出具体模型名和数值提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a coarse evaluation issue in tool-using agent security: binary attack-success rate cannot tell how harmful a successful compromise actually was.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an evaluation-protocol contribution. It replaces a single-bit compromise metric with an action-severity scale. Useful for agent safety, tool-use constraints, and judge design, but only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method introduces a seven-level ordinal harm rubric (L0-L6) based on three properties of the executed tool trajectory: reversibility, scope crossing to another party, and privilege expansion. Severity is computed in two ways: a deterministic oracle using the trajectory and attacker goal, and a panel of three frontier LLM judges reading a tag-free account of the same trajectory.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on the AgentDojo workspace suite across four victim models and two defenses. Severity grading reveals cases hidden by binary attack-success rate, including a defense that reports zero attack success while still allowing externally visible harmful actions. The abstract does not provide detailed model names or exact numbers.

recommendation.zh: 这是 agent 安全评测口径修正，不是基座方法论文；知道“0% ASR 也可能很危险”这个点就够了，正文可不读。
recommendation.en: This is an agent-safety metric correction, not a foundation-model paper; the main takeaway is that 0% ASR can still hide harmful behavior, and that is enough.

paper.title: Evaluating SageMath-Augmented LLM Agents for Computational and Experimental Mathematics
paper.abstract: Recent advances in AI for Mathematics have focused largely on autoformalization and theorem proving, leaving the role of Computer Algebra Systems (CAS) in agentic LLM workflows underexplored. We propose a ReAct-style agentic setup that combines LLM reasoning with verifiable feedback from SageMath, together with Context7 for the up-to-date documentation. We evaluate this agentic setup across frontier models for solving research-level mathematical problems from the RealMath benchmark in a setting

summary.core_problem: 评估带 SageMath 工具的 LLM agent 在计算数学和实验数学问题上，相比纯语言推理能带来多少可验证增益。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏评测和 agent workflow 分析。它把数学 AI 中常被 theorem proving 和 autoformalization 遮住的 CAS 工具使用单独测量，并对 RealMath benchmark 的题目抽取与验证流程做了清洗改进。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 ReAct-style agent，让 LLM 调用 SageMath 获得可执行、可验证反馈，并结合 Context7 获取较新的文档信息；同时提出多步后处理和多阶段验证 pipeline，用来提高 RealMath 问题集的抽取可靠性。
summary.experiments: 在 RealMath 的研究级数学问题上评估多个 frontier models。SageMath access 在所有被测模型上带来平均 +9.7 个百分点提升，单模型提升范围为 +1.5 到 +27.8 个百分点，并缩小开源权重与闭源模型差距。摘要未列出具体模型清单和统计显著性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether SageMath-augmented LLM agents can solve computational and experimental mathematics problems more reliably than language-only reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mostly evaluation and workflow analysis. It measures the role of CAS tools, which is often secondary to theorem proving and autoformalization in AI-for-math work, and refines the RealMath benchmark extraction and validation process.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setup uses a ReAct-style agent that combines LLM reasoning with executable feedback from SageMath and documentation access through Context7. It also adds multi-step post-processing and a multi-stage validation pipeline for improving the extracted RealMath problem set.
summary_en.experiments: The authors evaluate frontier models on research-level RealMath problems. SageMath access improves performance by +9.7 percentage points on average, with gains ranging from +1.5 to +27.8 points, and narrows the gap between open-weight and closed models. The abstract does not list the full model set or significance tests.

recommendation.zh: 结论符合直觉但数字可留意；只看工具增益分布和 RealMath 清洗流程，别当作数学推理范式突破。
recommendation.en: The result is intuitive but the gain distribution is worth noting; read the tool-ablation and RealMath cleanup, not as a new math-reasoning paradigm.

paper.title: Behavior Leverage Imbalance in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: Agentic language models must learn when to call tools, when to consume tool responses, and when to answer directly. This makes multi-teacher on-policy distillation a natural training strategy: one teacher can specialize in tool calls, another in direct responses, and the student can learn from both on its own generated distribution. We show that this strategy can induce a behavior shift that is invisible from aggregate losses alone. In a two-teacher tool-use setting, vanilla generalized knowledg

summary.core_problem: 论文关注多教师 on-policy distillation 在工具调用模型中的一个隐蔽失效模式：学生模型虽然学会了更多正确的工具调用，但同时更容易在本应直接回答的样本上误调用工具。这个行为偏移不能从总 loss、token 数量或全序列平均 divergence 中直接看出来。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对 LLM 基座研究的价值不在于提出新的蒸馏框架，而在于把“token 级训练信号的位置”纳入分析。工具调用、函数名、结构标记这类 mode-entry token 一旦被强化，会改变后续整条生成轨迹；自然语言回答信号则分散在大量内容 token 上，对“调用工具还是直接回答”这个离散边界的控制更弱。这个观察对 agent post-train、工具使用数据配比、格式学习、以及 pretrain 到 posttrain 的接口都有参考意义：不能只看平均 loss 或教师贡献，还要看训练信号落在什么生成决策点上。
summary.technical_approach:
方法建立在多教师 GKD 式 on-policy distillation 上。学生先用当前策略生成轨迹，再由教师在学生生成分布上给出 token-level divergence 监督。每个样本带有 teacher tag，路由到 tool-call teacher 或 response teacher。两个教师从同一基座模型出发，分别在结构化工具调用样本和直接回答样本上训练。主实验还加入一个小权重 supervised loss，作为工具调用格式的锚点。

论文的核心分析是 behavior leverage imbalance。作者排查了几类直观解释：工具调用样本是否拿到更多 token exposure，全序列 per-token JSD 是否更大，梯度 proxy 是否偏向 tool teacher。实验日志不支持这些解释，有些 run 中 response token 反而有更多 exposure 和更大 aggregate divergence。作者因此转向决策边界附近的局部信号，认为 <tool_call>、函数名、结构符号等位置具有更高行为杠杆。

缓解方法是 Soft Clamp。对 batch 内每个 token divergence d_i，设动态阈值 C = k * mean(d)。低于阈值的 token 不变；高于阈值的 token 使用 d'_i = d_i * C / stopgrad(d_i)。这样前向值被压到 C，反向梯度按 C / d_i 缩小，但不会像 hard clipping 一样完全截断困难 token 的学习信号。它也不同于全局 reweighting，因为只处理极端 token-level 信号。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 APIGen-MT、BFCL、When2Call，以及一个 BFCL multi-turn loop diagnostic。主要现象是：vanilla GKD 提高了工具调用召回和整体决策准确率，但同时提高了 over-calling，即在直接回答样本上错误进入工具调用模式。作者报告称，aggregate token exposure、full-sequence JSD 和梯度 proxy 都不能解释最终偏移；response-side decision pressure 与 over-calling 更相关。

Soft Clamp 在 GKD 变体中能降低 over-calling，同时保持 APIGen 决策准确率。论文给出的贡献更偏诊断和校准，而不是大规模模型能力提升。提供内容中没有出现具体数值表格，因此不宜补写精确提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 behavior leverage imbalance 的定义，重点理解为什么 mode-entry token 的局部信号会改变整条轨迹。再看 Problem Setup，确认 GKD、teacher routing、tool-call serialization 和 supervised format anchor 的训练细节。然后看 Soft Clamp 公式，注意 stopgrad 的作用：它让前向被压缩，但保留缩小后的梯度。实验部分重点看三类诊断指标是否失效，以及 decision-boundary 指标如何解释 over-calling。若只关心工程落地，可直接看 Soft Clamp 与 BFCL/When2Call 的对比结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a hidden failure mode in multi-teacher on-policy distillation for tool-using language models. A student can improve tool-call recall while also becoming more likely to call tools when a direct answer is appropriate. This shift is not visible from aggregate loss curves, token exposure, or full-sequence average divergence.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a training-dynamics observation rather than a new distillation paradigm. Token-level supervision should be judged not only by magnitude, but also by where it lands in the generation process. Tokens such as <tool_call>, function names, and structural markers can move the model into a different behavioral mode; natural-language response supervision is more distributed and often has weaker control over the discrete boundary between answering and tool use. This is relevant for agent post-training, tool-use data mixtures, format learning, and the interface between pretraining and downstream behavioral tuning.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The setup follows GKD-style multi-teacher on-policy distillation. The student samples continuations from its current policy, and teachers provide next-token distribution targets on those sampled trajectories. Each example is routed by a teacher tag to either a tool-call teacher or a response teacher. Both teachers start from the same base model and are specialized on structured tool-call targets or direct natural-language answers. A small supervised loss is also used as a format anchor for tool-call serialization.

The paper introduces the diagnosis of behavior leverage imbalance. The authors check several plausible aggregate explanations: whether tool-call samples receive more token exposure, whether full-sequence per-token JSD is larger for the tool teacher, and whether a gradient proxy is larger. These explanations do not match the observed behavior; in some runs, response tokens receive more exposure or larger aggregate divergence. The proposed explanation is that local signals near the decision boundary have higher behavioral leverage than average sequence-level signals.

The mitigation is Soft Clamp. For token divergence d_i, the method defines a batch-level threshold C = k * mean(d). Divergences below C are left unchanged. Divergences above C are transformed as d'_i = d_i * C / stopgrad(d_i). The forward contribution is capped around C, while the backward gradient is scaled down rather than removed. This differs from hard clipping, which can erase difficult-token gradients, and from global reweighting, which does not target extreme local signals.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation uses APIGen-MT, BFCL, When2Call, and a BFCL multi-turn loop diagnostic. Vanilla GKD improves decision accuracy and tool-call recall, but increases over-calling on cases that should be answered directly. Aggregate diagnostics such as token exposure, full-sequence JSD, and a gradient proxy do not explain the final tool-call shift. Decision-boundary pressure on the response side is reported as a more targeted diagnostic.

Soft Clamp reduces over-calling among GKD variants while preserving APIGen decision accuracy. The supplied text does not include the numerical tables, so exact deltas should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 20–30 minutes. Read the introduction for the definition of behavior leverage imbalance and the examples of high-leverage mode-entry tokens. Then read the problem setup to understand teacher routing, on-policy sampling, tool-call serialization, and the supervised format anchor. The Soft Clamp formula is the key technical part; pay attention to the stop-gradient term and how it changes forward values and gradients. In the experiments, focus on the failed aggregate explanations and the decision-boundary diagnostics rather than only the headline task metrics.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，不是因为 tool-use，而是它把“局部 token loss 如何扭曲全局行为”讲得很像真问题；先看行为杠杆分析，别只盯 aggregate KL。
recommendation.en: Worth reading not for tool use per se, but because it makes a credible case that local token losses can distort global behavior; read the leverage analysis before trusting aggregate KL.

paper.title: From Atomic Actions to Standard Operating Procedures: Iterative Tool Optimization for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Tool utilization enables Large Language Model (LLM) agents to interact with the real world and resolve complex tasks. However, existing agent frameworks predominantly rely on static toolsets composed of granular atomic actions (e.g., basic file I/O or single-turn search), which forces agents to reinvent low-level logic for every recurring workflow, leading to increased reasoning overhead and failure rates. In this study, we propose that agents can achieve self-evolution by synthesizing these ato

summary.core_problem: 让工具增强型 LLM agent 不再只依赖静态的原子工具（atomic actions），而是能从自身执行轨迹中抽取可复用的多步流程（SOP，高阶工具），并通过迭代的合并/评估/剪枝持续优化工具集，降低长链推理与交互轮次带来的失败率。
summary.importance: 对“基座预训练/训练动态/数据效率”相关性较弱，更偏 agent 系统工程与工具管理。可借鉴点主要在：把长轨迹压缩成可调用子程序，可能减少推理 token 与交互成本；以及“工具集会膨胀，需要生命周期管理”的经验。但它不涉及预训练目标、数据配比、tokenizer、scaling 或训练稳定性等核心问题。
summary.technical_approach:
EvoSOP 框架是模型无关的系统循环：
- 从 agent 的执行轨迹里识别重复且有效的原子动作序列，将其抽象为 SOP（可调用的高阶工具，封装多步逻辑）。
- 在同一迭代周期内做工具集治理：合并冗余 SOP、基于历史表现评估并剪枝低效工具，避免工具集膨胀带来的决策噪声。
- 形式化上把 agent 交互建模为 ReAct 风格的 reasoning+tool-call 序列，并把 persona/goal/history/memory/toolset 作为上下文状态的一部分。
summary.experiments: 摘要与引言层面只给出定性结论：在多个 benchmark 上提升任务成功率并减少交互轮次，相比若干 baseline 更好。你提供的全文片段未包含具体 benchmark 名称、成功率提升幅度、平均轮次下降、以及对“合并/剪枝策略”的消融；需要在实验章节与附录表格中核对。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读即可，优先看：
- Introduction：问题定义（原子工具导致长链推理开销、工具集膨胀）与 EvoSOP 的迭代生命周期。
- 方法章节中 SOP 抽取、评估指标、合并与剪枝规则（这些决定了是否可迁移到你的 agent 框架）。
预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟；若只关心预训练研究，可跳过。

summary_en.core_problem: How to let tool-augmented LLM agents evolve beyond static atomic tools by extracting reusable multi-step Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) from their own execution trajectories, and iteratively managing the toolset (merge/evaluate/prune) to reduce long-horizon reasoning overhead and failures.
summary_en.importance: Only loosely connected to foundation-model pretraining. The main transferable insight is toolset lifecycle management: compressing recurring long action chains into callable routines can reduce interaction rounds and token budget, while uncontrolled tool growth can add decision noise. It does not contribute to pretraining objectives, data/tokenization, scaling laws, or optimization dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach:
EvoSOP is a model-agnostic system loop:
- Mine execution trajectories to identify recurring, useful sequences of atomic actions and package them as higher-order SOP tools.
- Iteratively optimize the toolset by merging redundant SOPs and pruning low-utility tools based on historical performance, preventing toolset bloat.
- Uses a ReAct-like agent formalization where context includes persona, goal, interaction history, external memory, and the current toolset.
summary_en.experiments: The excerpt reports qualitative outcomes: higher task success rates and fewer interaction rounds across multiple benchmarks versus baselines. The provided text does not include benchmark names, exact deltas, or ablations for SOP construction/merging/pruning; those need to be checked in the experiment section and appendix tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction for the motivation and the iterative tool-optimization lifecycle, then jump to the method details on SOP extraction and pruning/merging criteria (the parts that determine portability). Budget ~20–30 minutes. If your focus is pretraining research, this is optional.

recommendation.zh: 读 §方法和消融；高阶工具自举是好方向，但要重点查 SOP 库是否吃了测试分布。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; higher-order tool bootstrapping is promising, but check whether the SOP library absorbs the test distribution.

paper.title: Reason Less, Verify More: Deterministic Gates Recover a Silent Policy-Violation Failure Mode in Tool-Using LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Tool-using LLM agents can violate the very policies they are deployed to enforce while appearing to complete the task successfully. In policy-permissive environments, a tool may execute any well-formed call even when the corresponding state transition is forbidden by domain policy. The result is a silent wrong state (a booking cancelled, a passenger count changed, a claim acted on without verification) that neither the tool nor the agent's self-report exposes. We study this failure mode in the $

summary.core_problem: 研究工具调用 Agent 在表面成功完成任务时，是否会悄悄执行违反业务策略的状态修改。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 安全失效模式分析和轻量系统干预。它指出工具调用的成功返回不等于策略合规，错误可能表现为 silent wrong state，而不是显式 tool error。
summary.technical_approach: 在 τ²-bench 航空领域分析 policy-permissive 工具环境：工具只检查调用格式，不检查业务策略。论文提出 deterministic read-only pre-execution gates，在写操作执行前读取当前状态和候选调用，按硬规则决定是否放行。方法不依赖模型再推理，而是把一部分策略验证移到确定性门控。
summary.experiments: 在 gpt-4o-mini 预算 Agent 上，观察到的失败中 78% 是没有工具报错的 silent wrong-state failures，且跨不相交随机种子可复现。四个 gate 的组合把全基准成功率从 29.6% 提升到 42.0%，提升 12.4 个百分点；摘要提到使用 paired task-level bootstrap。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether tool-using agents can silently violate domain policies while appearing to complete the task successfully.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-safety failure analysis with a lightweight systems intervention. It separates successful tool execution from policy-compliant state transition and highlights silent wrong-state failures.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors analyze a policy-permissive tool environment in the τ²-bench airline domain, where tools execute well-formed calls even when the transition is forbidden by policy. They add deterministic, read-only pre-execution gates that inspect the proposed write call and the current state before execution. The key choice is to verify policy with hard gates rather than asking the model to reason more.
summary_en.experiments: On a budget agent using gpt-4o-mini, 78% of observed failures are silent wrong-state failures without tool errors, and the aggregate failure rate is reproducible across disjoint seeds. A four-gate suite improves full-benchmark success from 29.6% to 42.0%, a 12.4 percentage-point gain, with paired task-level bootstrap analysis.

recommendation.zh: 只看 failure taxonomy 和 gate ablation；它提醒工具成功率会高估 Agent 真实可靠性。
recommendation.en: Read only the failure taxonomy and gate ablation; it is a useful reminder that tool success can overstate agent reliability.

paper.title: SkillCenter: A Large-Scale Source-Grounded Skill Library for Autonomous AI Agents
paper.abstract: Autonomous AI agents can execute complex tasks with limited human review, yet they often lack the grounded operational knowledge to make their outputs not just executable but correct, secure, and maintainable. We introduce SkillCenter, to our knowledge the largest open skill library for agents by total count: 216,938 structured skills across 24 domain bundles. A SkillGate-filtered pipeline contributes 114,565 source-grounded skills from peer-reviewed journals, ArXiv, and over 24,000 technical so

summary.core_problem: 为自主 agent 构建大规模、可追溯来源的技能库，缓解 agent 缺少可靠操作知识的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 资源与系统管线。它不是预训练数据工作，也不是通用建模方法；价值主要在 source-grounded skill 的组织方式和质量控制流程。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SkillCenter，包含 216,938 条结构化技能，覆盖 24 个 domain bundles。管线包括多源采集、LLM 质量门控 SkillGate、模板化生成、迭代式 source grounding、质量控制发布；每条保留声明需要映射到源文献或技术资料中的精确引用。离线分发采用 SQLite FTS5 可搜索 bundle。
summary.experiments: 资源包括 114,565 条来自 peer-reviewed journals、ArXiv 和 24,000 多个技术来源的 source-grounded skills，以及 102,373 条 GitHub 和 ClawHub marketplace 社区技能。摘要未给出下游 agent benchmark 的量化收益。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a large source-grounded skill library to give autonomous agents more reliable operational knowledge.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent resource and pipeline contribution. It is not pretraining data in the foundation-model sense, but the source-grounding design may be useful for agent memory and tool-use systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: SkillCenter contains 216,938 structured skills across 24 bundles. The pipeline combines multi-source acquisition, an LLM-based SkillGate, template-driven generation, iterative source grounding, and quality-controlled publishing. Retained claims are mapped to exact source quotations.
summary_en.experiments: The library includes 114,565 source-grounded skills from journals, arXiv, and more than 24,000 technical sources, plus 102,373 community skills from GitHub and ClawHub. The abstract does not report clear downstream agent-performance gains.

recommendation.zh: 作为 agent skill 数据资产备查即可；没有下游闭环收益时，规模数字对预训练判断帮助有限。
recommendation.en: Keep it as an agent-skill resource reference; without closed-loop performance evidence, the scale numbers do not teach much for pretraining.

paper.title: When Agents Remember Too Much: Memory Poisoning Attacks on Large Language Model Agents
paper.abstract: Personal AI agents powered by large language models can reason and act using available tools to access emails, manage calendars, and push code to remote repositories, all with minimal oversight. When augmented with long-term memory, an agent can recall specific details relevant to the current task, reducing the need for large context windows. Currently, long-term memory agents tend to fall into two distinct domains: conversational and action-planning agents. Personal assistant agents sit at the

summary.core_problem: 指出带长期记忆的个人 LLM Agent 会把外部不可信内容写入记忆，从而形成可持久化、可延迟触发的攻击面。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 安全威胁建模。它把风险从普通 prompt injection 扩展到记忆子系统，尤其适用于会读邮件、管理日历、推送代码这类有工具权限的个人助手。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GhostWriter 攻击向量，分为 injection 和 activation 两阶段：攻击者先通过隐藏 payload 污染 Agent 的长期记忆；之后当 Agent 在相关任务中检索到这段记忆时，恶意指令被激活并影响工具调用或决策。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体实验平台、Agent 框架、模型、攻击成功率或防御基线。可确认的是论文聚焦 conversational memory 与 action-planning agent 交汇处的个人助手场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how long-term memory in personal LLM agents can be poisoned by untrusted external content and later activated during tool-using tasks.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent-security threat model. It extends the usual prompt-injection framing from transient context attacks to persistent memory corruption in personal assistants with sensitive tools.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces GhostWriter, a two-phase attack. During injection, an adversary sends a hidden payload that enters the agent's memory store. During activation, the poisoned memory is retrieved in a future task and steers the agent's behavior or tool calls.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report the evaluated agent stack, models, success rates, or defense baselines. The stated scope is the intersection of conversational long-term memory and action-planning personal agents.

recommendation.zh: 不改预训练方法，但记忆污染这个 threat model 很干净；做 Agent memory 或 tool-use 的看攻击流程即可。
recommendation.en: It does not change pretraining, but the memory-poisoning threat model is clean; read the attack flow if you work on agent memory or tool use.

paper.title: PolyWorkBench: Benchmarking Multilingual Long-Horizon LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have shown strong performance in long-horizon tasks that require planning, tool use, and interaction with external environments. However, most existing benchmarks implicitly assume a monolingual setting, where the entire execution process, including reasoning, tool invocation, and output generation, is conducted within a single language. In contrast, real-world applications often involve multilingual inputs and outputs within a unified workflow, yet the interact

summary.core_problem: 解决现有长程 agent benchmark 默认单语执行，无法评估真实工作流中多语言输入、推理、工具调用和输出交织带来的能力缺口。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 multilingual long-horizon agent benchmark。对 agent 评测设计有价值，也能给多语种工具使用和轨迹监督提供数据视角，但与 LLM 基座预训练的直接联系有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PolyWorkBench，覆盖 commerce、knowledge work、legal analysis、localization、manufacturing 五类工作流，共 67 个任务；任务要求处理异构多语输入、迭代推理、调用外部工具并生成结构化输出，重点考察多语环境下的长程执行。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出参评模型名单和具体分数。预期实验会比较多种 LLM agent 在单语与多语工作流中的性能差异，并分析语言切换对规划、工具调用和错误累积的影响。作为 benchmark，其价值主要在任务构造而非模型方法。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the gap that existing long-horizon agent benchmarks assume monolingual execution and therefore miss failures arising from multilingual inputs, reasoning, tool use, and outputs within one workflow.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a multilingual long-horizon agent benchmark. It is useful for agent evaluation design and may inform multilingual tool-use supervision, but it is only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces PolyWorkBench, spanning 67 tasks across commerce, knowledge work, legal analysis, localization, and manufacturing. Tasks require heterogeneous multilingual inputs, iterative reasoning, external tool use, and structured outputs, explicitly targeting multilingual agent execution.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not list evaluated models or exact scores. The likely evaluation compares multiple LLM agents under monolingual versus multilingual workflows and analyzes how language switching affects planning, tool invocation, and error accumulation. Its value lies primarily in task design rather than a new model method.

recommendation.zh: 做 agent eval 的可以收下，但对 pretrain 研究员只需知道一个事实：多语工具链会引入新的长程误差源，读任务设计和失败类型就够了。
recommendation.en: Useful if you track agent evals, but for pretraining the only takeaway is that multilingual tool chains create new long-horizon failure modes; skim the task design and error taxonomy.

paper.title: Beyond the Leaderboard: A Synthesis of Tool-Use, Planning, and Reasoning Failures in Large Language Model Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly evaluated on their ability to use tools, plan multi-step tasks, coordinate with other agents, and operate over extended horizons. Reported benchmark gains often obscure recurring failure modes documented across otherwise unrelated evaluation efforts. This paper synthesizes 27 benchmark, taxonomy, and audit papers (2023-2026), spanning 19 distinct benchmarks, into a cross-cutting taxonomy of agent limitations. To our knowledge, this is the first

summary.core_problem: 解决 agent leaderboard 只报分数、不系统归纳失败模式的问题，试图给出跨 benchmark 的统一失效分类。
summary.importance: 这是一篇综述/综合分析型工作，价值在于把 tool use、planning、long-horizon、multi-agent 和安全失效放到同一框架下。对做 agent eval 或 post-train 的人有参考，但对预训练研究员的直接增益有限。
summary.technical_approach: 综合 27 篇 benchmark、taxonomy 和 audit 论文，覆盖 19 个 benchmark，提炼六类失败簇，包括工具调用错误、规划与约束满足失败、长上下文退化、多 agent 协调失败、安全与安全性问题，以及测量有效性缺陷。
summary.experiments: 不是原始方法实验，而是文献综合；核心产出是 taxonomy 而非新 benchmark、新 judge 或新模型，因此更适合作为 agent 评测地图，而不是技术结论来源。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the gap between leaderboard scores and a systematic understanding of failure modes in LLM agents, aiming to build a unified taxonomy across benchmarks.
summary_en.importance: This is a synthesis paper. Its value lies in organizing failures in tool use, planning, long-horizon reasoning, multi-agent coordination, and safety under one framework. Useful for agent evaluation and post-training discussions, but only indirectly relevant to pretraining researchers.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper synthesizes 27 benchmark, taxonomy, and audit papers spanning 19 benchmarks, and extracts six failure clusters including tool invocation errors, planning and constraint failures, long-horizon degradation, multi-agent coordination failures, safety/security failures, and measurement-validity issues.
summary_en.experiments: There are no original method experiments; the output is a taxonomy rather than a new benchmark, judge, or model. It is better used as an evaluation map than as a source of technical causal claims.

recommendation.zh: 这是文献整理，不是新结果；做 agent eval 时可拿来当 failure checklist，其他人看摘要和 taxonomy 就够了。
recommendation.en: This is a synthesis rather than a new result; use it as a failure checklist for agent eval, otherwise the abstract and taxonomy are enough.

paper.title: When Does Tool Use Increase the Expressive Power of Finite-Precision Recurrent Models?
paper.abstract: Modern sequence models are increasingly deployed as agents that interleave token generation with calls to external tools. We give an exact, architecture-level account of when such tool access increases computational expressivity. We model any fixed finite-precision recurrent sequence model, including finite-precision state-space models (SSMs) with $B$ bits of internal state, as a deterministic finite-state controller interacting with an oracle through a finite command/observation interface. Our

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是一个很具体但常被口头化处理的问题：有限精度的循环序列模型，在接入外部工具之后，表达能力到底何时会真正提升。作者把“固定参数、固定精度”的 recurrent model 统一抽象成有限状态控制器，再把工具抽象成带有限命令/观测接口的 oracle，给出一条清晰分界线：如果工具本身也是有限状态、接口也是有限的，那么工具几乎不增加表达能力；如果工具提供了最小形式的无界外部存储，那么即便控制器内部状态是常数级，也可以达到图灵完备。问题的关键不在模型名字是 RNN、SSM 还是 selective SSM，而在有限精度带来的有限状态本质，以及工具接口是否引入了无界记忆。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它把“tool use 会不会让小模型变强”从经验问题变成了结构性结论，尤其适合解释 agent/tool-augmented LM 的能力边界。第二，它直接触及 finite-precision SSM 的理论上限：不带外部无界记忆时，SSM 仍受限于 regular language；带上最小 tape oracle 后，能力跃迁来自外部内存而不是 SSM 内部动力学。第三，它对预训练研究有一个很实际的提醒：如果系统能力提升主要来自外部 scratchpad、代码执行器、检索或可写 memory，那么训练目标和模型架构本身的表达能力分析，必须和“接口预算”分开记账。贡献类型偏理论刻画，不是 recipe 改进，但结论很硬，适合作为理解 tool-augmented LM、CoT、external memory 的底层参照。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者先定义 observation-driven finite-state controller：模型先读入输入串，随后在生成阶段可以输出 token、发出工具命令、接收工具观测或停止。任何具有 B bit 内部状态的固定有限精度 recurrent model，都可视为至多 2^B 个状态的确定性控制器。

第一部分是有限状态工具的可内化定理。若 oracle 也只是有限内存 M、有限命令字母表和有限观测字母表，那么控制器只需额外增加 log2|M|+O(1) bit，就能把 oracle 的状态并入自身状态，做 product-state simulation。这个结论说明：有限接口、有限记忆的工具不会从根本上突破有限状态机的表达边界。作者还强调有限状态接口假设是必要的；一旦放松，哪怕是 1 bit oracle，也可能因为接口编码方式而变得任意强。

第二部分是最小无界工具的构造。作者定义了一个 tape oracle，只支持局部 read / write / move 三种操作。控制器内部只需 O(log|Q|+log|Γ|) bit，就能模拟任意单带图灵机，其中 Q 是图灵机状态集，Γ 是带符号表。这里的思想很直接：把无界工作记忆完全外包给 tape，控制器只维护当前 TM 状态和少量局部信息。这个构造给出了“工具增强表达力”的最小充分条件：不是复杂计算器，不是强检索器，而是可寻址、可写、可移动的无界外部存储。

第三部分是有限问题上的严格分离。作者用 EQ_n 作为例子，证明没有工具时需要 2^n 个控制器状态；而有 tape access 时，一个固定常数大小的控制器就能对所有 n 求解。这一点很重要，因为它避免了只给出渐近图灵完备而缺少有限规模 separation 的常见问题。

第四部分把上述控制器结果落到 selective affine SSM。作者证明，任意 observation-driven finite-state controller 都可以被一层 finite-precision selective affine SSM 精确实现，隐藏状态采用 one-hot binary 编码，转移矩阵取 {0,1}，bias 为 0。把 tape simulation 套进去，就得到 finite-precision selective SSM controller 在带 tape oracle 时可达图灵完备。正文中的 one-hot 实现需要 O(|Q||Γ|) hidden dimension；补充材料进一步给出对数级改进：在明确不把固定参数表和外部 tape 计入 recurrent-memory 预算的前提下，只需 O(log B) recurrent bits 就能模拟任意 B-state 图灵机。与此同时，作者还给出一个 matching impossibility：若没有外部内存，要在一次 affine recurrent update 中精确实现任意转移映射 f:[B]×{0,1}→[B]，总 recurrent dimension 必须恰好是 B-1，即使允许多层 triangular selective-affine 结构也不行。这个负结果把“为什么对数级结果成立”依赖哪些建模约定讲得很清楚。
summary.experiments:
这篇文章没有训练实验，核心证据是精确构造和无条件下界。需要抓住的“结果数字”主要是理论资源界：
1. 有限状态 oracle 可被内化，额外内存开销为 log2|M|+O(1) bit，其中 M 是 oracle memory。
2. 带 read/write/move tape oracle 时，控制器只需 O(log|Q|+log|Γ|) bit 内部状态即可模拟任意单带图灵机。
3. 对 EQ_n，纯有限状态控制器需要 2^n 个状态；而带 tape 的常数大小控制器可统一处理所有 n。
4. selective affine SSM 的直接 one-hot 实现，hidden dimension 为 O(|Q||Γ|)；补充材料中的改进把 recurrent-memory 降到 O(log B) bit 来模拟任意 B-state 图灵机。
5. 三符号显式实现给出常数 C0=9。
6. 无外部内存时，精确实现任意 f:[B]×{0,1}→[B] 的一次 affine recurrent update，需要总 recurrent dimension 恰为 B-1。

如果从“实验洞察”角度理解，这篇工作的消融对应的是建模假设消融：有限工具 vs 无界 tape、one-hot realization vs logarithmic simulation、带外部内存 vs 不带外部内存。作者把每一步能力变化都和资源预算一一对应，没有依赖近似论证。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓主线，不必一开始陷入附录细节。优先看 Introduction 和 Table 1，先建立那条二分结论：有限状态工具几乎无增益；最小无界外存足以带来图灵完备。然后看 Section 4 的 product-state simulation，这部分最能帮助判断“哪些 tool use 只是把有限 automaton 串起来”。接着看 Section 5 和 Section 6，理解 tape oracle 的接口为何已经足够，以及控制器内部到底需要记什么。Section 7 的 EQ_n separation 值得看，它把抽象结论落到一个有限、可比较的问题上。若你关心 SSM 理论边界，再看 Section 8，重点看 finite-state controller 到 one-layer selective affine SSM 的精确实现。

补充材料更适合带着问题读。Appendix B 的 O(log B) 结果和 impossibility theorem 是最值得深挖的两处：前者说明对数级模拟依赖“外部 tape 免费、固定参数不计入 recurrent budget”的资源记账方式；后者说明如果不借助外部内存，想靠 recurrent update 本身压缩任意状态转移，维度下界是硬的。预计泛读 30–45 分钟可抓住主结论；若要认真理解 selective SSM realization 与资源记账，建议预留 1.5–2 小时。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a precise version of a common systems question: when does tool use actually increase the expressive power of a fixed finite-precision recurrent model? The authors model any such sequence model as a deterministic finite-state controller, and model tools as oracles with finite command/observation interfaces. The main result is a sharp dichotomy. If the tool is itself finite-state with a bounded interface, it adds essentially no expressive power. If the tool provides even a minimal form of unbounded writable external memory, then a controller with only constant internal memory can become Turing complete. The point is not whether the controller is called an RNN or an SSM; the point is finite precision versus unbounded external memory.
summary_en.importance: This matters for pretraining and foundation-model research in three ways. First, it turns a fuzzy intuition about tool-augmented models into an exact architectural statement. Second, it clarifies the limits of finite-precision SSMs: without unbounded external memory they remain finite-state, hence regular-language limited; with a tape-like oracle, the jump in power comes from the external memory, not from the internal recurrence. Third, it gives a clean accounting principle for modern LM systems: if capability gains come from scratchpads, interpreters, retrieval, or writable memory, those gains should not be attributed to the base model’s intrinsic expressivity. The contribution is theoretical rather than recipe-oriented, but the conclusions are directly relevant to how one interprets tool use, CoT, and memory-augmented language models.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The setup is an observation-driven finite-state controller. After reading the input, the controller enters a generation phase where it may emit output tokens, issue tool commands, receive observations, or halt. Any fixed finite-precision recurrent model with B bits of internal state induces such a controller with at most 2^B states.

The first result is a product-state simulation theorem for finite-state tools. If the oracle has finite memory M and finite command/observation alphabets, then the controller can internalize the oracle by augmenting its own state with only log2|M|+O(1) extra bits. So bounded-interface finite-state tools do not fundamentally extend expressivity. The bounded-interface assumption is essential; once it is relaxed, even a one-bit oracle can encode arbitrarily strong behavior.

The second result introduces a minimal unbounded tool: a tape oracle with only local read, write, and move operations. The controller needs only O(log|Q|+log|Γ|) internal bits to simulate any single-tape Turing machine, where Q is the TM state set and Γ is the tape alphabet. The construction isolates the true source of added power: not sophisticated computation inside the tool, but unbounded writable addressable memory.

The third step gives a finite, non-asymptotic separation. For the language EQ_n, a controller without tools needs 2^n states, while a single constant-size controller with tape access solves EQ_n for all n. This is useful because it complements the Turing-completeness statement with a concrete finite-size gap.

The fourth step maps the controller results to selective affine SSMs. The paper proves that every observation-driven finite-state controller can be realized exactly by a one-layer finite-precision selective affine SSM with one-hot binary hidden states, {0,1} transition matrices, and zero biases. Plugging in the tape simulation yields Turing completeness for finite-precision selective SSM controllers with tape access. The main text gives a one-hot realization with hidden dimension O(|Q||Γ|). The supplement then sharpens this to O(log B) recurrent bits for simulating any B-state Turing machine, under an explicit accounting convention where the external tape is free memory and fixed parameters/readout tables are not charged to recurrent memory. The supplement also proves a matching impossibility result: without external memory, exactly realizing an arbitrary transition map f:[B]×{0,1}→[B] in one affine recurrent update requires total recurrent dimension exactly B-1, even with multiple triangular selective-affine layers. That negative result makes the modeling assumptions behind the logarithmic simulation fully explicit.
summary_en.experiments:
There are no training experiments; the evidence is entirely in exact constructions and unconditional lower bounds. The key quantitative results are resource bounds:
1. A finite-state oracle can be internalized with only log2|M|+O(1) extra bits, where M is the oracle memory.
2. With a read/write/move tape oracle, the controller needs only O(log|Q|+log|Γ|) internal bits to simulate any single-tape Turing machine.
3. For EQ_n, a tool-free controller requires 2^n states, while a constant-size controller with tape access handles all n.
4. The direct one-hot selective affine SSM realization uses hidden dimension O(|Q||Γ|), while the supplement reduces recurrent memory to O(log B) bits for simulating any B-state Turing machine.
5. The supplement gives an explicit three-symbol realization with constant C0=9.
6. Without external memory, exactly implementing an arbitrary f:[B]×{0,1}→[B] in one affine recurrent update requires recurrent dimension exactly B-1.

If one wants an “ablation” view, the paper effectively ablates assumptions: finite-state oracle versus unbounded tape, one-hot realization versus logarithmic simulation, and external memory versus no external memory. Each capability jump is tied to a precise resource change.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with the Introduction and Table 1. They contain the main dichotomy and the intended interpretation. Then read Section 4 for the product-state simulation theorem; this is the cleanest part if you want to understand when tool use is merely composing finite automata. Next read Sections 5 and 6 to see why the tape oracle is already sufficient and what the controller actually has to remember internally. Section 7 is worth reading because the EQ_n separation turns the asymptotic story into a concrete finite example. If your interest is in SSM expressivity, go to Section 8 and focus on the exact realization of finite-state controllers by one-layer selective affine SSMs.

The supplement is where the sharper resource accounting lives. Appendix B is the main place to spend extra time: the O(log B) simulation result is useful, but only if you keep track of what is and is not charged to recurrent memory; the impossibility theorem is equally important because it shows that the logarithmic result does not come from compressing arbitrary recurrent transitions in the no-tool setting. A first pass takes about 30–45 minutes. A careful read of the SSM realization and the accounting conventions takes closer to 1.5–2 hours.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不教你怎么训模型，但它把“工具是否真的提升能力”切成了可证明的两类；做 agent 或外部记忆接口的人应直接读定理和建模假设。
recommendation.en: It will not tell you how to train a model, but it cleanly separates tools that truly expand capability from those that merely repackage finite-state computation; read the formal setup and theorems.

paper.title: Controlling Tool Use with Heading-Specific Activation Steering
paper.abstract: Tool-augmented large language models extend their capabilities beyond parametric knowledge through external tools, but tend to invoke them unnecessarily. We investigate whether tool-use decisions have any stable internal representation that can be extracted and manipulated, a question that is non-trivial given that tools exist entirely in context at inference time and have no direct encoding in model weights. We show that steering vectors extracted from heading-anchors positions exert bidirectio

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文问的是：工具调用这个完全由上下文定义的行为，是否存在可被抽取和干预的内部激活方向。问题不只是减少工具过用，而是验证模型在即将生成 Search、Code、AskUser 这类结构化 heading 时，是否形成了稳定到足以做因果控制的表示。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不高，但对 agentic LLM 的机制分析和推理时控制有参考意义。它把 activation steering 从情感、拒答、真实性这类有参数化语义基础的概念，推进到工具调用这种非参数化、上下文临时定义的行为。主要启发是：模型行为可被局部激活干预控制，并不必然说明存在干净的线性概念表示；因果可控性和几何可解释性可能分离。
summary.technical_approach: 方法围绕结构化输出中的 Heading-Anchors 展开，例如 ### Reasoning、### Search、### Code、### AskUser、### Final Response。作者不在全生成过程中持续 steering，而只在模型即将形成 heading 的位置做局部干预。具体做法是：先收集带完整工具交互轨迹的数据，在指定层抽取每个 heading 的 leading ### token hidden state；再以样本为单位比较 Reasoning heading 与目标工具 heading 的激活，构造工具类型相关的 steering vector；推理时检测 imminent ### heading formation，并只重跑被触发的那个 decoding step，在指定层通过 hook 加入或移除相关方向。样本级构造避免长轨迹因 heading 数量多而被过度加权。与常规 representation engineering 的区别在于，它处理的不是权重中长期学习到的概念，而是 prompt 内临时声明的工具接口。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖五个开源 instruction-tuned 模型和三个工具使用领域。主要现象是：activation addition 可以显著压低工具调用率，orthogonalization 反而会把工具调用率推高，说明该方向对工具选择有双向因果作用。抑制效果在模型参数知识足以解决的问题上更明显；在确实需要检索、代码执行或向用户澄清的场景中效果下降。更大的模型整体更难被 steering 改变。几何分析给出一个负结果：工具调用步相对 suppression vector 的 cosine similarity 呈弥散的双峰分布，而不是线性概念假设下应看到的稳定负对齐；不同工具类型使用的内部特征维度重叠较低。提供内容未给出具体模型名称、层号、调用率下降幅度和各 benchmark 分数。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Methodology 中 heading-anchor state 的抽取、样本级 delta 的构造、触发式局部干预流程；再看结果部分中 suppression、orthogonalization 的对照，以及 cosine/geometric analysis。最值得深挖的是因果 steering 有效但线性结构不干净这一点，它提醒不要把 activation steering 的成功直接解释为发现了单一线性概念方向。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether tool-use decisions in tool-augmented LLMs have an internal activation pattern that can be extracted and causally controlled, even though tools are defined only in the prompt and interaction context rather than encoded as stable parametric concepts.
summary_en.importance: The work is not central to base-model pretraining, but it is useful for understanding controllability in agentic LLMs. Its main contribution is methodological: it tests activation steering on a non-parametric behavior, unlike prior steering work on sentiment, refusal, or truthfulness. The important lesson is that causal steering can work even when the underlying geometry does not look like a clean linear representation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses structured headings such as ### Reasoning, ### Search, ### Code, ### AskUser, and ### Final Response as intervention points. Instead of steering every token, the method intervenes only when the model is about to form a new heading. The authors collect complete tool-use trajectories, run the model over the full prompt-response sequence, and extract hidden states at the leading ### token of each heading at a chosen layer. For each tool type, they construct a contrastive vector from Reasoning-heading states and tool-heading states, using sample-level averaging to avoid overweighting trajectories with many headings. At inference time, the system detects imminent heading formation, reruns only that decoding step, and applies a local hook-based activation intervention at the target layer.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments span five open-source instruction-tuned models and three domains. Adding the extracted vectors suppresses tool calls below baseline, while orthogonalizing hidden states with respect to the vectors increases tool use. Suppression is strongest when the model can answer from parametric knowledge and weaker when external search, code execution, or user clarification is actually needed. Larger models are more resistant to the intervention. The geometric analysis is the most informative result: tool-invocation states show a diffuse bimodal cosine-similarity pattern rather than consistent alignment, and different tool types rely on largely distinct feature dimensions. The provided content does not include exact model names, layer choices, or numerical suppression rates.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the heading-anchor construction, the sample-level steering vector estimator, and the triggered one-step intervention mechanism. Then read the causal-control results together with the cosine-similarity and cross-tool-overlap analysis. The key point is the gap between behavioral controllability and simple linear-representation explanations.

recommendation.zh: 值得看，不是因为 steering 又多强，而是它把“可控=线性特征”这个偷懒解释拆掉了；重点读几何分析那部分。
recommendation.en: Worth reading not for another steering trick, but because it weakens the lazy equation of controllability with linear feature encoding; focus on the geometry analysis.

paper.title: Beyond Static Evaluation: Building Simulation Environments for Scalable Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) evolve into autonomous agents, traditional static evaluation fails to capture multi-step decision-making. We introduce AgenticAI-Supervisor, an API and UI-driven RL Gym environment that decouples environment creation from scalable execution. By moving to verifiable execution outcomes, the platform generates high-fidelity traces and applies multi-dimensional reward shaping. Critically, our framework mitigates reward hacking through rigorous internal state validatio

summary.core_problem: 解决静态 benchmark 无法支撑 agent 多步决策优化的问题，尝试构建可扩展的 agentic RL 交互环境。
summary.importance: 价值在于把 agent 训练从静态评测转向可验证执行环境，并强调 reward hacking 控制。这对 post-train 与 RL 信号质量有一定启发，但离预训练本体较远，且当前展示仍偏平台雏形。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AgenticAI-Supervisor，一个 API/UI 驱动的 RL Gym 环境，将环境构建与大规模执行解耦；通过可验证执行结果生成轨迹，并使用多维 reward shaping，同时用内部状态校验和测试来抑制 reward hacking。
summary.experiments: 摘要只给出 customer support agent 个案，展示闭环反馈可用于模型优化；没有看到通用 agent 基线、跨任务泛化、规模曲线或 RL 收敛分析，因此证据强度有限。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the mismatch between static benchmarks and the needs of optimizing multi-step LLM agents, by building a scalable interactive environment for agentic RL.
summary_en.importance: The main value is the shift from static evaluation to verifiable execution environments, with explicit attention to reward-hacking control. That is somewhat relevant to post-training signal quality, but still fairly far from core pretraining research and currently looks like an early platform paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces AgenticAI-Supervisor, an API/UI-driven RL Gym environment that decouples environment creation from scalable execution. It uses verifiable execution outcomes to collect traces, applies multi-dimensional reward shaping, and validates internal state to reduce reward hacking.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract only mentions a customer-support-agent case study showing a closed-loop optimization setup. There is no evidence yet of strong general-agent baselines, cross-task transfer, scaling behavior, or RL convergence analysis, so the empirical support appears limited.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 RL 信号质量和 reward hacking，可只看环境设计与验证部分；目前更像平台提案，证据还不够硬。
recommendation.en: Read only the environment and reward-validation design if you care about RL signal quality; for now it looks more like a platform proposal than a settled result.

paper.title: SPORK: Self-Speculative Forking to Accelerate Agentic LLM Inference
paper.abstract: LLM agents are becoming a common interface for research, coding, and question answering, yet their Thought-Action-Observation loop is often serial: the model reasons, emits a tool call, then idles the GPU until the result returns. This wait consumes 16-37% of wall time in our workloads and 35-61% in prior reports. Speculative tool execution can hide this wait, but existing systems need auxiliary predictors, historical traces, or static workflow graphs, leaving a gap for training-free, day-one de

summary.core_problem: LLM Agent 的 Thought-Action-Observation 循环中，工具调用与模型推理串行执行，GPU 在等待工具返回时空转，工具等待占端到端时延的 16–61%，且随着推理速度提升这一瓶颈会更加突出；现有推测工具执行方案依赖辅助预测模型、历史轨迹或静态工作流图，无法做到免训练、零冷启动部署。
summary.importance: 提出一种无需训练、无需额外模型的自推测工具执行范式，直接利用正在运行的 LLM 自身作为预测器，为 Agent 推理时延优化提供了一条轻量可行的路径；对预训练研究的启发在于，指令微调模型在生成完整思维链之前就已确定后续工具调用，这一现象反映了模型内部决策与表层推理输出的时序错位，值得在对齐与推理增强训练中进一步研究。
summary.technical_approach: Spork（Self-Speculative Forking）是一个免训练的 serving 侧控制器，核心设计有三点：1）D1 首 token 分叉：在主生成流输出第一个 token 后分叉 KV cache，启动一个 probe 流提前预测完整工具调用，利用前缀缓存共享将 probe 开销从 1.6s 降到 0.35s；2）D2 置信度门控：用 probe 输出的 token logprob 均值作为置信度，达到阈值才真正派发工具调用，在最早的可信时刻提交以最大化重叠时间；3）D3 拒绝复用：即使预测不被严格匹配接受，probe 生成的前缀 token 可作为推测解码的 draft，被主流验证后复用，避免重复解码。整体采用严格的名称+参数匹配作为接受条件，失败则回退到串行执行，不影响任务正确率。
summary.experiments: 基于 Qwen3-32B 在五个 benchmark 上验证：1）首 token 分叉点的工具名称预测准确率在 GAIA、tau2-bench、BrowseComp、HotpotQA、BFCL 上达 74.6–99.6%；2）GAIA 上正确预测的平均 span 概率为 0.90，错误预测为 0.46，置信度可区分对错；随着思维链上下文增加，参数准确率从 7.6% 升至 97.5%；3）被拒绝的 probe 与最终工具调用中位数共享 18 个已验证 token，可让主流跳过 35–50% 的工具调用体重解码；4）GAIA（165 题，真实网页搜索）上完整配置 P50 时延从 34.7s 降到 31.2s（降 10%），P95 从 131.9s 降到 108.1s（降 18%），精确匹配准确率与基线相差在 1 个百分点以内；HotpotQA（200 题，真实 Wikipedia API）上完整配置处于 Pareto 最优。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，重点看第 3 节的三个实证发现（模型早知道现象、置信度可分性、前缀复用），这是方法成立的核心依据；第 4 节系统设计的 D1/D2/D3 三个组件可快速浏览；实验部分关注图 2 的时延剖分和表 2/3 的准确率与延迟数字。预计阅读时间 30–40 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In the Thought-Action-Observation loop of LLM agents, tool execution and model reasoning run serially, leaving the GPU idle while waiting for tool results. Tool wait accounts for 16–61% of end-to-end latency, and this bottleneck becomes more severe as inference speeds up. Existing speculative tool execution systems rely on auxiliary predictor models, historical traces, or static workflow graphs, and cannot be deployed in a training-free, day-one fashion.
summary_en.importance: Spork proposes a training-free, no-extra-model paradigm for speculative tool execution that uses the running LLM itself as the predictor, offering a lightweight path to reduce agent inference latency. For pretraining research, the observation that instruction-tuned models decide their next tool call before completing the full chain-of-thought reveals a temporal misalignment between internal decision and surface reasoning output, which merits further study in alignment and reasoning-enhanced training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Spork is a training-free serving-side controller with three core designs: (1) D1 first-token fork: a probe stream is forked from the KV cache after the first token of the main generation to predict the full tool call early; prefix-cache sharing reduces probe overhead from 1.6s to 0.35s. (2) D2 confidence gating: the mean token logprob of the probe is used as confidence; tool dispatch only triggers above a threshold, committing at the earliest confident moment to maximize overlap. (3) D3 rejected-probe reuse: even when a prediction is rejected by strict matching, the verified prefix tokens from the probe serve as a speculative-decoding draft and are reused by the main stream, avoiding redundant decoding. Strict name+argument matching is the acceptance criterion; on failure the system falls back to serial execution with no correctness penalty.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Qwen3-32B across five benchmarks: (1) Tool name prediction accuracy at the first-token fork point ranges from 74.6% to 99.6% across GAIA, tau2-bench, BrowseComp, HotpotQA, and BFCL. (2) On GAIA, mean span probability is 0.90 for correct predictions vs. 0.46 for incorrect ones, showing confidence is discriminative; argument accuracy climbs from 7.6% to 97.5% as more chain-of-thought context is observed. (3) Rejected probes share a median of 18 verified tokens with the final tool call, letting the main stream skip 35–50% of tool-call body re-decoding. (4) On GAIA (N=165, real web search), the full configuration reduces median latency from 34.7s to 31.2s (10% reduction) and P95 from 131.9s to 108.1s (18% reduction), with exact-match accuracy within 1pp of baseline. On HotpotQA (N=200, real Wikipedia API), the full configuration is Pareto-optimal.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read. Focus on Section 3 for the three empirical findings (early-decision phenomenon, confidence discriminability, prefix reuse), which are the foundation of the method. Skim Section 4 for the D1/D2/D3 system design. In experiments, look at Figure 2 for latency profiling and Tables 2–3 for accuracy and latency numbers. Estimated reading time: 30–40 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 cost model 和 prefix-cache fork；这类自预测若稳定，会改变 agent serving 的调度接口设计。
recommendation.en: Read the cost model and prefix-cache fork; stable self-prediction would change how agent-serving schedulers expose tool calls.

paper.title: AgentGym2: Benchmarking Large Language Model Agents in De-Idealized Real-World Environments
paper.abstract: Language agents, i.e., LLM agents, progress rapidly and are increasingly deployed in production environments. This trend underscores the urgent need for rigorous and realistic evaluations. However, most existing benchmarks evaluate agents in simplified, idealized settings. They typically rely on pre-packaged tool interfaces, overlook critical steps, and assume inputs are clean and fully specified. Consequently, they understate the difficulty of real deployments, where uncertainty and noise are u

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：现有 agent benchmark 过于理想化，导致我们高估了 LLM agent 在真实生产环境中的可用性。很多评测默认工具已经选好、接口已经包装好、输入干净且目标明确，中间那些现实里最耗时也最容易出错的步骤——澄清需求、发现工具、处理噪声、拼接工作流——被 benchmark 预先替你做掉了。作者因此提出一个“去理想化”的 agent 评测框架，想测的不是单步推理能力，而是端到端完成真实工作请求的能力。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，但对 post-train、agentic training 和能力评估有现实意义。它提供了一个更接近部署环境的外部测量面，能帮助判断模型到底缺的是知识、规划、工具使用，还是交互鲁棒性。对预训练研究员的启发主要在两点：一是很多能力缺口并不会随着 token-level 语言建模自然补齐，尤其是工具发现、噪声处理、目标澄清这类交互能力；二是论文观察到参数规模和 post-training 会带来稳定收益，但增加交互轮数本身没有形成 scaling effect，这说明 agent 失败常常不是“想得不够久”，而是策略、工具接口和训练信号不对。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，AgentGym2 的核心不是新 agent 算法，而是新的评测环境设计。它采用分层模块化架构，把 environment、tools、agent、configuration 解耦。环境侧提供更真实的数字运行时；工具侧不再给 query-specific 的专用接口，而是只给一组基础、通用、可组合的工具，覆盖网页浏览、信息检索、文件处理、多模态理解、代码执行等五类能力，共 27+ actions。这样做的目的，是把“该用什么工具、如何组合工具”也纳入评测，而不是默认这些决策已经替 agent 做好。

任务构建上，作者从 GitHub、Reddit、Kaggle 等平台收集真实用户需求，再通过自动合成、query augmentation 和人工标注转成评测实例。每个任务还经过级联验证流程，结合模型检查和人工审核，确保任务有效、描述清晰、结果可核验。这个流程的重点在于把 benchmark 从“人工设计的干净题目”转成“现实世界工作请求的抽样近似”。系统层面还支持环境隔离、并行工具调用和可复现实验，这些工程设计对大规模 agent eval 很关键，因为真实环境评测很容易被状态污染和执行不稳定拖垮。
summary.experiments: 实验上，作者评测了 15 个主流闭源和开源模型。最醒目的结果是，即便是 GPT-5 也只有约 44% 的完成率，Claude Sonnet 4.5 约 37%，说明在这种去理想化环境下，当前强模型离稳定生产可用还有明显距离。开源模型方面，经过较强 post-training 的 agent 模型收益明显，例如 Nex-N1-32B 和 Nex-N1-671B 相比各自 base model 分别提升约 9.16% 和 10.53%。论文还观察到两个趋势：一是参数规模和计算成本增加通常带来更高分数；二是单纯增加 interaction turns 并不会带来类似 scaling 的收益。后者很重要，因为它说明失败并不主要来自预算不足，而更像是探索策略差、工具使用不当、或者在噪声环境中出现幻觉。细粒度分析里，作者点出常见失败模式包括探索不足和 hallucination，这与很多真实 agent 系统的故障形态一致。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和 framework 图，抓住它与 AgentBench、GAIA、TheAgentCompany 这类 benchmark 的差别：不是换一批题，而是把工具选择、环境噪声和任务不完备性重新放回评测。然后看任务构建与验证流程，判断 benchmark 数据质量是否站得住。实验部分重点看三类结果：闭源/开源模型的绝对分数，post-training 带来的增益，以及 interaction turns 不随之扩展的结论。最后浏览 failure analysis，看看 benchmark 是否真的测到了现实部署中的痛点。预计 25 到 35 分钟可以完成一轮有效泛读。如果你做 agent training 或 RL for agents，这篇更适合作为评测面和训练目标设计的参考，而不是算法细节来源。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a familiar but important mismatch: most agent benchmarks are too idealized, so they overestimate how ready LLM agents are for real deployment. Existing evaluations often pre-package the right tools, simplify interfaces, and assume clean, fully specified inputs. In practice, agents must clarify ambiguous goals, discover available tools, handle noisy information, and stitch together end-to-end workflows. AgentGym2 is built to evaluate those missing pieces rather than only reasoning inside a sanitized setup.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it matters as an evaluation surface for post-training and agentic learning. For foundation-model researchers, the main lesson is that several deployment-critical capabilities do not emerge automatically from stronger next-token modeling alone, especially tool discovery, robustness to noise, and proactive clarification. Another useful observation is that larger models and stronger post-training help consistently, while simply allowing more interaction turns does not create a scaling effect. That suggests many failures are not due to insufficient deliberation budget, but due to weak policies, poor exploration, or inadequate training signals.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main contribution is the benchmark design rather than a new agent algorithm. AgentGym2 uses a layered, modular architecture that decouples environments, tools, agents, and task configurations. On the environment side, it provides more realistic digital runtimes. On the tool side, it deliberately avoids query-specific, handpicked interfaces and instead exposes a basic, general-purpose, composable toolbox spanning web browsing, information retrieval, file processing, multimodal understanding, and code execution, with more than 27 actions. This design forces the agent to decide what to use and how to combine tools, which is exactly what many existing benchmarks abstract away.

Task construction is also a key part of the method. The authors collect real user demands from sources such as GitHub, Reddit, and Kaggle, then transform them into benchmark instances through automated synthesis, query augmentation, and manual annotation. A cascading verification pipeline, combining model-based checks and human review, is used to ensure task validity, clarity, and verifiability. The benchmark therefore aims to approximate real work requests rather than curated clean puzzles. At the systems level, the framework supports environment isolation, parallel tool invocation, and scalable execution, which are necessary if one wants realistic agent evaluation without losing reproducibility.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark is used to evaluate 15 leading proprietary and open-source models. The headline result is that performance remains modest even for strong systems: GPT-5 reaches roughly 44%, and Claude Sonnet 4.5 around 37%. That gap between perceived and measured capability is the main empirical message. On the open-model side, stronger post-training helps substantially: Nex-N1-32B and Nex-N1-671B outperform their respective base models by about 9.16% and 10.53%. The paper also reports two broader trends. First, performance generally improves with model scale and compute. Second, increasing the number of interaction turns does not produce a comparable scaling effect. That is an important finding because it suggests that many failures come from poor exploration, weak tool use, or hallucination under noisy conditions rather than from too little time to think. The fine-grained analysis explicitly highlights insufficient exploration and hallucinations as recurring failure modes.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction and the framework figure to understand how AgentGym2 differs from earlier benchmarks such as AgentBench-style or pre-packaged tool evaluations. Then read the task-construction and verification sections to judge whether the benchmark instances are grounded and reliable. In the experiments, focus on three things: absolute scores of strong closed and open models, the gains from post-training, and the claim that more interaction turns do not scale performance. Finish with the failure analysis to see whether the benchmark is exposing realistic deployment bottlenecks. A useful first pass should take about 25–35 minutes. It is more valuable as an evaluation reference for agent training and RL than as a source of new algorithmic ideas.

recommendation.zh: 更贴近真实部署的Agent评测基准，关注工具发现与噪声鲁棒性，可用于评估预训练模型的Agent能力
recommendation.en: More realistic agent benchmark focusing on tool discovery and noise robustness; useful for evaluating pretrained models' agent capabilities

paper.title: The Making of Claude Code
paper.abstract: The inside story of how Claude Code went from an internal CLI to Anthropic's coding agent, told by researchers, engineers and early users who built it.

summary.core_problem: 回顾 Claude Code 从内部 CLI 工具演进为 Anthropic 官方编码 Agent 的完整过程，披露研发、产品化与早期用户反馈中的关键决策。
summary.importance: 顶级机构的编码 Agent 产品化复盘，可反推基座能力打磨、工具使用对齐、长程任务工程化的实际取舍，属于工程经验类贡献。
summary.technical_approach: 以第一人称叙事串联内部原型迭代、能力边界测试、用户反馈闭环、与 Claude 基座版本联动的过程，未披露具体训练配方或架构细节。
summary.experiments: 无系统量化实验，仅包含研发过程中的定性观察与案例。
summary.authors_note: Anthropic 官方博客，由参与 Claude Code 研发的研究员、工程师与早期用户共同撰写。

summary_en.core_problem: Retraces Claude Code's evolution from an internal CLI tool to Anthropic's official coding agent, disclosing key decisions in R&D, productization, and early-user feedback loops.
summary_en.importance: Top-lab coding agent productization retrospective that reveals practical tradeoffs in foundation capability shaping, tool-use alignment, and long-horizon task engineering; an engineering-experience contribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: First-person narrative covering internal prototype iteration, capability boundary testing, user feedback loops, and coupling with Claude foundation model releases; no specific training recipes or architecture details disclosed.
summary_en.experiments: No systematic quantitative experiments; only qualitative observations and case studies from the development process.
summary_en.authors_note: Official Anthropic blog post, co-authored by researchers, engineers, and early users involved in Claude Code development.

recommendation.zh: 重点看内部原型到产品的能力边界取舍，可反推 coding 方向基座 pretrain 与后训练的优先级，细节不多但信号真实。
recommendation.en: Focus on capability-boundary tradeoffs from internal prototype to product; useful for inferring pretrain and posttrain priorities for coding-oriented foundation models, with limited but authentic signals.

paper.title: The Remarkable Effectiveness of Providing AI Agents with Natural Language Tools: A Replication Study Validating NLT Performance Across 14 Models
paper.abstract: This study independently replicates and extends the Natural Language Tools (NLT) framework of Johnson et al.~(2025), which questions the use of structured tool calling in large language model (LLM) agentic systems. We evaluated NLT across 14 models and 8,560 trials, adding newer frontier, reasoning, and open-weight models to the original set. The results confirm the core findings and add detail. NLT improves tool-calling accuracy by 14.9 percentage points overall (62.3\% versus 47.4\% structured

summary.core_problem: 在 LLM Agent 的工具调用中，主流做法是让模型输出严格结构化格式（如 JSON schema）以便解析与执行。但 Johnson et al. (2025) 提出 Natural Language Tools（NLT）：用自然语言描述工具调用意图与参数，反而更准。本文要解决的是：NLT 的收益是否可复现、是否跨模型家族稳定、以及在新一代前沿模型/推理模型/开源权重模型上是否仍成立。
summary.importance:
对“预训练本体”不是直接贡献，但对 pretrain↔posttrain 接口与 agent 训练信号有间接价值：
- 它把一个常被忽略的变量（输出格式约束）变成可量化的性能瓶颈，并提示“格式分布”与“任务分布”不匹配会带来显著退化。这与预训练数据分布、tokenizer/语料中代码占比、以及后训练的 tool-use SFT/RL 强相关。
- 作为 replication，价值在于给出边界条件：哪些模型会从 NLT 获益、哪些模型因原生 tool calling 优化而收益变小甚至反转。这能反过来指导：是否值得在后训练里继续强化结构化 function calling，还是应该把工具接口设计得更贴近自然语言分布。
summary.technical_approach:
论文复现并扩展 Johnson et al. (2025) 的 NLT 框架，核心对照是：
- Structured tool calling：要求模型按 JSON/schema 输出可解析的函数名与参数。
- NLT：把“调用哪个工具、参数是什么、为什么这么填”用自然语言表达，由外部解析器/规则将自然语言映射为实际调用。

作者提出的机制解释是“认知负担/分布错配”：JSON 生成模式主要来自代码语料分布，而很多工具调用任务来自客服、健康、业务流程等自然语言分布；强制 schema 会让模型把注意力资源花在格式合规上，挤占任务求解。论文将其类比为格式约束触发更费力的处理路径，并预测：未针对 tool calling 深度优化的模型、小模型、以及推理型模型更可能受益。
summary.experiments:
实验规模：14 个模型、8,560 次试验。
关键结果（论文在引言中给出总体数值）：
- 总体准确率：NLT 相比 structured 提升 14.9 个百分点（62.3% vs 47.4%）。
- 严重错误（critical errors）：减少 93%（51 vs 755）。
- 模型分层效应：无原生 tool calling 的模型、推理模型、小模型收益更大（+24.0pp 到 +43.1pp）；高度优化的前沿模型（文中点名 GPT-5、Gemini 2.5 Pro）收益更小或可能反转。

从预训练/后训练视角更值得看的不是平均提升，而是“收益随模型能力与对齐程度变化”的曲线：它暗示 structured tool calling 的优势更多来自后训练与系统工程，而不是语言建模本身天然适配 schema。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
1) 先看实验设置：任务类型、成功判定、critical error 的定义、structured 与 NLT 的提示模板是否严格对齐。
2) 直接看分模型结果表：哪些模型提升最大、哪些无提升/下降；把它当作“tool-use 对齐强度”的侧写。
3) 关注鲁棒性细节：是否更换实现、解析器、prompt 仍稳定；以及方差/失败模式分析。
4) 如果你做后训练：把 NLT 看成一种“把输出分布拉回自然语言”的接口设计，思考它是否能降低 SFT/RL 对 schema 合规数据的需求量，或作为 curriculum 的早期阶段。

summary_en.core_problem: Structured tool calling (e.g., JSON schemas) is the default in LLM agents for reliability, but Natural Language Tools (NLT) claims that letting models express tool calls in plain language can improve correctness. This paper’s goal is to independently replicate Johnson et al. (2025) and test whether NLT’s gains hold across a broader, newer set of models, including frontier and reasoning models.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining-method paper, but it matters at the pretrain↔post-train boundary where tool-use behavior is shaped. The work isolates output-format constraints as a measurable performance bottleneck and frames it as a distribution mismatch: schema-like outputs are learned from code-heavy distributions, while many tool-use tasks are natural-language heavy. The replication also provides boundary conditions—NLT helps most when models are not heavily optimized for native function calling—informing whether future post-training should keep pushing structured calling or redesign tool interfaces to stay closer to the model’s natural language distribution.
summary_en.technical_approach:
A replication/extension of the NLT framework with a controlled comparison:
- Structured calling: the model must emit a schema-compliant JSON/function-call object.
- NLT: the model describes the intended tool call and arguments in natural language; an external layer maps that text to an executable call.

The proposed mechanism is “format-induced cognitive load / distributional mismatch”: enforcing schema compliance competes with task reasoning, especially for models not specifically tuned for structured outputs. The paper expects larger gains for smaller models, models without native tool calling, and some reasoning-oriented models.
summary_en.experiments:
Scale: 14 models, 8,560 trials.
Headline results reported in the paper:
- Tool-calling accuracy: +14.9 percentage points overall for NLT (62.3% vs 47.4%).
- Critical errors: 93% reduction (51 vs 755).
- Strong heterogeneity: large gains for models without native tool calling, reasoning models, and smaller models (+24.0pp to +43.1pp), while heavily optimized frontier models (GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro) show smaller gains or even reversals.

For researchers, the most informative artifact is the per-model breakdown and failure-mode taxonomy, since it indirectly reflects how much post-training/system integration has already specialized the model for structured calling.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
1) Verify the evaluation protocol: task suite, success criteria, and how “critical error” is defined.
2) Jump to the per-model results table/plots to see where NLT helps and where it doesn’t.
3) Read robustness notes: prompt alignment, parser assumptions, variance across runs, and common failure modes.
4) If you work on post-training, treat NLT as an interface choice that shifts the output distribution back toward natural language; consider whether it can reduce the amount of schema-compliance SFT/RL data needed or serve as an early curriculum stage before structured calling.

recommendation.zh: 看结果分层表；它提醒 tool-use 训练别过早把结构化 API 当作唯一正确接口。
recommendation.en: Read the stratified results; it warns against treating structured APIs as the only sane tool-use interface.

paper.title: VideoSearcher: Empowering Video Deep Research with Multi-Tool Agentic Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Video understanding is moving beyond closed-context perception toward open-world evidence exploration, a paradigm formalized as Video Deep Research (VDR). However, existing multimodal search agents primarily target static images, and the current VDR benchmark relies on text-centric retrieval that discards crucial visual information. To address these limitations, we propose VideoSearcher, a closed-loop agentic framework that empowers Vision-Language Models with multi-tool reasoning for VDR. Video

summary.core_problem: 现有视频深度研究基准依赖文本中心检索丢失视觉信息，且多模态搜索agent多针对静态图像，缺乏视频场景的多工具闭环推理能力。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出面向视频深度研究的多工具agent框架及双分支RL优化算法。
summary.technical_approach: 提出VideoSearcher闭环agent框架，统一时间定位、空间聚焦和多模态搜索于单条推理轨迹；提出BiSPO强化学习算法，解耦工具调用优化与答案准确性优化，提供更稳定的学习信号。
summary.experiments: 在视频深度研究任务上验证效果，未披露具体模型参数量与训练数据规模。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing video deep research benchmarks rely on text-centric retrieval that discards visual information, and most multimodal search agents target static images, lacking closed-loop multi-tool reasoning capability for video scenarios.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposing a multi-tool agent framework for video deep research and a dual-branch RL optimization algorithm.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes VideoSearcher closed-loop agent framework that unifies temporal localization, spatial focusing, and multimodal search in a single reasoning trajectory; proposes BiSPO reinforcement learning algorithm that decouples tool invocation optimization from answer accuracy optimization to provide more stable learning signals.
summary_en.experiments: Effectiveness verified on video deep research tasks; specific model parameters and training data scale not disclosed.

recommendation.zh: 视频领域agent的增量工作，双分支RL解耦设计可做弱参考，无需深读。
recommendation.en: Incremental video domain agent work; the dual-branch RL decoupling design can be used as weak reference.

paper.title: AgenticDataBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Data Agents
paper.abstract: Data science aims to derive actionable insights from heterogeneous raw data, unlocking the value of the massive amounts of data generated in modern society. Automating this process is essential to reducing labor-intensive efforts for data scientists and enabling scalable data-driven applications. Recently, large language model (LLM)-based data agents have emerged as a promising solution to automate data science workflows. However, the field lacks comprehensive benchmarks to rigorously evaluate t

summary.core_problem: 构建一个覆盖数据科学工作流的 LLM data agent 评测基准，解决现有评测缺少多场景、细粒度 ground truth 的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Benchmark。它面向 data agent，而不是单一 SQL、表格问答或可视化任务，试图覆盖从原始异构数据到分析结论的完整数据科学流程。
summary.technical_approach: AgenticDataBench 收集真实数据集和任务，覆盖 15 个垂直领域，并提供细粒度标注，用于评估 agent 在不同数据处理、分析和决策步骤中的表现。摘要提到包含 5 个真实 B2B 用例，强调任务来源和标注粒度。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、agent baseline、榜单结果或分项指标。可确认的是 benchmark 包含多领域真实任务和细粒度 ground-truth labels，用于系统评估 LLM-based data agents。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper introduces a benchmark for LLM-based data agents across data science workflows, addressing the lack of diverse and fine-grained evaluation assets.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark contribution. It targets data agents beyond isolated SQL, table QA, or visualization tasks, aiming to evaluate realistic end-to-end data science scenarios.
summary_en.technical_approach: AgenticDataBench collects real datasets and tasks across 15 vertical domains and provides fine-grained ground-truth labels. The abstract mentions five real-world B2B use cases and emphasizes coverage of heterogeneous scenarios and detailed task-level evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete model baselines, leaderboard results, or metric numbers. The confirmed asset is a multi-domain benchmark with realistic tasks and fine-grained labels for evaluating LLM-based data agents.

recommendation.zh: 这是 data-agent 评测资产，不会改变 pretrain prior；若做工具调用评测，扫任务 taxonomy 即可。
recommendation.en: This is a data-agent evaluation asset, not a pretraining signal; skim the task taxonomy only if tool-use evaluation is on your plate.

paper.title: SkillFuzz: Fuzzing Skill Composition for Implicit Intents Discovery in Open Skill Marketplaces
paper.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents increasingly automate software engineering tasks through reusable skills, natural-language instruction documents that guide planning and execution. Open skill marketplaces enable users to assemble agents by co-activating community-contributed skills, but marketplace operators typically audit skills in isolation. As a result, individually benign skills may interact to redirect an agent toward unintended objectives, which we term implicit intents. Detecting

summary.core_problem: 解决开放 skill marketplace 中多个单独良性的 agent skills 组合后诱导隐式意图的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 安全与测试方法。它关注组合式工具/技能生态中的 emergent misuse，对通用 agent 平台有意义，但对 LLM 预训练只提供间接安全信号。
summary.technical_approach: 将隐式意图发现建模为 skill composition 的 fuzzing 问题。测试单元不是单个 skill，而是 co-activation 组合；利用 planning artifacts 在执行前暴露 agent intent，并将带 skill 的计划与 skill-free baseline 的偏移作为差分信号，从而减少对真实执行环境的依赖。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出 marketplace 规模、skill 数量、fuzzing 覆盖率、误报率或与人工审计/随机组合 baseline 的定量结果。核心实验应围绕组合空间搜索效率和隐式意图发现率。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets implicit intents that emerge when individually benign agent skills are composed in open skill marketplaces.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-safety and testing contribution. It is relevant to general-purpose agent platforms and tool ecosystems, but only indirectly informative for LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: It formulates implicit-intent discovery as fuzzing over skill compositions. The unit under test is a co-activated skill set rather than a single skill. Planning artifacts are used to expose agent intent before execution, and deviations from a skill-free baseline provide a differential signal without requiring full execution environments at admission time.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report marketplace size, number of skills, coverage, false-positive rate, or comparisons against human review and random composition. The key empirical question is whether fuzzing finds composition-only failures efficiently.

recommendation.zh: 只看威胁模型和 baseline-difference 设计即可；它是 agent 安全测试，不会改变预训练方法判断。
recommendation.en: Skim the threat model and baseline-difference design; this is useful agent-safety testing, not a signal for pretraining methodology.

paper.title: Janus: a Playground for User-Involved Agentic Permission Management
paper.abstract: AI agents that autonomously execute tool calls on a user's behalf raise pressing questions about permission management: what role could users play, and what role should they play? Despite many proposed approaches, the user's role in agentic permission management remains under explored. We introduce Janus, a playground system for implementing and evaluating user-involved agentic permission management designs. Janus consists of two components: Janus-Core, a modular agentic system supporting a dive

summary.core_problem: 研究自主工具调用 Agent 中，用户应该如何参与权限管理，以及不同用户参与设计如何影响隐私、安全和认知负担。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 安全与交互系统。它不是预训练方法论文，但把权限管理拆成可实现、可评估的设计轴，对未来通用 Agent 的安全边界和工具调用协议有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Janus playground，包括 Janus-Core 和 Janus-Harness。Janus-Core 是模块化 Agent 系统，可实现不同权限管理策略；Janus-Harness 用自动化方式评估这些策略。论文基于一个用户参与权限管理的概念模型，实现了 6 个 permission assistants，并用合成用户响应器测试不同交互策略。
summary.experiments: 在 3 类场景和 3 个 synthetic responders 上评估 6 种权限助手。摘要给出的主要结果是：用户输入能显著增强隐私与安全；AI 辅助用户决策可降低认知负担。未从摘要中看到大模型规模、真实用户实验规模或开放 benchmark 数字。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括华盛顿大学安全与隐私方向的 Tadayoshi Kohno 和 Franziska Roesner，他们长期研究系统安全、隐私和人机交互安全。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how users should participate in permission management for autonomous tool-using agents, and how design choices affect privacy, security, and user burden.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent safety and interaction-systems contribution rather than a pretraining paper. Its value is in decomposing agentic permission management into implementable and evaluable design axes, which is relevant to future tool-use protocols.
summary_en.technical_approach: Janus is introduced as a playground with two parts: Janus-Core, a modular agentic system supporting multiple permission-management designs, and Janus-Harness, an automated evaluation framework. The authors instantiate six permission assistants over a conceptual design space for user involvement.
summary_en.experiments: The six assistants are evaluated across three scenarios and three synthetic responders. The reported findings are that user input materially improves privacy and security, while AI augmentation can reduce cognitive load. The abstract does not specify model scale, real-user study size, or a standardized benchmark release.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes University of Washington security and privacy researchers Tadayoshi Kohno and Franziska Roesner, known for work on computer security, privacy, and human-centered security.

recommendation.zh: 只看概念模型和 6 个助手的对比；对预训练没直接作用，但能校准 tool-use Agent 的权限边界。
recommendation.en: Read only the design axes and six-assistant comparison; it does not affect pretraining directly, but it sharpens priors on permission boundaries for tool-using agents.

paper.title: Reasoning effort, not tool access, buys first-try reliability in agentic code generation: an observational study
paper.abstract: Agentic coding assistants are increasingly given extra capabilities, such as browser based testing tools and design oriented system prompts, on the assumption that more capability yields better software. This study tested that assumption directly. Ninety independent agent runs built the same application, a real time retrospective board, from one detailed specification, each scored on a fixed 14 criterion functional rubric (42 point maximum) and a visual quality review. The runs spanned several m

summary.core_problem: 业界普遍假设为代码生成Agent增加浏览器测试工具、设计导向系统提示词等能力可以提升生成软件的质量，但该假设缺乏控制变量的实证检验。现有公开的代码Agent对比通常仅进行单次运行，且混淆了模型选择、工具配置、提示词设计、推理强度等多个因素的影响，无法分离各变量的真实贡献。
summary.importance: 该研究通过严格控制变量分离了影响代码Agent生成质量的核心因素，明确推理强度对首次生成可靠性的影响远大于工具接入或提示词优化，为预训练阶段的推理能力建模、推理预算分配策略提供了实证依据。同时其发现的相同配置下的高运行方差，也提示预训练模型能力评测需要采用多次重复、控制变量的设计，避免单次结果带来的评估偏差。
summary.technical_approach: 设计了控制变量的观测研究：共进行90次独立Agent运行，所有运行使用同一份详细的实时回顾看板应用规格说明（要求实现React+Vite前端、Node.js后端、SQLite持久化、WebSocket实时同步、Docker部署等功能），采用固定的14项功能评分标准（满分42分）加视觉质量评审。控制变量包括5个模型家族（Claude Opus 4.7/4.6、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 3.1、Qwen）、2种Agent框架、2种推理强度（High/xHigh）、是否提供Playwright浏览器测试工具、3种设计提示词设置（无/完整第三方提示词/单段精简版提示词）。相同配置重复多次，每次仅改变一个变量以分离各因素的独立影响。
summary.experiments: 结果显示模型能力层级是结果的主导因素：前沿模型得分接近性能天花板，低成本本地模型得分仅为前沿模型的一半左右。推理强度从High提升到xHigh带来的功能可靠性增益，远大于接入测试工具或添加设计提示词的效果。测试工具对功能正确性的提升有限，设计提示词主要影响视觉质量，对功能得分几乎无影响。相同配置的多次运行存在明显方差，单次运行结果不具备统计代表性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读可重点关注三部分：实验设计中的控制变量方案，结果章节中各因素贡献的分解（尤其是推理强度与工具、提示词的效果对比），相同配置下运行方差的分析及对评测的启示。预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The industry widely assumes that adding capabilities such as browser-based testing tools and design-oriented system prompts to code generation agents can improve the quality of generated software, but this assumption lacks controlled empirical validation. Existing public comparisons of coding agents usually run single trials and conflate the effects of multiple factors including model choice, tool configuration, prompt design, and reasoning effort, making it impossible to isolate the true contribution of each variable.
summary_en.importance: This study isolates the core factors affecting coding agent generation quality through strict variable control, clarifying that reasoning effort has a far larger impact on first-try generation reliability than tool access or prompt optimization. This provides empirical support for reasoning capability modeling and inference budget allocation strategies during LLM pretraining. Meanwhile, the observed high run-to-run variance under identical configurations also indicates that pretrained model capability evaluation requires repeated, controlled designs to avoid assessment bias from single-trial results.
summary_en.technical_approach: A controlled observational study was designed: 90 independent agent runs were conducted, all using the same detailed specification for a real-time retrospective board application (requiring implementation of React+Vite frontend, Node.js backend, SQLite persistence, WebSocket real-time sync, Docker deployment, etc.). Outputs were scored on a fixed 14-criterion functional rubric (max 42 points) plus visual quality review. Controlled variables include 5 model families (Claude Opus 4.7/4.6, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 3.1, Qwen), 2 agent harnesses, 2 reasoning effort levels (High/xHigh), availability of Playwright browser testing tool, and 3 design prompt settings (none, full third-party prompt, single-paragraph abridged prompt). Identical configurations were replicated multiple times, with only one variable changed per run to isolate the independent effect of each factor.
summary_en.experiments: Results show that model capability tier dominates outcomes: frontier models score near the performance ceiling, while low-cost local models score only about half as much as frontier models. The gain in functional reliability from increasing reasoning effort from High to xHigh is far larger than the effect of adding testing tools or design prompts.
