summary_en.reading_guide: As this is an official product blog rather than an academic paper, focus on the following sections for pretraining-relevant insights: 1) Capability integration logic: Compare the design with the previous standalone Gemini 2.5 Computer Use model, and extract the design rationale for native integration into the general base, especially the compatibility mechanism with existing built-in toolchains. 2) Safety and safeguards section: Study the targeted adversarial training design for computer-use-specific attack surfaces, and the boundary划分 of the two-layer enterprise protection framework — this part clarifies the tradeoff between safety embedded in model training and system-level external safeguards, and is the most insightful content for pretraining alignment research. 3) Public reference implementation and Browserbase demo API specifications: These can be used to infer the tokenization scheme for the model's output GUI action space (click, input, scroll, etc.). 4) Worth further exploration: Reverse-engineer the possible mixed training ratio and curriculum strategy for "GUI screenshot-action paired data + general text-image/tool calling data" in the pretraining stage based on the observed capability fusion performance.
summary_en.authors_note: Google DeepMind; specific author names are not disclosed in the blog post

recommendation.zh: 别当研究论文读；把它当产品信号看，重点想清楚 GUI 轨迹数据、动作 token 化和安全约束会怎样反过来塑造下一代预训练目标。
recommendation.en: Do not read this as a research paper; read it as a product signal about where GUI trajectories, action tokenization, and safety constraints may reshape future pretraining objectives.

paper.title: Localizing RL-Induced Tool Use to a Single Crosscoder Feature
paper.abstract: Fine-tuning through RL reshapes the internal representations of language models to enable agentic behaviors such as tool use, yet the mechanistic basis of these changes remains poorly understood. While RL substantially improves structured tool-call generation, it is unclear which features emerge, which are preserved, and whether identified features can be leveraged for retraining-free behavioral control. In this work, we show that $\textit{Dedicated Feature Crosscoders (DFC)}$ isolate a compact

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 RL 微调如何在模型内部写入工具调用能力。更具体地说，它问了三个问题：RL 后新增的能力是否能被 crosscoder 分解到少量模型差异特征中；这些特征是完整承载能力，还是只起过滤作用；找到这些特征后，能否不重新训练模型而直接控制工具调用行为。
summary.importance: 这是一篇值得精读的机制分析工作。它把 post-train 后的能力变化从行为指标推进到表征层面，说明 RL 训练出的 agentic 行为可以在残差流中被较紧凑地定位。对预训练研究的启发有两点。第一，pretrain 与 post-train 的接口不只是数据和 loss，也包括可被定位、可被调制的内部方向。第二，能力差异可能不是均匀分布在全模型参数中，而是部分集中在稀疏特征和特定残差方向上。这会影响后续的持续训练、能力保留、模型合并、RL 安全开关和 runtime steering 设计。需要注意，论文的结论目前限定在 Qwen2.5-3B、ToolRL 风格工具调用、小规模评测和 crosscoder 设定下，不应外推为所有 RL 能力都可由单特征解释。
summary.technical_approach: 论文比较两个同架构模型：Model B 是 Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B base，Model A 是 chengq9/ToolRL-Qwen2.5-3B，后者经过结构化 <tool_call> 调用的 RL 微调。模型维度 d=2048，共 36 层。作者训练 Dedicated Feature Crosscoder，将两个模型的 residual stream post-MLP 激活共同编码到稀疏字典中，再分别解码回两个模型。DFC 的字典被显式切成 A-exclusive、B-exclusive 和 shared 三块，并通过 gradient masking 强制独占分区只能写入对应模型。这样可以测试 RL 模型特有的工具调用表征是否进入 A-exclusive 分区。训练数据包含 40,000 条 FineWeb 通用样本和 40,000 条 ToolRL 指令-输出样本。论文系统扫了 48 个 crosscoder 变体，变化轴包括普通 CrossCoder 与 DFC、字典大小、top-k 稀疏度、exclusive share，以及 exclusive penalty λ_excl。技术重点有三处。第一，用 encode-decode reconstruction 测试 crosscoder 是否保留甚至转移工具调用能力。第二，用 Cohen’s d 按工具样本与通用文本激活差异筛选工具相关特征，并要求工具样本 firing rate ≥0.3、通用样本 firing rate ≤0.1。第三，对 A-exclusive 特征做 residual steering：把选中特征的 decoder column 乘以系数 α，加到 RL 模型 residual stream 中，观察工具调用行为是否可控。论文还用 mass-ratio 构造普通 CrossCoder 的伪分区，用来区分 DFC 的结构约束是否真的改变了特征几何。
summary.experiments: 实验结果的核心是“DFC 能定位强 RL 特征，但不是完整的能力容器”。在 48 个变体的扫参中，把 RL 模型激活经过 crosscoder encode-decode 后，tool correctness 平均提升 +31.1±9.7 个百分点；把 base 模型激活经过 jointly-trained crosscoder，也能在没有微调的情况下被动转移 +6.8 个百分点工具调用正确率。这说明字典和解码路径中包含了可迁移的工具调用结构。DFC 的 A-exclusive 分区确实聚集了强模型特异性特征；但当对 exclusive 分区加惩罚时，RL 模型重构保真度下降，说明这些特征更像 filter，而不是完全吸收能力差异的 sink。最显著的行为控制结果是：只 steering 一个 A-exclusive 特征，就能带来 +65.0 个百分点的 tool-correctness 变化，并且在多数被探测层上泛化。几何分析显示，在 DFC 中 A-exclusive 特征形成可分离的 “Tool Interaction” 区域，区别于 shared 和 B-exclusive 特征；而同等规模的普通 CrossCoder 伪分区没有同样清晰的结构。评测使用 ToolRL held-out prompts：每个 sweep variant 100 条，每个 steering cell 40 条，greedy decoding，max_new_tokens=200，max_length=2048。指标包括 format_accuracy、tool_correctness 和取值为 {-1,0,+1,+2} 的 overall_score。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读，预计 60 到 90 分钟。先看 Methodology，尤其是 DFC 分区、gradient masking、top-k 稀疏编码和 exclusive penalty 的定义；这些决定了后面“特征是否独占”的可信度。然后看 Feature Space Analysis，重点是 mass-ratio 伪分区对照，它回答了 DFC 的几何分离是不是架构约束带来的。接着看 Sec. 5 的 reconstruction、spillover 和 exclusive penalty 消融，这是判断 DFC 是 filter 还是 sink 的核心证据。最后看 Sec. 6 的单特征 steering，关注实验是否只改变工具调用格式，还是也改善了工具名选择。读时要特别留意三个限制：评测 prompt 数量较小；工具调用任务较窄；crosscoder 本身可能引入能力转移路径，因此“单特征定位”不等于该能力在原模型中只由一个神经元实现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how RL fine-tuning writes tool-use behavior into a language model’s internal representations. More precisely, it asks whether the capability difference between a base model and an RL-tuned tool-use model can be isolated into a small set of crosscoder features, whether those features fully carry the capability or only filter it, and whether they can be used for behavioral control without retraining.
summary_en.importance: This is a strong mechanistic study for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. It moves the analysis of RL-induced agentic behavior from surface metrics to residual-stream features. The main implication is that post-training can create model-specific directions that are localizable and steerable. This matters for continual training, capability preservation, model diffing, model merging, safety switches, and runtime control. The result should be read with scope in mind: it is demonstrated on Qwen2.5-3B, a ToolRL-style tool-calling task, limited held-out evaluation, and a specific crosscoder setup. It does not imply that all RL-induced capabilities reduce to a single feature.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study compares two models with the same architecture: Model B is Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B, and Model A is chengq9/ToolRL-Qwen2.5-3B, an RL-tuned model for structured <tool_call> generation. The architecture has d=2048 residual width and 36 layers. The authors train Dedicated Feature Crosscoders on post-MLP residual-stream activations from both models. A DFC encodes both models into a sparse dictionary and decodes back into the two residual streams, but the dictionary is explicitly partitioned into A-exclusive, B-exclusive, and shared features. Gradient masking enforces the exclusive partitions. Training uses 40,000 FineWeb samples and 40,000 ToolRL instruction-output pairs. The paper evaluates 48 crosscoder variants, sweeping architecture, dictionary size, top-k sparsity, exclusive share, and the exclusive penalty λ_excl. Tool-related features are ranked by Cohen’s d between tool-use and general-text activations, with firing-rate filters of at least 0.3 on tool prompts and at most 0.1 on general text. Steering is then performed by adding selected A-exclusive decoder directions into Model A’s residual stream with coefficient α. A mass-ratio analysis is used to construct matched proxy partitions for a standard CrossCoder, providing a control for whether the DFC geometry is merely a labeling artifact.
summary_en.experiments: The main result is that DFCs localize strong RL-specific tool-use features, but the exclusive partition is a filter rather than a complete sink for the capability. Across the 48-variant sweep, encode-decode reconstruction improves the RL model’s tool correctness by +31.1±9.7 percentage points. Passing base-model activations through the jointly trained crosscoder passively transfers +6.8 percentage points of tool correctness without fine-tuning. Penalizing the exclusive partition degrades RL-model fidelity, indicating that the exclusive features carry important model-specific signal but do not fully isolate the capability difference. The strongest behavioral result is that steering a single A-exclusive feature yields a +65.0 percentage-point change in tool correctness and generalizes across most probed layers. The geometry analysis shows that DFC A-exclusive features occupy a separable “Tool Interaction” region, unlike a matched standard CrossCoder proxy partition. Evaluation uses 100 held-out ToolRL prompts per sweep variant and 40 prompts per steering cell, with greedy decoding, max_new_tokens=200, and max_length=2048. Metrics include format accuracy, tool correctness, and an overall score in {-1, 0, +1, +2}.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read this paper carefully, around 60 to 90 minutes. Start with the methodology: the DFC partition, gradient masking, top-k sparse coding, and exclusive penalty define what can and cannot be claimed about feature exclusivity. Then read the feature-space analysis, especially the mass-ratio control against a standard CrossCoder. The reconstruction, spillover, and exclusive-penalty ablations in Section 5 are the main evidence for the filter-versus-sink interpretation. The single-feature steering section is the most interesting behavior-control result; check whether the intervention improves valid tool selection or only pushes the model toward tool-call formatting. Keep three limitations in view: the held-out prompt counts are small, the task is narrow, and the crosscoder itself can introduce transfer pathways, so identifying one effective steering feature is not the same as proving that the original model stores the capability in one neuron.

recommendation.zh: 把“RL 改了哪些表征”落到可干预特征上，值得立刻复现；重点看 spillover 设定是否干净、是否只是提示格式迁移。
recommendation.en: It pins RL-induced changes to intervenable features—worth reproducing; scrutinize whether the spillover setup is clean or just prompt/format transfer.

paper.title: Confidence-Aware Tool Orchestration for Robust Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Video reasoning language models implicitly assume that every input frame is equally reliable. This leads to what we term the Blind Trust Problem: under realistic perturbations such as motion blur, glare, or occlusion, frontier video reasoning models can suffer 15-30%p accuracy drops on real-world embodied benchmarks, while remaining unaware that their visual evidence has been degraded. To address this challenge, we propose Robust-TO, an agentic video understanding framework that explicitly integ

summary.core_problem: 解决视频推理模型在模糊、遮挡、眩光等退化帧上仍盲目信任视觉证据，导致鲁棒性显著下降的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献更接近通用多工具agent式视频理解，而不是预训练本身。价值在于它把“证据可靠性”显式纳入工具编排，这对多模态agent和后续训练信号设计有一点启发，但离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Robust-TO框架：先为每帧计算reliability-relevance分数，选择可信帧；再把原问题拆成子查询分发给异构视觉工具；各工具返回统一格式的证据，包括预测结果、时间定位和校准后的可靠性分数；最后在推理阶段综合这些带置信度的证据。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在真实世界具身视频基准上，前沿视频推理模型在扰动下会掉15-30个百分点，Robust-TO用于缓解这一问题。但未给出具体模型规模、工具集合、基准名称和提升幅度，因此目前只能把它当作agent系统思路而非扎实的基座结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the tendency of video reasoning models to trust degraded frames—blurred, occluded, or glared—as if they were equally reliable, causing large robustness drops.
summary_en.importance: This is closer to a general tool-orchestrating agent for video understanding than to pretraining. Its main value is the explicit treatment of evidence reliability, which may modestly inform multimodal agent design or training-signal design, but it is far from core foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Robust-TO computes a reliability-relevance score per frame, selects trustworthy frames, decomposes the original query into sub-queries for heterogeneous visual tools, and aggregates tool outputs in a unified evidence format containing predictions, temporal grounding, and calibrated reliability scores.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims that frontier video reasoning models lose 15–30 percentage points on embodied benchmarks under perturbations, and that Robust-TO mitigates this. However, it does not provide model scale, tool inventory, benchmark names, or exact gains, so this currently reads more like an agent-system idea than a clean foundation-model result.

recommendation.zh: 有一点像把 uncertainty-aware routing 搬进多模态 agent；看问题设定即可，别把它误当成预训练方法论文。
recommendation.en: This is mildly interesting as uncertainty-aware routing for multimodal agents; read the setup, but do not mistake it for a pretraining paper.

paper.title: Autoformalization of Agent Instructions into Policy-as-Code
paper.abstract: Agent safety in high-stakes domains requires formal policy enforcement, but most existing approaches either rely on probabilistic guardrails (fine-tuned classifiers, prompt-based steering) that offer no formal guarantees, or on hand-coded symbolic enforcement that does not scale to the breadth of real policy specifications. We present an autoformalization pipeline that translates agent prompts, MCP tool descriptions, and natural language policy documents into formally verified policies using an

summary.core_problem: 把自然语言 Agent 指令、MCP 工具描述和政策文档自动转成可形式验证的 Policy-as-Code，减少高风险 Agent 只靠概率式护栏的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献在通用 Agent 安全和工具权限治理：它把 LLM autoformalization 用到 Cedar Policy Language 上，尝试把自然语言规范变成可执行、可验证的策略约束。对预训练没有直接作用，但对 Agent 工具使用和后训练安全信号设计有间接参考。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是 LLM generator-critic 循环：生成器把自然语言策略、Agent prompt 和 MCP tool schema 翻译成 Cedar 策略，批评器检查覆盖率、语义一致性和潜在漏洞，再迭代修正。核心是把自然语言安全要求编译到符号策略系统，而不是训练一个更强的安全分类器。
summary.experiments: 论文在 MedAgentBench 上评估自动生成策略的覆盖率，并声称相较先前手写符号 enforcement 覆盖了更多自然语言规范。摘要未给出具体模型、样本量、覆盖率数字或误报漏报权衡。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper autoformalizes agent instructions, MCP tool descriptions, and natural-language policy documents into formally verifiable policy-as-code.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is in general agent safety and tool governance. It uses LLM-based autoformalization to translate natural-language requirements into Cedar policies, giving a symbolic enforcement layer rather than relying only on probabilistic guardrails. It is indirect but relevant to safety signal design for tool-using agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses an LLM generator-critic loop. The generator translates prompts, tool schemas, and policy text into Cedar policies; the critic checks coverage, consistency, and violations, then drives iterative repair. The main idea is compiling natural-language safety constraints into executable symbolic policies instead of training another classifier.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses MedAgentBench and reports that autoformalized policies cover substantially more of the source natural-language specification than prior hand-coded symbolic enforcement. The abstract does not provide model details, dataset scale, coverage numbers, or false-positive and false-negative trade-offs.

recommendation.zh: 预训练侧只需知道这个接口形态；若做 tool-use 安全，读生成-批评循环和覆盖率定义即可。
recommendation.en: For pretraining, just note the interface pattern; if working on tool-use safety, read the generator-critic loop and coverage metric.

paper.title: Beyond Function Calling: Benchmarking Tool-Using Agents under Tool-Environment Unreliability
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as agents that solve tasks by interacting with external tool environments. Although recent tool-use benchmarks increasingly cover complex task settings, they still largely assume clean, stable, and trustworthy tool environments, leaving tool-environment unreliability insufficiently examined. We introduce ToolBench-X, a benchmark for evaluating agents under recoverable reliability hazards. ToolBench-X contains executable multi-step tasks across dive

summary.core_problem: 现有工具调用评测大多假设工具环境稳定、接口文档可信、返回值规范。ToolBench-X 关注更接近真实系统的问题：当工具存在可恢复的不可靠性时，Agent 是否还能完成多步任务，而不只是生成正确的函数名和参数。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对基座预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 Agent 能力评测有参考价值。它把工具使用失败拆成可控的环境不可靠性，而不是只看 function calling accuracy。这有助于区分模型的调用能力、错误诊断能力、证据校验能力和恢复策略能力。对后训练和推理时扩展也有启发：很多失败不是任务不可解，而是模型没有正确识别异常、没有复核中间证据，或过早给出答案。
summary.technical_approach: ToolBench-X 构造了 1106 个可执行多步任务和 4956 个 Python 工具，覆盖顺序、并行、混合三类工作流。每个任务有确定性工具和标准最终答案，支持自动执行和 exact-match 评测。核心设计是从干净工具环境出发，系统注入五类 reliability hazards：Specification Drift、Invocation Error、Execution Failure、Output Drift、Cross-Source Conflict。注入的错误必须是 disruptive 但 recoverable，即会干扰模型，但任务仍保留至少一条可行恢复路径，例如重试、fallback、交叉验证、输出归一化、证据补全。这个设计区别于简单的工具破坏或噪声注入，因为它评估的是恢复能力，而不是把任务变成不可解。
summary.experiments: 基准规模为 1106 tasks / 4956 tools。与 BFCL、ToolBench、τ-bench、T-EVAL、UltraTool、AgentNoiseBench 等相比，ToolBench-X 同时覆盖五类工具环境不可靠性，并包含顺序、并行、混合工具流。实验结论是当前被测模型在可靠性 hazard 下整体脆弱，所有模型成功率均低于 60%。作者还测试了 targeted hints 和 failure-triggered test-time scaling：当模型遇到困难时提供针对性提示，或允许模型基于失败反馈进行额外反思和多轮推理，任务完成率会明显提升。这说明一部分失败可以通过更好的诊断和推理预算缓解。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对工具环境不可靠性的定义，Table 1 中与已有工具评测的差异，以及 benchmark construction / hazard taxonomy 部分。实验部分主要看不同 hazard 下的失败模式、hint 的增益、failure-triggered test-time scaling 的设置。对预训练研究者更有价值的是错误类型设计和自动评测协议，而不是具体排行榜数字。

summary_en.core_problem: Most tool-use benchmarks assume clean APIs, stable documentation, and trustworthy outputs. ToolBench-X evaluates a harder and more realistic setting: whether an agent can finish multi-step tasks when the tool environment contains recoverable reliability hazards, not merely whether it can emit the right function call.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a direct contribution to pretraining, but it is useful for evaluating agent robustness. It separates function-call correctness from failure diagnosis, evidence verification, and recovery behavior. This distinction matters for post-training and inference-time scaling: many failures are not caused by unsolvable tasks, but by the model trusting suspicious observations, failing to cross-check evidence, or stopping before the required information is complete.
summary_en.technical_approach: ToolBench-X contains 1,106 executable multi-step tasks and 4,956 Python tools, covering sequential, parallel, and mixed workflows. Each task has deterministic tools and a canonical final answer, enabling automatic execution and exact-match evaluation. Starting from clean environments, the benchmark injects five structured hazard types: specification drift, invocation errors, execution failures, output drift, and cross-source conflicts. A key design constraint is recoverability. The injected hazards should disrupt the agent, but every task should still preserve at least one viable recovery path, such as retrying, falling back to another tool, normalizing outputs, cross-checking sources, or verifying incomplete evidence. This makes the benchmark different from simple API corruption or random noise injection.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark scale is 1,106 tasks and 4,956 tools. Compared with BFCL, ToolBench, τ-bench, T-EVAL, UltraTool, and AgentNoiseBench, ToolBench-X jointly covers five forms of tool-environment unreliability and supports sequential, parallel, and mixed tool-use workflows. The evaluated models remain fragile under these hazards, with all reported success rates below 60%. Targeted hints substantially improve task completion when the model gets stuck. Failure-triggered test-time scaling, where the model reflects on failed attempts and spends additional reasoning rounds, also improves performance. These results suggest that better diagnosis and recovery policies can recover a nontrivial fraction of failures.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient, around 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on the motivation in the introduction, Table 1 for the benchmark comparison, and the sections defining the hazard taxonomy and benchmark construction. In the experiments, look at per-hazard failure patterns, the effect of targeted hints, and the failure-triggered test-time scaling setup. For pretraining researchers, the main value is the taxonomy and evaluation protocol rather than the absolute leaderboard numbers.

recommendation.zh: Agent 评测里这个 setup 比普通 function-calling 更干净；看 hazard taxonomy 和 recovery-path 标注即可。
recommendation.en: This setup is cleaner than ordinary function-calling benchmarks; read the hazard taxonomy and recovery-path construction.

paper.title: Why Multi-Step Tool-Use Reinforcement Learning Collapses and How Supervisory Signals Fix It
paper.abstract: Tool use enables large language models (LLMs) to perform complex tasks, and recent agentic reinforcement learning (RL) methods show promise for enhancing model capabilities. However, RL alone often leads to instability or limited gains in tool-use tasks. In our experiments, some models exhibit catastrophic collapse, where performance abruptly drops and tool-invocation structures fail. The analysis reveals that these failures stem from unexpected probability spikes in specific control tokens, dis

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是多步 tool-use 场景下，为什么纯 RL 训练会突然失稳，甚至把一个原本会调用工具的模型训到几乎不可用。全文给出的结论很明确：主要问题不是能力退化，也不是推理链被彻底破坏，而是结构性崩塌。模型在 RL 过程中会把概率质量异常集中到少数控制 token 或格式 token 上，导致工具调用语法、turn 结构和执行协议被破坏；一旦结构坏掉，环境反馈也随之失真，训练进一步恶化。也就是说，模型“会做事”的能力还在，但“按正确协议把事做出来”的行为层被 RL 放大偏了。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义不在于 tool-use 本身，而在于它揭示了一个更一般的现象：当训练目标只给稀疏标量奖励，而生成过程又依赖严格结构时，优化会优先利用最容易被放大的局部 token 模式，而不是稳健地提升整体策略。这和长链推理、代码格式、XML/JSON 约束生成、函数调用协议都有直接关系。论文的贡献主要有两层。第一层是诊断层面：把 agentic RL 的失败从“RL 不会教会模型用工具”改写成“RL 会把结构 token 学坏”。第二层是方法层面：系统比较多种监督信号如何与 RL 结合，并指出简单混训不够，监督必须以合适的时序和形式介入，才能稳定结构而不过度牺牲泛化。
summary.technical_approach:
方法部分分成两块：失稳机理分析，以及监督信号设计。

机理分析上，作者把多轮 tool trajectory 写成 action-feedback 序列，关注 RL 训练中 token 分布如何演化。核心观察是，崩塌前往往先出现特定控制 token 的概率尖峰，随后合法工具调用格式迅速下降，错误响应频率陡增。作者进一步说明，这不是能力真正消失，因为在改变提示或放宽格式约束后，模型仍能表现出部分正确的工具使用与推理能力。问题出在 policy mass 被重新分配到少数“结构支点 token”上，生成被这些 token 牵引到退化模式。

在稳定化方案上，作者系统考察了六类 supervisory signals，并按训练组织方式分成 synchronous 和 interleaved 两大类。文中反复强调两者差别：synchronous 是在同一优化阶段把 RL 与监督目标一起混合；interleaved 则是在训练时间轴上交替进行 RL 和 SFT/监督更新。作者发现前者容易出现分布错配，因为监督样本和当前 RL rollout 的状态分布不一致，梯度会互相拉扯；后者更像周期性地把策略拉回到合法结构流形上，因此更稳。

具体监督形式包括：1）SFT 后接 RL，作为强初始化；2）off-policy supervision，用高质量轨迹直接监督当前策略；3）错误轨迹监督，把失败样本也纳入训练；4）hint-based guidance，在生成前提供正确提示或中间线索，但优化时去掉 hint，等于用 hint 只做行为引导、不让模型依赖显式提示；5）process reflection supervision，从训练过程中的中间推理步骤抽取反思文本，总结每一步的优缺点，再与原始错误轨迹配对构造 SFT 数据。这里最有意思的是最后两项，它们不是单纯喂正确答案，而是在结构失稳前给模型更细粒度的过程约束，弥补标量 reward 无法表达“这一轮格式对不对、调用位置对不对”的缺陷。

从与已有方法的区别看，很多 agentic RL 工作把重点放在 reward 设计、轨迹采样或环境搭建上；这篇文章更关心 token-level control dynamics，认为稳定性首先是一个生成结构控制问题，而不是单纯 credit assignment 问题。这一点很像把 RL 训练中的 failure mode 从高层策略失败，下沉到序列建模层面的局部概率异常。
summary.experiments:
实验部分的重点不是追求单点最好成绩，而是展示崩塌现象、比较监督方式、分析稳定性与泛化的取舍。全文明确提到在两类模型家族上做了系统实验，并比较了六种监督配置。虽然给到的正文片段没有完整表格数字，但几个结论是清楚的。

第一，纯 RL 会出现灾难性 collapse。表现为某一阶段后任务成功率接近归零，同时合法 tool-invocation 结构明显损坏，错误响应频率突然上升。这个“突然”很关键，说明不是平滑退化，而是训练动力学跨过某个阈值后的相变式失稳。

第二，SFT 初始化显著改善早期稳定性。也就是先把模型放到一个会按协议调用工具的区域，再做 RL，能明显降低一开始就跑偏的概率。但作者也指出，单靠 SFT 初始化并不能解决全部问题，尤其在更难的 OOD 设置下，可能出现泛化受限。

第三，简单同步混合监督与 RL 效果有限，甚至会因 distribution mismatch 带来问题。相比之下，interleaved training 更稳定，最终性能也更可靠。这个结论很重要，因为它说明“有没有监督”不是唯一变量，“监督在什么时候、以什么节奏进入训练”同样决定结果。

第四，process reflection supervision 能进一步提升稳定性和最终表现。原因不是它提供了更多标签，而是它把错误轨迹转成了可学习的过程文本，让模型知道哪一步出了问题、为什么错，而不是只看到一个终局 reward。

第五，作者专门分析了学习率敏感性和跨设置迁移。结论是稳定方法通常对学习率更不敏感，且在 format-level 和 content-level OOD 上更稳；但某些强监督方案虽然能保结构，却可能在 OOD 上掉点，说明结构约束和开放泛化之间存在张力。

如果精读全文，建议重点看展示 collapse 曲线、控制 token 概率演化、合法格式比例变化的图。这些图比最终平均分更能说明问题。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合按“现象—机理—干预”顺序读。

先看 Introduction 和展示 collapse 的主图，确认作者到底把什么定义为 failure。这里不要只看任务分数，要同时看 malformed tool call、错误响应频率、控制 token 概率变化。

然后看分析部分，重点理解作者为何说能力没有消失而是被结构失稳遮蔽。若文中有案例分析或替代提示实验，这部分值得细读，因为它决定了后续方法设计的方向：如果真是能力退化，就该改 reward 或探索；如果是结构崩塌，就该加行为约束。

接着看 supervisory signals 的分类和训练范式对比。尤其要分清 synchronous 与 interleaved 的差别，以及 hint-based guidance、process reflection supervision 各自解决什么问题。这里建议连同训练时间轴示意图一起看。

最后看 OOD、learning rate 和 transfer 分析。泛读时容易只记住“加监督更稳”，但真正有用的信息是：哪些监督主要修结构，哪些会牺牲泛化，哪些对超参更鲁棒。预计 35–50 分钟能抓住主线；如果要把方法迁移到代码 agent、函数调用或长链推理训练，建议把实验和附录里的失败案例一起看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why pure RL often becomes unstable in multi-step tool-use training, sometimes driving a previously competent tool-using model to near-zero performance. The central claim is precise: the main failure is not loss of reasoning ability, but structural collapse. During RL, probability mass gets disproportionately amplified on a small set of control or formatting tokens, which breaks tool-call syntax, turn structure, and execution protocol. Once the structure is corrupted, environment feedback also becomes less meaningful, and training deteriorates further. In other words, the model may still know what to do, but RL distorts how that competence is serialized into valid agent trajectories.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining and foundation-model research goes beyond tool use. It exposes a broader optimization pathology: when the objective provides sparse scalar rewards but successful behavior depends on strict structured generation, training may exploit fragile local token patterns before it improves the full policy. That observation matters for function calling, code generation with syntax constraints, XML/JSON outputs, and long-horizon reasoning traces. The contribution is twofold. First, it reframes agentic RL failure from a capability-learning problem into a structural-control problem. Second, it systematically studies how different supervisory signals interact with RL, showing that supervision is not just an auxiliary boost; when scheduled properly, it acts as a stabilizer for structured generation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The technical story has two parts: diagnosing the collapse mechanism and designing supervisory interventions.

On the diagnosis side, the paper models multi-turn tool-use trajectories as alternating action-feedback sequences and tracks how token distributions evolve under RL. The key empirical pattern is that collapse is preceded by sharp probability spikes on specific control tokens, followed by a rapid drop in valid tool-invocation structure and a surge in malformed responses. The authors argue that this is not true capability erasure: under altered prompts or relaxed formatting conditions, the model can still display parts of the underlying reasoning and tool-use competence. The issue is that policy mass is being reallocated toward a few structural anchor tokens, pulling generation into degenerate execution modes.

On the intervention side, the paper studies six supervisory configurations, organized into two training paradigms: synchronous and interleaved. This distinction is one of the main practical insights. In synchronous training, RL and supervision are mixed within the same optimization phase. In interleaved training, RL updates and supervised updates alternate over time. The paper argues that synchronous mixing often suffers from distribution mismatch, because supervised trajectories and current RL rollouts come from different state distributions, leading to conflicting gradients. Interleaving instead acts like a periodic projection back onto a manifold of valid structured behavior, which is why it is more stable.

The supervisory forms include: (1) SFT followed by RL as a strong initialization; (2) off-policy supervision using high-quality trajectories; (3) supervision on erroneous trajectories; (4) hint-based guidance, where correct hints are prepended before generation but removed during optimization, so hints guide behavior without becoming a crutch; and (5) Process Reflection Supervision, where intermediate reasoning steps are converted into reflective textual supervision summarizing what each step did well or poorly, then paired with error trajectories to build SFT data. The last two are especially interesting because they do not merely provide correct outputs; they inject process-level constraints that scalar rewards cannot express, such as whether a tool was invoked in the right place or whether the trajectory remained structurally valid.

Relative to prior agentic RL work, which often emphasizes reward design, trajectory synthesis, or environment construction, this paper focuses on token-level control dynamics. Its main claim is that instability is first a sequence-modeling and structural-generation problem, not only a high-level credit-assignment problem.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are designed more to characterize failure modes and stabilization trade-offs than to chase a single best benchmark number. The paper reports systematic studies on two model families and compares six supervisory configurations. Even from the provided full-text excerpt, several findings are clear.

First, pure RL can undergo catastrophic collapse. Performance drops abruptly to near zero, valid tool-invocation structures break down, and malformed responses spike. The abruptness matters: this is not smooth degradation but threshold-like instability in training dynamics.

Second, SFT initialization substantially improves early-stage stability. Starting RL from a model already located in a region of valid tool-use behavior reduces the chance of immediate drift. At the same time, the paper notes that SFT alone is not enough, especially under harder OOD settings where generalization can remain limited.

Third, simply mixing supervision with RL in a synchronous way is often insufficient and can even hurt due to distribution mismatch. Interleaved training is consistently more stable and usually yields more reliable final performance. This is one of the strongest practical takeaways: the timing and scheduling of supervision matter as much as its presence.

Fourth, Process Reflection Supervision further improves both stability and final performance. Its advantage is not just more labels, but richer process-level learning signals extracted from failures, allowing the model to learn why a step was wrong rather than only receiving a terminal reward.

Fifth, the paper analyzes learning-rate sensitivity and cross-setting transfer. More stable methods tend to be less sensitive to learning rate and more robust under format-level and content-level OOD evaluation. However, some stronger supervision schemes preserve structure at the cost of OOD generalization, indicating a real tension between structural regularization and open-ended adaptability.

When reading the results, the most informative figures are likely those showing collapse trajectories, control-token probability evolution, and valid-format ratios over training, rather than only aggregate task scores.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in the order of phenomenon, mechanism, then intervention.

Start with the introduction and the main collapse figures. Do not focus only on task success rate; also track malformed tool calls, error-response frequency, and the probability trajectories of control tokens.

Then move to the analysis section and understand why the authors claim the capability is preserved but hidden by structural failure. If the paper includes prompt-variation or format-relaxation case studies, those are worth close reading because they determine the right remedy. If the issue were capability loss, one would redesign rewards or exploration. If it is structural collapse, one needs behavioral constraints.

Next, study the taxonomy of supervisory signals and the comparison between synchronous and interleaved training. Pay particular attention to what hint-based guidance and Process Reflection Supervision are each fixing. Training-timeline diagrams, if present, are likely useful here.

Finish with the OOD, learning-rate, and transfer analyses. The easy takeaway is “supervision stabilizes RL,” but the useful takeaway is finer-grained: which supervision mainly repairs structure, which harms generalization, and which is more hyperparameter-robust. Around 35–50 minutes should be enough for the main thread; if you want to adapt the ideas to code agents, function calling, or long-chain reasoning, also read the failure cases and appendix details.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 §分析和监督信号消融；“能力没丢、格式 token 崩了”是可复现实验的好假设。
recommendation.en: Skim the failure analysis and supervision ablations; “capability intact, format tokens collapsed” is a clean hypothesis to test internally.

institutions: The Key Laboratory of Cognition and Decision Intelligence for Complex Systems
Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences
University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

paper.title: ASAP: Agent-System Co-Design for Wall-Clock-Centered Auto HPO Research for ML Experiments
paper.abstract: Hyperparameter Optimization (HPO) is essential for maximizing machine learning model performance, and its core challenge is sample efficiency: finding strong configurations within a limited budget. Because every HPO tool relies on a surrogate prior that imparts its own inductive bias, individual tools struggle once problems become sufficiently diverse and drift from these priors. Motivated by the reasoning and generalization capabilities of LLMs, recent work has explored using LLMs for HPO and r

summary.core_problem: 解决现有LLM-based HPO方法将LLM作为单一工具、按迭代次数评估，导致归纳偏置单一、不符合实际墙钟时间开销的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新（提出Agent-System协同设计的HPO框架），首次将墙钟时间作为HPO的核心评估指标，更贴近真实ML实验场景
summary.technical_approach: 提出ASAP框架，将HPO任务拆解为LLM Agent调度多类HPO工具的协同流程，以墙钟时间而非迭代次数作为优化目标，平衡不同工具的时间开销与搜索效率
summary.experiments: 提供的摘要被截断，未完整披露实验细节，仅提及针对现有LLM-based HPO的两大局限提出改进框架
summary.authors_note: 圣母大学团队，Nitesh V. Chawla为知名机器学习与数据科学研究者

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses two key limitations of existing LLM-based HPO methods: using LLMs as single-tool replacements with narrow inductive bias, and evaluating performance by iteration count instead of real-world wall-clock time
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; proposes an agent-system co-design framework for HPO and centers wall-clock time as the core evaluation metric for the first time, aligning with real ML experiment workflows
summary_en.technical_approach: The ASAP framework decomposes HPO into a collaborative workflow where an LLM agent dispatches multiple heterogeneous HPO tools instead of relying on a single LLM, and optimizes for wall-clock time rather than iteration count to balance tool latency and search efficiency
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract is truncated and does not disclose full experimental details; only mentions the framework design targeting two limitations of prior LLM-based HPO
summary_en.authors_note: Team from University of Notre Dame; Nitesh V. Chawla is a well-known researcher in machine learning and data science

recommendation.zh: HPO的Agent化改造思路可参考，仅当需要优化预训练超参搜索流程时看方法部分，其余无需细读
recommendation.en: The agent-based HPO redesign is worth referencing; only read the method section if optimizing pretraining hyperparameter search workflows, skip the rest

paper.title: When Retrieval Metrics Mislead: Measuring Policy Signal in Long-Horizon Tool-Use Agents
paper.abstract: Exact-match retrieval recall is often used as a proxy for whether a retriever supplies useful policy context to a downstream decision model. We test this proxy for pre-action policy classification in tau-bench using Qwen2.5-3B/7B classifiers. Under gold-policy conditioning, a compact structured state improves macro-F1 over raw trajectories by 0.13-0.17 after tuning. We then replace the benchmark-designated policy clause with the top-ranked clause retrieved from decision-time context. Although th

summary.core_problem: 检验长时程工具使用 agent 中，retrieval exact-match recall 是否真能代表下游决策模型获得了有用的 policy signal。
summary.importance: 这是 agent/RAG 评测代理指标的审计，价值在于指出 retrieval recall 可能误导系统设计；对做 tool-use、decision-time retrieval、agent eval 的研究员有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在 tau-bench 的 pre-action policy classification 设定下，用 Qwen2.5-3B/7B 分类器比较 gold-policy、retrieved-policy、mismatched-policy、no-policy 等条件，并先验证 compact structured state 相比 raw trajectory 是否更利于分类。
summary.experiments: 在 airline states 上，benchmark 指定的 exact governing clause 只有 7% 能被 rank-1 检索到，但 3B 分类器用 retrieved clauses 的 macro-F1 为 0.58，接近 gold clauses 的 0.60；mismatched-policy 和 no-policy 分别为 0.32 和 0.21。作者未能检测到 retrieved 与 gold 的显著差异，但置信区间较宽，尚不能证明非劣。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether exact-match retrieval recall is actually a good proxy for useful policy signal in long-horizon tool-use agents.
summary_en.importance: This is an audit of proxy metrics for agent/RAG evaluation. Its value is in showing that retrieval recall can be misleading for downstream decision quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using pre-action policy classification on tau-bench, the authors compare gold-policy, retrieved-policy, mismatched-policy, and no-policy conditions with Qwen2.5-3B/7B classifiers, and also study compact structured state versus raw trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: On airline states, the exact governing clause is retrieved at rank 1 only 7% of the time, yet the 3B classifier reaches macro-F1 0.58 with retrieved clauses versus 0.60 with gold clauses; mismatched-policy and no-policy controls score 0.32 and 0.21. The interval is too wide to establish non-inferiority, but the qualitative gap between retrieval recall and policy utility is clear.

recommendation.zh: 如果你还在用 retrieval recall 当 agent 上下文质量代理，这篇会给你泼冷水；读摘要和主结果表就够，结论有意思但统计把握还不够硬。
recommendation.en: If you still use retrieval recall as a proxy for agent context quality, this paper is a useful corrective; the main table is enough, though the statistical confidence is still loose.

authors: Juan Pablo De la Cruz Weinstein

paper.title: SAFARI: Scaling Long Horizon Agentic Fault Attribution via Active Investigation
paper.abstract: As autonomous agents tackle increasingly complex multi-step, multi-agent tasks, their execution trajectories have scaled beyond the constraints of even the largest context windows. Current methods for effectively diagnosing agent failures load the full trajectory into an LLM's context window, which suffers from attention dilution and fails when agentic traces inevitably exceed context limits. To address this, we introduce SAFARI (Scaling long-horizon Agentic Fault AttRibution via active Investig

summary.core_problem: 长时序多智能体执行轨迹长度可达百万token级别，现有故障归因方法要么全量加载轨迹到模型上下文窗口导致注意力稀释，超出上下文长度限制后直接失效，要么依赖超长上下文窗口方案，成本高且效率低，无法在长轨迹下稳定定位最早的未修正错误步骤。
summary.importance: 该工作提出用主动检索+假设验证的闭环替代被动全量上下文加载的长序列处理思路，对智能体可靠性评测、长上下文任务的信息处理范式设计有参考价值，但其本身属于智能体应用层方法，与基座预训练直接关联较弱，仅在长序列效率优化方向有间接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 将故障归因流程从“全量轨迹喂入模型”改为工具增强的主动调查闭环：1）给调查智能体配置两个专用工具，read工具读取指定偏移位置的连续轨迹片段，search工具支持基于正则的全轨迹关键词/错误标识检索，无需将全轨迹载入上下文；2）加入持久化短期记忆模块，上下文窗口达到预算时保留关键调查证据，避免已收集信息随历史轮次被驱逐丢失；3）设置强制验证环节：调查智能体输出结论前需将故障假设拆解为最多3个可证伪的原子论断，并行发送给独立推理评估器核验证据对论断的支撑度，平均置信度低于70分时根据评估反馈补充检索，达标后再输出最终故障位置。
summary.experiments: 在Who&When和TRAIL两个长时序智能体故障归因基准上测试：在上下文窗口受限的设定下，性能显著优于全量加载上下文的基线和现有长上下文故障检测方法，能够定位超出模型原生上下文长度的百万token级轨迹中的故障，基线方法在该长度下完全失效；验证环节可稳定提升归因准确率，整体token消耗比全量加载方案低一个量级。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注方法部分的主动调查闭环设计和验证阶段机制，无需深究实验细节，预计阅读时间15分钟。其主动检索替代全上下文加载的思路可作为长序列预训练效率优化的方向参考，但方案本身不直接适用于核心预训练流程。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-horizon multi-agent execution traces can scale to millions of tokens, exceeding the native context window of even the largest LLMs. Existing fault attribution methods that load full trajectories into context suffer from attention dilution and hard context limits, while approaches relying on extended context windows carry high cost and poor efficiency, leading to failed attribution on very long traces.
summary_en.importance: This work demonstrates a paradigm of replacing passive full-context ingestion with active retrieval and hypothesis-driven exploration to scale beyond context window limits, with relevance to agent reliability evaluation and long-sequence information processing design. As an application-layer agent method, it has limited direct relevance to base LLM pretraining, offering only indirect inspiration for long-sequence efficiency research.
summary_en.technical_approach: SAFARI replaces end-to-end trajectory loading with a closed-loop active investigation framework: (1) An investigator agent is equipped with two specialized tools: a read tool to pull contiguous trajectory segments at specified offsets, and a regex-based search tool to jump directly to relevant spans without loading the full trace. (2) A persistent short-term memory module retains key evidence across iterations, preventing loss of collected information when old conversation turns are evicted to meet context budgets. (3) A mandatory verification stage requires the agent to decompose fault hypotheses into up to 3 falsifiable atomic claims, which are sent in parallel to independent reasoning evaluators to check if cited evidence supports each claim. If average confidence falls below a 70-point threshold, the agent collects additional evidence based on evaluator feedback before finalizing attribution.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on the Who&When and TRAIL fault attribution benchmarks. Under constrained context window limits, SAFARI outperforms full-context baselines and existing long-horizon fault detection methods by a large margin, and remains functional on million-token TRAIL traces that exceed all tested models' native context windows, where baseline methods fail entirely. The verification stage delivers consistent accuracy gains, and total token consumption is roughly one order of magnitude lower than full-context approaches.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the methodology section for the active investigation loop and verification design; deep dives into experiment details are not necessary. Allocate ~15 minutes for reading. The active retrieval paradigm may offer indirect inspiration for long-sequence pretraining efficiency research, but is not directly applicable to core pretraining workflows.

recommendation.zh: 它不改变基座建模，但对“长轨迹=长上下文”这个偷懒设定给了更干净的替代；读方法图和主表即可，别把它误当长上下文架构结论。
recommendation.en: It does not change foundation modeling, but it cleanly challenges the lazy assumption that long traces should be handled as long context; read the method figure and main table, not as an architecture claim.

paper.title: LemonHarness Technical Report
paper.abstract: As large language model (LLM) agents are applied to longer tasks, they increasingly modify workspace state across multiple rounds of iteration. However, agents typically observe only tool outputs and log fragments, while the actual state changes occur in the file system. Without explicit workspace boundaries, state-changing operations such as file writes and temporary artifact generation may scatter changes across paths. Over time, these weakly constrained changes accumulate, making states such

summary.core_problem: 长程 Agent 在多轮工具调用中会持续修改文件系统状态，但现有执行环境常只暴露工具输出和日志，导致真实工作区变化难以追踪和约束。
summary.importance: 这是通用 Agent 执行基础设施工作，不是评测 harness，也不是预训练研究。它的可取之处是把长程 Agent 的状态边界、文件写入、依赖安装和临时产物管理作为一等工程问题处理，对构建可靠 coding/web/工具 Agent 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: LemonHarness 通过显式 workspace 边界约束所有会改变状态的操作，并把模型调用、工具执行和规则知识放入同一个受控边界。文件写入、依赖安装、临时 artifact 创建等操作通过结构化机制执行，以便追踪、隔离和恢复工作区状态。
summary.experiments: 给定摘要没有提供具体 benchmark、任务数量、模型后端、baseline 或量化提升。技术报告重点似乎是执行框架设计和长程 Agent 状态管理。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-horizon agents repeatedly modify filesystem state, but typical execution setups expose only tool outputs and log fragments, making real workspace changes hard to track and constrain.
summary_en.importance: This is general agent execution infrastructure, not an evaluation harness and not pretraining research. Its useful part is treating workspace boundaries, file writes, dependency installation, and temporary artifacts as first-class reliability issues for long-horizon tool agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: LemonHarness creates an explicit workspace boundary for all state-changing operations and brings model invocation, tool execution, and rule knowledge into one controlled boundary. File writes, dependency installation, and temporary artifact creation are executed through structured mechanisms for tracking, isolation, and state recovery.
summary_en.experiments: The supplied abstract does not report benchmarks, task counts, model backends, baselines, or quantitative gains. The technical report appears focused on execution framework design and state management for long-horizon agents.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文；做 Agent infra 可扫 workspace boundary 设计，别把它误读成评测框架或能力提升结论。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper; skim the workspace-boundary design if you build agent infra, but do not read it as an evaluation framework or capability result.

paper.title: From Knowing to Acting: Benchmarking Self-Awareness Capability of LLM Agents
paper.abstract: The integration of external tools has transitioned LLM agents from passive responders to autonomous systems. However, current benchmarks prioritize execution success, neglecting self-awareness capability, the ability to discern whether a problem requires necessary external resources or can be solved via internal parametric knowledge. To address this, we introduce KAPRO (Knowing-Acting Quadrant PRObe), a framework that evaluates cognitive-behavioral alignment by decoupling an agent's metacognitiv

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM Agent评测基准以端到端任务成功率为核心指标，无法区分两类性质不同的失败：一是模型真的不具备相关知识、不知道需要调用外部工具（认知盲区）；二是模型清楚自身知识边界，但执行时做出了错误的调用决策（执行控制失效）。这种评测盲区导致两类常见问题无法被单独衡量：工具调用不足该查不查，依赖幻觉输出答案；工具过度调用，对参数内已有的知识仍冗余查询工具，增加延迟和噪声。
summary.importance: 现有工具调用类Agent的训练流程多聚焦于教授工具调用格式，缺少对「何时不该调用工具」的校准信号。研究发现的开源模型模式化触发工具、所有模型对自身参数知识边界校准不足等现象，明确指向元认知校准是一种与执行能力分离的、可预测任务表现的能力，和模型的不确定性估计、幻觉倾向直接相关。这类能力无法仅靠格式类SFT获得，对理解预训练与后训练阶段涌现的内省能力、优化工具调用类训练信号设计有实际参考。
summary.technical_approach: 评估框架KAPRO（知行象限探测）将评测拆分为两个相互独立的维度：（1）认知判断维度（Knowing）：阻断模型的执行路径，强制其逐子步骤内省判断是否需要外部工具支持，测量模型对自身能力边界的显式认知；（2）行为表现维度（Acting）：在标准无约束的工具使用环境中，观察模型的自发工具调用行为。两个维度交叉可得到四象限结果，将认知-行为对齐度量化，分离「真的不知道」和「知道但做错」两类失败。配套的KAware评测数据集将任务严格划分为三个可控子空间：纯外部依赖任务（需实时信息、私有数据等参数不可能覆盖的内容）、纯内部可解任务（翻译、摘要、常识推理等参数能力覆盖范围内的内容）、混合任务（部分子步骤需工具、部分可内部解决），任务构造时控制工具数量、推理跳数、并行度等变量，避免无关因素干扰。
summary.experiments: 在覆盖开源/闭源、指令微调/推理增强的多类主流Agent上的测试显示三个核心结果：（1）自我意识校准分数与端到端任务成功率呈强正相关，该能力对实际表现有直接影响；（2）闭源、经过推理优化的模型工具门控行为更校准，会在内部知识足够时主动放弃工具调用；开源模型普遍存在模式化调用倾向，只要环境中有工具就倾向于触发，不做必要性判断；（3）所有模型在判断「自身参数知识是否足以解决问题」这一维度上的校准度显著低于判断「是否需要外部工具」的校准度，对自身已掌握知识的边界认知是跨模型的普遍短板。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注引言部分对两类工具使用失败模式的拆分、KAPRO的四象限评估逻辑，以及跨模型对比的三个核心发现。可跳过工具种子清洗、任务合成的工程细节，除非计划复现或构建同类基准。预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM agent benchmarks prioritize end-to-end task success rate as the primary metric, failing to distinguish two categorically different failure modes: epistemic gaps where the model genuinely lacks knowledge and does not recognize a tool is required, and executive control failures where the model correctly understands its knowledge boundary but makes incorrect tool-use decisions at execution time. This blind spot leaves two common pathologies unmeasured: tool underuse, where the model skips necessary tools and produces hallucinated answers, and tool overuse, where the model makes redundant tool calls for information already encoded in its parameters, increasing latency, cost, and input noise.
summary_en.importance: Current tool-use training pipelines for agents mostly focus on teaching correct tool call formatting, with no explicit calibration signal for when a tool is unnecessary. The observed patterns — open-source models exhibiting reflexive tool triggering, and all models showing poor calibration of their own parametric knowledge boundaries — establish metacognitive calibration as a capability separate from raw execution skill that reliably predicts task performance. This capability is tightly linked to model uncertainty estimation and hallucination propensity, and cannot be instilled through format-focused SFT alone. The findings are relevant for studying introspective capabilities that emerge across pretraining and post-training, and for designing better training signals for tool-augmented models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The KAPRO (Knowing-Acting Quadrant Probe) framework splits evaluation along two independent axes: (1) Knowing, where execution is blocked and the model is forced to make per-substep judgments about whether external tool support is required, measuring explicit awareness of capability boundaries; (2) Acting, where the model's spontaneous tool use is observed in a standard unconstrained tool environment. Crossing these two axes produces a four-quadrant mapping that quantifies cognitive-behavioral alignment, separating 'unknown unknowns' from 'knowing but acting wrong' failures. The accompanying KAware dataset partitions tasks into three controlled subspaces: purely external-dependent tasks requiring real-time or private information outside parametric coverage, purely internal-solvable tasks within parametric capability (translation, summarization, commonsense reasoning), and hybrid tasks requiring selective tool use across subtasks. Task construction controls for tool count, reasoning hop count, and parallelism to eliminate confounding variables.
summary_en.experiments: Tests across a diverse set of agents spanning open-source/proprietary and instruction-tuned/reasoning-augmented designs yield three core findings: (1) Self-awareness calibration score is strongly positively correlated with end-to-end task success, demonstrating the capability has tangible performance impact rather than being a purely cognitive curiosity; (2) Proprietary, reasoning-optimized models show more calibrated tool gating, actively abstaining from tool use when internal knowledge is sufficient, while open-source models broadly exhibit pattern-driven invocation, triggering available tools regardless of necessity; (3) All models show significantly worse calibration when judging whether their internal parametric knowledge is sufficient to solve a problem, compared to judging when external tools are required — awareness of the limits of stored knowledge is a cross-model, underaddressed weakness.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for core framing and empirical results. Focus on the two-mode failure taxonomy in the introduction, the four-quadrant structure of the KAPRO evaluation, and the three cross-model findings. Skip granular details of tool seed curation and task synthesis pipeline unless building a comparable evaluation benchmark. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: Agent评测的新维度，对理解基座的能力边界—工具调用耦合关系有价值，重点看§3的任务划分和§5里开源/闭源模型的自我认知差异表。
recommendation.en: A new dimension for agent evaluation, useful for understanding base model capability vs. tool-use coupling; focus on §3 task taxonomy and §5 open vs. closed-model self-awareness tables.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: PlanBench-XL: Evaluating Long-Horizon Planning of LLM Tool-Use Agents in Large-Scale Tool Ecosystems
paper.abstract: LLM agents increasingly operate in large tool ecosystems, where real-world tasks require discovering relevant tools, inferring implicit sub-goals, and adapting to dynamic environments over long horizons. However, existing benchmarks rarely evaluate planning under retrieval-limited tool visibility. To address this gap, we introduce PlanBench-XL, an interactive benchmark of 327 retail tasks over 1,665 tools that tests whether agents can iteratively retrieve usable tools, invoke them to uncover int

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文提出 PlanBench-XL，用来评测 LLM tool-use agent 在大型工具生态中的长程规划能力。它关注的不是单个 API 调用是否正确，而是 agent 在只能看到检索到的一小部分工具时，能否逐步发现相关工具、形成隐含子目标、调用工具获得中间证据，并在关键工具缺失、失败或误导时重新规划。
summary.importance: 它属于 agent 评测工作，对基座预训练的直接贡献有限，但对 post-train 和 agent RL 环境有参考价值。现有很多工具使用评测给定完整工具集，或者把中间目标写得很清楚，这会低估真实工具生态中的难度。PlanBench-XL 把问题改成检索介导的部分可观测规划，更接近企业 MCP、软件 API 和大型平台工具环境。对训练研究的启发在于：tool-use agent 的失败不只来自模型不会调用函数，还来自工具检索、子目标发现、路径中断检测和恢复规划之间的耦合。
summary.technical_approach: PlanBench-XL 构造了一个零售场景下的交互式工具使用基准，包含 327 个任务实例和 1,665 个工具，平均每个任务约 25 轮交互。agent 不能一次看到完整工具列表，而是通过 retriever 在大工具空间中逐步检索候选工具。基准设计强调 bi-directional anticipation：一方面从已有证据向前探索，寻找下一步可用工具；另一方面从目标结果向后推断需要哪些中间状态或工具，再尝试桥接当前状态与目标状态。环境包含默认噪声工具，某些工具描述或返回会表明其可能不相关、过期或错误。除此之外，论文设计了可选 block mode，在检索时替换或破坏路径关键工具，并保持任务仍然可解，从而测试 agent 是否能识别当前路径失效并寻找替代路径。论文还描述了一个可扩展的 LLM-based task generator，用于生成 grounded queries 及其配套工具生态。
summary.experiments: 作者评测了 10 个开源和闭源前沿模型。总体结果显示，大规模工具生态中的长程规划仍然困难。在默认设置下，多数模型准确率低于三分之二；加入 retrieval-time blocking 后性能显著下降。文中报告 GPT-5.4 在只保留一条可行路径时降到约 30%，在只保留最长恢复路径时略高于 10%。误差分析强调，成功不仅需要广泛探索工具空间，还需要精确利用已经发现的信息，并稳定调用工具。换言之，增加检索次数并不自动带来成功；如果模型不能把中间证据转化成新的查询意图，或不能意识到某条路径已被阻断，长程任务会很快失败。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 到 35 分钟。重点看 benchmark construction、retrieval-mediated tool visibility、blocker module 和实验分析。Table 1 可用于快速了解它和已有工具评测的区别。Figure 1 有助于理解工具生态、retriever 和交互环境之间的关系。实验部分建议关注默认模式与 block mode 的性能差异，以及作者对 exploration、exploitation、tool invocation 三类失败的拆分。若目标是构建 agent RL 训练环境，可以进一步看任务生成器和阻断机制；若只关心 LLM 预训练，可快速扫过。

summary_en.core_problem: PlanBench-XL evaluates whether LLM tool-use agents can plan over long horizons in a large tool ecosystem when only retrieved subsets of tools are visible. The benchmark stresses iterative tool discovery, implicit subgoal formation, intermediate evidence gathering, and recovery when plausible tool paths fail.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an agent evaluation paper, not a core pretraining paper. Its value for LLM research is in the post-training and RL environment design side. Many tool-use benchmarks expose a fixed tool set or provide clear intermediate goals, which hides the difficulty of partial observability in real tool ecosystems. PlanBench-XL makes tool use retrieval-mediated: the agent must search for tools, use outputs to form new retrieval intents, and adapt when path-critical tools are missing, failing, or distracting. This helps diagnose whether failures come from planning, retrieval, evidence use, or tool invocation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark is an interactive retail-domain environment with 327 tasks and 1,665 tools. Each task requires about 25 turns on average. Agents do not receive the full tool inventory; they retrieve candidate tools from a large tool space at each step. The design supports bidirectional anticipation. Forward anticipation means searching from currently accumulated evidence toward the next useful action. Backward anticipation means reasoning from the desired final outcome to hypothesized intermediate states and tools. The environment includes default noisy tools whose descriptions or outputs may be irrelevant, stale, or erroneous. An optional blocking mode adds retrieval-time disruption by replacing or disabling path-critical tools while preserving at least one feasible solution path. The paper also describes a scalable LLM-based task generator that creates grounded user queries and paired tool ecosystems.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates ten leading open and proprietary LLMs. Performance remains limited even without blocking: most models are below two-thirds accuracy in the default setting. Blocking causes a large degradation. GPT-5.4 drops to around 30% when only one feasible path remains, and to slightly above 10% when only the longest recovery path is preserved. The analysis suggests that successful agents need more than broad exploration. They must exploit discovered evidence precisely, invoke tools reliably, and detect when a current plan has become invalid. More retrieval alone is insufficient if the model cannot convert intermediate observations into the next useful search or re-plan after failure.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Read the benchmark construction, the retrieval-mediated visibility setup, the blocker design, and the error analysis. Table 1 is useful for positioning the benchmark relative to prior tool-use evaluations. Figure 1 explains the interaction loop among the tool ecosystem, retriever, and agent. The most relevant experimental results are the default-versus-blocking comparisons and the breakdown of failures into exploration, exploitation, and tool invocation. For agent RL environment design, the task generator and blocking mechanism are worth a closer read. For pure pretraining interests, a quick skim is enough.

recommendation.zh: 首个千级工具集下的长程规划benchmark，看§3实验设置和Table 2阻塞场景结果即可，揭示当前模型动态纠错能力极弱。
recommendation.en: First long-horizon planning benchmark with 1000+ tools; read §3 setup and Table 2 blocking results, which show current models have extremely weak dynamic error recovery.

paper.title: Governance Decay: How Context Compaction Silently Erases Safety Constraints in Long-Horizon LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Modern LLM agents increasingly rely on context compaction, summarization, or eviction to keep long-running sessions within a token budget. We show that this context-management layer is a safety-critical failure surface: in-context governance constraints that agents reliably obey while visible can be silently removed by compaction, causing the same agent to perform prohibited tool actions later in the session. We call this failure mode Governance Decay. We introduce ConstraintRot, a benchmark of

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论长程 LLM Agent 中的一个安全失效面：上下文压缩会把原本在上下文里的治理约束压掉，导致模型在压缩前遵守规则、压缩后执行违规工具调用。问题不在模型权重变化，也不依赖越狱提示，而在 Agent harness 的记忆管理策略通常只优化任务连续性，没有把组织策略、运行时规则、长期 memory 这类非 system-channel 约束当作必须保留的状态。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，但对长上下文 Agent、记忆机制和对齐评测有启发。它把“上下文管理”从工程细节提升为安全边界的一部分：如果规则只以普通消息、检索文档或 memory entry 的形式存在，那么压缩器就是一个隐式策略选择器。这个结论会影响 Agent 训练和评测设计：不能只测模型在完整上下文下是否拒绝，还要测压缩、摘要、截断、memory replay 后是否仍然遵守约束。
summary.technical_approach: 论文定义了 Governance Decay：当历史 H 超过 token budget B 时，压缩算子 C 用摘要或驱逐替换旧内容；治理约束 p 原本在 H 中可见，但在 C(H) 中被删除或弱化，随后模型面对同一个被禁止请求 r 时发生违规。作者构造 ConstraintRot benchmark，每个场景包含一个早期治理约束、较长的中间任务轨迹和后续禁止请求，并用工具调用中的禁止效果做确定性判分，而不是依赖 LLM judge。威胁模型只允许攻击者控制 Agent 摄入的普通上下文数据，例如工具输出或检索文档；攻击方式包括用大量内容触发压缩并挤出约束，以及在待摘要内容中注入面向 summarizer 的删除指令。缓解方法是 Constraint Pinning：把治理约束从有损压缩路径中隔离出来，在每轮中重放或完整性检查，类似 protected state，而不是寄希望于摘要器自然保留这些低频但高优先级规则。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 7 个模型家族、1323 个 episode 和 4 类压缩策略。总体上，未压缩控制条件下违规率为 0%，压缩后平均升至 30%，最高到 59%。如果约束在摘要中幸存，违规率仍为 0%；如果约束被删除，违规率为 38%。分模型看，DeepSeek 从 0% 到 59%，GLM 从 0% 到 0%，Qwen 从 0% 到 30%，Kimi 从 0% 到 59%，Claude 从 0% 到 19%，GPT 从 0% 到 41%，Gemini 从 0% 到 4%。作者还比较了不同约束通道：同样的 policy 放在被保留的 system message 中，压缩带来的衰减约为 0 个百分点；放在 standing instruction、memory 或普通上下文通道中，衰减可达 +50、+45、+33 个百分点。Constraint Pinning 在主实验中把违规率恢复到 0%，token 开销低于 0.5%，但作者也指出朴素 pinning 在更复杂约束解析、冲突策略和恶意改写场景下仍有缺口。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。建议重点看 Sec. 2 的 threat model，确认它不假设 system prompt 会被压缩，而是关注 memory、retrieved policy 和普通对话承载的治理约束；看 Sec. 4 的 ConstraintRot 设计，尤其是为什么使用工具调用结果做确定性判分；看 Sec. 5 的模型分解结果，理解违规率与“约束是否幸存于摘要”之间的关系；看 Sec. 6 的 compaction-eviction attack，判断它和常见 indirect prompt injection 的差异；最后看 Sec. 7 的 Constraint Pinning，因为这个缓解方案简单，但暴露了更一般的问题：Agent 的安全规则需要被当作受保护状态，而不是普通可摘要文本。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a safety failure mode in long-horizon LLM agents: context compaction can remove governance constraints that were previously present in the conversation or memory, so the same model refuses a prohibited action before compaction but executes it after compaction. The failure is caused by the agent harness, not by weight updates or jailbreaks. Current compaction mechanisms are usually optimized for task continuity, so standing policies carried in non-system channels are treated as low-salience content.
summary_en.importance: The direct contribution to pretraining is limited, but the work is relevant for agent evaluation, memory design, and alignment interfaces. It shows that context management is part of the safety boundary. If organizational rules, runtime policies, or retrieved memory entries are represented as ordinary text, the summarizer or eviction policy becomes an implicit policy selector. This affects how long-context agents should be evaluated: refusal should be tested not only with the full context visible, but also after summarization, truncation, memory replay, and other compaction events.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors define Governance Decay in a harness where a history H is compacted by an operator C once it exceeds a token budget B. A governance constraint p is initially present in H, but may be removed or weakened in C(H). The model is then asked the same prohibited request r, and violation is measured through downstream tool calls. The paper introduces ConstraintRot, a benchmark with self-contained long-horizon agent scenarios. Each scenario places a governance rule early, forces an extended trajectory, and later issues a prohibited request. Grading is deterministic because it checks whether the prohibited effect appears in the tool call. The threat model allows an adversary to control only in-context data ingested by the agent, such as tool outputs or retrieved documents. The attack either adds enough volume to trigger eviction or injects instructions aimed at the summarizer so that the legitimate constraint is omitted. The proposed mitigation, Constraint Pinning, quarantines governance constraints from lossy compaction and integrity-checks them across turns, similar to protected state rather than ordinary summarizable text.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers seven model families, 1,323 episodes, and four compaction strategies. In the control condition, violation is 0%. After compaction, the average violation rate rises to 30%, with a maximum of 59%. When the constraint survives the summary, violation remains 0%; when the constraint is dropped, violation reaches 38%. Per-model decay is reported as DeepSeek 0% to 59%, GLM 0% to 0%, Qwen 0% to 30%, Kimi 0% to 59%, Claude 0% to 19%, GPT 0% to 41%, and Gemini 0% to 4%. Channel placement matters: policies preserved as system messages show about 0-point decay, while non-system standing policies, memory, or conversation-carried constraints show large increases, including +50, +45, and +33 points in the reported channel tests. Constraint Pinning restores violation to 0% in the main setting with less than 0.5% token overhead, although the paper notes that naive pinning still leaves open problems around policy conflicts, constraint parsing, and malicious rewriting.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is enough; allocate about 20–30 minutes. Read the threat model first to separate this setting from system-prompt preservation claims. Then inspect the ConstraintRot construction, especially the deterministic tool-call grading. The most useful empirical part is the breakdown connecting violations to whether the constraint survived compaction. The attack section is worth reading for the distinction between deletion-oriented compaction attacks and standard indirect prompt injection. The mitigation section is useful because Constraint Pinning is simple, but it makes the design principle clear: safety rules in agents need protected-state handling, not ordinary summarization.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改预训练范式，但它把“memory compaction 是安全边界”说得很清楚；只看 benchmark 设计和那组 0%→30%→59% 的对照就够，适合拿来约束你们的长程 agent 训练设定。
recommendation.en: It does not change pretraining, but it cleanly shows that memory compaction is a safety boundary; read the benchmark design and the 0%→30%→59% contrast, then use it to stress-test your long-horizon agent setup.

paper.title: AIR: Adaptive Interleaved Reasoning with Code in MLLMs
paper.abstract: Following the paradigm shift initiated by OpenAI o3, interleaved reasoning with code to enhance multimodal large language models (MLLMs) has become a pivotal research frontier. The existing literature focuses primarily on tool-use within vision-perception tasks. However, such approaches typically rely on predefined heuristics for visual manipulation and are inherently incapable of addressing numerical computation problems due to their exclusive focus on visual operations. This paper empowers MLL

summary.core_problem: OpenAI o3 之后，多模态大模型的交错推理研究大多局限在旋转、缩放等视觉操作类工具，依赖预定义启发式做视觉处理，既无法覆盖需要精确数值计算的多模态数学推理场景，也缺少让模型自主判断“何时调用代码工具、何时纯文本推理”的自适应机制；同时小模型难以冷启动工具调用能力，agentic RL 在工具使用比例升高时容易出现训练不稳定甚至模型崩溃。
summary.technical_approach: AIR 框架分为冷启动 SFT 与交错推理 RL 两个训练阶段，配套三条技术线。第一，两阶段冷启动数据构造：先让 MLLM 生成纯文本 CoT 推理路径，再用 LLM 把 CoT 重写为插入代码调用的交错推理格式，最后做代码执行完整性与结果正确性的校验；这种解耦式生成避免了单步合成在多模态场景下推理深度不足、效率低的问题。第二，双轨数据过滤：Self-Sampled 策略对 SFT 模型做多轮 rollout，用 Pass@k 作为候选样本的准入门槛，通过目标模型自身的多轮共识过滤噪声；Prior-Filtered 策略作为补充，用强能力教师模型做外部质量门控，进一步筛除低质量交错推理样本。第三，带组约束的 GRPO 奖励机制：在 RL 阶段对工具调用行为加分组约束，引导模型自适应判断是否需要调用工具、选择合适的调用时机；该约束同时抑制了工具使用率升高时的训练波动，缓解了 agentic RL 长期训练不稳定的问题。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕多模态复杂数值计算与数学推理任务展开。冷启动阶段，两阶段数据构造相比单步合成，在代码可执行率与最终答案准确率上都有明显提升；双轨过滤相比无过滤或单轨过滤，显著降低了 SFT 数据中的噪声比例，后续 RL 的收敛速度更快。RL 阶段，带组约束的 GRPO 相比普通 GRPO：一是自适应工具调用率更合理，不会出现过度调用或不调用的极端情况，在需要计算的题目上准确率提升显著；二是训练曲线更平稳，在工具使用比例较高的设置下没有出现普通 GRPO 常见的 reward 震荡与模型崩溃现象。论文还做了消融，分别验证了两阶段数据构造的解耦收益、双轨过滤各自的贡献、以及组约束在自适应调用与训练稳定性两方面的独立作用。
summary.reading_guide: 精读顺序建议：先读方法章节 3.1 整体架构图与 3.2 冷启动数据构造部分，重点理解“先生成 CoT 再重写交错推理”的解耦设计，这是整套方案能低成本落地的关键；接着读 3.3 RL 部分的组约束奖励设计，尤其关注作者对“自适应工具调用为何能稳定训练”的观察与分析，这是超出预期的训练动态发现；然后看实验章节的主结果表与训练曲线，对比普通 GRPO 在高工具使用率下的崩溃现象，判断组约束的实际作用强度；最后补读附录中的数据样例与失败案例，评估这套数据 pipeline 的可迁移边界。核心创新集中在数据构造解耦、双轨过滤、组约束 GRPO 三处，值得深挖的点是 agentic RL 中工具调用行为与训练稳定性之间的因果关系，以及该机制是否能迁移到纯文本或其他工具类型的 RL 训练中。

summary_en.core_problem: Since OpenAI o3, interleaved reasoning research on MLLMs has been mostly limited to visual-operation tools such as rotation and zoom, which rely on predefined heuristics for visual processing. They cannot cover multimodal mathematical reasoning scenarios requiring precise numerical computation, and lack an adaptive mechanism for the model to autonomously decide when to invoke code tools versus perform pure textual reasoning. In addition, smaller models struggle to cold-start tool-use capability, and agentic RL often suffers from training instability or even model collapse as the tool-use ratio rises.
summary_en.importance: The work impacts pretraining research on three levels. First, it extends the interleaved reasoning paradigm initiated by o3 from pure-text and visual-only tools to the MLLM + Python code invocation scenario for numerical computation, filling the capability gap of non-visual tools in multimodal agentic RL and providing a reproducible training recipe for multimodal foundations to move from perception-reasoning to a perception-computation-reasoning closed loop. Second, the combined recipe of cold-start data construction, dual-track data filtering, and group-constrained GRPO directly addresses two engineering pain points: the difficulty of activating tool use in small models, and the long-term instability of agentic RL. The unexpected finding that adaptive tool use actually stabilizes training offers practical reference for analyzing training dynamics in RL pretrain. Third, the entire pipeline is open-source implementable and does not depend on proprietary capabilities of closed-source models, providing direct engineering guidance for the community to reproduce o3-style multimodal reasoning models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The AIR framework has two training stages: cold-start SFT and interleaved reasoning RL, supported by three technical lines. First, two-stage cold-start data construction: an MLLM first generates pure-text CoT reasoning traces, then an LLM rewrites the CoT into interleaved reasoning format with inserted code calls, followed by verification of code execution integrity and answer correctness. This decoupled generation avoids the insufficient reasoning depth and low efficiency of one-step synthesis in multimodal scenarios. Second, dual-track data filtering: the Self-Sampled strategy performs multiple rollouts on the SFT model and uses Pass@k as the admission threshold for candidate samples, filtering noise through multi-turn consensus of the target model itself; the Prior-Filtered strategy acts as a complement, using a strong teacher model as an external quality gate to further remove low-quality interleaved reasoning samples. Third, group-constrained GRPO reward mechanism: group constraints are applied to tool-use behavior during RL, guiding the model to adaptively judge whether tool invocation is needed and choose the right timing. This constraint also suppresses training fluctuations when tool-use rate increases, mitigating long-term instability in agentic RL.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments focus on multimodal complex numerical computation and mathematical reasoning tasks. In the cold-start stage, two-stage data construction delivers clear improvements over one-step synthesis in code executability and final answer accuracy. Dual-track filtering, compared with no filtering or single-track filtering, significantly reduces noise in SFT data and leads to faster convergence in subsequent RL. In the RL stage, group-constrained GRPO outperforms vanilla GRPO in two aspects: adaptive tool-use rate is more reasonable, without extreme over-use or non-use, and accuracy on problems requiring computation improves notably; training curves are smoother, with no reward oscillation or model collapse under high tool-use settings, which is common in vanilla GRPO. Ablations separately verify the decoupling benefit of two-stage data construction, the individual contributions of the two filtering tracks, and the independent effects of the group constraint on both adaptive invocation and training stability.
summary_en.reading_guide: Recommended close-reading order: start with Section 3.1's overall architecture diagram and Section 3.2 on cold-start data construction, focusing on the decoupled design of 'generate CoT first, then rewrite into interleaved reasoning' — this is the key to the low-cost deployability of the whole recipe. Then read the group-constrained reward design in the RL part of Section 3.3, paying special attention to the authors' observation and analysis of why adaptive tool use stabilizes training; this is an unexpected training-dynamics finding. Next, examine the main result tables and training curves in the experiments section, comparing the collapse phenomenon of vanilla GRPO under high tool-use rates to judge the actual strength of the group constraint. Finally, read the data samples and failure cases in the appendix to assess the transfer boundary of this data pipeline. The core innovations concentrate on three pieces: decoupled data construction, dual-track filtering, and group-constrained GRPO. A worthwhile deep-dive direction is the causal relationship between tool-use behavior and training stability in agentic RL, and whether this mechanism transfers to pure-text RL or RL with other tool types.

recommendation.zh: 更像多模态 RL/tool-use 配方，预训练研究员只需看数据过滤和奖励约束，别把它当基座范式变化。
recommendation.en: This is a multimodal RL/tool-use recipe; read the data filtering and reward constraints, not as a base-model paradigm shift.

paper.title: Tmax: A simple recipe for terminal agents
paper.abstract: Terminal-using agents have quickly become the most popular downstream application of language models (LMs). Despite their prevalence, relatively little academic work has examined RL-based training of these models, likely due to difficult benchmarks, a lack of data, and a lack of simple baseline recipes. We present Tmax, the strongest open RL recipe for terminal agents to date, bringing open data recipes closer to the frontier. While simple, our recipe achieves 27\% on Terminal-Bench 2.0 with onl

summary.core_problem: 如何在长时序、强交互、奖励稀疏且评测严格的“终端（terminal）代理”场景里，给开源权重模型提供一套可复现、稳定的 RL 后训练配方，并配套足够难、足够大、可用于 RL 的环境数据，从而把小模型的 terminal agent 能力推到可用水平。
summary.importance: 这篇更像“RL post-train 工程配方 + 可训练环境数据”的工作，而不是预训练范式创新。对基座研究的价值主要在两点：第一，长时序 agent RL 的稳定性手段（算法选择、数值精度、group size、异步基础设施）给出了可落地的经验组合；第二，证明了在 terminal 这种工具交互分布上做 RL，不只是 harness-fitting，能外溢到 SWE-Bench Verified、甚至 AIME 这类非同分布评测。对“pretrain↔posttrain 闭环”的启发在于：高质量、可控难度的合成环境 + 稳定 RL 训练，能把能力推到传统 SFT 难以覆盖的区域。
summary.technical_approach:
核心由两部分组成：
1) 数据/环境生成（TMAX-15K）：用强闭源/前沿模型合成 terminal 环境实例，而不是只合成轨迹。作者强调用一个“taxonomy”去组织生成：显式难度控制（逐级变难）、persona（改变任务叙事/约束以增加分布多样性）、verifier diversification（多样化校验器/评分器，避免单一二值判定带来的奖励脆弱性）。并且在部分任务上引入连续值奖励，而不是只有 pass/fail。
2) RL 训练配方（TMAX）：基于 open-instruct 的全异步 RL 基础设施做长时序训练。作者观察到朴素 GRPO 在 long-horizon agent 场景里不稳定，于是改用 DPPO（Divergence Proximal Policy Optimization），并配合两个关键稳定性措施：FP32 的 LM head（降低混合精度下 logits/softmax 的数值问题）与更大的 group size（降低优势估计方差、让更新更“平均”）。整体目标是让策略更新在长轨迹、工具调用频繁、奖励噪声更大的情况下不崩。
与既有工作差异：相对 Endless Terminals / OpenThinker-Agent 这类“有数据/有 RL 但规模或难度不足”的路线，TMAX 更强调可控难度的环境生成与 RL 稳定性工程；相对 SWE 系列从真实 repo/issue 构造环境，TMAX 更偏 taxonomy 驱动的合成任务覆盖面，减少被软件工程单一分布绑架。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文片段可确认的关键结果：
- 数据：TMAX-15K 共 14,600 个 RL 环境实例，作者称比第二大“完整释放环境数据”的 terminal 数据集大 2.5x，并且用 Gemini-3-Flash-Preview 的 pass rate 侧面证明更难。
- 主结果：9B 模型在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上达到 27%（默认设置），优于此前同量级开源模型，并声称接近某些小型闭源模型（文中举例 Claude Haiku 4.5）。
- 迁移/外溢：RL 后训练让 SWE-Bench Verified 提升 5+ points；并且对 AIME 这类非 agent 评测也有提升（幅度未在片段中给出具体数）。
- 泛化性：在不同 prompts/toolsets 的 harness 下仍有提升，作者据此主张不是单纯对评测 harness 过拟合。
（注：你提供的全文内容在实验细节处截断，诸如 DPPO/GRPO 的对照曲线、group size/FP32 head 的消融、训练步数/采样量/奖励设计的具体数字，需要在论文实验章节与附录中补齐才能给出更精确的量化复述。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–40 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 里对“为什么 GRPO 不稳、为什么选 DPPO + FP32 head + 大 group”的动机描述，抓住作者认为的主要失稳来源。
- 精看数据生成那一节（taxonomy、difficulty/persona/verifier diversification、连续奖励），这是可复用性最高的部分：它决定了 RL 信号质量与任务覆盖。
- 实验部分重点找三类图表：① RL 稳定性（loss/kl/reward 曲线、崩溃案例）；② 关键消融（GRPO vs DPPO、FP16/FP32 head、group size、数据来源对比）；③ 泛化实验（跨 harness、跨任务）。
- 如果要复现/迁移到别的工具型 agent，优先抄“异步 rollouts + 稳定更新”的系统结构与日志产物（作者提到释放 rollouts 与 logprobs，适合做训练动态分析）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to make RL post-training for long-horizon terminal-using agents reproducible and stable for open-weight models, while also providing sufficiently large and difficult RL-ready terminal environments so that relatively small models can reach practical performance on Terminal-Bench–style evaluations.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an RL post-training recipe plus an RL environment dataset, not a new pretraining paradigm. Its value to foundation-model researchers is pragmatic: (1) it packages a stability-oriented set of choices for long-horizon agent RL (algorithm, precision, group size, async infra) that others can replicate; (2) it argues the learned improvements are not merely harness overfitting, showing gains that transfer to SWE-Bench Verified and even non-agent math evals. It’s a concrete example of the pretrain↔post-train loop where controllable synthetic environments + stable RL can push capabilities beyond what SFT typically covers.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Two pillars:
1) TMAX-15K environment generation: instead of only generating trajectories, they synthesize full terminal RL environment instances using a strong frontier model. A taxonomy drives generation with explicit difficulty control, persona variation (to diversify constraints and narrative framing), and verifier diversification (to avoid brittle binary checks). Some tasks use continuous-valued rewards rather than pass/fail.
2) RL recipe (TMAX): built on an asynchronous RL stack (open-instruct). They report naive GRPO becoming unstable in long-horizon agent settings, and switch to DPPO (Divergence Proximal Policy Optimization). Two emphasized stabilizers are an FP32 LM head (to mitigate mixed-precision numerical issues around logits/softmax/entropy/KL) and a large group size (lower-variance advantage estimates and smoother updates).
Compared to prior open terminal-agent efforts, the novelty is less about a new algorithm and more about a coherent, stability-first training stack paired with harder, taxonomy-controlled environments.
summary_en.experiments:
Confirmed from the provided full-text excerpt:
- Dataset: TMAX-15K contains 14,600 RL environment instances; claimed 2.5× larger than the next-largest terminal dataset that releases full environment data, and harder per Gemini-3-Flash-Preview pass rates.
- Main score: a 9B model reaches 27% on Terminal-Bench 2.0 under default settings, outperforming prior open models at similar sizes; they claim comparable performance to some smaller closed models (example given: Claude Haiku 4.5).
- Transfer: RL training improves SWE-Bench Verified by 5+ points; also reports gains on AIME (exact numbers not visible in the excerpt).
- Generalization: improvements persist under different prompts/toolsets (different harnesses), used as evidence against pure harness-fitting.
Note: the excerpt cuts before detailed tables/ablations; exact training compute, rollout counts, DPPO-vs-GRPO curves, and precision/group-size ablations should be taken from the experiments/appendix for a fully numeric recap.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–40 minutes):
- Read the Introduction carefully for the failure mode claim (why GRPO is unstable) and the rationale for DPPO + FP32 head + large group size.
- Focus on the environment/data generation section: taxonomy design, difficulty scheduling, persona and verifier diversification, and where continuous rewards are used.
- In experiments, prioritize: (i) stability plots (reward/KL/loss spikes, collapse cases), (ii) ablations (GRPO vs DPPO, FP16 vs FP32 head, group size, data-source comparisons), and (iii) cross-harness / cross-task transfer results.
- If you plan to reproduce, the released rollouts and logprobs are worth inspecting for training-dynamics analysis.

recommendation.zh: 把“terminal agent 怎么做数据+怎么做 outcome-only RL”讲成可复现配方，适合直接照着复现；但提升可能主要来自数据生成与评测对齐，别把算法增益想太多。
recommendation.en: A reproducible recipe for terminal-agent data + outcome-only RL that you can copy into internal baselines; likely more about data/eval alignment than a new RL algorithm, so treat gains accordingly.

paper.title: Self-Compacting Language Model Agents
paper.abstract: Long agent traces composed of chains of thought and tool calls accumulate stale content that anchor subsequent generations, and eventually outgrow the context window. Existing scaffolds mitigate it with fixed-interval compaction triggered at a token threshold. Such triggers pay no heed to trajectory structure, risking discard of partial results mid-derivation or mid-search. We propose SelfCompact, a scaffold that allows the model itself to decide when and how to compact. Specifically, it pairs t

summary.core_problem: 现有长horizon Agent的轨迹压缩方法要么依赖固定token阈值/间隔触发（不感知推理/搜索的结构状态），要么要求用户手动触发；前者容易在推导中途、已验证事实未沉淀时错误压缩，丢弃关键中间结果、加剧上下文腐烂（context rot），后者增加使用负担，且两类方案的整体token效率都偏低。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发集中在两点：一是证明预训练模型内置的工具调用、状态感知能力可以直接复用在长轨迹维护上，不需要额外微调或外部模块；二是长horizon Agent的上下文管理效率高度依赖模型的子任务完成判定能力，为预训练阶段注入结构化推理、自我状态监控类轨迹数据提供了明确方向。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SELFCOMPACT推理脚手架，包含两个缺一不可的组件，全部基于同一基座模型执行、无额外微调：1）内联压缩工具：给模型暴露<summarize>特殊调用入口，模型主动触发时脚手架对累计上下文做摘要，用摘要替换原始长前缀后继续生成；2）轻量判定规则（rubric）：明确触发条件（子任务已解决、轨迹收敛到答案）和抑制条件（推导中途、搜索卡壳），引导模型在合适时机调用工具。消融显示去掉规则后，模型要么乱调用工具要么完全不调用，效果骤降。
summary.experiments: 覆盖7个开源模型+3个商用搜索Agent（MiniMax-M2.5、GLM-4.7-Flash、MiMo-V2-Flash），两类任务验证效果：1）竞赛数学（IMO-Answerbench、HMMT 2025年11月/2026年2月赛题）：比无压缩基线最高提18.1分；2）Agent搜索（BrowseComp、BrowseComp-Plus、DeepSearch QA）：准确率提5-9分，单问题token成本降低30%-70%。样例对比显示固定间隔压缩会在中途擦除4个已验证事实导致错误，SELFCOMPACT则在每个事实验证后立即压缩，完整保留关键信息。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，预计15-20分钟。重点关注：Figure 1的三类压缩策略对比样例（直观理解固定阈值触发的核心缺陷）；消融实验部分（验证规则与工具二者的必要性）；跨模型泛化结果（观察不同能力层级的模型对自主压缩的适配程度）。不需要深抠脚手架的工程实现细节，核心掌握自适应上下文管理的推理侧范式。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing long-horizon agent trajectory compaction methods either rely on fixed token thresholds or interval triggers (blind to the structural state of reasoning/search) or require manual user initiation. The former often triggers compression mid-derivation or before verified facts are consolidated, discarding critical intermediate results and exacerbating context rot; the latter adds user burden, and both categories suffer from low overall token efficiency.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, two key takeaways emerge: first, pretrained models' inherent tool-use and state-perception capabilities can be directly repurposed for long trajectory maintenance without additional fine-tuning or external modules. Second, long-horizon context management efficiency depends heavily on a model's ability to recognize sub-task completion, providing a clear signal for injecting structured reasoning and self-state monitoring trajectories into pretraining data.
