summary_en.technical_approach: SELFCOMPACT is an inference-time scaffold with two co-dependent components, both executed by the same base model without fine-tuning: 1) An inline compaction tool that exposes a <summarize> call interface; when triggered, the scaffold summarizes the accumulated context and replaces the original long prefix with the summary to resume generation. 2) A lightweight rubric that explicitly defines trigger conditions (sub-task resolved, trajectory converging to an answer) and suppression conditions (mid-derivation, search stuck) to guide appropriate tool use. Ablations show removing the rubric leads to either excessive unhelpful calls or no tool use at all, with severe performance degradation.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 7 open-weight models and 3 deployed search agents (MiniMax-M2.5, GLM-4.7-Flash, MiMo-V2-Flash) across two task families: 1) Competition math (IMO-Answerbench, HMMT Nov 2025 / Feb 2026): up to 18.1 point gain over the no-compaction baseline. 2) Agentic search (BrowseComp, BrowseComp-Plus, DeepSearch QA): 5-9 point accuracy gain with 30-70% lower per-question token cost. A case comparison shows fixed-interval compression wipes 4 verified facts mid-trajectory and produces a wrong answer, while SELFCOMPACT triggers compaction right after each fact is verified and retains all critical information.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read, 15-20 minutes estimated. Focus on: Figure 1's side-by-side comparison of three compaction strategies (intuitive demonstration of fixed-trigger flaws); the ablation study validating the necessity of both the rubric and inline tool; cross-model generalization results to observe how model capability correlates with self-compaction performance. No need to dig into engineering implementation details; the core takeaway is the adaptive context management paradigm at inference time.

recommendation.zh: 针对 Agent 长轨迹的 context 管理，提出用 tool + rubric 让模型自适应压缩历史，思路很干净。做长序列 Agent 或 R1-style 长 CoT 截断的同学可以参考其 rubric 设计。
recommendation.en: Proposes using a tool + rubric for adaptive history compaction in long agent traces. The clean approach is a good reference for those working on long-sequence Agents or R1-style long CoT truncation.

paper.title: Don't Blindly Trust It: How Unreliable Feedback Breaks Tool-Using LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Tool-augmented agents are typically evaluated by their gains under reliable external feedback. Yet these gains leave open a key counterfactual: when feedback is unreliable, would the agent be better off receiving no task evidence? We study this question with a controlled matched-loop comparison that fixes the agent loop, prompt, action space, and decoding, while varying only the returned observation: faithful, misleading, or absent. Across question answering and fact verification, persistent mis

summary.core_problem: 工具增强 LLM agent 的评估通常默认工具反馈是可靠的，因此只比较“有干净工具”相对“无工具”的收益。论文提出一个更关键的反事实问题：当外部反馈不可靠甚至具有误导性时，使用工具是否还不如完全不接收任务证据？
summary.importance: 对工具使用、检索增强、agent 训练和 web-grounded 预训练/后训练都有实际意义。论文揭示的不是“噪声会伤害性能”这种预期结果，而是存在 value inversion 区间：工具依赖一旦建立，模型会轻易被错误观测带偏，表现低于同一 agent loop 下的无反馈回退。这提示在训练 tool-using agent 时，需要显式建模“何时信任观测、何时回退到参数知识”，否则 RAG/工具调用在开放环境中的实际收益可能被高估。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是 matched-loop comparison：固定 agent loop、prompt、动作空间、解码策略，只改变工具返回观测的性质。三种条件分别是 clean（忠实反馈）、corrupted（误导性反馈，包括 shuffle 和同题干扰项）、no-feedback（工具接口仍在但不返回任务证据，agent 必须在相同交互结构下回退到自身知识）。这种设计把差异严格归因于观测保真度，而不是 scaffold 变化。论文进一步测试了 inversion 的边界：错误证据是否持续、后期干净证据能否修复、不同 scaffold 和模型规模下是否成立、简单修复策略（怀疑式提示、重查验证）是否有效。
summary.experiments: 在 HotpotQA 上，Qwen2.5-7B 干净检索 F1 为 44.8，无反馈为 22.3，shuffle 检索仅 4.7，出现明显的价值反转。FEVER 和 GPT-4o 上观察到相同定性排序。用局部合理的同题干扰项替换 shuffle 噪声后，inversion 仍然存在；更强的检索后端提升了干净条件上限，但 corrupted 条件仍低于 no-feedback。若早期误导、后期重新引入干净证据，性能可部分恢复。怀疑式提示只有小幅收益，re-query 验证多数时候只是把控制权交还给回退答案。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看 matched-loop 设计（第 2 节）和 value inversion 的边界条件分析。结果本身直观，真正有价值的是对照组设置：必须把 no-feedback 做成同一 loop 下的回退，而不是换一个 closed-book prompt，否则无法区分“工具价值下降”和“工具价值反转”。预计阅读时间 25–35 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Tool-augmented LLM agents are typically evaluated under the assumption that external feedback is reliable, so the comparison of interest is clean tools versus no tools. The paper asks a sharper counterfactual: when external feedback is unreliable or actively misleading, is the agent actually worse off receiving task evidence than receiving no evidence at all?
summary_en.importance: The finding matters for tool use, retrieval augmentation, agent training, and web-grounded data workflows. The point is not the unsurprising fact that noise hurts performance, but that there exists a regime of value inversion: once agents become dependent on tool observations, misleading feedback can push them below a matched no-feedback fallback. This suggests that training tool-using agents requires explicit modeling of when to trust observations and when to fall back to parametric knowledge; otherwise the real-world benefit of RAG or tool calls can be overestimated under benign evaluation setups.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper uses a controlled matched-loop comparison: the agent loop, prompt, action space, and decoding are held fixed, and only the observation returned by the tool is varied. The three conditions are clean (faithful feedback), corrupted (misleading feedback, including shuffled evidence and in-topic distractors), and no-feedback (the tool interface remains available but returns no task evidence, forcing the agent to rely on its own knowledge within the same interaction structure). This isolates observation fidelity as the causal variable, rather than confounding it with scaffold changes. The paper then studies boundary conditions: whether misleading feedback is persistent, whether later clean evidence can repair trajectories, whether the pattern holds across scaffolds and model scales, and whether simple repairs such as skeptical prompting or re-query verification help.
summary_en.experiments: On HotpotQA, Qwen2.5-7B achieves 44.8 F1 with clean retrieval, 22.3 F1 with no feedback, but only 4.7 F1 under shuffled retrieval, a clear value inversion. The same ordering appears on FEVER and with GPT-4o. Replacing shuffled text with locally plausible same-question distractors preserves the inversion; stronger retrieval backends raise the clean ceiling but leave corrupted performance below the no-feedback fallback. If misleading feedback appears early but clean evidence is reintroduced later, performance partially recovers. Skeptical prompting yields only modest gains, and re-query verification often just returns control to the fallback answer.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level reading. Focus on the matched-loop design in Section 2 and the analysis of boundary conditions for inversion. The result itself is intuitive; the useful contribution is the control condition: no-feedback must be implemented as a fallback inside the same agent loop rather than as a separate closed-book prompt, otherwise tool-value decrease cannot be distinguished from tool-value inversion. Estimated reading time: 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读实验设计和 HotpotQA 数字；它把“工具总有正收益”的默认假设打得很干净。
recommendation.en: Read the matched-loop design and the HotpotQA numbers; it cleanly breaks the default assumption that tools are always net-positive.

paper.title: When Lower Privileges Suffice: Investigating Over-Privileged Tool Selection in LLM Agents
paper.abstract: As LLM agents increasingly select tools autonomously, their choices among tools with different privileges become safety-relevant. However, prior tool-selection studies focus on safety-agnostic metadata preferences, leaving privilege-sensitive choices underexplored. To address this gap, we study over-privileged tool selection, in which an agent selects or escalates to a higher-privilege tool despite a sufficient lower-privilege alternative. We introduce ToolPrivBench to evaluate whether agents ch

summary.core_problem: 在多工具可用且权限等级不同的 agent 场景里，LLM 往往会选择“权限更大但非必要”的工具（或在轻微失败后过早升级权限）。论文要回答的是：当低权限工具已足够完成任务时，主流 LLM agent 是否具备“最小权限”偏好；这种偏差在什么条件下被放大；以及能否用可操作的训练/对齐手段把它压下去而不明显伤害任务成功率。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献（更偏 agent safety / post-train 行为塑形），但对“对齐信号能否泛化到结构化安全偏好”有现实启发：常规安全对齐并不会自动带来最小权限的工具选择；而且在多轮、带失败恢复的轨迹里，模型会把“成功概率/省事”当作隐式目标，牺牲权限最小化。这类偏差如果被纳入偏好数据或 RL 信号，会反过来影响后续持续预训练/对齐阶段的行为分布（工具调用分布、失败恢复策略、风险暴露面）。
summary.technical_approach:
核心做法是把“是否需要高权限”从“是否能完成任务”里剥离出来，用一个仿真基准 ToolPrivBench 专门测 privilege-sensitive tool selection。
- 任务构造：每个 case 给 6 个工具（3 低权限、3 高权限），并通过设计保证“每个低权限工具都独立足够完成任务”，从而把选择高权限解释为偏好/策略问题而非能力不足。
- 行为定义：两类 over-privilege。
  1) aggressive selection：一开始就选高权限工具。
  2) premature escalation：先用低权限工具，但在出现短暂、与权限无关的失败（transient failure）后，过早切到高权限工具；评估时把“尚未尝试的低权限充分工具”视为仍可行备选，因此在未穷尽前升级即记为 over-privileged。
- 覆盖面：8 个应用域 + 5 类重复出现的风险模式（文中以“风险类型”组织案例族），并区分初始选择与失败后的升级决策。
- 干预：对比常规 safety alignment、prompt 工程等手段的效果与多轮退化；提出一个 privilege-aware 的 post-training 防御（更像定向偏好学习/行为约束），目标是在保持总体完成度的同时减少不必要的高权限调用。论文强调 prompt 工程在多轮里会衰减，因而需要训练级别的行为塑形。
summary.experiments:
论文主结果是现象学 + 干预有效性：
- 现象：主流 LLM agents 普遍存在 over-privileged tool selection；在引入 transient tool failure 后，premature escalation 明显增多（失败恢复阶段更倾向“升级权限换成功率”）。
- 对齐泛化：常规安全对齐对“最小权限选择”不稳定，说明它没有把 least-privilege 当作可迁移的安全原则内化。
- 干预对比：prompt 工程能降低一部分高权限选择，但在 multi-turn/有失败恢复的设置下效果变弱；提出的 privilege-aware post-training 能“显著减少”不必要的高权限使用，同时“基本保持”通用性能（文中用任务成功/整体表现来约束）。
注：你给的全文片段未包含具体表格数字、模型清单与提升幅度；若需要精确数字，需要对照论文实验章节的主表与消融表逐项摘录。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
1) 先看 Introduction 里对问题的界定：它把风险从“工具能不能做”转成“用多大权限去做”，这是全文的逻辑支点。
2) 重点看 Evaluation Setup：尤其是“低权限工具独立足够”的验证流程、over-privilege 的形式化定义、以及 transient failure 的注入方式；这些决定了结论是否站得住。
3) 直接跳到主结果表：分别看 aggressive selection 与 premature escalation 的比例，以及不同域/风险类型的差异。
4) 看干预部分：对比 prompt 工程在单轮 vs 多轮的退化曲线；再看 privilege-aware post-training 的训练信号是什么、约束了哪些行为（是否是偏好对、规则惩罚、或轨迹级奖励）。
5) 若你做 pretrain/posttrain 闭环：额外关注它如何定义“权限元数据”、以及这种元数据能否作为通用 tool schema 融入训练（例如作为 tool card 的结构化字段进入模型上下文）。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM agents often pick higher-privilege tools even when lower-privilege tools are sufficient, and they may escalate privileges prematurely after transient, privilege-irrelevant failures. The paper asks: how prevalent is this “over-privileged tool selection” under controlled conditions, what factors amplify it (especially failure recovery), and can targeted post-training reduce unnecessary high-privilege tool use without materially hurting task success?
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to the pretrain↔post-train loop in a concrete way: standard safety alignment does not reliably generalize to a least-privilege behavioral principle, and multi-turn trajectories expose a strong implicit objective of “maximize success / minimize friction,” which can dominate privilege minimization. If tool-use traces and preference data are later recycled into continual pretraining or RL-style alignment, this bias can become a stable part of the model’s behavioral distribution (tool-call priors, recovery policies, and risk surface).
summary_en.technical_approach:
They introduce ToolPrivBench, a simulation benchmark designed to decouple privilege choice from capability.
- Case design: each instance provides six tools (three low-privilege, three high-privilege), and critically, each low-privilege tool is constructed to be independently sufficient for the task. This removes the confound “the safe tool can’t do it.”
- Behavioral targets: (1) aggressive selection (choosing high privilege upfront) and (2) premature escalation (switching to high privilege after transient failures that are unrelated to privilege).
- Formalization: over-privilege is defined as selecting a higher-privilege tool while there still exist unruled-out sufficient low-privilege tools (including untried ones).
- Coverage: eight application domains and five recurring risk patterns.
- Mitigations: they compare conventional safety alignment and prompt-based interventions (noting multi-turn degradation), and propose a privilege-aware post-training defense aimed at reducing unnecessary high-privilege calls while preserving overall performance.
summary_en.experiments:
Main findings are empirical prevalence + mitigation behavior:
- Over-privileged tool selection is common across mainstream agent setups.
- Injecting transient tool failures increases premature escalation, suggesting failure recovery is a key amplifier.
- Conventional safety alignment does not consistently yield least-privilege tool choice.
- Prompting helps but weakens in multi-turn settings; privilege-aware post-training substantially reduces unnecessary high-privilege usage while largely maintaining general task performance.
Note: the provided full-text excerpt does not include the numeric tables (model list, rates, deltas). Exact figures should be pulled from the main results and ablation tables in the experiments section.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
1) Read the problem framing in the Introduction: the key move is redefining failure from “can the agent solve it” to “does it solve it with minimal privilege.”
2) Focus on the Evaluation Setup: how they guarantee low-privilege sufficiency, the formal definition of over-privilege, and how transient failures are injected.
3) Jump to the main results: separate initial selection vs escalation-after-failure, and check domain/risk-pattern breakdowns.
4) Read the mitigation section: look for why prompting degrades over turns, and what training signal the privilege-aware post-training uses (pairwise preferences, rule-based penalties, or trajectory-level rewards).
5) If you care about training interfaces: examine how privilege metadata is represented and whether it could be standardized as part of tool schemas for future training data.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是 pretrain，但结论对 post-train 很扎实：安全对齐不会自动学会 least privilege，做 tool-use 的团队应直接复现 benchmark 和 failure-induced escalation 设置。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the post-training lesson is solid: safety alignment does not buy least-privilege behavior for free; tool-use teams should reproduce the benchmark and the failure-induced escalation setup.

institutions: Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences
Institute for Artificial Intelligence, Peking University

paper.title: AutoPass: Evidence-Guided LLM Agents for Compiler Performance Tuning
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise for code compilation tasks, but applying them to runtime performance tuning is difficult due to complex microarchitectural effects and noisy runtime measurements. We present AutoPass, a multi-agent framework for compiler performance tuning that uses compiler and runtime evidence to guide LLM-generated optimization decisions. Rather than treating the compiler as a black box like prior auto-tuning schemes, AutoPass opens up the compiler to the LLM, enablin

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 用于编译器性能调优时难以处理微架构效应、运行时噪声和编译器内部状态不可见的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent / compiler agent 方法创新。它不推进基座预训练，但提供了一个较干净的 tool-use 场景：LLM 不只生成代码或参数，而是读取编译器内部证据并闭环修正。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AutoPass，多 Agent 框架在无需训练和无需微调的 inference-only 设置下运行。系统允许 LLM 查询编译器内部优化状态、分析中间表示，并结合实际运行时测量，迭代诊断性能回退和调整编译选项。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整平台、benchmark 和提升幅度。可确认的是它以运行时延迟为反馈，和把编译器当黑盒的自动调优方案形成对比，并强调可迁移到新 benchmark 和硬件平台。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the difficulty of using LLMs for compiler performance tuning under complex microarchitectural effects, noisy runtime measurements, and hidden compiler-internal states.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a coding-agent method for compiler optimization. It does not advance foundation pretraining, but it offers a relatively clean tool-use setting where the LLM reads compiler evidence rather than merely emitting code or flags.
summary_en.technical_approach: AutoPass is an inference-only, training-free multi-agent framework. It lets LLMs query compiler-internal optimization states, inspect intermediate representations, and use measured runtime feedback to diagnose regressions and iteratively refine optimization configurations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide full platform details, benchmarks, or exact gains. It states that AutoPass is evaluated through runtime feedback and contrasted with black-box auto-tuning schemes, with emphasis on portability to new benchmarks and platforms.

recommendation.zh: 看系统接口设计即可；把编译器状态暴露给 LLM 比纯 prompt 搜索更靠谱，但这是工具闭环，不是训练范式。
recommendation.en: Read the system-interface design only; exposing compiler state to the LLM is cleaner than prompt-only search, but this is a tool loop, not a training paradigm.

paper.title: Beyond the GUI Paradigm: Do Mobile Agents Need the Phone Screen?
paper.abstract: Recent advances in mobile agents are dominated by the GUI paradigm, in which agents perceive UI information and emit screen interactions. However, mobile platforms also expose a command-line interface (CLI) that provides direct access to device services and data. We argue CLI deserves first-class consideration alongside GUI. We evaluate three coding agents (Claude Code, Terminus-2, mini-swe-agent) across four model APIs on AndroidWorld and MobileWorld without any mobile-specific post-training, c

summary.core_problem: 研究移动端 Agent 是否必须通过手机屏幕 GUI 感知和操作，还是可以把 CLI 作为一等交互接口。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 交互范式分析。它挑战了移动 Agent 默认走视觉 GUI 的设定，指出直接调用移动平台命令行接口可能在任务成功率、可复现性和可控性上更有优势。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在 AndroidWorld 和 MobileWorld 上比较 CLI Agent 与可复现 GUI baseline。CLI 侧使用 Claude Code、Terminus-2、mini-swe-agent 三类 coding agent，并接入四种模型 API；GUI 侧比较 GUI-Owl-1.5-32B、MAI-UI、Qwen3-VL-32B。实验不做移动场景专门后训练，同时给出 oracle CLI solutions 来估计 CLI 范式上限。
summary.experiments: Claude Code 搭配 Opus 4.7 在 AndroidWorld 和 MobileWorld 上分别达到 71.8% 和 51.9%，超过可复现 GUI baseline。GUI baseline 在 AndroidWorld 上为 69.3%、68.1%、57.8%，在 MobileWorld 上为 43.2%、26.3%、13.3%。oracle CLI solutions 在 AndroidWorld 达到 88.8%，其中 103/116 个任务可由 CLI 解决；在 MobileWorld 达到 86.3%，其中 101/117 个任务可由 CLI 解决。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 Mila – Québec AI Institute、Concordia University、University of Toronto、McMaster University；未见可确认的 LLM 基座预训练知名作者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether mobile agents really need to perceive and operate through phone-screen GUIs, or whether command-line interfaces should be treated as first-class interaction channels.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-interface paradigm study. It challenges the default GUI-centric framing of mobile agents and shows that direct access to platform services through CLI can be competitive or stronger under reproducible evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors evaluate CLI-based agents on AndroidWorld and MobileWorld using Claude Code, Terminus-2, and mini-swe-agent across four model APIs, without mobile-specific post-training. They compare against reproducible GUI baselines including GUI-Owl-1.5-32B, MAI-UI, and Qwen3-VL-32B. Oracle CLI solutions are added to estimate the ceiling of the CLI paradigm.
summary_en.experiments: Claude Code with Opus 4.7 reaches 71.8% on AndroidWorld and 51.9% on MobileWorld, outperforming the reproducible GUI baselines. The GUI baselines score 69.3%, 68.1%, and 57.8% on AndroidWorld, and 43.2%, 26.3%, and 13.3% on MobileWorld. Oracle CLI solutions reach 88.8% on AndroidWorld with 103/116 CLI-solvable tasks and 86.3% on MobileWorld with 101/117 CLI-solvable tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include Mila – Québec AI Institute, Concordia University, University of Toronto, and McMaster University; no clearly identifiable foundation-model pretraining lead is indicated in the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 预训练侧不用细读；但 Agent 接口选择的 prior 会被改动，看 abstract 数字和 oracle CLI 上限即可。
recommendation.en: No need to read deeply for pretraining, but it shifts the prior on agent interfaces; the abstract numbers and oracle CLI ceiling are the useful parts.

paper.title: S-Agent: Spatial Tool-Use Elicits Reasoning for Spatial Intelligence
paper.abstract: Real-world spatial intelligence requires reasoning over a continuous and evolving 3D world, yet existing VLMs and tool-augmented agents largely remain tied to static, stateless inference from isolated visual observations. We introduce \textbf{\textsc{S-Agent}}, a spatial tool-use agentic paradigm for understanding and reasoning over continuous multi-view images and videos. By formulating spatial reasoning as spatio-temporal evidence accumulation rather than isolated frame-level prediction, \text

summary.core_problem: 让 VLM/Agent 从静态、单帧视觉问答扩展到连续多视角图像和视频中的空间推理，能够累积 3D 证据并回答计数、测量、朝向、相对位置等问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态 agent 方法和空间工具使用框架。它不是预训练论文，但对 native multimodal 模型的能力边界有参考价值：很多空间能力可能仍需要显式工具、记忆和几何证据累积，而不是只靠单次 VLM 前向。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 S-Agent，将 VLM 作为语义 planner，由它决定需要哪些空间证据；下层是一组分层空间工具和专家，负责 2D 目标 grounding、提升到 3D 几何证据，并把证据聚合成场景级空间知识。系统还加入 temporal memory，在连续观测中维护和更新空间状态。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark、模型参数量、工具实现细节、基线和数值结果。可确认的评估对象是连续多视角图像和视频中的空间理解与推理任务，包括计数、测量、方向和相对位置。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to move VLM agents beyond static single-frame inference toward spatial reasoning over continuous multi-view images and videos, with accumulated 3D evidence for counting, measurement, orientation, and relative position.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a multimodal agent framework for spatial tool use. It is not a pretraining paper, but it gives a useful signal about current VLM limitations: spatial intelligence may still require explicit tools, memory, and geometric evidence accumulation rather than one-shot VLM inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: S-Agent uses the VLM as a semantic planner that decides what evidence is needed. A hierarchy of spatial tools and experts grounds objects in 2D, lifts them into 3D geometric evidence, and aggregates evidence into scene-centric spatial knowledge. A temporal memory module maintains spatial state across continuous observations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide benchmark names, model scale, tool implementation details, baselines, or numerical results. The evaluated setting involves spatial understanding and reasoning over continuous multi-view images and videos, including counting, measurement, orientation, and relative position.

recommendation.zh: 只看工具分层和 memory 设计；它更像空间感知 agent 工程，暂时不能反推 VLM 预训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Read only the tool hierarchy and memory design; it is spatial-agent engineering, not evidence for a VLM pretraining recipe.

paper.title: Analyzing the Narration Gap in LLM-Solver Loops
paper.abstract: Formal tools such as SAT and SMT solvers are increasingly embedded in language model reasoning pipelines when a safety or security critical question can be formulated in logic. Unlike chain of thought whose steps are sampled from the model distribution without formal guarantee, a solver produces a sound and independently verifiable answer. However, the soundness guarantee can be lost in the interaction between the solver and the model. The hybrid pipeline has three components: formalizing the qu

summary.core_problem: 分析 LLM 调用 SAT/SMT 等形式化 solver 后，如何在把 solver 输出转写成用户答案时丢失原本的 soundness guarantee。
summary.importance: 贡献是 tool-use / LLM-solver pipeline 的可靠性分析，指出形式化工具的正确性不会自动传递到最终自然语言回答；对通用 agent 工具调用安全有参考价值，但不直接服务于基座预训练。
summary.technical_approach: 将 LLM-solver loop 建模为 verified decision procedure，拆分为 formalization、decision、narration 三段；重点研究 narration step，并用 certificate gating 约束 solver verdict，再测试 prompt injection 对最终叙述的影响。
summary.experiments: 评估 5 个开源模型在 prompt injection 下的表现；摘要称 certificate gating 可保持 solver verdict 的 soundness，但攻击者仍可通过不同措辞和 channel 反转最终自然语言结论。未给出具体模型名单和数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how LLM pipelines that call SAT/SMT solvers can lose formal soundness when the solver’s output is narrated back to the user.
summary_en.importance: It is a reliability analysis for tool-using LLM systems. The main value is separating solver correctness from answer narration, showing that a formally verified decision can still be corrupted in the final language layer.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors model the LLM-solver loop as a verified decision procedure with three stages: formalization, decision, and narration. They focus on the narration stage, apply certificate gating to protect solver verdicts, and test prompt-injection attacks against the final answer.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates five open-source models under prompt injection. The abstract reports that certificate gating preserves the solver verdict, while adversarial prompts can still invert the verified conclusion across phrasings and channels. Model names and exact numbers are not available in the provided abstract.

recommendation.zh: 工具调用安全的边界案例；只看 narration gap 的形式化和攻击样例，和预训练关系很远。
recommendation.en: A useful boundary case for tool-use safety; read the narration-gap formalization and attack examples, not as a pretraining paper.

paper.title: ORAgentBench: Can LLM Agents Solve Challenging Operations Research Tasks End to End?
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents for multi-step tasks in executable environments, yet their ability to perform realistic operations research (OR) work remains unclear. Existing OR evaluations often decouple modeling from solving, rely on pre-formalized or text-only instances, and rarely test the full workflow from operational artifacts to validated decisions. In this work, we introduce ORAgentBench, an execution-grounded benchmark for evaluating autonomous age

summary.core_problem: 现有 OR 评测通常只测建模或求解的局部环节，无法衡量 LLM agent 从业务材料到可验证决策的端到端能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent benchmark。它把运筹优化任务包装成可执行环境，要求 agent 读自然语言 brief、多文件数据和配置，再写代码求解并提交结构化结果，评测更接近真实工作流。
summary.technical_approach: ORAgentBench 包含 107 个经人工审核的任务，每个任务有隔离执行环境、自然语言描述、多文件输入、配置文件和提交 schema。评测使用隐藏 validator 检查 schema 合法性、硬约束可行性和归一化目标质量，避免只用文本答案或预形式化问题。
summary.experiments: 摘要称评测了 14 个 frontier agent，但给出的片段未包含具体模型名单、分数、失败模式和提升幅度。实验重点应是端到端 OR 工作流中建模、编码、执行、约束满足和目标优化质量的综合表现。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing OR evaluations often test only isolated modeling or solving steps, leaving unclear whether LLM agents can perform the full workflow from operational artifacts to validated decisions.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent benchmark contribution. It turns operations-research tasks into executable environments where agents must read natural-language briefs, multi-file data, and configs, then write code and submit structured solutions.
summary_en.technical_approach: ORAgentBench contains 107 human-reviewed tasks, each packaged with an isolated environment, natural-language brief, multi-file inputs, configuration artifacts, and a required submission schema. Hidden validators check schema validity, hard-constraint feasibility, and normalized objective quality.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that fourteen frontier agents are evaluated, but the provided excerpt does not include model names, scores, failure modes, or quantitative gaps. The evaluation targets end-to-end modeling, coding, execution, constraint satisfaction, and objective optimization.

recommendation.zh: 作为 agent eval 资产知道即可；预训练侧只需看 validator 设计，OR 任务分布本身不太会改变模型训练判断。
recommendation.en: Useful as an agent-eval asset; for pretraining, only the validator design matters, while the OR task mix is unlikely to change training priors.

paper.title: Beyond Static Endpoints: Tool Programs as an Interface for Flexible Agentic Web Services
paper.abstract: In the agentic web era, LLM-based agents increasingly invoke web services as tools, yet most interfaces remain \emph{static endpoints} that poorly express long-horizon workflows with loops, conditionals, joins, and retries. We present ToolPro, which represents an agent's tool intent as an \emph{executable tool program} that compactly encodes multi-step service interactions with explicit effect types. ToolPro combines constraint-guided program construction, effect-aware replay for exactly-once st

summary.core_problem: 当前LLM Agent调用Web服务的静态端点接口无法表达含循环、条件、合并、重试的长时序工作流，存在端到端延迟高、客户端流量大的问题。
summary.importance: Agent工具调用的方法与系统创新，提出将工具意图表示为可执行工具程序的新接口范式，显著提升复杂Web服务调用效率。
summary.technical_approach: 设计ToolPro框架，包含约束引导的工具程序构造、效果感知的状态修改调用重放（保证exactly-once语义）、配置驱动的策略决策（选择程序调用或逐步调用），基于MCP风格服务通过WebAssembly沙箱隔离执行。
summary.experiments: 在真实应用的多种复杂工作流上评测，相比传统逐步调用静态端点的方式，端到端延迟最高降低53.4%，客户端流量最高降低96.1%，网络延迟与流程复杂度越高增益越明显。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing static endpoint interfaces for LLM agent web service invocation cannot express long-horizon workflows with loops, conditionals, joins and retries, leading to high end-to-end latency and excessive client traffic.
summary_en.importance: Method and system innovation for agent tool calling, proposing a new interface paradigm that represents agent tool intent as executable tool programs to drastically improve complex web service invocation efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: Build the ToolPro framework with three core components: constraint-guided tool program construction, effect-aware replay for exactly-once semantics of state-modifying calls, and profile-driven policy to switch between program execution and stepwise calling; deployed over MCP-style services with WebAssembly sandboxing.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on diverse real-world complex workflows: reduces end-to-end latency by up to 53.4% and client-side traffic by up to 96.1% compared to traditional stepwise static endpoint calling, with larger gains under higher network latency and workflow complexity.

recommendation.zh: Agent工具调用的系统级优化，仅对做Agent基建的研究员有参考，预训练研究员仅需知道该范式即可，无需深读正文。
recommendation.en: System-level optimization for agent tool calling, only relevant for agent infrastructure researchers; pretraining researchers only need to know the paradigm, no need to read the full paper.

paper.title: TRAP: Benchmark for Task-completion and Resistance to Active Privacy-extraction
paper.abstract: Agents are increasingly deployed in document-intensive workflows where sensitive private information is not an edge case but a routine input, e.g., an agent booking a flight needs passport numbers. In such settings, the agent must use private information to complete tasks accurately while never exposing it in its responses, because it cannot verify who is actually at the keyboard. These two obligations are in fundamental tension. A model capable enough to use private information for task complet

summary.core_problem: 评测 Agent 在必须使用隐私信息完成任务时，能否同时抵抗用户主动诱导泄露同一隐私信息。
summary.importance: 贡献是 Agent 安全与隐私方向的 benchmark。它把任务完成率和隐私泄露率放在同一场景中测量，适合观察工具调用能力与隐私约束之间的张力。
summary.technical_approach: TRAP 的每个场景包含一份带隐私字段的文档、一个需要用隐私字段调用正确工具的任务查询，以及一个试图用自然语言诱导模型泄露同一信息的攻击查询；评测目标不是单独测拒答，而是同时测 task completion 和 active privacy-extraction resistance。
summary.experiments: 作者评测了 22 个模型，覆盖前沿闭源模型和开源模型；摘要未给出完整排行榜和具体数值，但设计上能比较不同模型在任务成功率与隐私泄露率之间的取舍。

summary_en.core_problem: The benchmark evaluates whether agents can use private information to complete tool-mediated tasks while resisting active attempts to extract the same private information.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent safety and privacy benchmark. It measures task completion and privacy leakage in the same scenario, making the capability-safety trade-off explicit rather than testing refusal behavior in isolation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Each TRAP scenario contains a document with private fields, a task query that requires invoking the right tool using those fields, and an attack query that tries to elicit the same private information in natural language. The benchmark jointly measures task accuracy and resistance to active privacy extraction.
summary_en.experiments: The authors evaluate 22 models spanning frontier proprietary and open models. The abstract does not include the full leaderboard or numerical breakdown, but the setup is designed to expose the trade-off between task success and privacy leakage.

recommendation.zh: 读任务构造和泄露定义即可；它把“会用隐私”和“不泄露隐私”的冲突测得比较干净。
recommendation.en: Read the task construction and leakage definition; the clean part is the joint measurement of using private data without revealing it.

paper.title: VISUALSKILL: Multimodal Skills for Computer-Use Agents
paper.abstract: Computer-use agents (CUAs) approach human-level performance on standardised benchmarks but still struggle on long-horizon tasks and unseen software. Existing skill libraries address this with reusable skills, but represent the skill artifact as text only, despite the visual nature of GUI interaction. We propose VISUALSKILL: a hierarchical multimodal skill, tailored to each target application and organised as a central index over per-topic files, which the agent consumes through a load_topic MCP

summary.core_problem: 解决 computer-use agent 在长程任务和未见软件上泛化差的问题，尤其是技能库只用文本表示而忽略 GUI 视觉信息。
summary.importance: 贡献属于通用 agent 方法而非基座模型研究。价值在于说明 GUI agent 的技能表示不应只靠文本，视觉化技能资产能带来明显增益。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 VISUALSKILL，把技能做成分层多模态文档：中心索引加按主题拆分的文件，agent 通过 load_topic MCP 工具按需加载文字和图示。技能构建采用两阶段流程，结合人工文档与真实应用 UI 探索。
summary.experiments: 在 CUA-World 和 OSExpert-Eval 上，用 Claude Code CLI + Claude Opus 4.6，平均分从无技能基线 0.303 提升到 0.456，绝对提升 15.3 点；并优于由同源内容生成的 text-only skill。实验说明多模态技能表示有效，但主要结论停留在 GUI agent 层面。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab，含 Jacob Andreas。团队在语言、推理与 agent 方向有持续积累。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles the poor long-horizon and out-of-distribution generalization of computer-use agents, especially when skill libraries are represented as text only despite the visual nature of GUIs.
summary_en.importance: This is a general agent-method paper rather than a foundation-model study. Its main value is the concrete evidence that GUI-agent skills should be multimodal rather than purely textual.
summary_en.technical_approach: VISUALSKILL represents skills as hierarchical multimodal artifacts: a central index plus topic files that can be fetched on demand through an MCP tool, containing both text and figures. Skills are built with a two-stage pipeline combining authored documentation and live UI exploration.
summary_en.experiments: On CUA-World and OSExpert-Eval, a Claude Code CLI agent backed by Claude Opus 4.6 improves from a no-skill baseline of 0.303 to 0.456 on average, a +15.3 absolute gain, and outperforms a matched text-only skill built from the same source content. The result is meaningful for GUI agents but remains downstream to pretraining.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab, including Jacob Andreas. The team has a strong track record in language, reasoning, and agent research.

recommendation.zh: 这是 GUI agent 的技能表示论文，不是基座研究；只需看结果表确认“图文技能库优于纯文本”这个结论，别过度外推到 pretrain。
recommendation.en: This is a GUI-agent skill-representation paper, not a foundation-model one; just read the result tables for the multimodal-vs-text-only takeaway and do not overgeneralize to pretraining.

paper.title: An Evaluation of Data Leakage Risks in Tool-Using LLM Agents in Realistic Scenarios
paper.abstract: AI agents are increasingly being adopted in enterprise and personal settings with access to emails, databases, documents, and other tools where they can read, update, and disseminate sensitive information. Much of prior research on data leakage risks in agents has focused on adversarial data exfiltration through prompt injections and jailbreaks. However, sensitive information may also be exposed during non-adversarial use, creating leakage risks even when users issue benign requests.   We report

summary.core_problem: 评估 tool-using LLM agents 在非对抗、真实工作流中也会发生哪些数据泄漏，而不仅是 prompt injection 或 jailbreak 下的外泄。
summary.importance: 这是 agent 安全评测工作。对预训练研究员的直接价值有限，但它提醒一个常被忽略的点：很多泄漏来自模型对数据边界、受众和最小披露原则的弱表征，而不是显式攻击。
summary.technical_approach: 新加坡与韩国 AI Safety Institute 联合构建 12 个现实任务场景，覆盖客服、DevOps、网页自动化、企业与个人生产力，并从数据感知、受众感知、策略合规、数据最小化、访问边界感知五类风险评估 agent 行为。两家机构独立测试同一组场景以提高结果稳健性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型名单和量化结果，但强调评测场景是非对抗、贴近部署环境的 realistic scenarios。核心产出是风险 taxonomy 与场景化评测，而不是新的 agent 方法或训练方案。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Singapore AI Safety Institute 与 Korea AI Safety Institute 的联合评测工作，代表性在于跨机构独立复核同一套 agent 风险场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates what kinds of data leakage occur in tool-using LLM agents during realistic, non-adversarial workflows, rather than only under prompt injection or jailbreak attacks.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-safety evaluation paper. Its direct value to pretraining researchers is limited, but it highlights an often-missed point: many leaks come from weak representations of data boundaries, audience awareness, and minimization principles rather than explicit attacks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Singapore AI Safety Institute and the Korea AI Safety Institute jointly build 12 realistic tasks spanning customer support, DevOps, web automation, and enterprise/personal productivity, and evaluate agents along five risk types: data awareness, audience awareness, policy compliance, data minimization, and access-boundary awareness. The same scenarios are tested independently by both institutes for robustness.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not list specific models or quantitative scores, but emphasizes realistic non-adversarial deployment-like scenarios. The main output is a risk taxonomy and scenario-based evaluation setup rather than a new agent method or training recipe.
summary_en.authors_note: This is a joint evaluation by the Singapore AI Safety Institute and the Korea AI Safety Institute, notable for independent cross-institution testing on the same set of agent-risk scenarios.

recommendation.zh: 安全评测而非基座方法；如果你做 tool-use agent 或训练数据治理，可借它的风险 taxonomy，其他人看结论页即可。
recommendation.en: This is safety evaluation, not foundation-model method work; borrow the risk taxonomy if you build tool-using agents, otherwise the conclusion page is enough.

paper.title: MuseVLA: An Adaptive Multimodal Sensing Vision-Language-Action Model for Robotic Manipulation
paper.abstract: Humans naturally leverage diverse sensing modalities to interact with the physical world, while most Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for robotics rely solely on RGB observations. This limits their ability to perceive physical properties that are difficult or impossible to infer from RGB cameras, such as temperature, sound, or radar response. We present MuseVLA, an adaptive multimodal sensing VLA model that integrates novel sensors as on-demand tools for robotic manipulation. Given a task ins

summary.core_problem: 现有机器人Vision-Language-Action (VLA) 模型仅依赖RGB视觉，无法感知温度、声音、雷达等物理属性。
summary.importance: 首次将传感器作为可调用工具集成到VLA模型中，在多模态机器人感知层面有一定方法创新。
summary.technical_approach: MuseVLA首先生成传感器token和目标描述来选择感知模态（类似工具调用），然后将传感器测量值转换为统一的'传感器图像'中间表示，实现异质传感器数据与VLA骨干网络的解耦融合。
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中提供具体实验参数和量化结果。
summary.authors_note: Xingyuming Liu等，含Jiaolong Yang、Baining Guo（微软亚洲研究院资深研究者）。

summary_en.core_problem: Current robotic Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models rely solely on RGB vision, unable to perceive physical properties like temperature, sound, or radar signals.
summary_en.importance: First integration of sensors as callable tools in a VLA model, with some methodological novelty in multimodal robotic perception.
summary_en.technical_approach: MuseVLA first generates a sensor token and target description to select a sensing modality (analogous to tool calling), then converts the sensor measurement into a unified 'sensor image' intermediate representation for decoupled fusion with the VLA backbone.
summary_en.experiments: Specific experimental parameters and quantitative results not provided in abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Xingyuming Liu et al., including Jiaolong Yang and Baining Guo (senior researchers at Microsoft Research Asia).

recommendation.zh: 将传感器视为可调用工具的思想对多模态LLM的工具扩展有微弱启发，但核心是机器人应用，可略读摘要了解思路。
recommendation.en: The sensor-as-callable-tool idea provides minor inspiration for multimodal LLM tool extension, but the core is robotics application — skim the abstract only.

paper.title: Can LLM Agents Infer World Models? Evidence from Agentic Automata Learning
paper.abstract: We propose agentic automata learning to evaluate the extent to which tool-calling LLM agents can uncover hidden environments through interaction. In our setup, an agent should uncover a hidden deterministic finite automaton (DFA) by interacting with an oracle through (1) membership queries ("Does this string belong to the target language?") and (2) equivalence queries ("Is this the target DFA?"). This yields a scalable testbed with controlled task complexity, measurable interaction efficiency, a

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的问题很具体：工具调用型 LLM agent 在与环境交互时，能否真正学出一个可验证的世界模型，而不是只靠局部模式和短视试探。作者把问题落到 active automata learning 上，让模型通过 membership query 和 equivalence query 去识别一个隐藏 DFA。这样做的好处是，环境结构已知、复杂度可控、最优或强基线算法现成，因而可以把“会不会建模环境”拆成可测的几个维度：成功率、查询效率、随状态数增长的退化曲线，以及交互轨迹中的规划失误类型。
summary.importance: 对基座研究本身，它不是预训练方法论文，但对“agent 能力到底来自哪里”给了一个很干净的诊断框架。价值主要有三层。第一，它把 world-model inference 从开放任务里抽离出来，避免 benchmark 污染和任务提示技巧，把能力测成一个受控变量。第二，它说明当前强推理模型即便在小规模离散环境里也远未接近经典算法，问题不只是知识不足，而是主动查询规划、证据整合、假设修正这几步都不稳。第三，这类结果对预训练和后训练都有启发：如果模型在这种最小化环境建模任务上都明显掉队，那么仅靠更长 CoT 或更大模型未必能补齐，可能需要更明确的交互式训练信号、外部记忆、程序化状态表示，或把“查询策略学习”直接纳入训练目标。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，作者把经典 automata learning 重新包装成 agentic setting。每个任务实例先采样一个目标 DFA，agent 只能通过两类工具与 oracle 交互：MQ 询问某个字符串是否被目标语言接受，EQ 提交一个候选 DFA，若错误则得到反例。评测时既看最终是否恢复正确 DFA，也看用了多少查询。复杂度主要由最小 DFA 的状态数控制。基线选了经典的 L* 和 TTT，这一点很关键，因为它让结果不只是“模型彼此比较”，而是“模型与已知高效学习程序比较”。从全文描述看，作者还做了轨迹级分析，把失败分成几类：查询不够信息化、对已有观测推理不一致、构造假设时没有正确利用历史证据、收到 counterexample 后修正方向不对。这个分析框架比单纯报成功率更有信息量，因为它把 agent 失败定位到 planning 和 state tracking，而不是笼统归因于 reasoning 不足。
summary.experiments: 最关键的结果有三点。第一，随着 DFA 状态数增加，成功率快速下滑；对 9-state automata，没有任何模型超过 25% 成功率，而经典算法在同类任务上是 100%。第二，即便只看成功样本，最强模型 Gemini 3.1 Pro 的查询数仍比 TTT 多约 45.8%，说明问题不只是偶尔失败，而是整体发现过程低效。第三，reasoning model 与非 reasoning model 差距很大：在 4–5 状态任务上，Gemini 3.1 Pro 可达 85% 成功，而 GPT-5.4 非 reasoning、Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite、Llama-3.3-70B 为 0%。这些数字说明，显式推理能力确实有帮助，但帮助主要体现在把模型从“几乎不会做”拉到“能做一部分”，离稳定、系统化的环境归纳还很远。轨迹分析部分的价值也不小：模型常提出冗余或低区分度查询，不能围绕当前 hypothesis 的不确定边界去设计 probe；拿到反例后，也常不能把反例转成结构性修正，而只是局部打补丁。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和任务定义，理解为什么 DFA learning 是一个比一般 agent benchmark 更干净的世界模型测试。然后重点看实验主表和按状态数分层的结果图，抓住两个事实：性能随复杂度的退化斜率，以及与 L*/TTT 的效率差。接着看 trajectory analysis，尤其是作者如何把失败拆成 query planning、evidence integration、hypothesis construction 三类。若只花 20–30 分钟，建议读任务设定、主结果、失败案例三部分即可。若要深挖，可以思考两件事：一是当前 agent 框架里，模型到底缺的是搜索策略、外部记忆，还是离散结构归纳偏置；二是如果把这类任务做成 post-training 或 RL 环境，奖励该如何设计，才能学到接近经典 learner 的查询策略。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrow but important question: can tool-using LLM agents actually infer a latent world model through interaction, rather than relying on shallow local heuristics? It instantiates this as active automata learning: the agent must recover a hidden DFA using membership queries and equivalence queries. This setup gives controlled environment complexity, exact ground truth, strong algorithmic baselines, and trajectory-level observability, so “world-model inference” becomes measurable instead of anecdotal.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is useful for foundation-model researchers because it isolates one capability that many agent benchmarks blur together. The contribution is mainly diagnostic. First, it turns latent-structure inference into a clean controlled testbed. Second, it shows that current reasoning-capable LLM agents remain far from classical learners even in small deterministic environments, so the gap is not just missing knowledge but weak query planning, weak evidence aggregation, and unstable hypothesis revision. Third, it suggests that scaling CoT alone is unlikely to close this gap; more explicit interactive training signals, external state tracking, or policy learning over information-gathering actions may be needed.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method recasts classical active automata learning as an agentic evaluation environment. For each instance, an oracle is initialized with a target DFA. The LLM agent can call two tools: MQ asks whether a string is accepted by the target language, and EQ submits a hypothesized DFA, which is either accepted or rejected with a counterexample. Task difficulty is controlled by the number of states in the minimal DFA. Evaluation measures both final identification success and interaction efficiency in number of queries. A strong design choice is the inclusion of classical learners such as L* and TTT as baselines, which anchors the results against known efficient procedures rather than only against other LLMs. The paper also goes beyond aggregate scores and analyzes trajectories, attributing failures to poor query informativeness, inconsistent reasoning over accumulated evidence, weak use of prior observations when constructing hypotheses, and ineffective use of counterexamples for refinement.
summary_en.experiments: Three results matter most. First, performance drops sharply as DFA size grows: for 9-state automata, no tested model exceeds 25% success, while classical algorithms solve all instances. Second, even on successful runs, Gemini 3.1 Pro, the best model in the study, uses about 45.8% more queries than TTT, indicating a substantial efficiency gap. Third, reasoning models are much stronger than non-reasoning ones: on 4–5 state automata, Gemini 3.1 Pro reaches 85% success, whereas GPT-5.4 without reasoning, Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite, and Llama-3.3-70B score 0%. The trajectory analysis is equally informative: models often ask redundant or weakly discriminative queries, fail to maintain a coherent global hypothesis, and treat counterexamples as local patches rather than structural evidence for DFA refinement.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the task formulation and motivation sections to see why DFA learning is a cleaner probe of world-model inference than open-ended agent benchmarks. Then read the main results tables and the plots stratified by DFA size; the key signal is the degradation slope with complexity and the efficiency gap to L*/TTT. After that, focus on the trajectory analysis and failure cases, especially how the paper separates planning failures from evidence-integration failures. For a quick read, 20–30 minutes on setup, main results, and representative trajectories is enough. For deeper reading, the useful question is not whether LLMs fail, but what kind of inductive bias is missing: search policy, external memory, symbolic state abstraction, or training on information-gathering behavior itself.

recommendation.zh: 只看任务形式和错误轨迹分析即可；它把“agent 会不会学世界模型”拆成了干净可控的反例生成器。
recommendation.en: Read the task setup and failure-trajectory analysis; it gives a clean counterexample generator for claims about agents learning world models.

paper.title: ToolMenuBench: Benchmarking Tool-Menu Filtering Strategies for Reliable and Efficient LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Tool-augmented large language model agents increasingly operate over large tool libraries, but existing evaluations often focus on whether a model can call a tool correctly rather than how the visible tool menu shapes reliability, efficiency, and safety-relevant risk exposure. We introduce ToolMenuBench, a benchmark for evaluating tool-menu construction in multi-step LLM agents. ToolMenuBench varies tool-menu size, distractor type, state-dependent task structure, and risk exposure, and reports b

summary.core_problem: 评测 LLM Agent 在大工具库下如何构造可见工具菜单，以及菜单大小、干扰工具和风险暴露如何影响可靠性、效率与安全。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 工具使用评测基准。它把评测重点从“能否正确调用工具”推进到“给模型看哪些工具会改变行为”，这对 tool-use agent 的可靠性分析更贴近实际部署。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ToolMenuBench，通过控制工具菜单大小、干扰工具类型、状态依赖任务结构和风险暴露来测试多步 Agent；指标同时覆盖过滤器本身和下游 Agent 表现，包括可见工具数、风险工具暴露、任务成功率、错误工具调用、过早行动和 token 使用量。
summary.experiments: 在 7 个模型后端、3 种工具菜单大小、6 种过滤方法和 7 种评测设置上实验。摘要报告 CMTF 将任务成功率从 all-tools exposure 下的 32.1% 提升到 85.7%，同时平均 token 使用量减少约 98%；因果最小工具过滤在成功率、成本和风险之间取得较好折中。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates how tool-menu construction affects the reliability, efficiency, and risk exposure of LLM agents operating over large tool libraries.
summary_en.importance: It contributes an agent benchmark that shifts evaluation from whether a model can call tools to which tools should be made visible. This is closer to practical deployment, where the exposed action space strongly shapes model behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: ToolMenuBench varies tool-menu size, distractor type, state-dependent task structure, and risk exposure in multi-step agent tasks. It reports both filter-level and downstream metrics, including visible tool count, risky-tool exposure, task success, wrong-tool calls, premature actions, and token usage.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates seven model backends, three menu sizes, six filtering methods, and seven evaluation settings. The abstract reports that CMTF raises task success from 32.1% under all-tools exposure to 85.7%, while reducing average token usage by about 98%. Causal minimal tool filtering gives the strongest overall tradeoff.

recommendation.zh: 工具菜单是被低估的 Agent 控制面；读指标和 CMTF 对照，别把数字外推到通用规划能力。
recommendation.en: Tool menus are an underrated agent control surface; read the metrics and CMTF ablation, but do not extrapolate the numbers to general planning.

paper.title: PACT: Privileged Trace Co-Training for Multi-Turn Tool-Use Agents
paper.abstract: Multi-turn tool-use agents must reason, call tools, and adapt to observations across several interaction turns. Post-training such agents is challenging, as reinforcement learning often suffers from sparse rewards and weak credit assignment despite matching the prompt-only inference setting, while supervised fine-tuning on expert traces provides dense process supervision but can over-constrain the model to fixed trajectories. To tackle this, we propose PACT, a Privileged trAce Co-Training framew

summary.core_problem: PACT 处理的是多轮工具调用 agent 的训练矛盾：RL 的 rollout 条件和推理一致，但奖励稀疏、信用分配弱；专家轨迹能提供过程信号，但直接 SFT 容易把模型压到单一路径上，且训练条件和推理条件可能不一致。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的启发点在于把专家轨迹从“推理时提示”改成“训练时特权信号”。对预训练研究本身不是核心贡献，但对 pretrain 到 posttrain 的接口有参考价值：它讨论了如何把高质量过程数据用于优化，而不改变模型实际部署时的条件分布。这个思想也适用于更一般的推理训练、工具使用训练和合成过程数据利用。
summary.technical_approach: PACT 保持 rollout 从原始 prompt 出发，不把专家轨迹放进生成上下文，因此采样分布和推理时一致。优化阶段再引入专家轨迹，形成两类信号。第一类是 trace-conditioned RL surrogate：用专家轨迹作为训练时的 privileged context 来评估或塑造 rollout 的更新方向，但不让模型在 rollout 时看到它。第二类是 component-aware SFT：不模仿完整专家轨迹，而是只监督选定的 reasoning prefix 和完整 tool-call，避免把所有中间文本都当成唯一正确答案。方法还给不同轨迹组件设置独立退火，使早期有较强过程约束，后期逐步降低模仿强度。prompt-only anchoring 则把一部分样本路由到标准 RL，不使用 trace loss，用来减轻模型对特权轨迹上下文的依赖。相比 hint-based 方法，PACT 不改变 rollout 条件；相比简单 SFT+RL，它更细地处理多轮工具调用中的 reasoning、tool-call、observation 和 final answer 结构。
summary.experiments: 提供内容中没有给出具体 benchmark 名称、模型规模、训练步数或提升数字。文中声称在多轮工具调用 benchmark 上，PACT 相比 SFT 基线和 RL 基线有稳定提升。更有价值的实验应当是三类消融：去掉 trace-conditioned RL 后是否退化为弱信用分配的 RL；去掉 component-aware SFT 后是否失去早期过程引导；去掉 prompt-only anchoring 后是否出现对特权轨迹条件的依赖。还需要关注专家轨迹是否去除了 final answer，以避免答案泄漏，这一点在方法设定中被明确提到。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看方法部分中 trace-conditioned RL surrogate 的目标函数、component-aware SFT 的 token/组件选择规则、退火 schedule 和 prompt-only anchoring。实验部分重点看与纯 RL、纯 SFT、hint-conditioned rollout、joint SFT-RL 的对比，以及 ablation 表。若时间有限，抓住一个问题：专家轨迹到底进入了哪个概率条件、哪个 loss、哪个训练阶段；没有进入 rollout 这一点是方法成立的关键。

summary_en.core_problem: PACT addresses a training mismatch in multi-turn tool-use agents: RL matches prompt-only inference but suffers from sparse rewards and weak credit assignment, while expert-trace SFT gives dense process supervision but can over-constrain the model to one fixed trajectory.
summary_en.importance: The main value is in the pretrain–posttrain interface rather than base pretraining itself. It shows a clean way to use high-quality process traces as optimization-only privileged signals, without changing the rollout distribution seen at inference. The same design pattern is relevant to reasoning training, tool-use training, and the use of synthetic process data.
summary_en.technical_approach: PACT separates rollout generation from trace-based optimization. Rollouts are sampled from the original prompt only, so the generation condition matches deployment. Expert traces are used only during optimization through two signals. The first is a trace-conditioned RL surrogate, where the expert trace acts as privileged context for shaping policy updates but is not exposed during rollout. The second is component-aware SFT, which supervises selected reasoning prefixes and complete tool calls rather than the entire trace. Separate annealing schedules reduce imitation pressure over training, giving early process guidance while avoiding long-term over-imitation. Prompt-only anchoring routes a subset of prompts to standard RL without trace losses, reducing dependence on privileged context. Compared with hint-based methods, PACT does not alter rollout conditions. Compared with naive SFT+RL, it uses the structure of multi-turn tool interaction more explicitly.
summary_en.experiments: The provided content does not include concrete benchmark names, model sizes, training budgets, or numeric gains. The paper reports consistent improvements over strong SFT and RL baselines on multi-turn tool-use benchmarks. The most informative results to inspect are the ablations: removing trace-conditioned RL, removing component-aware SFT, changing the annealing schedules, and removing prompt-only anchoring. The trace construction detail also matters, especially the exclusion of final answers to avoid answer leakage.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the objective for trace-conditioned RL, the component selection rule in component-aware SFT, the annealing schedules, and prompt-only anchoring. In the experiments, look for comparisons against pure RL, pure SFT, hint-conditioned rollout, and joint SFT-RL. The key question is where the expert trace enters the computation graph: it should affect optimization, not rollout generation.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和 ablation 即可；把专家轨迹只放进优化器而不放进 rollout，是干净的后训练接口设计。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; using expert traces only in optimization, not rollout, is a clean post-training interface choice.

paper.title: Looking Is Not Picking: An Attention-Segment Account of Tool-Selection Failures in LLM Agents
paper.abstract: LLM agents mis-call tools, and the natural guess is that the model failed to see the right tool in a crowded harness. We show the opposite through a lens concurrent work sets aside -- the model's attention to labeled tool-definition segments. On real BFCL failures, by per-candidate attention argmax the model attends most to the correct tool 80% of the time (vs. 21% chance), and the gold is the under-attended segment on only 10%: it looks at the right tool and still picks wrong. This directly ref

summary.core_problem: 解释 LLM agent 的工具选择失败究竟来自“没看到正确工具”，还是来自看到之后的决策读出错误。
summary.importance: 这是一篇机制分析工作。它不直接改进预训练，但对 tool-use agent 的错误归因很干净：把问题从 prompt/harness 拥挤，转向 readout/decision layer。对做 agentic pretrain、tool token 建模、后训练诊断的人有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者用 attention-segment 视角分析真实 BFCL 失败样本，统计模型对带标签工具定义片段的注意力 argmax 是否落在正确工具上。随后比较两类干预：输入侧修补（重排、复制 gold tool）与读出侧干预（attention-logit bias、residual-stream steering）。如果输入侧收益有限而读出侧显著恢复，就说明失败主要发生在决策读出而非检索可见性。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出几个关键数字：在真实 BFCL 失败中，模型有 80% 的情况最关注正确工具片段，远高于 21% 的随机机会；只有 10% 的失败是 gold tool 明显欠关注。输入侧 prompt 修补最多恢复不超过 23% 的失败，而读出侧干预可恢复 59%-91%。这不是 benchmark 扩展，而是对失败机制的定量拆解。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether tool-selection failures in LLM agents come from not attending to the correct tool or from making the wrong decision after seeing it.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis rather than a new training method. Its value is in clean error attribution: it shifts the diagnosis from crowded prompts and harness layout toward the readout/decision stage. That matters for agentic pretraining, tool-token modeling, and post-training diagnostics.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author analyzes real BFCL failures through an attention-segment lens, checking whether per-candidate attention argmax lands on the correct labeled tool-definition segment. It then contrasts input-side fixes—reordering or duplicating the gold tool—with readout-side interventions such as additive attention-logit bias and residual-stream steering. If prompt repairs help little but readout interventions recover many failures, the bottleneck is the decision readout rather than visibility.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports several useful numbers: on real BFCL failures, the model attends most to the correct tool 80% of the time versus a 21% chance baseline, and the gold tool is under-attended in only 10% of cases. Prompt-side repairs recover at most 23% of failures, while readout-side interventions recover 59% to 91%. The contribution is a quantitative decomposition of failure modes, not a new benchmark.

recommendation.zh: 这篇最有用的是把 tool failure 从“检索不到”改判成“读出错了”；只看摘要里的数字和读出干预结果，就足够改你的诊断 prior。
recommendation.en: Useful because it flips the diagnosis of tool failures from retrieval/visibility to readout error; the abstract numbers plus the readout interventions are enough to update your prior.

paper.title: Is Code Better Than Language for Algorithmic Reasoning
paper.abstract: For tool-augmented language models, comparing natural-language reasoning with code-execution pipelines is difficult because the comparison changes both the intermediate representation and the execution mechanism. We separate these factors with an intermediate intervention: the model expresses its reasoning as executable code, and the language model simulates that code in context to produce an answer. On a 40-task verifiable algorithmic benchmark, deterministic code execution outperforms natural-

summary.core_problem: 区分代码工具带来的算法推理收益究竟来自“代码作为中间表示”，还是来自可靠的外部执行机制。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理机制分析。它把 tool use 中常被混在一起的两个因素拆开：表达形式和执行器。结论会影响对代码数据、程序化 CoT、工具增强推理训练的判断。
summary.technical_approach: 论文设计中间干预：让模型先用可执行代码表达推理，但不调用真实解释器，而是让语言模型在上下文中模拟这段代码并给出答案。这样可以保持 intermediate representation 为 code，同时去掉外部 deterministic execution。还给出一个简单的统计决策理论模型，刻画何时执行器优于语言模型内部推理。
summary.experiments: 在 40 个可验证算法任务上，确定性代码执行比自然语言推理高 31.6 个百分点；但代码中间表示加 LM 自行模拟执行只比自然语言推理高 0.15 个百分点，几乎没有差异。结果表明在该设置下，工具收益主要来自可靠执行，而不是代码形式本身。
summary.authors_note: Dan Roth 是知名 NLP 研究者；给定元数据未提供论文机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper separates whether the algorithmic-reasoning gains from code tools come from code as an intermediate representation or from reliable external execution.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism analysis contribution. It disentangles two factors often conflated in tool use: representation format and executor reliability. The result matters for how one interprets code data, programmatic chain-of-thought, and tool-augmented reasoning training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce an intermediate intervention: the model expresses reasoning as executable code, but instead of using a real interpreter, the language model simulates the code in context to produce the answer. This keeps the intermediate representation as code while removing deterministic external execution. They also propose a simple statistical decision-theoretic model for when execution dominates internal reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: On a 40-task verifiable algorithmic benchmark, deterministic code execution outperforms natural-language reasoning by 31.6 percentage points. The code-intermediate intervention with LM-simulated execution differs from natural-language reasoning by only 0.15 percentage points. This suggests the gains in this setting mainly require reliable external execution rather than code format alone.
summary_en.authors_note: Dan Roth is a well-known NLP researcher; institutional affiliations are not available in the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 读实验设计和 40-task 结果即可；它削弱了“代码天然更会推理”的说法，强调 executor 是关键变量。
recommendation.en: Read the intervention design and 40-task result; it weakens the claim that code itself reasons better and points to the executor as the key variable.

paper.title: Can LLM Coding Agents Reason About Time Series?
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being used for automated decision-making systems in finance, healthcare, or environmental monitoring. Time series data are ubiquitous in these fields, yet hard to process automatically. Can time series be analyzed by LLM agents? We examine three approaches: providing the agent with raw numerical data, using the LLM as a coding agent, or a combination of both. In the coding agent setup, the model iteratively queries the data using Python code. Using t

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM coding agents 是否能通过原始数值输入、Python 工具调用或二者结合来理解和分析时间序列。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent 能力分析。主题偏领域评测，不是通用预训练研究；但它暴露了工具型 agent 在数值统计任务中的边界，对训练数据中代码执行、统计推理和工具监督信号的设计有间接参考。
summary.technical_approach: 比较三种设置：直接把原始时间序列数值提供给模型；让模型作为 coding agent 迭代编写 Python 查询数据；以及同时提供原始数据和代码访问。作者还用强 LLM judge 分析输出，定位模型策略和推理缺口。
summary.experiments: 在两个时间序列理解 benchmark 上评测。coding-agent 设置相比只处理原始数据的模型最高提升约 10%，但最强 agent 仍有约 22-34% 问题答错。分析显示模型能选择合适统计检验，但常漏掉关键细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Charles University 的 Institute of Formal and Applied Linguistics。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLM coding agents can reason over time series using raw numerical input, Python-based data querying, or a combination of both.
summary_en.importance: This is an empirical coding-agent capability study. It is domain-leaning rather than a general pretraining paper, but it gives a useful failure profile for tool-using agents on numerical and statistical reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors compare three setups: feeding raw numerical data to the model, using the model as a coding agent that iteratively queries data with Python, and combining raw data access with code access. A strong LLM judge is used to analyze model strategies and reasoning gaps.
summary_en.experiments: On two time-series understanding benchmarks, code-access agents outperform raw-data-only models by up to 10%. Even the best agent still answers roughly 22-34% of questions incorrectly; the analysis suggests agents can choose statistical tests but often miss important nuances.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the Institute of Formal and Applied Linguistics at Charles University.

recommendation.zh: 看实验结论即可；它提醒代码执行不是数值推理的充分条件，22-34% 错误率比提升幅度更有用。
recommendation.en: Read the empirical result only; it shows code execution is not enough for numerical reasoning, and the 22-34% error rate matters more than the gain.

institutions: Institute of Formal and Applied Linguistics, Charles University
Institute of Formal and Applied Linguistics

paper.title: ACCORD: Action-Conditioned Contextual Grounding for Language Agents
paper.abstract: User instructions are often underspecified because humans rely on implicit assumptions about the surrounding environment. For large language model (LLM) agents operating in information-rich digital and physical environments, these assumptions cannot be inferred from the instruction alone; they must be recovered from the current state of tools, data, interfaces, and observations. Effective execution therefore requires agents to identify missing context, ground it in observed evidence, and carry i

summary.core_problem: ACCORD 处理的是 LLM agent 在执行欠指定用户指令时的环境 grounding 问题。用户常省略具体实体、约束和当前状态，agent 如果只依赖指令和自身先验，就会在写操作前缺少必要证据，或忽略工具返回中已经存在的关键信息。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但对 agent 训练数据和工具使用 post-training 有直接启发。它把 agent 失败归因到两类可操作的信号缺口：一类是没有主动查询环境导致轨迹不完整，另一类是观察已经返回但没有在决策点被用上。对构造 tool-use SFT/RL 数据来说，关键不只是最终动作正确，还要让读操作、环境证据和写操作之间形成可审计的因果链。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是两层框架。第一层在 inference-time 介入，在每个会改变环境状态的 write action 执行前暂停 agent，检查该动作需要哪些上下文事实，然后从已有轨迹、工具返回、schema 和实时环境观察中重新整理证据，形成 action-ready grounded state。第二层是 policy-level prompting，鼓励主 agent 在轨迹早期主动探查环境，而不是等到写操作前才发现信息不足。与 reflection 或 self-refine 类方法不同，ACCORD 不主要让模型反思自己的内部信念，而是要求写操作绑定到外部环境的客观信号。
summary.experiments: 提供的正文片段主要覆盖问题定义和方法动机，没有给出完整实验表和具体数值。可确认的实验设计方向是：作者先分析当前 agent 的两类 grounding failure，即 incomplete grounding 和 overlooked grounding；随后用 ACCORD 的 inference-time grounding 与 policy prompting 分别处理这两个失败源。需要在完整论文中检查不同 agent、不同环境和不同写操作类型上的成功率、额外工具调用成本，以及仅使用 inference-time 层、仅使用 policy 层、两者合用的消融结果。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 20 到 30 分钟。先看 §2.2–§2.3，确认作者如何定义 incomplete grounding 和 overlooked grounding；再看 §3.1，重点看写操作前如何构造 grounded state；最后看 §3.2 和实验消融，判断 policy prompt 是否只是增加查询次数，还是确实提升了证据使用质量。若关心 agent 训练数据，重点看失败案例和轨迹格式，它们比总体分数更有参考价值。

summary_en.core_problem: ACCORD addresses contextual grounding failures in LLM agents. User requests are often underspecified, and the missing details are not in the instruction itself but in the current tool state, interface state, observations, or prior trajectory. Agents fail when they commit write actions using assumed details rather than observed evidence.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a pretraining recipe, but it is relevant to tool-use post-training and agent data design. Its useful contribution is the separation of two failure modes: trajectories that never collect the needed environmental facts, and trajectories where the facts are present but not surfaced at the decision point. For SFT or RL data for tool-using models, this suggests that correctness should be tied to an evidence chain from observation to action, not only to the final API call.
summary_en.technical_approach: ACCORD uses a two-layer mechanism. At inference time, it intercepts each write action before execution, identifies the contextual facts needed by that action, and reconstructs an action-ready grounded state from prior observations, live tool responses, returned data, and tool schemas. At the policy layer, it prompts the main agent to gather sufficient environmental information earlier in the trajectory. The key distinction from reflection-style methods is that ACCORD grounds actions in external signals rather than asking the model to refine its own internal beliefs.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full-text excerpt covers the problem setup and method motivation but does not include complete result tables or exact metrics. The experimental claims visible in the excerpt are centered on two recurring failure modes, incomplete grounding and overlooked grounding, and on evaluating whether the two ACCORD layers address them. The full version should be checked for success-rate gains, added tool-call overhead, environment diversity, and ablations comparing inference-time grounding only, policy prompting only, and the combined system.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20 to 30 minutes. Start with §2.2–§2.3 to understand the failure taxonomy. Then read §3.1 for the intervention before write actions, because this is the main mechanism. §3.2 and the ablations are useful for judging whether the policy prompt improves evidence collection or merely increases probing. For agent-training interests, the most useful material is likely the trajectory examples and failure annotations.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 failure taxonomy 和 action 前 probing 设计；方法不深，但会影响你写 agent 数据合成的状态字段。
recommendation.en: Skim the failure taxonomy and pre-action probing design; the method is simple, but it informs how to structure agent data synthesis.

paper.title: CoAgent: Concurrency Control for Multi-Agent Systems
paper.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems -- coding agents, devops agents, document agents -- now routinely run several agents in parallel against the same git tree, Kubernetes cluster, or document. As soon as two of them mutate shared state, they enter the regime classical concurrency control has studied for decades, but classical mechanisms fit LLM agents poorly. A single agent transaction spans minutes of inference, read sets are broad and opaque rather than statically inferable, and the live state agents act

summary.core_problem: 解决多Agent系统并发修改同一共享状态时的冲突控制问题，例如多个coding/devops/document agent同时操作同一git树、集群或文档。
summary.importance: 这是Agent系统基础设施问题，不是单个任务应用；贡献在于把传统并发控制重新适配到LLM Agent的长事务、不可静态推断读集、即时写入状态等约束下。
summary.technical_approach: 提出CoAgent，将冲突控制从强制锁或乐观并发控制的回滚重试，改成advisory protocol：运行时通知Agent发生了冲突写入，由Agent内部LLM判断该写入是否使当前计划失效，并只修复受影响的操作。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体benchmark、Agent数量、任务类型、冲突率或吞吐提升数字；可确认其评估对象应是多Agent并发执行场景，并与锁、OCC等传统机制对比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses concurrency conflicts when multiple LLM agents mutate the same shared state, such as a git tree, Kubernetes cluster, or document.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent infrastructure problem rather than a narrow application. The contribution is to adapt concurrency control to LLM agents, where transactions last minutes, read sets are broad and opaque, and writes take effect immediately.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoAgent replaces blocking locks or abort-and-retry optimistic concurrency control with an advisory protocol: the runtime reports conflicting writes, and the LLM agent judges whether its plan is invalidated and repairs only the dependent operations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete benchmarks, agent counts, conflict rates, or throughput numbers. The intended comparison is against classical locking and OCC-style baselines in parallel agent execution.

recommendation.zh: 只看协议设计和冲突修复案例；它不改预训练，但提醒Agent训练数据应覆盖共享状态失效后的局部重规划。
recommendation.en: Read the protocol and repair examples only; it does not affect pretraining directly, but it flags shared-state invalidation as a useful agent-training regime.

paper.title: HiMPO: Hindsight-Informed Memory Policy Optimization for Less-Entangled Credit in Long-Horizon Agents
paper.abstract: Long-horizon agents rely on memory mechanisms to compress interaction history, but optimizing memory writing faces a distinct credit assignment challenge: a memory update may be rewarded or penalized due to downstream tool failures, noisy observations, or reasoning errors rather than its own contribution. This causally entangled credit can lead agents to discard useful evidence or preserve irrelevant information. We propose HiMPO, a Hindsight-Informed Memory Policy Optimization framework for ass

summary.core_problem: 长程 Agent 的记忆写入动作很难正确归因，因为后续工具失败、噪声观察或推理错误会污染对记忆更新本身的奖励。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 训练中的信用分配方法。它不直接推进基座预训练，但把 reward/advantage 分解到 memory tokens 的思路，对长上下文、外部记忆和 RL 训练接口有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: HiMPO 先在相同 pre-write state 下比较旧记忆和新记忆能恢复的任务相关信息，估计 memory update 的 local utility；再用 hindsight relevance 作为有界回看过滤器，当局部效用得不到目标结果支持时削弱记忆信用；最终只把 memory-specific advantage 应用于 memory tokens。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出任务、模型规模、训练环境、baseline 和定量结果。实验应围绕长程 Agent 的记忆写入质量、任务成功率和信用污染缓解效果展开，但具体证据需要正文确认。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Data Science & Artificial Intelligence Research Institute, China Unicom。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-horizon agents face a memory-specific credit assignment problem: a memory write can be rewarded or penalized because of later tool failures, noisy observations, or reasoning errors rather than its own contribution.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-training method contribution. It is not a foundation pretraining paper, but its decomposition of reward and advantage onto memory tokens is relevant to long-context agents, external memory, and RL training interfaces.
summary_en.technical_approach: HiMPO estimates the local utility of a memory update by comparing task-relevant information recoverable from the previous and updated memories under the same pre-write state. It then applies hindsight relevance as a bounded retrospective filter and assigns a memory-specific advantage only to memory tokens.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide tasks, model sizes, environments, baselines, or quantitative gains. The intended evaluation concerns long-horizon agent memory quality, task success, and reduced credit entanglement.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the Data Science & Artificial Intelligence Research Institute, China Unicom.

recommendation.zh: 看公式定义即可；memory-token advantage 的切分有用，但 Agent setup 若不强，结论只能当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Skim the objective definitions; memory-token advantage is useful, but weak agent setups would make the empirical claim soft.

paper.title: HarnessX: A Composable, Adaptive, and Evolvable Agent Harness Foundry
paper.abstract: AI agent performance depends critically on the runtime harness, comprising the prompts, tools, memory, and control flow that mediate how a model observes, reasons, and acts. Yet today's harnesses remain largely hand-crafted and static: each new model or task still demands bespoke scaffolding, and the rich traces produced during execution are rarely distilled back into systematic improvement. We introduce HarnessX, a foundry for composable, adaptive, and evolvable agent harnesses. HarnessX assemb

summary.core_problem: 现有AI智能体的运行时harness（包括提示词、工具、记忆、控制流等介导模型观察、推理、行动的组件）均为手工定制的静态系统，存在三大核心问题：模型/工具/任务域变化时需重新定制，无经验驱动的改进机制；各组件架构耦合，修改易出错、复用依赖复制；harness工程与模型训练完全割裂，执行轨迹数据被丢弃，无法实现协同优化。
summary.importance: 明确了harness是智能体能力的一等决定因素，而非外围工程补丁，其优化增益常超过模型小版本迭代的收益。提出的harness-模型协同进化框架将harness优化产生的轨迹复用为RL训练信号，同时打破了单独harness优化的性能天花板与单独模型RL的训练信号天花板。对智能体后训练的数据流水线设计、闭环优化机制有明确参考价值，可组合harness的形式化方法也为智能体工程标准化提供了基础。
summary.technical_approach: HarnessX是统一的harness铸造框架，包含三大核心模块：1）可组合harness：将harness形式化为一等类型化对象，由覆盖上下文、工具、技能、控制、记忆的类型化原语（processor）通过替换代数在生命周期钩子点插入组合，九维分类法覆盖完整行为空间，实现类型安全的组件增删改与完全解耦。2）AEGIS自适应进化引擎：将harness适配建模为符号工件（提示词、工具、记忆、控制策略）上的学习问题，通过四阶段流水线（Digester压缩轨迹、Planner规划适配方案、Evolver生成候选、Critic评估）结合全轨迹可观测性，解决对应RL的奖励黑客、灾难性遗忘、探索不足等风险；可选变体隔离策略避免异构任务集上的跨任务干扰。3）harness-模型协同进化：通过共享回放缓冲区，交替进行harness进化与模型GRPO训练，让模型内化不同版本harness的策略，形成闭环优化。
summary.experiments: 在5个基准（GAIA、ALFWorld、WebShop、τ³-Bench、SWE-bench Verified）、3类任务智能体（Claude Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5.4、Qwen3.5-9B）上开展最多15轮进化实验。15组模型-基准配置中14组获得提升，平均绝对增益为+14.5%，最高增益达+44.0%（ALFWorld上的Qwen3.5-9B）。增益呈逆缩放规律：基线性能越弱的模型从harness进化中获益越大。在异构任务集GAIA上，单harness进化会出现停滞，变体隔离策略可恢复稳定提升（+13.6%，15轮无退化）。协同进化相比单独harness优化额外带来+4.7%的增益。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先关注第1节中现有harness的三大核心问题定义、第3节的可组合harness核心设计、第4节的AEGIS四阶段进化流水线、第6节的主要实验结果（尤其是逆缩放规律与协同进化增益），预计阅读时间20-25分钟。若关注工程实现可查看第3节的类型化原语与替换代数细节，若关注训练闭环设计可重点阅读第5节的协同进化机制。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing AI agent runtime harnesses (including prompts, tools, memory, and control flow that mediate model observation, reasoning, and action) are hand-crafted, static systems with three core flaws: bespoke reengineering is required for any change in model, tooling, or task domain, with no mechanism for experience-driven improvement; components are architecturally entangled, leading to fragile modifications and copy-based reuse; harness engineering and model training operate in silos, with execution traces discarded rather than reused, preventing joint optimization.
summary_en.importance: The agent harness is established as a first-class determinant of agent capability rather than a peripheral engineering patch, with optimization gains that often exceed minor model version iterations. The proposed harness-model co-evolution framework repurposes traces from harness optimization as RL training signal, breaking both the performance ceiling of harness-only optimization and the training signal ceiling of model-only RL. Actionable insights are provided for agent post-training data pipeline design and closed-loop optimization, while the composable harness formalization lays groundwork for standardized agent engineering.
summary_en.technical_approach: HarnessX is a unified harness foundry with three core modules: 1) Composable harness: The harness is formalized as a first-class typed object, assembled from typed primitives (processors spanning context, tools, skills, control, memory) via a substitution algebra inserted at lifecycle hook points. A 9-dimensional taxonomy covers the full behavioral space, enabling type-safe component addition/removal and full decoupling. 2) AEGIS adaptive evolution engine: Harness adaptation is framed as a learning problem over symbolic artifacts (prompts, tools, memory, control policies). A four-stage pipeline (Digester for trace compression, Planner for adaptation planning, Evolver for candidate generation, Critic for assessment) combined with full trace observability addresses RL-aligned risks including reward hacking, catastrophic forgetting, and under-exploration. An optional variant-isolation strategy eliminates cross-task interference on heterogeneous benchmarks. 3) Harness-model co-evolution: A shared replay buffer enables interleaved harness evolution and model GRPO training, allowing the model to internalize strategies from successive harness versions to form a closed optimization loop.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations cover 5 benchmarks (GAIA, ALFWorld, WebShop, \(\tau^3\)-Bench, SWE-bench Verified), 3 task agent families (Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.4, Qwen3.5-9B) with up to 15 evolution rounds. 14 of 15 model-benchmark configurations show improvement, with an average absolute gain of +14.5% and a maximum of +44.0% (Qwen3.5-9B on ALFWorld). Gains follow an inverse-scaling pattern: weaker baseline models benefit more from harness evolution. On heterogeneous GAIA, single-harness evolution stagnates; variant isolation restores a stable +13.6% gain without degradation over 15 rounds. Co-evolution delivers an additional +4.7% gain over harness-only optimization.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming: start with the three core flaws of existing harnesses in Section 1, core composable harness design in Section 3, AEGIS four-stage evolution pipeline in Section 4, and key experimental results in Section 6 (especially inverse-scaling patterns and co-evolution gains); estimated reading time 20-25 minutes. For implementation details, explore typed primitives and substitution algebra in Section 3; for training loop design, focus on the co-evolution mechanism in Section 5.

recommendation.zh: 轨迹驱动脚手架自演化的闭环设计有参考价值，重点看§3的AEGIS演化机制与§4的跨基准增益拆解。
recommendation.en: The closed-loop trace-driven harness evolution design is worth referencing; focus on §3 for the AEGIS mechanism and §4 for cross-benefit breakdown.

paper.title: When the Tool Decides: LLM Agents Defer Blindly to Graph Neural Network Tools, and Stronger Backbones Defer More
paper.abstract: A growing line of work equips large language model (LLM) agents with graph neural networks (GNNs) as callable tools, assuming the agent exercises judgment over when and how much to rely on such a tool. We test this directly. We expose a frozen GNN to a ReAct-style LLM agent as an explicit tool and measure, on node classification over a text-attributed graph (ogbn-arxiv, replicated on WikiCS), whether the agent uses the tool or merely obeys it. We find the agent does not exercise judgment: its pr

summary.core_problem: 工具增强型LLM Agent的一个隐含假设——Agent会对工具的可信性做出独立判断，决定何时信任工具、何时依赖自身推理——在将冻结GNN作为显式工具的场景下是否成立。
summary.importance: 直接证明了一类工具增强Agent（图-LLM混合系统）的常见评测假设可能完全失效：Agent并不行使判断力。更强的模型反而表现出更多的盲从，这一发现与'能力增长带来工具使用更智能'的直觉相反，对Agent系统的消融实验设计和结果报告方式有直接影响。
summary.technical_approach: 在ogbn-arxiv文本属性图节点分类任务上，将一个预训练并冻结的GCN暴露给ReAct风格LLM Agent作为显式工具（返回预测标签、异常分数、链接概率）。通过两个核心指标测量行为：(1) Agent最终答案与原始GNN预测的一致性，测量'盲从'；(2) per-node oracle gap，测量盲从的代价。实验设计了四个对比臂：Agent+GNN工具、Agent+最小图导航工具、纯GNN、无图工具纯Agent。使用Qwen2.5-Instruct系列（0.5B到7B）本地部署。
summary.experiments: 7B模型与GNN预测一致性在不同同质性区间为97.6%~99.2%，而与自身无工具推理的一致性仅17%~37%。跨尺度分析：从0.5B到7B，一旦模型能够使用工具（≥1.5B），与GNN的一致性从60%增长到98%，能力越强盲从越严重。Oracle gap在7B时为0.12/0.18/0.22（低/中/高同质性），在高同质性区域相比3B时约翻倍，因为此时邻居标签工具已优于GNN但Agent仍然服从。尝试了选择性调用门控（简单门控恢复约一半gap但无全局净增益，学习型四特征路由器无改进）和信息上限分析（标准测试时不确定性特征最多只能恢复oracle空间的1/6到1/3）。结果在WikiCS上得到验证。
summary.reading_guide: 核心结果集中在Section 4-7，建议先看Table 1（基本一致性）和Table 2（跨尺度分析）快速抓住主要发现；Section 7的信息上限分析有启发性，说明问题不仅是路由器设计，更是可用信息的固有局限。全文阅读约15-20分钟。
