summary_en.core_problem: Whether an implicit assumption underlying tool-augmented LLM agents — that the agent exercises independent judgment over tool trustworthiness and decides when to trust the tool vs. rely on its own reasoning — holds when a frozen GNN is given as an explicit tool.
summary_en.importance: Directly demonstrates that a common evaluation assumption for tool-augmented agents (graph-LLM hybrid systems) can fail outright: the agent does not exercise judgment. Stronger models exhibit more deference, opposite to the intuition that capability growth brings smarter tool use. This finding has direct implications for how ablation studies and result reporting should be conducted for such systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: On the ogbn-arxiv text-attributed graph node classification task, a pretrained and frozen GCN is exposed to a ReAct-style LLM agent as an explicit tool (returning predicted label, anomaly score, link probabilities). Behavior is measured via two core metrics: (1) prediction-level agreement between agent's final answer and raw GNN prediction, measuring 'deference'; (2) per-node oracle gap, measuring the cost of deference. Four arms are compared: Agent+GNN-tool, Agent+minimal graph-navigation tool, GNN-only, and agent-only with no graph tool. Qwen2.5-Instruct models (0.5B to 7B) are served locally.
summary_en.experiments: The 7B model shows 97.6%–99.2% agreement with GNN predictions across homophily regimes, but only 17%–37% agreement with its own tool-free reasoning. Cross-scale analysis: from 0.5B to 7B, once a model can use the tool at all (≥1.5B), agreement with GNN grows from 60% to 98%, with stronger models showing more deference. Oracle gap at 7B is 0.12/0.18/0.22 (low/mid/high homophily), roughly doubling at high homophily compared to 3B, because the neighbor-label tool overtakes the GNN at high homophily yet the agent still defers. A simple selective-invocation gate recovers about half the gap where informative but yields no net global gain, and a learned four-feature router does no better. Information ceiling analysis shows standard test-time uncertainty features can recover at most 1/6 to 1/3 of the oracle headroom. Results replicated on WikiCS.
summary_en.reading_guide: Core results are in Sections 4–7. Start with Table 1 (base agreement) and Table 2 (cross-scale analysis) to grasp the main findings quickly. Section 7's information ceiling analysis is instructive, showing the problem is not merely router design but inherent limits of available information. Full reading ~15–20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: Agent 越聪明越盲从工具——反常识的发现，但实验在单一任务（节点分类）+ 单一场景（ReAct+GNN），外推性弱，仅作弱信号
recommendation.en: Counterintuitive finding that stronger agents defer more to tools, but limited to node classification with ReAct+GNN setup; treat as weak signal.

paper.title: Naive Visual Memory is Not Enough: A Failure-Mode Study of GUI Agents
paper.abstract: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents are increasingly used to automate complex computer tasks across applications, websites, and operating systems. To improve their reliability, recent work has introduced experiential memory, where agents retrieve prior trajectories to guide decision-making in similar states. More recent approaches further extend this idea to visual memory by storing and retrieving screenshots from past interactions, providing agents with richer contextual information than text

summary.core_problem: 分析 GUI agent 中“视觉记忆”到底在修复哪些失败模式、又会引入哪些新错误，而不是默认记忆越多越好。
summary.importance: 价值在于 failure-mode 分析而非提出新 agent 架构。对做通用 agent、工具使用和长期交互的研究员有参考意义，但对 LLM 基座预训练的直接推动有限。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出一套 GUI agent 失败分类法，将错误映射到 perception-reasoning-action 管线中的四类：认知失败、视觉状态误解、隐藏操作盲区、grounding error。核心做法是系统比较加入视觉记忆前后的行为变化，分析视觉记忆在不同失败类型上的作用与副作用。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示其通过系统实验研究 prepending visual memory 的效果，但给出的文本被截断，无法确认具体 benchmark、模型、任务规模和数值提升。可以确定的是，这篇更像诊断性分析，而不是 clean 的方法增益论文。
summary.authors_note: 作者中有 Jinwoo Shin。若为其常见团队线索，这类工作通常偏可靠的分析与系统视角，但仅凭摘要无法确认具体机构。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies what visual memory in GUI agents actually fixes and what new failure modes it introduces, instead of assuming more memory is always better.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a failure-mode analysis rather than a new agent architecture. It is useful for researchers working on general agents, tool use, and long-horizon interaction, but only indirectly relevant to LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes a taxonomy of GUI-agent failures mapped to the perception-reasoning-action pipeline: cognitive failure, visual state misunderstanding, hidden operation blindness, and grounding error. The main method is a systematic comparison of agent behavior with and without visual memory to isolate where memory helps or hurts.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates controlled experiments on the effect of prepending visual memory, but the provided text is truncated, so the exact benchmarks, models, and quantitative gains are unclear. What is clear is that this is primarily a diagnostic study rather than a clean method paper.
summary_en.authors_note: Jinwoo Shin is among the authors. If this is from his usual line of work, the paper likely has a solid analysis/system flavor, though the exact institution cannot be confirmed from the provided metadata alone.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做 agent memory，这篇可看失败分类和负面案例；对 pretrain 本身帮助不大，读 taxonomy 和案例分析就够了。
recommendation.en: If you work on agent memory, read the failure taxonomy and negative cases; for pretraining, the direct payoff is small, so the analysis sections are enough.

paper.title: Keep Policy Gradient in Charge: Sibling-Guided Credit Distillation for Long-Horizon Tool-Use Agents
paper.abstract: Long-horizon tool-use reinforcement learning can learn from outcome verification, but its   trajectory-level advantage is broadcast across many reasoning, API, and answer tokens.   Self-distillation promises a denser signal by reusing a policy's own rollouts or a privileged   teacher. We show, however, that direct token-level self-distillation can silently destroy tool use:   it rehearses teacher behavior without knowing which actions the verifier rewards, so useful skills   and harmful shortcut

summary.core_problem: 长程工具使用 RL 中，轨迹级优势信号被分散在大量 reasoning/API/answer token 上；直接 token 级自蒸馏会无差别放大有用技能和有害捷径，破坏工具使用能力。
summary.importance: 发现了自蒸馏在长程 tool-use 中的隐性破坏机制；提出 SGCD 方法将蒸馏用于 credit assignment 而非替代 actor loss，保持 policy gradient 主导。
summary.technical_approach: Sibling-Guided Credit Distillation (SGCD)：动态采样生成混合成败的兄弟轨迹；外部 LLM 对比总结为 stepwise credit reference；用 teacher/student 散度驱动信用再分配；有界分离权重重塑 GRPO token 优势。
summary.experiments: 未给出具体模型规模和基线细节（摘要被截断）；核心论断是 SGCD 相比直接自蒸馏保留了工具使用能力并提升了长程任务表现。

summary_en.core_problem: In long-horizon tool-use RL, trajectory-level advantage is spread across many reasoning/API/answer tokens; direct token-level self-distillation indiscriminately amplifies both useful skills and harmful shortcuts, silently destroying tool use.
summary_en.importance: Identifies a hidden failure mode of self-distillation in long-horizon tool use; proposes SGCD which uses distillation for credit assignment rather than replacing actor loss, keeping policy gradient in charge.
summary_en.technical_approach: Sibling-Guided Credit Distillation (SGCD): dynamic sampling produces mixed success/failure sibling rollouts; external LLM summarizes contrast into stepwise credit reference; teacher/student divergence drives credit reassignment; bounded detached weights reshape GRPO token advantages.
summary_en.experiments: Full model scale and baseline details not provided (abstract truncated); claims SGCD preserves tool use and improves long-horizon task performance vs direct self-distillation.

recommendation.zh: 自蒸馏破坏 tool-use 的观察有价值，对做 RL 后训练的研究员是有用的负例教训。SGCD 方法本身属增量创新，看方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: The observation that self-distillation silently destroys tool use is a valuable negative lesson for RL post-training researchers. SGCD itself is incremental; focus on the method section.

authors: Juan Pablo De la Cruz Weinstein

paper.title: SENTINEL: Failure-Driven Reinforcement Learning for Training Tool-Using Language Model Agents
paper.abstract: Language model agents are increasingly effective in solving realistic tasks through multi-turn tool use. However, training reliable tool-using agents remains challenging in practice. While reinforcement learning provides an on-policy paradigm for improving agents from their own environment interactions, its effectiveness depends heavily on the training task distribution. When tasks are fixed before training, the task distribution can become increasingly mismatched with the policy's evolving capa

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 tool-using agent 的 RL 训练分布失配问题。固定任务集在训练早期可能有用，但随着 policy 改进，任务会变得过易、过难、重复，或不能覆盖当前模型真实失败模式，导致 rollout 预算花在信息量低的交互上。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关联不强，主要属于 post-train / agent RL。但它对训练数据闭环有启发：失败轨迹可以作为动态数据生成的控制信号，而不是只作为评测错误记录。这个思路可迁移到更一般的 SFT/RL 数据合成：用当前模型的真实失误来驱动下一轮任务分布，而不是依赖一次性离线合成数据。对基座研究员而言，值得关注的是 on-policy 数据分布如何随能力变化自适应，以及如何避免固定任务集带来的训练信号退化。
summary.technical_approach: SENTINEL 采用 Controller-Proposer-Solver 闭环。Solver 是待训练的工具使用模型，在可执行环境中执行多轮工具调用并产生轨迹。Controller 读取失败轨迹，归纳 recurring error patterns，例如选错工具变体、遗漏步骤、工具调用顺序错误、没有遵守业务规则、参数或记录选择错误。然后 Controller 把这些错误转成显式生成指令。Proposer 根据这些指令合成新的可执行任务，目标是专门触发当前 policy 的弱点。Solver 再在这些 targeted tasks 上做 RL，使用环境中的 executable evaluator 给出任务成功奖励。与普通 self-play curriculum 或按难度排序的课程不同，SENTINEL 的任务分布不是围绕抽象难度调节，而是围绕当前模型的具体失败类型调节。
summary.experiments: 实验在 Tau2-Bench Retail 域进行，这是一个多轮客户服务工具调用环境，要求模型在领域规则约束下完成任务。基础模型是 Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507。主要结果是 Pass@1 从 66.4 提升到 74.9，并且在 Pass@k 指标上优于使用一般合成任务做 RL 的对照。论文还强调 targeted failure-driven tasks 能让训练分布更贴近当前 policy 的缺陷，从而提高 rollout 的有效性。由于材料中未给出完整消融细节，不能确认 Controller、Proposer、RL 算法选择各自贡献的精确幅度；已知的核心证据是相对 fixed/general synthetic task RL 的收益。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 到 30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 对 fixed task distribution 问题的定义，再看 Method 中 Controller、Proposer、Solver 三个角色如何交换信息。实验部分重点看 Tau2-Bench Retail 的任务构造、reward/evaluator 定义、Pass@1 和 Pass@k 对比，以及失败类型分析。如果关注通用 agent RL，可继续看任务生成是否真的 executable、是否有过滤机制、是否会过拟合 Retail 域。若只关注基座预训练，可把它当作 post-train 数据闭环案例，不需要深读环境细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a training-distribution problem in reinforcement learning for tool-using agents. A fixed task set can become poorly matched to the evolving policy: too easy, too hard, repetitive, or unrelated to the model's current failure modes. As a result, many environment rollouts provide little learning signal.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a post-training and agent-RL paper, not a pretraining paper. Its relevance to foundation-model training is the closed-loop data principle: failed on-policy trajectories can guide the next round of data generation. Instead of treating failures only as evaluation artifacts, the system converts them into targeted tasks. This idea is useful for broader SFT/RL data construction, where static synthetic data often stops matching the model's weaknesses after several training iterations.
summary_en.technical_approach: SENTINEL uses a Controller-Proposer-Solver loop. The Solver is the policy being trained; it interacts with an executable tool-use environment and produces multi-turn trajectories. The Controller analyzes failed trajectories and summarizes recurring errors, such as wrong tool selection, missing steps, incorrect tool-call order, policy violations, or wrong record access. These diagnoses are converted into explicit generation directives. The Proposer then synthesizes executable tasks designed to stress those weaknesses. The Solver is trained with reinforcement learning on these targeted tasks, using an executable evaluator as the reward source. The key difference from static synthetic-task RL is that the task distribution is updated from the current policy's actual failures, not fixed before training. It also differs from generic curriculum learning because the adaptation is organized around diagnosed error types rather than only task difficulty.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation is conducted on the Tau2-Bench Retail domain, a multi-turn customer-service tool-use environment with domain-specific policies. Using Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507, SENTINEL improves Pass@1 from 66.4 to 74.9 and outperforms RL on general synthetic tasks across Pass@k metrics. The reported evidence supports the claim that targeted failure-driven tasks provide more useful rollouts than a static or generic synthetic task pool. The provided material does not include enough detail to quantify the separate contribution of the Controller, Proposer, and RL configuration, so the strongest supported conclusion is the benefit of closing the loop between failure diagnosis and task generation.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20 to 30 minute skim should be sufficient. Read the introduction for the fixed-distribution failure mode, then the method section for the information flow among Controller, Proposer, and Solver. In the experiments, focus on Tau2-Bench Retail, the executable evaluator, Pass@1 and Pass@k comparisons, and any failure-type analysis. For readers interested in general agent RL, the important questions are whether generated tasks are truly executable, how task validity is filtered, and whether the method overfits the Retail domain. For pretraining-oriented readers, the paper is best read as a post-training data-loop case study.

recommendation.zh: 读 Controller/Proposer 设计即可；它像 agent 版 hard-example mining，setup 若干净，值得内化到内部 RL 任务采样。
recommendation.en: Read the Controller/Proposer design; it is hard-example mining for agents, and a clean setup would be worth porting into internal RL task sampling.

paper.title: Perceive, Interact, Reason: Building Tool-Augmented Visual Agents for Spatial Reasoning
paper.abstract: While recent vision-language models (VLMs) demonstrate strong multimodal understanding, they remain limited in spatial reasoning tasks that require active evidence acquisition and multi-step visual interaction. This limitation suggests that relying solely on implicit visual representations from vision encoders is insufficient for recovering fine-grained spatial evidence. We introduce PERception-Interaction-reason Agent (PERIA), a tool-augmented visual agent for spatial reasoning tasks across map

summary.core_problem: 让 VLM 在需要主动取证和多步视觉交互的空间推理任务中，不再只依赖隐式视觉编码器表示。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视觉 agent 方法创新。它把空间推理拆成感知工具、交互工具和推理策略，并引入面向多工具使用的训练 recipe；对预训练研究的直接贡献不大，但对“视觉表示不足时如何外接可验证证据”有方法参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PERIA，即 PERception-Interaction-reason Agent。它使用两类轻量工具：感知工具把图像证据显式化为文本、符号和空间信息；交互工具用于操作视觉上下文、路径追踪和空间关系验证。训练上结合监督式 tool-use trajectory synthesis、composite rewards，以及 Observation-Relaxed Group-in-Group Policy Optimization, OR-GIGPO。
summary.experiments: 任务覆盖地图推理、视觉探查和视觉重建。摘要未给出底座模型、参数规模、训练数据量、baseline 名称、评测集或数值提升；因此结论可信度需要看正文实验设置是否干净。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses spatial reasoning failures in VLMs when tasks require active evidence acquisition and multi-step visual interaction rather than only latent visual representations.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a visual-agent method. It decomposes spatial reasoning into perception tools, interaction tools, and a trained reasoning policy. It is not directly about pretraining, but it is relevant to how external verifiable evidence can compensate for weak internal visual representations.
summary_en.technical_approach: PERIA, the PERception-Interaction-reason Agent, uses two lightweight tool families. Perception tools expose textual, symbolic, and spatial evidence; interaction tools manipulate visual context, trace paths, and verify spatial relations. Training combines supervised tool-use trajectory synthesis, composite rewards, and Observation-Relaxed Group-in-Group Policy Optimization, or OR-GIGPO.
summary_en.experiments: The tasks include map reasoning, visual probing, and vision reconstruction. The abstract does not provide the base model, parameter count, data scale, baseline names, benchmarks, or numerical gains, so the experimental cleanliness needs to be checked in the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫训练目标和 OR-GIGPO；若实验只靠合成轨迹堆 prompt，结论要按弱信号处理。
recommendation.en: Skim the objective and OR-GIGPO; if gains mostly come from synthetic tool traces and prompting, treat the conclusion as a weak signal.

paper.title: ISE: An Execution-Grounded Recipe for Multi-Turn OS-Agent Trajectories
paper.abstract: Training capable OS agents requires data that simultaneously captures structured user intents, multi-turn task delegation, and grounded tool execution--properties absent from existing datasets. We propose ISE (Intent -> Simulate -> Execute), a three-stage synthesis paradigm that addresses these gaps jointly. Stage 1 constructs roughly 50000 structured intents via a 4D framework (Persona x Domain x Task x Complexity); after deduplication the pool contains 43956 unique intents and attains a Vendi

summary.core_problem: OS Agent 训练缺少同时覆盖结构化用户意图、多轮委派和真实工具执行反馈的数据，导致模型学不到失败恢复和真实交互节奏。
summary.importance: 贡献主要在数据合成流程与执行环境构造，而不是新模型范式。对做 agent 数据工程的人有参考价值；对基座预训练研究员，价值更多在“如何把真实执行信号写回训练轨迹”这一点。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ISE（Intent -> Simulate -> Execute）三阶段合成方案。先用 Persona×Domain×Task×Complexity 的 4D 框架生成并去重结构化意图；再用 role-locked user simulator 基于执行结果驱动多轮用户-代理对话；最后把每次工具调用放到隔离的真实 OS workspace 中执行，保留真实失败、报错与恢复轨迹，而不是用模拟工具响应替代。
summary.experiments: 构造约 5 万个结构化意图，去重后 43,956 个；生成 23,132 条完整轨迹，平均 8.12 个用户轮次、68.24 个总对话轮次。摘要称在 ISETrace 上微调可提升 OS agent 表现，但未在给定信息中看到清晰的模型规模、基线名称和提升幅度，因此当前更像数据 recipe 论文而非可直接迁移到基座预训练的结论。

summary_en.core_problem: OS-agent training lacks data that jointly captures structured intents, multi-turn delegation, and real execution feedback, so models fail to learn realistic recovery behavior.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a data synthesis pipeline plus an execution-grounded environment, not a new modeling paradigm. For pretraining researchers, the useful part is how real execution outcomes are written back into trajectories.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes ISE (Intent -> Simulate -> Execute), a three-stage synthesis pipeline. It first builds structured intents with a Persona×Domain×Task×Complexity schema, then uses a role-locked user simulator whose turns are grounded in actual execution outcomes, and finally executes every tool call inside an isolated live OS workspace to preserve authentic failure-recovery dynamics.
summary_en.experiments: It reports roughly 50k structured intents, 43,956 unique after deduplication, and 23,132 complete trajectories with 8.12 user turns and 68.24 total dialogue turns on average. The abstract claims finetuning gains on ISETrace, but the provided information does not expose model sizes, baselines, or effect sizes clearly, so the paper currently reads more like an agent-data recipe than a result that directly shifts pretraining practice.

recommendation.zh: 更像 OS-agent 数据工程而非基座研究；只需看它如何把真实执行失败写回轨迹，别把这类合成数据的收益外推到通用 pretrain。
recommendation.en: This is mostly OS-agent data engineering, not base-model research; only read how execution failures are fed back into trajectories, and do not overgeneralize the gains to general pretraining.

paper.title: Infini Memory: Maintainable Topic Documents for Long-Term LLM Agent Memory
paper.abstract: Long-term LLM agents need persistent memory that can track changing facts and provide relevant evidence across sessions. Existing memory systems often store observations as isolated records, summaries, or indexed fragments, which makes evidence aggregation, fact revision, and memory maintenance difficult. We propose Infini Memory, a maintainable text-based persistent memory architecture that treats agent memory as topic-structured documents. Each topic document serves as a semantic unit for coll

summary.core_problem: 解决长期 LLM Agent 中持久记忆难以维护、事实难以修订、跨会话证据难以聚合的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 记忆系统设计。它把长期记忆从零散 observation、摘要或向量片段，改成可编辑的 topic-structured documents，对长期个性化 Agent 和可审计记忆有一定参考意义，但距离基座预训练问题较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Infini Memory：以 topic document 作为语义记忆单元，集中保存相关证据、元数据和随时间更新的事实。新观察先进入 buffer，再周期性 consolidation 成连贯文本；推理时通过 agentic retrieval，让模型用多轮工具调用迭代读取记忆，而不是一次性向量检索。
summary.experiments: 在 MemoryAgentBench 上报告 64.7% overall score。消融显示，topic-structured maintenance 和 iterative evidence inspection 分别改善事实维护与证据检索能力。摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据或完整 baseline 细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自清华大学和上海交通大学。工作更偏 Agent memory architecture，而不是模型预训练或通用记忆机制的训练目标。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses maintainable long-term memory for LLM agents, especially fact revision and evidence aggregation across sessions.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent memory-system design. It replaces isolated observations, summaries, or vector fragments with editable topic-structured documents, which is useful for persistent and auditable agents but only indirectly related to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Infini Memory uses topic documents as semantic memory units that preserve related evidence, metadata, and evolving facts. New observations are staged in a buffer and periodically consolidated into coherent text. At inference time, the agent reads memory through iterative tool calls instead of a single retrieval step.
summary_en.experiments: The system reports a 64.7% overall score on MemoryAgentBench. Ablations suggest that topic-structured maintenance and iterative evidence inspection improve complementary parts of the memory pipeline. The abstract does not specify model size, training data, or full baseline details.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Tsinghua University and Shanghai Jiao Tong University. The work is mainly about agent memory architecture rather than pretraining objectives or model-internal memory.

recommendation.zh: 只看系统图和消融即可；topic document 是实用工程选择，但不会改变对基座记忆或训练目标的判断。
recommendation.en: Skim the system diagram and ablations; topic documents are a practical engineering choice, not a new prior for model memory or pretraining.

paper.title: Less Context, Better Agents: Efficient Context Engineering for Long-Horizon Tool-Using LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Large language models deployed as autonomous agents for enterprise workflows face a key challenge: verbose tool responses from enterprise systems can cause context overflow, stale-state errors, and high inference cost. We study this problem in automated expense itemization in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations using Model Context Protocol tools. We evaluate four GPT-5 configurations on a 50-task hotel expense benchmark: no user model, full conversation history, context pruned to the l

summary.core_problem: 研究长程工具调用 Agent 中，企业系统返回的冗长工具响应如何导致上下文溢出、状态陈旧和推理成本升高。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 上下文工程的实证分析。它不是通用预训练工作，但对工具调用系统的上下文预算、历史保留策略和状态压缩有一定工程参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 在 Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations 的自动费用拆分场景中，对比四种 GPT-5 配置：无用户模型、保留完整对话历史、仅保留最近 5 轮工具调用/响应、剪枝后再自动摘要。核心方法是用显式上下文剪枝和摘要替代无差别保留全历史。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 50 个酒店费用拆分任务，每个配置独立运行 5 次，并固定用户模型以控制变量。无用户模型完成率为 8.0%；完整上下文完成率为 71.0%，消耗 1,480,996 tokens 和 14.56 小时；仅保留最近 5 轮工具调用完成率提升到 79.0%，token 降到 535,274，运行时间降到 5.39 小时。摘要策略的完整结果在给定摘要中未显示。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how verbose enterprise tool responses in long-horizon tool-using agents cause context overflow, stale state, and high inference cost.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an empirical agent context-engineering study. It is not a pretraining paper, but it gives a concrete signal about context budget, history retention, and state compression in tool-use systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors compare four GPT-5 configurations on automated expense itemization in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations: no user model, full conversation history, pruning to the last five tool-call/response pairs, and pruning plus automated summarization. The key intervention is replacing full-history retention with explicit context pruning and optional summarization.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 50 hotel-expense tasks, averaged over five independent runs with the user model held fixed. The no-user-model baseline reaches 8.0% complete itemization. Full context reaches 71.0% but uses 1,480,996 tokens and 14.56 hours. Keeping only the last five tool-call pairs reaches 79.0%, with 535,274 tokens and 5.39 hours. The excerpt does not provide the full summarization results.

recommendation.zh: 只看结果表即可；“少上下文更好”像是状态污染问题，不是可直接外推到通用 Agent 的规律。
recommendation.en: Read the result table only; the “less context is better” result likely reflects state pollution, not a general law for agents.

paper.title: The Cold-Start Safety Gap in LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Are tool-calling LLM agents equally safe throughout a conversation? We discover they are not: agents are most vulnerable at the very start of a session and become substantially safer after a few regular agentic tasks -- a phenomenon we term the cold-start safety gap. To study this systematically, we introduce Safety Over Depth for Agents (SODA), a benchmark that controls how many regular agentic tasks the agent completes before encountering a safety threat, supporting up to 20 preceding tasks. E

summary.core_problem: 工具调用型 LLM agent 的安全性是否随对话进程变化；如果会变化，为什么“会话刚开始”更容易被诱导执行有害工具操作，以及如何用最小代价缓解。
summary.importance:
这是偏评测+机制分析的工作，但对预训练/对齐闭环有直接启发：同一个已对齐模型，其安全行为不是静态属性，而是强依赖“上下文深度/历史轨迹”的动态状态。它提示两类训练与评测缺口：
- 评测缺口：只测 D=0 的单轮威胁会系统性高估或低估真实部署风险（文中显示 D=0 最危险）。
- 训练缺口：对齐可能更像一种可被上下文激活的“persona/模式”，而不是始终在线的硬约束；这会影响 pretrain→posttrain 的接口设计（system prompt 不足以稳定激活 agent 安全模式）。
summary.technical_approach:
核心贡献是 SODA 基准与对“冷启动安全缺口”的归因。
1) SODA（Safety Over Depth for Agents）：用“深度可控的威胁注入”设计，把同一类安全威胁放在不同对话深度 D 下评测。D 定义为威胁出现前，agent 已完成的常规工具任务数量，支持最高 20 个前置任务。作者构造 16 个工具环境（如 BankAccount、EmailManager、FileSystem、WebBrowser 等），每个环境 5 个场景（共 80），每个场景 5 个安全威胁（共 400 threats）。前置任务从同场景的“常规任务池”随机采样，确保工具分布与交互形态接近真实 agent 使用。
2) 现象：安全性随 D 增大而单调提升，提出 cold-start safety gap。
3) 机制与消融：把“历史里有什么”拆开。
- 结论一：主要驱动来自“用户侧的常规 agent 任务请求”出现在历史里，而不是 agent 自己先前输出的具体内容；把 agent 回复替换成简短同意文本或随机文本，安全提升仍接近。
- 结论二：但要保持 utility，真实的 agent 回复/工具交互过程很关键；用假回复会伤害工具使用能力。
4) 表征分析：用隐藏状态做线性可分的 safety boundary，观察随深度增加，hidden states 向“更安全区域”迁移，支持“逐步激活 agent persona”的解释。
5) 缓解策略：warm-up——在处理潜在高风险请求前，先让 agent 做 5–10 个常规工具任务。
summary.experiments:
模型：7 个模型，来自 4 个家族（Llama、Qwen3、Qwen3.5、Gemma）。
SODA 主结果：当深度从 D=0 增加到 D=20，安全性提升 9%–52%（不同模型幅度不同）。
泛化：warm-up 效果迁移到其他开源 agent 安全基准：AgentHarm 安全 +23%，Agent Safety Bench（ASB）+8%。
效用评估：在 BFCL、API-Bank 上验证 warm-up 不损害工具调用效用；同时消融显示“替换 agent 回复为无关文本”会降低效用（即安全提升不依赖回复内容，但效用依赖真实交互轨迹）。
机制证据：表示空间随深度跨过线性 safety 边界（需要结合正文图/附录看具体层、具体表示取法：last token/mean pooling/某层等）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 35–50 分钟）：
- 先看 SODA 的构造细节：16 个环境的工具 schema、威胁类型覆盖、常规任务池如何与威胁共享工具分布；这决定它是不是“只是在 prompt 上做花样”。
- 重点看深度曲线（D=0→20）在不同模型上的形状：是快速饱和还是线性增长；这关系到 warm-up 需要几步。
- 精看消融：把历史拆成“用户请求 vs agent 回复”，以及“真实回复 vs 伪回复”对 safety/utility 的不同影响，这是全文最有信息量的部分。
- 表征分析部分建议至少看一遍：他们如何定义 safety boundary、用哪一层/哪种 pooling、是否跨任务一致；这能帮助判断‘persona 激活’是合理解释还是仅仅是上下文长度/格式效应。
- 如果要落地：直接看 warm-up 的推荐步数（5–10）与对 BFCL/API-Bank 的效用结果，评估是否适合接入现有 agent 框架。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether tool-using LLM agents are equally safe throughout a session; why they are most vulnerable at the very beginning (cold start), and how to mitigate this without sacrificing tool-use utility.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an evaluation + mechanism paper, but it feeds back into the pretrain/post-train loop: safety behavior is a dynamic state conditioned on conversational trajectory, not a static property of an aligned model. It exposes two gaps: (1) benchmarking that only tests single-turn, depth-0 threats can mischaracterize real deployment risk; (2) alignment may behave like a context-activated agent persona rather than an always-on constraint, implying system prompts alone may not reliably engage the safety mode.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Main contributions are the SODA benchmark and a causal-style decomposition of what in the history drives safety gains.
1) SODA (Safety Over Depth for Agents): a depth-controlled threat injection protocol. The same safety-critical tool-use threats are evaluated at multiple conversation depths D, where D is the number of ordinary agentic tool tasks completed before the threat (up to 20). The benchmark includes 16 tool environments (e.g., BankAccount, EmailManager, FileSystem, WebBrowser), 5 scenarios per environment (80 total), and 5 threats per scenario (400 threats). Preceding tasks are sampled from a scenario-specific pool of benign tool tasks to keep tool schemas and interaction patterns realistic.
2) Phenomenon: safety improves monotonically with depth; the paper names this the cold-start safety gap.
3) Ablations: separate the effect of (a) benign user task requests in history vs (b) the agent’s own prior responses. They find benign task requests are the primary driver; the exact content of the agent’s prior responses matters little for safety (random/agreeable filler works similarly).
4) Utility caveat: while response content is not needed for the safety gain, real agent responses/tool interactions are important to preserve utility; fake responses degrade tool performance.
5) Representation analysis: hidden states move across a linear “safety boundary” as depth increases, supporting an ‘agent persona gradually activates’ hypothesis.
6) Mitigation: warm-up—run a few benign tool tasks (5–10) before handling potentially risky requests.
summary_en.experiments:
Models: 7 models across 4 families (Llama, Qwen3, Qwen3.5, Gemma).
SODA: safety improves by 9%–52% when increasing depth from D=0 to D=20 (model-dependent).
Generalization: warm-up improves safety on other agent safety benchmarks: +23% on AgentHarm and +8% on Agent Safety Bench.
Utility: warm-up preserves tool-use utility on BFCL and API-Bank; replacing prior agent responses with unrelated text harms utility.
Mechanistic evidence: representation trajectories cross a linear safety separator with increasing depth (details depend on which layer/pooling is used; worth checking the exact setup in the main text/appendix).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~35–50 minutes):
- Read the SODA construction carefully: tool schemas, threat taxonomy, and how benign task pools are built to match the same tool distribution. This determines whether the effect is an artifact of prompt formatting.
- Inspect the depth–safety curves across models (D=0→20): saturation speed vs near-linear gains; this directly informs how many warm-up steps are needed.
- Spend time on the ablations that disentangle user requests vs agent responses, and real vs fake responses; this is the most informative part for understanding the mechanism.
- Read the representation analysis once end-to-end: how the safety boundary is defined, which layers/states are used, and whether the trend is consistent across environments.
- For deployment, focus on the recommended warm-up length (5–10) and the BFCL/API-Bank utility results to judge integration cost.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是 pretrain 论文，但它提醒你对齐不是静态属性而是上下文状态函数；只看现象图和表示分析就够，值得拿内部 agent/safety eval 复现。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it usefully shows alignment is a context-state function rather than a fixed model trait; read the phenomenon plots and representation analysis, then replicate internally.

paper.title: VisualLeakBench: Reproducible Action-Boundary Propagation Failures in Vision-Language Agents
paper.abstract: Vision-language agents increasingly consume screenshots, documents, and user interfaces before writing to memory, sending messages, or invoking external tools. We study a concrete failure mode in this setting: action-boundary propagation, where sensitive or unsafe visible text is copied from an image into downstream tool arguments. We present VisualLeakBench, a diversified 500-image benchmark spanning UI, chat, document, form, and dashboard scenes, and evaluate a stratified 100-image agent subse

summary.core_problem: VLM agent在看图（截图/UI/文档）后执行工具调用时，会把图中敏感/不安全文本“跨动作边界”复制进工具参数，造成隐私与安全泄露；缺少可复现评测来量化该失败模式。
summary.importance: 提供面向VLM agent的具体安全失败模式与可复现实证基准（benchmark贡献）；对多模态预训练/后训练的启发在于：视觉OCR式拷贝能力与工具调用通道耦合后，会形成新的泄露面，需要把“可见文本→行动参数”的传播当作一等公民指标。
summary.technical_approach: 构建VisualLeakBench：500张多场景图像（UI/聊天/文档/表单/仪表盘等），并从中抽取100张做agent工作流评测；定义action-boundary propagation为核心度量，观察目标字符串是否进入下游tool arguments；评测两类工作流（note capture与external handoff），并测试防御性system prompt的效果与不同工具表面的差异。
summary.experiments: 在4个“生产级VLM系统”上评测：基线下PII传播到工具参数78.8%，渲染不安全文本传播85.5%；加防御prompt后，不安全文本仍有52.6%传播，PII传播降到2.0%但主要靠抑制工具使用而非保持效用；不同工具类型（如search-like）对传播率影响显著。摘要未披露具体模型名称与判定细则实现。

summary_en.core_problem: VLM agents can copy sensitive/unsafe visible text from images into downstream tool arguments across action boundaries; there is no reproducible benchmark to quantify this failure mode.
summary_en.importance: A benchmark contribution exposing a concrete safety failure mode for vision-language agents. It suggests that OCR-like copying coupled with tool-call channels creates a new leakage surface, and “visible text → action arguments” propagation should be a first-class metric in multimodal training/eval.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduce VisualLeakBench: 500 images across UI/chat/document/form/dashboard scenes, plus a stratified 100-image agent subset. Define and measure action-boundary propagation by checking whether target strings appear in tool arguments under two workflows (note capture, external handoff), and test a defensive system prompt and tool-surface dependence.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated 4 production VLM systems: baseline propagation into tool args is 78.8% for PII and 85.5% for rendered unsafe text. With a defensive prompt, unsafe-text propagation remains 52.6%, while PII drops to 2.0% largely by suppressing tool use. Strong dependence on tool surface (e.g., search-like tools). Model names and exact judging details are not in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 把“看见的文本会被写进工具参数”量化成基准，这点很实用；只需看任务定义+两张主结果表，prompt防御靠禁用工具的结论要警惕。
recommendation.en: Useful benchmark that operationalizes “visible text leaks into tool arguments”; read the task definition and main result tables—be skeptical since the prompt defense mostly works by disabling tool use.

paper.title: IEA: Amateur-Friendly Conversational Image Editing Agent via Three Stages of Multitask Alignment
paper.abstract: Current image editing software often hinges on fixed filters or expert tuning, leaving a gap between amateur users' intent and outcomes. Creations by generative models may contain artifacts, implausible details, or stylistic drift away from photorealism and offer little insight into why an edit was made. We propose IEA, a conversational Image Editing Agent that learns to operate parameterized tools in an explicit, interpretable action space. IEA is trained via a three-stage multitask pipeline: (

summary.core_problem: 如何构建一个能理解业余用户意图并提供可解释编辑步骤的对话式图像编辑 Agent？
summary.importance: 提出了一个通过三阶段多任务对齐训练的 Agent (IEA)，能够在显式、可解释的动作空间中操作参数化工具，弥合了用户意图与编辑结果之间的差距。
summary.technical_approach: 三阶段训练：(1) 在蒸馏的专家编辑数据上进行 SFT；(2) 使用 GRPO 进行 RL，奖励包括相似度提升、工具实用性和意图总结；(3) 大规模合成微调，联合掌握图像编辑、细化和意图总结。Agent 逐步操作 16 种编辑工具。
summary.experiments: 在编辑任务上获得了更低的像素距离，在总结任务上获得了比强基线更高的 ROUGE-L 分数。

summary_en.core_problem: How to build a conversational image editing agent that understands amateur user intent and provides interpretable editing steps?
summary_en.importance: Proposes an agent (IEA) trained via a three-stage multitask alignment pipeline, operating in an explicit, interpretable action space with parameterized tools, bridging the gap between user intent and editing outcomes.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three-stage training: (1) SFT on distilled expert edits; (2) GRPO with rewards for likeness improvement, tool usefulness, and intent summarization; (3) large-scale synthetic fine-tuning to jointly master editing, refinement, and summarization. The agent manipulates 16 tools step-by-step.
summary_en.experiments: Achieved lower pixel distance on the edit task and higher ROUGE-L on the summary task compared to strong baselines.

recommendation.zh: 将 GRPO 应用于多模态 Agent 的工具调用（图像编辑），展示了 RL 在复杂动作空间对齐中的潜力，可作为 post-train 扩展到多模态的参考。
recommendation.en: Applies GRPO to tool calling (image editing) for multimodal agents, demonstrating the potential of RL in aligning complex action spaces. Useful reference for extending post-training to multimodal domains.

paper.title: Decision-Aware Memory Cards: Counterfactual-Inspired Context Selection and Compression for Tool-Using LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Tool-using LLM agents often fail not because relevant text is absent, but because decisive evidence is not selected, compressed, or surfaced at action time. We present CICL, a decision-aware context layer that turns instance evidence into a context graph, routes deterministic, Opus-assisted, Qwen, Codex/GPT-5.5, and Qwen-QLoRA judgments through a shared eight-field schema, scores units by action shift, outcome uplift, necessity, and negative-transfer risk, and packs high-utility evidence as type

summary.core_problem: 工具使用LLM Agent常因决定性证据未被选择、压缩或呈现而失败
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出决策感知记忆卡框架，通过反事实启发的上下文选择和压缩
summary.technical_approach: CICL将实例证据转为上下文图，通过共享八字段 schema 路由多种模型判断，按行动转移、结果提升、必要性和负迁移风险评分，打包为类型化记忆卡供预算限制下的Agent使用
summary.experiments: 在50个SWE-bench Verified文件检索实例上，Qwen3.6-plus重排BM25 top-50候选将hit@1从0.58提升到0.78，MRR@10从0.634到0.790
summary.authors_note: 作者机构不明

summary_en.core_problem: Tool-using LLM agents often fail because decisive evidence is not selected, compressed, or surfaced at action time
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: proposes decision-aware memory cards with counterfactual-inspired context selection and compression
summary_en.technical_approach: CICL converts instance evidence into context graph, routes multiple model judgments through shared eight-field schema, scores by action shift/outcome uplift/necessity/negative-transfer risk, packs as typed memory cards for budgeted agents
summary_en.experiments: On 50 SWE-bench Verified file-retrieval instances: Qwen3.6-plus reranking of BM25 top-50 raises hit@1 from 0.58 to 0.78, MRR@10 from 0.634 to 0.790
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions unclear

recommendation.zh: CICL在SWE-bench上的证据评分方案有参考价值，看实验部分即可，对Agent上下文管理思路可借鉴但无范式突破。
recommendation.en: Useful context management scheme for SWE-bench retrieval; read experiments section worth skimming for context compression ideas, but no paradigm shift.

paper.title: Projecting the Emerging Mindset of SWE Agent by Launching a Wild Code Understanding Journey
paper.abstract: Software engineering agents (SWE agents) increasingly work through tool-mediated trajectories in real repositories, yet their behavior remains difficult to characterize in concrete, observable terms. These trajectories record tool use, intermediate reasoning, evidence selection, and self-directed stopping, but they do not by themselves explain why particular moves were chosen, what evidence was trusted, or when understanding was judged sufficient. This tension makes trajectory data both limited

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作想回答：SWE agent 在真实代码仓库中的理解行为，能否被限制在可审计、可回放的轨迹里，并据此观察其证据选择、工具使用和停止决策。
summary.importance: 贡献更偏分析装置与任务设定，而不是新的基座模型方法。它的价值在于把“仓库级代码理解”从黑箱 agent 轨迹，变成一个边界清楚、可记录、可观察的实验环境，适合作为后续研究 agent 行为的经验载体。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Ada，一个面向 repository-level code understanding 的受限工具接口框架。核心设计是“wild-but-bounded”：允许 agent 在真实代码库中开放探索，但所有动作都通过有限工具接口执行，从而形成有限、可回放的轨迹。论文重点不在训练新模型，而在通过这种 apparatus 观察 agent 如何决定看哪里、读多深、何时整合局部理解、何时停止。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，实验重点是展示 Ada 在真实代码仓库中的探索与理解轨迹，而不是大规模模型对比、训练规模或标准 benchmark 刷分。未见明确参数量、训练数据规模、强基线或定量 SOTA 结果，因此更像一个行为研究平台而非方法性能论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether the behavior of SWE agents in real repositories can be made observable and auditable through bounded, replayable trajectories, so that evidence selection, tool use, and stopping decisions become empirically studyable.
summary_en.importance: This is more of an instrumentation and task-framing contribution than a foundation-model method. Its value is in turning repository-level code understanding from opaque agent traces into a constrained empirical setting for studying agent behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce Ada, a scoped apparatus for repository-level code understanding. The key idea is a wild-but-bounded setup: the agent can explore real codebases in an open-ended way, but only through a bounded tool interface, making trajectories finite and replayable. The emphasis is on observing where the agent looks, what it reads closely, when it consolidates partial understanding, and when it decides to stop.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the experiments mainly demonstrate exploration and understanding trajectories in real repositories rather than large-scale model comparisons or benchmark gains. No clear model size, training corpus, strong baselines, or headline quantitative results are visible, so this reads more like a behavioral study platform than a performance paper.

recommendation.zh: 更像 SWE agent 行为观察装置，不改 pretrain prior；做代码 agent 评测设计的人可留作备查，其余看设定即可。
recommendation.en: This is mainly an instrumentation paper for SWE-agent behavior, not something that changes pretraining priors; useful as a reference if you design code-agent evals, otherwise the setup is enough.

paper.title: Data Agents Under Attack: Vulnerabilities in LLM-Driven Analytical Systems
paper.abstract: Data agents integrate LLM-driven reasoning with relational data access, executable analytical tools, and multi-step workflow orchestration, making them increasingly central to enterprise analytics. This integration introduces new security vulnerabilities across data resources, database execution, and agent reasoning, recombining concerns from database security and general-purpose LLM-agent security into failure modes that neither line of work captures on its own. To address this gap, we present

summary.core_problem: LLM驱动的数据分析型agent（连数据库、跑SQL/工具、编排多步流程）出现新的安全失效模式，传统DB安全或通用LLM-agent安全都覆盖不全。
summary.importance: 偏系统安全与威胁建模：给出分层漏洞框架与攻击分类，并用“基于真实schema的payload生成”做系统化评估；对做tool-use/agent的研究员是直接可用的failure mode清单，也能反向约束训练信号与对齐目标。
summary.technical_approach: 提出三块：1) 分层漏洞框架（解释/执行/策略层）并总结8类风险；2) 按对手目标-战术-技术组织的攻击taxonomy（3目标、7战术、14技术）；3) 基于真实数据库schema的LLM驱动payload生成流水线，用于构造攻击与测试用例并评估数据agent。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体被测系统/模型、成功率、覆盖范围等量化结果；但明确在真实数据库schema上做攻击生成与评估（需看正文的attack success rate与防护对比）。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM-driven data agents (DB access + executable tools + multi-step workflows) introduce security failure modes not fully captured by classic DB security or generic LLM-agent security.
summary_en.importance: Systematic security/threat-modeling contribution: a layered vulnerability framework plus an attack taxonomy, and an evaluation pipeline that generates payloads grounded in real DB schemas. Useful as a concrete failure-mode checklist for tool-use agents and as constraints for alignment/training signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three parts: (1) a layered vulnerability framework (interpretation/execution/policy) with eight risks; (2) an attack taxonomy by adversary goal/tactic/technique (3 goals, 7 tactics, 14 techniques); (3) an LLM-driven payload generation pipeline grounded in real database schemas to create attacks and evaluate data agents.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract omits specific systems/models and quantitative rates; it indicates evaluation with payloads grounded in real DB schemas—check the paper for attack success rates and mitigation comparisons.

recommendation.zh: 把“数据agent安全”拆成解释/执行/策略三层很实用；只看taxonomy表和schema-grounded payload生成流程，能直接补齐你对tool-use风险的盲区。
recommendation.en: The interpretation/execution/policy layering is a practical way to reason about data-agent security; read the taxonomy table and schema-grounded payload generation pipeline to plug tool-use blind spots.

paper.title: Exploring Agentic Tool-Calling Decisions via Uncertainty-Aligned Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents often make suboptimal tool-use decisions, including unsupported tool invocation and hallucinated direct responses, which may accumulate errors throughout multi-step interactions. Existing approaches mainly improve these behaviors through inference-time correction or coarse-grained reward signals based on decision outcomes and structured checklists, leaving the uncertainty characteristics of agent decisions underexplored. We observe that decision-oriented r

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 agent 在工具调用决策上的一个更细的问题：现有基于 RL 的 tool-calling 优化，往往只奖励“动作对不对”，却没有约束“模型对错误动作是否保持足够不确定”。结果是策略虽然在训练集上学会了更多正确动作，但也更容易对错误动作产生低不确定度，也就是过度自信的错判。对多轮 agent 来说，这类错判比普通文本幻觉更麻烦，因为一次错误的 Tool / Direct / Ask / Unable 决策会改写后续状态，导致错误沿轨迹传播。论文要解决的核心不是单纯提高工具调用准确率，而是在 policy optimization 里显式保留并强化‘正确动作低不确定、错误动作高不确定’的分离结构，让策略既更准，也更可校准。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关联不算强，它属于 post-training / agent policy optimization，但有两个点对基座研究员仍然有参考价值。第一，它把 uncertainty 从推理时诊断信号，前移成训练目标的一部分，这和语言模型校准、拒答、工具使用边界学习是同一类问题。第二，它揭示了一个常见但容易被忽略的现象：只按 outcome 或 correctness 做 RL，会压坏模型原有的置信结构，造成 overconfident errors。这一点不只发生在 agent tool use，推理 RL、拒答训练、甚至某些 preference optimization 里也可能出现。贡献量级上，这更像一个针对 agent 决策校准的训练 recipe，而不是新的通用 RL 范式；但问题抓得准，分析也比只报 benchmark 提升更有信息量。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 TRUST：Tool-calling decision Reward with Uncertainty-Separated post-Training。论文把 agent 每个决策点建模为四分类动作空间：Direct、Tool、Ask、Unable。状态由历史轨迹和可用工具集合组成，策略输出结构化响应。与已有做法只根据动作是否正确给奖励不同，TRUST 在 turn-level reward 里加入 uncertainty-aligned 项，把不确定度差距当成一个“排斥力”。

具体思路是：对当前状态，除了 ground-truth decision，还考虑负向或反事实决策；然后根据模型对这些候选动作的不确定度，构造一个 certainty margin。训练目标鼓励正确动作具有更低不确定度，同时让错误动作维持更高不确定度，而不是一并被 RL 推成高置信。这样做的意义在于，错误但低不确定的样本会收到更强惩罚，策略更新会被推离这些不可靠区域，探索信号也更健康。

从全文描述看，这里的 UQ 不是单独训练一个 uncertainty head，而是从策略分布中提取决策不确定度，再把它写进 reward。也就是说，它不是后处理校准，而是 reward shaping。相比 Ross et al.、Suri et al. 这类 decision-oriented RL，区别不在动作空间或环境建模，而在奖励函数显式编码了 calibration structure。

另一个设计点是把训练从单点决策扩展到多轮轨迹。作者没有给整条轨迹做重标注，而是只标关键 decision turns，用轻量标注把两层信号结合起来：trajectory-level reward 负责整体任务成功和工具执行质量，turn-level UQ-aligned reward 负责工具调用时机与动作适配性。这个分层设计比较务实，因为全轨迹精标成本高，而且很多 agent 失败确实集中在少数关键转折点。

从方法取舍上看，TRUST不是去改 inference-time verifier，也不是加一个外部 uncertainty model，而是尽量复用现有 RL post-training 流程，只改 reward 结构。这使它更像一个可插拔训练模块。代价则是效果依赖于不确定度估计是否稳定；如果 policy logits 本身噪声大，或者 sampled action space 太窄，certainty margin 的质量会受影响。
summary.experiments:
论文给出的关键现象很明确：以 Qwen3-4B-Thinking 为例，经过常规 decision-oriented RL 后，“Wrong Decision But Low Uncertainty”的比例从 34.50% 上升到 70.21%，说明 RL 确实在把一部分错误动作推向高置信区域。TRUST 的实验价值首先在于修复这个现象，而不只是刷分。

结果上，turn-level tool-calling decision 优化中，TRUST 在 When2Call 上带来超过 11% 的准确率提升。再和 trajectory-level tool-calling post-training 结合后，在更复杂的多轮 benchmark 上也有稳定增益：BFCL-V4 提升 6.33%，ToolSandbox 提升 7.07%。作者特别强调增益集中在 decision-intensive 场景，例如 BFCL-V4 的 Multi-Turn、Irrelevance 子集，以及 ToolSandbox 中多用户轮次、干扰工具较多的设置，这和方法目标是对齐的。

从全文脉络推测，实验应当包含三类证据：一是总体任务成功率或 decision accuracy；二是 uncertainty separation / calibration 相关统计；三是多轮轨迹上的累积收益。真正值得看的不是平均分本身，而是错误类型分解：unsupported tool invocation、hallucinated direct response 是否都下降，以及这些下降是否伴随更好的 uncertainty gap。

如果精读时要留意数字，重点看：基座模型规模是否只在 4B 左右，还是还有更大模型；turn-level 与 trajectory-level reward 各自贡献多少；只加 UQ reward、不加轨迹奖励时在复杂环境是否仍然有效；以及是否报告了 calibration 指标如 ECE、AUROC 或 uncertainty histogram。摘要里没有全部展开，这部分需要从正文表格和附录确认。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读偏精读之间。先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，核心价值就在作者抓到的训练病灶：RL 提高正确率的同时破坏 uncertainty separation。这个观察如果成立，整篇就值得读。

然后看方法部分里 reward 定义，重点弄清三件事：第一，不确定度具体怎么估；第二，certainty margin 如何和 correctness 组合；第三，负向/反事实动作是如何构造的。这里决定了方法是否真能泛化到别的 agent setting。

实验部分建议优先看三类图表：
1. 常规 RL 与 TRUST 在 uncertainty 分布上的对比图；
2. When2Call、BFCL-V4、ToolSandbox 的主结果表；
3. 多轮和干扰场景的分项结果。
如果时间有限，30-40 分钟可以抓住主线。若要深挖，建议继续看消融：去掉 UQ 项、只做 turn-level、只做 trajectory-level、不同 UQ 估计方式的差异。这决定它到底是“reward 设计有效”，还是“多加监督就有效”。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode in tool-using agents: RL that optimizes only decision correctness often improves action accuracy while damaging the uncertainty structure behind those decisions. As a result, the policy becomes more overconfident on wrong actions, such as unsupported tool calls or unjustified direct answers. In multi-turn agents, this is especially costly because a wrong decision changes the future state and propagates errors through the trajectory. The core problem is therefore not just better tool-call accuracy, but preserving and strengthening the separation between low-uncertainty correct actions and high-uncertainty incorrect ones during policy optimization.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense; it is a post-training / agent RL paper. Still, it carries a useful lesson for foundation-model research. It shows that uncertainty should not be treated only as an inference-time diagnostic. It can be built into the training objective itself. More importantly, it documents a broader pathology: outcome-driven RL can distort confidence calibration and create overconfident errors. That issue is relevant beyond tool use, including reasoning RL, abstention training, and preference optimization. The contribution is best viewed as a targeted training recipe for calibrated agent decisions rather than a new general RL paradigm, but the diagnosis is sharper than a typical benchmark-only paper.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is TRUST: Tool-calling decision Reward with Uncertainty-Separated post-Training. Each decision point is modeled as a four-way action choice: Direct, Tool, Ask, or Unable. The state consists of the interaction history and the available tool set, and the policy outputs a structured response. The key change is in the reward. Instead of rewarding only whether the chosen action is correct, TRUST adds an uncertainty-aligned term that acts like a repulsive force against unreliable decisions.

The idea is to consider not only the ground-truth action for the current state, but also negative or counterfactual decisions. From the model’s uncertainty over these alternatives, the method constructs a certainty margin. Training encourages lower uncertainty on the correct decision while maintaining relatively higher uncertainty on incorrect ones. This matters because standard RL tends to increase confidence on rewarded samples without preserving the geometry of confidence across correct and incorrect actions. TRUST explicitly penalizes wrong-but-low-uncertainty cases, which should improve both calibration and exploration.

From the full-text description, uncertainty is extracted from the policy itself rather than from a separate uncertainty head. So this is reward shaping with uncertainty-aware signals, not post-hoc calibration. Relative to prior decision-oriented RL approaches, the novelty is not in the action space or environment, but in encoding calibration structure directly into the reward.

A second design choice is extending the setup from isolated decisions to multi-turn trajectories. Instead of fully relabeling every step, the authors annotate lightweight key decision turns. Training then combines two levels of supervision: trajectory-level rewards for overall task success and tool execution quality, and turn-level UQ-aligned rewards for whether tool use is timely and appropriate. This is a practical compromise, since many agent failures are concentrated at a few critical turns and full trajectory annotation is expensive.

The method is attractive because it can likely plug into existing RL post-training pipelines with minimal architectural changes. The main caveat is that its benefit depends on the quality of uncertainty estimation. If policy uncertainty is noisy or poorly identified, the certainty margin may become unstable.
summary_en.experiments:
The most informative empirical result is the failure analysis that motivates the paper. On Qwen3-4B-Thinking, standard decision-oriented RL increases the fraction of “wrong decision but low uncertainty” cases from 34.50% to 70.21%. That is a strong sign that RL can indeed collapse uncertainty separation while improving reward.

On benchmark performance, TRUST improves turn-level tool-calling accuracy by more than 11% on When2Call. When combined with trajectory-level tool-calling post-training, it also improves more complex multi-turn benchmarks: +6.33% on BFCL-V4 and +7.07% on ToolSandbox. The gains are reported to be larger in decision-heavy settings, including Multi-Turn and Irrelevance subsets on BFCL-V4, and scenarios with multiple user turns or distracting tools in ToolSandbox. That pattern is consistent with the method’s intended effect.

The most important evidence to inspect in the full paper is not just average benchmark gains, but whether the uncertainty structure is actually repaired. Useful tables and plots should include: calibration or uncertainty-separation statistics before and after RL, breakdowns of unsupported tool calls versus hallucinated direct answers, and ablations separating turn-level UQ reward from trajectory-level reward. The abstract does not provide all those details, so the main text and appendix matter here.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and Figure 1. The paper stands or falls on one observation: standard RL improves correctness while collapsing uncertainty separation. If that analysis is convincing, the rest of the method becomes meaningful.

Then read the reward formulation carefully. Three details matter most: how uncertainty is computed, how the certainty margin is combined with correctness, and how negative or counterfactual actions are defined. Those choices determine whether the method can generalize beyond the specific benchmarks.

In the experiments, prioritize three pieces: 
1. plots comparing uncertainty distributions under standard RL versus TRUST;
2. the main results on When2Call, BFCL-V4, and ToolSandbox;
3. subset results for multi-turn and distraction-heavy scenarios.
A 30-40 minute read is enough to capture the main idea. For a deeper pass, inspect the ablations: removing the UQ term, using only turn-level reward, using only trajectory-level reward, and varying the uncertainty estimator. Those ablations tell you whether the gain comes from the uncertainty-aware design or simply from adding more supervision.

recommendation.zh: 指出了RL在Agent训练中容易导致过度自信（破坏不确定性分离）的坑，并用不确定性惩罚来修正Reward，关注RLHF/RLVR训练动态的研究员值得看其Reward设计。
recommendation.en: Points out the pitfall of RL causing overconfidence (disrupting uncertainty separation) in agent training, and uses uncertainty penalty to correct the Reward. Researchers focusing on RLHF/RLVR training dynamics should look at its Reward design.

paper.title: Are Large Language Models Suitable for Graph Computation? Progress and Prospects
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have been increasingly explored for graph computation, where tasks require reasoning over structured relationships and algorithmic operations. Yet, it remains unclear when LLMs can reliably support such computation and how they should be incorporated into graph-solving pipelines. Existing surveys at the intersection of LLMs and graphs primarily focus on graph learning, text-attributed graphs, or graph-language modeling. To bridge this gap, we provide a comprehensive

summary.core_problem: 综述 LLM 是否适合图计算任务，以及应当直接执行图算法，还是作为规划器调用外部工具完成图求解。
summary.importance: 贡献是综述和分类框架，而非新模型或新训练方法。它对预训练研究的价值主要在于整理 LLM 的结构化推理边界，可作为算法推理和 tool-use 研究的背景材料。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出角色式分类：LLM as executors，即直接根据图描述和指令求解；LLM as planners，即负责问题建模、步骤分解，并调用外部工具或 agent 执行。随后比较不同范式在简单图推理、复杂算法和工具集成中的优缺点。
summary.experiments: 这是综述论文，摘要未报告新的模型训练或大规模实验。主要内容是梳理现有 LLM 图计算方法、任务类型和系统管线，并总结可靠性边界。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of New South Wales、Shanghai Jiao Tong University、Edith Cowan University 和 Lyon 1 University 等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The survey asks whether LLMs are suitable for graph computation and when they should directly execute graph tasks versus plan and delegate execution to external tools.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a taxonomy and literature review rather than a new model or training method. For base-model researchers, it is mainly useful as background on the limits of structured and algorithmic reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes a role-based taxonomy with two paradigms: LLMs as executors, directly solving graph tasks from descriptions and instructions; and LLMs as planners, formulating problems, decomposing steps, and invoking external tools or agents for execution. It then compares strengths and limitations across these roles.
summary_en.experiments: As a survey, it does not report new large-scale training or controlled experiments in the abstract. It reviews existing methods, task settings, and graph-solving pipelines, with emphasis on reliability boundaries.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the University of New South Wales, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Edith Cowan University, Lyon 1 University, and related institutions.

recommendation.zh: 作为图算法推理文献索引可留存；对预训练没有直接动作项，不必细读方法表之外的内容。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a graph-algorithm reasoning index; it gives no direct pretraining action item, so the taxonomy tables are enough.

institutions: Antai College of Economics and Management
Antai College of Economics and Management, Shanghai Jiao Tong University

paper.title: SlimSearcher: Training Efficiency-Aware Web Agents via Adaptive Reward Gating
paper.abstract: Deep research agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in complex information-seeking tasks, yet this power comes at a steep computational cost. Driven by accuracy-focused training paradigms, current models adopt brute-force strategies characterized by blind tool dependency and performative reasoning-generating long, redundant trajectories that are far from necessary for resolving these tasks, leading to wasteful tool calls and excessive token consumption. To overcome this efficiency tra

summary.core_problem: 解决 web research agent 在追求准确率时形成冗长轨迹、过度调用工具、token 成本过高的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 agent 训练效率问题，不是预训练论文；但它涉及 SFT/RL 中如何把“成本”显式写进训练信号，对 post-train 目标设计有一点参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SlimSearcher。在 SFT 阶段用 Pareto-efficient filtration，从成功轨迹中筛出同时兼顾成功率与经济性的样本；在 RL 阶段用 Adaptive Reward Gating，根据任务难度与轨迹质量动态调节奖励，抑制无效工具调用和表演式长推理。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调在准确率与计算成本之间推进 Pareto frontier，但未给出具体基座模型、训练规模、工具环境、成本下降比例和与标准 RL/SFT 的定量差距。更像 agent recipe 调整，而非通用训练规律。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the tendency of web research agents to produce long trajectories, overuse tools, and consume excessive tokens under accuracy-only training objectives.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-training efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is mildly relevant because it makes cost an explicit training signal in SFT/RL, which may inform post-training objective design.
summary_en.technical_approach: SlimSearcher uses Pareto-efficient filtration in SFT to keep trajectories that are both successful and economical, then applies Adaptive Reward Gating in RL to dynamically shape rewards based on task difficulty and trajectory quality, discouraging wasteful tool use and performative reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims a better accuracy-cost Pareto frontier, but does not provide concrete base models, training scale, environments, cost reduction numbers, or clean comparisons to standard SFT/RL. It reads more like an agent recipe tweak than a general training law.

recommendation.zh: 只在你关心 agent RL 成本约束时有用；看奖励设计即可，别把它误当成对长 CoT 本身的普适结论。
recommendation.en: Only useful if you care about cost-aware agent RL; read the reward design, but do not overgeneralize it into a claim about long CoT in general.

paper.title: Evaluating Agentic Configuration Repair for Computer Networks
paper.abstract: Misconfigurations in computer networks remain a major source of critical Internet outages. Research is turning to Large Language Models (LLMs) to automate the complex, error-prone task of network configuration. However, even state-of-the-art models fail to resolve misconfigurations in large-scale, complex scenarios and often introduce new errors. In this work, we benchmark open- and closed-source LLMs augmented with formal network verification and context retrieval tools. We demonstrate that age

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM 在计算机网络配置修复任务中的 agentic repair 能力，以及工具增强是否真的提升成功率与安全性。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是面向网络配置修复的评测与比较：把 formal verification、检索和 agentic loop 纳入统一评估。它不是通用 agent 范式突破，但对“工具+验证器”能否稳定改进 agent 行为提供了较干净的任务证据。
summary.technical_approach: 比较开源和闭源 LLM 在基础单轮修复与 agentic 架构下的表现，并加入形式化网络验证与上下文检索工具，让模型能迭代提出、检查、修正配置。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告 agentic 架构相对 base LLM 在修复有效性上平均提升 12%，安全性上平均提升 17%。任务是大规模复杂网络误配置修复，但未在摘要中给出模型名单、样本规模和 benchmark 细节。

summary_en.core_problem: It evaluates whether agentic LLM setups, augmented with tools, actually improve computer-network configuration repair in both efficacy and safety.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation setup for network configuration repair that integrates formal verification, retrieval, and agentic loops. It is not a general agent paradigm shift, but it offers relatively clean evidence on when tools plus verifiers help.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper compares open- and closed-source LLMs in base repair mode versus agentic architectures, adding formal network verification and context retrieval so models can iteratively propose, validate, and revise repairs.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports average gains of 12% in repair efficacy and 17% in safety for agentic architectures over base LLMs. The task involves large-scale complex network misconfigurations, though model names, dataset size, and benchmark details are not given in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文，但“验证器把 agent 拉回可行域”这个结论够干净；看实验设计和 error taxonomy，别在具体网络场景上花太多时间。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the verifier-driven improvement signal is fairly clean; read the setup and error taxonomy, not the networking details.

paper.title: ToolChoiceConfusion: Causal Minimal Tool Filtering for Reliable LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model agents increasingly rely on external tools, but larger tool menus can reduce reliability and efficiency by increasing wrong-tool calls, premature actions, and token cost. Existing tool-selection methods often optimize semantic relevance, exposing tools whose names or descriptions match the user request. We argue that relevance is insufficient: a tool may be related to the task while still being unnecessary or premature at the current step.   We propose Causal Minimal Tool Fi

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM agent 在工具菜单过大时容易误选工具、过早调用工具和上下文成本上升的问题。
summary.importance: 这是通用 tool-use agent 的方法改进，贡献点在于把工具选择从“语义相关性”改成“当前步骤下的因果充分性”。对基座预训练没有直接作用，但对后训练 agent 设计有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出训练免费方法 CMTF。它为工具定义轻量级 precondition-effect contracts，根据当前状态和目标只暴露最小的下一步工具前沿，而不是把所有语义相关工具都交给模型选择。
summary.experiments: 在多步工具使用任务上，对比全工具暴露、关键词检索、state-aware filtering 和因果路径消融，评估任务成功率、误工具调用、过早动作、工具暴露数量和 token 成本。摘要未给出具体 benchmark 名称和数值。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the drop in reliability and efficiency when LLM agents face large tool menus, leading to wrong tool calls, premature actions, and higher token cost.
summary_en.importance: This is a general tool-use agent method that reframes tool selection from semantic relevance to causal sufficiency at the current step. It is not directly about pretraining, but it may inform post-training agent design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes a training-free method, CMTF, which uses lightweight precondition-effect contracts for tools and exposes only the minimal next-step tool frontier needed to advance toward the goal.
summary_en.experiments: It evaluates on multi-step tool-use tasks against all-tools exposure, keyword retrieval, state-aware filtering, and causal-path ablations, measuring success rate, wrong-tool calls, premature actions, tool exposure, and token cost. The abstract does not provide benchmark names or exact numbers.

recommendation.zh: 想做 tool-use agent 可以看，但更像 prompt-time control 而不是新学习范式；先看 contracts 定义和 ablation，若没有强 benchmark 就当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Worth a look if you work on tool-use agents, but this is prompt-time control rather than a new learning paradigm; check the contract design and ablations first.

paper.title: Beyond Vector Similarity: A Structural Analysis of Graph-Augmented Retrieval for Industrial Knowledge Graphs
paper.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) fails systematically on queries requiring structural reasoning over interconnected entities. We compare eight retrieval architectures for aerospace supply chain intelligence, progressing from text retrieval through graph traversal to graph computation. Using a 46-node knowledge graph with 64 typed edges, we evaluate 23 queries across 10 intent categories and demonstrate that five query classes are structurally unreachable for vector retrieval. Our central fin

summary.core_problem: RAG系统在需要对互联实体进行结构推理的查询上系统性失效，文本向量检索无法处理五类需要图结构推理的查询。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出operator vocabulary thesis，认为LLM图推理的瓶颈不是模型智能而是可用的计算算子工具；在航空供应链知识图谱场景下验证了图遍历原语+图计算工具的分层架构。
summary.technical_approach: 设计了包含9种类型化遍历原语的LLM查询规划器，以及额外6种图计算工具的分层架构；LLM可根据查询类别选择性调用不同工具层级。
summary.experiments: 在46节点、64条类型化边的航空供应链知识图谱上评测23条查询（10类意图）；LLM查询规划器F1=0.632对比定制handler的0.472；实体级F1系统性低估图推理性能。
summary.authors_note: 作者信息有限，为单作者Grama Chethan，无法确认机构背景。

summary_en.core_problem: RAG systems fail systematically on queries requiring structural reasoning over interconnected entities; vector retrieval is structurally unreachable for five query classes.
summary_en.importance: Methodological contribution: proposes the operator vocabulary thesis — the barrier to LLM-based graph reasoning is not model intelligence but available computational operators as tools; validates a layered architecture of traversal primitives + graph computation tools on an aerospace supply chain KG.
summary_en.technical_approach: Designs an LLM Query Planner with 9 typed traversal primitives, plus an additional 6 graph computation tools forming a layered architecture; the LLM selectively adopts tools for exactly the query categories where traversal fails.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates 23 queries across 10 intent categories on a 46-node KG with 64 typed edges; LLM Query Planner achieves F1=0.632 vs. 0.472 for bespoke handlers; identifies that entity-level F1 systematically underscores graph reasoning performance.
summary_en.authors_note: Single-author paper by Grama Chethan; institutional affiliation not confirmed.

recommendation.zh: Operator vocabulary thesis是有价值的框架性观察，但实验在极小KG上进行，对LLM基座研究启示有限，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: The operator vocabulary thesis is a useful framing, but experiments are on a tiny 46-node KG; limited direct insight for LLM base research — read abstract only.

paper.title: TAPO: Tool-Aware Policy Optimization via Credit Transfer for Multimodal Search Agents
paper.abstract: We identify and formally characterize credit misassignment as a systematic failure mode of GRPO in tool-augmented multimodal search agents: its uniform broadcast of trajectory-level advantages to all tokens causes valuable tool-use steps in failing trajectories to be penalized no differently from valueless ones. We further empirically quantify the scale of this phenomenon. Over half of failing trajectories and failing tool-use actions exhibit correctable credit misassignment, demonstrating that

summary.core_problem: GRPO在工具增强型多模态搜索Agent训练中存在系统性信用错配：它将轨迹级优势均匀广播到所有token，导致失败轨迹中正确的工具调用步骤与无价值步骤受到同等惩罚。
summary.importance: 对RL训练工具有增强型模型（尤其是搜索Agent）的信用分配问题提出了新视角。对预训练研究者的启示是：RL阶段的优化缺陷（如GRPO的均匀信用广播）可能系统性地浪费有价值的训练信号，且这种浪费存在可被利用的结构规律。
summary.technical_approach: 识别出信息获取工具的参数确定性性质：相似的调用参数对应等价的信息获取行为。TAPO利用这一性质，从当前批次的成功轨迹中构建反事实参考库，用参数相似度和覆盖率的乘积作为置信度分数来门控信用转移，并施加保守截断确保失败步骤不会被全局鼓励。无需额外模型、标注或采样，可直接替换任何基于组的RL算法中的优势分配步骤。
summary.experiments: 在中等阈值(θ≈0.5)下，超过一半的失败轨迹和失败工具使用动作存在可纠正的信用错配。参数相似度与参考覆盖率单调相关。TAPO在多个多模态搜索benchmark和三种RL算法上一致提升性能，计算开销可忽略不计。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看引言部分的形式化分析（将GRPO偏差分解为项I和项II）和方法部分的信用转移门控机制。实验部分关于'正确工具调用出现在失败轨迹中'的统计最有启发。预计阅读时间25分钟。
summary.authors_note: 机构信息未在提供的文本中明确给出。

summary_en.core_problem: GRPO suffers from systematic credit misassignment in training tool-augmented multimodal search agents: its uniform broadcast of trajectory-level advantages to all tokens causes correct tool-use steps in failing trajectories to be penalized identically to valueless steps.
summary_en.importance: Offers a new perspective on credit assignment in RL training of tool-augmented models, especially search agents. For pretraining researchers, the key takeaway is that optimization flaws in the RL phase (such as GRPO's uniform credit broadcast) can systematically waste valuable training signal, and this waste exhibits exploitable structural regularities.
summary_en.technical_approach: Identifies the parameter-determinism property of information-acquisition tools: similar call parameters correspond to equivalent information-acquisition actions. TAPO exploits this by constructing a counterfactual reference library from successful trajectories in the current batch, using a confidence score (parameter similarity × coverage) to gate credit transfer, and applying a conservative clamp ensuring no failing step is globally encouraged. Requires no additional models, annotation, or sampling, and integrates as a drop-in replacement for the advantage assignment step in any group-based RL algorithm.
summary_en.experiments: At moderate threshold (θ≈0.5), over half of failing trajectories and failing tool-use actions exhibit correctable credit misassignment. Parameter similarity is monotonically correlated with reference coverage. TAPO consistently improves performance across multiple multimodal search benchmarks and three RL algorithms with negligible computational overhead.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the formal analysis in the Introduction (decomposing GRPO bias into terms I and II) and the credit transfer gating mechanism in the Method section. The statistics on correct tool calls appearing in failing trajectories are most illuminating. Estimated reading time: 25 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution not explicitly stated in the provided text.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该看的是它把 GRPO 在 tool-use 上的 credit 病灶讲清了；先读误分配定量分析和 counterfactual credit transfer，可能直接影响你设计 RL 信号。
recommendation.en: Read this for its diagnosis of GRPO's credit pathology in tool use, not for the agent wrapper; the quantification and counterfactual credit transfer could directly change how you design RL signals.

paper.title: When Tools Fail: Benchmarking Dynamic Replanning and Anomaly Recovery in LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Existing benchmarks evaluate Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) in LLMs on idealized ''happy paths'', largely overlooking real-world tool failures. We introduce ToolMaze, a benchmark for dynamic path discovery and error recovery in TIR agents. To separate systematic replanning from blind trial-and-error, ToolMaze adopts a two-dimensional design: DAG-based topological complexity and a $2 \times 2$ taxonomy of tool perturbations (explicit/implicit, transient/permanent). Evaluations show that perturba

summary.core_problem: 现有工具集成推理（TIR）的Agent基准全部基于无错误的“理想路径”设计，无法衡量Agent在工具故障场景下的动态重规划和异常恢复能力；且现有故障注入方案随机、无系统的任务复杂度维度划分，无法区分有效重规划和盲目试错行为。
summary.importance: 为LLM Agent的鲁棒性评测提供了结构化的测试框架，对预训练阶段植入工具容错能力、对齐阶段训练重规划策略都有标准化的评测参照。
summary.technical_approach: 提出双维度评测框架ToolMaze：第一维度是基于有向无环图（DAG）的拓扑复杂度（分4级），预先枚举所有合法的工具调用恢复路径；第二维度是2×2的扰动分类（显式/隐式、瞬时/永久），在预设的工具节点注入故障而非随机注入；新增扰动恢复率（PRR）、恢复成本（RC）两个指标，替代单一的任务成功率（TSR）来区分有效重规划和无效试错；配套270个覆盖6个领域的真实工具语料，支持可扩展的任务合成。
summary.experiments: 测试多款主流LLM Agent，所有扰动场景下性能均出现下降；其中隐式语义故障场景下扰动恢复率（PRR）下降约37%，原因是Agent对错误输出的过度信任；复杂DAG拓扑会让Agent陷入无效试错循环，任务成功率和实际重规划能力出现明显脱钩。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读第1章引言明确现有评测的缺陷，第2章快速了解双维度评测设计和新增指标的定义，实验部分直接查看核心结论表格即可，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing benchmarks for Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) agents are all designed around error-free "happy paths", and cannot measure agents' dynamic replanning and anomaly recovery capabilities under tool failure scenarios. Existing fault injection schemes are random and lack systematic task complexity stratification, making it impossible to distinguish effective replanning from blind trial and error.
summary_en.importance: ToolMaze provides a structured testing framework for LLM agent robustness evaluation, offering standardized evaluation references for implanting tool fault tolerance during pretraining and training replanning strategies during alignment stages.
summary_en.technical_approach: ToolMaze adopts a two-dimensional evaluation framework: the first dimension is DAG-based topological complexity (4 levels), with all valid tool call recovery paths pre-enumerated; the second dimension is a 2×2 perturbation taxonomy (explicit/implicit, transient/permanent), with faults injected at pre-specified tool nodes instead of random locations. It introduces two new metrics, Perturbation Recovery Rate (PRR) and Recovery Cost (RC), to replace the single Task Success Rate (TSR) and distinguish effective replanning from invalid trial and error. It is paired with a corpus of 270 real tools covering 6 domains, supporting scalable task synthesis.
summary_en.experiments: Tests on multiple mainstream LLM agents show performance declines across all perturbation scenarios. The Perturbation Recovery Rate (PRR) drops by approximately 37% under implicit semantic failure scenarios, caused by agents' over-trust in corrupted outputs. Complex DAG topologies trap agents in futile trial-and-error loops, leading to a clear decoupling between task success rate and actual replanning capability.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 1 to understand the limitations of existing benchmarks, quickly review Section 2 to grasp the two-dimensional evaluation design and definition of new metrics, and directly read core conclusion tables in the experiment section. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不教你怎么训模型，但会改你对“scale 自然解决 agent 可靠性”的预期；先看 PRR 定义和 3.66× slower 那个结论。
recommendation.en: It will not teach you how to train models, but it should update your prior that scale alone fixes agent reliability; start with the PRR definition and the 3.66× slower scaling result.

paper.title: Beyond Ideal Instruction: A Comprehensive Framework for Evaluating LLMs in Realistic Interactions
paper.abstract: Despite great advances in tool-use capabilities of large language models (LLMs), existing evaluation benchmarks struggle to fully align with real-world scenarios. Such benchmarks mostly rely on simulated idealized user assumptions and lacks experience-oriented evaluation. These limitations fail to account for the ambiguity, uncooperative behaviors, and shifting intentions characteristic of real-world users. To fill this gap, we propose RUT-Bench, a dedicated benchmark designed to assess LLMs und

summary.core_problem: 现有 tool-use/agent benchmark 多建立在“理想用户”与静态交互假设上，难以覆盖真实部署中常见的含糊指令、不配合、参数编造、目标中途切换等行为，从而导致评测结果与真实用户体验脱节。论文要解决的是：如何构建一个可执行、可多轮交互、能系统覆盖非理想用户行为的工具调用评测框架，并给出不仅看任务成功率、也能反映可靠性与体验的诊断指标。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献（不涉及数据配比、tokenizer、scaling 或训练 recipe），但对“pretrain→posttrain→agent”闭环有现实价值：它把工具调用能力的失败模式从静态正确率，推进到更接近线上分布的交互鲁棒性与体验维度。对做 agentic 数据合成、tool-use SFT/RL、以及把评测信号反哺训练的人，RUT-Bench 提供了更难被投机的目标分布与更细的错误分型。论文给出的关键结论是：在非理想用户设定下，主流模型成功率显著下滑，说明当前训练信号（多为理想指令/干净轨迹）与真实交互存在系统性分布差。
summary.technical_approach:
核心设计分三块：
1) 非理想用户行为 taxonomy：从语言行为学/会话准则相关工作出发，结合真实对话日志归纳为 7 类：Ideal Rational、Underspecification（信息不足/含糊）、Information Overload（信息过载）、Fabricated Parameters（编造参数/不一致事实）、Goal Switching（目标切换）、Contradictory Constraints（矛盾约束）、Impatience and Hostility（不耐烦/敌对）。并用 WildChat 的真实交互样本做统计验证（用 GPT-5.4 标注 1000 段英文对话）。
2) 可执行的 tool-use 环境与任务：RUT-Bench 不是纯文本问答，而是包含 59 个可执行、带状态的工具环境，支持单轮与多轮对话，在同一任务骨架上注入不同用户行为扰动，使评测覆盖“理想→非理想”的分布迁移。
3) 多维度评测：以 overall task success rate 为主指标，同时增加两类诊断指标，用于刻画 response reliability 与 user experience（论文在引言中明确提出，但你给的全文片段未包含指标的精确定义公式与计算细节；精读时需要回到方法/评测章节确认其可复现性与是否会被策略性优化）。
方法取舍上，它选择“高保真用户模拟器 + 可执行环境”而不是“静态题库 + 参考答案”，目的是让模型必须在不确定性下做信息收集与策略调整，而不是匹配固定模式。
summary.experiments:
规模与设置：RUT-Bench 含 1638 个高质量测试样本，覆盖 59 个可执行工具环境，包含单轮/多轮与理想/非理想用户行为。
关键结果（论文在你提供的正文中给出的数字有限）：
- 在 19 个开源与闭源主流 LLM 上评测，所有模型 overall success rate 均低于 40%。
- 从理想用户场景切换到非理想场景时，性能“显著/剧烈”下降（原文用 drastically），表明鲁棒性不足。
- 来自 WildChat 的统计：在抽样的 1000 段英文对话中，22.6% 落入非理想类别；最常见的是 underspecification，其次是 information overload 与 fabricated parameters；goal switching 与 impatience/hostility 更偏后期多轮出现。
消融与更细粒度对比（例如：不同非理想类型分别造成的成功率下降幅度、不同模型家族的差异、以及诊断指标与成功率的相关性）在你提供的片段中未出现；如果论文正文有这些表格，它们会是判断 benchmark“是否真的提供新信息”的关键。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读优先级：中等（偏 eval/agent 方向），预计 30–45 分钟。
建议阅读路径：
- 先看 taxonomy 定义与 Figure 1：7 类非理想行为的边界是否清晰、是否可操作化生成。
- 看 WildChat 统计与标注流程（Appendix E）：尤其是用 GPT-5.4 自动标注的可靠性、提示词、以及是否有人类复核；这决定 taxonomy 与分布结论的可信度。
- 精看 RUT-Bench 构建流程（Figure 2 + Section 4）：任务生成、环境可执行性、以及多轮用户模拟器如何驱动状态变化。
- 精看评测指标定义：两类诊断指标如何计算、是否与成功率独立提供信息、是否容易被“迎合指标”的策略钻空子。
- 最后看 19 模型对比表：重点不是排名，而是失败模式是否与 taxonomy 对齐、以及理想→非理想的 drop 是否一致。

summary_en.core_problem: Tool-use/agent benchmarks largely assume ideal, cooperative users and static interactions, which misses common real deployment behaviors such as underspecified requests, uncooperative turns, fabricated parameters, and goal switching. The paper targets a concrete gap: building an executable, multi-turn benchmark that systematically injects realistic non-ideal user behaviors and evaluates not only task success but also reliability and user experience under distribution shift.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper (no scaling/data/tokenizer/optimizer contributions), but it matters for the pretrain→post-train→agent loop because it sharpens the target distribution for tool-use robustness. If you do tool-use SFT/RL, trajectory synthesis, or want evaluation signals that better reflect real user interactions, RUT-Bench provides a harder and more behaviorally grounded testbed. The headline finding—mainstream models staying below 40% success and dropping sharply from ideal to non-ideal settings—suggests current training data (often clean, ideal instructions) is misaligned with real interaction dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Three main components:
1) A taxonomy of non-ideal user behaviors (7 classes): Ideal Rational, Underspecification, Information Overload, Fabricated Parameters, Goal Switching, Contradictory Constraints, and Impatience/Hostility. The taxonomy is motivated by pragmatics/speech-act style prior work and empirically checked using real chat logs.
2) An executable benchmark: 1,638 test cases across 59 stateful, runnable tool-use environments, supporting both single-turn and multi-turn dialogues. The key design choice is to evaluate agents in interactive environments with controllable user simulators rather than static prompt-answer pairs.
3) Multi-dimensional evaluation: overall task success rate plus two diagnostic metrics intended to capture response reliability and user experience. (The provided excerpt does not include the exact metric definitions; verifying their computation and robustness is essential when reading the full paper.)
summary_en.experiments:
Scale: 1,638 curated samples, 59 executable environments, ideal and non-ideal user simulations, single- and multi-turn.
Main reported numbers from the excerpt:
- Evaluated 19 popular open and proprietary LLMs; all achieve <40% overall success on RUT-Bench.
- Performance degrades drastically when moving from ideal-user scenarios to realistic non-ideal settings.
- WildChat analysis: 22.6% of 1,000 sampled English dialogues fall into non-ideal categories; underspecification is most frequent, followed by information overload and fabricated parameters; goal switching and impatience/hostility appear more in later turns.
