Reported findings are that adaptive tool invocation reduces redundant overhead and avoids harmful tool calls in some cases, improving multimodal reasoning quality and efficiency over always-using-tools setups.

recommendation.zh: 点子不新到改写 prior，但“工具不是免费午餐”这个训练信号设计值得记一笔；只看 reward 设计和 ablation，别在任务细节上花时间。
recommendation.en: It does not really change priors, but the ‘tools are not always a free lunch’ framing is worth noting; read the reward design and ablations, not the task-specific details.

paper.title: Mem-π: Adaptive Memory through Learning When and What to Generate
paper.abstract: We present Mem-π, a framework for adaptive memory in large language model (LLM) agents, where useful guidance is generated on demand rather than retrieved from external memory stores. Existing memory-augmented agents typically rely on similarity-based retrieval from episodic memory banks or skill libraries, returning static entries that often misalign with the current context. In contrast, Mem-π uses a dedicated language or vision-language model with its own parameters, separate from the downstr

summary.core_problem: 解决长程 LLM agent 中“记忆该何时用、用什么形式用”的问题：相比从外部记忆库检索静态片段，如何按当前上下文按需生成更贴合任务的指导信息。
summary.importance: 这是一个 agent memory 设计问题，不是基座预训练本身，但它触及一个对 pretrain 有外溢价值的点：把“记忆”从检索对象改成可学习的条件生成器，并显式学习 abstain。贡献类型主要是方法设计加 RL 训练目标，而不是新的基座训练范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Mem-π：在下游 agent 之外单独放一个语言模型或视觉语言模型作为 memory generator。该模型基于当前 agent 上下文，联合决定何时生成指导、以及生成什么指导。训练上采用 decision-content decoupled 的 RL 目标，把“是否该说”和“说什么”拆开优化，使模型可以在无益时选择不生成，在有益时输出简洁指导。核心新意是把 memory 从 retrieval item 变成 context-conditional generated guidance，并把 abstention 作为一等决策变量。
summary.experiments: 论文在 web navigation、terminal tool use、text-based embodied interaction 等多类 agent benchmark 上评测，结论是相较于基于 episodic memory bank 或 skill library 的检索式 memory，Mem-π 在复杂任务上更稳，且能减少与当前上下文不匹配的静态记忆调用。摘要未给出模型规模、训练 token 或具体提升幅度，因此更适合作为方法信号而非定量结论来源。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 ServiceNow AI Research、Mila、Université de Montréal、McGill 等。Christopher Pal 是 Mila/ServiceNow 体系内较知名研究者，长期参与大模型与多模态方向。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles a memory-design problem for long-horizon LLM agents: instead of retrieving static entries from external memory stores, how can an agent generate context-specific guidance only when it is actually useful?
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it touches a question that matters to foundation-model researchers: whether memory should be modeled as retrieval over stored traces or as a learned conditional generator with abstention. The contribution is mainly a method plus an RL objective, not a new base-model training paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: Mem-π introduces a separate language or vision-language model, distinct from the downstream agent, to act as an adaptive memory module. Conditioned on the current agent context, it jointly decides when to emit guidance and what guidance to emit. Training uses a decision-content decoupled RL objective so the model can abstain when guidance would not help and otherwise produce concise, task-relevant hints. The key move is to replace retrieved memory snippets with generated, context-conditioned guidance.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on agentic benchmarks spanning web navigation, terminal-based tool use, and text-based embodied interaction. The reported takeaway is that Mem-π outperforms retrieval-based episodic memory or skill-library baselines by reducing context mismatch and improving task performance on complex settings. The abstract does not provide model sizes, training scale, or exact gains, so this is more useful as a design signal than as a clean quantitative reference.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from ServiceNow AI Research, Mila, Université de Montréal, and McGill. Christopher Pal is a well-known researcher associated with the Mila/ServiceNow ecosystem and has a strong track record in large-model and multimodal research.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 本身帮助有限，但“生成式记忆+可 abstain”这个接口设计值得记一下；读方法图和 RL objective 就够，不必深挖 benchmark。
recommendation.en: Limited direct value for pretraining, but the generated-memory-with-abstention interface is worth noting; read the method figure and RL objective, not the benchmark details.

paper.title: Gemini for Science: AI experiments and tools for a new era of discovery
paper.abstract: A collection of science tools and experiments to expand the scale and precision of scientific exploration.

summary.core_problem: Gemini for Science 解决的是科学研究流程中的代理化问题：如何让通用模型在文献理解、假设生成、计算实验和专业数据库调用中承担更长链条的研究任务，而不是只回答单个问题。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的影响不在新的语言建模目标，而在训练与评测接口。科学任务需要长上下文阅读、可靠引用、代码生成与执行、工具调用、多代理辩论、实验设计和结果验证。这些能力很难只靠普通网页语料学到，通常需要后训练、工具环境、可验证奖励和领域数据库接入。Gemini for Science 给出了一种可观察的系统形态：通用 Gemini 能力作为底座，Co-Scientist、AlphaEvolve、ERA、NotebookLM 和 Science Skills 负责把科学工作流拆成可执行、可检查的环节。对基座团队的启发是，科学能力不应只用问答 benchmark 衡量，更应放到带工具、带文献证据、带计算验证的闭环任务中评估。
summary.technical_approach: 系统由几个原型工具组成。Hypothesis Generation 基于 Co-Scientist，流程是让研究者定义研究问题，然后通过多代理“idea tournament”生成、辩论和评估假设，并用可点击引用支撑关键主张。这里的重点不是单次生成，而是让候选假设经过竞争、批评和证据校验。Computational Discovery 基于 AlphaEvolve 和 ERA，定位为 agentic research engine，会并行生成和打分大量代码变体，用于探索新的建模或计算实验方案，例如太阳能预测和流行病学建模。Literature Insights 基于 NotebookLM，负责检索科学文献，把结果按用户自定义属性整理成表格，并在用户整理的语料范围内进行 grounded chat，同时生成报告、幻灯片、信息图、音频和视频概览。Science Skills 则把 30 多个生命科学数据库和工具接入 Google Antigravity，包括 UniProt、AlphaFold Database、AlphaGenome API 和 InterPro，用于结构生物信息学和基因组分析等多步骤工作流。和窄领域模型相比，这套方案更偏向“通用模型 + 工具 + 代理流程 + 验证”的组合。
summary.experiments: 博客没有给出统一 benchmark 数字，也没有公开消融结果、模型规模或训练数据。给出的验证信息主要来自部署和外部合作。ERA 和 Co-Scientist 的研究论文已在 Nature 发表，但博客未列出具体实验指标。企业和科研合作包括 BASF 用 AlphaEvolve 优化供应链，Klarna 用其改进机器学习模型，Daiichi Sankyo、Bayer Crop Science 和美国能源部 Genesis Mission 相关国家实验室使用 Co-Scientist。Science Skills 的早期测试中，Google 研究团队把一个通常需要数小时的复杂分析缩短到数分钟，并获得了关于 AK2 基因突变导致罕见遗传病潜在机制的新线索。另有超过 100 家机构参与验证，包括 Stanford、Imperial College London 和 The Crick Institute；还提到与 ICML、STOC、NeurIPS 开展代理化审稿和科学验证工具试点，包括 Paper Assistant Tool 和 ScholarPeer。
summary.reading_guide: 精读重点应放在任务分解和验证闭环。第一，看 Hypothesis Generation 的“multi-agent idea tournament”和引用校验设计，关注它如何降低 hallucination，并把开放式想法生成转成可审查流程。第二，看 Computational Discovery 中“生成并打分数千个代码变体”的描述，这接近可执行环境中的搜索与优化，可为 RL、程序合成和自动实验设计提供训练信号。第三，看 Science Skills 的数据库和工具接入方式，它说明高质量工具接口可能比把全部领域知识压进参数更有效。第四，看合作与验证段落，尤其是 Nature 论文、100 多家机构测试、会议审稿工具试点。需要注意，博客没有提供可复现实验数字；若要评估技术强度，应继续读 ERA、Co-Scientist、AlphaEvolve 及相关 Nature 论文。预计阅读博客 10 分钟，技术追踪需要转向关联论文和系统文档。
summary.authors_note: Google / Google DeepMind 发布。涉及 Co-Scientist、AlphaEvolve、ERA、NotebookLM、Google Antigravity、Science Skills 等团队。未提供具体作者名单。

summary_en.core_problem: Gemini for Science targets agentic scientific workflows: how a general model can support literature analysis, hypothesis generation, computational experimentation, and domain-tool use over a longer research loop instead of answering isolated questions.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to pretraining is indirect but concrete. Scientific agents require long-context reading, grounded citation, code generation and execution, tool use, multi-agent critique, experimental design, and result verification. These behaviors are hard to obtain from generic web-text pretraining alone. They usually need post-training, executable environments, verifiable rewards, and access to curated scientific databases. The system described here uses Gemini as the general model layer, with Co-Scientist, AlphaEvolve, ERA, NotebookLM, and Science Skills turning research workflows into structured and checkable steps. For foundation-model teams, the useful lesson is that scientific capability should not be measured only by static QA. It should be evaluated in tool-rich loops where claims are tied to evidence and computational results can be checked.
summary_en.technical_approach: The announcement describes several prototypes. Hypothesis Generation is built with Co-Scientist. A researcher defines a research challenge, then a multi-agent “idea tournament” generates, debates, and evaluates hypotheses, with claims supported by clickable citations. The important design choice is iterative critique and evidence checking, not one-shot ideation. Computational Discovery is built with AlphaEvolve and ERA. It is described as an agentic research engine that generates and scores thousands of code variations in parallel, allowing researchers to explore modeling approaches for areas such as solar forecasting and epidemiology. Literature Insights is built with NotebookLM. It searches scientific literature, organizes results into tables with user-defined searchable attributes, supports grounded chat over a curated corpus, and produces artifacts such as reports, slides, infographics, and audio or video overviews. Science Skills connects more than 30 life-science databases and tools in Google Antigravity, including UniProt, AlphaFold Database, AlphaGenome API, and InterPro, so that agents can perform structural bioinformatics and genomic workflows. The overall pattern is a general model combined with tools, agent procedures, and verification mechanisms rather than a collection of narrow standalone models.
summary_en.experiments: The blog does not provide a unified benchmark, ablations, model sizes, or training data details. The validation evidence is mostly deployment-oriented and points to external papers. It states that ERA and Co-Scientist papers have been published in Nature, but it does not report their metrics. Partner examples include BASF using AlphaEvolve for supply-chain optimization, Klarna using it to improve machine-learning models, and Daiichi Sankyo, Bayer Crop Science, and U.S. National Labs under the Department of Energy’s Genesis Mission using Co-Scientist. For Science Skills, an internal early test reportedly reduced a complex analysis from hours to minutes and produced new clues about possible mechanisms for a rare genetic disease caused by AK2 mutations. The announcement also mentions validation with more than 100 institutions, including Stanford University, Imperial College London, and The Crick Institute, plus pilots with ICML, STOC, and NeurIPS for agentic peer review and scientific validation tools such as Paper Assistant Tool and ScholarPeer.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on workflow decomposition and verification. The Hypothesis Generation section is useful for understanding how multi-agent debate and citation grounding can turn open-ended ideation into a reviewable process. The Computational Discovery section is relevant to executable search: generating and scoring many code variants can provide a training or evaluation signal for RL, program synthesis, and automated experiment design. The Science Skills section is important because it shows a practical alternative to forcing all domain knowledge into model parameters: expose high-quality databases and tools through structured agent interfaces. The collaboration and validation section should be read carefully, especially the references to Nature papers, institutional testing, and peer-review pilots. The blog itself can be read in about 10 minutes; technical assessment requires following the linked ERA, Co-Scientist, and AlphaEvolve materials.
summary_en.authors_note: Released by Google / Google DeepMind. The work refers to Co-Scientist, AlphaEvolve, ERA, NotebookLM, Google Antigravity, and Science Skills teams. Individual authors are not listed.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做通用 tool-use agent，可扫一眼产品形态；对 pretrain 几乎没有可执行信号。
recommendation.en: Only worth a quick look for product-form clues in tool-use agents; it offers almost no actionable signal for pretraining.

paper.title: Gemini 3.5: frontier intelligence with action
paper.abstract: Gemini 3.5 is built to help you execute complex, agentic workflows.

summary.core_problem: 这篇内容要解决的不是单点模型能力，而是一个更具体的问题：怎样把前沿基础模型做成可在真实环境里稳定执行长时程、多步骤、强工具依赖任务的 agent 核心模型，同时不牺牲延迟与成本。Google 给出的答案是 Gemini 3.5 系列，先发布 3.5 Flash，目标是把“高智能”和“可行动”放在同一模型里，让模型不仅会答题，还能规划、调用工具、并行组织子代理、处理长文档和多模态输入，并在企业与消费级产品里直接落地。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它把模型评价重心从传统静态 benchmark 明确推向 agentic workload，强调终局不是单轮问答，而是长时程执行、上下文保持、工具调用可靠性和多代理协作。第二，它说明小步快跑的高吞吐模型并不只是“便宜版旗舰”，而可以通过训练和系统协同，成为 agent 场景里的主力模型；这对预训练阶段的目标设计、数据配比和后训练接口都有直接启发。第三，它透露出一个重要趋势：模型能力不再只由参数规模定义，而是由模型本体、agent harness、子代理编排、以及安全与可解释性检查共同决定。对做 pretrain 的人来说，这意味着训练目标需要更早考虑 actionability，而不是把可执行性完全留给 post-train 或外部工具层。
summary.technical_approach: 公开信息没有给出训练 recipe、数据组成、架构改动或损失函数细节，因此不能把它当成一篇完整技术论文来解读。但从全文能看出几个明确设计方向。其一，3.5 Flash 延续 Flash 系列的低延迟定位，却把能力重点放在 coding、agentic execution 和 multimodal understanding，这通常意味着训练中不仅要保留通用语言建模能力，还要强化工具使用、代码编辑、长上下文检索与跨模态 grounding。其二，Google 反复强调与 Antigravity harness 的耦合，说明模型并非只做单代理对话，而是被设计成能在外部编排器下稳定承担 planner / builder / player / auditor 等不同角色，并支持并行子代理执行。这类能力通常依赖两部分：模型侧对角色切换、状态追踪、工具反馈整合的鲁棒性；系统侧对任务分解、上下文裁剪、失败恢复和监督执行的工程化支持。其三，文中提到“frontier safety framework”“更强的 cyber 与 CBRN safeguard”“用 interpretability tools 在回答前检查内部推理”，这说明安全训练不只是输出过滤，而可能包含更细粒度的中间表征监测或 reasoning trace 风险判别。其四，3.5 Flash 被描述为 4 倍于其他 frontier models 的输出速度，且成本低于一半，这暗示其推理栈、模型尺寸与 serving 优化是联合设计的；虽然不属于预训练细节，但会反过来约束模型架构和训练目标，例如更偏向高吞吐 dense 模型还是稀疏路由、是否为长序列 agent 任务优化 token efficiency 等。
summary.experiments: 可用的实验信息主要来自产品公告中的 benchmark 与案例。定量结果包括：Terminal-Bench 2.1 达到 76.2%，GDPval-AA 为 1656 Elo，MCP Atlas 为 83.6%，CharXiv Reasoning 为 84.2%。文中称其在这些 coding、agentic 和 multimodal benchmark 上超过 Gemini 3.1 Pro，并且输出 token/s 约为其他 frontier models 的 4 倍，成本常低于其一半。案例层面，Google 展示了多个长时程任务：自动重命名和分类非结构化资产；用两个 agent 综合 AlphaZero 论文并在 6 小时内写出可玩的游戏；将遗留代码库迁移到 Next.js；并行生成城市景观；builder-player 自改进循环开发游戏；生成交互式动画、硬件原型和 UX 方案。企业侧案例包括 Shopify 用并行子代理做复杂数据分析，Macquarie Bank 处理 100+ 页文档做 onboarding，Salesforce 在 Agentforce 中做多轮工具调用，Ramp 做复杂发票 OCR 与历史模式推理，Xero 自动处理 1099 相关多周流程，Databricks 做实时监控、诊断和修复建议。需要注意，这些结果大多是产品级展示，不包含严格对照实验、数据规模、训练 token 数、参数量、消融或置信区间，因此更适合用来判断方向，而不适合做精确方法归因。
summary.reading_guide: 精读时不要把重点放在宣传性措辞，而要抓三件事。第一，看 benchmark 选择。Terminal-Bench、GDPval-AA、MCP Atlas、CharXiv 共同指向的不是传统聊天能力，而是代码执行、agent 可靠性、多模态推理和长任务完成度，这反映了 Google 当前对模型能力的内部目标函数。第二，看 Antigravity 的角色。文中几乎所有高价值案例都依赖 harness 和 subagents，这说明单模型能力边界正在被“模型+编排器”重新定义；做预训练的人需要思考哪些能力应在 base model 内生，哪些交给系统层。第三，看安全段落。Google 明确提到在回答前用 interpretability tools 检查内部推理，这比常见的输出后过滤更值得留意，后续如果有技术报告，优先关注安全训练、内部表征监测和 refusal calibration。阅读时间大约 15 到 20 分钟；如果只想抓核心，先看 benchmark 段、Antigravity 案例段、以及安全段即可。真正值得深挖的不是单个分数，而是“高吞吐模型是否正在成为 agent 默认底座”这个判断。
summary.authors_note: 机构：Google DeepMind / Google。页面署名为 Gemini team 风格的官方博客，未给出明确个人作者名单。

summary_en.core_problem: The central problem here is not generic model quality, but how to turn a frontier foundation model into a practical engine for long-horizon, tool-using, multi-step agent workflows without paying the usual latency and cost penalty. Gemini 3.5, starting with 3.5 Flash, is presented as Google's answer: a model family designed to combine strong reasoning, coding, multimodal understanding, and reliable action execution in real product environments.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining researchers, the significance is less about a disclosed algorithm and more about a shift in what counts as core model capability. First, the target has clearly moved from static QA-style evaluation toward agentic execution: long-horizon completion, tool use, context retention, and multi-agent coordination. Second, Google is signaling that a fast, lower-latency model can be the primary agent model rather than a cheaper fallback, which has implications for training objectives, data mixture, and the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. Third, the announcement reinforces a broader trend: capability is increasingly defined by the joint system of model, orchestration harness, subagent decomposition, and safety checks, not by parameter count alone. That matters for base-model design because actionability can no longer be treated as a thin post-training layer.
summary_en.technical_approach: The post does not disclose architecture, optimizer, data recipe, or training objective, so it should not be read as a full technical paper. Still, several design signals are clear. First, 3.5 Flash keeps the Flash identity of low latency, but the capability emphasis is on coding, agentic execution, and multimodal understanding. That usually implies training pressure on tool-use robustness, code editing, long-context retrieval, and cross-modal grounding, not just generic next-token prediction. Second, the repeated coupling with the Antigravity harness suggests the model is meant to operate under external orchestration, taking on planner, builder, player, or auditor roles and supporting parallel subagents. In practice, that requires model-side robustness to role conditioning, state tracking, and tool-feedback integration, plus system-side support for decomposition, context management, recovery, and supervision. Third, the safety section is notable: Google mentions stronger cyber and CBRN safeguards and interpretability tools that inspect internal reasoning before response generation. That points to a safety stack that likely goes beyond output filtering into intermediate-state monitoring or risk detection over latent reasoning traces. Fourth, the claim of roughly 4x output speed versus other frontier models, at often less than half the cost, implies co-design between model architecture and serving stack. Even without details, that kind of deployment target feeds back into pretraining choices such as token efficiency, sequence handling, and whether the model is optimized for dense high-throughput inference in agent workloads.
summary_en.experiments: The available evidence is mostly benchmark reporting and product demonstrations rather than a controlled experimental section. Reported numbers include 76.2% on Terminal-Bench 2.1, 1656 Elo on GDPval-AA, 83.6% on MCP Atlas, and 84.2% on CharXiv Reasoning. Google states that 3.5 Flash outperforms Gemini 3.1 Pro on these coding, agentic, and multimodal benchmarks, while delivering about 4x the output tokens per second of other frontier models and often at less than half the cost. The showcased tasks are also informative: automatic renaming and categorization of unstructured assets, synthesizing the AlphaZero paper and building a playable game in six hours with two agents, migrating a legacy codebase to Next.js, generating city landscapes with parallel subagents, and running builder-player self-improvement loops for game development. Enterprise examples include Shopify for long-horizon data analysis, Macquarie Bank for reasoning over 100+ page onboarding documents, Salesforce Agentforce for multi-turn tool calling, Ramp for invoice OCR plus historical-pattern reasoning, Xero for multi-week 1099 workflows, and Databricks for monitoring, diagnosis, and remediation suggestions. These are directionally useful, but they are not substitutes for ablations, scaling curves, parameter counts, or training-token disclosures.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it as a capability signal, not as a methods paper. Three parts matter most. First, look at the benchmark selection: Terminal-Bench, GDPval-AA, MCP Atlas, and CharXiv together define Google's current capability target more clearly than the marketing language does. The emphasis is execution, coding, multimodal reasoning, and long-horizon reliability. Second, pay attention to Antigravity. Nearly every high-value example depends on the harness and subagent orchestration, which means the practical capability boundary is being redrawn around the combined model-plus-orchestrator system. That is the key lens for anyone thinking about what should be learned in pretraining versus delegated to runtime systems. Third, read the safety paragraph carefully. The mention of interpretability tools checking internal reasoning before response is more interesting than standard refusal language, and it is the part most likely to connect to future technical disclosures. Estimated reading time is 15 to 20 minutes. If you only skim, focus on the benchmark paragraph, the Antigravity examples, and the safety section.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution: Google DeepMind / Google. This is an official Gemini team blog post; no clear individual author list is provided.

recommendation.zh: 当行业信号看：关注它怎么定义“action/agentic workflow”和对外承诺的能力边界，但别指望拿到可复现的训练配方。
recommendation.en: Treat it as an industry signal: note how they frame “action/agentic workflows” and capability claims, but don’t expect reproducible training details.

paper.title: Harnessing LLM Agents with Skill Programs
paper.abstract: Equipping LLM agents with reusable skills derived from past experience has become a popular and successful approach for tackling complex and long-horizon tasks. However, such lessons are often encoded as textual guidance that remains largely advisory, lacking explicit mechanisms for when and how to intervene in the agent loop. To bridge the gap, we introduce HASP(Harnessing LLM Agents with Skill Programs), a new framework that upgrades skills into executable Program Functions (PFs). Rather than

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM agent 从历史经验中学到的“技能”通常只是文本建议，缺少明确触发条件和可执行干预机制的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个 agent 框架改进，贡献点是把技能从 advisory text 变成可执行程序函数。它对基座预训练本身帮助有限，但对 agent post-training 和 inference-time control 有一定参考价值，尤其是如何把经验压缩成可复用、可触发的结构化对象。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 HASP，将技能表示为 Program Functions（PFs）。PFs 在 agent loop 中充当可执行 guardrail：在失败高发状态被触发，修改下一步动作或注入纠错上下文。框架具有三种使用方式：推理时直接介入 agent loop；后训练时提供结构化监督；以及在 self-improvement 流程中由教师审核后不断演化 PFs。核心思想是把“经验”从自然语言提示升级为带触发逻辑和执行效果的程序化技能。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明实验覆盖 web-search、数学推理等复杂任务，并同时对比 training-free 与 training-based 方法，HASP 均有明显提升。摘要未给出模型规模、数据规模、具体 benchmark 和提升幅度，因此目前只能判断其框架想法清楚，但证据强度仍需看正文中的触发精度、误触发代价和跨任务泛化。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses a limitation in skill-based LLM agents: lessons from past experience are usually encoded as textual advice, without explicit triggering conditions or executable intervention mechanisms.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-framework improvement. Its main contribution is turning skills from advisory text into executable program functions. The relevance to foundation-model pretraining is limited, but it is moderately useful for agent post-training and inference-time control, especially as a way to compress experience into reusable structured objects.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes HASP, which represents skills as Program Functions (PFs). PFs act as executable guardrails inside the agent loop: they activate on failure-prone states and either modify the next action or inject corrective context. The framework is modular and can be used for inference-time intervention, structured supervision during post-training, or self-improvement through teacher-reviewed PF evolution.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, experiments cover tasks such as web search and math reasoning, and HASP shows gains over both training-free and training-based baselines. The abstract does not provide model size, dataset size, benchmark names, or exact margins, so the main paper is needed to assess trigger precision, false-positive costs, and cross-task generalization.

recommendation.zh: 想法不差，但更像 agent engineering 而非基座研究；看 PF 触发机制和失败案例就够了，别在 headline 提升上花太多时间。
recommendation.en: The idea is decent, but this is closer to agent engineering than foundation-model research; read the PF triggering mechanism and failure cases, not the headline gains.

paper.title: SkillSmith: Compiling Agent Skills into Boundary-Guided Runtime Interfaces
paper.abstract: Recently, skills have been widely adopted in large language model (LLM)-based agent systems across various domains. In existing frameworks, skills are typically injected into the agent reasoning loop as contextual guidance once matched to a runtime task, enabling specialized task-solving capabilities. We find that this execution paradigm introduces two major sources of redundancy: irrelevant context injection and repeated skill-specific reasoning and planning. To this end, we propose SkillSmith,

summary.core_problem: 解决技能型Agent在运行时把整段技能上下文塞进推理链，导致上下文冗余和重复规划的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个Agent runtime/编译框架工作，价值在于把技能从prompt知识改成可执行接口，减少token和思考轮次。对基座研究的直接启发有限，但对工具使用Agent的系统设计有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: SkillSmith提出boundary-first compiler-runtime框架：离线编译技能包，抽取细粒度操作边界，生成最小可执行接口；在线阶段，Agent只访问与当前任务相关的接口组件，而不是注入整段技能说明，从而减少无关上下文和重复的skill-specific reasoning。
summary.experiments: 在SkillsBench上，方法将solve阶段token用量降低57.44%，thinking iterations降低42.99%，并保持或提升求解表现。摘要未给出底座模型规模、训练细节和更强baseline覆盖，因此更像runtime engineering而非能力研究。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自中国人民大学和UC San Diego。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets the redundancy caused by injecting full skill descriptions into the reasoning loop of skill-based agents, which wastes context and repeats planning.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent runtime/compiler paper. Its value lies in turning skills from prompt context into executable interfaces, reducing token usage and reasoning overhead. The direct relevance to foundation-model pretraining is limited.
summary_en.technical_approach: SkillSmith proposes a boundary-first compiler-runtime framework: skill packages are compiled offline into minimal executable interfaces by extracting fine-grained operational boundaries. At runtime, the agent accesses only the relevant components instead of loading full skill descriptions into context.
summary_en.experiments: On SkillsBench, the method reduces solve-stage token usage by 57.44% and thinking iterations by 42.99%, while maintaining or improving task success. The abstract does not provide strong detail on backbone models, training setup, or broad baselines, so this reads more like runtime engineering than capability science.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Renmin University of China and UC San Diego.

recommendation.zh: Agent工程里常见的“把技能当长prompt”确实该淘汰，但这更像runtime编译技巧；看结果表即可，不必投入正文时间。
recommendation.en: The paper usefully confirms that treating skills as long prompts is wasteful, but this is mostly a runtime compilation trick; the result table is enough.

paper.title: Prompting Policies for Multi-step Reasoning and Tool-Use in Black-box LLMs with Iterative Distillation of Experience
paper.abstract: The shift toward interacting with frozen, "black-box" Large Language Models (LLMs) has transformed prompt engineering from a heuristic exercise into a critical optimization challenge. We propose a Reinforcement Learning (RL) framework for training learned prompting policies via iterative distillation of experience. In this architecture, a lightweight prompter model is optimized to maximize task-specific rewards for a larger, frozen worker LLM. By utilizing a contrastive experience buffer that co

summary.core_problem: 如何通过强化学习优化黑盒LLM在多步推理和工具使用任务中的Prompt策略？
summary.importance: 提出了一种通过迭代经验蒸馏来训练Prompt策略的RL框架，将迭代的Prompt优化过程摊销到轻量级Prompter模型的单次前向传播中，显著提升了黑盒LLM的复杂任务性能。
summary.technical_approach: 训练一个轻量级的Prompter模型，以最大化冻结的Worker LLM的任务特定奖励。利用包含标量奖励和密集文本批评的对比经验缓冲区，将迭代的Prompt改进蒸馏到策略权重中。
summary.experiments: 在Big Bench Extra Hard (BBEH)和Tau-bench上进行实验。在逻辑推理任务上性能从55%提升至90%，在工具使用任务上从74%提升至91%。
summary.authors_note: Google Research团队工作。

summary_en.core_problem: How to optimize prompt policies for black-box LLMs in multi-step reasoning and tool-use tasks via reinforcement learning?
summary_en.importance: Proposes an RL framework for training prompt policies via iterative distillation of experience, amortizing the iterative prompt refinement process into a single forward pass of a lightweight prompter model, significantly improving black-box LLM performance on complex tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Trains a lightweight prompter model to maximize task-specific rewards for a frozen worker LLM. Utilizes a contrastive experience buffer coupling scalar rewards with dense textual critiques to distill iterative prompt refinement into policy weights.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Big Bench Extra Hard (BBEH) and Tau-bench. Improved performance from 55% to 90% in logic-intensive reasoning and 74% to 91% in tool-use tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from Google Research.

recommendation.zh: Google用RL训练小模型来给大模型写Prompt，将迭代优化蒸馏为单次生成，对Post-train阶段的推理能力增强和Agent系统设计有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Google uses RL to train a small model to write prompts for a large model, distilling iterative optimization into single-shot generation, valuable for reasoning enhancement in post-train and agent system design.

paper.title: CRANE: Constrained Reasoning Injection for Code Agents via Nullspace Editing
paper.abstract: Code agents must both reason over long-horizon repository state and obey strict tool-use protocols. In paired Instruct/Thinking checkpoints, these capabilities are complementary but misaligned. The Instruct model is concise and tool-disciplined, whereas the Thinking model offers stronger planning and recovery behavior but often over-deliberates and degrades agent performance. We present CRANE (Constrained Reasoning Injection for Code Agents via Nullspace Editing), a training-free parameter-editi

summary.core_problem: 解决代码 Agent 中“会思考”和“守工具协议”难以同时保留的问题：Thinking checkpoint 规划更强，但容易过度推理并破坏工具调用格式；Instruct checkpoint 更守规矩，但长程恢复能力弱。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是训练-free 参数编辑和 checkpoint merging。它不是预训练方法，但触及一个实用问题：如何把 reasoning checkpoint 的能力迁移到 agentic coding 模型，同时避免破坏 tool-use 行为。
summary.technical_approach: CRANE 把 Thinking-Instruct 参数差值视为候选 reasoning edit 池。方法包括三步：用 magnitude thresholding 去掉低信号 delta；用 Conservative Taylor Gate 保留同时有利于 reasoning transfer 和 tool-use preservation 的方向；用 Graduated Sigmoidal Projection 抑制格式敏感方向，接近 nullspace editing 的思路。
summary.experiments: 摘要只说明在合并 paired Instruct/Thinking checkpoints 后，CRANE 相比单独 Instruct 或 Thinking 模型取得明显提升；未给出模型规模、benchmark 名称、训练数据、提升幅度或显著性检验。需要看正文确认是否覆盖 SWE-bench 类仓库级任务，以及 tool-call failure 是否单独统计。
summary.authors_note: Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute 与 IBM Research 合作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a mismatch in code agents: Thinking checkpoints often plan and recover better, while Instruct checkpoints are more concise and tool-protocol compliant.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-free parameter editing method for merging reasoning behavior into a tool-disciplined code-agent backbone. It is not pretraining work, but it is relevant to how reasoning-tuned and instruction-tuned checkpoints can be composed.
summary_en.technical_approach: CRANE treats the Thinking-minus-Instruct weight delta as a pool of candidate reasoning edits. It denoises the delta with magnitude thresholding, applies a Conservative Taylor Gate to keep edits that improve reasoning without harming tool use, and uses Graduated Sigmoidal Projection to suppress directions that affect format-critical behavior.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports gains over either individual checkpoint after merging paired Instruct and Thinking models, but does not provide model sizes, task names, baselines, absolute numbers, or ablation details. The main questions are whether the gains hold on repository-level coding benchmarks and whether tool-use errors are measured separately.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute and IBM Research.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练方法；若你在做 Thinking→Instruct 权重合并，只看门控和投影设计，实验数字需等正文核对。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper; if you merge Thinking into Instruct checkpoints, inspect the gating/projection design and verify the numbers in the full paper.

paper.title: Articraft: An Agentic System for Scalable Articulated 3D Asset Generation
paper.abstract: A bottleneck in learning to understand articulated 3D objects is the lack of large and diverse datasets. In this paper, we propose to leverage large language models (LLMs) to close this gap and generate articulated assets at scale. We reduce the problem of generating an articulated 3D asset to that of writing a program that builds it. We then introduce a new agentic system, Articraft, that writes such programs automatically. We design a programmatic interface and harness to help the LLM do so ef

summary.core_problem: 铰接式3D物体数据集规模小、多样性不足，限制3D理解模型性能，人工构建数据集成本高、扩展性差
summary.importance: 系统创新，提出首个基于LLM的铰接式3D资产规模化生成Agent系统，通过程序式生成解决3D训练数据瓶颈
summary.technical_approach: 将3D资产生成问题转化为程序编写问题，设计Articraft Agent系统，提供领域专用SDK用于定义部件、几何、关节和验证测试，通过受限工作空间和结构化错误反馈引导LLM生成有效程序
summary.experiments: 生成的3D资产质量优于现有SOTA基线，摘要未给出具体量化指标及所用LLM的参数规模
summary.authors_note: 剑桥大学、牛津大学、南洋理工大学，Andrea Vedaldi为牛津大学知名计算机视觉研究者

summary_en.core_problem: Small, low-diversity articulated 3D object datasets limit performance of 3D understanding models, while manual dataset construction is costly and hard to scale
summary_en.importance: System innovation: the first LLM-based agent system for scalable articulated 3D asset generation, resolving 3D training data bottlenecks via programmatic synthesis
summary_en.technical_approach: Frames 3D asset generation as a programming problem, designs Articraft agent system with a domain-specific SDK for defining parts, geometry, joints and validation tests, guides LLM via restricted workspace and structured error feedback
summary_en.experiments: Outperforms existing SOTA baselines in 3D asset quality; no explicit quantitative metrics or LLM parameter size disclosed in abstract
summary_en.authors_note: University of Cambridge, University of Oxford, Nanyang Technological University; Andrea Vedaldi is a well-known computer vision researcher at the University of Oxford

recommendation.zh: 基于LLM程序合成的3D资产生成Agent，做代码Agent或多模态数据合成可参考系统设计，不用精读
recommendation.en: LLM program synthesis agent for 3D asset generation, reference system design only if working on code agents or multimodal data synthesis

paper.title: Concurrency without Model Changes: Future-based Asynchronous Function Calling for LLMs
paper.abstract: Function calling, also known as tool use, is a core capability of modern LLM agents but is typically constrained by synchronous execution semantics. Under these semantics, LLM decoding is blocked until each function call completes, resulting in increasing end-to-end latency. In this work, we introduce AsyncFC, a pure execution-layer framework that decouples LLM decoding from function execution, enabling overlap between model decoding and function execution as well as inter-function parallelism w

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 function calling agent 里的执行层串行瓶颈。标准同步协议要求模型发出函数调用后，必须等函数执行完成、结果写回上下文，模型才能继续解码。这样会把“模型思考/规划”和“工具执行”强行串行化，导致端到端延迟随函数调用数快速累积。论文的问题意识很明确：很多延迟并不是模型能力不够，而是 runtime 把本可并发的部分锁死了。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接相关性有限，它更偏 agent runtime / serving 系统，而不是基座训练方法。但它仍有两个值得记住的点。第一，它说明一部分 agent 能力并不需要靠模型改造或额外训练获得，执行语义的重新设计就能释放明显收益。第二，它暴露了一个有意思的能力边界：现成 LLM 在没有专门微调的情况下，已经能在一定程度上对 unresolved future placeholder 进行推理和规划。这对 tool-use 数据构造、post-train 协议设计、以及未来 agent pretraining 的接口定义都有启发，不过量级仍属于系统层方法创新，不是基座范式变化。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 AsyncFC，核心思想是把同步 function calling 的值传递，改造成基于 future 的占位符传递，但对模型表面上仍保持标准 call-return 语义，不要求改模型、不要求改已有函数实现。

具体机制分四步。

第一步，schema 自动改写。系统把原本同步函数的输入输出 schema 转成 future-compatible 版本，使模型可以接收和传递 future 占位符，而不是只能处理已解析的具体值。与此同时，系统额外提供一个轻量的 await_future 函数，让模型在需要真实结果时显式请求解析。这个设计的关键是：不要求模型学新的并发语言，只是把“未完成结果”包装成一种它能在上下文里继续操作的符号对象。

第二步，异步派发与立即返回。当模型发出函数调用时，runtime 不阻塞等待执行完成，而是把底层同步函数提交给异步执行器，然后立刻把一个 symbolic future id 当作返回值写回上下文。这样从协议上看，函数已经“返回”，模型可以继续解码后续内容、发起更多调用、甚至把这个 future 作为后续函数的参数继续传递。

第三步，事件驱动的结果整合。后台函数完成后，系统在 turn boundary 把真实结果或错误信息注入上下文，使模型后续可以消费已解析值。这里作者强调保持标准同步协议外观：模型看到的仍是 call 后面跟 return，只不过 return 先是 future placeholder，之后再被解析。

第四步，依赖感知调度。为了避免并发执行破坏状态一致性，AsyncFC 默认保守串行；只有在开发者提供 resource interaction annotation 后，调度器才会放开 dependency-safe 的并行执行。这样系统同时支持两类并发：模型解码与函数执行重叠，以及多个互不冲突函数之间的并行。

与已有方法相比，论文刻意回避两条常见路线：一是修改模型或训练模型显式管理 fork/join；二是改 function-calling 协议，让模型自己承担更多并发控制复杂度。AsyncFC 的立场是把并发管理下沉到 runtime。这样做的好处是兼容现有模型和函数生态，坏处是收益受限于模型能否自然理解 future placeholder，以及调度器能否拿到足够准确的依赖注释。
summary.experiments:
论文报告了几组端到端延迟结果。最明确的数字是：在 BFCL v4 Web Search workload 上，在现实函数延迟设定下达到 1.26× speedup；集成到 SWE-agent 后，在 SWE-bench Lite 上、使用更贴近真实环境的放大函数延迟设定时达到 1.44× speedup；此外还扩展到 HotpotQA 这类 multi-hop reasoning 任务，说明该机制不只适用于 API 调用，也适用于需要多步检索和等待的推理流程。

作者强调 speedup 来自两部分：一是 decoding 与 function execution 的重叠，二是依赖允许时的 inter-function parallelism。更重要的是，这些收益是在不牺牲准确率的前提下取得的，也就是异步执行没有明显破坏任务完成质量。

从论文叙述看，实验还比较了两类基线：标准同步 function calling，以及模型原生支持的 parallel function calling 模式。AsyncFC 的结论是，即便模型已有原生 parallel FC，执行层的 future-based runtime 仍能进一步降延迟，因为很多 API 只是在“同一轮可并行发起”，但没有解决执行期间模型解码被阻塞的问题，也没有给出清晰的执行顺序语义。

当前给出的正文片段没有完整表格和误差条，也没有展开不同函数延迟分布、不同依赖图密度、不同模型家族下的细粒度结果。因此能确认的重点是方向性结论和上述两个 speedup 数字；更细的 benchmark 分项、准确率变化幅度、以及调度注释带来的额外收益，需要完整正文支撑。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合快速泛读。先看 Introduction，把作者的主张抓住：并发不一定要模型学会，runtime 也可以提供。然后直接看 Method，重点理解三个对象：future placeholder、await_future、dependency-aware scheduler。只要这三者关系清楚，整篇就读通了。

实验部分建议重点看两类结果：一类是 BFCL 和 SWE-bench Lite 的端到端 latency 对比；另一类是 accuracy 是否保持稳定。若有时间，再看 schema adaptation 和调度策略的案例，判断这种协议兼容性在真实 agent stack 里是否容易落地。

预计阅读时间 15 到 25 分钟。对做基座预训练的人，不必深究实现细节；更值得关注的是“模型能否在未解析符号上继续规划”这个现象，以及它对未来 tool-use 训练数据设计意味着什么。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a runtime bottleneck in function-calling agents. Under the standard synchronous protocol, once the model emits a function call, decoding blocks until the function finishes and its result is appended to the context. This forces model reasoning and tool execution into a serialized loop, so end-to-end latency grows quickly with the number of calls. The paper's central claim is that a large part of this latency is a systems artifact rather than a model-capability limitation.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to pretraining is limited; this is primarily an agent runtime and execution-semantics paper, not a foundation-model training paper. Still, it carries two useful lessons. First, some agent gains do not require model changes or extra training; redesigning execution semantics can unlock substantial speedups. Second, it reveals an interesting capability boundary: off-the-shelf LLMs can often reason over unresolved future placeholders without fine-tuning. That matters for tool-use protocol design, post-training data construction, and possibly future agent pretraining interfaces, but the contribution remains system-level rather than a change in core LM learning.
summary_en.technical_approach:
AsyncFC replaces blocking value-based function interaction with future-based interaction while preserving the standard call-return shape that existing models expect. It does this without modifying the model or the underlying function implementations.

The mechanism has four parts.

First, automatic schema adaptation. The runtime rewrites synchronous function schemas into future-compatible ones so the model can accept and pass around future placeholders instead of only concrete resolved values. It also introduces a lightweight await_future function that lets the model explicitly request resolution when needed. The key idea is that the model does not need to learn a new concurrency language; unresolved results are exposed as symbolic objects it can continue to manipulate.

Second, asynchronous dispatch with immediate return. When the model emits a function call, the runtime submits the original synchronous function to an async executor and immediately returns a symbolic future identifier into the conversation. From the protocol's perspective, the function has already returned, so the model can keep decoding, issue more calls, or pass the future into downstream calls.

Third, event-driven result integration. Once the backend execution completes, the runtime injects the resolved result or an error message into the context at turn boundaries. The model still sees a call followed by a return, but the return is initially a future placeholder and only later becomes a concrete value.

Fourth, dependency-aware scheduling. To avoid unsafe parallel execution, AsyncFC is conservative by default and serializes calls unless the developer provides resource-interaction annotations. With those annotations, the scheduler can unlock dependency-safe inter-function parallelism. This yields two forms of concurrency: overlap between model decoding and function execution, and parallel execution among independent functions.

Compared with prior approaches, the paper deliberately avoids two common routes: changing the model so it explicitly manages fork/join behavior, or changing the function-calling protocol so the model itself bears more concurrency-management complexity. AsyncFC pushes concurrency management into the runtime. The upside is compatibility with existing models and tools; the downside is that gains depend on whether the model can naturally operate over future placeholders and whether the scheduler has sufficiently accurate dependency annotations.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper reports several end-to-end latency results. The clearest numbers are a 1.26x speedup on BFCL v4 Web Search workloads under realistic function latencies, and a 1.44x speedup on SWE-bench Lite when integrated with SWE-agent under scaled latencies intended to better reflect real-world conditions. It also extends the setup to multi-hop reasoning tasks such as HotpotQA, suggesting the mechanism is useful not only for API-heavy workflows but also for retrieval-and-wait reasoning patterns.

The reported gains come from two sources: overlap between decoding and function execution, and inter-function parallelism when dependencies allow it. Importantly, the paper claims these latency reductions do not come with an accuracy drop, meaning the asynchronous execution semantics preserve task quality reasonably well.

The evaluation appears to compare against both standard synchronous function calling and native parallel function-calling modes exposed by some models. The argument is that even when a model supports parallel FC, an execution-layer future-based runtime can still reduce latency further, because native parallel APIs often allow same-turn parallel issuance but do not remove decode-time blocking or define execution-order semantics clearly enough for stateful calls.

The provided text does not include the full tables, confidence intervals, or detailed breakdowns by latency distribution, dependency-graph density, or model family. So the safe takeaways are the direction of the effect and the two headline speedup numbers above; finer-grained benchmark details would require the complete paper.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a quick skim paper. Start with the introduction and lock onto the main claim: concurrency does not have to be learned by the model; it can be provided by the runtime. Then go straight to the method section and understand three objects: future placeholders, await_future, and the dependency-aware scheduler. Once those are clear, the rest of the paper is straightforward.

In the experiments, focus on two things: end-to-end latency on BFCL and SWE-bench Lite, and whether accuracy stays stable. If time permits, look at the schema-adaptation examples and scheduling cases to judge how easily this would fit into a real agent stack.

Estimated reading time is 15 to 25 minutes. For foundation-model researchers, the implementation details are less important than the behavioral observation that models can continue planning over unresolved symbolic values, and what that might imply for future tool-use training data and interfaces.

recommendation.zh: 这是少见的“只改执行层就能大幅降延迟”的agent工作；读实现语义与依赖调度即可，别期待对预训练有直接方法论。
recommendation.en: A rare agent paper where execution-layer semantics alone can cut latency; focus on the future/promise design and dependency scheduling, not on pretraining takeaways.

paper.title: ExploitBench: A Capability Ladder Benchmark for LLM Cybersecurity Agents
paper.abstract: Exploitation is not a binary event. It is a ladder of acquiring progressive capabilities, from executing a single buggy line of code to taking full control of the target. However, existing LLM security benchmarks treat a crash as exploitation success. That single binary outcome collapses the hard parts of exploitation: the transition from triggering a bug to constructing reusable primitives and control.   We present ExploitBench, a capability-graded benchmark that decomposes exploitation into 16

summary.core_problem: 现有网络安全 Agent benchmark 把 exploit 成功当成二元结果，无法测出从 crash 到真正控制目标之间的能力台阶。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是 benchmark 设计：把 exploit 过程拆成可验证的能力阶梯，而不是只看最终是否拿到 shell。对评估 Agent 的长链条能力、工具使用和中间进展度量有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ExploitBench，用 16 个 capability flags 分解漏洞利用过程，覆盖 coverage、crash、sandbox primitives、arbitrary read/write、control-flow hijack 到 arbitrary code execution。每一级都用确定性 oracle 验证，包括随机 challenge-response、与真值二进制差分执行、signal-handler proof 等。
summary.experiments: 基于 41 个 V8 bugs 实例化 benchmark。摘要未给出具体模型、分数和提升幅度，但强调现有 benchmark 的二元成功标准会压扁关键中间能力差异。
summary.authors_note: Carnegie Mellon University；David Brumley 是程序分析与安全领域知名学者。该工作更像安全 Agent 评测基础设施，而非 LLM 基座方法。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing cybersecurity-agent benchmarks reduce exploitation to a binary success signal, missing the capability ladder between a crash and full target control.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is benchmark design: exploitation is decomposed into verifiable intermediate capabilities rather than judged only by end success. This is useful for evaluating long-horizon agent competence, tool use, and progress signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: ExploitBench defines 16 capability flags spanning coverage, crash, sandbox primitives, arbitrary read/write, control-flow hijack, and arbitrary code execution. Each stage is checked by deterministic oracles, including randomized challenge-response, differential execution against ground-truth binaries, and signal-handler proofs.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark is instantiated on 41 V8 bugs. The abstract does not provide full model or score details, but the key point is that binary exploit success hides meaningful differences in intermediate capability acquisition.
summary_en.authors_note: Carnegie Mellon University; David Brumley is a well-known researcher in program analysis and security. The paper is better viewed as security-agent evaluation infrastructure than as a foundation-model method paper.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但 benchmark 设计是认真的；若你做 agent eval，只看 16-level capability 定义和 oracle 设计，别陷进安全细节。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the benchmark design is solid; if you care about agent eval, read the 16-level capability ladder and oracle construction, not the security specifics.

paper.title: Context Training with Active Information Seeking
paper.abstract: Most existing large language models (LLMs) are expensive to adapt after deployment, especially when a task requires newly produced information or niche domain knowledge. Recent work has shown that, by manipulating and optimizing their context, LLMs can be tailored to downstream tasks without updating their weights. However, most existing methods remain closed-loop, relying solely on the model's intrinsic knowledge. In this paper, we equip these context optimizers with Wikipedia search and browse

summary.core_problem: 解决部署后不更新权重的 LLM 如何通过优化上下文并主动检索外部信息来适配新任务和长尾知识的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是上下文优化与工具使用方法。它对 pretrain 的直接价值有限，但能提供一个信号：模型能力越来越依赖上下文构造、检索策略和候选上下文搜索，而不是单次 prompt engineering。
summary.technical_approach: 在已有 context optimizer 上加入 Wikipedia search 与 browser tools，并指出简单串行地把工具接入上下文优化会降低性能。论文改用 search-based training，维护多个候选上下文，在搜索过程中剪枝，避免单一路径早期错误污染最终上下文。
summary.experiments: 覆盖低资源翻译 Flores+、健康场景等多领域任务。摘要称主动信息获取与多候选上下文搜索结合后有一致且显著收益，但未给出模型规模、具体 LLM、检索预算、baseline 名称和提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 给定机构为 The University of Edinburgh；Arthur Szlam 和 Marc'Aurelio Ranzato 是大模型与强化学习/序列建模领域知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how deployed LLMs can adapt to new tasks and niche or newly produced knowledge by optimizing context and actively seeking external information, without updating model weights.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a method for context optimization with tool use. Its direct pretraining value is limited, but it gives a useful signal: downstream competence can depend heavily on context search, retrieval policy, and candidate management rather than one-shot prompt design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work augments context optimizers with Wikipedia search and browser tools. It finds that naively inserting tools into a standard sequential context optimization pipeline can hurt performance. The proposed alternative uses search-based training, keeps multiple candidate contexts, and prunes them to reduce early-path error lock-in.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans low-resource translation on Flores+, health scenarios, and other domains. The abstract reports consistent and substantial gains from active information seeking when paired with multi-candidate context search, but does not provide model sizes, exact LLMs, retrieval budgets, baseline names, or numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institution is The University of Edinburgh; Arthur Szlam and Marc'Aurelio Ranzato are well-known researchers in large-scale learning, reinforcement learning, and sequence modeling.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文；看 abstract 和算法图即可，关键点是“加工具会变差，搜索式上下文训练才稳”。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper; the useful bit is that adding tools can hurt unless context optimization is treated as search with pruning.

paper.title: ToolCUA: Towards Optimal GUI-Tool Path Orchestration for Computer Use Agents
paper.abstract: Computer Use Agents (CUAs) can act through both atomic GUI actions, such as click and type, and high-level tool calls, such as API-based file operations, but this hybrid action space often leaves them uncertain about when to continue with GUI actions or switch to tools, leading to suboptimal execution paths. This difficulty stems from the scarcity of high-quality interleaved GUI-Tool trajectories, the cost and brittleness of collecting real tool trajectories, and the lack of trajectory-level sup

summary.core_problem: 解决计算机使用代理（CUA）的混合GUI-工具动作空间调度问题：现有代理要么过度调用工具导致错误率上升，要么完全不利用工具仅依赖GUI长序列操作效率低下。现有方法缺乏高质量的交错GUI-工具轨迹数据，且训练信号仅聚焦单步模仿或最终任务完成，无法提供轨迹级的路径选择反馈，难以学习最优的GUI-工具切换策略。
summary.importance: 提出可扩展的混合GUI-工具路径编排范式，解决了计算机使用代理同时支持原子GUI操作和结构化工具调用的核心落地痛点，对通用智能体的多粒度动作空间统一建模、训练信号设计有直接参考价值，也为复用现有大规模纯GUI轨迹数据提供了低成本方案。
summary.technical_approach: 采用两阶段训练范式：第一阶段是可扩展的交错GUI-工具数据构造管线，基于已有的静态GUI语料，用多模态大模型从重复出现的GUI操作流程中合成轨迹感知的工具库，通过工具步骤生成和下一状态接地，将纯GUI数据转换为交错的GUI-工具轨迹，无需采集成本高昂的真实工具轨迹。第二阶段是分层强化微调：先通过暖启动有监督微调获得基础混合动作能力，再用单轮强化学习优化显式的GUI-工具切换点决策，最后在真实GUI-工具环境中用在线智能体强化学习优化，奖励函数包含工具适配性项（鼓励在有益时调用工具、无必要时避免调用）和路径效率项（鼓励用工具调用替代冗余GUI操作缩短路径），提供轨迹级反馈引导模型选择全局最优执行路径。
summary.experiments: 在OSWorld-MCP基准上，同等参数量级下ToolCUA达到46.85%的任务成功率，相比Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct基线相对提升约66%，性能接近头部闭源模型。消融实验验证了数据合成管线和轨迹级奖励的贡献：仅用合成数据的有监督微调阶段就比基线提升27%相对性能，加入轨迹级强化学习后再提升31%相对性能；不同强度的工具偏好设置下，模型可在工具调用率和成功率之间实现可控的权衡。
summary.reading_guide: 首先精读引言部分的混合动作空间问题定义和现有方案的缺陷分析，然后重点看数据合成管线设计和分层强化学习训练框架章节，核心图表关注路径选择问题建模示意图、基准对比结果表、以及工具奖励项的消融实验表。值得深挖的点包括：如何将该数据合成范式扩展到更多非桌面端的智能体场景、轨迹级奖励的设计是否可迁移到其他多动作空间的智能体训练。

summary_en.core_problem: This work addresses the hybrid GUI-tool action space orchestration problem for Computer Use Agents (CUAs): existing agents either overuse tools leading to higher error rates, or underutilize tools and rely solely on long sequences of GUI operations with low efficiency. Current methods lack high-quality interleaved GUI-tool trajectory data, and training signals only focus on step-level imitation or final task completion, failing to provide trajectory-level path selection feedback, making it hard to learn optimal GUI-tool switching policies.
summary_en.importance: It proposes a scalable hybrid GUI-tool path orchestration paradigm, solving the core deployment pain point of CUAs that need to support both atomic GUI operations and structured tool calls. It provides direct reference for unified modeling of multi-granularity action spaces and training signal design for general agents, and offers a low-cost solution for reusing existing large-scale pure GUI trajectory corpora.
summary_en.technical_approach: A two-stage training paradigm is adopted: The first stage is a scalable interleaved GUI-tool data construction pipeline. Based on existing static GUI corpora, MLLMs are used to synthesize trajectory-aware tool libraries from recurring GUI operation procedures. Pure GUI data is converted to interleaved GUI-tool trajectories through tool step generation and next-state grounding, eliminating the need to collect high-cost real tool trajectories. The second stage is hierarchical reinforcement fine-tuning: first, warmup supervised fine-tuning is used to obtain basic hybrid action capabilities, then single-turn RL is applied to optimize decisions at explicit GUI-tool switching points, finally online agentic RL is performed in a realistic GUI-tool environment. The reward function includes a tool appropriateness term (incentivizing tool calls when beneficial and abstention when unnecessary) and a path efficiency term (encouraging replacement of redundant GUI operations with tool calls to shorten trajectories), providing trajectory-level feedback to guide the model to select globally optimal execution paths.
summary_en.experiments: On the OSWorld-MCP benchmark, ToolCUA achieves 46.85% task success rate at the same parameter scale, a ~66% relative improvement over the Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct baseline, on par with leading closed-source models. Ablation studies verify the contribution of the data synthesis pipeline and trajectory-level reward: the SFT stage using only synthetic data already delivers 27% relative performance gain over the baseline, and adding trajectory-level RL brings another 31% relative improvement. With different tool preference settings, the model can achieve controllable trade-offs between tool call rate and success rate.
summary_en.reading_guide: First carefully read the hybrid action space problem definition and limitation analysis of existing solutions in the Introduction, then focus on the data synthesis pipeline design and hierarchical RL training framework sections. Key figures and tables include the path selection problem modeling diagram, benchmark comparison results table, and ablation tables for tool reward terms. Worth further exploring points include extending the data synthesis paradigm to more non-desktop agent scenarios, and whether the trajectory-level reward design can be transferred to training of other agents with multi-action spaces.

recommendation.zh: 预训练方向不必通读，只看轨迹合成和 RFT 设计；它对“工具数据从哪来”比对模型结构更有信息量。
recommendation.en: No need to read end to end for pretraining; inspect the trajectory synthesis and RFT setup, since the useful signal is where tool-use supervision comes from.

paper.title: The Bicameral Model: Bidirectional Hidden-State Coupling Between Parallel Language Models
paper.abstract: Existing multi-model and tool-augmented systems communicate by generating text, serializing every exchange through the output vocabulary. Can two pretrained language models instead coordinate through a continuous, concurrent channel? The Bicameral Model couples two frozen language models through a trainable neural interface on their intermediate hidden states. At every generation step, both models run in lockstep: a primary model drives the task while an auxiliary model operates tools, solves co

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究两个冻结语言模型能否不通过文本消息，而是通过中间 hidden state 建立连续、并行、双向的通信通道。目标不是让一个模型调用工具后把结果写成文本再交给另一个模型，而是让主模型和辅助模型在每个生成步同步前进，并通过可训练接口交换激活信息。
summary.importance: 这不是典型预训练论文，但对基座模型研究有两个启发。第一，它提供了一种模块化扩展能力的路径：不改动两个已有模型，只训练约 1% 参数量的接口，让辅助模型或工具能力进入主模型生成过程。第二，它把多模型协作从离散 token 协议转向连续表征协议，相关问题包括层间表征对齐、通信瓶颈、冻结模型适配、工具结果如何被主模型吸收。当前证据主要来自小模型和工具任务，结论还不能直接外推到大规模预训练系统，但方向本身和模型组合、agent 内部通信、latent interface 有关。
summary.technical_approach: Bicameral Model 包含主模型、辅助模型和双向神经接口。两个预训练 Transformer 都冻结。主模型生成用户可见输出；辅助模型维护并行推理流，并可连接 calculator、Z3 solver 或 Python sandbox。每个生成位置上，两个模型同步运行。接口在指定层读取发送方 residual stream，将其通过 translation network 映射到接收方表征空间，再用 learned suppression gate 控制写入强度。正向通道从主模型到辅助模型，使辅助模型获得任务相关信息；反向通道从辅助模型到主模型，使工具推理结果影响最终生成。训练只更新接口参数，使用 dual-target supervised fine-tuning，并且没有预先规定 hidden-state 通道应该传什么格式。一个重要设计是 suppression gate：它不是简单把外部激活相加，而是学习何时通信、往哪个方向通信、通信强度多大。
summary.experiments: 论文报告了三个主要设置。calculator 设置中，将 0.5B 主模型与带计算器的辅助模型耦合，算术准确率从 36.2% 提升到 96.5%。Z3 设置中，将 0.6B 模型与约束求解器辅助流耦合，在 ZebraLogic 上相对未增强模型达到 1.7 倍提升。Python 设置中，辅助模型能够仅根据 hidden-state 信号生成问题相关代码，而不直接看到问题文本。训练动态分析显示，通信通道按因果依赖顺序形成：先出现主到辅的 forward coupling，随后出现工具结果 recall，再体现为准确率提升。门控行为也有方向差异：主到辅通道集中在数字和操作关键词等任务相关 token；辅到主通道在工具输出可用或被回忆时出现峰值。adapter-equivalent 消融表明，性能增益不是单纯来自接口参数容量，而是来自辅助模型和工具流提供的能力。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30 分钟。重点看 Architecture 中接口读写层、translation network 和 suppression gate 的定义；再看实验中 calculator、Z3、Python 三个设置如何构造能力差距。最值得看的不是最终准确率，而是门控可视化、训练动态和 adapter-equivalent 消融。这些部分决定该方法是否真的学到了隐藏态通信，而不是把接口当作一个小型 adapter。需要保留的疑问是：同步双模型推理成本较高；hidden-state 协议是否能跨模型家族和更大尺度稳定迁移；辅助模型看不到原始文本时，训练分布是否限制了泛化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether two frozen language models can coordinate through intermediate hidden states instead of exchanging serialized text. The proposed setup runs a primary model and an auxiliary model in lockstep at each generation step, with a trainable bidirectional interface that lets activations flow between them.
summary_en.importance: This is not a standard pretraining paper, but it is relevant to base-model research because it explores continuous inter-model communication. It suggests a way to add capabilities without updating either underlying model: train a small interface, about 1% of the combined parameters, and let an auxiliary model or tool stream influence the primary model. The work also raises useful questions about representation alignment, communication sparsity, frozen-model adaptation, and latent interfaces for tool use. The evidence is still limited to small models and controlled tool settings, so the result should be read as an architectural probe rather than a settled recipe for large-scale systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Bicameral Model has three components: a frozen primary transformer, a frozen auxiliary transformer, and a trainable neural interface. The primary model produces the user-facing output. The auxiliary model runs a concurrent stream with access to tools such as a calculator, Z3, or a Python sandbox. At each token position, both models advance together. The interface reads a residual-stream state from one model, maps it into the other model’s hidden space through a translation network, and writes it into a selected layer using a learned suppression gate. The forward direction lets the auxiliary observe task-relevant information from the primary. The reverse direction lets auxiliary reasoning and tool outputs affect primary generation. Only the interface is trained, using dual-target supervised fine-tuning. No explicit communication format is prescribed; the gate learns when and how strongly to transmit signals from task loss.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports three main tool-backed settings. In the calculator setting, coupling a 0.5B primary model to a calculator-equipped auxiliary raises arithmetic accuracy from 36.2% to 96.5%. In the Z3 setting, coupling a 0.6B model to a constraint-solving auxiliary gives a 1.7x improvement over the unaugmented model on ZebraLogic. In the Python-tool setting, the auxiliary can generate problem-specific code from hidden-state signals alone, without directly seeing the problem text. The gate analysis is one of the more informative parts: primary-to-auxiliary coupling concentrates on numbers and operation words, while auxiliary-to-primary coupling spikes when tool output becomes available or is recalled. Training dynamics show a causal order: forward coupling appears first, then tool recall, then task accuracy improves. Adapter-equivalent ablations suggest the gains are not explained only by the extra trainable parameters.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper in about 30 minutes. Focus on the architecture section, especially the read/write layer choices, translation networks, and suppression gates. Then read the three experimental setups to see how the authors create a capability gap between the primary and auxiliary streams. The most useful evidence is in the gate visualizations, training dynamics, and adapter-equivalent ablations, because these determine whether the model is actually using a hidden-state communication channel. Important open questions remain: the inference cost of synchronized dual-model generation, robustness across model families and scales, and whether the learned protocol generalizes beyond the supervised tool distributions used in training.

recommendation.zh: setup 有点重，但 hidden-state 通信绕开文本瓶颈；读接口和 gate 消融，看它是否真学到协议而非任务捷径。
recommendation.en: The setup is heavy, but activation-level communication is a real alternative to text protocols; read the interface and gate ablations for shortcut risks.

paper.title: OLIVIA: Online Learning via Inference-time Action Adaptation for Decision Making in LLM ReAct Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model agents interleave reasoning, action selection, and observation to solve sequential decision-making tasks. In deployed settings where agents repeatedly handle related multi-step tasks, small action-selection errors can accumulate into wasted tool calls, latency, and reduced reliability. Despite this need for deployment-time improvement, existing inference-time adaptation methods for LLM agents mainly rely on prompting or retrieval, which influence behavior indirectly through

summary.core_problem: 现有ReAct风格LLM智能体的推理时自适应方法大多依赖提示工程、反思或记忆增强，通过间接修改上下文影响行为，没有显式的决策层支持从动作级反馈中在线更新，难以在流式部署场景下实现细粒度、可追踪的动作选择优化。
summary.importance: 将上下文老虎机（contextual bandit）范式引入LLM智能体的推理时动作适配，为冻结基座模型下的在线决策优化提供了轻量方案，其利用LLM隐藏状态作为决策上下文的设计对部署端智能体的持续改进有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: OLIVIA在冻结LLM基座之上添加轻量上下文决策层：每一步决策时，将LLM输出的当前任务与推理历史的隐藏状态表征作为上下文，从候选动作集中选择下一步动作，基于单步反馈以上下文老虎机范式更新决策层参数，支持动作打分、不确定性感知的探索和增量更新，无需微调基座模型、修改提示或存储大规模检索记忆。
summary.experiments: 在4个工具使用基准上测试，相比静态提示基线和基于提示的推理时自适应基线，OLIVIA在任务性能和在线自适应表现上均有提升，同时完整保留了基座LLM的原有能力。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第3章方法部分的决策层与LLM隐藏状态的对接设计，以及第4章在不同基准上的自适应效果对比，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing inference-time adaptation methods for ReAct-style LLM agents mostly rely on prompt engineering, reflection, or memory augmentation, which influence behavior through indirect context modification. They lack an explicit decision layer that supports online updates from action-level feedback, making fine-grained, trackable action selection optimization difficult during streaming deployment.
summary_en.importance: It introduces the contextual bandit paradigm to inference-time action adaptation for LLM agents, providing a lightweight solution for online decision optimization with a frozen base model. Its design of using LLM hidden states as decision context offers references for continuous improvement of agents at the deployment stage.
summary_en.technical_approach: OLIVIA adds a lightweight contextual decision layer on top of a frozen LLM backbone. At each decision step, it takes the LLM's hidden-state representation of the current task and reasoning history as context, selects the next action from the candidate set, and updates the decision layer parameters under the contextual bandit paradigm using step-level feedback. It supports action scoring, uncertainty-aware exploration, and incremental updates, without requiring base model fine-tuning, prompt modification, or large-scale retrieval memory storage.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on four tool-use benchmarks. Compared with static prompting baselines and prompt-based inference-time adaptation baselines, OLIVIA achieves improvements in both task performance and online adaptation behavior, while fully preserving the original capabilities of the base LLM.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the design of the interface between the decision layer and LLM hidden states in Section 3, as well as the comparison of adaptation effects across different benchmarks in Section 4. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫算法和反馈设定；把 ReAct 动作层 bandit 化很干净，但结论强度取决于反馈是否真实可得。
recommendation.en: Skim the algorithm and feedback setup; banditizing the ReAct action layer is clean, but the result hinges on whether feedback is realistically available.

paper.title: Under the Hood of SKILL.md: Semantic Supply-chain Attacks on AI Agent Skill Registry
paper.abstract: Autonomous AI agents increasingly extend their capabilities through Agent Skills: modular filesystem packages whose SKILL.md files describe when and how agents should use them. While this design enables scalable, on-demand capability expansion, it also introduces a semantic supply-chain risk in which natural-language metadata and instructions can affect which skills are admitted, surfaced, selected, and loaded. We study SKILL.md - only attacks across three registry-facing stages of the Agent Ski

summary.core_problem: 解决 AI agent skill registry 中，纯自然语言元数据如何在发现、选择和治理三个环节引入语义供应链攻击的问题。
summary.importance: 这不是基座预训练论文，但对 agent 生态很实际：它指出 tool/skill 注册表的攻击面不只在代码，还在描述文本本身。贡献类型是安全分析与系统性攻击面刻画。
summary.technical_approach: 围绕 SKILL.md 设计三类语义攻击：在 Discovery 阶段操纵 embedding 检索排序，在 Selection 阶段用描述 framing 诱导 agent 偏向恶意技能，在 Governance 阶段通过语义规避绕过基于文本的审核。方法上更像红队评测框架，而非新模型。
summary.experiments: 基于真实 ClawHub skills 和较真实的 registry 机制评估。摘要报告：检索阶段对抗技能可达到 86% pairwise win rate、80% Top-10 placement；选择阶段功能等价的恶意变体平均被选中 77.6%。治理阶段也展示了绕过文本审核的语义规避，但摘要未给出完整数值细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Maryland；Soheil Feizi 在鲁棒性、安全与模型行为分析方面较知名。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how natural-language metadata in AI agent skill registries creates a semantic supply-chain attack surface across discovery, selection, and governance.
summary_en.importance: This is not a foundation-model pretraining paper, but it is practically relevant for agent systems: the attack surface is not just code, but also the textual descriptions that control registry behavior. The contribution is a security analysis and attack taxonomy.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work constructs SKILL.md-only attacks for three stages: manipulating embedding-based retrieval in discovery, biasing agent choice through description framing in selection, and evading text-based governance filters through semantic obfuscation. It is primarily a red-teaming and systems-security study rather than a new model.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations use real ClawHub skills and realistic registry mechanisms. The abstract reports up to 86% pairwise win rate and 80% Top-10 placement in discovery, and 77.6% average selection rate for adversarial but functionally equivalent variants in selection. Governance evasion is also demonstrated, though the abstract gives fewer details.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Maryland. Soheil Feizi is well known for work on robustness, security, and model behavior analysis.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但 agent infra 会真踩这个坑；读实验表和攻击分层即可，别把 registry 文本当无害元数据。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but agent infrastructure will run into this in practice; read the attack taxonomy and tables, and stop treating registry text as harmless metadata.

paper.title: SOD: Step-wise On-policy Distillation for Small Language Model Agents
paper.abstract: Tool-integrated reasoning (TIR) is difficult to scale to small language models due to instability in long-horizon tool interactions and limited model capacity. While reinforcement learning methods like group relative policy optimization provide only sparse outcome-level rewards. Recently, on-policy distillation (OPD) has gained popularity by supplying dense token-level supervision from a teacher on student-generated trajectories. However, our experiments indicate that applying OPD to TIR leads t

summary.core_problem: 将On-policy Distillation（OPD）应用于小语言模型（SLM）的工具集成推理（TIR）时，错误的工具调用会在后续推理步骤中级联放大，导致学生-教师分布快速偏离，教师的token级监督变得不可靠甚至误导，引发训练不稳定甚至崩溃。
summary.importance: 解决了SLM在TIR任务上训练不稳定的核心失效模式。首次让0.6B量级模型在AIME 2025上达到26.13%准确率，在多个benchmark上比次优基线最高提升20.86%，为小模型agent能力迁移提供了更可靠的训练范式。
summary.technical_approach: SOD在每个推理步骤上根据学生与教师的分布差异自适应调整蒸馏强度。当学生与教师对齐良好时保留密集监督，当差异较大时逐步衰减该步骤的蒸馏信号，减少分布外状态下误导性监督的影响。核心机制是per-step的自适应重加权（step-wise reweighting），在vanilla OPD基础上增加了分步门控。
summary.experiments: 在数学、科学和代码benchmark上比次优基线最高提升20.86%。0.6B学生模型在AIME 2025上达到26.13%准确率，是首个在此难度推理benchmark上达到该水平的十亿参数以下模型。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读Introduction中关于级联错误机制的分析（图1）和Method部分step-wise reweighting的具体实现，实验部分看主要结果表格。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: When applying On-policy Distillation (OPD) to tool-integrated reasoning (TIR) in small language models (SLMs), erroneous tool calls cascade across subsequent reasoning steps, causing rapid student-teacher distribution divergence. This renders the teacher's token-level supervision unreliable or misleading, leading to training instability and even collapse.
summary_en.importance: Addresses a critical failure mode in SLM agent training. First work to demonstrate a sub-billion-parameter model (0.6B) achieving 26.13% on AIME 2025, with up to 20.86% improvement over baselines across math, science, and code benchmarks. Provides a more reliable training paradigm for transferring agent capabilities to small models.
summary_en.technical_approach: SOD adaptively adjusts distillation strength at each reasoning step based on student-teacher divergence. When the student is well-aligned with the teacher, dense supervision is preserved. When deviation becomes large, the distillation signal for that step is progressively attenuated, reducing the influence of misleading supervision under out-of-distribution states. The core mechanism is step-wise reweighting, adding per-step adaptive gating to vanilla OPD.
summary_en.experiments: SOD outperforms the second-best baseline by up to 20.86% across multiple benchmarks. The 0.6B student model achieves 26.13% accuracy on AIME 2025, the first sub-billion-parameter model to reach this level on such a challenging reasoning benchmark.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the cascade error analysis in Introduction (Figure 1) and the step-wise reweighting mechanism in Method. Scan the main results tables in Experiments. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看 failure analysis 和 step-level weighting；它不改预训练 prior，但对工具轨迹蒸馏的数据清洗很实用。
recommendation.en: Read the failure analysis and step-wise weighting; it does not change pretraining priors, but it is useful for cleaning tool-trajectory supervision.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: Tool Calling is Linearly Readable and Steerable in Language Models
paper.abstract: When a tool-calling agent picks the wrong tool, the failure is invisible until execution: the email gets sent, the meeting gets missed. Probing 12 instruction-tuned models across Gemma 3, Qwen 3, Qwen 2.5, and Llama 3.1 (270M to 27B), we find the identity of the chosen tool is linearly readable and steerable inside the model. Adding the mean-difference between two tools' average internal activations switches which tool the model selects at 77-100% accuracy on name-only single-turn prompts (93-10

summary.core_problem: 论文问的是：工具调用模型在输出工具名之前，内部是否已经形成了可读、可干预的工具选择表示。这个问题的风险点在于，错误工具调用通常要到执行后才暴露。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把工具选择从纯行为层面的 agent 失败，拉回到表示学习和指令微调接口。实验显示，base 模型中已经存在较强的工具身份信号，指令微调更多是在把这个信号接到输出层，而不是从零产生该能力。这对理解 pretrain 到 tool-use posttrain 的迁移有价值，也提示工具调用安全监控可以直接读 residual stream，而不一定依赖额外分类器或执行后反馈。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 mean-difference steering。先收集某个工具在若干查询下的平均 hidden activation，再用目标工具均值减去源工具均值得到方向向量。生成时把这个向量加到 residual stream 上，观察模型是否切换工具。论文还做了 PCA、matched-prompt control、activation patching 和 circuit tracing，避免把共享 prompt 结构误判为工具专用子空间。一个重要细节是，作者发现工具名一旦被切换，后续 JSON 参数会自回归地跟随新工具 schema，因此干预工具名阶段就足以改变完整调用。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Gemma 3、Qwen 3/Qwen 2.5、Llama 3.1 共 12 个 instruction-tuned 模型，参数量从 270M 到 27B。name-only 单轮提示下，mean-difference steering 的工具切换准确率为 77–100%；4B 以上模型达到 93–100%。加入短工具描述后，对 4B 以上模型提升有限，部分 sub-1B 模型反而变差。PCA 上，15 个工具的均值可由约 10 个方向解释，但 matched-prompt control 也有 k90=7–9，说明紧凑谱不完全等价于工具专用表示。200 个 ToolBench API 上，36 个方向覆盖主要方差，但 control 的 k90=39，进一步说明 prompt 共享结构占了相当部分。错误预测方面，Gemma 3 12B/27B 中 top-1 与 top-2 工具内部得分间隔最小的查询，错误率高出 14–21 倍。base 模型结果更有意思：Gemma 3 4B base 在 BFCL v3 上直接生成正确工具只有约 3%，但用 residual stream 最近均值方向读出可恢复到 75%；Gemma 1B、12B 和 Llama 3.1 8B base 也有 56–72 个百分点的读出差距。机制分析显示，270M 基本没有稳定 circuit，1B 开始出现，指令微调后更清晰；Gemma 3 4B 中 L17 H0/H1 等 attention heads 承担较强决策作用，但 Qwen 3 4B 中 attention heads 与 MLP 的贡献更接近。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 30–45 分钟即可。优先看 Section 4.1 的 PCA 与 matched-prompt control，避免把低维结构过度解释为工具语义子空间；再看 Section 4.4 的 steering 结果和 JSON schema 跟随现象；最后看 Section 4.5 的 scale threshold，尤其是 270M、1B、4B 的差异。若关心机制解释，再读 Section 4.2 和 Table 26，重点看不同模型中 attention 与 MLP 贡献并不一致这一点。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether a model’s tool choice is already encoded in its internal activations before the tool name is emitted, and whether that representation can be read or steered.
summary_en.importance: The main value is for understanding the interface between pretraining, instruction tuning, and tool-use behavior. The results suggest that pretrained models already contain a strong latent signal for tool identity, while instruction tuning largely makes that signal accessible to the output head. This is useful for tool-use monitoring, but also for understanding how post-training routes existing representations into executable actions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is mean-difference steering. For each tool, the authors average hidden activations over example queries, then use the difference between two tool means as an intervention direction. Adding this vector to the residual stream can switch the selected tool. The paper combines this with PCA, matched-prompt controls, activation patching, and circuit tracing. A useful observation is that changing the emitted tool name is often enough: the subsequent JSON arguments autoregressively adapt to the new tool schema.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers 12 instruction-tuned models from Gemma 3, Qwen 3/Qwen 2.5, and Llama 3.1, ranging from 270M to 27B parameters. On name-only single-turn prompts, mean-difference steering switches the selected tool with 77–100% accuracy, and models at 4B or larger reach 93–100%. Short tool descriptions give little additional benefit for larger models and can hurt some sub-1B models. PCA over 15 tool means appears low-dimensional, but matched-prompt controls show similarly compact spectra with k90=7–9, so the low rank is not purely a tool-specific subspace. With 200 ToolBench APIs, 36 directions explain most variance, while the matched control has k90=39. For error prediction, small internal margins between the top two tools correspond to 14–21x higher error rates on Gemma 3 12B and 27B. Base models show a strong hidden signal: Gemma 3 4B base generates the correct BFCL v3 tool only about 3% of the time, but nearest-mean readout from activations recovers 75%; other Gemma and Llama base models show 56–72 point gaps. Circuit evidence suggests little stable structure at 270M, emergence around 1B, and sharper circuits after instruction tuning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–45 minutes. Start with Section 4.1 for the PCA results and the matched-prompt controls. Then read Section 4.4 for the steering experiments and schema-following behavior. Section 4.5 is the most relevant part for scaling behavior. Section 4.2 and Table 26 are useful if the goal is mechanistic analysis, especially because attention and MLP contributions differ across model families.

recommendation.zh: 读 §实验和激活干预部分就够；若结果稳，tool routing 可从黑盒日志诊断推进到内部 margin 监控。
recommendation.en: Read the experiments and intervention sections; if robust, tool routing can move from black-box log debugging to internal-margin monitoring.

paper.title: When Routine Chats Turn Toxic: Unintended Long-Term State Poisoning in Personalized Agents
paper.abstract: Personalized LLM agents maintain persistent cross-session state to support long-horizon collaboration. Yet, this persistence introduces a subtle but critical security vulnerability: routine user-agent interactions can gradually reshape an agent's long-term state, inadvertently weakening future confirmation boundaries, expanding tool-use defaults, and escalating autonomous behavior over time. We formalize this risk as \textbf{unintended long-term state poisoning}. To systematically study it, we i

summary.core_problem: 研究个性化 agent 的持久跨会话状态会如何在日常交互中被逐步“污染”，导致授权边界、工具使用和自主性长期漂移。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是安全 benchmark 与问题定义。它把一次性 prompt injection 之外的慢性状态污染单独提出，并给出状态中心的 Harm Score，这对长期记忆 agent 的训练和评测都有参考价值，但离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 作者形式化 unintended long-term state poisoning，构建 ULSPB：覆盖 5 类助手场景、7 种交互模式、24 轮 routine interaction，并配有 matched single-injection 对照。评测指标 Harm Score 分解为 authorization drift、tool-use escalation、unchecked autonomy 三部分，用于量化长期状态偏移的风险。
summary.experiments: 在 OpenClaw 上评测 4 个 backbone LLM。摘要表明长期、日常式交互能比单次注入更隐蔽地改变后续行为边界，但未在摘要中给出具体模型名和完整数值。实验价值主要在 benchmark 设计和对照设置，而不是算法突破。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自香港理工大学、香港科技大学及港科大（广州）。属于 agent 安全与长期记忆评测方向。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how persistent cross-session state in personalized agents can be gradually poisoned through routine interactions, causing long-term drift in authorization boundaries, tool use, and autonomy.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a security benchmark and problem formulation. It isolates chronic state poisoning from one-shot prompt injection and introduces a state-centric Harm Score. This matters for long-memory agents, though it is only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formalize unintended long-term state poisoning and build ULSPB, a bilingual benchmark spanning five assistant categories, seven interaction patterns, 24-turn routine interactions, and matched single-injection controls. Harm Score decomposes risk into authorization drift, tool-use escalation, and unchecked autonomy.
summary_en.experiments: They evaluate on OpenClaw with four backbone LLMs. The abstract suggests that routine long-horizon interactions can more subtly reshape future behavior than single injections, though the abstract does not provide the full model list or detailed numbers. The value is mostly in the benchmark design and control setup rather than a new algorithm.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, HKUST, and HKUST (Guangzhou). The work sits in agent safety and long-term memory evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但做长期记忆 agent 或 continual post-train 的人该记住这个 failure mode；读 benchmark 设计即可。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but if you work on long-memory agents or continual post-training, this failure mode is worth knowing; the benchmark design is the main thing to read.

institutions: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
