paper.title: Group of Skills: Group-Structured Skill Retrieval for Agent Skill Libraries
paper.abstract: Skill-augmented agents increasingly rely on large reusable skill libraries, but retrieving relevant skills is not the same as presenting usable context. Existing methods typically return atomic skills or dependency-aware bundles whose internal roles remain implicit, leaving the agent to infer the execution entry point, support skills, visible requirements, and failure-avoidance guidance. We introduce Group of Skills (GoSkills), an inference-time group-structured retrieval method that changes the

summary.core_problem: 解决技能库 agent 在检索阶段只返回原子技能列表，导致执行入口、支持技能、检查条件和规避信息都需要模型自行推断的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 agent inference-time 设计，不是基座模型研究。价值在于把 skill retrieval 的返回对象从平面列表改成带角色结构的执行上下文，对工具使用和规划接口设计有一点启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GoSkills：基于类型化技能图构建以 anchor 为中心的技能组，再通过 group graph 扩展支持组，最后压缩成有限原子技能载荷，并渲染为固定执行契约，包含 Start、Support、Check、Avoid 四类字段。整个方法不改下游 agent、本体技能或执行环境。
summary.experiments: 在 SkillsBench 和 ALFWorld 上验证。摘要强调其为 inference-time 方法，比较对象应是原子技能检索或依赖感知 bundle 检索，但未给出具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the mismatch between retrieving atomic skills and providing actually usable execution context for skill-library agents.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-interface paper, not foundation-model research. Its main value is the idea of changing the retrieval output from a flat list into a role-structured execution context, which may be mildly useful for tool-use interface design.
summary_en.technical_approach: GoSkills builds anchor-centered skill groups from a typed skill graph, expands support groups through a group graph, compresses the selected plan into a bounded set of atomic skill payloads, and renders a fixed execution contract with Start, Support, Check, and Avoid fields.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on SkillsBench and ALFWorld. The abstract positions it against atomic-skill retrieval and dependency-aware bundles, but does not provide concrete gains in the summary.

recommendation.zh: 偏 agent 工程，和 pretrain 关系不大；如果你关心 tool-use 接口，只看“固定执行契约”这个表示层设计，别花时间读全篇。
recommendation.en: Mostly agent engineering, not pretraining; if you care about tool-use interfaces, just inspect the fixed execution contract idea and skip the rest.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: Securing Computer-Use Agents: A Unified Architecture-Lifecycle Framework for Deployment-Grounded Reliability
paper.abstract: Computer-use agents(CUAs)are moving frombounded benchmarks toward real software environments, wherethey operate browsers, desktops, mobile applications, flesystems,terminals, and tool backends. In such settings, reliability isno longer captured by task success alone: perception errors,planning drift, memory use, tool mediation, permission scope,and runtime oversight jointly determine whether agent actionsremain aligned with user intent, Existing surveys organize theCUA landscape by methods, plat

summary.core_problem: 讨论 computer-use agents 在真实软件环境部署时，如何把能力形成、权限暴露、失败形态和控制位置放进同一个可靠性框架。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏综述和框架整理，不是新的训练方法或系统实现。价值在于把 CUA 的可靠性从单一任务成功率扩展到感知、规划、记忆、工具、权限和运行时监督的组合问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 architecture-lifecycle framework：架构上把 CUA 拆成 Perception、Decision、Execution 三层，生命周期上覆盖 Creation、Deployment、Operation、Maintenance 等阶段，用来定位风险来源和控制点。
summary.experiments: 摘要未显示实证实验或 benchmark 结果，主要是概念框架、威胁面和部署可靠性维度的组织。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自北京邮电大学；摘要中未能确认更具体的知名作者背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to reason about reliability of computer-use agents in real software environments where actions carry permissions and operational risk.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a survey/framework contribution rather than a new training or agent method. Its useful point is expanding reliability beyond task success to perception, planning drift, memory, tool mediation, permission scope, and runtime oversight.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes an architecture-lifecycle framework: Perception, Decision, and Execution form the architectural layers, while Creation, Deployment, Operation, and Maintenance define lifecycle stages where failures and controls can be placed.
summary_en.experiments: No concrete empirical benchmark or model-scale result is visible from the abstract; the work appears to be a conceptual and organizational framework.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications; no widely known author background can be confirmed from the provided information.

recommendation.zh: 可作 CUA 安全 checklist 备查；对预训练没有直接动作，不值得细读。
recommendation.en: Useful as a CUA safety checklist; it gives no direct pretraining lever, so keep it as background.

paper.title: Teaching Thinking Models to Reason with Tools: A Full-Pipeline Recipe for Tool-Integrated Reasoning
paper.abstract: Tool-integrated reasoning (TIR) offers a direct way to extend thinking models beyond the limits of text-only reasoning. Paradoxically, we observe that tool-enabled evaluation can degrade reasoning performance even when the strong thinking models make almost no actual tool calls. In this paper, we investigate how to inject natural tool-use behavior into a strong thinking model without sacrificing its no-tool reasoning ability, and present a comprehensive TIR recipe. We highlight that (i) the effe

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是强 thinking model 接入代码工具后不会自然学会“边想边用工具”的问题，并且工具提示本身还可能破坏原有的纯文本推理能力。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的价值主要在 post-train 与 reasoning policy 的接口。论文强调，工具能力不是简单靠 prompt 暴露执行器就能得到，也不是只靠少量工具轨迹 SFT 就能稳定注入。对基座研究员更有启发的是三点：训练数据要选择“工具确实有优势”的问题；SFT 的目标不应只看监督损失，而要看后续 RL 的可塑性；工具使用策略会干扰原有推理分布，需要通过混合 text-only 和 TIR 轨迹来控制遗忘。
summary.technical_approach:
论文提出一个完整的 TIR 训练流程，覆盖数据构造、SFT 程度选择、从 SFT 到 RL 的衔接，以及 RL 本身。

数据侧，作者区分普通难题和 tool-advantaged problems。后者更适合训练模型在中间步骤主动调用代码，因为纯文本推理成本高、容易出错，而代码执行能提供明确反馈。教师轨迹还要满足 learnability：学生模型不仅要看到工具调用格式，还要能学到何时调用、如何把输出纳入后续推理。为避免 thinking model 在工具格式下遗忘原有能力，SFT 数据混合了 TIR 轨迹和 text-only 轨迹。

训练侧，论文把 SFT 学习过程拆成 form、substance、noise 三个阶段。早期模型主要学格式，中期学到有效工具使用模式，过度训练则可能拟合教师噪声。作者因此不用单纯的 SFT loss 决定训练终点，而用 pass@k 和 rollout length 选择更适合后续 RL 的 checkpoint。

RL 侧，作者强调合适的 SFT 初始化和 on-policy 训练。奖励设计上不依赖格式奖励，而使用 outcome-based reward，并选择足够难的问题，让工具使用从解决任务的需要中自然出现。目标是让模型形成 interleaved tool use，而不是把代码执行器当作最后验算器。
summary.experiments:
引言中的诊断实验显示，直接给 Qwen3 thinking models 开工具并不能诱导有效工具使用。在 BeyondAIME 上，Qwen3-4B-Thinking 的 no-tool / tool-enabled 准确率为 54.3 / 50.3，Pass@4 为 66 / 62，平均工具调用仅 0.07 次，工具轨迹长度约 15.3k。Qwen3-30B-Thinking 的准确率为 66.0 / 58.0，Pass@4 为 79 / 68，平均工具调用为 0.00 次，长度约 17.1k。Qwen3-30B-Instruct 虽然会调用更多工具，平均 1.38 次，但准确率从 51.3 降到 39.5，Pass@4 从 66 降到 58。

这些数字说明两件事：thinking model 往往不调用工具，或者只在最后验证；instruct model 更容易按格式调用工具，但推理质量受扰动更明显。论文示例中的 BeyondAIME Burnside 计数题也展示了 delayed-code pattern：基线模型先用错误前提完成推导，最后调用 Python 只是验证错误假设；TRICE-30B 则把枚举、反射分类计数等步骤交给代码，得到正确答案 88。

提供的正文片段提到，TRICE-4B 和 TRICE-30B 在多类 benchmark 上评测，TRICE-30B 在某项结果中达到 96.7%，但完整 benchmark 名称、对比模型、训练数据规模和消融表未出现在片段中，不能进一步确认。
summary.reading_guide:
建议泛读，预计 30–40 分钟。优先看 Table 1 和 Figure 1，它们把“有工具但不会用”的问题讲得比较清楚。然后看数据工程部分，特别是 tool-advantaged problem 的筛选和 teacher trajectory 过滤标准。训练部分重点看 SFT checkpoint 如何用 pass@k 和 rollout length 选择，而不是只看 loss。RL 部分重点看 outcome-only reward 为什么能稳定工具使用，以及是否有对 format reward、SFT 训练步数、TIR/text-only 混合比例的消融。

对预训练研究员来说，最值得看的不是具体数学题成绩，而是训练分布如何改变 reasoning policy。这个问题和长 CoT、工具调用、RLVR、以及未来把工具反馈纳入更早训练阶段都有关。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why strong thinking models do not naturally learn interleaved tool use when given a code executor, and why tool-enabled prompting can even degrade their original text-only reasoning ability.
summary_en.importance: Its main relevance is the interface between post-training and reasoning policy. The paper shows that tool use is not obtained by simply exposing a sandbox, and that naive SFT on tool trajectories can disturb an existing thinking model. The useful lessons are concrete: train on problems where tools are genuinely helpful, mix tool-use and text-only trajectories to reduce forgetting, and choose SFT checkpoints by downstream RL potential rather than supervised loss alone.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper proposes a full pipeline for tool-integrated reasoning. It covers data construction, SFT, SFT-to-RL coordination, and RL.

On the data side, it emphasizes tool-advantaged problems: tasks where text-only reasoning is expensive or unreliable, and code execution provides clear intermediate feedback. Teacher trajectories are filtered not only for correctness but also for learnability. The student needs to learn when to call the tool and how to incorporate tool outputs, not just the syntax of calling a sandbox. The SFT mixture includes both TIR and text-only trajectories to avoid damaging the model’s original reasoning distribution.

On the training side, the paper describes SFT as moving through form, substance, and noise. Early training mainly teaches formatting, middle training teaches useful tool-use behavior, and excessive training may fit teacher artifacts. The SFT checkpoint is therefore selected using pass@k and rollout length, with downstream RL gains in mind.

For RL, the recipe relies on a suitable SFT initialization and on-policy training. It avoids explicit format rewards and uses outcome-based rewards on challenging questions, so tool use is encouraged by task success rather than by superficial formatting compliance.
summary_en.experiments:
The diagnostic results in the introduction are the key evidence. On BeyondAIME, directly enabling tools does not induce useful interleaved reasoning. Qwen3-4B-Thinking drops from 54.3 to 50.3 accuracy under tool-enabled evaluation, with Pass@4 dropping from 66 to 62, while making only 0.07 tool calls on average. Qwen3-30B-Thinking drops from 66.0 to 58.0 accuracy, with Pass@4 dropping from 79 to 68, and makes essentially no tool calls. Qwen3-30B-Instruct calls tools more often, 1.38 times on average, but its accuracy drops from 51.3 to 39.5.

These numbers separate two failure modes. Thinking models often ignore the tool or use it only as a late verifier. Instruct models are more willing to call tools, but their reasoning is more easily disrupted. The Burnside-counting example illustrates the delayed-code pattern: the baseline derives from flawed assumptions and calls Python only at the end, while TRICE-30B interleaves enumeration and reflection-counting calls with natural-language reasoning and obtains the correct answer, 88.

The provided text mentions TRICE-4B and TRICE-30B and reports a 96.7% result on one benchmark, but the excerpt does not include the full benchmark table, training scale, data size, or ablation numbers, so those details cannot be verified here.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim in 30–40 minutes. Start with Table 1 and Figure 1; they establish the failure mode clearly. Then read the data-engineering section, especially the definition and filtering of tool-advantaged problems and teacher trajectories. In the training section, focus on how SFT checkpoints are selected using pass@k and rollout length rather than loss alone. In the RL section, check the evidence for outcome-only reward and the ablations on format rewards, SFT duration, and the TIR/text-only mixture if available.

For pretraining-oriented readers, the important part is not the math benchmark score itself. The useful signal is how a post-training pipeline reshapes the model’s reasoning policy without erasing its original text-only capability.

recommendation.zh: 这不是新架构，但 pipeline taste 很像真做过系统实验；重点看 teacher 轨迹可学性和 tool/no-tool 配比，能直接指导你设计后训练混料。
recommendation.en: Not a new architecture, but it reads like people who actually ran the pipeline; focus on trajectory learnability and tool/no-tool mixture, which can directly inform post-training data design.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: Maximizing Rollout Informativeness under a Fixed Budget: A Submodular View of Tree Search for Tool-Use Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: We formalize Rollout Informativeness under a Fixed Budget (RIFB) as the expected non-vanishing policy-gradient mass that a tool-use rollout set injects into Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). We prove that any budget-agnostic independent sampler suffers a collapse rate bounded away from zero for hard prompts regardless of the budget. Motivated by this, we recast intermediate state selection as a monotone submodular maximization problem, where a greedy one-step selector enjoys a 1 minus 1

summary.core_problem: 在固定 rollout budget 下，如何为 tool-use agent 的 GRPO 训练选择更有信息量的树搜索 rollout，避免大量采样落在无梯度或低梯度信号上。
summary.importance: 贡献是 agentic RL 训练过程的目标重写和搜索策略设计：把 rollout informativeness 定义为能注入 GRPO 的非消失 policy-gradient mass，并用子模最大化解释预算分配、UCB 探索和 entropy bonus。对关心 RL 后训练信号质量的人有直接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文将 RIFB 形式化为固定预算下最大化有效梯度质量的问题，证明 budget-agnostic independent sampler 在 hard prompt 上存在 collapse rate 下界；随后把 intermediate state selection 转成 monotone submodular maximization，贪心 one-step selector 具有 1-1/e 近似保证。方法 InfoTree 结合 UUCB、learned Adaptive Budget Allocator 和 asynchronous Speculative Expansion，在训练时动态扩展更可能产生有效学习信号的 rollout tree。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型参数量、任务集合、baseline 名称或数值提升。可确认的实验主张是：ABA 用于补救初始树产生 uniform outcomes 的 prompt，UUCB 来自目标函数的闭式 marginal gain，而 speculative expansion 用于降低训练时树搜索开销。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Shanghai Jiao Tong University 和 Shanghai Maritime University；摘要信息不足以确认知名 LLM 预训练作者或代表性大模型技术报告背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to choose more informative tree-search rollouts for tool-use agent training under a fixed budget, so that GRPO receives non-vanishing gradient signal rather than wasted samples.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a training-objective and search-policy reformulation for agentic RL: rollout informativeness is defined as expected non-vanishing policy-gradient mass, and budget allocation, UCB exploration, and entropy bonuses are tied to a submodular objective. This is directly relevant to researchers who care about RL signal quality after pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: RIFB is formalized as maximizing useful gradient mass under a rollout budget. The paper proves that budget-agnostic independent samplers suffer a bounded-away-from-zero collapse rate on hard prompts, then casts intermediate-state selection as monotone submodular maximization with a 1-1/e greedy approximation. InfoTree combines UUCB, a learned Adaptive Budget Allocator, and asynchronous Speculative Expansion to expand rollout trees toward states likely to produce training signal.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, task suites, named baselines, or numerical gains. It does state that ABA rescues prompts whose initial trees produce uniform outcomes, UUCB follows as a closed-form marginal gain, and speculative expansion is used to reduce training-time tree-search overhead.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Shanghai Jiao Tong University and Shanghai Maritime University; the provided information does not identify a well-known LLM pretraining author or major foundation-model technical report.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 RIFB 定义和 collapse 证明；若实验干净，应把 rollout budget 当训练信号分配问题复现。
recommendation.en: Read the RIFB definition and collapse proof; if the experiments are clean, rollout budget should be treated as training-signal allocation.

paper.title: TACT: Mitigating Overthinking and Overacting in Coding Agents via Activation Steering
paper.abstract: When language model agents tackle complex software engineering tasks, they often degrade over long trajectories, which we define as *agent drift*. We focus on two recurring failure modes *overthinking* and *overacting*, i.e., where the agent repeatedly reasons over information it already has, and where it issues tool calls without integrating recent observations or acquiring new evidence. In this paper, we introduce TACT (Think-Act Calibration via activation Steering), to detect and mitigate age

summary.core_problem: 长程编码Agent执行复杂软件工程任务时会出现轨迹推进过程中的性能退化（Agent漂移），具体表现为对已有信息重复推理的过度思考、不整合观测就盲目调用工具的过度行动两类失效模式；现有干预均为行为层面的黑盒调整，只能在失效发生后补救，无法在行为显现前提前修正。
summary.importance: 将表示工程方法引入Agent长程轨迹校准场景，证明Agent的步骤级校准状态可在Transformer残差流中线性区分，为Agent推理过程的底层干预提供了新路径，对预训练后模型的推理控制、Agent行为对齐研究有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出三阶段TACT流程：1）设计带滚动状态审计的LLM-as-judge标注管线，结合全轨迹上下文标注每一步为过度思考、过度行动或校准状态；2）提取标注步骤的</think>token隐藏态，用平衡均值差法计算两类漂移的对比方向轴，经Gram-Schmidt正交化后实现独立引导；3）测试时将每步隐藏态投影到两个轴上，漂移超过阈值时沿对应轴反向调整残差流，无需微调或修改提示词。
summary.experiments: 在SWE-bench Verified、Terminal-Bench 2.0、CLAW-Eval三个编码Agent基准上测试，Qwen3.5-27B的任务解决率提升5.8个百分点，Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it提升4.8个百分点，解决问题所需步数最多降低26%；标注步骤的隐藏态聚类AUC约0.9，验证了线性可分性。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第3节的标注管线设计和第4节的激活轴提取方法，附录的标注质量校验部分可快速浏览，总阅读时间约20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-horizon coding agents suffer from performance degradation over extended trajectories (agent drift) when tackling complex software engineering tasks, manifesting as two failure modes: overthinking (repeated reasoning over already acquired information) and overacting (issuing tool calls without integrating recent observations). Existing behavioral black-box interventions can only remediate failures after they occur, rather than correcting issues before behavioral manifestation.
summary_en.importance: This work applies representation engineering to agent trajectory calibration, proving that step-level calibration states of agents are linearly separable in transformer residual streams. It provides a new path for low-level intervention of agent reasoning processes, and offers reference for inference control of post-pretrain models and agent behavior alignment research.
summary_en.technical_approach: The three-stage TACT pipeline includes three steps: 1) An LLM-as-judge annotation pipeline with rolling state audit labels each trajectory step as overthinking, overacting, or calibrated, considering full trajectory context instead of isolated steps; 2) Hidden states of the </think> token from labeled steps are extracted, two contrastive drift axes are computed via the balanced mean-difference method, then orthogonalized via Gram-Schmidt for independent steering; 3) At test time, hidden states of each step are projected onto the two axes; when drift exceeds a threshold, the residual stream is adjusted backward along the corresponding axis, with no fine-tuning or prompt modification required.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on three coding agent benchmarks: SWE-bench Verified, Terminal-Bench 2.0, and CLAW-Eval. It improves resolve rate by 5.8 pp on Qwen3.5-27B and 4.8 pp on Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it, and reduces steps-to-resolve by up to 26%. The hidden states of labeled steps achieve a clustering AUC of ~0.9, verifying linear separability of the three states.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the annotation pipeline design and Section 4 for activation axis extraction. The annotation quality validation in the appendix can be skimmed. Total reading time is around 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 hidden-state 线性分离和 steering ablation；若 AUC 跨模型成立，会改变对 agent drift 的归因。
recommendation.en: Read the hidden-state separability and steering ablations; if the AUC transfers across models, it changes how to attribute agent drift.

paper.title: MAS-Algorithm: A Workflow for Solving Algorithmic Programming Problems with a Multi-Agent System
paper.abstract: Algorithmic problem solving serves as a rigorous testbed for evaluating structured reasoning in AI coding systems, as it directly reflects a model's ability to perform structured reasoning in complex scenarios.Existing approaches predominantly rely on model-centric strategies, such as architectural modifications and data scaling, which are costly and offer limited interpretability. Alternative methods leveraging external tools or prompting techniques (e.g., chain-of-thought) are often fragmented

summary.core_problem: 用多智能体工作流解决算法竞赛式编程题，目标是把解题、验证、工具调用和修正过程结构化。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是系统/工作流设计，不是模型预训练或代码模型训练方法；价值主要在于观察复杂编程任务中如何拆分 reasoning pipeline，对 coding agent 评测和工具编排有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: MAS-Algorithm 模仿竞赛选手和算法工程师的解题流程，将端到端求解拆成多个模块阶段，由不同 agent 负责理解题意、设计算法、生成代码、调用工具、检查和迭代修正。方法更偏工程编排和 prompting/workflow 设计，而非新模型架构。
summary.experiments: 摘要被截断，未能确认具体 benchmark、模型规模、baseline 和提升幅度。根据摘要，只能确认论文声称该流程可泛化到多种算法问题类型，并强调结构化推理和工具集成。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自北京大学和华中科技大学；方向与代码智能、软件工程 agent 相关。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles competitive-programming-style algorithmic problem solving with a structured multi-agent workflow.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly a system/workflow design rather than a pretraining or code-model training method. The useful part is how it decomposes long-horizon coding reasoning into inspectable stages with tools and revision loops.
summary_en.technical_approach: MAS-Algorithm imitates how competitive programmers and algorithm engineers solve tasks, splitting the pipeline into modular stages for problem understanding, algorithm design, code generation, tool use, validation, and repair. The method is closer to agent orchestration and prompting than to a new model architecture.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract is truncated, so the exact benchmarks, model sizes, baselines, and gains are not available. The abstract only indicates that the workflow is evaluated across diverse algorithmic problem types and is designed for extensibility.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Peking University and Huazhong University of Science and Technology, with a focus aligned with code intelligence and software-engineering agents.

recommendation.zh: 作为 coding-agent workflow 备查即可；若没有干净 ablation，别把提升归因到多智能体本身。
recommendation.en: Useful as a coding-agent workflow reference; without clean ablations, do not attribute gains to multi-agent structure itself.

paper.title: Superintelligent Retrieval Agent: The Next Frontier of Information Retrieval
paper.abstract: Retrieval-augmented agents are increasingly the interface to large organizational knowledge bases, yet most still treat retrieval as a black box: they issue exploratory queries, inspect returned snippets, and iteratively reformulate until useful evidence emerges. This approach resembles how a newcomer searches an unfamiliar database rather than how an expert navigates it with strong priors about terminology and likely evidence, and results in unnecessary retrieval rounds, increased latency, and

summary.core_problem: 这项工作处理的是 RAG agent 的检索接口问题：现有 agent 往往把检索器当作黑盒，通过多轮查询、阅读片段、再改写查询来逼近答案。这种流程把很多信息发现工作放在交互过程中，导致检索轮数多、延迟高，也容易漏掉真正有区分度的证据。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值有限，但对 LLM 作为检索控制器的设计有启发。重点不在训练一个新基座模型，而在说明：当 LLM 接外部知识库时，检索能力不只取决于语义相似度，也取决于能否利用语料级统计信号，例如稀有术语、约束词、排除条件和字段结构。这个角度对 RAG 数据构造、agentic search 训练信号、以及 retrieval-aware post-training 有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: SIRA 的核心思路是把多轮探索压缩成一次“语料判别性”的检索动作。它不是只问哪些词与用户问题语义相关，而是问哪些词能让目标证据在当前语料库中排在干扰文档前面。方法倾向于重新利用 BM25 这类可控、可解释的词项检索：LLM 负责提出稀有且有区分度的关键词、约束、拆解子查询和可能的排除条件；BM25/词项统计负责把这些词映射到可审计的排序信号。与纯 dense retrieval 相比，这种设计牺牲了一部分端到端语义匹配的便利性，但换来更强的可控性：agent 可以显式调整关键词、强化必须匹配的概念、避免高频泛词，并利用 IDF 让领域术语发挥作用。
summary.experiments: 从给出的正文内容看，实验细节和具体数值不足以完整判断。引言主要建立问题设定：多轮 ReAct/IRCoT 类检索 agent 依赖检索上下文积累，dense retrieval 的单向量表示对组合约束和排除条件支持弱，BM25 的 IDF 和可解释性更适合让 LLM 进行可控检索。泛读时需要确认实验是否真正比较了单次 SIRA 检索与多轮 agentic retrieval，在召回率、检索轮数、延迟和证据覆盖上的差异；也需要看它是否在不同语料库和复杂约束查询上稳定成立。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。优先看方法部分如何定义“corpus-discriminative retrieval action”，以及 LLM 到 BM25 查询/约束的具体生成格式。实验部分重点看三点：是否有强 BM25、dense retriever、hybrid retriever、多轮 ReAct/IRCoT 的公平对照；是否报告检索轮数和延迟，而不只报告最终 QA 分数；失败案例是否来自 LLM 生成错误术语、语料术语不匹配，还是 BM25 无法覆盖语义改写。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a retrieval-interface bottleneck in RAG agents. Most agents treat retrieval as a black box: they issue a query, inspect snippets, and repeat. This makes the agent learn the corpus through interaction, which increases latency and still leaves recall fragile when the useful evidence requires rare terminology or explicit constraints.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is not a pretraining method, but it is relevant to retrieval-aware LLM systems. The useful point is the shift from semantic relevance to corpus discrimination. For an LLM-controlled retriever, the key question is not only which terms are related to the user request, but which terms make the desired evidence outrank plausible distractors in the target index. This matters for RAG data design, search-agent training signals, and post-training setups where the model must learn how to control retrieval tools rather than merely call them.
summary_en.technical_approach: SIRA aims to compress multi-round exploratory search into one discriminative retrieval action. The method leans on classical lexical retrieval, especially BM25-style signals, because they expose controllable primitives: keyword boosting, hard constraints, exclusions, decomposition, and IDF-driven rare-term weighting. The LLM supplies expert vocabulary and constraints; the lexical retriever turns them into transparent ranking behavior. Compared with dense retrieval, this gives up some convenience of single-vector semantic matching, but provides better handles for compositional requests and auditability.
summary_en.experiments: The available text mainly covers the motivation and system framing, not enough concrete experimental numbers to assess the empirical strength. The key claims to verify in the experimental sections are whether one-shot SIRA improves recall or answer accuracy over dense, BM25, hybrid, and multi-round agentic baselines; whether it reduces retrieval calls and latency; and whether gains hold for long, constrained, or jargon-heavy queries rather than only for hand-picked examples.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Focus on the formal definition of a corpus-discriminative retrieval action, the prompt or policy used to generate BM25 queries and constraints, and the baseline setup. The most important empirical details are retrieval-call budget, latency accounting, recall at fixed depth, and failure analysis. The paper is less useful if the evaluation only reports final QA accuracy without isolating retrieval quality.

recommendation.zh: 读方法定义和实验表就够了；它对 RAG policy 有味道，但离预训练信号质量还有一层。
recommendation.en: Read the method definition and results table; the RAG-policy idea is clean, but it is still one step away from pretraining signal quality.

institutions: click standard result links substantially less often (Pew Research Center

paper.title: SkillRet: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Skill Retrieval in LLM Agents
paper.abstract: As LLM agents are increasingly deployed with large libraries of reusable skills, selecting the right skill for a user request has become a critical systems challenge. In small libraries, users may invoke skills explicitly by name, but this assumption breaks down as skill ecosystems grow under tight context and latency budgets. Despite its practical importance, skill retrieval remains underexplored, with limited benchmarks and little understanding of retrieval behavior on realistic skill librarie

summary.core_problem: LLM Agent生态中可复用技能库规模持续扩大，现有依赖显式命名或全量上下文加载的技能调用方式不再可行，技能检索成为规模化Agent系统的核心瓶颈，但该领域缺乏大规模、公开的专用评测基准，现有工作多关注端到端执行而非检索本身。
summary.importance: 填补了Agent技能检索领域的基准空白，为技能检索模型的训练、评测以及规模化Agent系统的检索层设计提供了标准化数据集和基线参考。
summary.technical_approach: 从公开Agent技能市场爬取22795条技能，经过质量过滤、去重、多轮校验得到17810条高质量可复用技能，构建包含63259条训练样本、4997条评测样本的数据集，标注二级分类标签（6大类18小类），支持技能检索任务的细粒度分析。
summary.experiments: 1. 现有通用检索模型在技能检索任务上表现有限，说明技能检索是独立于通用文本检索、工具检索的专门任务；2. 在SkillRet训练集上做任务特定微调可带来显著性能提升，小参数微调模型的表现可匹配甚至超过大参数通用检索模型；3. 重排序的收益取决于第一阶段检索的性能上限，当基础检索模型足够强时，重排序的边际收益快速下降；4. 微调模型的性能提升主要来自对长查询中少量与技能相关的关键句子的精准聚焦。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看基准构建流程、核心实验结论部分，预计阅读时间15分钟；如需构建相关检索系统可参考附录的数据集字段说明与基线实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: As reusable skill libraries for LLM agents grow continuously, existing skill invocation methods relying on explicit naming or full context loading become infeasible. Skill retrieval has become a core bottleneck for large-scale agent systems, but there is a lack of large-scale, public dedicated evaluation benchmarks in this field, and most existing work focuses on end-to-end execution rather than retrieval itself.
summary_en.importance: Fills the benchmark gap in agent skill retrieval. Provides a standardized dataset and baseline reference for training and evaluating skill retrieval models, as well as designing retrieval layers for large-scale agent systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: Crawls 22,795 skills from public agent skill marketplaces, obtains 17,810 high-quality reusable skills through quality filtering, deduplication, and multi-round validation. Constructs a dataset with 63,259 training samples and 4,997 evaluation samples, annotated with two-level taxonomy labels (6 major categories, 18 sub-categories) to support fine-grained analysis of skill retrieval tasks.
summary_en.experiments: 1. Existing general retrieval models have limited performance on skill retrieval tasks, indicating that skill retrieval is a specialized task independent of general text retrieval and tool retrieval. 2. Task-specific fine-tuning on the SkillRet training set brings significant performance gains, and small fine-tuned models can match or even outperform much larger general retrieval models. 3. The benefit of reranking depends on the performance headroom of the first-stage retriever; when the base retriever is strong enough, the marginal benefit of reranking drops rapidly. 4. The performance improvement of fine-tuned models mainly comes from accurate focusing on a small number of skill-relevant key sentences in long queries.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the benchmark construction pipeline and core experimental conclusions for skimming, with an estimated reading time of 15 minutes. For building related retrieval systems, refer to the dataset field descriptions and baseline implementation details in the appendix.

recommendation.zh: 只看数据构造和 disjoint skill pool 设定即可；它不改预训练方法，但会影响工具/技能接口如何进后训练数据。
recommendation.en: Read the dataset construction and disjoint skill-pool setup; it does not change pretraining, but it informs how tool and skill interfaces should enter post-training data.

paper.title: AgenticRAG: Agentic Retrieval for Enterprise Knowledge Bases
paper.abstract: We present AgenticRAG, a practical agentic harness for retrieval and analysis over enterprise knowledge bases. Standard RAG pipelines place significant burden of grounding on the search stack, constraining the language model to a fixed candidate set chosen deep in the retrieval process. Our approach reduces this overdependence by layering a lightweight harness on top of existing enterprise search infrastructure, equipping a reasoning LLM with search, find, open, and summarize tools enabling the

summary.core_problem: 传统RAG采用静态的检索-生成范式，检索决策在推理开始前就已确定，LLM只能在预先选定的固定候选集内推理，无法处理需要多文档综合、迭代导航的复杂企业级信息查询需求。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于展示了推理侧工具编排与基座能力的配合边界：轻量工具 harness 无需模型微调即可大幅提升RAG性能，说明基座的规划与工具使用能力可以通过合理的系统设计释放，为预训练阶段的工具调用能力建模提供了目标参考。
summary.technical_approach: 在现有企业搜索基础设施之上构建轻量级智能体harness，为LLM配备4种工具：search（调用底层搜索栈进行全库文档发现，支持最多5次查询改写）、find（候选文档内精确检索）、open（候选文档全内容滚动窗口访问）、summarize（上下文超限触发，合并检索结果并保留引用）；实现有界迭代的智能体循环，自动维护对话状态、token计数和文档引用映射，支持多轮查询复用已检索内容，无需模型微调、自定义嵌入模型或图谱构建。
summary.experiments: 在三个公开基准上测试：BRIGHT基准recall@1达到49.6%，较最优嵌入基线提升21.8个百分点；WixQA基准事实性得分0.96，相对提升13%；FinanceBench基准答案正确率92%，与oracle访问的差距在2个百分点以内；完成工具贡献、多查询搜索效果、不同模型的检索策略差异的消融实验。
summary.reading_guide: 优先阅读方法章节的工具设计和迭代循环逻辑（第3节），其次实验部分的消融结果，总阅读时间约20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Traditional RAG adopts a static retrieve-then-generate paradigm, where retrieval decisions are finalized before reasoning starts. The LLM can only reason within a preselected fixed candidate set and cannot handle complex enterprise-level information query requirements that require multi-document synthesis and iterative navigation.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, it demonstrates the boundary between inference-side tool orchestration and base model capabilities: a lightweight tool harness can significantly improve RAG performance without model fine-tuning, indicating that the base model's planning and tool use capabilities can be unleashed through reasonable system design, providing a target reference for modeling tool call capabilities during pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: A lightweight agent harness is built on top of existing enterprise search infrastructure, equipping the LLM with four tools: search (delegates to the underlying search stack for full-library document discovery, supports up to 5 query reformulations), find (precision retrieval within candidate documents), open (rolling window access to full content of candidate documents), and summarize (triggered when context exceeds limit, consolidates retrieval results while preserving citations). A bounded iterative agent loop is implemented, which automatically maintains conversation state, token accounting, and document reference mappings, supports reuse of retrieved content for multi-turn queries, and requires no model fine-tuning, custom embedding models, or graph construction.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on three public benchmarks: recall@1 reaches 49.6% on the BRIGHT benchmark, 21.8 percentage points higher than the best embedding baseline; factuality score is 0.96 on the WixQA benchmark, a 13% relative improvement; answer accuracy is 92% on the FinanceBench benchmark, within 2 percentage points of oracle access. Ablation experiments on tool contribution, effect of multi-query search, and differences in retrieval strategies across models are completed.
summary_en.reading_guide: Prioritize the tool design and iterative loop logic in the method section (Section 3), then the ablation results in the experiment section, with a total reading time of about 20 minutes.

recommendation.en: Microsoft's practical scheme combining agent tool use with enterprise RAG; architecture and ablation analysis are informative for agent system design. Skim methods and experiments.

paper.title: 即可阅读笔记。
paper.abstract: 大模型知识分享 清华大学 关注 谷歌SkillOS：让自进化Agent学会skill策展 LLM Agent 正越来越多地被用来处理流式任务，但通常解决的是一次性问题，无法从过往交互中学习。 从经验中提炼出的可复用 skills 为自进化提供了基础，而高质量技能策展（skills curation）依然是关键瓶颈。现有方法要么依赖人工 skills curation、规定启发式 skills 操作，要么针对短程 skills 操作进行训练，仍难以从间接的、延迟的反馈中学习复杂的长期 curation 策略。 为应对这一挑战，谷歌团队及其合作者提出了一个经验驱动的 RL 训练方案 SkillOS，用于在自进化 Agent 中学习 skills curation。SkillOS 将一个冻结的 Agent 执行器（负责检索和应用技能）与一个可训练的 skills 策展器（负责从积累的经验中更新外部 SkillRepo）配对。 为给 curation 过程提供学习信号，他们设计了复合奖励机制，并基于 skills 相关的任务依赖关系，对分组任务流进行训练：前期轨迹更新 SkillRepo，而后

summary.core_problem: 讨论自进化 LLM Agent 在流式任务中如何从历史交互里学习“可复用技能”，并把技能策展（skills curation）从人工/启发式规则推进到可学习的长期策略。
summary.key_insights: 介绍 Google 的 SkillOS：将冻结的执行器（检索/应用技能）与可训练的策展器（更新外部 SkillRepo）解耦；用复合奖励为策展提供学习信号，并用“前期轨迹更新技能库、后期相关任务评估更新效果”的分组任务流来解决延迟反馈下的 credit assignment；宣称在多轮 agentic 任务与单轮推理任务上同时提升有效性与效率，并且策展器可跨执行器骨干与任务域泛化；观察到 SkillRepo 中的技能随时间演化为结构更丰富的 Markdown/元技能，带来更有针对性的技能调用。
summary.limits: 内容看起来是二手笔记式复述，缺少关键实验细节（奖励构成、训练稳定性、对比基线强度、成本/样本效率、失败案例）与可复现信息；与“基座预训练”关联偏间接，更偏向 agent 记忆/工具/技能库的后训练与系统设计。

summary_en.core_problem: How to make self-improving LLM agents learn reusable skills from streaming interactions, focusing on learnable skill curation rather than manual or heuristic updates.
summary_en.key_insights: Summarizes Google SkillOS: decouples a frozen executor (retrieves/applies skills) from a trainable curator that updates an external SkillRepo; uses a composite reward and a grouped task-stream setup where early trajectories modify the repo and later related tasks evaluate those modifications, addressing delayed-feedback credit assignment; reports consistent gains in effectiveness and efficiency on multi-turn agentic tasks and single-turn reasoning tasks, with curator generalization across executor backbones and domains; notes the repo evolves into more structured Markdown-like artifacts encoding higher-level meta-skills.
summary_en.limits: Appears to be a secondary, high-level recap with limited methodological detail (reward design, training dynamics, baseline rigor, compute/sample efficiency, failure modes) and no reproducibility pointers; relevance to foundation-model pretraining is indirect, leaning more toward post-training/system-level agent learning.

paper.title: OpenSeeker-v2: Pushing the Limits of Search Agents with Informative and High-Difficulty Trajectories
paper.abstract: Deep search capabilities have become an indispensable competency for frontier Large Language Model (LLM) agents, yet their development remains dominated by industrial giants. The typical industry recipe involves a highly resource-intensive pipeline spanning pre-training, continual pre-training (CPT), supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL). In this report, we show that when fueled with informative and high-difficulty trajectories, a simple SFT approach could be surprisingly

summary.core_problem: 这项工作讨论一个很具体的问题：在不做大规模 CPT、复杂 SFT+RL 流水线的情况下，是否能仅靠高难度、高信息密度的轨迹数据，把 30B 级 ReAct 搜索 Agent 训练到接近工业系统的水平。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，它不是基座预训练方法论文。但它对 post-train 数据设计有参考价值：搜索能力的提升不一定来自更复杂的优化阶段，轨迹难度、证据密度、工具调用长度分布会显著影响 SFT 的上限。这个结论对 pretrain ↔ posttrain 接口有启发，尤其是如何用小规模高质量数据激活基座模型已有的搜索、规划和信息整合能力。
summary.technical_approach: 方法很简单，重点在数据合成。OpenSeeker-v2 沿用 ReAct 范式，让模型交替生成 reasoning trace、tool call 和 observation 后给出答案。相比 OpenSeeker-v1，主要改了三处。第一，扩大知识图谱子图的采样范围，从种子节点扩展到更大的局部证据图，让合成问题更容易依赖多节点、多跳证据，而不是单一网页或关键词检索。第二，扩大工具集合，使轨迹覆盖更多查询和交互模式，模型需要学习在不同工具之间选择，而不是只学固定搜索模板。第三，加入严格的低步数过滤，丢弃工具调用步数低于阈值的轨迹，避免训练集被直接查找型问题占据。最终训练目标仍是标准 SFT，没有引入 RL 或过程奖励。核心差异不在优化算法，而在把训练分布推向更长链路、更高信息密度的搜索行为。
summary.experiments: 实现上使用 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 作为基座，训练数据约 10k 条高难度轨迹，只进行一次 SFT。论文报告 OpenSeeker-v2 在四个搜索/Agent 评测上取得较强结果：BrowseComp 46.0%，BrowseComp-ZH 58.1%，Humanity’s Last Exam 34.6%，xbench 78.0%。作为对照，文中列出的 Tongyi DeepResearch 分别为 43.4%、46.7%、32.9%、75.0%。这些数字说明，小规模但严格筛选的长轨迹数据可以显著提高搜索 Agent 表现。需要注意的是，全文给出的消融信息较少，三项数据改动的独立贡献、步数阈值敏感性、工具集合大小与泛化之间的关系还没有充分拆开。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20 分钟。重点看 Methodology and Results 中三个数据合成改动：扩大图规模、扩大工具集合、低步数过滤。真正有用的信息是它如何定义“高难度轨迹”，以及为什么过滤短轨迹能改变 SFT 学到的行为分布。实验部分看四个 benchmark 的绝对值和与工业系统的对比即可。需要谨慎看待的是，论文更多证明了一个强数据配方的有效性，而不是证明 SFT 可以普遍替代 RL；如果没有轨迹质量控制和强基座模型，这个结论不应外推。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether a 30B-scale ReAct search agent can reach strong deep-search performance using only SFT, without large-scale continual pretraining, multi-stage alignment, or reinforcement learning, if the training trajectories are sufficiently difficult and information-rich.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, so its direct impact on foundation-model pretraining is limited. Its main value is in the design of post-training data. The results suggest that search-agent capability can be strongly affected by trajectory difficulty, evidence density, tool diversity, and the distribution of tool-call lengths. That is useful for thinking about the interface between pretraining and post-training: a capable base model may already contain much of the required reasoning and search prior, while carefully filtered SFT data can make those behaviors much more accessible.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method keeps the training objective simple and changes the data pipeline. OpenSeeker-v2 uses a ReAct-style format, where the model alternates between reasoning traces, tool calls, observations, and a final answer. Compared with the previous OpenSeeker pipeline, it introduces three data-side changes. First, it expands the source graph around each seed node, producing larger evidence subgraphs and making generated questions more likely to require multi-hop aggregation rather than shallow lookup. Second, it enlarges the tool set, exposing the model to more varied interaction patterns and forcing tool selection rather than memorization of a narrow search routine. Third, it applies strict low-step filtering, removing trajectories that can be solved with too few tool calls. The final model is trained with a standard SFT loss over the filtered trajectories. The main contribution is therefore a data recipe, not a new optimizer or RL algorithm.
summary_en.experiments: The reported implementation starts from Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 and trains on roughly 10k high-difficulty trajectories with a single SFT run. OpenSeeker-v2 reports 46.0% on BrowseComp, 58.1% on BrowseComp-ZH, 34.6% on Humanity’s Last Exam, and 78.0% on xbench. The paper compares these numbers with Tongyi DeepResearch at 43.4%, 46.7%, 32.9%, and 75.0%, respectively. The main empirical message is that a compact but aggressively filtered trajectory set can be enough to produce strong search-agent behavior. The limitation is that the ablation evidence appears thin: the separate effects of graph expansion, tool-set expansion, and low-step filtering are not fully isolated, and sensitivity to the minimum-step threshold is not deeply analyzed.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim read is enough; expect around 20 minutes. Focus on the methodology section, especially the three data modifications: larger evidence graphs, broader tool sets, and filtering out short trajectories. The useful part is the operational definition of high-difficulty search data and how it changes the SFT behavior distribution. The benchmark table is worth checking for absolute numbers and comparisons. The conclusion should be read carefully: the paper supports a strong SFT data recipe for search agents, but it does not show that SFT generally replaces RL under weaker base models or lower-quality trajectory generation.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改模型，只改训练信号；若 ablation 干净，它会直接动摇“search agent 必须 RL/CPT”的默认配方，先看数据过滤和对比设置，再决定是否复现。
recommendation.en: It changes the supervision, not the model; if the ablations are clean, it weakens the default belief that strong search agents require CPT/RL—read the data filtering and comparison setup first.

commentary.article_title: 纯 SFT 超越复杂训练
commentary.article_excerpt: 小机器人儿 关注 纯 SFT 超越复杂训练？OpenSeekerv2 来了！ 前沿 Search Agent 的构建，长期被视为只有大厂才能承担的系统工程：模型需要经历预训练、CPT、SFT 与 RL 等多阶段训练，背后依赖的是大规模数据、高昂算力和复杂工程体系。 我们刚刚挂出的report证明了：“只要数据足够高质量，纯 SFT 也能做出同规模 SOTA Search Agent。” 🔥 OpenSeeker-v2 的核心亮点： OpenSeeker由纯学术团队打造，仅用10.6k高难度轨迹数据 + 纯 SFT，就超越了采用 CPT + SFT + RL 复杂训练流程的 30B 级 Search Agent 📈 核心结果： OpenSeeker-v2-30B-SFT 取得： BrowseComp：46.0% BrowseComp-ZH：58.1% Humanity’s Last Exam：34.6% xbench：78.0% 全面超过阿里Tongyi DeepResearch和小红书REDSearcher的CPT+SFT+RL训练结果。（注：仅对比同等 30B 级纯 ReAct Agent，不含 context management、test-time scaling 等增强方法。） 🧠 为什么纯 SFT 也能取得SOTA？ OpenSeeker-v2 的关键不在于训练流程更复杂，而在于尽量提升 SFT 数据本身的质量、难度和可扩展性，这次主要对数据构建方式做了三处简单、但影响显著的调整： - 扩大合成QA的Graph规模：提升合成QA难度，增加搜索探索深度 - 扩展工具集规模：增强 Agent 功能边界 - 严格低步数过滤：保留更高信息密度、更高难度的专家轨迹 我们认为，OpenSeeker-v2 不只是一个结果，也提供了一条值得继续探索的路线： 在 Search Agent 训练中，高质量数据合成本身可能还有较大的 scaling 空间。 🚀 OpenSeeker-v2 模型已开源，代码近期也将开源 - Model: https://huggingface.co/PolarSeeker/OpenSeeker- v2-30B-SFT - Paper: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2605.04036 - GitHub: https://github.com/PolarSeeker/OpenSeeker #大模型 #Deepresearch #SearchAgent #论文分享 #AI科研 #llm #深度搜索 #BrowseComp #深度学习 4天前

paper.title: Agentic Vulnerability Reasoning on Windows COM Binaries
paper.abstract: Windows Component Object Model (COM) services run with elevated privileges and are widely accessible to authenticated users, making race conditions in these binaries a critical surface for local privilege escalation. We present SLYP, an end-to-end agentic pipeline that discovers race condition vulnerabilities in COM binaries and generates debugger-verified proof-of-concept (PoC) code. SLYP exposes binary exploration, COM inspection, and dynamic debugging as reusable tool interfaces, giving agent

summary.core_problem: 让LLM代理在Windows COM二进制上端到端发现竞态漏洞，并生成可被调试器验证的PoC代码。
summary.importance: 属于“工具化+反馈闭环”的安全代码代理系统；对预训练本身不直接，但对“可验证反馈信号如何塑形代理行为”有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: SLYP 将二进制探索、COM检查、动态调试封装为可复用工具接口；代理利用静态上下文、COM激活元数据与调试器反馈，从发现到PoC验证形成闭环。
summary.experiments: 20个COM对象、40个漏洞案例基准上F1=0.973；相对生产级coding agents最高+0.208 F1；相对SOTA静态分析器bug发现提升3.3x；默认不带工具的生产代理几乎无法验证PoC。
summary.authors_note: UIUC（University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign）团队工作。

summary_en.core_problem: Enable an LLM agent to discover race-condition vulnerabilities in Windows COM binaries and generate debugger-verified PoC code end-to-end.
summary_en.importance: A tool-augmented, feedback-closed-loop security coding-agent system; not pretraining, but informative on how verifiable feedback signals shape agent behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: SLYP exposes binary exploration, COM inspection, and dynamic debugging as reusable tool interfaces; the agent uses static context, COM activation metadata, and debugger feedback to iterate from discovery to verified PoC generation.
summary_en.experiments: On 20 COM objects / 40 vulnerability cases: F1=0.973; up to +0.208 F1 over production coding agents; 3.3× bug discovery over an SOTA static analyzer; without tools, production agents verify essentially no PoCs.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign (UIUC).

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文，但“调试器可验证反馈+工具接口”把代理从嘴炮拉回可执行；只看工具抽象与失败案例分析就够。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but debugger-verifiable feedback plus tool interfaces meaningfully constrain agents; read the tool abstraction and failure analysis, skip the rest.

paper.title: OpenSearch-VL: An Open Recipe for Frontier Multimodal Search Agents
paper.abstract: Deep search has become a crucial capability for frontier multimodal agents, enabling models to solve complex questions through active search, evidence verification, and multi-step reasoning. Despite rapid progress, top-tier multimodal search agents remain difficult to reproduce, largely due to the absence of open high-quality training data, transparent trajectory synthesis pipelines, or detailed training recipes. To this end, we introduce OpenSearch-VL, a fully open-source recipe for training fr

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个很具体、也很难复现的问题：如何用开放数据和开放训练流程，把多模态 deep search agent 训练到接近前沿闭源系统的水平。难点不在单轮 VQA，而在长轨迹、多工具、图像证据不完美、检索链条多跳、以及 RL 训练中频繁出现的工具失败。全文围绕三个瓶颈展开：高质量多跳图文搜索数据从哪里来；工具环境如何覆盖真实视觉输入中的预处理需求；长轨迹 agentic RL 遇到中途 fatal failure 时，怎样保留前半段有效学习信号而不过度污染梯度。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接相关性不如纯预训练论文强，但它在 pretrain↔post-train 接口上有实质信息量，尤其适合关注 tool-use、agentic RL、数据合成和多模态训练配方的人。价值主要有三点。第一，它把“搜索能力”拆成了可训练的数据结构，而不是只靠人工标注或闭源轨迹蒸馏，这对后续构造知识密集型多模态训练集有参考意义。第二，它提出的 fatal-aware RL 处理长轨迹失败的方式很工程化，也很贴近真实 agent 训练中的噪声来源。第三，它把视觉预处理工具和检索工具放进同一决策回路，说明多模态 agent 的瓶颈不只是 reasoning，也包括输入清洗和证据可读性。贡献量级在 agent 方向里算扎实，尤其因为数据、代码、模型都计划开放；但如果只从“LLM 预训练新范式”看，它更偏 post-train/agent recipe，而不是基座建模本身。
summary.technical_approach: 技术方案由数据、工具、训练三部分组成。数据方面，作者从 Wikipedia hyperlink graph 出发采样多跳实体路径，再把中间实体改写成模糊描述，构造成需要逐步定位实体、验证证据、再继续搜索的图文问答样本。这里的关键不是简单把 wiki 页面转成 QA，而是通过 fuzzy entity rewriting 和过滤机制，尽量避免模型靠一步图像检索或表面匹配走捷径。作者还做了 source-anchor visual grounding，把问题和图像中的可见锚点、页面来源、后续检索链条绑定起来，提升训练轨迹的可执行性。最终形成两个数据集：SearchVL-SFT-36k 用于监督微调，SearchVL-RL-8k 用于 agentic RL。工具环境方面，除了常规 search，还加入 OCR、crop、sharpen、super-resolution、perspective correction 等视觉工具。这样设计的原因很直接：真实图片常常模糊、倾斜、分辨率低，若不先做视觉修复，后续检索查询本身就会失真。训练方面，作者基于 GRPO 做长轨迹多轮工具使用 RL，并针对 fatal failure 设计了两点改动。其一是 fatal-aware token masking：一旦某步工具调用彻底失败，后续无意义 token 不参与优化，避免错误后缀把梯度带偏。其二是 one-sided advantage clamping：保留失败前有价值的推理和动作片段，让部分成功轨迹仍能提供正向学习信号，而不是整条 rollout 作废。这个设计明显是在解决 agent RL 中 credit assignment 粗糙、失败传播过强的问题。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 7 个多模态 deep search benchmark，摘要里明确给出相对 Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B agentic baseline 的平均分从 47.8 提升到 61.6，平均增幅 13.8 分。分项提升包括 VDR +13.3、MMSearch +24.5、FVQA +10.2、InfoSeek +16.2，说明收益不局限于单一数据集。模型名显示主力系统是 OpenSearch-VL-30B-A3B，底座应为 Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B。全文主张其在若干 benchmark 上可比甚至超过部分闭源商业模型，这一点如果精读时建议核对具体表格中的评测设置和是否使用相同工具预算。更值得看的是消融：数据构造中多跳路径采样、模糊实体改写、过滤策略分别贡献多少；工具集合里视觉预处理工具对低质图像样本的提升有多大；fatal-aware masking 与 one-sided advantage clamping 各自带来多少收益。就摘要和正文前半部分看，作者强调简单丢弃失败轨迹会浪费 pre-failure reasoning，而保留完整失败轨迹又会引入噪声，说明他们的 RL 改动在长轨迹任务上应当有稳定收益。若全文表格完整，建议重点核对成功率、平均工具步数、失败类型分布，以及 RL 前后在不同难度样本上的提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇值得精读，但要带着问题读。先看 Introduction 和方法总览，明确作者解决的是哪三类瓶颈：数据、工具、RL。然后重点读数据构造章节，尤其是 Wikipedia path sampling、fuzzy entity rewriting、source-anchor grounding 和过滤规则，因为这部分决定了模型学到的是“多跳搜索”还是“模板化检索”。接着读 RL 章节，重点看 fatal-aware token masking 和 one-sided advantage clamping 的公式、伪代码、以及失败轨迹示例。这里最值得深挖的是：他们如何定义 fatal failure，mask 到哪里为止，advantage clamp 是否会引入偏差，以及为什么不用更常见的 trajectory-level filtering。实验部分建议优先看主表、数据消融、工具消融、RL 消融，以及按图像质量或问题类型分组的结果。若时间有限，1 小时可抓住主线；若你做 agent RL 或多模态 post-train，建议花 2 小时把附录里的 prompt、工具接口、奖励设计和失败案例也看掉。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a concrete and difficult reproducibility problem: how to train a strong multimodal deep-search agent with an open recipe rather than proprietary data and hidden trajectories. The challenge is not single-turn VQA. It is long-horizon, tool-using search over imperfect visual inputs, multi-hop evidence chains, and reinforcement learning under frequent tool failures. The full paper is organized around three bottlenecks: how to build high-quality multimodal multi-hop search data, how to provide a tool environment that handles real visual noise before retrieval, and how to train with agentic RL when many rollouts become partially invalid after a fatal tool error.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper, but it is relevant at the pretrain/post-train interface, especially for researchers interested in tool use, agentic RL, multimodal data construction, and training recipes. Its main value comes from three places. First, it turns search capability into a data-generation problem with explicit structure, rather than relying only on manual annotation or closed trajectory distillation. That is useful for future knowledge-intensive multimodal training sets. Second, the fatal-aware RL design addresses a real failure mode in long-horizon agent training: useful reasoning often exists before a rollout collapses, and standard filtering wastes it. Third, the paper integrates visual preprocessing tools with retrieval tools in one decision loop, which is an important reminder that multimodal agent performance depends not only on reasoning but also on making evidence legible. The contribution is substantial within the agent setting, though it is better viewed as a post-training/agent recipe than as a new foundation-modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: The approach has three components: data, tools, and training. For data, the authors start from the Wikipedia hyperlink graph, sample multi-hop entity paths, and convert them into image-grounded question-answer instances by rewriting intermediate entities into fuzzy descriptions. This is meant to suppress shortcut behavior such as one-hop image lookup or direct string matching. They further add source-anchor visual grounding so that the question, visible image anchors, source pages, and downstream retrieval chain remain executable as a training trajectory. The resulting datasets are SearchVL-SFT-36k for supervised fine-tuning and SearchVL-RL-8k for agentic RL. For tools, the environment includes not only search but also OCR, cropping, sharpening, super-resolution, and perspective correction. That design choice is practical: many real images are blurry, skewed, low-resolution, or cluttered, so retrieval quality depends on visual cleanup before querying external knowledge. For training, the paper builds on GRPO for long-horizon multimodal tool use and introduces two modifications for fatal failures. Fatal-aware token masking removes invalid post-failure suffix tokens from optimization once a tool call irrecoverably fails. One-sided advantage clamping preserves useful pre-failure reasoning and action segments so partially successful rollouts still contribute learning signal. Together, these changes target a common agent-RL problem: coarse credit assignment under cascading failures.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers seven multimodal deep-search benchmarks. The headline result is an average score improvement from 47.8 to 61.6 over a Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B agentic baseline, a gain of 13.8 points. Reported benchmark gains include +13.3 on VDR, +24.5 on MMSearch, +10.2 on FVQA, and +16.2 on InfoSeek. The main model appears to be OpenSearch-VL-30B-A3B built on top of Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B. The paper also claims performance comparable to, and in some cases better than, proprietary commercial systems on several benchmarks; when reading closely, it is worth checking tool budgets and evaluation conditions for those comparisons. The most informative parts are likely the ablations: how much comes from multi-hop path sampling, fuzzy entity rewriting, and filtering in the data pipeline; how much the visual preprocessing tools help on degraded images; and how much each RL component contributes. The paper explicitly argues that discarding failed trajectories wastes useful pre-failure reasoning, while keeping full failed rollouts injects noisy gradients, so the RL modifications are intended to produce stable gains specifically in long-horizon settings. If the full tables are available, the most useful metrics to inspect are success rate, average number of tool steps, failure-type breakdown, and gains by difficulty or image quality.
summary_en.reading_guide: This one deserves a full read, but with a clear agenda. Start with the introduction and method overview to frame the three bottlenecks: data, tools, and RL. Then read the data-construction section carefully, especially Wikipedia path sampling, fuzzy entity rewriting, source-anchor grounding, and filtering rules. That part determines whether the model is learning genuine multi-hop search or just templated retrieval. Next, read the RL section in detail, focusing on the formal definition of fatal failure, the masking boundary, the one-sided advantage clamping rule, and the rollout examples. The key questions are why this is preferable to trajectory-level filtering, what bias the clamping may introduce, and how much useful signal survives after masking. In experiments, prioritize the main benchmark table, data ablations, tool ablations, RL ablations, and any breakdown by image quality or question type. About one hour is enough to get the main ideas; if you work on agent RL or multimodal post-training, two hours on the appendix is justified for prompts, tool interfaces, reward design, and failure cases.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但数据构造把“检索捷径”当训练信号问题来处理，这点很对；只看数据 pipeline 和 RL 设定，别被 agent 榜单带跑。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it treats retrieval shortcuts as a training-signal design problem, which is the right lens; read the data pipeline and RL setup, ignore the leaderboard theater.

institutions: and models to support open research on multimodal deep search agents
multimodal search agent research more transparent, reproducible, and accessible

paper.title: TSCG: Deterministic Tool-Schema Compilation for Agentic LLM Deployments
paper.abstract: Production agent frameworks (OpenAI Function Calling, Anthropic Tool Use, MCP) transmit tool schemas as JSON, a format designed for machine parsing, not for interpretation by language models. For small models (4B-14B), this protocol mismatch accounts for the majority of tool-use failure at production catalog sizes. We present TSCG, a deterministic tool-schema compiler that resolves this mismatch at the API boundary, converting JSON schemas into token-efficient structured text without model acces

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的不是“模型不会用工具”这个泛问题，而是一个更具体、也更工程化的瓶颈：生产环境里工具定义通常以 JSON Schema 形式注入上下文，但 JSON 的结构冗余、字段嵌套和 tokenizer 不友好表示，会让中小参数模型在工具目录稍大时迅速失效。论文把问题界定为 protocol mismatch，而不是单纯的 prompt compression：同样的语义，如果换一种更适合自回归模型读取的表示，工具调用准确率会显著恢复。这个界定比“压缩 token”更重要，因为作者后面用实验说明，性能提升主要来自表示形式变化，而不只是上下文变短。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身，它不是新训练目标或新架构论文，但对“模型如何消费结构化上下文”有直接启发。第一，它提醒人们：很多能力退化并不来自模型参数不足，而来自输入协议与 AR transformer 的读取机制不匹配。第二，它把 tokenizer、位置偏置、attention sink、recency bias 这些通常在预训练里讨论的机制，落到了一个可部署的 schema 编译器上。第三，它给出一个很清楚的信号：如果未来要做原生 agentic pretrain，训练数据里的工具表示格式、结构化文本规范、以及模型对 schema 的读取习惯，可能和模型规模一样关键。贡献量级更像“强工程方法 + 机制化分析 + benchmark”，不是范式级建模创新，但在小模型 agent 部署场景里影响是实打实的。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 TSCG，一个确定性的 tool-schema compiler。输入是标准 JSON schema，输出是 token-efficient 的结构化文本表示；不需要访问模型参数，不做微调，也不做运行时搜索。作者把整个系统拆成 8 个可组合算子，并按固定顺序组成 10 步 pipeline。设计思路很明确：不是学习一个 schema rewriter，而是把若干已知的 transformer 读取偏好编码成规则。

几类关键算子分别对应不同机制。第一类是纯压缩型变换，如 delimiter 选择、删除 filler token、把冗长结构短语替换成紧凑分隔符。这部分利用的是 BPE 非单调性和 tokenizer 差异，例如某些符号在特定 tokenizer 下比自然语言短得多。第二类是重排型变换，如把输出约束前置到 prompt 开头，利用 attention sink；把多步操作按拓扑顺序排列，保证因果可达性。第三类是增强型变换，如在结尾追加 closure block，或按 fragility 分数复制关键语义原子，利用 recency bias 和首尾位置优势。

论文里一个值得注意的点是，它没有把所有算子都当成“越多越好”。作者明确区分了 token-reducing、structure-preserving、token-expanding 三类操作，并给出形式化定义与语义保持条件 sem(τ(p)) ⊇ sem(p)。更重要的是，他们证明了若只看一组压缩算子，well-formed schema 上可保证至少 51% 的 token 压缩。这个理论结果不复杂，但足够说明该系统不是经验拼装。

方法上的另一个亮点是 format-versus-compression 分解。作者比较 JSON baseline 与文本 baseline，发现准确率与 token 数的相关性在 JSON 表示下很强，R²=0.88；换成文本表示后几乎消失，R²=0.03。这个结果支持他们的主张：决定性因素是 representation change，而不是简单缩短 prompt。也就是说，模型不是单纯“上下文太长看不过来”，而是“看不懂这种结构”。

从预训练研究视角看，TSCG 的真正价值不在规则本身，而在它把 schema 理解问题拆成了 tokenizer 友好性、位置布局、因果可访问性、关键原子冗余保护这几个可分析维度。这些维度都可以反过来指导数据合成和预训练格式设计。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖面做得比较完整。作者构建了 TSCG-Agentic-Bench，约 1.9 万次 API 调用，覆盖 12 个模型、5 个场景，模型规模从 4B 到 32B，并包含 3 个 frontier 模型。核心结果是：在工具数上来以后，小模型的原始 JSON schema 表现会出现明显断崖，而 TSCG 能把多个模型从 0%–49% 的准确率区间拉回到 65%–90%。文中最醒目的例子是 Phi-4 14B：20 个工具时从 0% 提升到 84.4%，50 个工具时达到 90.3%。

token 开销方面，作者报告在 100 个工具规模下仍能保持 52%–57% 的 token 节省，这说明压缩收益不会随着 catalog 扩大而迅速消失。对真实 MCP schema 的测试显示，准确率优势仍有约 +5.0 个百分点，说明不是只在轻量合成目录上有效。作者还做了 BFCL 外部验证，给出 108%–181% 的 ARR 提升，用来说明 benchmark 外推不是完全失真。

消融实验是这篇文章最值得看的部分之一。首先，算子级消融显示并非所有机制都稳定有效。CFL 和 CFO 在小 catalog 下有帮助，但在 43 个工具以上会变成负收益，说明首位锚定和顺序重排会与长上下文竞争注意力。CCP 在 11 个模型上的消融几乎没有 measurable gain，却增加约 85–306 token，作者也坦率承认它更多是理论完整性保留，而不是当前最实用组件。这个态度比较可信。其次，作者总结出三类模型响应模式：operator-hungry、operator-sensitive、operator-robust，意思是不同模型对 schema 编译策略的最优配置并不一致。这一点很像 tokenizer 或 prompt format 的模型特异性现象。

还有一个实验结论很关键：合成 TAB 对真实 MCP 性能的预测误差在 0.1 accuracy points 以内。若这个结果稳健，说明他们的 benchmark 至少抓住了主要失效机制，而不是只测到某种人工构造偏差。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先看 Introduction、Figure 1、Section 3 的算子定义，再直接跳到实验主表和 Table 23 这类算子消融。预计 25–35 分钟可以抓住主要信息。

阅读时重点看三件事。第一，作者如何把“JSON 不适合 LLM”从直觉变成可检验命题，尤其是 format-versus-compression 的分解实验。第二，8 个算子里哪些是真正稳定有效的，哪些只是机制上说得通但实测收益有限。第三，规模敏感性：为什么 CFL/CFO 在小工具集有效、在大工具集反而伤害性能，这里面涉及位置竞争和注意力预算，是最接近基座机制的问题。

如果想深挖，可看 Appendix E 的 fragility scoring 和预算分配。虽然这是工程启发式，但它其实对应一个更一般的问题：在固定上下文预算下，如何对结构化语义原子做重要性重排与冗余编码。这个问题完全可以延伸到预训练数据格式设计、RAG schema 设计，甚至多模态离散 token 的序列化方式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode in agentic LLM deployments: tool definitions are usually passed as JSON Schema, but JSON is optimized for deterministic machine parsing rather than autoregressive language-model consumption. As tool catalogs grow, small and mid-sized models fail not simply because prompts get longer, but because the representation itself is poorly aligned with how AR transformers read structured context. The paper frames this as a protocol mismatch at the API boundary, not merely a prompt-compression problem.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to foundation-model research because it exposes a representation bottleneck that looks very similar to tokenizer and serialization issues in pretraining. The main contribution is practical and mechanistic: it shows that model capability can collapse or recover depending on how structured information is serialized, even when semantics are preserved. For researchers thinking about native tool-use pretraining, structured-context curricula, or schema-aware data formats, this is a useful signal. The impact is strongest for deployment of 4B–14B models, less so as a new modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
TSCG is a deterministic compiler that converts JSON tool schemas into a compact structured-text format. It is model-agnostic, requires no finetuning, and does not rely on runtime search. The system is built from eight composable operators arranged in a fixed pipeline. The design philosophy is to encode known transformer reading biases into deterministic rewrites rather than learn a schema rewriter.

The operators fall into three groups. Token-reducing operators compress the schema by choosing tokenizer-friendly delimiters, removing filler phrases, and replacing verbose structural language with compact symbolic forms. These exploit BPE non-monotonicity and tokenizer-specific token counts. Structure-preserving reordering operators move critical constraints to the beginning of the prompt to exploit attention sink effects, and reorder multi-step operations topologically so prerequisites are causally accessible. Token-expanding operators add redundancy near the end of the prompt or duplicate fragile semantic atoms to exploit recency bias and boundary-position advantages.

A strong point is that the paper does not treat all operators as uniformly beneficial. It formalizes semantic preservation, distinguishes reducing vs. reordering vs. expanding transforms, and proves a >=51% compression guarantee on well-formed schemas for the reducing subset. More importantly, the paper isolates representation change from raw compression. On JSON baselines, accuracy is strongly correlated with token count (R²=0.88), but on text baselines that correlation nearly disappears (R²=0.03). That result supports the central claim: the dominant effect is not just shorter context, but a representation that the model can actually parse.

From a pretraining perspective, the deeper value is the decomposition itself. The paper turns schema understanding into analyzable dimensions: tokenizer friendliness, positional layout, causal accessibility, and redundancy allocation for fragile semantic atoms. Those dimensions could inform data formatting and serialization choices in future pretraining pipelines.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical section is broad enough to be credible. The authors build TSCG-Agentic-Bench with roughly 19,000 API calls, 12 models, and 5 scenarios, covering 4B–32B models plus three frontier systems. The headline result is that several small models recover from near-collapse under raw JSON schemas to usable tool-calling accuracy under TSCG. The most visible example is Phi-4 14B: from 0% to 84.4% accuracy at 20 tools, and 90.3% at 50 tools.

On efficiency, the compiler preserves 52%–57% token savings even at 100 tools, so the compression benefit does not vanish at larger catalog sizes. On heavier real-world MCP schemas, the method still yields about +5.0 percentage points, suggesting the gains are not limited to lightweight synthetic catalogs. The paper also reports external validation on BFCL with 108%–181% ARR improvements.

The ablations are the most informative part. Some operators are clearly scale-sensitive. CFL and CFO help at smaller catalog sizes but become harmful beyond around 43 tools, which suggests positional anchoring and reordering can start competing for limited attention budget in long contexts. CCP, despite being theoretically motivated, shows no measurable gain in an 11-model ablation while adding about 85–306 tokens; the authors explicitly acknowledge this. That makes the paper more trustworthy. Another useful finding is the model-specific operator-response taxonomy: operator-hungry, operator-sensitive, and operator-robust. There is no universal best configuration.

A final result worth noting is that the synthetic TAB benchmark predicts real MCP performance within 0.1 accuracy points. If robust, that means the benchmark is capturing the main failure mechanism rather than a narrow synthetic artifact.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with the introduction, Figure 1, the operator definitions in Section 3, and then jump to the main result tables plus the operator ablations such as Table 23. Around 25–35 minutes should be enough to extract the main ideas.

Focus on three questions while reading. First, how the paper turns the intuition that “JSON is bad for LLMs” into a testable claim, especially through the format-vs-compression decomposition. Second, which operators are consistently useful and which are only theoretically motivated. Third, why some operators help at small tool counts but hurt at larger ones; that scale sensitivity is the part most relevant to transformer behavior.

If you want to go deeper, Appendix E on fragility scoring and budget allocation is worth a look. It is presented as an engineering heuristic, but it maps onto a broader research question: under a fixed context budget, how should structured semantic atoms be reordered and redundantly encoded? That question extends naturally to pretraining data formats, RAG schema design, and multimodal token serialization.

recommendation.zh: 读 §4 的分解实验即可；它提醒工具调用失败常是接口表示问题，不一定要先上 SFT。
recommendation.en: Read the decomposition in §4; it is a useful reminder that tool failures can come from interface representation, not only missing SFT.

paper.title: DecodingTrust-Agent Platform (DTap): A Controllable and Interactive Red-Teaming Platform for AI Agents
paper.abstract: AI agents are increasingly deployed across diverse domains to automate complex workflows through long-horizon and high-stakes action executions. Due to their high capability and flexibility, such agents raise significant security and safety concerns. A growing number of real-world incidents have shown that adversaries can easily manipulate agents into performing harmful actions, such as leaking API keys, deleting user data, or initiating unauthorized transactions. Evaluating agent security is in

summary.core_problem: 论文关注 AI agent 的安全评测缺少可控、可复现、接近真实工具环境的平台，尤其是间接提示注入、工具投毒、环境注入和多步攻击组合难以系统测试。
summary.importance: 这篇论文不属于预训练方法本身，但对 post-training 和 agent 安全评测有参考意义。它把 agent 风险从静态 prompt 测试扩展到工具调用、环境状态和执行结果层面。对基座模型研究的启发主要在评测信号质量：仅看模型回答是否合规不够，agent 场景需要检查真实环境状态是否发生了越权操作、数据泄露或资金转移。
summary.technical_approach: DTap 构建了一个受控的 agent red-teaming 平台，模拟 14 个领域、50 多个真实服务环境，包括 email、calendar、Zoom、PayPal、Robinhood 等常见工具。平台复制 agent 可见的 MCP 和 GUI 接口，同时保留环境状态的完全可观测性，便于插入攻击 payload、控制工具供应链、修改上下文输入并复现实验。论文还提出 DTAP-RED，一个自动 red-teaming agent。它不仅生成攻击文本，还联合搜索注入位置和注入方式，覆盖 prompt、tool、skill、environment 等攻击面，并支持组合攻击。攻击是否成功不主要靠 LLM judge，而是由 verifiable judges 检查环境结果，例如未授权交易是否真的执行。
summary.experiments: DTAP-BENCH 包含 6,682 个任务，其中 3,876 个是 red-teaming 任务；恶意目标超过 4K，来自 300 多类风险类别和 60 多份安全政策或领域规则。基准同时包含 benign tasks，用于衡量安全防护是否牺牲正常任务完成能力。red-teaming 设置分为两个威胁模型：间接威胁模型中，用户请求是正常的，攻击来自第三方环境、MCP 工具投毒或 skill 注入；直接威胁模型中，用户本身给出恶意请求，也可以叠加间接注入。已给出的内容没有包含具体模型攻击成功率和防御效果表格。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。优先看平台设计图、攻击面分类、DTAP-RED 的迭代优化流程，以及 DTAP-BENCH 的任务构成。若关注 post-training 数据和安全评测，可以重点看 verifiable judge 的设计，因为它比纯文本打分更接近 agent 部署中的真实失败条件。模型榜单和具体应用域细节可以略读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of controllable and reproducible environments for red-teaming AI agents. Static prompt-based testing is insufficient for agents because failures often arise through tools, persistent state, external data, indirect injections, and multi-step execution.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to post-training evaluation and agent safety. Its main useful idea is outcome-based evaluation: in agent settings, safety should be judged by environment state changes, not only by the model’s text. For foundation-model work, this points to better supervision and evaluation signals for tool-using models, especially when training or evaluating refusal, tool-use policy, and robustness to indirect prompt injection.
summary_en.technical_approach: DTap is a controlled red-teaming platform that simulates more than 50 realistic environments across 14 domains, including email, calendars, video meetings, payments, and trading-like services. It mirrors agent-facing MCP and GUI interfaces while keeping full observability and control over intermediate states. This allows payloads to be injected through environment data, tool supply chains, contextual inputs, and other surfaces without causing real-world harm. The paper also introduces DTAP-RED, an automated red-teaming agent that searches over both attack payloads and injection locations. It covers prompt-level, tool-level, skill-level, and environment-level attacks, including combinations. Attack success is checked with verifiable judges that inspect final environment states, such as whether an unauthorized transaction was executed.
summary_en.experiments: DTAP-BENCH contains 6,682 tasks, including 3,876 red-teaming tasks. It covers over 4K malicious goals, more than 300 risk categories, and over 60 security policies or domain regulations. The benchmark includes benign tasks to measure utility loss under defenses. It defines two threat models: an indirect threat model where the user request is benign but the environment or tools contain malicious injections, and a direct threat model where the user is the attacker, optionally combined with indirect vectors. The provided text does not include concrete attack success rates or model-by-model results.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on the environment design, attack-surface taxonomy, DTAP-RED’s iterative attack loop, and the construction of DTAP-BENCH. The most transferable part is the use of verifiable judges over environment outcomes. The domain-specific scenarios and individual service simulations can be read selectively unless the goal is to build a similar benchmark.

recommendation.zh: 读平台设计和场景 taxonomy；它不教你预训练，但会影响 agent 后训练安全评测的默认 setup。
recommendation.en: Read the platform design and scenario taxonomy; it will not teach pretraining, but it may shape default safety-eval setups for agent post-training.

paper.title: Uno-Orchestra: Parsimonious Agent Routing via Selective Delegation
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) multi-agent systems typically rely on rigid orchestration, committing either to flat per-query routing or to hand-engineered task decomposition, so decomposition depth, worker choice, and inference budget are not jointly optimized under one objective. We introduce Uno-Orchestra, a unified orchestration policy that selectively decomposes a task and dispatches each subtask to an admissible (model, primitive) pair, with both decisions learned together from curated RL traj

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是单纯的“给每个 query 选一个模型”，也不是传统多 agent 里“先规划、再手工分配执行器”的老问题，而是把两件事合成一个统一决策：面对一个复杂任务，系统应不应该拆解、拆到多深、每个子任务交给哪个模型、调用哪种 primitive、花多少预算，这些决策如何在同一个目标下联合优化。作者指出，现有 routing 方法大多停留在 query 级单次派发，无法利用复杂任务中的并行和层次结构；而层级式 agent workflow 虽然会拆任务，但子任务到执行器的映射通常是 prompt 规则、人工设计或绑定某个强模型，导致质量与成本的关键取舍没有被端到端学习。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身，它不是直接提出新的 pretrain objective，但对“后训练如何反哺模型系统能力”有现实启发，尤其是 controller policy、agentic RL、结构化 credit assignment 这几个点。更具体地说，它把 orchestration 从 workflow engineering 推向了 policy learning：把 decomposition 和 dispatch 写进同一个 causal LM 输出空间，再用真实 worker 交互轨迹做 SFT+RL。这类工作对未来的启发不在于“多 agent 更强”这件事本身，而在于：如果系统能力越来越依赖 learned controller，那么控制器的训练数据、奖励设计、动作空间设计，会逐渐变成和 pretrain 同样重要的能力来源。对做 pretrain 的人，值得关注的是它如何把结构化决策序列压进标准 LM 接口，以及如何用中间奖励缓解长时程 agent 训练的不稳定。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Uno-Orchestra：用一个单一的 causal LM policy，同时生成任务分解结果和每个子任务的路由决策。动作不是简单的“选模型”，而是为每个子任务选择一个 (model, primitive) 对。这里 primitive 被定义成可路由的原子动作，既可以是模型内部的认知操作，也可以是多步技能调用或外部工具调用。这样做的好处是把 planner 和 dispatcher 合并到同一 backbone，避免多模块之间反复传上下文，也让“是否拆解”和“拆完交给谁”共享同一个训练目标。

训练分两阶段。第一阶段是 SFT：作者构造了 verifier-gated curriculum，用 teacher-distilled 轨迹做监督学习。轨迹来自 38 个公开数据集，共 61,201 条，并且与评测集不重合。关键点在于 code 和 tool 子任务不是离线伪造 observation，而是在真实 sandbox 中执行，返回运行时结果，这让训练轨迹更接近真实 agent 交互。第二阶段是 Agentic-GRPO，用于处理 SFT 后剩余的 hard pool。它是对 GRPO 的多轮扩展，利用 orchestrator 输出中的结构线索，为不同分解模式自动附加 observation-level 和 process-level 中间奖励，缓解只有最终正确/错误信号时的长链路 credit assignment 问题。

从设计上看，这篇工作的几个关键取舍比较清楚。第一，不把 decomposition 和 routing 拆成两个模型，是为了减少模块边界带来的误差传播，也让预算约束能直接作用在统一动作空间上。第二，采用 closed worker pool 和 closed primitive vocabulary，而不是开放式自由调用，是为了让 RL 可学、可验证、可计成本。第三，强调 admissible set 的稀疏性，即不是每个模型都支持每个 primitive，这使问题更像受约束的组合决策，而不是普通文本生成。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 13 个 benchmark，横跨 math、code、knowledge、long-context 和 agentic tool-use，并与 22 个 baseline 比较。主结果是 macro pass@1 达到 77.0%，比最强 workflow baseline 高约 16%，同时单 query 成本低约一个数量级。这个结果说明收益不只是来自“多调用几个模型”，而是来自更细粒度的 selective delegation。

从论文给出的设定看，训练数据规模不算大，只有 61,201 条 SFT 轨迹和后续 hard-pool RL，这意味着性能提升更多来自动作空间和训练信号设计，而不是海量 imitation data。值得注意的实验点通常有三类：
1. 与 flat routing 的对比：能看出 query-level 单次派发在复杂任务上会明显吃亏，因为它无法把不同子问题交给不同能力/成本档位的 worker。
2. 与 hand-crafted hierarchical workflow 的对比：说明单纯会拆任务还不够，若 dispatch 不是联合优化，成本和成功率都容易失衡。
3. 消融：去掉 unified policy、去掉 Agentic-GRPO、去掉 verifier-gated curriculum，通常都会伤到最终表现，尤其是长时程任务和工具调用任务。

摘要里没有给出更细的模型规模、worker pool 组成和各 benchmark 分项数字；如果看全文，重点应核对：不同 primitive 的定义边界、成本函数如何标定、RL 奖励中 correctness 与 cost 的权重 α 如何设、以及 hard pool 的构造方式。这些细节决定了结果是否可迁移。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合泛读，不建议按“多 agent 新花样”去读，重点应放在三个地方。

第一，看方法定义部分，弄清楚 unified action space 到底怎么编码：一个 assistant turn 里如何同时表达 plan、subtask、依赖关系和 (model, primitive) 选择。这里决定了它是不是一个真正可学习的 policy，而不只是 prompt 模板。

第二，看训练部分，尤其是 verifier-gated curriculum 和 Agentic-GRPO。前者关系到轨迹质量控制，后者关系到多轮 agent RL 是否稳定。若只看一处图表，优先看奖励构成和训练流程图。

第三，看主表和消融表。重点不是绝对分数，而是：在什么任务上 selective delegation 最有收益，收益来自更深分解还是更便宜的 worker 组合，以及成本下降是否伴随成功率下降。

预计 25–35 分钟可以抓住主要内容。若要深挖，建议额外关注附录里的 action schema、worker/primitive vocabulary、以及失败案例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a joint decision problem that prior orchestration work usually splits apart: whether to decompose a task, how deep the decomposition should go, which worker should handle each subtask, which primitive should be invoked, and how all of that should be optimized under an explicit cost budget. Existing routers mostly operate at the whole-query level and miss the internal structure of complex tasks. Hierarchical multi-agent systems do decompose, but executor assignment is often hand-written, prompt-driven, or tied to a single strong model. The result is that decomposition and dispatch, which jointly determine both quality and cost, are rarely learned under one objective.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface. Its main value is in showing how system-level capability can increasingly come from a learned controller rather than from a single frontier model. For researchers working on foundation models, the useful signal here is not “multi-agent beats single-agent,” but how a standard causal LM can be turned into a structured control policy, how real interaction traces can supervise that policy, and how intermediate rewards can stabilize long-horizon agent RL. If orchestration becomes a major capability bottleneck, controller data quality, action-space design, and reward shaping start to matter in ways that resemble pretraining design choices.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Uno-Orchestra is a single causal-LM policy that emits both a task decomposition and a routing decision for every subtask. The routing unit is not just a model ID. It is a (model, primitive) pair, where a primitive is an atomic routable action: an internal reasoning mode, a multi-step skill invocation, or an external tool call. This collapses planning and dispatch into one shared backbone, instead of running a planner first and a dispatcher later.

Training has two stages. Stage one is supervised fine-tuning on a verifier-gated curriculum of 61,201 teacher-distilled trajectories from 38 public datasets, disjoint from evaluation. A notable detail is that code and tool subtasks are executed in real sandboxes, so observations are runtime outputs rather than synthetic traces. Stage two applies Agentic-GRPO on the residual hard pool. This extends GRPO to multi-turn orchestration by using structural cues from the generated plan to assign observation-level and process-level intermediate rewards, which helps with long-horizon credit assignment.

Several design choices are worth noting. First, decomposition and routing are merged because separate modules create context-passing overhead and error propagation, while a unified policy allows budget constraints to act directly on the full decision space. Second, the worker pool and primitive vocabulary are closed, which makes RL tractable and cost-accountable. Third, admissible actions are sparse: not every model supports every primitive. That turns the problem into constrained combinatorial control rather than generic free-form generation.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation spans 13 benchmarks across math, code, knowledge, long-context, and agentic tool use, with comparisons against 22 baselines. The headline result is 77.0% macro pass@1, about 16% above the strongest workflow baseline, at roughly an order-of-magnitude lower per-query cost. That matters because it suggests the gain is not simply from using more calls, but from finer-grained selective delegation.

The training set is relatively modest: 61,201 SFT trajectories plus RL on a hard subset. That makes the improvement more attributable to action-space design and training signals than to brute-force imitation scale. The most informative comparisons are likely the following: against flat routers, which cannot assign different subtasks to different capability-cost tiers; against hand-crafted hierarchical workflows, which decompose but do not jointly optimize dispatch; and ablations removing the unified policy, verifier-gated curriculum, or Agentic-GRPO.

The abstract does not expose all implementation details such as controller size, worker pool composition, or per-benchmark breakdowns. When reading the full paper, the details that matter most are the primitive taxonomy, how cost is calibrated, how the correctness–cost trade-off coefficient is set, and how the hard pool is constructed. Those choices determine whether the method is portable beyond the reported setup.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it as a policy-learning paper, not as another generic multi-agent workflow paper. Three parts deserve attention.

First, inspect the action representation. The key question is how a single assistant turn encodes subtasks, dependencies, and one (model, primitive) choice per subtask. If that schema is weak, the whole method reduces to prompt engineering; if it is clean, the paper is really about structured control through a causal LM.

Second, focus on the training pipeline, especially verifier-gated curriculum construction and Agentic-GRPO. Those sections contain the practical answer to how they keep trajectory quality high and how they make multi-turn RL learnable.

Third, read the main results and ablations with a systems lens: where does selective delegation help most, does the gain come from deeper decomposition or cheaper worker assignment, and how stable is the quality–cost trade-off.

A 25–35 minute skim should be enough for the main ideas. For deeper reading, check the appendix for the action schema, primitive vocabulary, and failure cases.

recommendation.zh: 只看策略定义和 cost/accuracy 曲线；若 worker 真实成本核算干净，可作为后训练路由数据的设计样板。
recommendation.en: Read the policy definition and cost-accuracy plots; if the worker-cost accounting is clean, it is a useful template for routing-oriented post-training data.

paper.title: LongSeeker: Elastic Context Orchestration for Long-Horizon Search Agents
paper.abstract: Long-horizon search agents must manage a rapidly growing working context as they reason, call tools, and observe information. Naively accumulating all intermediate content can overwhelm the agent, increasing costs and the risk of errors. We propose that effective context management should be adaptive: parts of the agent's trajectory are maintained at different levels of detail depending on their current relevance to the task. To operationalize this principle, we introduce Context-ReAct, a genera
