summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是长时程 search agent 的上下文失控问题：ReAct 式 agent 在多轮搜索、工具调用和观察累积后，工作上下文会越来越长，里面既有关键证据，也有失败分支、重复信息和已经过时的推理。现有做法通常是截断、定期总结或重启，但这些方法要么不区分信息重要性，要么破坏推理连续性，要么在反复摘要中引入误差。作者要解决的是：agent 能不能在推理过程中主动决定何时、何处、以何种保真度改写自己的上下文，而不是被动接受 append-only 历史。
summary.importance: 它对预训练的直接贡献有限，更接近 agent memory / long-context orchestration，但仍有两个值得基座研究员关注的点。第一，它把“上下文管理”从外部 heuristic 变成了模型内部可学习动作，这和未来长上下文模型的训练目标设计有关：模型不只是消费上下文，也可能需要学习重写、压缩和回滚上下文。第二，它提出的多分辨率上下文表示，对长序列建模有启发。当前很多 long-context 方案仍默认历史是只追加、等精度保存的；这篇工作则假设不同历史片段应以不同 fidelity 存在，这个假设对 memory-augmented LM、agentic continual context、甚至训练时的 trajectory packing 都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
核心范式叫 Context-ReAct。它在标准 ReAct 循环上加了一层显式的 meta-action：每一步不是只生成 reasoning trace 和 tool call，而是联合生成 reasoning、context meta-operations 和下一步工具调用。meta-operations 会在新 observation 加入前先作用于已有上下文，因此 agent 可以主动重塑工作记忆。

作者定义了五个原子操作：
1. Skip：上下文不变。
2. Compress：把一段连续历史替换成抽象摘要。
3. Snippet：从某一步中保留精确子串，适合数字、实体名、引用、代码等不能被抽象改写的证据。
4. Delete：删除已无残余价值的步骤。
5. Rollback：放弃一条失败分支，把上下文回退到更早状态，同时记录回退原因和可迁移信息。

这个设计的关键不是“多几个操作”，而是把上下文表示从单一文本序列改成多分辨率工作记忆。作者还给出 expressive completeness 的论证：理论上 Compress 足以模拟其他操作，但专门设计 Snippet、Delete、Rollback 是为了降低生成成本和摘要失真风险。这个论证有点像 instruction set 设计：最小完备集不一定是最好用的工程接口。

实例化系统 LongSeeker 基于 Qwen3-30B-A3B，并在 10k 合成搜索轨迹上微调。训练重点在于数据合成：需要构造包含 context edit 行为的轨迹，而不是普通 ReAct 轨迹。也就是说，模型学的不是单纯“怎么搜”，而是“什么时候该保留原文、什么时候该压缩、什么时候该回滚”。
summary.experiments:
LongSeeker 在四个 benchmark 上评测：BrowseComp、BrowseComp-ZH、xbench 和 GAIA。摘要中给出的主结果是 BrowseComp 61.5%，BrowseComp-ZH 62.5%，显著高于 Tongyi DeepResearch 的 43.2% / 46.7%，也高于 AgentFold 的 36.2% / 47.3%。这些数字说明收益主要出现在长时程、多轮搜索场景，而不是普通短链路 QA。

从全文应重点看三类实验。第一，和 sliding window、periodic summarization、restart 类方法的对比，验证 elastic context orchestration 是否真的优于固定策略。第二，各原子操作的消融，尤其是 Snippet 和 Rollback：前者对应高保真证据保留，后者对应搜索分支管理，二者通常比单纯 Compress 更能解释性能来源。第三，context 长度、token 成本、成功率之间的关系。如果论文给出了 trajectory-level 统计，值得看 agent 是否在更短上下文下保持或提升正确率，而不是靠更长推理链换分数。

训练规模方面，10k 合成轨迹不算大，因此结果更多反映范式设计是否有效，而不是大规模数据堆出来的收益。需要留意的是，合成数据的 teacher 和规则会不会把某种特定搜索风格固化进模型；如果泛化实验不足，这会影响方法外推性。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，重点不在 benchmark 排名，而在上下文操作接口的设计。

优先看方法部分前半，弄清楚 Context-ReAct 相比标准 ReAct 多了什么状态转移能力，五个操作分别解决什么失败模式。尤其要看 Snippet 和 Rollback 的定义，因为这两个操作最能体现作者不是在做普通摘要压缩。

然后看数据合成与训练部分。关键问题是：这些 meta-operations 的监督信号从哪里来，轨迹是如何构造的，模型如何学会在正确时机编辑上下文。若这一部分比较弱，方法就容易退化成 prompt 规则。

最后看主结果和消融。重点观察：性能提升是否伴随 token 成本下降；不同 benchmark 上哪类操作最常被触发；失败案例是否来自错误压缩、错误删除，还是搜索策略本身。

预计 20–30 分钟可以读完主线。若只挑图表，优先看范式示意图、操作消融表、以及上下文长度/成本统计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses context blow-up in long-horizon search agents. In standard ReAct-style systems, reasoning traces, tool calls, and observations are appended step by step, so the working context grows monotonically. Over time it mixes critical evidence with stale reasoning, failed branches, and redundant content. Existing fixes such as truncation, periodic summarization, or restart policies are all partial: they either ignore importance, break reasoning continuity, or accumulate abstraction errors. The central question here is whether the agent can actively reshape its own context during reasoning, instead of passively inheriting an append-only history.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to pretraining is limited, but it is still useful for foundation-model researchers for two reasons. First, it turns context management into a learned action space rather than an external heuristic. That is relevant to future long-context training objectives, where a model may need to learn not only to consume context but also to rewrite, compress, and roll back it. Second, the paper proposes a multi-resolution view of context: different parts of history should survive at different fidelities depending on current utility. That assumption is interesting for memory-augmented LMs, continual agent context, and any training setup where long trajectories are treated as uniform text even though their informational value is highly non-uniform.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main paradigm is Context-ReAct, which augments the standard ReAct loop with explicit context meta-actions. At each step, the agent jointly generates its reasoning trace, a set of context-edit operations, and the next tool call in one autoregressive pass. The meta-operations are applied before the next observation is appended, so the agent actively curates its working memory online.

The operation vocabulary has five atomic actions. Skip leaves the context unchanged. Compress replaces a contiguous span of prior steps with an abstractive summary. Snippet preserves an exact substring from a previous step, which is useful for numbers, entity names, quotations, or code where abstraction is risky. Delete removes a step that no longer carries value. Rollback abandons an unproductive branch by reverting to an earlier state while retaining the reason for backtracking and any transferable insight.

The key idea is not merely adding more actions. It is changing the representation of context from a uniform text log into a multi-resolution working memory. The paper also argues expressive completeness: in principle, Compress can simulate the other operations, but specialized operators reduce generation cost and fidelity loss. That is a sensible engineering choice, similar to designing a practical instruction set rather than relying on a theoretically minimal one.

The instantiated system, LongSeeker, is fine-tuned from Qwen3-30B-A3B on 10k synthesized search trajectories. The important training detail is that the data must teach not only how to search, but when to preserve exact evidence, when to summarize, and when to roll back.
summary_en.experiments:
LongSeeker is evaluated on BrowseComp, BrowseComp-ZH, xbench, and GAIA. The headline numbers in the paper are 61.5% on BrowseComp and 62.5% on BrowseComp-ZH, compared with 43.2% and 46.7% for Tongyi DeepResearch, and 36.2% and 47.3% for AgentFold. These gains suggest that elastic context control matters most in long-horizon, tool-augmented search rather than in short QA settings.

The most informative experiments are likely threefold. First, comparisons against sliding-window, periodic summarization, and restart-style baselines, to test whether adaptive context editing really beats fixed policies. Second, ablations over the five operations, especially Snippet and Rollback. Those two are the clearest indicators that the method is doing more than generic summarization. Third, analyses of context length, token cost, and success rate. If the paper reports trajectory-level statistics, the important question is whether the agent maintains or improves accuracy while operating on a shorter and cleaner context.

The training scale is modest at 10k synthesized trajectories, so the result is more about the usefulness of the paradigm than about data scale. One caveat to watch is whether the synthesis pipeline bakes in a particular search style from the teacher, which could limit generalization if the evaluation distribution shifts.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is best read as a context-interface paper rather than a benchmark paper. Start with the method section and understand exactly what Context-ReAct adds over standard ReAct. The most important part is the semantics of the five operations and the failure modes they are meant to address. Snippet and Rollback deserve special attention because they are the strongest departures from ordinary summarization.

Then read the data synthesis and training pipeline. The key question is where supervision for the meta-operations comes from and how the trajectories are constructed. If that part is weak, the whole method risks collapsing into a prompt-level heuristic.

Finally, inspect the main results and ablations with an efficiency lens: whether gains come with lower token cost, which operations are used most often, and whether failures are caused by bad compression, bad deletion, or poor search policy.

A 20–30 minute skim is enough for the main ideas. If reading selectively, prioritize the paradigm figure, the operation ablation table, and any statistics on context length or token usage.

recommendation.zh: 读操作空间和 ablation 即可；如果 Compress 完备性和实测收益都站得住，可借来设计长轨迹 SFT/RL 数据格式。
recommendation.en: Read the action space and ablations; if the Compress completeness claim and empirical gains hold, this is a useful template for long-trajectory SFT/RL data formats.

paper.title: AgentTrust: Runtime Safety Evaluation and Interception for AI Agent Tool Use
paper.abstract: Modern AI agents execute real-world side effects through tool calls such as file operations, shell commands, HTTP requests, and database queries. A single unsafe action, including accidental deletion, credential exposure, or data exfiltration, can cause irreversible harm. Existing defenses are incomplete: post-hoc benchmarks measure behavior after execution, static guardrails miss obfuscation and multi-step context, and infrastructure sandboxes constrain where code runs without understanding wha

summary.core_problem: 解决 AI agent 在执行文件、shell、HTTP、数据库等工具调用前缺少运行时安全拦截的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 安全系统和 benchmark。它关注真实副作用动作的执行前风险判断，比只做执行后评测或静态规则更贴近部署场景；对基座预训练的直接价值有限，但对工具使用安全边界有参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AgentTrust 运行时安全层，在工具调用执行前返回 allow、warn、block、review 四类结构化判断。系统包含 shell 去混淆归一化、SafeFix 安全替代建议、RiskChain 多步攻击链检测，以及带缓存的 LLM-as-Judge 处理模糊输入。
summary.experiments: 发布 300 个场景的 benchmark，覆盖 6 类风险，并额外构造 630 个真实风险样例。摘要未给出与具体 guardrail、sandbox 或 LLM judge baseline 的量化对比结果，需查正文确认误杀率和漏检率。
summary.authors_note: 作者为独立研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles runtime safety for AI agents by intercepting tool calls such as file operations, shell commands, HTTP requests, and database queries before execution.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent safety system and benchmark. It is closer to deployment than post-hoc evaluations or static guardrails because it reasons about real side-effecting actions, though its direct relevance to pretraining is limited.
summary_en.technical_approach: AgentTrust acts as a runtime safety layer that returns structured verdicts: allow, warn, block, or review. It combines shell deobfuscation, SafeFix suggestions, RiskChain detection for multi-step attacks, and a cache-aware LLM-as-Judge for ambiguous calls.
summary_en.experiments: The paper releases a 300-scenario benchmark across six risk categories plus 630 independently constructed real-world risk cases. The abstract does not provide detailed quantitative comparisons against guardrails, sandboxes, or judge baselines.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is an independent researcher.

recommendation.zh: 作为工具调用安全的工程清单可存档；没有改变模型训练 prior，正文最多看 benchmark schema。
recommendation.en: Useful as an engineering checklist for tool-call safety; it does not shift training priors, so the benchmark schema is the main thing to inspect.

paper.title: Programmatic Context Augmentation for LLM-based Symbolic Regression
paper.abstract: Symbolic regression (SR), the task of discovering mathematical expressions that best describe a given dataset, remains a fundamental challenge in scientific discovery. Traditional approaches, primarily based on genetic algorithms and related evolutionary methods, have proven useful but suffer from scalability and expressivity limitations. Recently, large language model (LLM)-based evolutionary search methods have been introduced into SR and show promise. However, existing LLM-based approaches ty

summary.core_problem: LLM做符号回归时，如何把“数据集里更丰富的结构信息”而非单一标量loss，变成可用的搜索反馈信号。
summary.importance: 属于“LLM+程序化工具/上下文增强”的通用套路，在科学发现类任务上给了一个相对干净的落地；对预训练本身不直接，但对tool-use训练信号设计有参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Programmatic Context Augmentation：让LLM在进化式搜索中通过代码与数据交互（统计分析、误差分解、可视化/诊断等），把分析结果写回上下文，指导下一轮候选表达式生成；相当于把标量reward扩展为结构化、可读的中间反馈。
summary.experiments: 任务为符号回归；与传统进化法及已有LLM-evolution SR方法对比（摘要未给出具体基准集、提升幅度与模型规格）。
summary.authors_note: Caltech、Nanjing University、UT Austin；Yisong Yue团队（偏AutoML/决策与学习）。

summary_en.core_problem: In LLM-based symbolic regression, how to turn rich dataset structure (beyond a single scalar loss) into actionable feedback for search.
summary_en.importance: A general pattern of LLM + programmatic tool/context augmentation applied to scientific discovery; not pretraining-focused, but useful for thinking about structured feedback signals in tool-use settings.
summary_en.technical_approach: Programmatic Context Augmentation: during evolutionary search, let the LLM interact with the dataset via code (analysis/diagnostics) and write structured findings back into the prompt/context to guide the next generation of candidate expressions—expanding feedback from scalar rewards to richer intermediate signals.
summary_en.experiments: Symbolic regression benchmarks with comparisons to classical evolutionary methods and prior LLM-evolution SR approaches (abstract does not specify datasets, model sizes, or exact gains).
summary_en.authors_note: Caltech, Nanjing University, UT Austin; Yisong Yue's group (AutoML/learning & decision-making).

recommendation.zh: 把“标量reward太贫”这个老问题用程序化上下文补齐，思路靠谱但看点主要在交互设计；只读方法段落，别期待预训练层面的新结论。
recommendation.en: A sensible fix for the “scalar reward is too poor” issue via programmatic context; value is in the interaction design—read the method, not for pretraining insights.

paper.title: Act2See: Emergent Active Visual Perception for Video Reasoning
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) typically rely on static initial frames for video reasoning, restricting their ability to incorporate essential dynamic information as the reasoning process evolves. Existing methods that augment Chain-of-Thought (CoT) with additional frame information often exhibit suboptimal CoT quality and lack the crucial ability to synthesize visual information for hypothetical or counterfactual scenarios. We introduce Act-to-See (Act2See), a novel framework that enables active

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是视频推理里的一个具体短板：大多数 VLM 在推理开始时只看到固定采样的视频帧，后续 CoT 再长，也只能围绕这批静态证据展开，无法像人一样在思考过程中主动补充视觉信息。更进一步，现有方法即便能在 CoT 中插入检索到的帧，也很难处理反事实或假设性问题，因为这类问题需要“生成并检查一个不存在于原视频中的场景”。作者要做的是让模型在文本推理链中主动决定何时检索已有帧、何时生成假设帧，并把这些视觉结果重新并入 CoT。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献不强，它主要是一个 post-train/SFT 框架。但它对基座研究仍有两点启发。第一，它把“视觉证据获取”从输入预处理变成了推理过程中的显式动作，这对未来原生多模态模型的训练目标设计有参考意义。第二，它说明高质量 reasoning trace 的监督信号可以显著改变模型的感知策略，而不只是改变答案风格。若从 pretrain↔posttrain 接口看，这类工作提示：模型是否需要在预训练阶段就学习何时请求更多感知、何时构造假设世界，而不是只在 SFT 阶段补上。
summary.technical_approach:
方法名 Act2See，核心不是改 backbone，而是构造一种带“视觉动作”的 CoT 监督数据，再对现有 VLM 做 SFT。作者定义了两类工具调用 token：<retrieve>...</retrieve> 和 <generate>...</generate>。训练数据构造时，先用 Gemini 2.5 Pro 按特定模板生成带工具调用的推理链；如果模型在某一步判断现有视觉信息不足，就会输出检索查询或生成查询。随后离线工具执行该操作：检索工具从视频中找相关帧；生成工具则先按查询检索一张参考帧，再结合查询做条件式 image-to-image generation，以提高生成质量和与原视频语境的一致性。

拿到新帧后，系统把前面已经生成的 CoT 保留，并把新视觉帧插回推理链中，再继续生成后续 reasoning trace。这样得到的是视频-文本交错的完整 CoT，而不是单纯在答案前后附几张图。为了控制数据质量，作者没有直接接受 frontier model 生成的所有 CoT，而是利用带人工标注 CoT 的数据集 MINERVA、CausalVQA、Social Genome，把自动生成的推理链与人工 ground-truth 做相似度过滤，低质量样本被剔除。最终构造出的 SFT 数据中，47% 的 trace 含有检索或生成帧。

训练阶段较直接：用这些交错 CoT 对 Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking 做监督微调。方法上的关键点有两个。第一，模型学到的不是“如何调用一个固定工具 API”，而是何时需要额外视觉证据，以及该用检索还是生成。第二，生成帧被纳入 CoT，使模型能在反事实问题上借助显式视觉想象，而不是只靠文本内隐推理。
summary.experiments:
作者在五个视频推理 benchmark 上评测：Video-MME、VideoEspresso、EgoNormia、VCR-Bench、ViTIB，覆盖时空推理、物理与社会因果、复杂感知、逻辑推理以及视频-文本交错验证。论文声称 Act2See 超过同量级标准 VLM，包括 InternVL2.5-8B、Video-LLaMA3-7B、Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking、Video-R1，也优于多种视频文本交错 CoT 方法，如 Chain-of-Shot、FrameMind、ReWatch-R1。给出的全文片段没有列出具体分数，因此不适合编造绝对提升值，但可以确认作者把“同尺寸 backbone + 更强主动感知”作为主要比较设置。

实验上最值得看的不是总分，而是几类分析。第一，含 retrieve/generate 的 trace 占比达到 47%，说明作者不是只在少量样本上演示工具调用，而是把它作为普遍监督信号。第二，论文强调 inference-time emergent capability：即使测试时没有人工指定何时调用工具，模型也会在 CoT 中自行插入检索或生成动作。第三，若正文包含消融，重点应看：只用 retrieve、不用 generate；不做人工 CoT 过滤；只给最终答案监督、不训练完整 interleaved CoT；以及不同工具质量对最终推理表现的影响。这些实验决定提升究竟来自主动感知机制，还是仅仅来自更长、更丰富的 CoT 数据。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Figure 1 和 Algorithm 1，把数据构造流程读顺：frontier VLM 如何生成工具调用、离线工具如何返回帧、帧如何重新插入 CoT。然后看 Table 1 的 prompt 模板，理解模型被教会的动作语法。接着直接跳实验，重点看 benchmark 主表、是否有按问题类型拆分的结果，以及 retrieve/generate 的消融。

预计 20–30 分钟可以判断这篇工作的真实价值。值得留意的点有三个：一是质量过滤是否足够严格，避免把 frontier model 的噪声 CoT 蒸馏进去；二是生成帧是否真的帮助反事实推理，还是只是增加了视觉上下文；三是这种能力是否能迁移到更通用的多模态 agent 设置，而不局限于视频 QA。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a concrete limitation in video reasoning: most VLMs only see a fixed set of sampled frames at the start, so even a long chain of thought can only reason over static evidence. Existing methods may insert retrieved frames into CoT, but they still struggle with counterfactual or hypothetical questions, where the model needs to reason about a scene that does not exist in the original video. Act2See aims to let the model decide during reasoning when to retrieve an existing frame and when to generate a hypothetical one, then fold that visual result back into the CoT.
summary_en.importance: Its direct contribution to pretraining is limited; this is primarily a post-training/SFT method. Still, it matters for foundation-model research in two ways. First, it turns visual evidence acquisition from a preprocessing choice into an explicit reasoning action, which is relevant to future training objectives for native multimodal models. Second, it shows that high-quality reasoning-trace supervision can change not only answer style but also the model’s evidence-gathering behavior. From a pretrain–posttrain interface perspective, it raises a useful question: should models learn when to request more perception or construct hypothetical worlds earlier in training, rather than only through SFT?
summary_en.technical_approach:
Act2See does not mainly modify the backbone. Its core idea is to build CoT supervision with explicit visual actions, then fine-tune an existing VLM on that data. The method defines two tool-call tokens: <retrieve>...</retrieve> and <generate>...</generate>. During data construction, Gemini 2.5 Pro is prompted with a template that encourages it to emit reasoning traces containing these calls. Whenever the model judges that current visual evidence is insufficient, it outputs either a retrieval query or a generation query. An offline tool then executes the action: the retrieval tool finds a relevant frame from the video, while the generation tool first retrieves a reference frame and then performs conditional image-to-image generation using the query, improving visual quality and consistency with the original scene.

After the new frame is obtained, the existing partial CoT is preserved, the frame is inserted into the reasoning trace, and generation continues. The result is a fully interleaved video-text CoT rather than a plain answer with extra images attached. To control data quality, the authors do not simply accept all frontier-model traces. They use datasets with human-annotated CoTs—MINERVA, CausalVQA, and Social Genome—and filter generated traces by similarity to the human ground truth. Low-quality traces are removed. In the final SFT dataset, 47% of traces contain retrieved or generated frames.

Training is straightforward supervised fine-tuning of Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking on these interleaved traces. The key methodological point is that the model is not only learning a tool syntax. It is learning when additional visual evidence is needed, and whether retrieval or generation is the right operation. By inserting generated frames into the CoT, the model can also externalize hypothetical visual reasoning instead of relying only on implicit text-side imagination.
summary_en.experiments:
The model is evaluated on five video reasoning benchmarks: Video-MME, VideoEspresso, EgoNormia, VCR-Bench, and ViTIB, covering spatiotemporal reasoning, physical and social causality, complex perception, logical reasoning including counterfactuals, and video-text interleaving verification. The paper reports that Act2See outperforms similarly sized standard VLMs such as InternVL2.5-8B, Video-LLaMA3-7B, Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking, and Video-R1, and also surpasses several video-text interleaved CoT methods including Chain-of-Shot, FrameMind, and ReWatch-R1. The provided excerpt does not include exact scores, so it would be unsafe to state numerical gains, but the intended comparison is clearly “same-scale backbone, stronger active perception.”

The most informative parts of the experiments are likely not the aggregate scores but the analyses. First, 47% of traces containing retrieve/generate actions indicates that tool use is a substantial training signal rather than a rare demonstration. Second, the paper emphasizes an emergent inference-time behavior: the model can insert retrieval or generation actions into its own CoT without being manually told when to do so. Third, the most important ablations to inspect are: retrieve-only versus retrieve+generate, with and without human-CoT filtering, final-answer supervision versus full interleaved-CoT supervision, and sensitivity to the quality of the retrieval/generation tools. Those results determine whether the gains come from active perception itself or simply from richer long-form supervision.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with Figure 1 and Algorithm 1 to understand the data-construction loop: how the frontier VLM emits tool calls, how offline tools return frames, and how those frames are inserted back into the CoT. Then read the prompt template in Table 1 to see the action syntax the model is trained on. After that, jump to the experiments and focus on the main benchmark table, any breakdown by question type, and the retrieve/generate ablations.

About 20–30 minutes should be enough to judge the paper’s real value. Three points deserve attention: whether the quality filtering is strict enough to avoid distilling noisy frontier-model CoTs, whether generated frames truly help counterfactual reasoning rather than merely adding context, and whether this behavior can transfer to broader multimodal agent settings beyond video QA.

recommendation.zh: 值得看数据构造和动作接口设计；核心不是视频分数，而是 CoT 中插入视觉检索/生成动作这一训练信号。
recommendation.en: Read the data construction and action-interface design; the useful part is visual retrieval/generation inside CoT, not the video benchmark score.

paper.title: SciResearcher: Scaling Deep Research Agents for Frontier Scientific Reasoning
paper.abstract: Frontier scientific reasoning is rapidly emerging as a key foundation for advancing AI agents in automated scientific discovery. Deep research agents offer a promising approach to this challenge. These models develop robust problem-solving capabilities through post-training on information-seeking tasks, which are typically curated via knowledge graph construction or iterative web browsing. However, these strategies face inherent limitations in frontier science, where domain-specific knowledge is

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个当前很实际的瓶颈：深度研究型 agent 想在前沿科学问题上变强，缺的不是通用网页检索能力，而是高质量、可自动扩展、能覆盖稀疏学术证据和科学计算过程的训练数据。现有自动构造信息寻求任务的方法，大多依赖 Wikipedia 式实体图谱或连续网页浏览，适合事实检索，不适合前沿科学里那种知识分散、概念异构、还需要公式和参数计算的长链条推理。SciResearcher 的核心目标，就是搭一个全自动数据构造框架，把“前沿科学推理”拆成可规模化生成的训练样本，并验证这些样本能否真正提升 deep research agent 的能力。
summary.importance: 从 pretrain/post-train 接口看，这篇工作的价值不在模型结构，而在训练信号设计。它给出了一条比较清楚的路径：当目标能力不是一般问答，而是长时程、工具密集、证据稀疏、带计算环节的科学推理时，数据构造方式本身就是主要瓶颈。贡献有三层。第一，提出了面向 frontier science 的自动数据生成框架，而不是把通用信息检索 recipe 直接搬过来。第二，数据不只覆盖概念性问答，还显式覆盖 computational reasoning，这一点对 agent 能力形态影响很大，因为它迫使模型学会把检索、建模、参数抽取和求解串起来。第三，作者把数据构造、SFT、RL、行为分析连成闭环，展示了 post-training 如何改变 agent 的轨迹长度、工具调用频率和难度自适应策略。对基座研究员来说，这篇工作更像一个高质量案例：当训练目标从“答对”转向“会找、会算、会分配推理预算”时，数据生成器本身就成了能力上限的一部分。
summary.technical_approach: 技术方案分为数据构造和 agent 训练两部分。数据构造侧，作者先建立一个 curated 的 frontier scientific entities 池，作为问题生成的起点。随后分成两条流水线。第一条是 conceptual pipeline：让 web agent 从种子科学实体出发浏览学术来源，收集证据，生成有依据的问题；然后引入 iterative anchor-based task augmentation，把一个问题围绕关键锚点实体不断增广，提升复杂度和多证据依赖。这里“anchor”不是普通实体标签，而是问题里决定性、可作为推理抓手的科学对象。第二条是 computational pipeline：针对与种子实体相关的科学模型，做三级证据筛选，抽取可形成计算题的 governing equations、机制解释和所需参数，再生成问题，并通过 voting-based solver verification 得到参考答案。这个设计的关键不是简单让模型做数值题，而是把“找到模型—确认方程—补齐参数—执行求解”作为训练监督的一部分。基于这两条流水线，作者构建了 SciResearcherQA。训练侧，作者采用较标准但执行完整的 deep research post-training recipe：先在 Qwen3-8B 基座上做带 rejection sampling 的 SFT，再用 GRPO 做强化学习，得到 SciResearcher-8B。值得注意的是，这里 RL 的作用不只是提高最终正确率，还在于塑造更长、更工具化、且会按任务难度调整预算的轨迹策略。与已有工作相比，区别主要有三点：一是数据源从实体中心网页转向异构学术证据；二是任务目标从事实检索扩展到科学计算；三是复杂度提升不是靠人工模板堆叠，而是通过 anchor augmentation 和 solver verification 形成较稳定的自动闭环。
summary.experiments: 实验结果有几个值得记住的数字。基于 Qwen3-8B 训练得到的 SciResearcher-8B，在 HLE-Bio/Chem-Gold 上达到 19.46% pass@1 和 31.54% pass@3，超过了以 GPT-4.1 为骨干的 SciMaster，并接近 OpenAI Deep Research 这类前沿专有系统的水平。除此之外，在 SuperGPQA-Hard-Biology 和 TRQA-Literature 上分别带来 13.04% 和 14.54% 的绝对提升。作者还分析了行为轨迹：相较 baseline，post-training 后 agent 的轨迹长度增加到原来的 0.3–2.7 倍区间，同时工具调用频率更高。更有意思的是 RL 相对 SFT 呈现出难度自适应效应：在更难的 HLE-Bio/Chem-Gold 上，agent 学会分配更多步骤和更多工具调用；而在相对容易的 benchmark 上，步骤数略减但性能仍提升，说明 RL 学到的不是单纯“更长链条”，而是更合适的预算控制。摘要里没有展开全部消融细节，但从正文主线看，作者至少验证了三件事：自动构造数据能带来跨 benchmark 泛化；概念题和计算题的混合监督能提升 frontier science reasoning；SFT+RL 不只是提分，还改变了 agent 的搜索与求解行为模式。
summary.reading_guide: 精读时建议按“问题定义—数据流水线—训练闭环—行为分析”四步看。先读引言和 Figure 2，理解作者为什么认为现有 KG-based 和 browsing-based task construction 不适合 frontier science。然后重点看两条数据流水线：conceptual pipeline 里 anchor-based augmentation 的定义、例子和过滤机制；computational pipeline 里三级证据筛选、方程/参数抽取和 solver verification，这部分决定了数据质量上限。接着看 SciResearcherQA 的统计和样例，判断任务是否真的覆盖多证据与计算。训练部分重点看 SFT 与 GRPO 的配方、采样和奖励设置，尤其是 rejection sampling 与 RL 各自承担什么角色。最后看行为分析图表：轨迹长度、工具调用次数、不同 benchmark 上的预算分配变化，这些结果比单纯分数更能说明 agent 学到了什么。若时间有限，优先读引言、方法总览图、数据构造章节、主结果表，以及 RL 后行为变化的分析图。值得深挖的点有两个：一是自动生成的科学计算题如何控制伪解和答案泄漏；二是这种 post-training 数据是否能反哺更一般的预训练目标，比如把检索、建模、求解统一成更原生的训练范式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a practical bottleneck in deep research agents for frontier science: the limiting factor is not generic web search, but scalable training data that captures sparse academic evidence, heterogeneous scientific concepts, and nontrivial scientific computation. Existing automated information-seeking pipelines are mostly built around Wikipedia-like entity graphs or iterative browsing over densely linked webpages. Those recipes work for factual retrieval, but they break down in frontier science, where knowledge is fragmented across papers and solving a problem often requires equations, parameters, and multi-step computation. SciResearcher is designed to automate the construction of such training data and test whether it can materially improve scientific deep-research agents.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is not a new model architecture but a stronger training signal for agent post-training. The paper shows that when the target capability is long-horizon, tool-using, evidence-sparse scientific reasoning, data construction becomes the central bottleneck. There are three concrete contributions. First, it proposes an automated task-construction framework tailored to frontier science rather than reusing general-domain information-seeking recipes. Second, it explicitly includes computational scientific reasoning, not just conceptual QA, forcing the agent to chain retrieval, model identification, parameter extraction, and solving. Third, it closes the loop from data construction to SFT to RL to trajectory analysis, showing how post-training changes not only benchmark accuracy but also search depth, tool-use frequency, and adaptive budget allocation. For researchers interested in the pretrain/post-train interface, this is a useful case study in how the structure of generated supervision shapes the resulting reasoning policy.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two main parts: automated data construction and agent post-training. On the data side, the authors start from a curated pool of frontier scientific entities. They then build two pipelines. The first is a conceptual pipeline: a web agent browses academic sources starting from seed entities, gathers evidence, and generates grounded questions. Complexity is then increased through iterative anchor-based task augmentation, where an anchor is the decisive scientific entity that serves as the central handle for the question. The second is a computational pipeline: the system performs a three-level evidence selection process to identify scientific models associated with seed entities, including governing equations, mechanistic understanding, and required input parameters. It then generates computational questions and obtains reference answers through voting-based solver verification. The key idea is not merely to add arithmetic, but to supervise the full chain of finding the right model, extracting the right quantities, and executing the computation. These pipelines produce SciResearcherQA. On the training side, the authors follow a fairly standard but carefully executed deep-research post-training recipe on top of Qwen3-8B: supervised fine-tuning with rejection sampling, followed by reinforcement learning with GRPO, yielding SciResearcher-8B. A notable point is that RL is used not only to improve final accuracy but also to shape longer, more tool-intensive, and difficulty-adaptive trajectories. Compared with prior work, the main differences are the shift from entity-centric web knowledge to heterogeneous academic evidence, the inclusion of computational reasoning as a first-class target, and a more stable automatic loop built from anchor augmentation and solver verification rather than shallow template expansion.
summary_en.experiments: Several numbers stand out. SciResearcher-8B, trained from Qwen3-8B, reaches 19.46% pass@1 and 31.54% pass@3 on HLE-Bio/Chem-Gold. It outperforms SciMaster built on GPT-4.1 and approaches the level of frontier proprietary deep-research systems such as OpenAI Deep Research. It also improves absolute performance by 13.04% on SuperGPQA-Hard-Biology and 14.54% on TRQA-Literature. The behavioral analysis is equally important: compared with the baseline, post-training produces trajectories that are 0.3x to 2.7x longer and uses tools more frequently. More interestingly, RL induces adaptive behavior relative to the SFT checkpoint. On the harder HLE-Bio/Chem-Gold benchmark, the agent learns to allocate more steps and more tool calls; on easier benchmarks, it uses slightly fewer steps while still improving performance. That suggests RL is not simply encouraging longer chains, but learning a better policy for reasoning-budget allocation. While the provided text does not list every ablation in detail, the main empirical message is clear: automatically constructed scientific data transfers across multiple benchmarks, mixing conceptual and computational supervision improves frontier-science reasoning, and SFT plus RL changes the agent’s search and solving behavior, not just its final score.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it in four passes: problem definition, data pipelines, training loop, and behavior analysis. Start with the introduction and the motivating figure to understand why knowledge-graph-based and browsing-based task construction are insufficient for frontier science. Then study the two pipelines carefully. In the conceptual pipeline, focus on how anchor-based augmentation is defined, instantiated, and filtered. In the computational pipeline, pay close attention to the three-level evidence selection process, equation and parameter extraction, and solver verification, because these determine the quality ceiling of the generated data. Next, inspect the SciResearcherQA statistics and examples to judge whether the dataset really captures multi-evidence and computational reasoning. In the training section, focus on the roles of rejection sampling in SFT and GRPO in RL, especially what each stage contributes. Finally, read the trajectory analysis figures on step count, tool-use frequency, and benchmark-dependent budget allocation; these are more informative than the headline scores alone. If time is limited, prioritize the introduction, the method overview figure, the data-construction sections, the main results table, and the RL behavior analysis. Two deeper questions are worth following up: how robust the computational pipeline is against spurious solutions or answer leakage, and whether this style of post-training data could feed back into more native pretraining objectives that unify retrieval, modeling, and solving.

recommendation.zh: 重点看数据生成 pipeline 和任务分布设计；若实验干净，应复用到内部 long-horizon tool-use 后训练消融。
recommendation.en: Read the data pipeline and task-distribution design; if the evaluation is clean, reproduce the recipe in internal long-horizon tool-use ablations.

paper.title: S^3-R1: Learning to Retrieve and Answer Step-by-Step with Synthetic Data
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has enabled newer capabilities in models, such as agentic tool-use for search. However, these models struggle primarily due to limitations with sparse outcome-based rewards and a lack of training data that encapsulates questions of differing hardness, which results in models not performing deeper searches with tools to collect evidence for question-answering. To address these limitations, we introduce S^3-R1 (Synthetic data and stabilized Search R1), a f

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体但长期存在的问题：把 RL 用到检索增强问答时，模型往往学不会稳定的多步搜索策略。原因有两层。第一，训练数据分布偏浅，很多样本并不真正要求多跳检索，模型容易靠短路径或参数记忆拿到答案。第二，奖励过于稀疏，通常只看最终答案是否正确，导致搜索质量、证据覆盖、查询是否有效这些中间行为拿不到训练信号。全文围绕这两个瓶颈展开：如何构造一批“确实需要多步检索、但又不是不可学”的训练题，以及如何让 RL 不只奖励最终答对，还奖励检索过程本身。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关系不在 base pretrain，而在 pretrain 到 post-train 的接口。它提供了一个很清楚的信号：当能力目标是 tool-use 和外部知识检索时，单靠 outcome-only RL 很容易把策略推向短视解。更有效的做法是同时改训练分布和奖励形状。这里最有启发的是“中等难度、可验证、可检索”的合成数据带设计，以及把 retrieval quality 显式写进 reward。对做 continual pretrain、mid-train、agentic post-training 的人，这种思路比单纯换 RL 算法更有参考价值。贡献量级属于扎实的训练范式改进，不是基础建模范式变化。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分成两部分。第一部分是数据。作者不是直接让强模型随便生成多跳题，而是先做 hard example mining，找到当前基座 agent 解不好的问题或文档片段，再让 frontier model 在这些材料上做问题变换和扩展，生成新的 multi-hop QA。之后接一个较严格的过滤链路，核心有两类校验：一类是 factual grounding，确保问题和答案能被原始文档支持，不是语言模型幻觉出来的伪题；另一类是 retrieval-solvability，检查在高召回但带噪声的检索环境里，这个问题是否仍然可解。这个设计的目的很明确：不是追求最难，而是找一个 RL 能学到策略改进的难度带。第二部分是奖励。作者在最终答案正确性之外，引入 retrieval-aware reward，显式鼓励更好的搜索查询和证据选择。按文中描述，这个奖励不是简单给每次 search 固定 bonus，而是和召回到的支持证据、搜索质量相关，意图缓解 credit assignment 问题，让模型知道“为什么这次搜索是有用的”。训练上沿用 Search-R1 一类的交互式 rollout 协议，使用 GRPO 做策略优化，并对外部检索返回内容做 token mask 处理，避免把工具返回直接当作普通生成 token 来更新。
summary.experiments: 从全文可见，实验重点不是证明一个全新 RL 算法，而是验证两件事：合成数据扩展训练分布是否有效，以及 retrieval-aware reward 是否比 outcome-only reward 更能学出深搜索行为。作者在多个 multi-hop QA benchmark 上与 Search-R1、R1-Searcher 一类强基线比较，结论是整体准确率和复杂问题上的表现都有明显提升，且提升主要集中在需要多次检索和证据整合的样本上。消融实验围绕三点展开：去掉合成数据后，模型更容易退回短路径回答；去掉检索感知奖励后，搜索步数和证据质量下降，即便最终答案偶尔还能蒙对；如果放松数据过滤，训练会混入不可解或伪难题，收益明显变差。给出的全文片段里没有完整表格数字、模型参数量和数据规模明细，因此无法可靠填入具体百分比或绝对提升值；但实验结构已经足够说明作者想证明的是“数据分布 + 稠密奖励”这组组合优于单独调 RL。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Method 开头，抓住作者的判断：问题不在 RL 优化器本身，而在训练分布和奖励信号。然后重点看 synthetic question generation / curation 那一节，尤其是 hard seed、verification、retrieval-solvability 这几个步骤，因为真正有方法含量的是数据带设计，而不是“再造一批 synthetic QA”这件事本身。接着看 reward 设计部分，确认 retrieval-aware reward 到底如何定义、是否依赖额外标注、是否会诱导 reward hacking。实验部分建议优先看 ablation：只加数据、只改奖励、两者同时加，三者差异最能说明方法是否成立。预计 20–30 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读；如果你关心 agentic RL 的训练信号设计，可以再细看 failure case 和 search depth 分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode in RL-based search agents for QA: models do not reliably learn multi-step retrieval policies. The root causes are twofold. First, the training distribution is too shallow; many examples do not truly require multi-hop search, so the policy can survive with short-horizon behavior or parametric recall. Second, the reward is too sparse, usually based only on final answer correctness, which gives almost no direct signal for query quality, evidence coverage, or whether an intermediate search action was useful. The paper is built around these two questions: how to construct questions that genuinely require retrieval yet remain learnable, and how to shape RL signals so the model is rewarded for the retrieval process rather than only the final answer.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to the pretrain–post-train interface. The main lesson is clear: for tool-use and retrieval-heavy capabilities, outcome-only RL tends to produce short-sighted policies unless the training distribution and reward design are fixed together. The most useful idea is the construction of a verified, retrieval-solvable, intermediate-difficulty synthetic dataset, paired with an explicit retrieval-aware reward. For researchers working on continual pretraining, mid-training, or agentic post-training, this is more informative than another small variation of PPO or GRPO. The contribution is a solid training recipe improvement rather than a new modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two main components. The first is data construction. Instead of asking a strong model to freely generate multi-hop QA pairs, the pipeline starts with hard example mining: identify questions or document regions that the current base agent fails on, then use a frontier model to mutate or expand them into new multi-hop questions. A filtering pipeline follows, with two key checks. One is factual grounding, which ensures the question and answer are supported by source documents rather than model hallucination. The other is retrieval-solvability, which tests whether the question remains answerable in a noisy but high-recall retrieval setting. This is an important design choice: the target is not maximal difficulty, but a learnable difficulty band where RL can improve policy behavior. The second component is reward design. In addition to final answer correctness, the paper introduces a retrieval-aware reward that explicitly scores search quality and evidence selection. From the full text, this is meant to provide denser credit assignment than a pure outcome reward, so the model can learn which search actions were actually productive. Training follows the interactive search rollout protocol used in Search-R1-style systems, optimized with GRPO, with masking applied to externally retrieved content during policy updates.
summary_en.experiments: The experimental section is organized to validate two claims rather than to introduce a new RL optimizer: expanding the training distribution with synthetic data helps, and adding retrieval-aware reward helps beyond outcome-only supervision. The paper compares against strong baselines such as Search-R1 and R1-Searcher on multiple multi-hop QA benchmarks, and reports consistent gains, especially on questions that require multiple retrieval steps and evidence aggregation. The ablations are the most informative part. Removing synthetic data pushes the model back toward shallow answering behavior. Removing the retrieval-aware reward reduces search depth and evidence quality, even when final-answer accuracy does not collapse immediately. Relaxing the filtering pipeline introduces unsound or effectively unsolvable questions, which weakens training gains. The provided full-text excerpt does not include the final numeric tables, model sizes, or exact dataset scale, so it would be unsafe to invent precise numbers. Still, the structure of the experiments makes the intended result clear: the combination of better data distribution and denser retrieval-specific reward is stronger than tuning RL alone.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and the opening of the method section. The key claim is that the bottleneck is not primarily the RL optimizer, but the training distribution and reward signal. Then read the synthetic question generation and curation section carefully, especially the hard-seed mining, verification, and retrieval-solvability checks. That is where the real methodological content sits; the value is not simply 'more synthetic QA', but how the difficulty band is engineered. After that, inspect the reward section to see how retrieval-aware reward is defined, whether it depends on extra supervision, and whether it creates room for reward hacking. In the experiments, prioritize the ablations: data only, reward only, and both together. Those comparisons tell you whether the method is actually doing what it claims. A useful skim should take about 20–30 minutes. If your interest is RL signal design for search agents, spend extra time on failure cases and search-depth analysis.

recommendation.zh: 读数据筛选和 dense reward 设计即可；方法像工程补丁，但能提醒预训练团队别把检索能力全压给 outcome RL。
recommendation.en: Read the data filtering and dense-reward design; it is an engineering patch, but a useful warning against relying on outcome-only RL for retrieval behavior.

institutions: The University of Texas at Austin

paper.title: FlexSQL: Flexible Exploration and Execution Make Better Text-to-SQL Agents
paper.abstract: Text-to-SQL over large analytical databases requires navigating complex schemas, resolving ambiguous queries, and grounding decisions in actual data. Most current systems follow a fixed pipeline where schema elements are retrieved once upfront and the database is only revisited for post-hoc repair, limiting recovery from early mistakes. We present FlexSQL, a text-to-SQL agent whose core design principle is flexible database interaction: the agent can explore schema structure, inspect data values

summary.core_problem: 解决复杂分析数据库上的 text-to-SQL：模型需要在大 schema、含糊问题和真实数据值之间做可靠 grounding，并能从早期错误中恢复。
summary.importance: 贡献是 text-to-SQL Agent 的系统设计，强调推理过程中随时探索 schema、检查数据值和执行验证查询，而不是只在开头检索一次 schema。对通用基座训练启发有限，但对工具交互式评测和 Agent scaffolding 有参考。
summary.technical_approach: FlexSQL 允许 Agent 在推理任意阶段访问数据库，生成多个执行计划覆盖不同解释；每个计划可选择用 SQL 或 Python 实现，并通过两级 repair 机制从代码级错误回退到计划级修正。
summary.experiments: 在 Spider2-Snow 上，使用 gpt-oss-120b 得到 65.4% 分数；摘要称其超过若干使用更强或更大模型的开源 baselines，包括 gpt-o3 和 DeepSeek-R1 相关设置，但未给出完整消融细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Alberta、Simon Fraser University、University of Waterloo、Princeton University 和 New York University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses text-to-SQL over large analytical databases, where systems must navigate complex schemas, resolve ambiguity, and ground decisions in actual data.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent-system design for interactive database grounding. It is not central to foundation-model pretraining, but it is relevant as evidence that tool-interaction policy can dominate raw model choice in structured reasoning tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: FlexSQL lets the agent explore schema, inspect values, and run verification queries at any point during reasoning. It creates diverse execution plans, implements them in SQL or Python depending on the task, and uses two-tier repair that can backtrack from code errors to plan revisions.
summary_en.experiments: On Spider2-Snow with gpt-oss-120b, FlexSQL reports a 65.4% score and outperforms open-source baselines that use stronger or larger models such as gpt-o3 and DeepSeek-R1 configurations. The abstract does not include full ablations.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the University of Alberta, Simon Fraser University, the University of Waterloo, Princeton University, and New York University.

recommendation.zh: 只看交互式 DB grounding 和两级 repair；这是 Agent scaffold 经验，不是模型能力结论。
recommendation.en: Skim the interactive DB grounding and two-level repair design; this is scaffold evidence, not a clean model-capability result.

paper.title: AcademiClaw: When Students Set Challenges for AI Agents
paper.abstract: Benchmarks within the OpenClaw ecosystem have thus far evaluated exclusively assistant-level tasks, leaving the academic-level capabilities of OpenClaw largely unexamined. We introduce AcademiClaw, a bilingual benchmark of 80 complex, long-horizon tasks sourced directly from university students' real academic workflows -- homework, research projects, competitions, and personal projects -- that they found current AI agents unable to solve effectively. Curated from 230 student-submitted candidates

summary.core_problem: OpenClaw 生态的现有评测偏“助理型任务”，缺少对真实学术/专业工作流中高难度、长时程、强执行约束任务的系统评估。论文要解决的是：如何构建一个来源真实、难度自然对齐前沿能力、并且可在 Docker 沙箱内可验证评分的 academic-level agent benchmark。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接相关性一般，但对 post-train（agent SFT/RL）、长时程能力诊断与数据合成方向有现实价值：它提供了更“硬”的任务分布（含 GPU/CUDA 执行、跨框架调试、形式化推理等），以及多维度验证方式，能更清晰地区分模型在工具使用、形式推理、执行鲁棒性上的短板。它也提示一个常见误区：token 消耗与质量几乎不相关，单纯拉长思考/轨迹并不等价于更好策略。
summary.technical_approach:
1) 任务来源：采用 bottom-up 收集，让本科生提交“他们亲自尝试过、现有 agent 做不好”的真实学术工作流任务；从 230 个候选经专家审核筛到 80 个最终任务，覆盖 25+ 领域，双语。
2) 执行与隔离：每个任务封装在隔离的 Docker 容器内，包含提示、参考材料与评分脚本/规程；其中 16 个任务需要 CUDA GPU 执行，这在同类 agent benchmark 中较少见。
3) 评分体系：不是单一 pass/fail，而是组合六类验证信号：确定性检查、代码执行、LLM-as-judge、VLM 评估、端到端浏览器测试、结构化输出校验；并配套安全审计维度。
4) 统一评测协议：在同一 OpenClaw agent 框架下评测多家前沿模型，分析总体通过率、任务级别的能力边界、行为模式差异（read-first / execute-first / minimalist）与 token-质量关系。
summary.experiments:
评测对象包含 Claude Opus 4.6、Claude Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5.4、Gemini 3.1 Pro、Qwen3.5-397B、MiniMax M2.7。在该基准上，最佳模型通过率约 55%（以 score≥75/100 计）。
更细的诊断结论：
- 约 22% 的任务在不同模型间出现最高约 90 分的巨大分差，显示明显 capability boundary。
- 生成式任务相对更好，形式化推理（如奥赛级题）普遍失败。
- token 消耗跨模型差异超过 5×，但与质量几乎零相关（r≈-0.03）。
（若需要更贴近“预训练研究”的可用信号，建议进一步查看：哪些任务类型对模型规模/训练数据更敏感，是否提供轨迹与中间产物以支持 error attribution。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
- 先看任务收集与筛选流程（能判断任务分布是否“可复现、可扩展”）。
- 再看评分与验证设计（六种验证如何组合、各自覆盖的失败模式、LLM-as-judge 的偏差控制）。
- 最后看模型对比与现象分析：capability boundary、三类行为 phenotype、token-质量脱钩。
预计 40-60 分钟可读完并抓住 benchmark 设计要点；若要用它做训练闭环（数据合成/RL），需要进一步深挖任务可程序化分解与奖励信号落地方式。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing OpenClaw benchmarks largely target assistant-like tasks and under-measure academic/professional workflows that are long-horizon, execution-heavy, and domain-intensive. The paper builds an academic-level benchmark with real user-sourced tasks and robust, sandboxed verification.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to core pretraining is moderate, but it is practically useful for agent post-training (SFT/RL), long-horizon diagnostics, and data-generation pipelines. It offers a harder task distribution (including CUDA/GPU execution and cross-stack debugging) and multi-signal evaluation that better separates weaknesses in tool use, formal reasoning, and execution robustness. A notable empirical warning is that more tokens/longer traces do not reliably translate into higher quality (near-zero token–quality correlation).
summary_en.technical_approach:
1) Bottom-up task sourcing: undergraduate students submit tasks from real academic workflows that current agents fail on; 230 candidates are expert-reviewed down to 80 bilingual tasks spanning 25+ domains.
2) Sandboxed execution: each task runs in an isolated Docker container with prompts, reference materials, and evaluation procedures; 16 tasks require CUDA GPU execution.
3) Multi-dimensional scoring: combine six verification mechanisms—deterministic checks, code execution, LLM-as-judge, VLM-based assessment, end-to-end browser testing, and structured-output validation—plus safety auditing.
4) Standardized evaluation: benchmark multiple frontier models under the same OpenClaw agent framework; analyze aggregate pass rates, task-level capability boundaries, behavioral phenotypes (read-first / execute-first / minimalist), and token usage vs quality.
summary_en.experiments:
Models evaluated include Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.4, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Qwen3.5-397B, and MiniMax M2.7. The best model reaches ~55% pass rate (score ≥ 75/100).
Additional findings: ~22% of tasks show up to ~90-point score swings across models (clear capability boundaries); generative tasks are handled better than formal reasoning (olympiad-level problems remain unsolved); token usage varies by >5× across models but is almost uncorrelated with quality (r ≈ -0.03).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim in three passes:
- Task collection and curation: to judge realism, difficulty calibration, and reproducibility.
- Evaluation design: how the six verification signals are combined, and how judge bias is controlled.
- Results analysis: capability boundaries, behavioral phenotypes, and the token–quality disconnect.
~40–60 minutes is enough to extract the benchmark design and key phenomena; using it for training loops requires deeper inspection of task decomposability and how to turn rubrics into reward signals.

recommendation.zh: 把“真实长链路学术工作流”做成可执行基准这点有用；但先只看任务构成与评分rubric，没看到强基线前别过度解读排名。
recommendation.en: Useful as an executable long-horizon academic-workflow benchmark; skim the task taxonomy and scoring rubrics first, and don’t over-trust any leaderboard until strong baselines are shown.

paper.title: Trojan Hippo: Weaponizing Agent Memory for Data Exfiltration
paper.abstract: Memory systems enable otherwise-stateless LLM agents to persist user information across sessions, but also introduce a new attack surface. We characterize the Trojan Hippo attack, a class of persistent memory attacks that operates in a more realistic threat model than prior memory poisoning work: the attacker plants a dormant payload into an agent's long-term memory via a single untrusted tool call (e.g., a crafted email), which activates only when the user later discusses sensitive topics such

summary.core_problem: 持久化 agent memory 让 LLM agent 能跨会话保存用户信息，但也把间接 prompt injection 变成可长期潜伏的攻击。Trojan Hippo 研究的是攻击者只通过一次不可信工具输入植入 payload，随后在用户谈到金融、健康、身份等敏感主题时触发并外传私人数据。
summary.importance: 这项工作与基座预训练的直接关系较弱，主要价值在 agent memory 和 post-training 安全评测。它提醒模型能力、工具调用、长期记忆三者组合后，安全边界会从单轮上下文扩展到跨会话状态。对训练研究的启发是：仅靠通用拒答或单轮安全对齐不足以覆盖持久记忆风险，训练数据和评测需要显式区分用户指令、外部内容、记忆写入、记忆读取和工具调用权限。
summary.technical_approach: Trojan Hippo 的威胁模型比传统 memory poisoning 更贴近部署场景。攻击者没有直接写 memory 的权限，也不假设用户恶意，而是通过邮件等外部工具返回内容植入指令。payload 需要完成三件事：通过安全模型过滤，进入长期 memory，并在之后遇到敏感主题时延迟激活。作者提出动态评测框架，强调三个维度：realism，使用间接注入和黑盒 safety-aligned frontier models；adaptiveness，用 OpenEvolve 对攻击 payload 做迭代搜索，在训练版 agent 环境中优化，再在 held-out 环境测试，减少对固定提示的过拟合；capability trade-off，评估防御时同时看安全性和 agent 记忆能力损失。防御设计基于最小权限、信息流隔离等安全原则。
summary.experiments: 给出的内容显示，实验覆盖异构 memory 架构和多种防御，并在端到端间接注入链路中评估攻击成功率。攻击对象是黑盒、经过安全对齐的前沿模型，payload 由自适应 red-teaming 流程生成，而不是人工固定模板。摘要和引言强调该流程能系统评估攻击与防御，但可见内容没有给出具体 ASR 数字、模型列表、memory 架构细节或各防御的量化结果。因此这里不补充未给出的数值。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 到 30 分钟。优先看 threat model，确认攻击者能力、用户假设、memory 写入路径和触发条件；再看 adaptive red-teaming 框架，尤其是 OpenEvolve 如何生成 payload、训练环境和 held-out 测试环境如何隔离。防御章节适合重点看 capability trade-off，因为很多强隔离策略会直接损伤个性化记忆能力。若只关心基座预训练，可略读实验细节，把重点放在 memory-aware safety data 和 agent instruction hierarchy 的启发上。

summary_en.core_problem: Persistent agent memory enables cross-session personalization, but it also turns indirect prompt injection into a durable attack vector. Trojan Hippo studies a setting where an attacker plants a dormant payload through a single untrusted tool output, such as a crafted email, and the payload later activates when the user discusses sensitive topics like finance, health, or identity.
summary_en.importance: The direct relevance to foundation-model pretraining is limited. The main value is for agent-memory safety and post-training evaluation. The key lesson is that once tool use, long-term memory, and personal data are combined, the safety boundary is no longer a single context window. Training and evaluation need to distinguish user instructions, external content, memory writes, memory reads, and tool permissions. Generic refusal behavior or single-turn safety tuning is unlikely to cover this class of persistent-memory failures.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Trojan Hippo threat model is more deployment-like than many earlier memory-poisoning setups. The attacker does not get direct memory-write access and the user is assumed benign. Instead, the attacker controls an external content channel, such as email, and tries to get a payload stored in long-term memory. The payload must pass safety filtering, survive the memory pipeline, remain dormant, and activate only under sensitive-topic conditions. The paper introduces a dynamic evaluation framework with three axes: realism, using indirect injection against black-box safety-aligned frontier models; adaptiveness, using OpenEvolve to iteratively refine attack payloads in a training agent environment and evaluate them on held-out environments; and capability trade-off, measuring defenses not only by attack reduction but also by how much they degrade useful memory behavior. The defense discussion is grounded in principles such as least privilege and information-flow separation.
summary_en.experiments: The visible content indicates systematic evaluation across heterogeneous memory architectures and defenses, using end-to-end indirect injection pipelines rather than direct memory writes. Attack payloads are generated through an adaptive red-teaming loop instead of fixed hand-written prompts. The paper emphasizes held-out evaluation to avoid overfitting to one environment. Specific ASR numbers, model lists, memory-system variants, and defense-by-defense quantitative results are not present in the provided content, so no additional figures are inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20- to 30-minute skim is appropriate. Start with the threat model: attacker capability, trusted-user assumption, memory write path, and trigger condition. Then read the adaptive red-teaming setup, especially how OpenEvolve optimizes payloads and how the held-out environment is separated from the training environment. The defense section is worth reading for the capability trade-off, since strict memory isolation can easily reduce the usefulness of personalization. For pretraining-focused readers, the main takeaway is about memory-aware safety data and instruction hierarchy rather than model architecture.

recommendation.zh: 读 threat model 和 defense table；它不教你预训练，但会改变对 agent memory 安全边界的默认假设。
recommendation.en: Read the threat model and defense table; it will not inform pretraining directly, but it should update your default assumptions about agent-memory safety boundaries.

paper.title: When Alignment Isn't Enough: Response-Path Attacks on LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) agent architectures let users route LLM traffic through third-party relays, creating a critical integrity gap: a malicious relay can modify an aligned LLM response after generation but before agent execution. We formalize this post-alignment tampering threat and show that, without end-to-end integrity, the relay can observe, suppress, or replace downstream messages, making even perfectly aligned LLMs ineffective against such attacks. We instantiate this threat as the Re

summary.core_problem: 该工作指出 BYOK 代理架构中的响应路径完整性缺口：即使 LLM 已经生成安全对齐的回复，第三方 relay 仍可在模型输出到 agent 执行之间篡改工具调用、参数或控制字段。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但对大模型 agent 的安全边界有直接提醒。它把“对齐保证”和“执行完整性”拆开：RLHF、宪法训练、系统提示词只能约束模型生成的 token，不能约束 agent 最终收到的 token。对基座研究员的启发在于，agent 场景里的安全失败不一定来自模型能力或对齐缺陷，也可能来自协议层缺少端到端完整性校验。评估 agent 安全时，不能只测 prompt injection 或 jailbreak，还要测模型输出链路是否可被替换。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把问题形式化为 post-alignment tampering，并用 game-based security definition 描述 relay 在 LLM-to-agent 路径上的能力。relay 不需要突破 TLS，也不需要诱导模型越狱；它是用户合法配置的中间服务，天然能看到明文请求和响应。攻击框架 RTA 分三步：第一，strategic orchestration 将多轮目标拆成子目标，并判断哪些轮次需要篡改；第二，tactical manipulation 不改大段自然语言，而是最小化修改结构化字段，例如 tool name、arguments、control flags；第三，stealth restoration 把篡改后的草稿再提交给同一个后端模型，让模型补回自然语言风格，从而降低人工或规则检测的异常感。论文区分两条路径：RTA-PreWrite 在对齐前改写用户查询，RTA-PostForge 在模型已生成安全输出后伪造响应。后者是重点，因为它绕过了所有模型侧对齐机制。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 AgentDojo 和 ASB 两个 agent-security benchmark，以及六个闭源和开源 LLM。主要攻击 RTA-PostForge 在 ASB 上达到 89.2% ASR，在 AgentDojo 上达到 73.5% ASR，强于 prompt injection 基线。辅助的查询路径攻击 RTA-PreWrite 在 ASB 上达到 99.1% ASR。论文还报告 RTA-PostForge 能保持风格一致性，74% 的额外延迟落在自然 relay 方差范围内。OpenClaw 和 Claude Code 的案例展示了端到端可行性。现有 agent 侧防御在保持可用性的前提下难以阻断 RTA-PostForge；一个 time-channel detector 在 50 轮交互上达到 AUC = 0.964 ± 0.075，但这更像检测信号，不是完整修复。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 对 BYOK 信任假设的拆解、formalization 中 response-path forgery 与 prompt injection 的区别、RTA 框架部分的三阶段设计，以及 evaluation 中 ASB、AgentDojo 的 ASR 表格。防御部分值得快速看，尤其是为什么 agent 侧过滤和模型侧重审都不能自然解决响应路径伪造。形式化证明可以按需阅读；如果主要关心预训练或对齐，只需抓住一个结论：模型对齐不能替代协议完整性。

summary_en.core_problem: The work studies an integrity gap in BYOK agent deployments: a third-party relay can rewrite an aligned LLM response after generation but before agent execution, changing tool calls, arguments, or control fields.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to the security boundary of LLM agents. The key distinction is between alignment guarantees and execution integrity. RLHF, constitutional training, and system prompts constrain what the model emits; they do not guarantee that the agent executes the same message. For foundation-model researchers, the useful lesson is that agent failures may come from protocol design rather than model behavior. Agent safety evaluations should therefore include response-path substitution, not only prompt injection and jailbreaks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formalizes post-alignment tampering with game-based security definitions. The relay is not a network attacker that needs to break TLS; it is a legitimate BYOK intermediary with plaintext access. The proposed Relay Tampering Attack has three stages. Strategic orchestration decomposes a multi-turn objective and decides when to intervene. Tactical manipulation performs small schema-level edits to execution-critical fields such as tool names, arguments, and control flags. Stealth restoration resubmits the edited draft to the same backend model so that surrounding prose is regenerated in the model’s native style while preserving attacker-chosen fields. The paper separates RTA-PreWrite, which modifies the query before alignment, from RTA-PostForge, which forges the response after a benign aligned output has already been produced. The latter is the central case because it bypasses model-side alignment entirely.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses AgentDojo and ASB across six proprietary and open-weight LLMs. RTA-PostForge reaches 89.2% attack success rate on ASB and 73.5% on AgentDojo, outperforming prompt-injection baselines. The auxiliary query-path variant, RTA-PreWrite, reaches 99.1% on ASB. The attack preserves stylistic consistency, and 74% of its latency overhead falls within natural relay variance. Case studies on OpenClaw and Claude Code show end-to-end feasibility. Existing agent-side defenses do not neutralize RTA-PostForge while preserving utility; a time-channel detector reports AUC = 0.964 ± 0.075 over 50 interaction turns, which is a useful signal but not a protocol-level fix.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough for most pretraining readers. Focus on the introduction’s trust-boundary argument, the formal distinction between response-path forgery and prompt injection, the three-stage RTA design, and the ASB/AgentDojo evaluation tables. The defense section is worth reading for the negative result: model-side rechecking and agent-side filters do not naturally solve response substitution. The formal proofs can be read selectively unless the reader works directly on agent security protocols.

recommendation.zh: 读威胁模型和防御失败表即可；它提醒安全评测不能只测模型输出，Agent 执行链路也要做端到端完整性。
recommendation.en: Read the threat model and defense-failure table; it is a clean reminder that agent safety needs end-to-end integrity, not just aligned model outputs.

paper.title: Are Tools All We Need? Unveiling the Tool-Use Tax in LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Tool-augmented reasoning has become a popular direction for LLM-based agents, and it is widely assumed to improve reasoning and reliability. However, we demonstrate that this consensus does not always hold: in the presence of semantic distractors, tool-augmented reasoning does not necessarily outperform native CoT. To explain this performance gap, we propose a Factorized Intervention Framework that isolates the cost of prompt formatting, the overhead of the tool-calling protocol, and the actual

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要回答一个很具体但常被忽略的问题：当输入里混入语义相关但推理无关的干扰信息时，为什么带工具的 agent 反而可能不如原生 CoT 推理。作者把这个现象称为 tool-use tax，意思是工具调用协议本身会引入额外负担，而这部分负担在有语义噪声时可能超过工具真正带来的收益。论文不是泛泛讨论“工具有没有用”，而是试图把 CoT 与 tool-agent 的性能差拆开，区分到底是 prompt 格式变了、函数调用协议变复杂了，还是工具执行本身没有提供足够增益。
summary.importance: 它不是预训练论文，但对 post-train、agent 训练和推理时控制有现实启发。很多 agent 工作默认把工具接入视为单调增益，这篇论文提醒人们：工具链路本身就是一种分布偏移和认知负担，尤其在输入含噪时更明显。对基座研究员有两点价值。第一，它把“工具能力”与“工具协议成本”分开测量，这对设计 tool-use SFT / RL 数据很重要，因为训练目标可能无意中把格式遵循和多轮调用成本混在一起。第二，它提出 capability overlap 视角：如果任务本来就大多能被 native CoT 解决，那么工具只是在少数样本上提供边际收益，却在所有样本上引入协议开销。这个判断对 agent 是否应该内生化、哪些能力该 pretrain、哪些该外接工具，有直接参考意义。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上最重要的是一个分解框架，而不是某个复杂模型。作者构造了七种干预条件，把从原生 CoT 到完整工具 agent 的路径拆成若干可测组件。

主分解链是：NoTool-CoT → NoTool-FCStyle → Agent-NoopTool → Agent-Full。

NoTool-CoT 是普通链式推理基线。NoTool-FCStyle 只把提示格式改成 function-calling 风格，但不给工具访问，用来测量 style cost，也就是仅仅因为输出格式、角色约束、schema 变化带来的性能损失。Agent-NoopTool 在此基础上加入完整工具调用协议，但工具返回 no-op stub，不提供真实帮助，用来估计 function-calling protocol overhead。Agent-Full 则恢复真实工具执行，测量最终净效果。

在这个链条上，作者定义了三个核心量：Δ_sty，格式成本；Δ_frc，函数调用协议开销；Δ_cmp，真实计算或工具执行带来的收益。这样，CoT 与 Agent 的性能差不再是一个黑箱净值，而能被拆成“先损失多少，再补回多少”。

此外，论文还设计了几个诊断条件。Agent-OracleCalc 用金标准工具输出替代真实工具结果，给出“如果工具执行完全正确，最多能补回多少”的上界；Agent-OracleEvidence 提供干净证据，隔离语义干扰主要伤害的是证据选择还是后续推理整合；Agent-Max1Turn 限制最多一次函数调用，用来判断多轮交互究竟在帮忙还是主要增加协议负担。

数据方面，作者没有只在原 benchmark 上比较，而是专门构造了 Sem-Distractor 版本的 GSM8K 和 HotPotQA。干扰分四类：Thematic Background、Semantic Paraphrase、Parallel Entity Distractor、Hedged Uncertainty。共同特点是“语义上相关、语言上自然、但对正确推理无帮助甚至误导”，比简单随机噪声更接近真实场景。

在机制解释上，作者提出 capability overlap principle：很多看似适合用工具的样本，其实 native CoT 已经能做对，因此工具执行的边际收益只覆盖一小部分样本；但工具协议成本会作用于更大范围样本，于是净效果可能为负。最后，作者提出 G-STEP 作为轻量推理时控制方法，用来缓解这种税负。给出的片段没有完整展开 G-STEP 细节，但从描述看，它应当是在推理时更谨慎地决定是否进入工具调用流程，减少不必要的 protocol overhead。
summary.experiments:
实验主线很清楚，虽然当前片段没有完整数字表。

第一，作者在 GSM8K-Sem-Distractor 和 HotPotQA-Sem-Distractor 上比较 native CoT 与 Agent-Full，发现语义干扰存在时，工具增强并不稳定优于 CoT，甚至会落后。这是全文的起点。

第二，通过分解实验，作者展示性能损失并不主要来自“工具算错了”，而是前面两层成本：FC-style prompt 改写本身会带来损失，完整函数调用协议再进一步拉低表现，而真实工具执行带来的收益 Δ_cmp 往往不足以抵消前两者。这就是 tool-use tax 的实证定义。

第三，Oracle 条件帮助定位瓶颈。如果 Agent-OracleCalc 仍然提升有限，说明问题不只在工具结果质量，而在于模型何时调用、如何整合、是否被干扰信息带偏。若 Agent-OracleEvidence 明显改善，则说明语义噪声主要伤害证据选择阶段。Agent-Max1Turn 则用于检验多轮调用是否值得；作者的叙述暗示额外轮次常常更多增加协议负担，而不是带来等量收益。

第四，作者用 capability overlap 解释结果分布：工具真正有独特帮助的样本比例有限，而协议成本覆盖面更广，因此平均净收益可能为负。最后用 G-STEP 做轻量干预，验证在不重新训练模型的情况下，可以部分减轻 tool-use tax。

由于给出的全文片段在 G-STEP 截断，且没有完整结果表，无法可靠填写具体模型名称、绝对准确率、提升幅度和统计显著性数字。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇论文适合按“现象—分解—机制—缓解”四步读。

先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1。Figure 1 基本就是全文骨架，读懂 NoTool-CoT、NoTool-FCStyle、Agent-NoopTool、Agent-Full 之间的关系，后面大部分结果都会变得直接。

然后看数据构造部分。重点不是 benchmark 本身，而是四类 semantic distractor 为什么比普通噪声更难。这里决定了论文结论适用的场景：它讨论的是语义相关干扰，不是随机脏数据。

接着看主结果和 factorized intervention 实验。建议把注意力放在三个差值 Δ_sty、Δ_frc、Δ_cmp 上，而不是只看最终谁高谁低。真正有信息量的是：损失发生在哪一段，工具收益是否足够覆盖协议成本。

Oracle 和 Max1Turn 部分值得细看，因为它们决定作者的机制解释是否站得住。如果给了金标准工具结果仍然不行，那问题就在 agent protocol 和 reasoning integration，而不是工具本身。

最后看 G-STEP。即便它只是轻量 inference-time 方法，也能帮助判断作者提出的 tool-use tax 是否可操作，而不只是一个描述性概念。泛读的话，读 Figure 1、主表、Oracle 结果和 G-STEP 部分，大约 25 分钟能抓住主线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a specific failure mode of tool-augmented LLM agents: under semantically relevant but reasoning-irrelevant distractors, why can native chain-of-thought outperform a full tool-using agent? The authors call this the tool-use tax. The key claim is that tool use is not a free capability boost. The function-calling format and interaction protocol introduce their own burden, and under semantic noise that burden can outweigh the actual benefit of executing tools.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it matters for post-training, agent design, and inference-time control. Many agent papers implicitly assume that adding tools is monotonic improvement. This work argues that the protocol itself can be a source of degradation. For foundation-model researchers, two points stand out. First, it separates tool capability from tool protocol cost, which is useful when designing SFT or RL data for tool use. Otherwise, one may conflate genuine external-computation gains with losses caused by formatting and multi-turn interaction. Second, the capability-overlap argument is relevant to the boundary between internalized model competence and external tools: if native CoT already solves most cases, tool execution only helps on a small subset while protocol overhead applies broadly, making the average gain negative.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main contribution is a factorized intervention framework rather than a new model architecture. The authors decompose the path from native reasoning to full tool-augmented reasoning into measurable components.

The primary chain is NoTool-CoT -> NoTool-FCStyle -> Agent-NoopTool -> Agent-Full.

NoTool-CoT is the standard chain-of-thought baseline. NoTool-FCStyle changes only the prompt format into a function-calling style without granting tool access, isolating the style cost introduced by schema, role constraints, and output formatting. Agent-NoopTool then adds the full tool-calling protocol but replaces actual tool outputs with a no-op stub, estimating the protocol overhead before any useful external computation happens. Agent-Full restores real tool execution and measures the net gain from actual tool logic.

This yields three central quantities: Delta_sty for formatting cost, Delta_frc for function-calling protocol overhead, and Delta_cmp for the gain from real computation or tool execution. Instead of treating the CoT-versus-agent gap as a single black-box number, the framework asks how much performance is first lost and how much is later recovered.

The paper also introduces diagnostic conditions around Agent-Full. Agent-OracleCalc replaces tool outputs with gold answers to bound losses attributable to imperfect tool execution. Agent-OracleEvidence provides clean evidence to isolate distractor-sensitive evidence-selection failures. Agent-Max1Turn restricts the agent to a single function-calling turn to test whether extra turns help or mostly add overhead.

On the data side, the authors build semantic-distractor versions of GSM8K and HotPotQA rather than evaluating only on clean benchmarks. They define four distractor types: Thematic Background, Semantic Paraphrase, Parallel Entity Distractor, and Hedged Uncertainty. These are designed to be topically relevant and linguistically natural, but logically unhelpful or misleading.

For mechanism, the paper proposes the capability overlap principle: many cases that appear tool-amenable are already solvable by native CoT, so the marginal benefit of tool execution is limited to a relatively small subset, while protocol costs affect a much larger set of examples. The paper then introduces G-STEP as a lightweight inference-time mitigation, apparently aimed at reducing unnecessary entry into the tool-calling protocol.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental story is clear even though the provided text does not include the full result tables.

First, on GSM8K-Sem-Distractor and HotPotQA-Sem-Distractor, native CoT and Agent-Full are compared under semantic noise. The main observation is that tool-augmented reasoning does not reliably beat native CoT and can underperform it.

Second, the factorized intervention results show that the degradation is not explained solely by bad tool outputs. There is measurable loss from adopting function-calling style prompts, additional loss from the tool-calling protocol itself, and the gain from actual tool execution often fails to compensate for those earlier losses. That empirical decomposition is the core evidence for the tool-use tax.

Third, the oracle conditions help localize the bottleneck. If Agent-OracleCalc still does not recover much, then the issue is not only tool correctness but also when the model calls tools, how it integrates results, and how distractors distort the process. If Agent-OracleEvidence improves substantially, then evidence selection under semantic noise is a major failure point. Agent-Max1Turn tests whether multi-turn interaction is useful or mostly costly; the paper's framing suggests that extra turns often add more protocol burden than benefit.

Fourth, the capability-overlap analysis explains why average gains can be negative: the subset of examples with unique tool benefit is limited, while protocol costs are widespread. Finally, G-STEP is used as a lightweight intervention to reduce the tax without retraining the model. The provided excerpt does not contain reliable model names, absolute accuracies, or exact deltas, so those should not be fabricated.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this paper in four passes: phenomenon, decomposition, mechanism, mitigation.

Start with the introduction and Figure 1. Figure 1 is the structural core of the paper. Once the relationship among NoTool-CoT, NoTool-FCStyle, Agent-NoopTool, and Agent-Full is clear, the rest of the experiments become much easier to interpret.

Then read the dataset construction section. The important point is not the benchmark names but why semantic distractors are a stronger stress test than generic noise. The conclusions are about semantically plausible interference, not random corruption.

Next, focus on the factorized intervention results. Pay attention to Delta_sty, Delta_frc, and Delta_cmp rather than only to end-to-end accuracy. The informative question is where performance is lost and whether real tool execution recovers enough to justify the protocol.

The oracle and Max1Turn analyses are worth careful reading because they determine whether the mechanism claim is convincing. If gold tool outputs still do not solve the problem, then the bottleneck lies in the agent protocol and reasoning integration rather than in the tool itself.

Finally, read the G-STEP section. Even if it is lightweight, it tests whether the tool-use tax is operationally actionable rather than just descriptive. For a quick read, Figure 1, the main results, the oracle analyses, and the G-STEP section are enough for roughly 25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是在吹新 agent，而是在拆工具调用的净收益；只看 factorized intervention 和 tool-use tax 定义就够，能直接校正你对 toolformer 类训练目标的预期。
recommendation.en: This is useful because it measures net tool value instead of selling another agent stack; read the factorized intervention setup and the tool-use tax definition, and recalibrate your expectations for tool-use training.

paper.title: RunAgent: Interpreting Natural-Language Plans with Constraint-Guided Execution
paper.abstract: Humans solve problems by executing targeted plans, yet large language models (LLMs) remain unreliable for structured workflow execution. We propose RunAgent, a multi-agent plan execution platform that interprets natural-language plans while enforcing stepwise execution through constraints and rubrics. RunAgent bridges the expressiveness of natural language with the determinism of programming via an agentic language with explicit control constructs (e.g., \texttt{IF}, \texttt{GOTO}, \texttt{FORAL

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 在结构化工作流执行中计划可表达但执行不稳定、难以保证逐步正确性的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献属于通用 agent 执行框架：把自然语言计划映射到带控制流和约束检查的执行语言，重点是执行可靠性而不是模型能力本身。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RunAgent：用显式控制结构（如 IF、GOTO、FORALL）表示 agentic language；每一步自动派生约束与 rubric，对步骤输出做语法和语义验证；在 LLM 推理、工具调用、代码生成执行之间动态选择，并带错误纠正和上下文过滤。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark、模型规模和提升幅度，只能确认其评估目标是结构化任务执行的正确性与鲁棒性。缺少 clean setup 细节，当前更像系统设计论文。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Maryland, College Park 与 NEC Laboratories America。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the gap between expressive natural-language plans and reliable execution in structured workflows with LLMs.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a general agent-execution framework: it turns natural-language plans into a constrained execution language, focusing on reliability of execution rather than improving the base model itself.
summary_en.technical_approach: RunAgent introduces an agentic language with explicit control constructs such as IF, GOTO, and FORALL; it derives constraints and rubrics for each step, verifies outputs syntactically and semantically, dynamically chooses among LLM reasoning, tool use, and code execution, and includes error correction plus context filtering.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete benchmarks, model sizes, or gains. It appears to evaluate correctness and robustness in structured task execution, but the setup details are too sparse to judge how clean the evidence is.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the University of Maryland, College Park and NEC Laboratories America.

recommendation.zh: 像是把 workflow engine 和 LLM agent 接起来的系统化实现，方法不新但工程边界画得清；只看控制流语言设计和约束验证部分即可。
recommendation.en: This looks like a workflow engine wrapped around an LLM agent: not a new paradigm, but the execution-language and constraint-validation pieces are the only parts worth skimming.

paper.title: Semia: Auditing Agent Skills via Constraint-Guided Representation Synthesis
paper.abstract: An agent skill is a configuration package that equips an LLM-driven agent with a concrete capability, such as reading email, executing shell commands, or signing blockchain transactions. Each skill is a hybrid artifact-a structured half declares executable interfaces, while a prose half dictates when and how those interfaces fire-and the prose is reinterpreted probabilistically on every invocation. Conventional static analyzers parse the structured half but ignore the prose; LLM-based tools read

summary.core_problem: 审计 LLM agent skill 中由自然语言条件触发的高风险工具调用，尤其是 tainted input 到危险 sink 的可证明传播路径。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 安全与静态分析工具。它关注的不是模型训练，而是 agent skill 这种混合制品的安全边界：结构化接口可解析，但自然语言触发条件难以被传统静态分析覆盖。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Semia，把 skill 转换为 Skill Description Language, SDL，即一个 Datalog fact base，显式表示 LLM 触发动作、自然语言条件和 human-in-the-loop 检查点。核心技术是 Constraint-Guided Representation Synthesis，用约束引导方式把 prose 半部分转成结构一致、语义尽量 faithful 的事实表示。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出数据集规模、baseline、漏洞发现数量或误报漏报指标。只能确认目标是可复现地证明 tainted input 是否能到达高影响 sink。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 University of California, Santa Barbara、Fuzzland 和 University of California, San Diego。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper audits LLM agent skills where natural-language conditions may trigger high-impact tool calls, especially taint flows from untrusted inputs to dangerous sinks.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent safety and static-analysis contribution. It targets the security gap in hybrid skill artifacts: executable interfaces are parseable, but prose-defined trigger conditions are usually ignored or handled unreliably.
summary_en.technical_approach: Semia lifts each skill into the Skill Description Language, a Datalog fact base representing LLM-triggered actions, prose-defined conditions, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. Its main technique is Constraint-Guided Representation Synthesis, which aims to produce a structurally valid and semantically faithful representation of the original skill.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide benchmark size, baselines, vulnerability counts, or precision and recall. It only states the goal of reproducibly proving taint reachability into high-impact sinks.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institutions include University of California, Santa Barbara, Fuzzland, and University of California, San Diego.

recommendation.zh: 预训练侧只需知道 agent skill 的 prose 已成攻击面；读 SDL 表示即可，不必深挖安全实验。
recommendation.en: For pretraining work, just note that prose in agent skills is now an attack surface; skim the SDL representation only.

paper.title: Skills as Verifiable Artifacts: A Trust Schema and a Biconditional Correctness Criterion for Human-in-the-Loop Agent Runtimes
paper.abstract: Agent skills -- structured packages of instructions, scripts, and references that augment a large language model (LLM) without modifying the model itself -- have moved from convenience to first-class deployment artifact. The runtime that loads them inherits the same problem package managers and operating systems have always faced: a piece of content claims a behavior; the runtime must decide whether to believe it. We argue this paper's central thesis up front: a skill is \emph{untrusted code} un

summary.core_problem: 讨论 Agent runtime 加载 skill 包时如何判断其可信性，避免把指令、脚本和引用材料当作默认可信内容执行。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏系统安全框架和形式化准则。它把 agent skill 明确视为未验证代码，并试图用 trust schema 和双条件正确性标准降低 human-in-the-loop 的无效触发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出一个 skill verification 的信任模式：默认 skill 不可信，验证过程与运行时加载过程分离；只有未验证或无法证明满足行为声明的 skill 才触发 HITL。论文还提出 biconditional correctness criterion，用来约束 skill 声称的行为与实际可执行行为之间的对应关系。
summary.experiments: 摘要未显示实证实验、benchmark、模型规模或线上系统评估，更像概念框架和安全规范论文。需要检查正文是否有可运行原型、攻击案例和误报/漏报分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how an agent runtime should decide whether to trust skill packages containing instructions, scripts, and references before loading them into an LLM-augmented system.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly a systems-security framework. It treats agent skills as untrusted code by default and proposes a trust schema plus a biconditional correctness criterion to reduce unsustainable human-in-the-loop gating.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed schema separates skill verification from runtime loading: skills are untrusted until verified, and HITL gates are reserved for unverified or unverifiable irreversible calls. The biconditional correctness criterion aims to align a skill's claimed behavior with what it can actually do at runtime.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report empirical evaluation, benchmarks, model sizes, or deployment metrics. It appears to be a conceptual and formal runtime-safety proposal unless the full text includes a prototype, attack cases, or false-positive/false-negative analysis.

recommendation.zh: 作为 agent runtime 安全备忘看摘要即可；没有模型训练信号，除非你在做 tool/skill sandbox，否则不读正文。
recommendation.en: Treat it as an agent-runtime safety memo; there is no training signal here, so skip the body unless you build tool or skill sandboxes.

paper.title: D3-Gym: Constructing Real-World Verifiable Environments for Data-Driven Discovery
paper.abstract: Despite recent progress in language models and agents for scientific data-driven discovery, further advancing their capabilities is held back by the absence of verifiable environments representing real-world scientific tasks.To fill this gap, we introduce D3-Gym, the first automatically constructed dataset with verifiable environments for scientific Data-Driven Discovery. D3-Gym comprises (1) 565 tasks sourced from 239 real scientific repositories across four disciplines where (2) each task is e

summary.core_problem: 为科学数据驱动发现任务构造可执行、可验证的真实环境，缓解现有科学 agent 评测缺少可靠验证信号的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 benchmark 与环境构建。它把真实科学代码仓库转成带依赖、数据、参考解和自动评测脚本的任务环境，对后训练中的 verifiable reward、agent RL 和长程工具使用评测有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: D3-Gym 从 239 个真实科学仓库自动构造 565 个任务，覆盖四个学科。每个任务包含自然语言指令、可执行环境、预装依赖、输入数据、artifact 预览、参考代码解法，以及自动合成的 evaluation script。核心技术点在于把开放式科学分析任务转成可执行验证环境，而不是只做文本问答。
summary.experiments: 论文报告了验证信号质量评估：自动评测脚本与人工 gold standard 达到 87.5% 一致，并在领域特定评估逻辑上有较好对齐。摘要提到进一步训练实验，但给出的片段未包含模型、训练设置或提升幅度细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 The Ohio State University 和 Cisco Research；Huan Sun 团队长期关注知识增强、复杂推理与 agent 评测。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds executable and verifiable real-world environments for scientific data-driven discovery, addressing the lack of reliable verification signals for scientific LLM agents.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a benchmark and environment-construction contribution. By turning real scientific repositories into tasks with dependencies, data, reference solutions, and evaluation scripts, it is relevant to verifiable rewards, agent RL, and long-horizon tool-use evaluation, though not directly to base-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: D3-Gym automatically constructs 565 tasks from 239 real scientific repositories across four disciplines.
