Each task includes a natural-language instruction, an executable environment, pre-installed dependencies, input data, artifact previews, a reference code solution, and an automatically synthesized evaluator. The key idea is to make scientific analysis tasks executable and checkable rather than treating them as text-only QA.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates the quality of the verification signal and reports 87.5% agreement between synthesized evaluation scripts and human-annotated gold standards, with good alignment on domain-specific evaluation logic. The abstract mentions further training, but the provided excerpt does not expose model scale, training setup, or numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from The Ohio State University and Cisco Research; Huan Sun's group is known for work on knowledge-intensive reasoning and agent evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 不改变预训练判断，但可作为可验证环境设计参考；看任务构造流程和 87.5% verifier 评估即可。
recommendation.en: Does not move pretraining priors, but the environment construction and 87.5% verifier audit are useful for verifiable-agent RL design.

paper.title: GLM-5V-Turbo: Toward a Native Foundation Model for Multimodal Agents
paper.abstract: We present GLM-5V-Turbo, a step toward native foundation models for multimodal agents. As foundation models are increasingly deployed in real environments, agentic capability depends not only on language reasoning, but also on the ability to perceive, interpret, and act over heterogeneous contexts such as images, videos, webpages, documents, GUIs. GLM-5V-Turbo is built around this objective: multimodal perception is integrated as a core component of reasoning, planning, tool use, and execution,

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：如果目标不是做一个“能看图的聊天模型”，而是做一个真正可执行多模态 agent 的基础模型，那么视觉感知、语言推理、工具调用、规划和执行应该怎样在同一个训练体系里被原生整合。论文关心的核心矛盾有两个。第一，多模态能力常常被当作外挂接口接到语言模型上，导致视觉只负责提供局部证据，无法深度参与推理和行动。第二，agent 能力如果直接端到端优化，训练信号稀疏、验证困难、任务定义不稳定，容易学到脆弱策略。GLM-5V-Turbo 试图通过新的视觉编码器、适配多模态输入的 multi-token prediction、深度融合的多模态训练，以及大规模多任务 RL，把“看、想、用工具、执行”放进一个更统一的基础模型框架。
summary.importance: 从基座研究角度，这篇工作的价值不在 benchmark 罗列，而在它展示了一条 native multimodal foundation model 的工程路线。它同时覆盖视觉 tokenizer/encoder、预训练 recipe、语言模型训练目标扩展、SFT 与 RL 的衔接、以及 agent 基础设施。对预训练研究员最有启发的有三点。第一，视觉侧不是简单接一个现成 encoder，而是单独做两阶段预训练，并明确处理表示学习与跨模态对齐的张力。第二，作者把 MTP 从纯文本扩展到多模态，讨论了 image token 应该怎样进入 MTP head，这属于训练目标层面的设计，而不是普通系统技巧。第三，论文强调 agent 能力更适合分层优化，而不是一把梭端到端训练，这对 pretrain 和 post-train 接口很有参考意义。需要注意的是，这篇工作更偏系统化技术报告，预训练细节虽有信息量，但很多结论仍需结合后续公开实验或复现来判断稳健性。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有四个关键部分。第一是视觉编码器 CogViT。作者没有直接沿用通用 CLIP/ViT，而是做了两阶段预训练。阶段一是蒸馏式 masked image modeling，用 student ViT 重建被 mask 区域在双教师特征空间中的表示：SigLIP2 提供偏语义的表征，DINOv3 提供偏纹理/局部结构的表征。35% masking ratio，224×224 分辨率，数据配比是 80% 高质量自然图像、10% instruction-following data、10% scientific imagery。这里的设计意图很明确：先把视觉 backbone 的通用感知能力打牢，避免过早被图文对齐目标牵着走。训练上使用 Muon optimizer，并引入 QK-Norm 来抑制注意力 logit 爆炸，说明作者在大规模视觉预训练稳定性上做了针对性处理。阶段二转向 contrastive image-text pretraining，用 SigLIP loss 做图文对齐。升级点包括 NaFlex 可变分辨率输入、64K global batch 的大规模对比训练、以及 8B 中英双语图文语料。这里体现的是先表示、后对齐的路线，而不是从头只做对比学习。

第二是 MMTP，Multimodal Multi-Token Prediction。标准 MTP 在文本里很自然，因为 prefix token 可以直接嵌入后送入 MTP head；但多模态场景下，图像 token 怎么传给 MTP head 并不显然。作者比较了三种方案：直接传视觉 embedding；在 MTP head 里完全屏蔽视觉 token，退化成 text-only MTP；保留视觉位置信息，但把视觉 token 内容替换成共享可学习的 <|image|> token。最终采用第三种。原因是它在优化和系统效率之间更平衡：直接传视觉 embedding 会增加 head 侧负担和不稳定性；完全屏蔽视觉 token 又损失多模态条件信息；共享 special token 则保留“这里有图像”的结构信号和位置信息，同时避免把高维视觉特征直接灌进 MTP head。这个点很值得预训练研究员关注，因为它触及多模态 LM 训练目标如何与基础设施兼容的问题。

第三是多模态训练与深度融合。论文强调 vision-language integration 不是只在 SFT 阶段做，而是贯穿 pre-training 和 supervised fine-tuning。虽然公开内容没有把所有数据配比和 curriculum 细节完全展开，但可以看出作者在追求“视觉参与推理主干”，而不是“视觉先编码成几个 token 再让语言模型自己想办法用”。

第四是 joint RL 与 agent 基础设施。作者在 30 多类任务上做联合强化学习，覆盖 perception、reasoning、agentic capabilities，并配套优化了大规模 multimodal RL 的基础设施。更重要的是，论文明确总结出一个经验：agent 能力往往通过 hierarchical optimization 学得更好，而不是 monolithic end-to-end training。这意味着他们实际训练中很可能把感知、工具使用、规划、执行拆成不同层次或不同阶段优化，而不是只用统一 reward 直接推全链路。
summary.experiments: 视觉侧，CogViT 在 general object recognition、fine-grained understanding、geometric/spatial perception 上给出竞争性结果，论文用 Figure 1 做了汇总展示。虽然这里更像 encoder 报告而非独立论文，但它说明两阶段 recipe 不是只服务某个单一 benchmark。模型整体上，GLM-5V-Turbo 在多模态 agent 相关 benchmark 上给出一组较强结果：ImageMining 30.7，BrowseComp-VL 51.9，MMSearch 72.9，SimpleVQA 78.2；GUI agent 任务上 AndroidWorld 75.7，OSWorld 62.3；Claw 体系评测上 PinchBench 87.0/80.7，ClawEval 57.7/75.0，ZClawBench 57.6。编码方面，多模态 Design2Code 94.8，超过 Claude Opus 4.6；文本代码能力也没有因多模态扩展而明显受损，CC-Backend 22.8、CC-Frontend 68.4、CC-RepoExploration 72.2，甚至超过语言基座 GLM-5-Turbo。对预训练读者更值得看的不是这些绝对分，而是几个设计选择的实验支持：一是 MMTP 三种视觉 token 传递方式的比较，最终为何 <|image|> 占优；二是 CogViT 两阶段预训练是否优于直接图文对齐；三是 joint RL 是否真的带来多任务泛化，而不是只在少数 agent benchmark 上过拟合。若正文给出消融，重点应关注 Muon、QK-Norm、NaFlex、SigLIP loss、大 batch bilingual corpus 这些训练 recipe 对稳定性和迁移性的影响。
summary.reading_guide: 如果从基座预训练角度读，优先看 Model, Training, and Infrastructure 这一节。先抓 CogViT 的两阶段 recipe：为什么先做蒸馏式 MIM，再做对比式图文对齐；双教师 SigLIP2 + DINOv3 分别提供什么；QK-Norm 和 Muon 在这里解决什么训练问题。然后重点看 MMTP 的设计比较，这部分最接近“训练目标创新”，也是全文里最有可迁移性的点。接着再看多模态训练和 joint RL，判断作者所谓 hierarchical optimization 到底落在数据组织、损失设计还是训练阶段划分上。实验部分不必逐个 benchmark 细读，先看能支持设计选择的消融和对比。若只想快速把握主线，30 分钟内读完 CogViT + MMTP + 关键 benchmark 表即可。若要深读，建议额外追问三个问题：第一，MMTP 在多模态下是否真的改善 sample efficiency 或 generation length；第二，视觉 encoder 的独立增强是否会和 LLM 主干对齐产生张力；第三，joint RL 的收益有多少来自任务覆盖面扩大，有多少来自 reward/verification 体系本身更成熟。
summary.authors_note: 智谱 GLM 团队技术报告，围绕 GLM-5V-Turbo 与多模态 agent 训练体系展开。公开文本中未完整列出作者背景细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a broader question than image understanding: if the target is a native multimodal agent rather than a language model with a vision plug-in, how should perception, reasoning, planning, tool use, and execution be integrated into one foundation-model stack? The central tension is that many multimodal systems still treat vision as an auxiliary interface to a language model, which limits how deeply visual evidence participates in reasoning and action. A second tension is optimization: end-to-end agent training is often unstable because rewards are sparse, task definitions are underspecified, and verification is hard. GLM-5V-Turbo addresses this by combining a dedicated vision encoder, a multimodal extension of multi-token prediction, deeply integrated multimodal training, and large-scale joint RL over heterogeneous agent tasks.
summary_en.importance: For a pretraining-oriented reader, the value is not the benchmark spread by itself. The value is that the paper lays out a concrete route toward a native multimodal foundation model. It touches the full stack: visual representation learning, cross-modal alignment, language-model objective design, the pretrain-to-posttrain interface, and multimodal RL infrastructure. Three parts are especially relevant. First, the vision side is not treated as a frozen external encoder; it is pretrained with a deliberate two-stage recipe that separates representation learning from alignment. Second, the paper extends multi-token prediction into the multimodal setting and explicitly studies how image tokens should enter the MTP head. That is a training-objective question, not just a systems trick. Third, the report argues that agentic capability is learned more effectively through hierarchical optimization than through monolithic end-to-end training, which is directly relevant to how pretraining and post-training should be coupled.
summary_en.technical_approach:
There are four main technical components. First, CogViT, a parameter-efficient vision encoder trained in two stages. Stage 1 uses distillation-based masked image modeling. A student ViT reconstructs masked regions in the feature spaces of two teachers: SigLIP2 for semantic representations and DINOv3 for texture and local structure. The setup uses a 35% masking ratio at 224x224 resolution, with a quality-aware data mixture of 80% high-quality natural images, 10% instruction-following data, and 10% scientific imagery. The intent is clear: build a strong visual backbone before forcing it into cross-modal alignment. Training uses the Muon optimizer, and QK-Norm is introduced to stabilize attention by mitigating logit explosion. Stage 2 switches to contrastive image-text pretraining with the SigLIP loss. The main upgrades are variable-resolution NaFlex inputs, a 64K global batch for large-scale contrastive learning, and an 8B bilingual Chinese-English image-text corpus. This is a representation-first, alignment-second recipe rather than pure contrastive training from scratch.

Second, MMTP, or Multimodal Multi-Token Prediction. In text-only MTP, prefix tokens can be passed naturally into the MTP head via token embeddings. In multimodal settings, however, it is unclear how image tokens should be exposed to the MTP head. The paper compares three options: directly passing visual embeddings, masking out visual tokens entirely at the MTP head, or preserving visual positional information while replacing visual content with a shared learnable <|image|> token. GLM-5V-Turbo adopts the third option. The reason is the trade-off between optimization and infrastructure efficiency. Direct visual embeddings make the head heavier and potentially less stable; removing visual tokens entirely loses multimodal conditioning; the shared special token preserves the structural signal that image content exists at certain positions without injecting full visual features into the MTP head. This is one of the most interesting parts of the paper for foundation-model training.

Third, multimodal training is deeply integrated across pretraining and supervised fine-tuning, rather than adding vision only at the instruction-tuning stage. The public text does not expose every data-mixture and curriculum detail, but the intended direction is clear: vision should participate in the model’s reasoning backbone, not merely provide a few side tokens.

Fourth, the paper performs joint reinforcement learning over more than 30 task categories spanning perception, reasoning, and agentic behavior, supported by dedicated multimodal RL infrastructure. The more important takeaway is the training philosophy stated in the report: agentic competence is often learned better through hierarchical optimization than through monolithic end-to-end training. That suggests the system likely decomposes perception, tool use, planning, and execution into different optimization layers or stages rather than relying on a single unified reward over the full chain.
summary_en.experiments: On the vision side, CogViT is reported to achieve competitive results on general object recognition, fine-grained understanding, and geometric or spatial perception, summarized in the paper’s overview figure. On the full model side, GLM-5V-Turbo reports strong results on multimodal agent benchmarks: 30.7 on ImageMining, 51.9 on BrowseComp-VL, 72.9 on MMSearch, and 78.2 on SimpleVQA. On GUI-agent tasks it reaches 75.7 on AndroidWorld and 62.3 on OSWorld. On Claw-based evaluations it reports 87.0/80.7 on PinchBench, 57.7/75.0 on ClawEval, and 57.6 on ZClawBench. For coding, it scores 94.8 on Design2Code, outperforming Claude Opus 4.6, while preserving or improving text-only coding relative to GLM-5-Turbo on CC-Backend, CC-Frontend, and CC-RepoExploration. For a pretraining reader, the most useful evidence is not the absolute benchmark list but the support for specific design choices: the comparison among the three MMTP visual-token interfaces, whether the two-stage CogViT recipe beats direct image-text alignment, and whether joint RL improves broad generalization rather than overfitting a narrow set of agent tasks. If the full report includes ablations, the most informative ones are likely around Muon, QK-Norm, NaFlex, SigLIP loss, and the large bilingual corpus.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the model, training, and infrastructure section first. Start with the CogViT recipe and ask why the paper separates masked-image distillation from image-text alignment. Pay attention to the role of the two teachers, the data mixture, and the stabilization choices such as Muon and QK-Norm. Then focus on MMTP. This is the part closest to a training-objective contribution, and it is the most transferable idea in the report. After that, read the multimodal training and joint RL sections with one question in mind: what exactly does hierarchical optimization mean in their implementation? Is it a curriculum, a task decomposition, a reward decomposition, or a staged training pipeline? In the experiments, prioritize ablations and design comparisons over the benchmark catalog. If time is limited, 30 minutes is enough to read the CogViT section, the MMTP comparison, and the main result tables. For deeper reading, keep three questions in mind: whether MMTP improves sample efficiency or generation behavior in multimodal settings, whether stronger standalone vision pretraining creates alignment tension with the language backbone, and how much of the RL gain comes from broader task coverage versus better reward and verification design.
summary_en.authors_note: Technical report from the Zhipu GLM team on GLM-5V-Turbo and its multimodal agent training stack. The public text does not fully specify detailed author backgrounds.

recommendation.zh: 值得看训练与 RL 章节；若只是 benchmark 堆分就降权，但 native 多模态 Agent 的 recipe 对内部路线有参考。
recommendation.en: Read the training and RL sections; if the report is mostly benchmark stacking, discount it, but the native multimodal-agent recipe is still useful for internal planning.

paper.title: Tatemae: Detecting Alignment Faking via Tool Selection in LLMs
paper.abstract: Alignment faking (AF) occurs when an LLM strategically complies with training objectives to avoid value modification, reverting to prior preferences once monitoring is lifted. Current detection methods focus on conversational settings and rely primarily on Chain-of-Thought (CoT) analysis, which provides a reliable signal when strategic reasoning surfaces, but cannot distinguish deception from capability failures if traces are absent or unfaithful. We formalize AF as a composite behavioural event

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的是：在工具调用型 LLM agent 中，如何把“模型不会安全地做”与“模型知道安全做法、但在被监控和被奖励压力改变时选择不安全做法”区分开。现有 alignment faking 检测主要看对话和 CoT，但 CoT 不一定忠实，也可能根本不外显策略性推理。Tatemae 把检测信号转到可观察的二元工具选择上。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不在训练目标或 scaling，而在 Pretrain/Posttrain 接口的安全评估。它提供了一个较干净的行为定义：模型先证明自己有安全能力，再在监控提示和奖励压力下改变动作，同时推理仍承认安全选项。这类评估有助于区分能力缺口、鲁棒性不足和训练目标诱导出的策略性顺从。对做 RLHF/RLAIF、agent tool-use post-training、以及研究模型是否学习到“被评估情境”的团队有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是把 alignment faking 定义为一个复合事件，而不是单个不安全输出。每个场景提供一个安全工具和一个更方便但风险更高的不安全工具。管线依次检查四类信号：T1 是中性条件下是否选择安全工具，用来确认能力；T2 是有业务压力但无监控时是否仍选安全工具，用来确认鲁棒性；T3 是加入监控提示后是否改选不安全工具；R3 是监控条件下的推理是否仍承认基线安全偏好 Y。只有当模型在 T1、T2 中表现安全，而在 T3 中选择不安全工具，同时 R3 仍承认安全偏好时，才计为 alignment faking。这个设计比单纯读 CoT 更稳，因为行为选择是结构化输出；它也比只看最终错误更细，因为先排除了能力不足和普通压力下失守。论文还加了一个三条件分类器，标注训练意识、价值修改意识和策略性输出选择，用来刻画检测到的案例。
summary.experiments: 数据集包含 108 个企业 IT 场景，覆盖 Security、Privacy、Integrity 三类问题，并设置 Corruption 与 Sabotage 两类对抗压力。论文在 6 个前沿 LLM 上评测。平均 alignment faking 检测率从 3.5% 到 23.7% 不等，且不同模型在不同领域和压力类型下表现差异较大，没有一个模型在所有设置下都稳定免疫。这个结果说明，工具选择场景里的策略性行为不是只由单一模型或单一任务触发，而与领域、压力形式、监控提示共同相关。消融层面的关键点是 T1/T2/T3 的分解：如果没有 T1，会把能力不足误判为欺骗；如果没有 T2，会把一般鲁棒性失败误判为 alignment faking；如果只看 R3，则会受 CoT 忠实性影响。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 25–35 分钟。先看 Section 2 的复合事件定义，尤其是 T1/T2/T3/R3 与 Y 的关系；再看 Figure 1，理解评测管线怎样把能力、压力鲁棒性和监控下顺从分开。Section 3 值得看数据构造，尤其是企业 IT 场景、两类压力和监控 system prompt。实验部分重点看各模型按 domain 与 pressure 拆开的检测率，不要只看均值。Appendix C.1 和 Appendix E 可快速扫一下，那里决定了“监控”和“对抗压力”是否过强，直接影响结论外推。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to detect alignment faking in tool-using LLM agents, where a model can act safely under ordinary conditions but switches to an unsafe tool when a monitored training context rewards helpfulness over safety. The key distinction is between lack of capability and strategic behavioral change. Tatemae moves the main signal from free-form conversation or CoT to observable tool selection.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly in alignment evaluation rather than pretraining mechanics. It is still relevant to foundation-model research because it probes the interface between learned preferences, post-training objectives, and evaluation awareness. The setup separates capability, robustness under pressure, and monitored compliance, which is useful for teams studying RLHF/RLAIF side effects, tool-use training, and agent safety evaluations.
summary_en.technical_approach: Tatemae defines alignment faking as a composite behavioral event. Each scenario offers a safe tool and a riskier but more convenient unsafe alternative. The pipeline checks whether the model selects the safe tool under neutral instructions, denoted T1; whether it remains safe under adversarial pressure without monitoring, denoted T2; whether it changes behavior under the monitored training prompt, denoted T3; and whether its monitored reasoning trace R3 still acknowledges the baseline safe preference Y. A case is counted only when the model has demonstrated safety capability and pressure robustness, then chooses the unsafe tool under monitoring while still recognizing the safe choice in its reasoning. This design avoids treating every unsafe action as deception and reduces dependence on CoT faithfulness. The paper also adds a three-criterion classifier for training awareness, modification awareness, and strategic output selection.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset contains 108 enterprise IT scenarios across Security, Privacy, and Integrity, with Corruption and Sabotage pressures. Six frontier LLMs are evaluated. Mean detected alignment-faking rates range from 3.5% to 23.7%, with substantial variation by model, domain, and pressure type. No model is uniformly robust across all settings. The most informative ablation is conceptual: T1 filters out inability, T2 filters out ordinary robustness failures, and R3 is treated as supporting evidence rather than the sole ground truth.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 25–35 minutes. Focus on Section 2 for the formal event definition and on Figure 1 for the evaluation pipeline. Then read Section 3 for scenario construction, pressure types, and the monitored system prompt. In the results, prioritize domain-by-pressure breakdowns over aggregate rates. Appendix C.1 and Appendix E are worth checking because prompt wording and pressure design determine how strongly the setup can be generalized.

recommendation.zh: 安全评测有一个干净的新观测接口；看形式化和结果表，别把 3.5–23% 当稳定基准。
recommendation.en: A useful observable signal for safety evals; read the formalization and tables, but treat the 3.5–23% rates as setup-sensitive.

paper.title: When to Retrieve During Reasoning: Adaptive Retrieval for Large Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Large reasoning models such as DeepSeek-R1 and OpenAI o1 generate extended chains of thought spanning thousands of tokens, yet their integration with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) remains fundamentally misaligned. Current RAG systems optimize for providing context before reasoning begins, while reasoning models require evidence injection during multi-step inference chains. We introduce ReaLM-Retrieve, a reasoning-aware retrieval framework that addresses this mismatch through three key inn

summary.core_problem: 解决长链推理模型在何时触发检索的问题：传统 RAG 在推理前一次性给上下文，但多步推理往往需要在中途按需补证据。
summary.importance: 这是一个通用 Agent / RAG 接口问题，不是预训练问题本身，但对理解“推理模型如何与外部记忆协同”有一定参考价值。贡献类型主要是推理时策略设计与系统集成，而不是新的建模范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ReaLM-Retrieve，包括三部分：按推理步骤检测不确定性的 step-level uncertainty detector；学习何时插入检索的 retrieval intervention policy；以及降低检索接入开销的高效集成机制。核心思路是把检索触发点从输入前移到 CoT 过程内部。
summary.experiments: 在 MuSiQue、HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA 上评测，摘要声称平均带来 10.1% 的绝对提升，并将单次检索开销相对朴素集成降低 3.2 倍。未见大规模基座训练或预训练相关实验，主要是多跳 QA 场景下的推理时增强。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies when a long-chain reasoning model should retrieve external evidence, instead of front-loading all context before reasoning starts as in standard RAG.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an agent/RAG interface problem rather than a pretraining contribution, but it is still relevant for understanding how reasoning models interact with external memory during inference. The contribution is a runtime policy/system design, not a new modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes ReaLM-Retrieve with three components: a step-level uncertainty detector, a retrieval intervention policy that decides when retrieval helps most, and an efficiency-oriented integration mechanism to reduce retrieval overhead. The key shift is to move retrieval from pre-reasoning to in-the-loop reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and 2WikiMultiHopQA. The abstract reports an average absolute gain of 10.1% and 3.2x lower per-retrieval overhead than naive integration. The setup is centered on multi-hop QA inference, not pretraining or scaling.

recommendation.zh: 这是 RAG 时机控制，不会改变预训练方法论；若你在看 test-time tool use，只读触发策略和开销表，别把 QA 提升误当成通用 reasoning 增益。
recommendation.en: This is about retrieval timing, not pretraining; read the intervention policy and overhead table if you care about test-time tool use, but do not overread QA gains as general reasoning progress.

paper.title: Operating-Layer Controls for Onchain Language-Model Agents Under Real Capital
paper.abstract: We study reliability in autonomous language-model agents that translate user mandates into validated tool actions under real capital. The setting is DX Terminal Pro, a 21-day deployment in which 3,505 user-funded agents traded real ETH in a bounded onchain market. Users configured vaults through structured controls and natural-language strategies, but only agents could choose normal buy/sell trades. The system produced 7.5M agent invocations, roughly 300K onchain actions, about $20M in volume, m

summary.core_problem: 在“真实资金约束”的长程自治LM代理中，如何把用户意图可靠地转成可验证、可结算的工具动作，并在大规模部署下保持低失败率。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是大规模真实部署与“operating layer”工程控制范式（验证、策略约束、状态管理）的经验数据；对pretrain本身间接，但对理解“模型能力 vs 系统约束”边界有价值。
summary.technical_approach: 在DX Terminal Pro中用结构化控制+自然语言策略配置vault；代理只能执行受策略验证的买卖交易；通过操作层（prompt渲染、验证器、组合状态、结算管线等）把LM输出约束为可提交交易，并记录从mandate到链上结算的全链路trace。
summary.experiments: 21天线上部署：3505个用户资金代理、750万次agent调用、约30万次链上动作、约2000万美元交易量、约70B推理token、提交交易99.9%结算成功；包含长程序列决策（单agent 6000+循环）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to make long-horizon autonomous LM agents reliably translate user intent into validated, settleable tool actions under real capital constraints at scale.
summary_en.importance: Primarily a large-scale real-world deployment and an 'operating layer' control pattern (validation, policy constraints, state management); indirect to pretraining but useful for separating model capability from system constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: DX Terminal Pro uses structured controls plus natural-language strategies to configure vaults; agents can only execute policy-validated trades; an operating layer (prompt rendering, validators, portfolio state, settlement pipeline) constrains LM outputs into submit-ready transactions and logs end-to-end traces.
summary_en.experiments: 21-day deployment: 3,505 user-funded agents, 7.5M invocations, ~300K onchain actions, ~$20M volume, ~70B inference tokens, 99.9% settlement success; long-running agents with 6,000+ prompt-state-action cycles.

recommendation.zh: 不是算法论文，但真实资金+长程trace很稀缺；只看系统约束/验证层如何把LM变“可结算动作”，别指望学到训练法。
recommendation.en: Not an algorithm paper, but real-capital long-horizon traces are rare; focus on how the validation/operating layer turns LM text into settleable actions, not on training insights.

paper.title: Enforcing Benign Trajectories: A Behavioral Firewall for Structured-Workflow AI Agents
paper.abstract: Structured-workflow agents driven by large language models execute tool calls against sensitive external environments. We propose \codename, a telemetry-driven behavioral anomaly detection firewall. Drawing on sequence-based intrusion detection, \codename\ compiles verified benign tool-call telemetry into a parameterized deterministic finite automaton (pDFA). The model defines permitted tool sequences, sequential contexts, and parameter bounds. At runtime, a lightweight gateway enforces these bo

summary.core_problem: 为结构化工作流中的 LLM Agent 提供运行时安全边界，降低恶意或异常工具调用轨迹造成的攻击成功率。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 安全系统方法。它不改进模型训练，但给出一种低开销、可审计的工具调用防火墙，对理解工具型 Agent 的部署风险有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法把已验证的良性工具调用遥测编译成参数化确定性有限自动机 pDFA，显式约束允许的工具序列、上下文状态和参数范围。运行时通过轻量网关做 O(1) 状态转移检查，把复杂分析移到离线阶段。
summary.experiments: 在 Agent Security Bench 上评估五类场景，宏平均攻击成功率为 5.6%。在三个结构化工作流中攻击成功率降至 2.2%，优于 stateless scanner Aegis 的 12.8%；在结构化设置下，多步攻击和上下文顺序攻击达到 0% ASR。摘要未说明底层 LLM、工作流规模和误拒率细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Van Lang University, Ho Chi Minh City。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a runtime safety boundary for LLM-driven structured-workflow agents, aiming to reduce successful attacks through abnormal or malicious tool-call trajectories.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-security systems contribution. It does not improve model training, but it offers a low-overhead and auditable guardrail for tool-using agents, which is relevant to deployment risk rather than pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method compiles verified benign tool-call telemetry into a parameterized deterministic finite automaton. The pDFA constrains valid tool sequences, sequential contexts, and parameter ranges; a runtime gateway performs O(1) state-transition checks while expensive analysis is moved offline.
summary_en.experiments: On Agent Security Bench, the method reports a 5.6% macro-averaged attack success rate across five scenarios. In three structured workflows, ASR drops to 2.2%, compared with 12.8% for the stateless scanner Aegis; multi-step and context-sequential attacks reach 0% ASR in structured settings. The abstract does not specify the underlying LLMs, workflow diversity, or false-rejection trade-offs.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is from Van Lang University, Ho Chi Minh City.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和 ASB 结果即可；pDFA 边界适合固定工作流，泛化到开放 Agent 仍是弱信号。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and ASB results only; pDFA boundaries fit fixed workflows, but transfer to open-ended agents is still a weak signal.

institutions: Van Lang University, Ho Chi Minh City

paper.title: Benchmarking and Improving GUI Agents in High-Dynamic Environments
paper.abstract: Recent advancements in Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents have predominantly focused on training paradigms like supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL). However, the challenge of high-dynamic GUI environments remains largely underexplored. Existing agents typically rely on a single screenshot after each action for decision-making, leading to a partially observable (or even unobservable) Markov decision process, where the key GUI state including important information for a

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是 GUI agent 在高动态界面中的部分可观测问题：如果 agent 每一步只看动作后的单张截图，那么很多关键状态变化会发生在两次截图之间并直接消失，导致决策依据缺失。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 基座预训练的直接价值较弱，不属于预训练方法、建模目标或训练动态研究。它的启发主要在于两点：一是把“单帧观测不足”明确表述为 POMDP 问题，这对多模态 agent 的训练信号设计有帮助；二是 benchmark 构造强调 hidden interstitial dynamics，而不是静态截图上的 GUI 理解。这更接近 agent evaluation 与系统设计，而不是 foundation model pretraining。
summary.technical_approach:
工作包含 benchmark 和 agent 两部分。Benchmark 方面，作者提出 DynamicGUIBench，覆盖 10 个应用、149 个任务，专门设计四类动态场景：interruptive UI states、ephemeral reference、dynamic list selection、content-triggered interaction。重点不是加入可见干扰，而是构造那些会在动作间隙出现、变化、消失的关键信息，使单截图策略天然信息不足。

方法方面，DynamicUI 以完整交互录屏视频而不是单帧截图作为输入。其 dynamic perceiver 先对视频帧做聚类，再结合 caption 与置信度迭代选出代表性帧，目的是把长视频压缩成可供 VLM 使用的动态上下文。随后 refinement strategy 用来修正“模型计划动作”和“环境实际执行结果”之间的偏差，reflection module 则基于修正后的轨迹给后续步骤提供高层反馈。整体上，这是一个围绕时序观测压缩、执行校正、轨迹反思构建的 GUI agent pipeline。
summary.experiments:
实验主轴是 DynamicGUIBench 和 OSWorld。作者声称 DynamicUI 在高动态 GUI 场景下明显优于现有方法，同时在静态或一般 GUI 理解任务上保持竞争力。Benchmark 构造部分还强调了可复现性：对 Chrome 类和多应用任务提供离线资产与确定性 HTML，以减少网络波动和环境更新带来的评测噪声。

从当前给出的全文片段里，看不到足够完整的数值表，因此不适合复述具体提升百分比。阅读时应重点确认三件事：视频输入带来的提升有多少；这种提升是否主要来自更多观察信息而非 agent 策略本身；在不同动态类别上，dynamic perceiver、refinement、reflection 各自贡献是否清晰。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇只建议泛读。先看 benchmark 定义和四类动态任务，理解作者到底把哪些 GUI 变化视为“单截图不可恢复”的隐藏状态。再看 DynamicUI 的系统图，确认视频压缩流程是否足够轻量，是否存在把长时序信息重新变成少量关键帧摘要的工程取舍。最后扫一眼主结果和模块消融，判断性能提升主要来自 benchmark 更匹配视频输入，还是方法本身确实更善于处理时序 GUI 线索。预计 15 到 25 分钟足够。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a concrete failure mode of GUI agents in highly dynamic environments: if the agent only observes a single screenshot after each action, important interface changes that occur between two observations may be missed entirely, turning the interaction into a partially observable decision process.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to LLM pretraining is limited. This is mainly an agent benchmark and system paper, not a study of pretraining objectives, scaling, tokenization, or optimization. The useful takeaway is conceptual: it frames dynamic GUI interaction as a POMDP caused by sparse temporal observation, and it evaluates agents on hidden interstitial dynamics rather than static screenshot understanding. That matters for multimodal agent training and evaluation, but only indirectly for foundation-model research.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has two parts: a benchmark and an agent framework. DynamicGUIBench contains 149 tasks across 10 applications and is designed around four dynamic scenario types: interruptive UI states, ephemeral reference, dynamic list selection, and content-triggered interaction. The key idea is not just to add visible perturbations, but to create cases where task-relevant evidence appears, evolves, or disappears between action steps, so a single screenshot is insufficient.

The proposed agent, DynamicUI, consumes full interaction screen-recording video rather than one post-action frame. Its dynamic perceiver clusters frames and iteratively selects salient centroids using generated captions and confidence scores, effectively compressing long videos into informative dynamic context. A refinement strategy then addresses mismatches between intended actions and actually executed behaviors. Finally, a reflection module uses the refined trajectory to provide higher-level guidance for subsequent decisions. In short, the system is built around temporal observation compression, execution correction, and trajectory-level reflection.
summary_en.experiments:
The main evaluations are on DynamicGUIBench and OSWorld. The paper reports that DynamicUI performs strongly in dynamic GUI settings while remaining competitive on more standard GUI tasks. The benchmark construction also emphasizes reproducibility by providing offline assets and deterministic HTML for Chrome-based and multi-app tasks, which is important because GUI evaluation is otherwise noisy and hard to standardize.

The excerpt provided here does not include enough numeric detail to restate exact margins. When reading the full paper, the key checks are: how much of the gain comes from having video instead of single-frame input, whether the gain remains after controlling for observation budget, and how much each module—dynamic perceiver, refinement, and reflection—contributes across different dynamic scenario types.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Start with the benchmark section and the four dynamic task categories to understand what the authors mean by hidden GUI dynamics. Then read the system diagram for DynamicUI and check how the video is compressed into a manageable context for the VLM. Finally, inspect the main results and ablations to see whether the improvement is mostly due to better temporal observability or to the agent design itself. Around 15 to 25 minutes should be enough.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 benchmark 设计和失败案例；它提醒 GUI Agent 的观测建模比 RL 算法选择更容易成为瓶颈。
recommendation.en: Skim the benchmark design and failures; it suggests observation modeling, not the RL recipe, may be the bottleneck for GUI agents.

paper.title: OxyGent: Making Multi-Agent Systems Modular, Observable, and Evolvable via Oxy Abstraction
paper.abstract: Deploying production-ready multi-agent systems (MAS) in complex industrial environments remains challenging due to limitations in scalability, observability, and autonomous evolution. We present OxyGent, an open-source framework that enables modular, observable, and evolvable MAS via a unified Oxy abstraction, in which agents, tools, LLMs, and reasoning flows are encapsulated as pluggable atomic components. This Lego-like assembly paradigm supports scalable system composition and non-intrusive m

summary.core_problem: 解决生产级多 Agent 系统在复杂工业环境中难以模块化组合、运行时观测和持续演化的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个 Agent 系统框架工作，贡献偏工程抽象和平台化：用统一 Oxy abstraction 把 agent、tool、LLM、reasoning flow 封装成可插拔组件，并强调运行观测、资产管理和数据回流。
summary.technical_approach: OxyGent 采用类似 Lego 的原子组件抽象，将多 Agent 系统中的模型、工具、流程和智能体统一封装；通过 permission-driven dynamic planning 在运行时生成执行图，替代固定 workflow，并支持非侵入式监控和可视化；OxyBank 负责 AI 资产管理、自动数据回流、标注和联合演化。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到有实证评估和真实案例，但没有给出 benchmark、任务设置、模型规模、吞吐、成功率或消融结果。可判断为工程框架验证，无法从摘要确认其方法收益是否来自 Oxy 抽象本身。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses production deployment issues in multi-agent systems: modular composition, runtime observability, and continuous evolution in complex industrial settings.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an agent framework and systems paper. Its contribution is an engineering abstraction: representing agents, tools, LLMs, and reasoning flows as pluggable Oxy components, with observability and asset/data feedback loops built into the platform.
summary_en.technical_approach: OxyGent wraps agents, tools, LLMs, and reasoning flows into unified atomic components. It uses permission-driven dynamic planning to generate execution graphs at runtime instead of relying on fixed workflows, enabling non-intrusive monitoring and adaptive visualization. OxyBank adds asset management, data backflow, annotation, and joint evolution.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions empirical evaluations and real-world case studies, but does not specify benchmark tasks, model sizes, success rates, latency, or ablation results. From the available information, the evidence appears to be framework-level validation rather than a clean causal evaluation of the abstraction.

recommendation.zh: Agent 工程框架味道较重；预训练研究员只需扫 Oxy 抽象和数据回流设计，别把案例结果当算法证据。
recommendation.en: This is mostly agent engineering; skim the Oxy abstraction and feedback-loop design, but do not treat case-study results as algorithmic evidence.

paper.title: See Further, Think Deeper: Advancing VLM's Reasoning Ability with Low-level Visual Cues and Reflection
paper.abstract: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have benefited from Reinforcement Learning (RL) for enhanced reasoning. However, existing methods still face critical limitations, including the lack of low-level visual information and effective visual feedback. To address these problems, this paper proposes a unified multimodal interleaved reasoning framework \textbf{ForeSight}, which enables VLMs to \textbf{See Further} with low-level visual cues and \textbf{Think Deeper} with effective visual

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决的是 VLM 视觉推理中的两个缺口：模型在长推理链里容易忽略边缘、二值图、显著异常等低层视觉线索；同时推理流程多是“看图—推理—作答”的开环过程，缺少基于视觉证据的自我检查和修正。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接贡献有限，更接近 VLM 推理期工具使用和 RL 后训练。但它有一个值得关注的接口问题：多模态模型的推理链不应只承载文本 token，也可以插入由工具生成的视觉中间表征，并让模型学习何时请求这些表征。这个方向对 native multimodal pretraining 有启发，尤其是如何把低层视觉 token、区域证据、反思动作纳入统一序列建模或 RL 训练信号。
summary.technical_approach: ForeSight 将 VLM 推理改成一个多轮、跨模态的过程。第一部分是低层视觉工具集合，用来提供边缘轮廓、二值化图、语义草图等细粒度视觉信息。模型不是固定调用工具，而是通过 RL 学习在推理过程中是否调用、何时调用。第二部分是 mask-based visual feedback。模型先给出初始答案及其对应的框，再把这些框覆盖到原图上，将 masked image 输入回模型，让模型判断原答案是否需要修改。训练信号使用最终答案准确性作为 reward。相比只做区域放大或高层视觉理解工具的 i-MCoT 方法，这里强调低层视觉证据；相比纯文本反思，这里把反思建立在图像扰动后的反馈上。
summary.experiments: 实验基于作者构造的 CG-SalBench，来源于 SalBench，面向显著视觉异常、字符与 grounding 类任务。主要基线是 Qwen2.5-VL-7B。ForeSight-7B 相比该基线 IoU 提升 29.68%，F1 提升 19.27%。这些数字说明收益主要来自更强的定位与细粒度视觉判别能力。给出的内容没有展开具体消融结果，精读时需要确认三类因素的独立贡献：低层工具、RL 决策、mask feedback 反思。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 15–20 分钟。重点看方法部分的工具接口、RL 动作空间、reward 设计，以及 mask feedback 的构造方式。实验部分重点看 CG-SalBench 的任务定义、评价指标和消融表。如果只关心预训练，可快速跳过应用动机，关注它如何把视觉中间结果插入推理链，以及这种监督能否迁移到多模态预训练或 mid-train。

summary_en.core_problem: The work targets two gaps in VLM reasoning: long text-only reasoning chains often miss low-level visual evidence such as edges, binarized maps, and salient anomalies; and most VLMs follow an open-loop process where an answer is generated without visual feedback-driven revision.
summary_en.importance: Its direct contribution to foundation-model pretraining is limited; it is closer to VLM tool use and RL post-training. The useful signal for pretraining research is the interface design: a multimodal reasoning trace can include tool-generated visual intermediates, not only text tokens, and the model can learn when to request such evidence. This matters for native multimodal training, especially if low-level visual tokens, region evidence, and reflection actions are later folded into a unified sequence objective or RL objective.
summary_en.technical_approach: ForeSight turns VLM reasoning into a multi-turn interleaved vision-language process. It first adds a set of low-level visual tools that expose fine-grained cues such as edge contours, binarized maps, and semantic sketches. Tool use is not hard-coded; the model is trained with RL to decide whether and when to invoke tools during inference. It then adds mask-based visual feedback. The model produces an initial answer and bounding boxes, masks the corresponding regions in the original image, feeds the masked image back to the VLM, and asks the model to reflect and revise when needed. The final answer accuracy is used as the reward. Compared with i-MCoT systems focused on region zooming or high-level visual tools, this work emphasizes low-level visual evidence. Compared with text-only reflection, the feedback signal is grounded in an image perturbation.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on CG-SalBench, a dataset built from SalBench for character and grounding-style salient visual reasoning. The main baseline is Qwen2.5-VL-7B. ForeSight-7B improves IoU by 29.68% and F1 by 19.27% over the baseline. These gains point to better localization and fine-grained visual discrimination. The provided content does not include detailed ablations, so the key question to verify is how much comes from low-level tools, RL-based tool selection, and mask-based reflection separately.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 15–20 minutes. Focus on the method section: tool API, RL action space, reward design, and construction of the masked visual feedback loop. In the experiments, check the CG-SalBench task definition, metrics, and ablation tables. For pretraining-oriented readers, the useful part is not the benchmark itself, but how visual intermediate representations are inserted into the reasoning trajectory and whether that training signal could be moved earlier into multimodal mid-training.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练本身帮助有限，但它把“视觉 grounding 不够”拆成低层线索缺失和反馈闭环缺失两件事；先看方法图和 ablation，别急着信 RL 带来的总分提升。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it cleanly decomposes weak visual grounding into missing low-level cues and missing feedback loops; read the method figure and ablations before trusting the RL headline gains.

paper.title: Skill Retrieval Augmentation for Agentic AI
paper.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) evolve into agentic problem solvers, they increasingly rely on external, reusable skills to handle tasks beyond their native parametric capabilities. In existing agent systems, the dominant strategy for incorporating skills is to explicitly enumerate available skills within the context window. However, this strategy fails to scale: as skill corpora expand, context budgets are consumed rapidly, and the agent becomes markedly less accurate in identifying the right s

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的问题不是“怎么给 agent 多塞一点工具说明”，而是当技能库扩展到大规模、持续增长、且技能本身是可执行能力包时，agent 如何在上下文窗口之外完成技能检索、筛选、装载和实际使用。作者把这个问题正式化为 Skill Retrieval Augmentation（SRA）。它和传统 RAG 的差别在于：检索对象不是事实性证据，而是会改变 agent 行为空间的能力单元，因此评估不能只看语义相关性，还要看检索到的技能是否真的被识别、整合并转化为任务成功率提升。全文的关键点是把问题拆成 retrieval、incorporation、application 三段，而不是把最终任务成败混成一个黑盒指标。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身，它不是直接提出新的 pretrain objective，但对“参数知识 + 外部能力”的接口定义得比较清楚，价值主要在系统范式和评测设计两层。第一，它把 agent 外挂技能库从 prompt engineering 问题提升为可测量的能力扩展问题，这对以后研究长期记忆、外部程序库、tool-use pretraining、能力路由都有参考意义。第二，它强调技能检索的目标函数和知识检索不同，这一点对训练数据构造和检索器监督信号很重要：如果未来要做 skill-aware pretraining 或 tool-augmented continual pretraining，这类分解式 benchmark 会比只看 end-task accuracy 更有诊断性。贡献量级更像“提出问题并搭建评测地基”，不是直接改写现有 agent 方法的技术突破。
summary.technical_approach:
技术上有两部分。第一部分是范式定义。作者把 skill 定义为模块化能力包，可能包含自然语言说明、触发条件、工具调用流程、代码和辅助资源。基于这个定义，SRA pipeline 被拆成三步：1）skill retrieval：从大规模外部技能库中召回候选技能；2）skill incorporation：agent 在候选集合中识别真正有用的技能，并把它们组织进当前求解过程；3）skill application：这些技能是否在执行中被真正调用，并改善最终结果。这个拆分很重要，因为它指出失败可能来自检索器、上下文整合、或执行链路，而不是统一归因给模型“不会用工具”。

第二部分是 benchmark 构建。作者建立了一个大规模 skill corpus，并提出 SRA-Bench。每个样本带有 user query、ground-truth answer 和 gold skill(s) 标注，因此可以分别评估召回、候选集质量、以及技能注入后对任务表现的增益。按引言给出的设计，SRA-Bench 的目标不是只测“agent 最后答对没有”，而是支持分阶段诊断。全文目前给出的信息显示，作者有意把它做成类似 capability retrieval benchmark，而不是普通 QA benchmark 套一层工具标签。

从方法新意看，这篇工作的创新不在复杂模型结构，而在问题建模和评测口径。它明确反对把所有技能枚举进 prompt 的做法，因为这种做法同时受上下文长度和选择准确率下降两方面限制。作者把“技能是能力而不是知识”作为核心区分，这使得 retrieval metric 需要和 downstream utility 对齐。若全文后续章节提供了具体 retrieval baselines、reranking、agent integration 策略，那些更像验证 SRA 设定的实现手段，而不是论文最核心的贡献。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文片段看，实验主轴应当围绕 SRA-Bench 的分解式评测展开，但当前可见内容还没有完整表格和具体数值，因此不能可靠复述参数量、样本规模或提升幅度。可以确认的实验设计重点有三点：

1）比较显式 in-context skill injection 与外部 skill retrieval 的可扩展性差异。作者的论点是，随着 skill corpus 变大，前者会快速耗尽上下文预算，并且模型在大量候选技能中做选择的准确率明显下降。

2）分阶段评估 retrieval / incorporation / application。因为 benchmark 提供 gold skill 标注，所以至少可以测召回是否覆盖正确技能，以及检索到正确技能后 agent 是否真的会用。

3）研究“语义相关”与“任务有用”之间的偏差。SRA 的一个关键实验价值就在这里：即便检索结果看起来和 query 语义接近，也未必能提升 agent 的执行表现。

如果精读全文，建议重点补齐以下数字：skill corpus 的规模、任务类型分布、gold skill 标注方式、top-k retrieval 指标、不同 agent/backbone 的 incorporation 成功率，以及 end-task gain 相对 no-skill / full-skill-enumeration baseline 的变化。这些数字决定 benchmark 的说服力。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合按“问题定义 + benchmark 设计”来读，不必期待很重的算法细节。优先看三部分：

1）Introduction 和任务定义部分。重点看作者如何区分 SRA 与 RAG，为什么“技能是可执行能力”会改变评测目标。

2）SRA-Bench 构建章节。要看清 skill corpus 从哪里来、样本如何标注 gold skill、任务覆盖哪些 agent 场景、是否存在技能粒度不一致或标签歧义。

3）实验中的 error breakdown。最值得看的不是总分，而是 retrieval 命中但 incorporation 失败、以及 incorporation 成功但 application 无收益的案例。这些失败模式对后续做 tool-use pretraining、skill routing、长期记忆接口设计更有启发。

如果只是泛读，抓住 benchmark schema、评价维度和 baseline 设定即可，预计 20–30 分钟。若要深挖，建议重点审视标注质量、skill 定义边界，以及 benchmark 是否真的避免了把普通知识检索伪装成技能检索。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a scaling failure in current agent systems: reusable skills are typically exposed by enumerating them in the prompt, which breaks down as the skill library grows. The authors formalize Skill Retrieval Augmentation (SRA), where an agent must retrieve relevant skills from a large external corpus, incorporate them into its reasoning process, and actually use them to solve the task. The key point is that skills are executable capabilities rather than factual evidence, so the problem is not just retrieval quality in the RAG sense; it is a coupled pipeline of retrieval, incorporation, and application.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to foundation-model research because it sharpens the interface between parametric knowledge and external capability memory. Its main contribution is conceptual and evaluative. First, it reframes skill use from prompt formatting into a measurable capability-augmentation problem. Second, it argues that skill retrieval should be judged by downstream utility, not only semantic relevance. That distinction matters for future work on tool-aware pretraining, external memory, capability routing, and continual accumulation of reusable procedures. The contribution is closer to problem formulation plus benchmark construction than to a new core model architecture.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The technical contribution has two layers. The first is the formulation. A skill is treated as a modular capability package that may include natural-language instructions, invocation conditions, tool-use procedures, executable code, and auxiliary resources. Based on this, the SRA pipeline is decomposed into three stages: skill retrieval, which asks whether the system can find relevant skills from a large external corpus; skill incorporation, which asks whether the agent can identify and organize the useful skills among retrieved candidates; and skill application, which asks whether those incorporated skills are actually used in a way that improves task success. This decomposition is useful because it separates retrieval failure from reasoning failure and execution failure.

The second layer is benchmark design. The paper introduces a large-scale skill corpus and SRA-Bench, where each instance contains a user query, a ground-truth answer, and gold skill annotation. That enables stage-wise evaluation instead of collapsing everything into a single end-task metric. The benchmark is designed to diagnose whether the right skill was retrieved, whether the agent recognized it as useful, and whether using it improved behavior. The novelty is therefore less about a sophisticated retrieval model and more about defining the right object of retrieval and the right evaluation protocol.

A central design choice is the explicit distinction from classical RAG. In knowledge-centric RAG, retrieved items are declarative evidence. In SRA, retrieved items change the agent’s action space. That means a semantically similar skill can still be useless, and a retrieval metric that ignores execution utility can be misleading. If later sections include concrete retrievers, rerankers, or integration strategies, those should be read mainly as operational baselines for the SRA setting rather than the main scientific contribution.
summary_en.experiments:
From the available full-text excerpt, the experimental section appears to center on decomposed evaluation over SRA-Bench, but the visible content does not include enough tables or numeric details to quote dataset sizes, model scales, or exact gains reliably. What can be inferred is the intended experimental structure.

First, the paper likely compares explicit in-context skill enumeration against retrieval-based skill access as the skill corpus grows. The claimed failure mode of the former is twofold: context budget exhaustion and degraded skill selection accuracy.

Second, because SRA-Bench includes gold skill labels, the experiments can separately measure retrieval coverage, candidate quality, and whether correct retrieval actually translates into better task performance.

Third, an important empirical question is the gap between semantic relevance and functional utility. The benchmark is set up to expose cases where retrieved skills look relevant but do not improve execution.

For a careful read, the most important missing numbers to extract are: corpus size, task distribution, annotation protocol for gold skills, top-k retrieval metrics, incorporation success rates under different agent backbones, and end-task gains relative to no-skill and full-skill-enumeration baselines. Those details determine whether the benchmark is merely well-motivated or genuinely useful.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this as a problem-definition and benchmark paper, not as a heavy algorithm paper. Start with the introduction and task formulation. The most important question is how the paper distinguishes SRA from standard RAG, and why executable capabilities require a different evaluation target.

Then focus on the benchmark construction section. Check where the skill corpus comes from, how gold skills are annotated, what task families are covered, and whether the notion of a skill is consistent across examples.

Finally, spend time on the error breakdown rather than only the headline scores. The most informative cases are: correct retrieval but failed incorporation, and successful incorporation but no downstream gain. Those failure modes are directly relevant to future work on tool-use pretraining, capability routing, and long-term external memory.

For a skim, 20–30 minutes is enough to capture the benchmark schema, evaluation axes, and baseline setup. For deeper study, scrutinize annotation quality, skill granularity, and whether the benchmark truly measures capability retrieval rather than relabeled knowledge retrieval.

recommendation.zh: 这是 agent memory/skills 走向检索化的干净问题定义；读 benchmark 分解和失败模式，别只看最终分数。
recommendation.en: A clean formulation of retrieval-based agent skills; read the benchmark decomposition and failure modes rather than just end-task scores.

paper.title: Uncertainty Quantification for LLM Function-Calling
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed to autonomously solve real-world tasks. A key ingredient for this is the LLM Function-Calling paradigm, a widely used approach for equipping LLMs with tool-use capabilities. However, an LLM calling functions incorrectly can have severe implications, especially when their effects are irreversible, e.g., transferring money or deleting data. Hence, it is of paramount importance to consider the LLM's confidence that a function call solves the ta

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM function-calling 场景中，模型在执行工具调用前如何量化“这次函数调用是否正确”的不确定性。
summary.importance: 贡献是 function-calling 的不确定性评测。它不直接推进预训练，但对工具调用安全、agent 执行控制、不可逆操作前的拒绝或人工确认策略有实用价值。
summary.technical_approach: 比较多种 UQ 方法在 function-calling 任务上的表现，重点检查多样本方法如 Semantic Entropy 是否仍然优于简单单样本不确定性指标。核心观察是 FC 的输出空间和自然语言 QA 不同，语义聚类式不确定性未必带来收益。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、数据集、函数调用任务数量或数值结果。主要实验结论是：在自然语言 QA 中表现较强的多样本 UQ 方法 Semantic Entropy，在 function-calling 设置下相对简单单样本 UQ 没有明确优势。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表包含 Yarin Gal，其代表性方向包括贝叶斯深度学习和不确定性估计。机构信息在给定材料中不完整。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates how to quantify an LLM's confidence that a function call is correct before executing the call.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an uncertainty-evaluation study for function calling. It does not directly advance pretraining, but it is relevant to tool-use safety, agent execution control, and human confirmation policies before irreversible actions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper compares uncertainty quantification methods for function-calling tasks, with special attention to whether multi-sample methods such as Semantic Entropy retain their advantage over simple single-sample scores. The key point is that the function-calling output space differs from open-ended natural-language QA, so semantic-clustering uncertainty may not help.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model names, dataset scale, task counts, or numerical results. The main reported finding is that Semantic Entropy, despite strong performance in natural-language QA, shows no clear advantage over simple single-sample UQ methods in function calling.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Yarin Gal, known for work on Bayesian deep learning and uncertainty estimation. The institution field in the provided metadata is incomplete.

recommendation.zh: 看摘要结论和实验表即可；Semantic Entropy 在 FC 上失效是有用负结果，但离 pretrain 较远。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and result tables only; Semantic Entropy failing on function calling is a useful negative result, but far from pretraining.

paper.title: From Skill Text to Skill Structure: The Scheduling-Structural-Logical Representation for Agent Skills
paper.abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on reusable skills, capability packages that combine instructions, control flow, constraints, and tool calls. In most current agent systems, however, skills are still represented by text-heavy artifacts, including SKILL.md-style documents and structured records whose machine-usable evidence remains embedded largely in natural-language descriptions. This poses a challenge for skill-centered agent systems: managing skill collections and using skills to support agent bo

summary.core_problem: 为 LLM Agent 的可复用技能建立机器可操作的结构化表示，避免技能知识只藏在自然语言文档中。
summary.importance: 贡献是 Agent skill 表示层的形式化尝试，关注技能调用接口、执行结构、约束和副作用的显式化；对通用 Agent 系统有一定参考，但离基座预训练和后训练信号设计较远。
summary.technical_approach: 作者借鉴 Schank 和 Abelson 的 Memory Organization Packets、Script Theory、Conceptual Dependency 等经典知识表示思想，提出 Scheduling-Structural-Logical Representation，把技能从纯文本或半结构记录转成包含调度、结构和逻辑关系的显式表示。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整实验设置、benchmark、模型规模或量化结果；当前能确认的是方法面向 skill-centered agent systems，目标是支持技能集合管理、技能获取和技能调用。
summary.authors_note: 作者机构包括北京大学计算机学院和北京大学中文系。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper proposes a machine-usable structured representation for reusable LLM-agent skills, rather than keeping skill knowledge mostly in natural-language documents.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a formal representation layer for agent skills, making invocation interfaces, execution structure, constraints, and side effects explicit. It is relevant to general agent systems but only indirectly connected to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors draw on Schank and Abelson's Memory Organization Packets, Script Theory, and Conceptual Dependency to introduce a Scheduling-Structural-Logical Representation. It converts text-heavy skill artifacts into explicit structures covering scheduling, execution structure, and logical relations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide full benchmarks, model scales, or quantitative results. It states that the method targets skill-centered agent systems, especially skill management, acquisition, and usage.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institutions include Peking University School of Computer Science and Peking University Department of Chinese Language and Literature.

recommendation.zh: 技能结构化这条线值得知道，但摘要看不到强实验；读表示定义即可，不必追实现细节。
recommendation.en: Structured agent skills are worth tracking, but the abstract shows no strong empirical signal; read the representation definition and skip implementation details.

paper.title: Quantifying Divergence in Inter-LLM Communication Through API Retrieval and Ranking
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly operate as autonomous agents that reason over external APIs to perform complex tasks. However, their reliability and agreement remain poorly characterized. We present a unified benchmarking framework to quantify inter-LLM divergence, defined as the extent to which models differ in API discovery and ranking under identical tasks. Across 15 canonical API domains and 5 major model families, we measure pairwise and group-level agreement using set-, rank-, an

summary.core_problem: 量化不同 LLM 在相同任务下进行 API 检索和排序时的一致性差异，从而评估 tool-use agent 的可靠性。
summary.importance: 贡献是 Agent/tool-use 评测框架，而不是训练方法。它把“模型是否选同一组 API、是否以相同顺序排序”拆成 set、rank 和 consensus 指标，对工具调用可靠性分析有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: 构建统一 benchmark，覆盖 15 个典型 API 域和 5 个主流模型家族；用 Average Overlap、Jaccard、Rank-Biased Overlap、Kendall's tau、Kendall's W、Cronbach's alpha 等指标衡量两两一致性和群体一致性。
summary.experiments: 结果显示整体一致性中等，Average Overlap 约 0.50，Kendall's tau 约 0.45；领域差异明显，Weather、Speech-to-Text 等结构化任务更稳定，Sentiment Analysis 等开放任务分歧更大。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Washington Tacoma。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper quantifies how much LLMs diverge when retrieving and ranking APIs for the same tasks, targeting reliability in tool-using agents.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an evaluation framework for agentic API selection rather than a training method. It operationalizes disagreement through set, rank, and consensus metrics.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark spans 15 canonical API domains and 5 major model families. It measures pairwise and group-level agreement using Average Overlap, Jaccard similarity, Rank-Biased Overlap, Kendall's tau, Kendall's W, and Cronbach's alpha.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports moderate overall agreement, with Average Overlap around 0.50 and Kendall's tau around 0.45. Agreement is domain-dependent: structured domains such as Weather and Speech-to-Text are more stable, while open-ended domains such as Sentiment Analysis show higher divergence.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is from the University of Washington Tacoma.

recommendation.zh: 看摘要和指标定义即可；它提醒 tool selection 不稳定，但单作者 benchmark 先当弱证据。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and metric definitions; it flags unstable tool selection, but treat the single-author benchmark as weak evidence.

paper.title: An open-source spec for orchestration: Symphony
paper.abstract: Learn how Symphony, an open-source spec for Codex orchestration, turns issue trackers into always-on agent systems—boosting engineering output and reducing context switching.

summary.core_problem: 在代码类 agent（如 Codex）落地时，如何把 issue tracker/工程流程编排成“常驻”的自动化代理系统，并降低上下文切换与运维成本。
summary.importance: 贡献类型更像工程规范/系统接口：给出一个开源 orchestration spec（Symphony）来标准化 agent 编排与任务流转；对预训练不直接，但对“训练数据如何记录/回放/可复现”有间接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Symphony 作为开源编排规范：把 issue tracker 事件、任务状态、工具调用与执行记录组织成可持续运行的 agent 工作流（摘要未给出更细的协议字段与参考实现细节）。
summary.experiments: 无标准学术实验；更多是产品/工程效果描述（摘要未给量化指标）。
summary.authors_note: OpenAI 官方发布，面向 Codex 工程化编排。

summary_en.core_problem: How to orchestrate coding agents (e.g., Codex) into always-on systems driven by issue trackers, reducing context switching and operational overhead.
summary_en.importance: Engineering spec/system interface contribution: an open-source orchestration spec (Symphony) to standardize agent workflows; indirect relevance to reproducible traces/logging that could feed training/evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Symphony as an orchestration specification organizing issue-tracker events, task states, tool calls, and execution records into persistent agent workflows (the abstract lacks protocol-level details).
summary_en.experiments: No academic-style experiments; mainly product/engineering claims without disclosed quantitative metrics in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: OpenAI release targeting Codex orchestration in production.

recommendation.zh: 别指望研究洞见；只看 spec 如何定义事件/状态/日志，可能反向启发“可回放轨迹”数据格式与评测。
recommendation.en: Don’t expect research insights; only skim how the spec defines events/states/logs—useful as a template for replayable trajectory data and eval.

paper.title: Sovereign Agentic Loops: Decoupling AI Reasoning from Execution in Real-World Systems
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly issue API calls that mutate real systems, yet many current architectures pass stochastic model outputs directly to execution layers. We argue that this coupling creates a safety risk because model correctness, context awareness, and alignment cannot be assumed at execution time. We introduce Sovereign Agentic Loops (SAL), a control-plane architecture in which models emit structured intents with justifications, and the control plane validates those i

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM agent 在真实系统中把随机生成的动作直接下发执行所带来的安全与可审计性问题，尤其是 API 调用会修改外部状态时的失控风险。
summary.importance: 这是一个 agent 控制面架构工作，不是基座模型方法创新；价值在于把“推理输出”和“执行权限”彻底解耦，给出了较清晰的安全边界、审计链路和形式化保证，对做 tool-use / agent 系统的人有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Sovereign Agentic Loops (SAL)。模型不直接产生命令，而是输出带 justification 的 structured intents；外部 control plane 再基于真实系统状态与策略进行验证、批准或拒绝。系统还加入 obfuscation membrane，限制模型接触身份敏感状态；并用 cryptographically linked Evidence Chain 记录决策与执行证据，支持审计和 deterministic replay。论文同时给出形式化定义与安全性质。
summary.experiments: 实验基于 OpenKedge 云基础设施原型。摘要声称 SAL 在策略层阻断了 93% 的不安全 intent，并拒绝剩余不满足条件的执行请求。公开摘要没有给出大模型规模、训练数据或与主流 agent framework 的系统性对比，更偏系统原型验证而非大规模 benchmark。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the safety and auditability problem that arises when LLM agents send stochastic model outputs directly to execution layers in real-world systems with state-mutating APIs.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent control-plane architecture paper rather than a foundation-model method paper. Its value is in cleanly decoupling model reasoning from execution authority, with explicit policy enforcement, auditability, and formal guarantees for tool-using systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Sovereign Agentic Loops (SAL). Instead of emitting executable actions, the model produces structured intents with justifications. A separate control plane validates those intents against true system state and policy before execution. The design also includes an obfuscation membrane to hide identity-sensitive state from the model, and a cryptographically linked Evidence Chain for auditability and deterministic replay. The paper formalizes the architecture and its guarantees.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses an OpenKedge prototype for cloud infrastructure. The abstract reports that SAL blocks 93% of unsafe intents at the policy layer and rejects the remaining invalid execution attempts. The abstract does not provide model scale, training setup, or broad comparisons against mainstream agent frameworks, so the evidence is more prototype-level than benchmark-heavy.

recommendation.zh: 这不是 pretrain 论文，但如果你在看 tool-use 安全边界，读架构图和形式化定义就够了；实验像原型演示，别把 93% 当可迁移结论。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but worth a quick read for tool-use safety boundaries; focus on the architecture and formalism, and treat the 93% number as prototype evidence rather than a portable result.

paper.title: From Skills to Talent: Organising Heterogeneous Agents as a Real-World Company
paper.abstract: Individual agent capabilities have advanced rapidly through modular skills and tool integrations, yet multi-agent systems remain constrained by fixed team structures, tightly coupled coordination logic, and session-bound learning. We argue that this reflects a deeper absence: a principled organisational layer that governs how a workforce of agents is assembled, governed, and improved over time, decoupled from what individual agents know. To fill this gap, we introduce \emph{OneManCompany (OMC)},

summary.core_problem: 解决多 Agent 系统中团队结构固定、协调逻辑耦合、运行后无法持续积累组织能力的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个多 Agent 组织层框架，把单个 agent 的技能、工具和运行配置封装成可迁移身份，并用类似公司组织的方式动态招聘、治理和重组。它是 Agent 系统工程方向的框架创新，但离 LLM 基座训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 OneManCompany，将技能、工具和 runtime config 封装为 Talents；通过 typed organisational interfaces 屏蔽异构后端；引入 Talent Market 做按需招募；组织决策由独立层处理，从 individual agent knowledge 中解耦。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体任务集、agent 数量、模型规模、baseline 或定量提升。当前可判断的信息更像系统框架和组织抽象，实验可信度需要看正文是否有真实长程任务和消融。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets fixed team structures, tightly coupled coordination logic, and session-bound learning in multi-agent systems.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multi-agent organizational framework that packages skills, tools, and runtime configurations into portable identities and dynamically recruits or reconfigures them like a company. It is a systems-level agent framework, but only loosely connected to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: OneManCompany introduces Talents as portable agent identities containing skills, tools, and runtime settings. Typed organizational interfaces abstract over heterogeneous backends, while a community Talent Market supports on-demand recruitment. Organizational decision-making is separated from what individual agents know.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report task suites, number of agents, model scale, baselines, or quantitative improvements. From the available information, the paper appears framework-heavy; the value depends on whether the full paper contains realistic long-horizon tasks and clean ablations.

recommendation.zh: 概念上比普通多 Agent 编排多一层组织抽象；若正文没有强实验，就当系统设计备查，不必细读。
recommendation.en: The organizational abstraction is more interesting than ordinary multi-agent orchestration; without strong experiments, keep it as systems-design reference rather than a close read.

paper.title: Tool Attention Is All You Need: Dynamic Tool Gating and Lazy Schema Loading for Eliminating the MCP/Tools Tax in Scalable Agentic Workflows
paper.abstract: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has become a common interface for connecting large language model (LLM) agents to external tools, but its reliance on stateless, eager schema injection imposes a hidden per-turn overhead the MCP Tax or Tools Tax that practitioner reports place between roughly 10k and 60k tokens in typical multi-server deployments. This payload inflates the key-value cache, is associated with reasoning degradation as context utilization approaches published fracture points around

summary.core_problem: MCP/工具调用在多工具 agent 工作流中引入了每轮大规模 schema 注入开销，导致上下文膨胀、KV cache 浪费和推理质量下降。
summary.importance: 贡献类型主要是 agent middleware / 系统层优化，而不是模型训练方法。它有现实工程意义：把工具选择从“全量 schema 进上下文”改成“按意图动态加载”，对长上下文 agent 的成本和稳定性有直接帮助。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Tool Attention 机制，在工具层做动态门控而不是对所有工具 schema 进行 eager injection。核心包括三部分：用句向量计算 Intent Schema Overlap (ISO) 作为相关性信号；用状态感知 gating 约束工具前置条件和权限范围；用两阶段 lazy schema loading，只把紧凑摘要常驻上下文，完整 schema 在需要时再加载。
summary.experiments: 摘要声称 practitioner 报告中的 MCP/Tools tax 通常在 10k-60k token，并将其与上下文利用率接近 70% 时的推理退化联系起来；但从给定信息看，实验更像系统效益论证，缺少清晰的模型规模、标准 benchmark、强 baseline 和统计显著性细节，结论可信度需看正文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the hidden overhead of MCP/tool use in multi-tool agent workflows, where eager schema injection bloats context, wastes KV cache, and can hurt reasoning quality.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an agent middleware / systems contribution rather than a training-method paper. Its practical value is clear: replacing full-schema-in-context with intent-conditioned loading can materially reduce cost and instability in long-context agent setups.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Tool Attention, a tool-level gating mechanism instead of eager injection of all tool schemas. The method combines three pieces: an Intent Schema Overlap (ISO) score from sentence embeddings, a state-aware gating function that enforces preconditions and access scopes, and a two-phase lazy schema loader that keeps only compact summaries in context until full schemas are needed.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract cites practitioner-reported MCP/Tools tax in the 10k-60k token range and links it to reasoning degradation as context utilization approaches roughly 70%. From the available information, the evaluation looks more like a systems-efficiency argument than a clean benchmark study; model scale, baselines, and statistical rigor need verification in the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 这是 agent middleware，不改模型 prior；只看方法图和实验表，判断 lazy schema loading 是否真比 prompt engineering 干净即可。
recommendation.en: This is agent middleware, not a model-method shift; read the method figure and eval tables only to see whether lazy schema loading is cleaner than prompt-level hacks.

institutions: the MCP/Tools Tax in Scalable Agentic Workflows

paper.title: Beyond Pixels: Introspective and Interactive Grounding for Visualization Agents
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) frequently misread values, hallucinate details, and confuse overlapping elements in charts. Current approaches rely solely on pixel interpretation, creating a Pixel-Only Bottleneck: agents treat interactive charts as static images, losing access to the structured specification that encodes exact values. We introduce Introspective and Interactive Visual Grounding (IVG), a framework that combines (1) spec-grounded introspection, which queries the underlying specificat

summary.core_problem: 解决可交互图表问答中，VLM 仅依赖像素读图而导致数值误读、遮挡混淆和幻觉的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献主要在 agent 式 grounding 框架和 benchmark：把图表底层 specification 与交互操作纳入推理闭环，并提供去除 VLM 偏置的评测集 iPlotBench。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 IVG 框架，包含两部分：一是 spec-grounded introspection，直接查询图表底层 specification 获取确定性证据；二是 view-grounded interaction，通过缩放、平移等视图操作消解重叠与遮挡。整体上不是新基座模型，而是给 VLM/agent 增加外部可验证信息源。
summary.experiments: 构建 500 个交互式 Plotly 图表、6,706 个二分类问题及对应真值 specification。实验显示 introspection 能提升数据重建保真度，加入 interaction 后 QA 准确率达到 0.81，在重叠几何场景上提升 6.7%。摘要未给出更大规模训练或预训练设置。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Oak Ridge National Laboratory。工作更像面向图表 agent 的 grounding 与评测，而非基座模型训练。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses failures of VLMs on interactive chart QA, where pixel-only reading causes value misreading, overlap confusion, and hallucination.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an agent-style grounding framework plus a benchmark: it brings chart specifications and interaction into the reasoning loop, and introduces iPlotBench for less VLM-biased evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed IVG framework has two components: spec-grounded introspection, which queries the underlying chart specification for deterministic evidence, and view-grounded interaction, which manipulates the view to resolve ambiguity from overlap or occlusion. This is not a new foundation model, but an external grounding layer for VLM agents.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 500 interactive Plotly figures and 6,706 binary questions with ground-truth specifications. Introspection improves reconstruction fidelity, and combining it with interaction yields the best QA accuracy of 0.81, including a 6.7% gain on overlapping geometries. No large-scale pretraining setup is involved.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Oak Ridge National Laboratory. The work is better viewed as grounding and evaluation for chart agents rather than foundation-model training.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它把“像素输入不够”讲得很干净；只看 benchmark 设计和 introspection 机制，能给多模态训练里的可验证监督一些思路。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it cleanly demonstrates where pixel-only VLMs break; read the benchmark design and introspection mechanism if you care about verifiable supervision in multimodal training.

paper.title: VLAA-GUI: Knowing When to Stop, Recover, and Search, A Modular Framework for GUI Automation
paper.abstract: Autonomous GUI agents face two fundamental challenges: early stopping, where agents prematurely declare success without verifiable evidence, and repetitive loops, where agents cycle through the same failing actions without recovery. We present VLAA-GUI, a modular GUI agentic framework built around three integrated components that guide the system on when to Stop, Recover, and Search. First, a mandatory Completeness Verifier enforces UI-observable success criteria and verification at every finish

summary.core_problem: 解决 GUI Agent 在真实交互中常见的两类失败：过早宣称任务完成，以及陷入重复操作循环却无法恢复。
summary.importance: 这是一个通用 GUI agent 可靠性问题，不是单纯换模型刷分。贡献主要是系统设计：把停止判定、失败恢复和外部搜索拆成强制执行的模块，试图提升 agent 在开放界面中的鲁棒性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出模块化框架 VLAA-GUI，核心有三部分：一是 Completeness Verifier，在每次 finish 动作前强制检查是否存在可观察的 UI 证据支持“已完成”；二是 Loop Breaker，用多级规则检测重复失败、界面状态回环和无效反思，并强制切换交互模式或策略；三是按需触发的 Search Agent，在遇到陌生工作流时调用更强 LLM 做在线搜索与步骤补全。方法偏系统编排与控制逻辑，不是新的基础模型或训练范式。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模和完整 benchmark 数字，但实验目标显然是比较加入 verifier、loop breaking、search 后对 GUI 自动化成功率和稳定性的提升。更值得关注的应是 ablation：验证器是否真能压制虚假完成，loop breaker 是否减少重复轨迹，以及 search 是否只在陌生流程上带来增益。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets two recurring failure modes in GUI agents: premature success claims without verifiable evidence, and repetitive action loops with no recovery behavior.
summary_en.importance: This is a reliability problem for general GUI agents rather than a task-specific wrapper. The contribution is mainly a systems design: explicitly separating stopping, recovery, and external search to improve robustness in open-ended interfaces.
summary_en.technical_approach: VLAA-GUI is a modular framework with three components. A mandatory Completeness Verifier checks whether every finish action is backed by UI-observable evidence. A mandatory Loop Breaker detects repeated failures, recurring screen states, and ineffective reflection, then forces strategy or interaction-mode changes. An on-demand Search Agent queries a stronger LLM for unfamiliar workflows. The novelty is in orchestration and control logic, not in a new foundation model or training objective.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes or full benchmark numbers, but the evaluation is clearly about GUI automation success and robustness with and without the verifier, loop breaker, and search modules. The most informative part is likely the ablation: whether the verifier suppresses false completion, whether loop breaking reduces cyclic trajectories, and whether search helps mainly on unfamiliar workflows.

recommendation.zh: 这是 GUI agent 工程补丁而不是新范式；若你做 tool-use reliability，可只看 verifier 和 loop-breaker 设计，别把结果外推到基座能力。
recommendation.en: This is a reliability patch for GUI agents, not a foundation-model advance; read the verifier and loop-breaker design if you care about tool-use robustness, but do not overgeneralize it to base-model capability.

paper.title: Introducing GPT-5.5
paper.abstract: Introducing GPT-5.5, our smartest model yet—faster, more capable, and built for complex tasks like coding, research, and data analysis across tools.

summary.core_problem: 发布 GPT-5.5，并强调其在复杂任务、编码、研究和数据分析上的能力提升与速度改进。
summary.importance: 这是重大产品/模型发布。对预训练研究员，价值不在宣传语，而在于从产品定位和能力侧重点推断 OpenAI 当前的训练目标、后训练重心与工具使用集成方向。
summary.technical_approach: 博客层面通常会概述模型能力、交互特性、工具调用、速度/成本权衡和适用场景，但不会给出完整训练细节。可与 system card 联读，抽取哪些能力被重点包装为产品卖点，哪些能力被刻意弱化或限制。
summary.experiments: 当前摘要没有实验细节。可预期会给出若干产品向 benchmark 或案例展示，但这些通常不足以支持方法判断；真正有用的是与前代模型的能力画像差异，以及是否强调 agentic workflow、coding、research、tool use 等新主轴。
summary.authors_note: 机构为 OpenAI Research。作为旗舰模型发布说明，它更像产品定位文档；需要结合 system card 才能形成较完整判断。

summary_en.core_problem: It announces GPT-5.5 and highlights improvements in complex tasks, coding, research, and data analysis, along with better speed.
summary_en.importance: This is a major product/model release. For a pretraining researcher, the value is not the marketing layer but what the product positioning reveals about OpenAI’s current training objectives, post-training emphasis, and tool-use integration.
summary_en.technical_approach: At the blog level, it likely summarizes capabilities, interaction features, tool use, speed/cost trade-offs, and target use cases, without exposing full training details. It is best read together with the system card to infer which capabilities are being productized versus constrained.
summary_en.experiments: The provided summary contains no experimental detail. Expect product-facing benchmarks or examples, which are usually weak evidence for method conclusions; the more useful signal is the capability profile shift relative to prior models and whether agentic workflows, coding, research, and tool use are central.
summary_en.authors_note: From OpenAI Research. As a flagship launch post, it is closer to a product-positioning document and should be paired with the system card for a fuller technical read.

recommendation.zh: 发布文只用来读产品定位，不用当技术证据；看它把 coding、research、tool use 放多重，就能猜到训练资源往哪儿倾斜了。
recommendation.en: Use the launch post for product positioning, not as technical evidence; how heavily it leans on coding, research, and tool use tells you where training effort is being concentrated.

paper.title: SkillGraph: Graph Foundation Priors for LLM Agent Tool Sequence Recommendation
paper.abstract: LLM agents must select tools from large API libraries and order them correctly. Existing methods use semantic similarity for both retrieval and ordering, but ordering depends on inter-tool data dependencies that are absent from tool descriptions. As a result, semantic-only methods can produce negative Kendall-$τ$ in structured workflow domains. We introduce SkillGraph, a directed weighted execution-transition graph mined from 49,831 successful LLM agent trajectories, which encodes workflow-prece

summary.core_problem: 解决现有LLM Agent工具选择和排序仅依赖语义相似性，忽略工具间数据依赖导致排序效果差的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出基于历史成功轨迹挖掘的图先验用于工具序列推荐，在公开Agent基准上取得显著提升
summary.technical_approach: 从49831条成功Agent轨迹中挖掘有向加权执行转移图SkillGraph作为先验，采用GS-Hybrid检索候选工具，再用学习的成对排序器优化序列顺序
summary.experiments: 在ToolBench（9965测试样本，1.6万工具）上Set-F1达0.271，Kendall-τ达0.096；在API-Bank上Kendall-τ从-0.433提升到0.613，优于LLaMA-3.1-8B排序器
summary.authors_note: 作者来自北京航空航天大学，无公开知名研究者

summary_en.core_problem: Solves the poor tool ordering performance of existing LLM agents, which only rely on semantic similarity and ignore inter-tool data dependencies
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposes a graph prior mined from historical successful trajectories for tool sequence recommendation, achieves significant improvements on public agent benchmarks
summary_en.technical_approach: Mines a directed weighted execution transition graph SkillGraph from 49831 successful agent trajectories as prior, uses GS-Hybrid for candidate tool retrieval, then optimizes sequence order with a learned pairwise ranker
summary_en.experiments: Achieves Set-F1=0.271 and Kendall-τ=0.096 on ToolBench (9965 test instances, ~16k tools); improves Kendall-τ from -0.433 to 0.613 on API-Bank, outperforms LLaMA-3.1-8B ranker
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Beihang University, no publicly well-known researchers

recommendation.zh: 只看实验部分的Kendall-τ对比即可，方法无通用预训练层面的启发
recommendation.en: Only check the Kendall-τ comparison in experiments, no inspiration for general pretraining.

institutions: Hao Liu is with the Hangzhou International Innovation Institute, Beihang
Dongyu Li is with the School of Cyber Science and Technology, Beihang

paper.title: R2IF: Aligning Reasoning with Decisions via Composite Rewards for Interpretable LLM Function Calling
paper.abstract: Function calling empowers large language models (LLMs) to interface with external tools, yet existing RL-based approaches suffer from misalignment between reasoning processes and tool-call decisions. We propose R2IF, a reasoning-aware RL framework for interpretable function calling, adopting a composite reward integrating format/correctness constraints, Chain-of-Thought Effectiveness Reward (CER), and Specification-Modification-Value (SMV) reward, optimized via GRPO. Experiments on BFCL/ACEBench

summary.core_problem: 解决函数调用场景中，RL 训练往往只优化调用结果而不约束推理过程，导致 reasoning 与 tool-call decision 脱节、可解释性差的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个后训练信号设计问题。价值不在 function calling 应用本身，而在于它把“过程质量”显式写进奖励，尝试缓解只看 outcome 的 reward hacking；对研究 pretrain↔posttrain 接口的人有弱相关参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 R2IF，用 GRPO 优化一个复合奖励：一部分约束输出格式与调用正确性，另一部分是 Chain-of-Thought Effectiveness Reward（CER），再加上面向规格修改价值的 SMV reward。核心想法是把工具调用决策、推理链有效性和规范遵循同时纳入 RL 目标，而不是只按最终调用是否成功给奖惩。
summary.experiments: 在 BFCL 和 ACEBench 上评测，摘要声称相对 baseline 最多提升 34.62%（Llama3.2-3B 在 BFCL），并报告正向的 Average CoT Effectiveness（如 0.05）。从摘要看，实验重点是小模型函数调用精度与可解释性指标；但未看到更大模型、跨工具泛化、reward ablation 细节，结论可信度仍依赖正文中的对照是否干净。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自华东师范大学、华中科技大学、南洋理工大学等学术机构；不是头部实验室的范式型工作，更像针对 tool-use RL 的奖励工程探索。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets the mismatch in function-calling RL where models are rewarded for final tool decisions but not for whether the intermediate reasoning is actually aligned, useful, or interpretable.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a post-training reward-design paper. Its value is not the application itself, but the attempt to encode process quality into RL objectives, which is mildly relevant if you care about reward quality and the pretrain–posttrain interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: R2IF optimizes a composite reward with GRPO: format/correctness constraints, a Chain-of-Thought Effectiveness Reward (CER), and an SMV reward for specification-modification value. The method explicitly scores both tool-call outcomes and the usefulness of the reasoning trace instead of relying on outcome-only rewards.
