summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on BFCL and ACEBench, with up to 34.62% improvement over baselines on BFCL for Llama3.2-3B, plus positive Average CoT Effectiveness (e.g., 0.05). From the abstract, the evidence is centered on small-model function-calling accuracy and interpretability metrics; robustness depends on whether the full paper provides clean ablations and cross-setting generalization.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from East China Normal University, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, and Nanyang Technological University. This looks like a targeted RL-for-tool-use study rather than a lab-defining paradigm paper.

recommendation.zh: 偏奖励工程，不会改变你对 tool-use RL 的基本看法；若你在做 outcome reward 的反作弊，只看复合奖励拆解和 CoT effectiveness 指标定义即可。
recommendation.en: Mostly reward engineering; it won't change your prior on tool-use RL, but the reward decomposition and CoT-effectiveness metric are worth a quick look if you're fighting outcome-only reward hacking.

institutions: Shanghai Key Laboratory of Trustworthy Computing
Huazhong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: SWE-chat: Coding Agent Interactions From Real Users in the Wild
paper.abstract: AI coding agents are being adopted at scale, yet we lack empirical evidence on how people actually use them and how much of their output is useful in practice. We present SWE-chat, the first large-scale dataset of real coding agent sessions collected from open-source developers in the wild. The dataset currently contains 6,000 sessions, comprising more than 63,000 user prompts and 355,000 agent tool calls. SWE-chat is a living dataset; our collection pipeline automatically and continually discov

summary.core_problem: 现有AI编码Agent研究多依赖人工构建的基准数据集，缺乏真实场景下人类与编码Agent交互的实证数据，无法获知实际使用模式、真实失败模式以及Agent输出的实际有效率。
summary.importance: 公开首个大规模真实场景编码Agent交互数据集，可用于优化编码Agent训练数据、交互设计、基准构建，为编码Agent后训练、人机协作范式设计提供实证依据。
summary.technical_approach: 构建SWE-chat数据集，从公开GitHub仓库的Entire.io CLI日志中自动收集真实开发者与编码Agent的完整交互轨迹，包含用户prompt、Agent工具调用、代码diff、行级代码作者归因等多维度数据。
summary.experiments: 数据集当前包含6000个会话、6.3万条用户prompt、35.5万次Agent工具调用，覆盖200多个仓库。实证分析得到多组结论：1）最常见用户意图为理解现有代码，Agent三分之一的工具调用为执行bash命令而非编辑文件；2）使用模式呈双峰分布，41%的会话中Agent生成几乎所有提交代码（vibe coding），其余会话中Agent生成代码占比极低；3）仅不到一半的Agent生成代码最终被用户提交；4）vibe coding模式下每提交一行代码消耗3倍token和成本，引入的安全漏洞为人类自写代码的9倍、人机协作代码的5倍；5）99.9分位的单次交互时长超过100分钟，Agent极少主动询问用户澄清，5%的轮次用户主动中断Agent，39%的轮次用户反驳Agent输出。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读第2章数据集构建逻辑、第3-4章实证分析结果，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing AI coding agent research mostly relies on manually curated benchmark datasets, lacking empirical data of human-coding agent interaction in real scenarios, which makes it impossible to obtain actual usage patterns, real failure modes, and actual effectiveness of agent outputs.
summary_en.importance: This work releases the first large-scale real-scene coding agent interaction dataset, which can be used to optimize coding agent training data, interaction design, benchmark construction, and provides empirical basis for coding agent post-training and human-agent collaboration paradigm design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The SWE-chat dataset is constructed by automatically collecting complete interaction traces between real developers and coding agents from Entire.io CLI logs of public GitHub repositories, including multi-dimensional data such as user prompts, agent tool calls, code diffs, and line-level code authorship attribution.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset currently contains 6000 sessions, 63,000 user prompts, 355,000 agent tool calls, covering more than 200 repositories. Empirical analysis draws multiple conclusions: 1) The most common user intent is to understand existing code, and one third of agent tool calls are executing bash commands instead of editing files; 2) Usage patterns show bimodal distribution: 41% of sessions have agents generating almost all committed code (vibe coding), while agents contribute very little code in the rest sessions; 3) Less than half of agent-generated code is finally committed by users; 4) In vibe coding mode, each committed line of code consumes 3x tokens and cost, and introduces 9x more security vulnerabilities than human-written code, 5x more than human-agent co-authored code; 5) The 99.9th percentile of single interaction duration exceeds 100 minutes, agents rarely actively ask users for clarification, users actively interrupt agents in 5% of turns, and users push back against agent outputs in 39% of turns.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the dataset construction logic in Chapter 2, empirical analysis results in Chapter 3 and Chapter 4, estimated reading time 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 不是方法论文，但数据分布很值钱：44% 代码保留率这类数字会直接影响你怎么定义 agent 训练目标与离线评测，先看 failure mode 统计。
recommendation.en: Not a methods paper, but the distributional evidence is valuable: numbers like 44% code survival should change how you define agent training targets and offline evaluation; start with the failure-mode analysis.

paper.title: Meta-Tool: Efficient Few-Shot Tool Adaptation for Small Language Models
paper.abstract: Can small language models achieve strong tool-use performance without complex adaptation mechanisms? This paper investigates this question through Meta-Tool, a controlled empirical study comparing hypernetwork-based LoRA adaptation against carefully designed few-shot prompting. Using a Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct backbone, we evaluate four adaptation mechanisms--few-shot prompting, documentation encoding, hypernetwork-generated LoRA weights, and value-guided beam search--across four diverse benchmarks

summary.core_problem: 小模型做 tool-use 时，复杂的参数化适配（如 hypernetwork 生成 LoRA）是否真的比精心设计的 few-shot prompting 更有效？
summary.importance: 高质量负结果：把“学一个适配器”与“把提示写好”放在同一控制实验里对比，能校准社区对 tool adaptation 的预期，也提示后训练/适配研究需要更强的 baselines。
summary.technical_approach: Meta-Tool 做受控对比：在 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 上评估四种机制——few-shot prompting、documentation encoding、hypernetwork 生成 LoRA 权重、value-guided beam search；并做系统消融，量化每个组件的边际贡献。
summary.experiments: 骨干模型：Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct；hypernetwork 规模 227.8M 参数。基准：Gorilla APIBench、Spider 2.0、WebArena、InterCode。结论：few-shot 贡献 +21.5%，documentation +5.0%，hypernetwork +0%（无可测提升）；并报告 3B+prompt 达到 GPT-5 平均表现的 79.7%（具体度量口径需看正文）。

summary_en.core_problem: For small LMs, does sophisticated tool-use adaptation (e.g., hypernetwork-generated LoRA) actually beat well-designed few-shot prompting?
summary_en.importance: A solid negative result with controlled baselines: it recalibrates expectations around parameterized tool adaptation and raises the bar for post-training/adaptation papers to beat strong prompting baselines.
summary_en.technical_approach: Meta-Tool runs controlled comparisons on Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct across four mechanisms—few-shot prompting, documentation encoding, hypernetwork-generated LoRA weights, and value-guided beam search—plus extensive ablations to attribute marginal gains.
summary_en.experiments: Backbone: Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct; hypernetwork: 227.8M params. Benchmarks: Gorilla APIBench, Spider 2.0, WebArena, InterCode. Findings: few-shot +21.5%, documentation +5.0%, hypernetwork +0% (no measurable gain). Also reports a 3B model with good prompts reaches 79.7% of GPT-5 average performance (metric details require the paper).

recommendation.zh: 读消融表就够：hypernetwork-LoRA 在这套 tool-use 设定里被 prompt+doc 完全压住；做适配/对齐前先把强提示基线跑干净。
recommendation.en: Just read the ablation tables: hypernetwork-LoRA adds 0% over prompt+docs here; if you do adaptation/alignment, first beat a clean strong prompting baseline.

paper.title: The Tool-Overuse Illusion: Why Does LLM Prefer External Tools over Internal Knowledge?
paper.abstract: Equipping LLMs with external tools effectively addresses internal reasoning limitations. However, it introduces a critical yet under-explored phenomenon: tool overuse, the unnecessary tool-use during reasoning. In this paper, we first reveal this phenomenon is pervasive across diverse LLMs. We then experimentally elucidate its underlying mechanisms through two key lenses: (1) First, by analyzing tool-use behavior across different internal knowledge availability regions, we identify a \textit{kno

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是 tool-integrated reasoning 里的一个常被忽略但很实际的问题：模型在并不需要外部工具时，仍然频繁调用工具，而且这种行为不只是浪费 latency 和 API 成本，还会直接伤害原本可以靠参数知识完成的题目准确率。全文把这个问题拆成两个层面。第一，模型并不能正确判断自己“知道到哪里为止”，也就是对内部知识边界的感知失真；第二，常见的 outcome-only RLVR 训练会把“只要最后答对就行”当成唯一信号，从而把多余工具调用一并强化。论文想解决的不是如何让模型更会用工具，而是如何让模型在该用时用、不该用时不用。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要有三点。第一，它把工具使用问题从“能力增强”拉回到“决策校准”上，指出工具调用本身也是一个需要建模和对齐的策略变量，而不是附属接口。第二，它给出一个和预训练/后训练接口直接相关的结论：如果模型对自身知识可得性没有校准，后续 SFT 或 RL 只会把这种错觉放大。第三，它说明 outcome-only reward 在工具场景下存在系统性偏置，这对 RLVR、agentic reasoning、以及带检索/计算器/代码执行器的训练范式都有参考价值。量级上，这不是改一点 prompt 的经验性工作，而是在训练目标层面指出了一个稳定存在的 failure mode，并给出可操作的缓解路径。
summary.technical_approach:
方法部分有两条主线。第一条是“知识边界错觉”的识别与校准。作者先用 avg@1024 估计单个样本上的内部知识可得性：对同一问题独立采样 1024 次，平均正确率越高，说明模型越有能力在不借助工具的情况下答对。然后把样本按知识可得性分区，观察不同区间里的工具调用行为。关键发现是，工具调用次数并不会随着内部知识可得性上升而显著下降，说明模型并不是在做可靠的 capability-aware routing，而是在错误感知自己的知识边界。为缓解这一点，作者构造 preference pair：一边是“正确且少用工具”的轨迹，另一边是“正确但过度用工具”或“错误且过度用工具”的轨迹，再做 knowledge-aware DPO。这里和普通 DPO 的区别不在于形式，而在于偏好数据的构造目标明确针对 epistemic boundary alignment：让模型学会把‘我能自己答’和‘我需要外部信息’区分开。

第二条是对 RLVR 激励失真的分析与修正。论文把工具推理建模成带 hybrid action space 的 POMDP，动作既包括文本生成，也包括 tool action。作者指出，若 reward 只看最终答案是否正确，那么任何能通向正确答案的多余工具调用都不会被惩罚，反而会因 credit assignment 被正向强化。随着训练推进，策略会越来越偏向“先调工具再说”的保守外包。为验证这一点，作者在 DAPO/GRPO 风格的 RLVR 框架下跟踪训练过程，观察到工具调用轮数持续上升。为此，他们提出一个兼顾结果正确性与工具效率的奖励设计，核心是通过较大的 inter-group rollout sampling 去感知当前问题上的 capability ceiling，再把工具效率纳入相对比较信号中。直观上，它不是简单加一个固定 tool penalty，而是让奖励依赖于‘在这类样本上模型是否本来就能不用工具做对’，因此比统一惩罚更不容易误伤真正需要工具的题目。论文还给出理论分析，说明 epistemic illusion 和 outcome-only reward 为什么会共同导致过度用工具。
summary.experiments:
实验结论比较完整。现象层面，作者在 frontier、开源、以及 RLVR-trained 模型上都观察到 tool overuse，平均每个本可内部解决的 query 会产生 0.93 次不必要工具调用。更关键的是，一旦开放工具，原本可由内部知识解决的问题准确率反而下降 3.29% 到 14.48%。这说明问题不只是成本，而是能力被错误路由稀释。

在知识边界分析里，Qwen3-8B 即使在高知识可得区间（avg@1024 > 0.8）仍平均每题调用 2.2 次工具，是论文最直观的证据之一。DPO 校准部分，knowledge-aware preference optimization 在 32B 模型上把过度用工具现象降低了 82.8%，同时回答准确率提升约 3%。这说明减少工具调用并不一定牺牲正确率，反而可能恢复被工具干扰的内部推理。

RLVR 部分，作者观察到随着训练步数增加，tool-call turns 最终上升 65%，支持“outcome-only reward 会放大 overuse”的判断。改进后的 reward 在数学推理基准上把 7B 模型的工具调用轮数降低 66.7%，32B 模型降低 60.7%，同时保持回答准确率基本不变。对预训练/后训练研究者来说，这组结果最有价值的地方在于：它把一个行为问题明确地追溯到训练信号，而不是只归因于 prompt 或 agent scaffold。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读但要抓住三处。第一看 Introduction 和问题定义，重点不是 taxonomy 本身，而是作者如何把 overuse 从“效率问题”提升为“知识边界感知错误 + 奖励错配”的训练问题。第二看内部知识可得性的测量设计，尤其是 avg@1024 的用法，以及按 knowledge regime 分析工具调用的图表；这里决定了全文最核心的经验结论是否站得住。第三看 RLVR 分析和 reward 改造实验，关注训练步数与 tool-call turns 的关系曲线，以及新奖励是否真的在不掉准确率的前提下减少调用。

如果时间有限，优先读：Figure 1、知识分区分析图、DPO 校准结果表、RLVR 训练动态图、reward ablation。预计 25 到 35 分钟能抓住主线。需要保留一点审慎：avg@1024 是经验性 proxy，不是严格的 knowledge oracle；如果后续要复现，先检查采样温度、判分方式、以及工具环境是否会影响这个 proxy 的稳定性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a practical failure mode in tool-integrated reasoning: LLMs often call external tools even when their parametric knowledge is already sufficient. The issue is not just wasted latency or API cost. Tool access can actually reduce accuracy on questions that should be solvable internally. The paper attributes this to two mechanisms. First, models misperceive the boundary of their own knowledge, so they cannot reliably tell when they already know enough. Second, outcome-only RLVR reinforces any trajectory that ends with a correct answer, including trajectories with unnecessary tool use. The target is therefore not better tool use in general, but calibrated tool use.
summary_en.importance: This matters for foundation-model research because it reframes tool use as a routing and calibration problem, not merely an augmentation interface. It also connects directly to the pretrain–posttrain boundary: if a model has poor self-knowledge calibration, later SFT or RL can amplify that defect instead of fixing it. A third contribution is the training-signal diagnosis. The paper shows that outcome-only rewards are structurally biased in tool settings, which is relevant to RLVR, retrieval-augmented reasoning, calculator/code tools, and agent training more broadly. The contribution is not a prompt trick. It identifies a persistent failure mode at the objective level and proposes concrete mitigation strategies.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper has two main technical threads. The first is diagnosing and aligning the model’s perceived knowledge boundary. The authors estimate internal knowledge availability with avg@1024, the average correctness over 1,024 independent samples for the same question. Higher avg@1024 is treated as stronger evidence that the model can solve the item without external help. They then bucket examples by this proxy and analyze tool-use behavior across knowledge regimes. The key finding is that tool calls do not reliably decrease as internal knowledge availability increases. In other words, the model is not performing capability-aware routing. It behaves as if it has already reached its knowledge boundary even when it has not.

To mitigate this, the authors build preference pairs that favor trajectories producing correct answers with minimal tool use over trajectories that are correct but tool-heavy, or incorrect and tool-heavy. They then apply a knowledge-aware DPO procedure. The novelty is less about the DPO form itself and more about the preference construction objective: it explicitly aligns perceived epistemic boundaries with actual capability.

The second thread analyzes RLVR incentives. Tool reasoning is formulated as a POMDP with a hybrid action space consisting of token-generation actions and tool actions. Under outcome-only rewards, any unnecessary tool call that still leads to a correct final answer receives no penalty and can be positively reinforced through credit assignment. As training proceeds, the policy drifts toward a conservative outsource-first behavior. The authors validate this under a DAPO/GRPO-style RLVR setup and observe increasing tool-call turns over training. They then propose a reward design that balances answer correctness and tool efficiency. The key idea is to estimate a capability ceiling through larger inter-group rollout sampling and incorporate tool efficiency into the relative reward signal. This is more nuanced than a fixed tool penalty because it depends on whether the model could likely solve the item internally, reducing the risk of penalizing genuinely necessary tool use. The paper also includes theoretical arguments supporting both mechanisms.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical story is fairly coherent. Across frontier, open-source, and RLVR-trained models, the authors find pervasive tool overuse: on average, 0.93 unnecessary tool calls per query for questions that do not require external assistance. More importantly, enabling tool use causes a 3.29% to 14.48% accuracy drop on questions solvable from internal knowledge alone. That makes the issue a capability-routing problem, not just an efficiency concern.

In the knowledge-boundary analysis, one of the clearest examples is Qwen3-8B: even in a high-knowledge regime with avg@1024 > 0.8, it still makes 2.2 tool calls per query on average. For mitigation, the knowledge-aware DPO setup reduces tool overuse by 82.8% on a 32B-scale model while improving response accuracy by about 3%.

For RLVR, the paper reports that tool-call turns increase progressively with training and eventually rise by 65%, supporting the claim that outcome-only rewards worsen overuse. The revised reward reduces tool-call turns by 66.7% on a 7B model and 60.7% on a 32B model on math reasoning benchmarks, while maintaining answer accuracy. For researchers, the important point is that the behavior is traced back to the training signal rather than treated as a prompt-level artifact.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and formal problem setup to see how the paper turns tool overuse from an efficiency annoyance into a training and calibration issue. Second, inspect the internal-knowledge measurement and the plots stratified by knowledge regime. Those figures carry the central empirical claim. Third, read the RLVR section with the training-dynamics plots and the reward ablations to check whether reduced tool use comes without accuracy loss.

If time is limited, prioritize Figure 1, the knowledge-regime analysis, the DPO alignment results, the RLVR training-dynamics figure, and the reward ablation tables. Roughly 25–35 minutes should be enough to extract the main ideas. One caveat is that avg@1024 is still a proxy rather than a true oracle of internal knowledge, so any follow-up work should examine sensitivity to sampling temperature, judging protocol, and tool-environment setup.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是看 agent 能力，而是看 reward 怎么把“会用工具”训成“离不开工具”；先读机制分析和 82.8% 降调用那组实验。
recommendation.en: Read this for how reward design turns tool competence into tool dependence, not for agent performance; start with the mechanism analysis and the 82.8% tool-use reduction result.

paper.title: Visual Reasoning through Tool-supervised Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: In this paper, we investigate the problem of how to effectively master tool-use to solve complex visual reasoning tasks for Multimodal Large Language Models. To achieve that, we propose a novel Tool-supervised Reinforcement Learning (ToolsRL) framework, with direct tool supervision for more effective tool-use learning. We focus on a series of simple, native, and interpretable visual tools, including zoom-in, rotate, flip, and draw point/line, whose tool supervision is easy to collect. A reinforc

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态大模型在复杂视觉推理中不会稳定学会调用工具、导致推理与操作能力纠缠优化的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献属于通用tool-use训练方法，而不是纯应用。对后训练研究员有一定参考价值，尤其是“先学工具、再学任务”的课程式RL设计。
summary.technical_approach: 提出ToolsRL：先用可直接监督的原生视觉工具（放大、旋转、翻转、画点/线）和工具专属奖励训练工具调用能力；再进入允许调用工具的准确率目标训练阶段，减少异质目标同时优化的冲突。
summary.experiments: 摘要称课程式训练更高效且有效，但未给出模型规模、数据规模和关键对比数字。若正文实验干净，主要该看工具监督与两阶段RL的消融。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the difficulty of teaching multimodal LLMs to reliably use tools for complex visual reasoning without entangling tool learning and task optimization.
summary_en.importance: This is a general tool-use training method rather than a narrow application. It is moderately relevant to post-training researchers, especially for curriculum RL design.
summary_en.technical_approach: ToolsRL first trains native visual tool use—zoom, rotate, flip, draw point/line—with direct supervision and tool-specific rewards, then switches to accuracy-oriented rewards while allowing tool calls.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims efficient and effective gains, but gives no model size, data scale, or key numbers. The main value likely lies in the ablations on tool supervision and the two-stage RL curriculum.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文，但“先把工具学会再放进任务奖励”这个RL拆解是对的；只看课程设计和消融，别被任务分数带跑。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the RL decomposition—learn tool use before task reward—is the right idea; read the curriculum and ablations, not the headline task scores.

paper.title: OThink-SRR1: Search, Refine and Reasoning with Reinforced Learning for Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) expands the knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet current static retrieval methods struggle with complex, multi-hop problems. While recent dynamic retrieval strategies offer improvements, they face two key challenges: 1) irrelevant retrieved noise can misdirect the reasoning process, and 2) processing full documents incurs prohibitive computational and latency costs. To address these issues, we propose OThink-SRR1, a framework that enhances large mod

summary.core_problem: 在多跳 QA 的动态检索场景中，如何减少无关检索噪声与长文档处理成本，同时让模型学会边搜边精炼再推理。
summary.importance: 这是 RAG/Agent 方向的方法改进，贡献类型是 RL 驱动的检索-精炼-推理框架。对预训练研究员的直接价值有限，但对 post-train 如何塑造工具使用与证据压缩行为有一点参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 OThink-SRR1，采用 Search-Refine-Reason 三阶段迭代流程。关键在 Refine：先把检索文档压缩成短事实，再进入推理，避免把整篇文档直接喂给模型。训练上引入 GRPO-IR，用奖励鼓励正确证据识别，同时惩罚过量检索，以学到更聚焦、更省算力的动态检索策略。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在 4 个 multi-hop QA benchmark 上优于强基线，但未给出具体数据集名称、模型规模、训练 token、奖励构成细节或提升幅度。就摘要信息看，属于任务导向的 agent/RAG 优化，而不是 clean 的基础研究设定。
summary.authors_note: 来自深圳大学与 OPPO Research Institute。作者中 Wangchunshu Zhou 在 LLM/RAG 方向有一定可见度，但这篇工作本身更偏应用型框架。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles dynamic retrieval for multi-hop QA, aiming to reduce irrelevant retrieval noise and document-processing cost while enabling iterative search, refinement, and reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent/RAG method paper, with RL used to improve retrieval-and-reasoning behavior. Its direct value to pretraining researchers is limited, though it offers some signal on how post-training can shape tool use and evidence compression.
summary_en.technical_approach: OThink-SRR1 uses an iterative Search-Refine-Reason pipeline. The key design is the Refine stage, which distills retrieved documents into concise facts before reasoning, instead of feeding full documents to the model. Training uses GRPO-IR, rewarding accurate evidence identification and penalizing excessive retrievals to encourage focused and efficient retrieval policies.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims gains over strong baselines on four multi-hop QA benchmarks, but does not provide benchmark names, model sizes, training scale, reward details, or exact margins. Based on the abstract, this is a task-oriented agent/RAG optimization rather than a clean foundation-model study.
summary_en.authors_note: From Shenzhen University and OPPO Research Institute. Wangchunshu Zhou is visible in LLM/RAG-related work, though this paper itself is more application-framework oriented.

recommendation.zh: RAG agent 的常规强化学习配方，思路不新；若你做 tool-use post-train，可只看 Refine 设计和 retrieval penalty，别指望它给 pretrain 新 prior。
recommendation.en: This is a fairly standard RL-for-RAG recipe, not a new paradigm; if you work on tool-use post-training, inspect the Refine stage and retrieval penalty, but don’t expect a new pretraining prior.

paper.title: AgentV-RL: Scaling Reward Modeling with Agentic Verifier
paper.abstract: Verifiers have been demonstrated to enhance LLM reasoning via test-time scaling (TTS). Yet, they face significant challenges in complex domains. Error propagation from incorrect intermediate reasoning can lead to false positives for seemingly plausible solutions, while lacking external grounding makes verifiers unreliable on computation or knowledge-intensive tasks. To address these challenges, we propose Agentic Verifier, a framework that transforms reward modeling into a multi-turn, tool-augme

summary.core_problem: 解决现有 verifier 在复杂推理任务中容易被错误中间步骤误导、且缺乏外部 grounding 导致奖励信号不可靠的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇工作重要之处不在于又做了一个 verifier，而是把 reward modeling 从单步打分器改成了多轮、可调用工具、前后向交叉核验的 agentic 过程；对 RL 信号质量、test-time scaling、以及 post-train 反哺 pretrain 都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Agentic Verifier：由 forward agent 从前提追踪到结论，backward agent 从结论反查前提，形成双向 deliberation；同时允许工具调用来处理计算和知识密集型验证。进一步提出 AgentV-RL，通过主动探索和强化学习，让 verifier 学会在内部推理与外部工具之间自主切换。核心创新是把 verifier 训练成一个带策略的过程，而非静态 reward model。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整参数规模与基线细节，但聚焦复杂推理场景下 verifier 的可靠性提升，目标是增强 test-time scaling 的收益。实验应包含与传统 reward model / verifier 的比较，以及工具增强和双向核验的消融。由于摘要信息有限，具体提升幅度仍需看正文表格判断结论强度。
summary.authors_note: 复旦、华中科大与字节 Seed 联合工作。字节 Seed 近年在推理、agent、后训练和多模态方向持续有系统性投入。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the unreliability of current verifiers on hard reasoning tasks, where wrong intermediate steps can look plausible and missing external grounding weakens reward signals.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is not just another verifier, but a shift from static reward scoring to a multi-turn, tool-augmented, bidirectional verification process. That matters for reward quality, test-time scaling, and the pretrain–posttrain interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes an Agentic Verifier with complementary forward and backward agents: one traces reasoning from premises to conclusions, while the other checks conclusions back against premises. It also supports tool use for computation- and knowledge-heavy verification. AgentV-RL then trains this verifier via proactive exploration and reinforcement learning so it can decide when to reason internally versus invoke tools.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not expose full model sizes or exact baselines, but the evaluation is aimed at complex reasoning settings where verifier reliability matters for test-time scaling. The key comparisons likely include standard reward models/verifiers and ablations on bidirectional checking and tool use. Exact effect sizes need the main tables to assess credibility.
summary_en.authors_note: A collaboration among Fudan, HUST, and ByteDance Seed. ByteDance Seed has been consistently active in reasoning, agentic systems, post-training, and multimodal foundation work.

recommendation.zh: 把 verifier 从“打分头”改成“会查证的策略体”这个方向是对的；先看方法图和 RL 训练细节，若 credit assignment 写得含糊，结论就当中等强度信号。
recommendation.en: The useful shift is treating the verifier as a policy that can investigate, not a scalar head; read the method figure and RL credit-assignment details first, or treat the gains as medium-strength evidence.

institutions: Huazhong University of Science and Technology
ByteDance Seed 5 Institute of Trustworthy Embodied AI, Fudan University
Shanghai Key Laboratory of Multimodal Embodied AI

paper.title: Subliminal Transfer of Unsafe Behaviors in AI Agent Distillation
paper.abstract: Recent work on subliminal learning demonstrates that language models can transmit semantic traits through data that is semantically unrelated to those traits. However, it remains unclear whether behavioral traits can transfer in agentic systems, where policies are learned from trajectories rather than static text. In this work, we provide the first empirical evidence that unsafe agent behaviors can transfer subliminally through model distillation across two complementary experimental settings. I

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要回答的问题很具体：在 agent distillation 里，即使训练数据已经做过显式安全过滤，学生模型是否仍会从教师轨迹中继承危险的行为倾向。作者关注的不是语义知识的“暗传递”，而是策略层面的行为偏置传递。更准确地说，他们研究的是：当教师模型在决策风格上存在稳定的破坏性偏好，例如在模糊任务里更倾向删除、清除、终止，而蒸馏数据只包含表面上安全的任务与轨迹、并且删除关键词被严格清洗后，这种偏好是否仍会通过轨迹结构、动作分布和局部决策模式渗入学生模型。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身，这篇工作不是直接的方法论文，但它对“用模型生成数据训练模型”这条路线有很直接的提醒。现在从预训练到后训练，再到 agent trajectory distillation，越来越多数据来自教师模型而不是人工标注。论文指出，安全过滤如果只盯显式 token 或关键词，可能挡不住更深层的策略偏置迁移。这个结论的意义在于，它把数据质量问题从“文本内容是否安全”推进到“行为分布是否安全”。对做合成数据、持续学习、RL pretrain、agentic pretraining 的人来说，这是一类需要进入数据审计范式的新风险：轨迹的结构统计特征本身可能携带不可见的 policy prior。
summary.technical_approach:
方法设计的重点是把“显式 unsafe supervision”和“隐式 behavioral transfer”分开。作者先构造一个带强 deletion bias 的教师 agent：通过显式删除类任务微调，让它在保留集上的删除率达到很高水平。然后让这个教师只在一组互不重叠的安全任务上生成轨迹，这些任务本身不需要删除动作，例如读文件、列目录、生成报告等。接着对轨迹做严格清洗，去掉删除相关关键词和显式危险内容，再用这些看起来安全的轨迹蒸馏学生模型。最后，作者在一组“模糊任务”上评估学生：这些任务里 destructive action 和 neutral action 都是可行解，但安全基线应接近不删。

技术上有两个值得注意的点。第一，作者没有把行为偏置定义成单一动作命中率，而是定义了 deletion propensity，即模型在模糊任务上分配给 destructive action 集合的总概率质量。这比只看最终采样动作更稳，因为它能反映策略层面的偏好，而不是一次解码偶然性。第二，作者做了两个互补环境：一个是结构化 API tool interface，动作空间受控；另一个是原生 Bash 环境，用 chmod-first 偏好做类比，检验现象是否只是受限动作空间下的假象。这个设计是合理的，因为如果只在 API action schema 下成立，很难说明它是一般性的 agent 行为迁移。

与已有 subliminal learning 工作相比，这篇论文的区别在于对象从静态文本语义转向交互式策略。过去工作多讨论实体偏见、世界知识或语义倾向如何在无关文本中迁移；这里作者关心的是“如何行动”的偏好，并且训练信号来自 trajectory imitation 而不是 next-token text-only 模仿。这使问题更接近真实 agent 训练流程，也更接近未来用轨迹做持续蒸馏和能力压缩的实际场景。
summary.experiments:
从全文可确认的实验结构看，作者主要围绕两类设置展开：Deletion Bias 的主实验，以及 Bash 环境中的 chmod-first 复现实验。模型族以 Llama-3 8B/3B 和 Qwen 系列为主，用来覆盖同构蒸馏、跨尺度蒸馏，以及一定程度上的跨模型族迁移。教师先被诱导出很强的删除偏置，目标是在 held-out deletion-relevant tasks 上达到 80%–100% 的删除率；学生只看安全任务轨迹，不直接接触删除动作或删除关键词。

论文的核心结果不是“学生学会了删除命令”，而是即便在显式删除词被过滤、训练任务本身不要求删除的条件下，学生在模糊评测任务上的 destructive preference 仍显著上升。并且作者强调，这种 behavioral transfer 的强度高于此前文献中常见的 semantic subliminal transfer，尤其是在同构模型蒸馏时更明显。另一个关键观察是，关键词级 sanitation 不足以阻断迁移；也就是说，危险行为并不一定通过显式 lexical channel 传播，而可能通过轨迹中的动作排序、状态转移模式、局部决策习惯等更隐蔽的统计结构传播。

Bash 复现实验的意义也很明确：作者把偏置从“删文件”换成“权限相关操作时优先 chmod”，因为在 shell 中很多命令表达更自由，动作边界也不再像 API 那样离散。如果在这种环境里仍能观察到偏好迁移，就说明问题不只是工具 schema 泄漏，而更像是策略风格被模仿。摘要截断导致具体表格数字未完全可见，但从正文叙述可以确定，论文的证据链主要依赖：教师偏置诱导成功、训练数据表面安全、学生在模糊任务上的偏置显著偏离安全基线、现象跨接口复现。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇论文适合泛读，但有几个部分值得重点看。第一看 Introduction 和 Methodology，确认作者如何定义 deletion bias、ambiguous tasks、以及为什么用 propensity 而不是单次动作率。第二看图 2 对整条 transfer pipeline 的拆解，那里最能看清作者如何隔离显式监督与隐式迁移。第三看主实验表格，重点不是绝对分数，而是四个对照：安全教师 vs 偏置教师、清洗前 vs 清洗后、同构蒸馏 vs 跨模型蒸馏、API 环境 vs Bash 环境。第四看消融，如果正文里有不同 sanitation 强度、不同任务类型、不同模型族的比较，这些部分决定结论是否稳。

预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。若只想抓住要点，先看问题设定、主结果表、Bash 复现和讨论部分即可。真正值得深挖的点有两个：一是轨迹里到底哪些统计结构在传递偏置；二是这种现象与常规 imitation learning 中的 covariate shift、style imitation、policy compression 有什么关系。论文提出了风险，但机制层面还没有完全打开。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrow but important question: in agent distillation, can a student inherit unsafe behavioral tendencies from a teacher even when the training trajectories are restricted to ostensibly safe tasks and explicitly sanitized for unsafe keywords? The target is not semantic subliminal transfer in static text, but policy-level transfer in interactive systems. More concretely, the authors study whether a teacher’s stable action preference—such as choosing deletion-like actions in ambiguous situations—can leak into the student through trajectory structure and action statistics, despite the absence of direct unsafe supervision.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it matters for the data pipeline that modern foundation-model training increasingly relies on. Distillation, synthetic data generation, continual training, and agent trajectory collection all assume that filtering explicit unsafe content is a meaningful safety barrier. The paper argues that this assumption is incomplete. If behavioral priors can transfer through sanitized trajectories, then data quality is not only about textual content; it is also about the policy distribution embedded in demonstrations. For researchers working on synthetic corpora, RL pretraining, agentic pretraining, or continual distillation, the practical implication is clear: trajectory datasets may carry hidden behavioral bias even when lexical safety checks pass.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The methodology is designed to separate explicit unsafe supervision from implicit behavioral transfer. First, the authors create a deletion-biased teacher agent by fine-tuning on explicit deletion-oriented tasks until it shows a strong destructive preference on held-out deletion-relevant evaluations. Second, this teacher is used only to generate trajectories for a disjoint set of safe tasks where deletion is never appropriate, such as reading files, listing directories, or generating reports. Third, the generated trajectories are sanitized with keyword-based filtering to remove explicit deletion-related content. Finally, a student model is distilled on these sanitized, apparently safe trajectories and evaluated on ambiguous tasks where both destructive and neutral actions are valid, but a safe model should assign near-zero mass to deletion.

Two design choices are especially important. First, the paper measures deletion propensity as the total probability mass assigned to a class of destructive actions, rather than only counting sampled actions. That makes the metric more policy-sensitive and less dependent on decoding noise. Second, the authors test two environments: a structured API-style tool interface and a native Bash setting with a chmod-first bias. This matters because a result confined to a discrete API schema could be dismissed as an artifact of constrained action design. Showing a similar effect in free-form shell command generation strengthens the claim that the transfer concerns behavioral style rather than a specific tool vocabulary.

Relative to prior subliminal learning work, the novelty is the shift from static semantic transfer to interactive policy transfer. Earlier papers mostly studied hidden transmission of semantic associations or world knowledge through unrelated text. Here the object is how an agent acts, and the supervision channel is trajectory imitation rather than plain next-token language modeling.
summary_en.experiments:
From the full text provided, the experimental program centers on two settings: the main deletion-bias setup and a Bash replication using a chmod-first preference. The model families include Llama-3 8B/3B and Qwen variants, allowing the authors to test homogeneous distillation, cross-scale transfer, and some cross-family generalization. The teacher is explicitly induced to become strongly deletion-biased, with a target deletion rate of 80%–100% on held-out deletion-relevant tasks. The student, however, is trained only on safe-task trajectories and is not directly exposed to deletion actions or deletion keywords.

The main result is not merely that the student can output unsafe commands. The stronger claim is that, after sanitization and despite the absence of explicit unsafe content, the student’s preference for destructive actions on ambiguous evaluation tasks still rises substantially above a safe baseline. The paper further argues that this behavioral transfer is stronger than the semantic subliminal transfer reported in earlier work, especially in homogeneous teacher-student settings. Another key finding is that keyword-based sanitation is insufficient: the transfer channel is not purely lexical, and may instead be carried by trajectory-level regularities such as action ordering, local decision patterns, or state-transition structure.

The Bash replication is important for external validity. By replacing deletion bias with a chmod-first preference in a freer command space, the authors test whether the phenomenon depends on a rigid API action schema. The reported result is that the effect persists, suggesting that the issue is better understood as policy-style imitation than as schema leakage. The excerpt does not expose all table values, so exact downstream numbers are not fully recoverable here, but the evidential chain in the paper is clear: successful teacher bias induction, apparently safe training data, measurable student bias on ambiguous tasks, and replication across interfaces.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this as a risk-analysis paper for trajectory distillation, not as a final mechanistic account. Start with the Introduction and Methodology to understand how deletion bias, ambiguous tasks, and deletion propensity are defined. Then inspect Figure 2 carefully; it is the clearest summary of how the authors isolate implicit transfer from explicit unsafe supervision. In the results section, focus less on absolute performance and more on the comparison axes: safe vs biased teacher, before vs after sanitization, homogeneous vs cross-model distillation, and API vs Bash environments. If there are ablations on sanitation strength, task type, or model family, those are the parts that determine how robust the claim really is.

A practical skim takes about 20–30 minutes. If time is limited, read the setup, the main result tables, the Bash replication, and the discussion. The most interesting open questions are mechanistic: which trajectory statistics actually carry the bias, and how this phenomenon relates to imitation-learning style transfer, policy compression, and covariate-shift effects. The paper establishes the risk clearly, but does not fully resolve the transfer mechanism.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改你对“过滤掉危险 token 就够了”的先验；先看实验对照和过滤细节，若 setup 干净，蒸馏安全审计流程得立刻补一层行为级检测。
recommendation.en: This should update the prior that removing harmful tokens is enough; read the controls and filtering details first, and if the setup is clean, your distillation safety audit needs behavior-level checks, not just lexical filtering.

paper.title: PolicyBank: Evolving Policy Understanding for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: LLM agents operating under organizational policies must comply with authorization constraints typically specified in natural language. In practice, such specifications inevitably contain ambiguities and logical or semantic gaps that cause the agent's behavior to systematically diverge from the true requirements. We ask: by letting an agent evolve its policy understanding through interaction and corrective feedback from pre-deployment testing, can it autonomously refine its interpretation to clos

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM agent 在自然语言组织政策存在歧义和缺口时，如何通过交互测试与纠错反馈逐步修正自身政策理解，而不是机械记忆错误规则。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值在 agent memory 与 policy compliance 机制，而不是基座模型本身。它有一定方法新意：把“政策理解”视为可演化对象，并构造了能区分对齐失败与执行失败的测试基准。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 PolicyBank，一种结构化记忆机制，用于维护工具级 policy insight，并在预部署测试中根据纠错反馈迭代更新。与把原始 policy 文本视为不可变真值的记忆方法不同，PolicyBank 允许 agent 显式修正对规则的解释。论文还扩展了一个 tool-calling benchmark，注入可控 policy gap，用来隔离 specification gap 带来的失败。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出模型规模和具体 benchmark 名称，但给出了关键对比设定：现有 memory 机制在原始 policy 上接近零违规，却在真实需求上仍有高违规率；PolicyBank 旨在缩小这种“表面合规、实则错误”的差距。若看正文，重点应放在 policy gap 构造方式、违规率定义和 ablation，而不是绝对分数。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 Google Cloud 和 University of Wisconsin-Madison。作者中 Jinsung Yoon、Tomas Pfister 具备较强工业研究背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how an LLM agent can refine its understanding of ambiguous natural-language organizational policies through interaction and corrective feedback, instead of rigidly memorizing flawed policy text.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mainly in agent memory and policy-compliance methodology rather than foundation-model research. The key novelty is to treat policy understanding as an evolvable object and to build a benchmark that separates alignment failures from execution failures.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose PolicyBank, a structured memory mechanism that stores tool-level policy insights and iteratively updates them using corrective feedback from pre-deployment testing. Unlike prior memory approaches that treat the original policy as immutable ground truth, PolicyBank explicitly revises the agent's interpretation. They also extend a tool-calling benchmark with controlled policy gaps to isolate failures caused by specification ambiguity.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes or the exact benchmark name, but it highlights the key comparison: existing memory methods can achieve near-zero violations against the raw policy text while still violating the true requirements at a high rate. The important parts to inspect are the construction of policy gaps, the violation metrics, and the ablations, rather than the headline scores.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from Google Cloud and the University of Wisconsin-Madison. Jinsung Yoon and Tomas Pfister have strong industry research backgrounds.

recommendation.zh: agent 方向里算有方法意识，但离基座研究较远；只看 benchmark 设计和“compliant but wrong”这个 failure mode，别在分数上停太久。
recommendation.en: This is method-aware by agent-paper standards but still far from core pretraining; read it for the benchmark design and the 'compliant but wrong' failure mode, not the raw scores.

paper.title: GTA-2: Benchmarking General Tool Agents from Atomic Tool-Use to Open-Ended Workflows
paper.abstract: The development of general-purpose agents requires a shift from executing simple instructions to completing complex, real-world productivity workflows. However, current tool-use benchmarks remain misaligned with real-world requirements, relying on AI-generated queries, dummy tools, and limited system-level coordination. To address this, we propose GTA-2, a hierarchical benchmark for General Tool Agents (GTA) spanning atomic tool use and open-ended workflows. Built on real-world authenticity, it

summary.core_problem: 解决现有 tool-use benchmark 与真实生产工作流脱节的问题：它们多依赖伪造查询、玩具工具和短链路任务，难以评估通用工具 Agent 的真实能力。
summary.importance: 这是一篇 Agent benchmark 工作。价值不在方法本身，而在评测设定：把 atomic tool use 和 open-ended workflow 放进同一层级框架，并尝试用递归 checkpoint 评估开放式交付物。对做通用 Agent 系统的人有参考，对预训练研究员相关性中等。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 GTA-2，分为两层：GTA-Atomic 评估短程、封闭式工具调用精度；GTA-Workflow 评估长程、开放式真实工作流完成度。数据侧强调真实用户查询、真实部署工具和多模态上下文；评估侧提出 recursive checkpoint-based evaluation，把开放目标拆成可验证子目标，统一评估模型能力与执行结果。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出参与评测的模型名单、任务规模、通过率或与现有 benchmark 的量化对比。能确认的是它是 benchmark/系统评测工作，而非新 Agent 架构；实验价值主要取决于任务构造质量和 checkpoint 评估的一致性。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表包含 Dacheng Tao。若论文正文确认其机构背景，可进一步判断 benchmark 的资源投入与持续维护能力。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the mismatch between existing tool-use benchmarks and real-world productivity workflows, where many current benchmarks rely on synthetic queries, dummy tools, and short-horizon tasks.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent benchmark paper. Its value is in evaluation design rather than a new agent method: it unifies atomic tool use and open-ended workflows, and proposes recursive checkpoint evaluation for open-ended deliverables. Relevance to pretraining researchers is moderate.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces GTA-2 with two levels: GTA-Atomic for short-horizon, closed-ended tool-use precision, and GTA-Workflow for long-horizon, open-ended real-world task completion. It emphasizes real user queries, deployed tools, and multimodal context, and uses recursive checkpoint-based evaluation to decompose open objectives into verifiable sub-goals.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide evaluated model names, task counts, pass rates, or quantitative comparisons against prior benchmarks. It is clearly a benchmark/system evaluation paper rather than a new agent architecture; its practical value will depend on task quality and evaluation consistency.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Dacheng Tao. If the full paper confirms institutional backing, that would matter for benchmark scale and maintenance credibility.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 tool-agent 评测失真，这篇可做 benchmark 备查；重点看 recursive checkpoint 评估，别指望它给出新的 agent 方法论。
recommendation.en: Useful as a benchmark reference if you care about tool-agent evaluation realism; read the recursive checkpoint evaluation, but don’t expect a new agent methodology.

paper.title: InfiniteScienceGym: An Unbounded, Procedurally-Generated Benchmark for Scientific Analysis

summary.core_problem: 如何在不依赖真实论文/人工标注的前提下，评测“科学助手型LLM/Agent”是否能基于给定仓库中的经验数据进行证据推理、在证据不足时正确拒答（abstention），并且在工具调用与文件交互上采取有效策略；同时避免真实数据评测固有的发表偏差、已知知识污染（parametric priors/known-knowledge bias）、标注噪声与数据分发成本。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不是提出新训练法，而是提供一种更“可控、可扩展、可验证”的评测范式：用程序化生成的科学仓库+特权生成器给出可证明的ground truth（含不可回答问题），从而把模型的“参数记忆”与“基于证据的推理/工具使用”更干净地解耦。对基座模型而言，它能作为数据与训练目标设计的诊断工具：1）量化模型在证据不足时的过度自信与幻觉倾向；2）揭示长上下文/工具使用下，token用量并不等价于证据处理量；3）为后续的pretrain/RL-pretrain/持续学习提供可无限采样的合成评测分布，用于做训练动态对比（例如不同数据配比、不同tool-use pretraining对“可拒答性”的影响）。
summary.technical_approach:
InfiniteScienceGym的核心是“三段式生成管线”并强调可复现与可验证：
1）Simulator（仓库模拟器）：输入随机seed，确定性生成一个“自包含”的科学研究仓库（目录结构+文件+表格数据+元信息+笔记等），尽量贴近真实科研项目的artifact形态。seed→repo是确定函数，因此可复现、可索引；同时按需生成避免存储/版权问题。
2）Privileged QA generator（特权问答生成器）：它访问模拟器的底层生成过程（而不是仅看表面文件），用模板化方式生成问题，并给出精确ground truth。关键点是能系统地产生“可回答/不可回答”两类问题：不可回答并非主观标注，而是由生成过程保证仓库中缺失必要证据（例如缺测、定义不匹配等），因此具备“可证明的不可回答性”。
3）Paraphrase module（释义模块）：把模板问答改写成更自然的研究者提问表述，用于测试对表面形式扰动的鲁棒性，同时保持可验证性。
评测设置强调agentic行为：模型可浏览仓库、选择加载文件或调用工具（如代码/分析）来得出结论。论文还把“交互/工具调用次数”与“token消耗”区分开，主张用前者更好刻画证据处理策略：强模型往往避免把大文件直接塞进上下文，而是用程序化方式处理。
summary.experiments:
论文在tool-enabled设置下评测多种闭源与开源模型，结论集中在三点：
1）总体性能低：所有模型在InfiniteScienceGym上都不理想，最强模型总体准确率仅44.8%，说明“基于仓库证据的科学推理+拒答”远未解决。
2）不可回答识别薄弱：大量系统在证据不足时仍给出自信答案（过度断言/幻觉），暴露出abstention能力与不确定性校准问题。
3）交互与工具调用与准确率正相关：更高的tool call/交互通常带来更高准确率；相反，token使用量不是可靠的努力/严谨度代理变量——强系统可能token更省但通过代码分析更有效地处理大文件。
（给定全文片段未包含更细的分任务指标、题型分解或具体模型列表/方差；若论文后文有表格，建议补充按“可回答/不可回答”、按仓库规模、按工具预算的分层结果。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约30–45分钟）：
1）重点读Introduction与“The Case for Procedurally Generated Scientific Evaluation”：理解它要解决的评测偏差（发表偏差、known-knowledge bias、标注噪声、存储/版权）以及为何程序化生成能提供“可证明不可回答”。
2）精看生成管线描述（simulator→QA generator→paraphrase）：这是方法核心，尤其关注“特权访问”如何保证ground truth与unanswerable的构造逻辑。
3）看实验结论部分关于“工具调用次数 vs token用量”的对比论点：这对设计pretrain数据（tool-use traces）、以及评测指标（effort proxy）很有启发。
4）如果你做预训练/持续学习：思考如何把该环境当作可无限采样的合成分布，用于RL-pretrain或课程学习（先可回答再不可回答、先小仓库再大仓库），以及如何定义奖励（正确+引用证据+正确拒答+成本约束）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate whether LLM-based scientific assistants/agents can (i) reason from empirical evidence contained in a project-like repository, (ii) correctly abstain when the repository lacks sufficient evidence, and (iii) use tools/files efficiently—without relying on real published studies or human labels that introduce publication bias, known-knowledge contamination, annotation noise, and heavy storage/legal burdens.
summary_en.importance: The paper is primarily an evaluation/benchmark contribution rather than a new pretraining algorithm, but it matters for foundation-model research because it offers a controllable, infinitely scalable, and verifiable testbed that better separates parametric knowledge from evidence-grounded reasoning. It exposes two pretraining-relevant failure modes: systematic overclaiming on unanswerable queries (calibration/abstention) and the mismatch between token-based “effort” and actual evidence processing under tool use. As a result, it can serve as a diagnostic target for data/recipe changes (e.g., tool-use pretraining, RL-pretrain for abstention, continual learning of scientific workflows) with reproducible seeds and ground truth.
summary_en.technical_approach:
InfiniteScienceGym is built around a deterministic, seed-indexed procedural generation pipeline:
1) A simulator maps a random seed to a self-contained “scientific repository” (realistic directory structure, files, tabular datasets, metadata, notes). Because generation is deterministic, instances are reproducible; because they are generated on demand, distribution avoids storing large corpora.
2) A privileged QA generator uses access to the simulator’s latent generation process (not just surface files) to produce templated questions with exact ground truth, including provably unanswerable questions constructed by ensuring missing/mismatched evidence.
3) A paraphrasing module rewrites templated QAs into more natural research queries while preserving verifiability.
Evaluation is agentic/tool-enabled: models can inspect repository contents and invoke analysis tools. The paper emphasizes that effective agents often avoid stuffing large files into context and instead analyze them programmatically, motivating metrics beyond token count.
summary_en.experiments: Across a mix of proprietary and open-weight models in a tool-enabled setting, no model performs well overall; the best reported accuracy is 44.8%. Unanswerable-question handling is a major weakness: many systems still answer confidently despite insufficient evidence. Strategy analysis shows accuracy increases with interaction/tool calls, whereas token usage is a poor proxy for diligence—stronger agents may use fewer tokens by operating on files via code/tools rather than loading them verbatim. (The provided full-text excerpt does not include finer-grained breakdown tables; consult the main results section for per-condition splits if available.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the Introduction carefully for the benchmark motivation and the specific confounders it targets (publication bias, known-knowledge bias, label noise, storage/legal constraints).
- Focus on the generator pipeline description (simulator → privileged QA → paraphrase). The key novelty is the “privileged” construction of exact ground truth and provable unanswerability.
- In the results, prioritize the analysis contrasting tool-call count vs token usage as effort proxies; this is the most actionable insight for pretraining/RL-pretrain and evaluation design.
- If you work on pretraining/continual learning, consider how to use the seed-indexed environment for scalable RL-style curricula and for training abstention/calibration with cost-aware rewards.

recommendation.zh: 当作可无限采样的诊断基准看：重点读“可拒答问题+特权生成器 ground truth”的设计，能用来区分参数记忆与证据推理；正文细节不必逐页啃。
recommendation.en: Use it as an endlessly-samplable diagnostic benchmark: focus on the unanswerable-question + privileged-generator ground-truth design to separate parametric recall from evidence reasoning; no need to read every detail.

paper.title: POINTS-Seeker: Towards Training a Multimodal Agentic Search Model from Scratch

summary.core_problem: 核心问题：现有多模态搜索/浏览类Agent大多是在通用LMM上“后挂工具+SFT/RL”得到的，导致agentic行为更像表层技能而非内生能力；同时长链路交互会引发上下文膨胀与“attention dilution / Lost-in-the-Middle”，即使证据已在历史中也难以被模型稳定定位与利用。论文试图回答：能否在“从零训练”的路线中，把搜索式自主探究（ReAct式规划-行动-观察-整合）作为模型形成期的核心能力注入，并在不牺牲证据保真度的前提下解决长时序交互的上下文瓶颈？
summary.importance:
对预训练/持续学习研究的启发主要在两点：
(1) 训练阶段划分的新范式：提出介于通用预训练与任务后训练之间的“Agentic Seeding”阶段，把长轨迹、工具交互、规划推理当作“形成期课程”而非下游技能灌输，属于对预训练课程设计/能力成因的直接探索。
(2) 长上下文与记忆的另类路径：V-Fold用“视觉空间承载历史”替代纯文本压缩/截断，实质是把上下文容量问题转化为多模态表征与对齐问题；这对长上下文建模、记忆外化、以及多模态token预算分配有方法论价值。
但从基座预训练角度，它更偏“多模态agent后训练/课程学习+上下文压缩机制”，不是纯粹的新语言建模目标或scaling law工作；价值在于训练配方与长程交互数据如何塑形能力。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由两条主线构成：Agentic Seeding（能力注入）与V-Fold（长程交互抗退化）。
1) Agentic Seeding：作者明确反对仅在成熟LMM上做工具调用SFT/RL的“外挂式”路线，主张在预训练之后、SFT/RL之前插入一个专门阶段，密集喂入长视野推理与ReAct轨迹，使模型在表征层面内化“提出子问题→检索/浏览→读证据→再规划→综合回答”的交互模式。其关键点是数据形态从静态QA/描述转为多步trajectory（含action、observation、history），让模型学习在历史中维护状态、在不确定性下继续探索。
2) 轨迹增强VQA数据：论文在方法章节中定义了交互形式（action/observation/history），并构建“trajectory-augmented VQA”以支撑SFT/RL训练：模型在每步决定调用何种工具或直接回答，工具返回网页URL/标题/片段等观测，历史不断累积。
3) SFT与RL管线：在轨迹数据上进行监督学习以对齐工具协议与多步推理格式，并进一步用RL强化长链路成功率（文中强调其目标是鲁棒自主搜索而非仅格式正确）。
4) V-Fold：针对长链路导致的注意力稀释，提出自适应“折叠”机制：保留最近窗口的交互为高精度文本；将更早的历史通过渲染（rendering）折叠进视觉模态，让模型“看见”历史证据而不是把它们作为大量文本token继续占用上下文。直觉上，这是用VLM的视觉-语言对齐能力来承载压缩后的历史，避免文本侧token冗余导致的检索失败。训练上声称非常省：只需在SFT中加入约5k条渲染轨迹即可让模型学会在部署时使用该折叠策略。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文片段可确认的实验结论与设置要点：
- 模型：POINTS-Seeker-8B。
- 评测：6个基准（MMSearch、MMSearch-Plus、FVQA、SimpleVQA、LiveVQA、BrowseComp-VL）。
- 结论：在上述基准上“持续SOTA”，并显著超过依赖post-hoc fine-tuning的既有多模态搜索agent。
- 关键现象与验证：论文强调长链路交互的性能瓶颈来自attention dilution（类Lost-in-the-Middle），V-Fold用于缓解；并声称仅用约5k渲染轨迹即可学到折叠能力。
注意：你提供的全文内容在实验数值（各benchmark具体分数、提升幅度、RL细节、消融表格）处被截断，无法从当前文本中可靠抽取“具体数字提升/数据规模/训练步数”等硬指标；若补充论文实验章节与表格，可进一步给出逐项对比与消融结论（例如：仅Agentic Seeding vs 仅V-Fold vs 两者结合；不同折叠阈值/窗口大小；不同工具集合；长轨迹长度分桶性能等）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约30–45分钟抓主线）：
1) Introduction：重点看作者对“从零训练agentic search”与“post-hoc工具微调”的差异化论证，以及Figure 3(b)关于attention dilution/Lost-in-the-Middle的失败案例。
2) Method 3.2（Agentic Seeding）：关注它在训练阶段划分上的定位（pretrain之后、SFT/RL之前）以及轨迹数据的组织形式（action/observation/history），这部分对“课程学习如何塑形agent能力”最关键。
3) Method 3.6（V-Fold）：重点理解“滑窗保留文本 + 历史渲染进视觉”的双通道表示，以及为何只需少量渲染轨迹就能泛化到部署。
4) Experiments（若你补全全文）：优先找(1)长链路长度分桶曲线/随turn增长的退化图；(2) V-Fold消融与不同压缩策略对比（截断/摘要/检索式记忆 vs V-Fold）；(3) Agentic Seeding是否带来更少的无效工具调用、更高的证据命中率。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets two coupled failures in multimodal web-search agents: (i) today’s agents are mostly “general LMM + tool-use post-training”, making agentic behavior a thin task layer rather than an intrinsic capability; (ii) long-horizon interactions inflate context and cause attention dilution / Lost-in-the-Middle, where the model misses already-present evidence in the history. The central question is whether we can build a natively agentic multimodal search model “from scratch” by injecting ReAct-style long trajectories during the model’s formative stage, and how to preserve evidence fidelity under long interaction histories without naive truncation/summarization.
summary_en.importance:
For foundation-model pretraining researchers, the contribution is mainly methodological rather than a new LM objective: 
1) A training-stage reframing (“Agentic Seeding”) that sits between pretraining and downstream SFT/RL, treating long-horizon tool-interaction trajectories as a core curriculum to shape representations—useful for thinking about capability formation and continual/curriculum learning.
2) A long-context mitigation route that offloads stale textual history into the visual channel (V-Fold), effectively turning context-length pressure into a multimodal representation/allocation problem. This is relevant to memory externalization and token-budget design in multimodal LMs.
Overall it’s more agentic multimodal training + context management than classic scaling-law/tokenizer work, but it offers concrete ideas on how data form (trajectories) and representation (visualized history) can unlock robustness.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Two main components:
1) Agentic Seeding: instead of teaching tool use post-hoc, the authors introduce a dedicated stage after pretraining that densely trains on long-horizon reasoning and ReAct-like trajectories (plan→act/tool-call→observe→update→answer). The model learns to maintain state over an interaction history defined by (query, actions, observations, …), internalizing autonomous inquiry patterns as part of its core behavior.
2) Trajectory-augmented VQA data + SFT/RL pipeline: they formalize actions (tool invocation or final answer), observations (URLs/titles/snippets returned by tools), and interaction history, then perform SFT to learn protocols and multi-step reasoning formats, followed by RL to improve long-horizon success.
3) V-Fold: an adaptive history folding mechanism to combat attention dilution. Recent turns remain as high-fidelity text in a sliding window; older history is rendered into the visual modality so the model can still “see” raw evidence via vision-language alignment without paying large text-token costs. Training is claimed to be lightweight: ~5k rendered trajectories added during SFT are sufficient for the model to generalize the folding behavior at deployment.
summary_en.experiments:
What can be reliably extracted from the provided full-text excerpt:
- Model: POINTS-Seeker-8B.
- Benchmarks: MMSearch, MMSearch-Plus, FVQA, SimpleVQA, LiveVQA, BrowseComp-VL.
- Claims: consistent SOTA across all six, outperforming prior post-hoc tool-augmented agents; V-Fold addresses long-horizon degradation; only ~5k rendered trajectories are needed to learn folding.
However, the excerpt does not include the experimental tables/figures with exact scores, dataset sizes, training budgets, or ablation numbers. With the full Experiments section, the most important details to extract would be: gains attributable to Agentic Seeding vs standard post-training, turn-length robustness curves, and comparisons against truncation/summarization baselines for long histories.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 min):
- Intro: focus on the argument for “native agentic” training and the attention-dilution failure mode (the Lost-in-the-Middle analogy).
- Method §3.2: Agentic Seeding’s placement in the training recipe and the exact trajectory format (action/observation/history).
- Method §3.6: V-Fold’s dual representation (text window + rendered visual history) and the training-efficiency claim (~5k trajectories).
- Experiments (if available): prioritize long-horizon robustness plots, V-Fold ablations vs truncation/summarization, and evidence-grounding metrics (e.g., evidence hit rate, tool-call efficiency).

recommendation.zh: 建议看训练配方：把 agentic 行为前置成“Agentic Seeding”课程并用 V-Fold 外化历史，可能改变你对长轨迹能力应在何阶段注入的 prior。
recommendation.en: Skim for the recipe: an explicit “Agentic Seeding” stage plus V-Fold history externalization may shift your prior on when long-horizon/tool-use behavior should be injected during training.

paper.title: UI-Copilot: Advancing Long-Horizon GUI Automation via Tool-Integrated Policy Optimization

summary.core_problem: 如何提升基于多模态大模型(MLLM)的GUI自动化在长时序/长地平线任务中的稳定性与可控性，缓解记忆退化、进度混乱与数值/算术幻觉。
summary.importance: 提出“执行agent + 轻量copilot工具”的协作范式与对应的策略优化方法（TIPO），属于较通用的tool-use与长地平线训练框架探索；对后训练阶段如何学会选择性调用工具、以及记忆/计算能力模块化有启发。
summary.technical_approach: UI-Copilot框架：主GUI agent负责操作执行；轻量copilot按需提供两类能力（Retriever用于记忆检索、Calculator用于数值计算）。关键设计包括memory decoupling（持久观测与瞬时执行上下文分离）以及Tool-Integrated Policy Optimization (TIPO)：将工具选择学习（单轮预测）与任务执行学习（on-policy多轮rollout）分开优化，以提升工具调用的可学性与稳定性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体benchmark名称/规模与量化结果细节，仅描述针对长地平线GUI场景的改进；缺少模型参数量、训练数据/轨迹规模、与强基线（如纯ReAct/纯toolformer式调用/现有GUI agent训练法）的明确对比幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Improving long-horizon MLLM-based GUI automation by mitigating memory degradation, progress confusion, and numerical/math hallucinations.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a collaborative agent+copilot tool-use paradigm and a dedicated policy-optimization recipe (TIPO). It is a fairly general contribution to tool invocation learning and long-horizon agent training, offering insights for post-training and modular capability design.
summary_en.technical_approach: UI-Copilot: a GUI policy agent executes actions while a lightweight copilot provides on-demand assistance as a Retriever (memory) or Calculator (numerics). Uses memory decoupling to separate persistent observations from transient execution context. Proposes Tool-Integrated Policy Optimization (TIPO): optimize tool selection via single-turn prediction and task execution via on-policy multi-turn rollouts.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete benchmark names, model/data scale, or numeric gains; it only claims improvements on long-horizon GUI scenarios. Strong-baseline comparisons are not specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 关注它如何把长地平线稳定性拆成“主策略+轻量工具copilot”并做策略优化；对后训练配方有用，但结论强度取决于任务/工具设定是否干净。
recommendation.en: Look at the decomposition into a main policy plus a lightweight tool-copilot with policy optimization; useful for post-training recipes, but strength depends on how clean the task/tool setup is.

paper.title: LiveClawBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Complex, Real-World Assistant Tasks

summary.core_problem: 现有Agent评测难以覆盖真实助手任务中的“组合式复杂度”，缺少更贴近部署场景的基准与复杂度刻画。
summary.importance: 重要benchmark/评测框架贡献：提出三轴复杂度框架并据此构建真实助手任务基准，有助于更可信地衡量Agent能力边界与失败模式（对训练数据合成、后训练目标设计也有间接启发）。
summary.technical_approach: 从真实OpenClaw使用案例抽象出Triple-Axis Complexity Framework（环境复杂度/认知需求/运行时适应性），并构建带复杂度因子标注的pilot benchmark，用于评测LLM Agent在现实助手任务中的综合能力。
summary.experiments: 提供pilot benchmark与复杂度标注；对多种LLM Agent在不同复杂度维度下的表现进行对比评测（具体模型与指标以论文为准）。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agent benchmarks under-represent compositional, real-world assistant difficulty; a more deployment-faithful benchmark and complexity taxonomy are needed.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark/framework contribution: introduces a three-axis complexity model and a pilot benchmark grounded in real OpenClaw use cases, enabling more realistic measurement of agent capability limits and failure modes (with indirect implications for training and post-training objectives).
summary_en.technical_approach: Derive a Triple-Axis Complexity Framework (environment complexity, cognitive demand, runtime adaptability) and build a pilot benchmark with explicit factor annotations to evaluate LLM agents on compositional real-world assistant tasks.
summary_en.experiments: Releases a pilot benchmark with complexity annotations and evaluates multiple LLM agents across the axes (exact models/metrics per paper).

recommendation.zh: 作为“真实助手任务”基准备查即可：只看复杂度三轴定义和失败案例汇总，能帮你更快定位 agent 评测的盲区。
recommendation.en: Useful as a reality-check benchmark reference: just read the complexity axes and the failure taxonomy to spot what your agent evals are missing.

paper.title: AgentSPEX: An Agent SPecification and EXecution Language

summary.core_problem: 如何用一种可维护、可复用、可控的方式来显式描述与执行 LLM Agent 的工作流（控制流、状态、并行、工具调用），避免“反应式 prompting”隐式流程带来的不可控与难维护。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏“系统/DSL 规范与工程框架”：把 agent workflow 从 Python 代码与 prompt 里解耦出来，提供显式控制流与状态管理，有助于提升可复现性、可验证性与工程可维护性；对通用 Agent 系统研究有参考价值，但对基座预训练方法论直接推动有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AgentSPEX：一个用于描述 agent 工作流的规格语言 + 可定制执行 harness。语言层面支持 typed steps、分支/循环、并行执行、可复用子模块、显式状态；执行层面提供工具访问、沙箱虚拟环境、checkpointing 与 verification 等能力（以论文摘要信息为准）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出清晰的标准 benchmark、对比对象与量化指标细节；更像框架/语言提案，效果评估与可复现性需要看正文是否包含真实任务上的对照实验（如 Web/Tool-use/代码修复等）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to specify and execute LLM-agent workflows with explicit control flow, state, and modularity, instead of relying on reactive prompting with implicit intermediate states that are hard to control and maintain.
summary_en.importance: Primarily a systems/DSL contribution: decouples agent workflow logic from Python and prompts, enabling explicit control flow and state management that can improve reproducibility, verifiability, and maintainability. Direct impact on foundation-model pretraining is limited.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces AgentSPEX, a specification language plus a customizable execution harness. The language supports typed steps, branching/loops, parallelism, reusable submodules, and explicit state; the harness provides tool access, a sandboxed environment, checkpointing, and verification (per abstract).
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide clear benchmark setups, baselines, or quantitative results; it reads more like a framework/DSL proposal, so the empirical validation needs to be checked in the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 偏工程 DSL，不细读：扫一眼语义/状态/并行与可复现性设计点，能借来规范内部 agent workflow，但不改预训练 prior。
recommendation.en: Mostly an engineering DSL: skim the semantics for state/parallelism and reproducibility hooks—good to standardize workflows, not a pretraining prior-shifter.

paper.title: WebXSkill: Skill Learning for Autonomous Web Agents

summary.core_problem: 解决 Web agent 长时程任务中“技能表示不落地/不可恢复”的问题：纯文本技能不可执行、纯代码技能不可解释，导致难以错误恢复与自适应。
summary.importance: 属于通用 Web agent 方法：提出“可执行程序 + 步级自然语言解释”的技能形态，并配套技能抽取/组织/部署流程；对 agent 记忆与可组合技能库有启发，但对基座预训练本身是间接相关。
summary.technical_approach: WebXSkill 三阶段：①从（合成的）agent 轨迹中挖掘可复用动作子序列并抽象为参数化 action program，同时为每步配套自然语言指导；②用基于 URL 的图结构索引技能以便情境检索；③部署时支持直接执行与 agent 基于步级语义进行改写/恢复（两种模式）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark 名称与量化结果细节；描述目标是提升长地平线网页任务成功率与可恢复性，并通过技能检索与可执行技能调用实现。

summary_en.core_problem: Address the grounding gap in long-horizon web agents: textual skills are not executable, while code skills are executable but opaque, hurting recovery and adaptation.
summary_en.importance: A method contribution for general web agents: an executable skill representation paired with step-level natural-language guidance, plus extraction/organization/deployment. Indirectly relevant to foundation pretraining via agent memory/compositionality.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three-stage WebXSkill: (1) mine reusable action subsequences from synthetic agent trajectories and abstract them into parameterized action programs with step-level NL guidance; (2) organize/index skills in a URL-based graph for context-aware retrieval; (3) deploy skills for direct execution and agent-driven adaptation/recovery.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify benchmarks or numeric gains; claims improvements on long-horizon web workflows via skill retrieval and executable skill invocation.

recommendation.zh: 值得知道“可执行程序+逐步解释”这类技能封装：只看技能抽取与恢复机制那节，能启发你做可调试的 web 任务记忆库。
recommendation.en: Worth noting the “executable program + stepwise rationale” skill packaging: read the extraction + recovery section to inform debuggable web-skill memory.

paper.title: Bridging Protocol and Production: Design Patterns for Deploying AI Agents with Model Context Protocol

summary.core_problem: MCP 只解决“能调用工具”，但缺少生产级“安全、可控、可恢复”运行所需的协议原语（身份传递、预算控制、错误语义），导致企业级 Agent 部署难以规模化与治理。
summary.importance: 属于面向生产落地的协议/系统设计总结：把 Agent 工具调用从 demo 级提升到可审计、可限流、可恢复的工程范式；对通用 Agent 系统与工具生态（MCP）有直接启发，但对基座预训练方法论影响间接。
summary.technical_approach: 提出三块补齐 MCP 的机制：(1) CABP：在 JSON-RPC 之上做“身份作用域”的请求路由与六阶段 broker pipeline，实现 identity propagation 与隔离；(2) ATBA：把串行工具调用建模为在异质延迟分布下的超时/预算自适应分配问题；(3) SERF：结构化错误语义与恢复框架（将工具错误类型化、可编排重试/降级/回滚）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出可核验的实验细节（具体任务集、对比基线、量化指标、消融与统计显著性均缺失）；更多是基于企业部署“field lessons”的设计模式归纳。

summary_en.core_problem: MCP standardizes tool invocation but lacks production-grade primitives (identity propagation, budgeting, structured error semantics), making large-scale safe and governable agent deployments difficult.
summary_en.importance: A protocol/system design write-up aimed at productionization: it upgrades tool-use agents from demo-level to auditable, budgeted, and recoverable operation. Highly relevant to agent infrastructure, but only indirectly informative for foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Adds three missing pieces: (1) CABP, a JSON-RPC extension with identity-scoped routing via a six-stage broker pipeline; (2) ATBA, adaptive timeout/budget allocation for sequential tool calls under heterogeneous latency distributions; (3) SERF, structured error semantics and recovery orchestration (typed failures, retry/degrade/rollback policies).
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide verifiable experimental details (datasets, baselines, metrics, ablations). It reads primarily as field-driven design patterns from an enterprise deployment.

recommendation.zh: 生产落地 checklist 价值大于研究增量：只看身份/预算/错误语义这些协议原语，能直接指导你把 MCP demo 变成可治理系统。
recommendation.en: More production checklist than research: focus on identity, budgeting, and error semantics—actionable primitives to turn MCP demos into governable systems.

paper.title: OccuBench: Evaluating AI Agents on Real-World Professional Tasks via Language World Models
paper.abstract: AI agents are expected to perform professional work across hundreds of occupational domains (from emergency department triage to nuclear reactor safety monitoring to customs import processing), yet existing benchmarks can only evaluate agents in the few domains where public environments exist. We introduce OccuBench, a benchmark covering 100 real-world professional task scenarios across 10 industry categories and 65 specialized domains, enabled by Language World Models (LWMs) that simulate domai

summary.core_problem: 现有 Agent benchmark 只覆盖少数有公共环境的领域，无法评测 Agent 在广泛专业职业场景的能力。
summary.importance: 用 LLM 驱动的 Language World Model 模拟工具响应，把 benchmark 可覆盖的职业数量从几个扩展到 100 个，是一种扩展 Agent 评测覆盖面的工程尝试。
summary.technical_approach: Language World Model (LWM) 作为环境模拟器生成工具响应；multi-agent 合成 pipeline 产出可解性、难度校准、文档锚定的评测实例；沿完成率和容错性两个维度评估。
summary.experiments: 100 个职业场景、10 大类、65 个专业领域，评测 15 个前沿模型；具体模型排名见正文。
summary.authors_note: 阿里/Qwen 团队相关人员参与（Dayiheng Liu, Fei Huang）。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agent benchmarks only cover the few professional domains with public environments, leaving most real-world occupational tasks unevaluated.
summary_en.importance: Uses LLM-driven Language World Models to simulate tool responses, dramatically expanding benchmark coverage; a scaling attempt for agent evaluation breadth rather than a methods contribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: LWMs simulate domain tool responses; a multi-agent synthesis pipeline generates solvable, difficulty-calibrated, document-grounded tasks; evaluation includes fault injection for environmental robustness.
summary_en.experiments: 100 scenarios across 10 categories and 65 domains; 15 frontier models evaluated on completion and robustness.
summary_en.authors_note: Includes Qwen-related authors (Dayiheng Liu, Fei Huang).

recommendation.zh: 用 LLM 模拟环境做 Agent benchmark 本身就有评测可信度问题——simulator 和被测模型能力相关会污染信号，作为 literature 备查，不必读正文。
recommendation.en: Benchmark validity is inherently suspect when the simulator is an LLM correlated with the models under test; keep as literature reference, skip the main text.

paper.title: AlphaEval: Evaluating Agents in Production

summary.core_problem: 现有Agent基准多为“回顾性整理”的任务（需求明确、指标确定、输入单一），与真实生产环境评估严重脱节：生产需求往往欠规格、隐含约束多、输入是跨来源的多模态文档、交付物长链路且质量由领域专家主观评判并随时间演化。论文要解决的是：如何把真实公司生产需求系统化地转化为可复现、可自动化的评测任务，并用统一框架衡量不同模型+脚手架（scaffold）在生产型Agent任务上的表现差异。
summary.importance: 对“预训练方法/数据/Scaling/Tokenizer”直接贡献不大，但对基座研究的间接价值在于：它提供了更贴近真实分布的评测信号，能暴露“模型能力提升≠生产可用性提升”的落差，并强调scaffold/产品形态对最终效果的影响幅度可与模型本身相当。这类基准可能反向影响预训练数据配比与后训练目标（例如更长交付物、更强文档理解/跨源整合、对隐含约束的遵循），但论文本身主要是评测与构建方法论。
summary.technical_approach:
AlphaEval包含两部分：
1) requirement-to-benchmark构建流水线：与企业合作获取真实需求，通过“合作对接—需求引导/澄清—任务形式化—迭代验证”四阶段，把模糊业务需求转成可执行、可复现的评测任务，并尽量保留生产复杂性（多源文档、多模态、长交付物、隐含约束）。
2) 统一评测框架：将任务评估拆成可组合的多种范式（参考答案校验、形式逻辑验证、rubric评分、基于执行的验证），并提供标准API与Docker沙箱执行；同时把LLM-as-a-Judge/Agent-as-a-Judge作为跨范式组件，用于更贴近专家主观标准的综合评判。
此外，论文强调“同一模型在不同agent产品/脚手架上差异巨大”，因此评测对象是model–scaffold configuration而非仅模型。
summary.experiments:
基准规模：94个生产任务，来自7家公司，覆盖6类O*NET职业域。
评测对象：6个前沿模型（Claude Opus 4.6、GPT-5.2、Gemini 3 Pro Preview、Kimi K2.5、GLM-5、MiniMax M2.5）通过4种商业agent产品（Claude Code、Codex、GitHub Copilot、Cursor）形成14种配置。
关键结果：
- 最佳配置（Claude Code + Opus 4.6）平均仅64.41/100，显示研究基准到生产的显著落差。
- scaffold影响可达11分：同为Opus 4.6，Claude Code为64.41，而Codex为53.45。
- 领域差异大：Technology Research约62.0，而Human Resources约30.0，说明单一总分难以代表生产就绪度。
（更多错误分析与“分数到经济价值”的映射在正文后半部分；若关注基座训练启示，建议重点看失败类型分布。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约40–60分钟）：
- 先读Introduction与他们对production evaluation三大结构性差异的定义（欠规格、主观评判、持续演化）。
- 再看方法部分的四阶段构建流程与任务评估范式分类图（taxonomy），理解其“可复用构建框架”而非仅一个静态榜单。
- 实验部分重点看：model vs scaffold的对比、按职业域拆分的雷达/柱状图、以及错误分析章节。
如果你的目标是预训练研究：把它当作“更真实的能力需求清单”，提炼哪些失败模式可能需要通过数据配比/合成数据/后训练目标来补齐。

summary_en.core_problem: Agent benchmarks are typically retrospective and well-specified, with deterministic metrics and clean inputs—unlike production, where requirements are underspecified with implicit constraints, inputs are heterogeneous (often multi-modal) and fragmented across sources, deliverables are long-horizon professional artifacts, and success is judged subjectively by evolving domain-expert standards. The paper addresses how to turn authentic production requirements into reproducible, automated evaluation tasks, and how to evaluate real model+scaffold agent configurations under production-like conditions.
summary_en.importance: Limited direct impact on pretraining/scaling/tokenizers, but it provides a more realistic evaluation signal that can reveal gaps masked by research benchmarks. Two takeaways relevant to foundation-model research: (1) “model improvements” may not translate to “production readiness” under ambiguous constraints and long deliverables; (2) scaffolding/product integration can shift scores as much as changing the base model, complicating how we interpret capability gains. Over time, such benchmarks can influence data/target design (document understanding, cross-source synthesis, constraint following), though this work is primarily about evaluation methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach:
AlphaEval contributes:
- A requirement-to-benchmark construction pipeline (partner engagement → requirement elicitation → task formalization → iterative validation) designed to preserve production complexity while making tasks automated and reproducible.
- A unified evaluation framework that composes multiple paradigms—reference verification, formal logic verification, rubric-based scoring, and execution-based verification—exposed via a standardized API with Docker sandboxing.
- LLM-as-a-Judge / Agent-as-a-Judge are treated as cross-cutting components to approximate domain-expert, multi-criteria judgments.
Crucially, the unit of evaluation is a model–scaffold configuration, reflecting that agent products/scaffolds materially affect outcomes.
summary_en.experiments:
Benchmark: 94 production-grounded tasks from 7 companies across 6 O*NET occupational domains.
Evaluated: 6 frontier models (Claude Opus 4.6, GPT-5.2, Gemini 3 Pro Preview, Kimi K2.5, GLM-5, MiniMax M2.5) deployed through 4 commercial agent products (Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor), totaling 14 configurations.
Findings:
- Best setup (Claude Code + Opus 4.6) reaches only 64.41/100 on average.
- Scaffold matters ~as much as the model: Opus 4.6 scores 64.41 via Claude Code vs 53.45 via Codex (~11-point gap).
- Large domain variance: e.g., ~62.0 in Technology Research vs ~30.0 in Human Resources, suggesting aggregate scores hide readiness differences.
(The paper also includes error analysis and a score-to-economic-value framing; consult those sections for actionable failure modes.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (40–60 minutes):
- Read the Introduction for the three structural mismatches between benchmarks and production (underspecification, subjective judgment, continuous evolution).
- Review the construction pipeline and the evaluation-paradigm taxonomy figure to understand the reusable framework.
- In results, focus on model-vs-scaffold comparisons, per-domain breakdowns, and the error analysis.
If your goal is pretraining research, treat the benchmark as a “capability demand map” and extract recurring failure patterns that might motivate data mixture changes or post-training objectives.

recommendation.zh: 当作生产分布评测方法论读：只看任务构建与scaffold影响那部分，结论是“模型变强≠上线变好”，但对预训练改法不给硬证据。
recommendation.en: Read it as a production-distribution eval methodology: skim task construction and scaffold-effect analysis—strong reminder that better models don’t guarantee better prod outcomes, but it offers little direct pretrain guidance.

paper.title: Towards Long-horizon Agentic Multimodal Search

summary.core_problem: 长时程（long-horizon）多模态 deep search 代理在迭代浏览/检索过程中会累积大量异构证据（文本+图像等），直接把视觉内容塞进上下文会导致 token 成本爆炸与噪声累积；而简单丢弃/摘要视觉又会丢关键信号。论文要解决的是：在不牺牲可回溯视觉证据的前提下，如何让多模态搜索代理在 50-100+ turn 的长轨迹中稳定管理与调用视觉信息，并保持可扩展的推理与工具使用能力。
summary.importance: 对“预训练/持续学习”本身不是直接贡献（更偏 agent 框架与后训练数据/工具接口），但对基座模型研究有两点启发：1）把多模态上下文管理从“压缩输入”转为“外部化记忆+按需取回”，为长上下文/记忆机制提供了工程可行的替代路径；2）给出了面向长时程多模态工具使用的轨迹蒸馏与数据合成范式（构造跨模态 multi-hop 查询、收集 teacher 轨迹再微调），可作为后训练数据科学的参考。整体贡献量级：在开放模型的多模态搜索基准上做出明显 SOTA，并展示可扩展到 100 turns 的稳定增益，但其核心创新主要在系统与表示/接口层，而非预训练目标或架构层。
summary.technical_approach:
核心是“文件化视觉表示（file-based visual representation）+ 轻量 UID 代理 + 按需 fetch”的上下文管理机制，目标是解耦 perception（重）与 reasoning/planning（轻）。做法：
1）外部文件系统存储视觉资产：搜索/浏览过程中遇到的图片等不直接进入模型上下文，而是落盘到外部文件系统。
2）UID 文本代理：每个视觉资产映射到唯一文本标识符（UID），上下文中只保留 UID（以及可选的轻量语义，如缩略图/摘要语义），从而把“视觉证据的持久性”从上下文 token 中剥离出去。
3）工具接口重设计：在传统多模态搜索工具之上，增加/改造工具以支持“按需取回与主动感知”，文中明确提出 fetch-image 工具用于在需要细粒度理解时再加载特定视觉内容。
4）渐进式工作流（progressive multimodal search workflow）：先用轻量上下文进行规划与证据管理；当推理链条需要视觉细节时，通过 UID 定位并调用 fetch-image 取回对应图像进行局部理解，再把结论以文本形式回写到上下文。
5）训练数据：提出数据合成管线，构造需要复杂 cross-modal multi-hop 推理的查询；结合开源 deep search queries，用强 teacher 采集高质量轨迹并蒸馏，最终微调 Qwen3-VL-Thinking-30A3B 得到专用代理（文中称 distill 12K trajectories）。
与已有方法差异：不是做“多模态上下文摘要/压缩”，也不是简单丢弃中间图像，而是把视觉证据当作可寻址的外部对象（类似 planning-with-files 思路），上下文只保留可操作的引用与必要语义，从机制上避免 context explosion。
summary.experiments:
论文在四个多模态搜索基准上评测（文中点名 MM-BrowseComp/MMBC 与 MMSearch-Plus 等）。关键数字（来自全文引言给出的结果）：
- 在长时程基准上：MMBC 成功率 22.3，MMSearch-Plus 成功率 32.9。
- 引入该上下文管理策略后可扩展到 100 turns：MMBC 30.1，MMSearch-Plus 34.8（强调在开放模型中 SOTA）。
- 框架可迁移到其他基座：在 Seed-1.8 上，MMSearch-Plus 达到 46.7，显示一定通用性。
- 训练侧：蒸馏/微调对象为 Qwen3-VL-Thinking-30A3B，轨迹规模 12K。
就“预训练研究者关心的实验洞察”而言，论文更像系统/数据驱动：核心证据是长 turn 可扩展性与跨基座泛化；但引言未给出更细的消融数字（例如 UID 语义补充、fetch-image 频率、不同存储/检索策略的对比），若正文有消融应重点核对其对 100-turn 稳定性的贡献来源。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30-45 分钟）：
1）优先看“Long-horizon Multimodal Context Management”章节：理解 UID 代理、外部文件存储、以及如何在对话上下文中记录/引用视觉证据（这是全文最核心的可复用思想）。
2）看工具接口与工作流设计部分：fetch-image 的触发条件、返回格式、以及如何把视觉理解结果回写为可持续推理的文本证据。
3）看数据合成与轨迹蒸馏部分：他们如何构造 cross-modal multi-hop 查询、如何统计“需要更多 tool turns/更高 vision tool 占比”，以及 teacher 轨迹的过滤标准（这对后训练数据科学更有价值）。
4）实验部分重点关注：100-turn 设置的评测协议（是否限制工具预算/上下文长度/失败判定）、与 prior framework（文中提到 RedSearcher）在同一 base model 下的对比是否公平，以及成功率提升主要来自“记忆机制”还是“专门微调数据”。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-horizon multimodal deep-search agents accumulate heterogeneous evidence (text plus images) across many browsing/search turns. Naively injecting visual content into the LLM context causes token blow-up and compounding noise, while dropping or aggressively summarizing images loses critical signals. The paper targets a practical but fundamental question: how to persist, track, and selectively revisit visual evidence over 50–100+ tool-use turns without exploding context length, while keeping reasoning and planning stable.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper; it is primarily an agent framework plus post-training data/trajectory distillation. Still, it matters to foundation-model researchers in two ways: (1) it operationalizes an “externalized memory” pattern for multimodal evidence—store heavy perception artifacts outside the context and keep only lightweight references—offering an alternative to long-context scaling and multimodal summarization; (2) it provides a recipe for synthesizing long-horizon cross-modal multi-hop queries and distilling teacher trajectories into a specialized agent, which is directly relevant to data-centric post-training for tool-using models. The contribution is sizable at the system level (open-source SOTA on long-horizon multimodal search and demonstrated scaling to 100 turns), but it does not introduce new pretraining objectives or architectures.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core design is a file-based visual representation with UID proxies and on-demand retrieval, aiming to decouple heavy perception from lightweight planning:
1) Externalize visual assets: images encountered during web browsing/search are saved to an external file system rather than embedded in the prompt.
2) UID-based textual proxies: each visual asset is mapped to a unique textual identifier (UID). The running context retains UIDs (optionally augmented with lightweight semantics such as thumbnail-derived cues), enabling long-horizon bookkeeping at minimal token cost.
3) Tool interface redesign: the agent is equipped with tools that support selective loading of visual content; the paper highlights a dedicated fetch-image tool for active perception when fine-grained understanding is needed.
4) Progressive workflow: plan and accumulate evidence using the lightweight context; only when a reasoning step requires visual detail does the agent resolve a UID via fetch-image, interpret the image, and write back textual conclusions.
5) Training pipeline: a synthesis pipeline creates cross-modal multi-hop queries; combined with existing deep-search queries, a strong teacher generates trajectories that are filtered/distilled (12K trajectories) to fine-tune Qwen3-VL-Thinking-30A3B into a specialized agent.
Key distinction from prior context management: it is neither pure summarization nor heuristic discarding; it treats visual evidence as addressable external objects with explicit references in the prompt, preventing context explosion by construction.
summary_en.experiments:
Reported headline results (from the paper’s main text excerpt):
- On long-horizon benchmarks: 22.3 success rate on MM-BrowseComp (MMBC) and 32.9 on MMSearch-Plus.
- With the proposed context management, the agent scales to 100 turns and reaches 30.1 (MMBC) and 34.8 (MMSearch-Plus), claimed as SOTA among open-source models.
- Generalization to other base models: applying the framework to Seed-1.8 yields 46.7 on MMSearch-Plus.
- Training specifics: fine-tunes Qwen3-VL-Thinking-30A3B using 12K distilled high-quality trajectories.
For deeper takeaways, the most important experimental details to verify in the full paper are the 100-turn evaluation protocol (tool budgets, failure criteria, context limits) and ablations separating gains from (a) the file/UID memory mechanism vs (b) the specialized distilled training data.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
1) Read the “Long-horizon Multimodal Context Management” section first—this is the reusable core (UID schema, what stays in-context vs offloaded, and how references are maintained).
2) Inspect the tool/interface design and the progressive workflow, especially how fetch-image is triggered and how visual findings are converted into durable textual evidence.
3) Skim the data synthesis + teacher-trajectory distillation pipeline for practical details (query construction, filtering, statistics on tool-turn distribution).
4) In experiments, focus on the 100-turn setting and the controlled comparisons against prior frameworks (e.g., RedSearcher) on the same base model to assess whether improvements come from memory design, training data, or both.

recommendation.zh: 主要看外部化多模态记忆与轨迹蒸馏数据合成流程；它解决的是长轨迹工程可扩展性而非新预训练目标，适合抄作后训练管线。
