recommendation.en: Look at the externalized multimodal memory design and the trajectory-distillation data pipeline; it’s about long-horizon engineering scalability, not new pretraining objectives—good to copy into post-training stacks.

paper.title: Long-Horizon Plan Execution in Large Tool Spaces through Entropy-Guided Branching

summary.core_problem: 在超大工具库与长时序任务中，如何对tool-augmented agent进行可扩展的计划级评测，并在巨大动作空间下高效执行多步计划。
summary.importance: 贡献了一个面向“大工具空间+上下文API调用”的合成评测基准SLATE，并提出用不确定性驱动的分支搜索以提升长链路执行效率；对通用Tool-use/Planning评测与搜索策略有一定启发，但更偏agent评测与搜索工程。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SLATE（电商场景的Synthetic Large-scale API Toolkit），允许多种功能等价的执行轨迹以避免静态指标误判；提出Entropy-Guided Branching(EGB)搜索：用模型预测分布熵作为不确定性信号，动态扩展高熵决策点的分支以控制搜索开销并提升自纠错与探索效率。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出关键规模细节（工具数量、任务数、使用的具体LLM与提升幅度等）；报告现有agent在自我纠错与搜索效率上表现不佳，并用EGB在SLATE上验证改进（具体数值需看正文）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate tool-augmented agents at the plan level and execute long-horizon tasks efficiently when the tool library (action space) is massive.
summary_en.importance: Introduces SLATE, a synthetic large-scale benchmark for context-aware API/tool use, and proposes an uncertainty-driven branching strategy to improve long-horizon execution. Useful mainly for agent evaluation/search rather than foundation pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: SLATE supports multiple functionally valid trajectories to avoid overly rigid metrics. Entropy-Guided Branching (EGB) uses predictive entropy as an uncertainty signal to selectively expand branches at uncertain decision points, aiming to improve exploration, self-correction, and search efficiency.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify key experimental scales (tool/task counts, exact LLMs, or gains). It claims current agents struggle with self-correction/search efficiency and that EGB improves performance on SLATE (details in the paper).

recommendation.zh: 更像评测+搜索工程：SLATE可当大工具空间的压测基准备查，熵引导分支是合理heuristic但不改prior；看基准定义和一张主结果表。
recommendation.en: Mostly benchmark + search engineering: SLATE is a handy stress test for huge tool spaces, entropy-branching is a reasonable heuristic but not paradigm-shifting; read benchmark spec and the main results table.

paper.title: Policy-Invisible Violations in LLM-Based Agents

summary.core_problem: LLM agent在可见上下文缺失关键合规信息时，如何避免做出“表面合理但违反组织政策”的动作（policy-invisible violations）。
summary.importance: 提出了一个贴近真实企业合规风险的失败模式与对应benchmark（PhantomPolicy），强调仅靠上下文内信息与表面语义一致性不足以保证合规；对agent安全评测与“世界状态/会话历史”约束的系统设计有启发，但对预训练本体关联中等。
summary.technical_approach: 定义policy-invisible violations：合规判断依赖实体属性/上下文状态/会话历史但在决策时不可见；构建PhantomPolicy基准（8类违规），工具返回仅含“干净业务数据”不含政策元数据；采用trace-level人工复核标注来评估模型行为，并提出在“有利条件下”的world-state-grounded enforcement作为上限对照（摘要未完整给出方法细节）。
summary.experiments: PhantomPolicy包含8类违规、平衡的违规/安全对照；对5个frontier模型生成的600条trace进行人工复核；人工复核相对原case级标注修正32条（5.3%），显示需要轨迹级评审（摘要未给出各模型违规率与改进幅度）。

summary_en.core_problem: Preventing LLM agents from taking actions that appear valid and user-approved yet violate organizational policies when critical compliance facts are not visible in the agent’s context (policy-invisible violations).
summary_en.importance: Introduces a realistic enterprise-risk failure mode and the PhantomPolicy benchmark, highlighting that semantic plausibility and limited context are insufficient for compliance. Useful for agent safety evaluation and system designs grounded in world state/session history, with moderate relevance to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Defines policy-invisible violations where compliance depends on hidden entity attributes, contextual state, or session history. Builds PhantomPolicy with 8 violation categories and tool responses containing clean business data without policy metadata. Uses trace-level human review and proposes a world-state-grounded enforcement setup as an upper-bound reference (details not fully in the abstract).
summary_en.experiments: PhantomPolicy: 8 categories, balanced violation vs. safe controls. 600 traces across 5 frontier models manually reviewed; 32 labels (5.3%) changed vs. original case-level annotations, motivating trace-level evaluation. No per-model violation rates reported in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 把“缺上下文仍会违规”的失败模式钉得很实，提醒你评测别只看in-context合规；作为安全评测补丁，扫PhantomPolicy任务设定与案例即可。
recommendation.en: Pins down ‘policy-invisible’ violations—useful reminder that in-context compliance isn’t enough; as a safety-eval patch, skim the PhantomPolicy setup and a few representative cases.

paper.title: TInR: Exploring Tool-Internalized Reasoning in Large Language Models

summary.core_problem: 现有 Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) 依赖在推理时把工具文档塞进上下文：导致工具掌握困难（文档异构）、工具规模受限（context window 不够）、推理/调用低效（prompt 过长）。论文提出 Tool-Internalized Reasoning (TInR)：让模型在不提供外部文档的情况下完成带工具的推理与调用。
summary.importance: 如果工具知识能被“内化”到模型参数中，推理时无需携带冗长文档，可显著降低延迟与成本，并支持更大规模工具集合；同时减少检索-使用错配风险，使面向真实应用的工具调用更稳定。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 TInR-U：统一推理与工具使用的工具内化框架，三阶段训练管线：1) 工具内化（Tool internalization）：用“专用工具 token”承载每个工具，并用双向知识对齐让模型既能从文档映射到工具 token，也能从 token 反向回忆文档内容；同时加入工具使用训练以学习参数约束、调用格式等规则。2) TInR SFT warm-up：通过拒绝采样与格式化构造高可靠标注推理数据，对模型进行监督微调，使其学会在无外部文档条件下进行工具选择与调用编排。3) TInR RL：设计针对工具 token 的奖励，强化探索性工具推理与“推理-调用”协同，从而更深度融合工具使用能力与模型固有推理能力。整体交互形式为：每步先生成自然语言推理 r_j，必要时生成工具动作 a_j（选择工具 t 与参数 p），执行得到 o_j 并进入下一步。
summary.experiments: 在 in-domain 与 out-of-domain 两类设置评测 TInR 能力；论文报告在 out-of-domain 工具调用上相对提升 18.13%，并在两类设置均达到 SOTA。建议在实验部分重点核对：工具集合规模 N、是否与 TIR（带文档）在同等推理预算/上下文长度下对比、成功率/格式正确率/参数合法率等指标，以及 RL 奖励设计与消融（仅内化/仅 SFT/仅 RL）。
summary.reading_guide: skim（泛读）建议：1) Introduction + Figure 1：理解 TIR vs TInR 的差异与三大痛点；2) Methodology 总览：三阶段训练流程与“工具 token”机制；3) 实验主表：看 in/out-of-domain 的总体收益。must_read（精读）建议：1) 工具内化的双向对齐细节：token 设计、对齐目标、如何处理异构文档与规则（参数约束/调用格式）；2) SFT 数据构造：拒绝采样标准、格式模板、如何保证轨迹可靠且贴近 TInR；3) RL：奖励在工具 token 上如何定义（正确工具选择、参数合法、调用时机、最终任务成功等）、训练稳定性与探索策略；4) OOD 设定：新工具/新组合/新任务的划分方式，避免数据泄漏；5) 失败案例分析：工具幻觉、参数越界、过度/不足调用等。
summary.authors_note: 作者强调把“工具知识”从上下文外置（文档提示）转为参数内化（工具 token + 对齐训练），以解决可扩展性与效率问题；并通过 SFT+RL 让模型学会在推理过程中自然地触发与编排工具调用，从而实现无需文档的统一推理与工具使用。

summary_en.core_problem: Most Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) methods require tool documentation in-context during inference, which makes tool mastery hard (heterogeneous docs), limits tool-set size (context window), and increases latency/cost (long prompts). The paper studies Tool-Internalized Reasoning (TInR): enabling tool use without external documentation at inference time.
summary_en.importance: Internalizing tool knowledge into model parameters can reduce inference overhead, scale to larger tool sets, and avoid retrieval–usage mismatch, improving reliability for real-world tool-using agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: TInR-U is a unified framework for reasoning and tool usage with a three-phase training pipeline: (1) Tool internalization: assign dedicated tool tokens and perform bidirectional knowledge alignment—map documentation to tool tokens and reconstruct documentation from tokens—plus tool-usage training to learn strict calling rules (formats, parameter constraints). (2) TInR SFT warm-up: build reliable annotated reasoning trajectories via rejection sampling and formatting, then supervised fine-tune to use internalized tool knowledge during reasoning. (3) TInR RL: reinforcement learning with rewards designed on tool tokens to encourage exploratory tool reasoning and tighter coordination between reasoning and tool calls. The interaction alternates natural-language reasoning steps r_j and tool actions a_j (tool t with parameters p), consuming tool outputs o_j in subsequent steps.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated in both in-domain and out-of-domain settings; the paper reports state-of-the-art results and a relative 18.13% improvement on out-of-domain tool calling. Readers should verify tool-set size, fairness of comparisons against TIR (with docs) under matched context/budget, metrics such as success rate/format correctness/parameter validity, and ablations for internalization vs SFT vs RL and reward design.
summary_en.reading_guide: skim: (1) Introduction + Figure 1 for TIR vs TInR framing; (2) Methodology overview for the three-stage pipeline and tool-token mechanism; (3) main results tables for in-/out-of-domain gains. must_read: (1) bidirectional alignment details (token design, objectives, handling heterogeneous docs and strict rules); (2) SFT data construction (rejection criteria, templates, reliability controls); (3) RL reward definition on tool tokens (tool choice, parameter legality, timing, final success) and training stability; (4) OOD protocol (new tools/tasks/compositions) and leakage checks; (5) failure analysis (tool hallucination, invalid params, over/under-calling).
summary_en.authors_note: The authors’ key idea is to move tool knowledge from external prompts into model parameters via dedicated tool tokens and alignment training, then use SFT+RL to make tool usage naturally coordinated with reasoning—achieving documentation-free tool reasoning at inference.

recommendation.zh: 只看工具规模扩展与去文档上下文的对比：若内化后仍能稳调用，动作项是把你们的工具说明从prompt迁到参数；否则就是记忆化噱头。
recommendation.en: Skim the scaling-to-many-tools and no-doc-context comparisons: if tool calls stay reliable, the action is moving tool specs from prompts into weights; otherwise it’s mostly memorization theater.

paper.title: Controllable and Verifiable Tool-Use Data Synthesis for Agentic Reinforcement Learning

summary.core_problem: 现有合成工具调用数据多为离线 SFT 设计：样本是静态的“用户问题-工具调用-工具输出-答案”，缺少可执行环境与可验证奖励，难以直接用于在线 RL（尤其是需要可自动打分的 RLVR）。同时真实世界工具使用需要应对歧义提问、干扰工具、噪声/多格式/错误输出、工具失败等鲁棒性场景，而现有数据覆盖不足且难以规模化获取真实日志。
summary.importance: 该工作把“合成数据”从静态监督推进到“RL-ready 的可控可验环境”，使得工具使用的鲁棒性能力可以通过在线 rollouts 与可计算奖励进行强化学习优化；同时提供可控扰动族，便于系统性 stress-test 与定向补齐能力短板。
summary.technical_approach:
COVERT 是两阶段的 RL-ready 工具使用数据/环境合成管线。
Stage I：自进化合成 + 多级验证，生成可靠的基础轨迹/实例 (s,u,𝒯,c*,o*,a*)：工具简单、查询明确、输出直接，确保 oracle 工具调用 c* 与 oracle 输出/答案可信。
Stage II：oracle-preserving 增强（augmentation）把“环境复杂度”系统性提高，但严格保留用于奖励计算的 oracle 元数据。增强作用于系统提示 s、用户查询 u、工具集合 𝒯、以及工具输出 o*，引入：
- 干扰工具（distractor tools）：增加无关/相似工具，考验工具选择；
- 间接/歧义查询（indirect/ambiguous queries）：考验意图解析与澄清；
- 多格式/噪声输出（multi-format/noisy outputs）：考验解析鲁棒性；
- 错误工具输出/失败（erroneous outputs）：考验失败检测与纠错策略；
并按可验证性分两类奖励：
1) 精确可验（exact-verifiable）：保留 c* 与 a*，用 reference matching 自动算奖；
2) 需裁判辅助（judge-assisted）：保留 c* 但最终响应可能不同于 a*（如需要指出错误/请求澄清），用轻量 LLM judge 结合能力标签 k 与 oracle 元数据评估。
定位上，COVERT 不是替代 SFT，而是作为 SFT 之后的 RL 精炼阶段，专注鲁棒性。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen2.5-Instruct-14B 上，COVERT-RL 将 BFCL v3 从 56.5 提升到 59.9，将 ACEBench 从 53.0 提升到 59.3；并在 LiveCodeBench、AIME、Math500、MMLU-Pro 等通用能力基准上基本保持不退化。与 TOUCAN-SFT 叠加后进一步到 BFCL 62.1、ACEBench 61.8，表明 SFT 与 RL 增益互补。实验核心验证点是：oracle-preserving 增强既能制造“更难更脏”的交互，又不破坏可计算奖励，从而可规模化 RL。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读）：
- Pipeline 定义段（实例元组 (s,u,𝒯,c*,o*,a*) 与两阶段目标）：理解他们如何把“数据”提升为“可执行 mock 环境”。
- Stage II 增强族的分类与 oracle-preserving 约束：逐类看清改了哪些环境组件、保留哪些 oracle 字段、为何仍可自动算奖。
- 奖励计算机制：exact-verifiable 的 reference matching 规则，以及 judge-assisted 的触发条件/判别依据（这决定 RLVR 的可扩展性与噪声上限）。
- 结果与消融（若全文包含）：重点看不同增强族对鲁棒性指标的贡献，以及对通用能力回归的控制。
skim（泛读）：
- Introduction（动机：SFT 数据不适配 RL；真实鲁棒性缺口）+ Contributions。
- 方法总览图/表（两阶段 + 增强族清单）。
- 主结果表（BFCL/ACEBench 提升 + 通用能力保持）。
summary.authors_note: 作者强调“可控扰动 + oracle 保真”是把合成工具数据用于 RL 的关键：既要让环境更接近真实噪声与失败模式，又必须保留可验证的 ground truth 以支持自动奖励；在无法精确匹配的行为上，用轻量 judge 作为折中以保持规模化。整体思路是把数据合成从‘写答案’转为‘造环境’。

summary_en.core_problem: Most synthetic tool-use corpora are built for offline SFT as static (query, tool call, tool output, answer) pairs, lacking executable environments and reward-checkable online rollouts required by RL/RLVR. Meanwhile, real-world tool use demands robustness to ambiguity, distractor tools, noisy/multi-format/erroneous outputs, and tool failures—coverage that is hard to obtain from real logs and underrepresented in existing datasets.
summary_en.importance: COVERT reframes synthetic data into RL-ready, controllable, and verifiable mock environments, enabling scalable online RL with automatically computable rewards while systematically stress-testing robustness capabilities. This provides a practical path to robust tool-use refinement beyond SFT.
summary_en.technical_approach:
COVERT is a two-stage pipeline for RL-ready tool-use environment synthesis.
Stage I: self-evolving synthesis with multi-level validation to produce reliable base instances (s,u,𝒯,c*,o*,a*) with simple tools, unambiguous queries, and trustworthy oracle metadata.
Stage II: oracle-preserving augmentations that increase environment complexity while preserving oracle fields needed for reward computation. Augmentations modify system prompts, user queries, tool sets, and tool outputs to introduce distractor tools, indirect/ambiguous queries, noisy or multi-format outputs, and erroneous/failing tool responses.
Rewards are computed in two modes:
- Exact-verifiable: preserve c* and a*; use reference matching for deterministic rewards.
- Judge-assisted: preserve c* but the expected final response may differ (e.g., error detection or clarification); use a lightweight LLM judge conditioned on capability label k and oracle metadata.
COVERT is positioned as an RL refinement stage complementary to SFT, focusing on robustness rather than long-horizon planning.
summary_en.experiments: On Qwen2.5-Instruct-14B, COVERT-RL improves BFCL v3 from 56.5 to 59.9 and ACEBench from 53.0 to 59.3, with minimal regressions on general benchmarks (LiveCodeBench, AIME, Math500, MMLU-Pro). Stacked on TOUCAN-SFT, it further reaches 62.1 (BFCL) and 61.8 (ACEBench), indicating complementary gains from SFT and RL. The key empirical claim is that oracle-preserving perturbations yield harder, more realistic interactions without breaking scalable reward computation.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep dive):
- Formal problem/pipeline definition: the instance tuple (s,u,𝒯,c*,o*,a*) and how it becomes an executable mock environment.
- Stage II augmentation families + oracle-preserving constraints: for each perturbation, what changes and what oracle metadata is preserved.
- Reward computation: reference matching rules for exact-verifiable cases and when/how judge-assisted evaluation is used.
- Results/ablations (if present in full text): which augmentation families drive robustness gains and how general-ability regressions are controlled.
skim (high level):
- Introduction + Contributions.
- Method overview figure/table (two stages and augmentation list).
- Main results tables (BFCL/ACEBench gains + general benchmark preservation).
summary_en.authors_note: The paper’s thesis is that scalable RL for tool use requires environments that are both controllably harder and still verifiable. ‘Oracle-preserving’ perturbations keep ground truth intact for automatic rewards, while a lightweight judge covers behaviors that cannot be reference-matched. Conceptually, it shifts synthesis from ‘writing trajectories’ to ‘constructing reward-checkable environments’.

recommendation.zh: 把“工具合成数据”做成可执行、可打分的RL环境这点很实用；只需看扰动族设计与reward可验证性，判断能否直接接入你们的rollout管线。
recommendation.en: Useful mainly because it turns synthetic tool-use into an executable, auto-gradable RL environment; skim the perturbation families + reward verifiability to see if it plugs into your rollout stack.

paper.title: Do LLMs Know Tool Irrelevance? Demystifying Structural Alignment Bias in Tool Invocations

summary.core_problem: 论文研究“工具无关（irrelevance）”场景下的一个系统性失败模式：当工具在语义上无法实现用户目标（semantic irrelevance）时，LLM 仍会因为“查询属性能一一映射到工具参数”（structural alignment）而倾向调用工具。作者将这种“用结构匹配替代语义核验”的机制性捷径形式化为 Structural Alignment Bias（SAB）。
summary.importance: 在真实工具生态里，不同服务常共享相似/统一的接口（参数名、字段类型、槽位结构），这使得“结构可对齐但语义无关”的情况非常常见。错误调用不仅带来延迟与误导，更可能在金融转账、数据库写入等高风险场景造成不可逆损失。论文指出以往评测对该类错误覆盖不足，导致我们高估了模型的“拒用无关工具”能力。
summary.technical_approach:
（1）概念与形式化：将工具函数ft与用户目标gq不一致定义为语义无关（ft ≢ gq），并将“查询中的属性可被有效赋值给工具参数集合Pt”的可映射性定义为结构对齐；SAB 即模型在决策时过度依赖结构对齐信号。
（2）数据集 SABEval：核心设计是“解耦结构对齐与语义相关”，构造更贴近现实的样本（强调不同服务共享统一接口，而非刻意的合成角落案例），从而系统测量在不同对齐程度下的误调用。
（3）因果验证：通过反事实分析（counterfactual）改变结构对齐因素，检验结构对齐对错误调用的因果贡献。
（4）机制解释：提出 Contrastive Attention Attribution（CAA）解释方法，在不要求反事实样本严格 token 对齐的前提下追踪信息流；作者发现模型内部存在两条“竞争路径”：一条负责语义核验（semantic checking），一条负责结构匹配（structural matching），最终是否调用由两条路径相对强度主导。
（5）缓解策略：基于上述竞争机制，提出“重新平衡两条路径”的精确干预方法，以降低结构匹配路径对决策的支配性，同时尽量保持一般工具使用能力。
summary.experiments: 作者在 5 个常用 tool-augmented LLM 上做系统实验。关键现象是：在以往研究常用的“结构不对齐”无关工具样本上，误调用率几乎可忽略（<0.2%）；但在 SABEval 的“结构对齐但语义无关”设置下，误调用率跃升到 41.9%，且随着对齐程度提高可进一步升至 90.4%。反事实分析进一步支持“结构对齐→错误调用”的强因果关系。缓解方法在多模型多工具上实现显著改进，报告约 80% 相对错误率下降，同时保持通用工具调用能力。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读）：
- 重点读 Introduction：把握 SAB 的直观例子（Fig.1）与“结构对齐/语义无关”的定义边界。
- 重点读 Problem Formulation：看作者如何形式化 structural alignment（参数集合、可赋值映射）以及与 irrelevance setting 的关系。
- 重点读 SABEval 构建与“alignment degree”分层：这是论文贡献的核心，决定了为何以往评测会“低估错误”。
- 重点读实验主结果表/图：关注误调用率从 <0.2%→41.9%→90.4% 的条件与控制变量。
- 重点读 counterfactual/causal 分析章节：确认“相关性”如何被提升为“因果性”。
- 重点读 CAA 方法与可视化：理解两条竞争路径（semantic checking vs structural matching）如何被识别，以及它们如何影响最终 tool-call。
- 重点读 mitigation 方案与消融：验证“重平衡路径”是否以牺牲正常工具能力为代价。

skim（泛读）：
- 读 Introduction + 贡献点列表：快速建立问题与结论。
- 读 SABEval 概述与主结果：抓住“结构对齐导致误调用暴涨”的核心证据。
- 读 mitigation 的总体思路与最终指标：确认是否能在不伤害通用能力的情况下减少误调用。
- 解释性方法（CAA）可只读方法直觉+关键图，不必逐行推导。
summary.authors_note: 作者的核心主张是：工具拒用失败并非单纯“没学会语义”，而是存在可被数据集与解释方法揭示的机制性捷径（结构匹配优先）。因此，评测应显式控制/分解结构因素；改进也应针对内部竞争通路做定点干预，而不是仅靠更大模型或泛化式指令微调。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a systematic failure in the tool-irrelevance setting: even when a tool is semantically incapable of achieving the user goal (semantic irrelevance), LLMs still tend to invoke it whenever query attributes can be cleanly mapped to the tool’s parameters (structural alignment). The authors formalize this shortcut behavior as Structural Alignment Bias (SAB): models prioritize structural match over semantic verification when deciding tool calls.
summary_en.importance: Real tool ecosystems often standardize interfaces across services, making “structurally alignable yet semantically irrelevant” situations common. Erroneous tool calls add latency and misleading outputs, and can be catastrophic in high-stakes domains (financial transactions, database operations). The paper argues prior evaluations under-cover this regime, leading to overestimation of LLMs’ ability to refuse irrelevant tools.
summary_en.technical_approach:
(1) Formalization: define semantic irrelevance as ft ≢ gq (tool function vs user goal mismatch), and structural alignment as the existence of a valid attribute-to-parameter assignment from the query to the tool parameter set.
(2) SABEval dataset: explicitly decouples structural alignment from semantic relevance, mirroring realistic cases where distinct services share unified interfaces, enabling controlled measurement across different alignment degrees.
(3) Causal validation: counterfactual analysis that manipulates structural alignment to test its causal effect on erroneous invocations.
(4) Mechanistic interpretability: propose Contrastive Attention Attribution (CAA), which traces information flow without requiring strict token-level alignment between counterfactual pairs; reveals two competing pathways—semantic checking vs structural matching—whose relative strength drives tool-call decisions.
(5) Mitigation: a targeted intervention that rebalances these pathways to reduce SAB while preserving general tool-use capability.
summary_en.experiments: Across five tool-augmented LLMs, the paper reports a stark gap: on previously used irrelevant-tool samples that are structurally misaligned, error is negligible (<0.2%); on SABEval where tools are structurally aligned but semantically irrelevant, erroneous invocation jumps to 41.9%, and can reach 90.4% as alignment degree increases. Counterfactual results support a strong causal link from structural alignment to wrong tool calls. The proposed mitigation yields large improvements (about 80% relative error reduction) while maintaining general tool-use performance.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep read):
- Introduction + Fig.1: internalize the SAB phenomenon and the semantic-vs-structural distinction.
- Problem Formulation: how structural alignment is defined (parameter sets, valid assignments) and how it interacts with irrelevance.
- SABEval construction + alignment-degree stratification: the key reason prior benchmarks miss the failure mode.
- Main results tables/figures: focus on the <0.2% → 41.9% → 90.4% jumps and the controlled conditions.
- Counterfactual/causal section: how causality is established beyond correlation.
- CAA method + visualizations: how the two competing pathways are identified and linked to tool-call decisions.
- Mitigation + ablations: verify robustness and whether general tool-use is preserved.

skim (quick read):
- Read Introduction + contributions: problem framing and headline claims.
- Read SABEval overview + main results: the core empirical evidence.
- Read mitigation idea + final metrics: whether SAB can be reduced without harming general tool use.
- For CAA, skim intuition + key figures; skip detailed derivations.
summary_en.authors_note: The central claim is that tool-refusal failures are not merely “weak semantics” but a mechanistic shortcut: structural matching can dominate decision-making. Therefore, evaluation should explicitly control for structural factors, and mitigation should use targeted interventions informed by internal competing pathways rather than relying only on larger models or generic instruction tuning.

paper.title: Test-time Scaling over Perception: Resolving the Grounding Paradox in Thinking with Images

summary.core_problem: 论文聚焦“Thinking with Images”范式中的细粒度视觉推理不可靠问题：模型必须先决定“看哪里/怎么裁剪缩放”，但正确决策又依赖尚未获取的局部证据，形成循环依赖。作者将其形式化为 Grounding Paradox（落地悖论）：感知证据不足→工具调用位置/策略猜测化→进一步错过关键证据→推理失败。
summary.importance: 该悖论解释了工具增强型 MLLM 的系统性失败模式（误缩放、冗余检查、漏检、该用工具却不用），指出瓶颈不在“有没有工具/分辨率”，而在“在不确定性下如何进行有根据的感知搜索”。这为多模态 test-time scaling 提供了清晰的研究切入点：不仅要扩展推理计算，还要扩展感知获取证据的计算。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 TTSP（Test-Time Scaling over Perception），把“感知”本身当作可扩展的推断过程，而非一次性工具轨迹。

must_read（详细技术分析）：
1) 多轨迹探索（exploratory perception traces）：在推理时并行/多次采样不同的工具调用与观察路径（如不同裁剪、缩放、区域检查），让模型在“看哪里”上产生多样性，而不是押注单一路径。
2) 置信过滤（entropy-based confidence estimation）：对每条感知轨迹或其中的观察结果进行基于熵的置信度估计，过滤不可靠/高不确定的观察，避免把噪声通过投票或自洽放大（作者强调多模态下轨迹差异不仅是“逻辑链”，更是“看到的证据不同”，因此必须显式建模证据可靠性与冲突）。
3) 结构化蒸馏（distill into structured knowledge）：将通过过滤的稳定观察压缩为结构化中间知识（可理解为“已确认的视觉事实/约束/候选集合/冲突点”的摘要），作为后续探索与最终回答的共享依据，降低长上下文与重复查看成本。
4) 迭代精化（iteratively refine exploration）：用结构化知识驱动下一轮工具探索，把计算集中到“尚未解决的不确定性/冲突证据”上，实现从猜测式 probing 到“感知假设检验”的闭环。

skim（方法概述）：TTSP = 多次看（多轨迹）→挑可信（熵过滤）→记成共识（结构化知识）→再去补看（迭代），最终答案来自逐步收敛的感知共识，而非单次工具调用。
summary.experiments: 作者声称在多种视觉推理基准上 TTSP 相比现有基线稳定提升，覆盖细粒度场景（小文本、细微属性、密集符号、杂乱场景等）并更鲁棒。由于你提供的“全文内容”目前仅包含引言级别信息，具体实验设置（数据集/指标/对比方法/消融：轨迹数、熵阈值、蒸馏形式、迭代轮数等）与定量结果无法从现有文本中复原；若补充论文方法与实验章节，我可以进一步给出可复现级别的实验解读与消融结论。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读建议）：
- 重点读：提出 Grounding Paradox 的动机与失败模式归因（通常在 Introduction + 相关失败案例/图1）。
- 重点读：TTSP 的完整流程定义（多轨迹生成、熵置信、结构化蒸馏、迭代策略）以及“为何多模态不能直接用 self-consistency/majority vote”的论证。
- 重点看图表：Figure 1（TTSP 总览/流程图）——理解“探索-过滤-蒸馏-再探索”的闭环与信息流。
- 重点抓创新点：把 test-time scaling 从“语言推理轨迹”扩展到“感知证据获取轨迹”；用熵做证据级可靠性筛选；用结构化中间知识做跨轨迹共识与后续探索的控制信号。

skim（泛读建议）：
- 只看：Introduction（悖论定义与动机）+ Figure 1（方法直觉）+ 实验主表（总体提升）+ 1-2 个关键消融（轨迹数/迭代轮数/是否熵过滤）。
summary.authors_note: 作者的核心立场是：工具增强并不等于真正的视觉推理；真正的能力在于当初始落地不充分/有歧义/出错时，模型能通过可扩展的感知搜索恢复证据。TTSP 试图把“看哪里”从一次性决策变成可迭代、可验证、可收敛的推断过程。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets brittleness in fine-grained visual reasoning under the “Thinking with Images” paradigm. Tool-augmented MLLMs must decide where/how to look (zoom/crop) before they have the local evidence needed to make that decision correctly, creating a circular dependency. The authors formalize this as the Grounding Paradox: insufficient grounding → speculative tool use → missed/incorrect evidence → reasoning failure.
summary_en.importance: The Grounding Paradox explains systematic failure modes (mislocalized zooms, redundant inspections, missed evidence, or not using tools when needed) and argues the bottleneck is not tool availability or resolution, but grounded perceptual search under uncertainty. This reframes multimodal test-time scaling: scaling should apply not only to reasoning trajectories but also to perception/evidence acquisition.
summary_en.technical_approach:
They propose TTSP (Test-Time Scaling over Perception), treating perception itself as a scalable inference process rather than a single tool-use trajectory.

must_read (technical deep dive):
1) Multiple exploratory perception traces: sample/execute diverse tool-use and observation paths (different crops/zooms/regions) to diversify “where to look”.
2) Confidence-aware filtering via entropy: estimate uncertainty (entropy-based) for traces/observations and discard unreliable evidence, preventing naive aggregation from amplifying perceptual noise (a key multimodal issue since trajectories differ in what they observe, not just in logic).
3) Distillation into structured knowledge: compress validated observations into structured intermediate knowledge (confirmed visual facts/constraints/candidates/conflicts) shared across trajectories, reducing redundancy and stabilizing downstream reasoning.
4) Iterative refinement: use the distilled knowledge to steer subsequent exploration toward unresolved uncertainty/conflicts, turning tool use into iterative hypothesis testing and consensus-building.

skim (high-level): TTSP = look multiple ways → keep confident evidence → distill into a shared structured state → look again to resolve remaining uncertainty; final answers come from progressively refined perceptual consensus.
summary_en.experiments: The paper claims consistent improvements over baselines across diverse visual reasoning benchmarks, especially in fine-grained settings (small text, subtle attributes, dense symbols, clutter). However, the provided “full content” here only includes introduction-level material; concrete experimental details (benchmarks, metrics, baselines, ablations on #traces/entropy thresholds/distillation format/iterations) and quantitative results cannot be reconstructed from the current text. If you share the method+experiments sections, I can produce a reproducibility-oriented analysis.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (close reading):
- Focus on: the formalization and diagnosis of the Grounding Paradox and its characteristic failure modes (typically Introduction + motivating examples/Fig. 1).
- Focus on: the full TTSP pipeline (trace generation, entropy confidence, structured distillation, iterative control) and the argument for why text-only self-consistency/majority vote is insufficient in multimodal settings.
- Key figure: Figure 1 (TTSP overview) to understand the explore–filter–distill–refine loop and information flow.
- Key contributions to extract: scaling perception (not just reasoning), entropy-based evidence reliability filtering, and structured intermediate knowledge as a control signal for iterative exploration.

skim (fast reading):
- Read: Introduction + Figure 1 + main results table + 1–2 critical ablations (e.g., #traces, #iterations, with/without entropy filtering).
summary_en.authors_note: The authors’ thesis is that tool access is not equivalent to genuine visual reasoning; the real capability is recovering from incomplete/ambiguous/misgrounded initial perception via deliberate, scalable perceptual exploration. TTSP operationalizes this by making “where to look” an iterative, verifiable, convergent inference process.

paper.title: Agentic Aggregation for Parallel Scaling of Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks

summary.core_problem: 如何在长时程、工具增强、开放式输出的 agentic 任务中实现“并行 test-time scaling”，并有效聚合多条并行轨迹的信息以提升最终答案质量。
summary.importance: 方法与系统层面的创新：把“并行采样+聚合”从 CoT 推理扩展到长轨迹 Agent 场景，指出仅聚合最终答案/拼接全轨迹都不适用，并提出可在轨迹空间中按需检索与综合的聚合代理范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AggAgent：将多条并行生成的 agent 轨迹视作一个可交互的“环境”，由一个聚合 agent 使用轻量工具对候选解进行检查、在轨迹间搜索与按需读取关键信息；避免全量拼接导致的上下文溢出，同时避免只看最终答案丢失过程信息。
summary.experiments: 在6个基准、3个模型家族（GLM-4.7、Qwen3.5、MiniMax-M2.5）上评测；相对既有聚合方法平均最高提升约5.3个百分点，单项最高约10.3个百分点（摘要所述）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to perform parallel test-time scaling for long-horizon, tool-augmented agentic tasks with open-ended outputs, and how to aggregate information across multiple parallel trajectories to improve final answer quality.
summary_en.importance: Extends the idea of parallel sampling plus aggregation from chain-of-thought to long-horizon agent trajectories, arguing that aggregating only final answers or concatenating full traces is ineffective, and proposing an aggregation-agent paradigm that can selectively retrieve and synthesize trajectory evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes AggAgent, which treats multiple parallel agent rollouts as an interactive environment; an aggregator agent uses lightweight tools to inspect candidates, search across trajectories, and read only relevant segments on demand, avoiding context overflow while retaining crucial process information beyond final outputs.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 6 benchmarks and 3 model families (GLM-4.7, Qwen3.5, MiniMax-M2.5); compared to prior aggregation methods, it achieves up to ~5.3 percentage points average improvement and up to ~10.3 points on the best single case (as reported in the summary).

recommendation.zh: 只看聚合代理的检索/综合策略与消融：它把“并行采样=拼答案”这个 prior 推翻了，但收益高度依赖轨迹表征与检索噪声。
recommendation.en: Skim the aggregation-agent policy + ablations: it breaks the “parallel sampling = merge final answers” prior, but gains look tightly coupled to trajectory representation and retrieval noise.

paper.title: ClawVM: Harness-Managed Virtual Memory for Stateful Tool-Using LLM Agents

summary.core_problem: 有状态的工具调用型 LLM 智能体把上下文窗口当作工作内存，但现有 agent harness 对“状态驻留（residency）与持久性（durability）”的管理多为 best-effort：压缩/裁剪后关键状态丢失、reset 时绕过 flush、写回覆盖式破坏（destructive writeback）。这些问题导致重复工具调用、偏好/约束丢失、计划中断且难以诊断与复现。
summary.importance: 随着智能体运行时长从分钟扩展到小时/天、跨多轮上下文窗口与多 session，状态管理成为可靠性的决定因素。仅靠检索质量提升、摘要压缩调参或外部记忆插件无法提供可执行的契约：什么必须保留、何时必须落盘、丢失如何可观测。作者主张应像操作系统管理内存一样，把“上下文=物理内存、外部存储=磁盘”的问题上升为虚拟内存机制，并在 harness 层强制执行。
summary.technical_approach:
ClawVM：一种由 harness 管理的“虚拟内存层”，核心设计包括：
(1) Typed pages：把 agent 状态拆成带类型的页面（而非自由文本块），便于策略化管理与验证。
(2) Minimum-fidelity invariants：每页定义最低保真不变量（在 token 预算压力下最多可降级到什么程度），避免 compaction 把关键状态降到不可用。
(3) Multi-resolution representations：同一页可在多分辨率/多表示间切换（全量细节→压缩→结构化字段→指针），实现“渐进降级”而非全有或全无。
(4) Staged, validated writeback：在每个生命周期边界（compaction/pruning/reset 等）执行分阶段、可验证、非破坏性的写回协议，防止 flush 被绕过与覆盖式写回。
(5) Observable faults + deterministic replay：当不变量被破坏或状态丢失时触发可观测 fault，使问题可诊断、可回放；并用 offline oracle（具备未来需求知识）分析在线策略是否仍有改进空间。
summary.experiments: 在合成工作负载、12 条真实 session trace、对抗压力测试与 OpenClaw 派生工作负载上评估：ClawVM 将“策略可控的 faults”（refetch、duplicate-tool、post-compaction bootstrap、flush-miss）从检索基线的平均 67.8/配置、以及“实践者调参的 compaction+retrieval”基线的 1.5/配置降到 0；paging instability 分别降低 77.4% 与 11.4%。在最紧 token 预算下，30 个任务级回放成功率 100%（对比实践者基线 76.7%）。策略引擎开销中位数 <50 微秒/turn。离线 oracle 显示在线策略已达最优 fault 数（零剩余 headroom）。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读）：
- 重点章节：Introduction（把 harness 视作“agent OS kernel”的论证与问题分类）；方法章节中关于 typed pages、minimum-fidelity invariants、multi-resolution 表示的形式化定义与示例；writeback 协议（如何做到 validated、non-destructive、覆盖所有 lifecycle boundary）；fault model 与 deterministic replay（如何让错误可观测、可回归测试）；offline oracle 分析（如何证明在线策略已最优）。
- 重点图表/结果：Figure 1（整体架构与数据流）；fault 类型统计与归零结果；不同 token budget 下的稳定性/成功率曲线；开销评估（<50μs/turn）。
- 创新点抓手：①把“记忆管理契约”上移到 harness 强制执行（而非靠模型提示/插件）；②最低保真不变量 + 多分辨率页面实现可控降级；③生命周期边界的分阶段验证写回，避免 destructive overwrite；④可观测 fault + 可确定性回放 + oracle 上界分析，形成可审计、可回归的工程闭环。

skim（泛读）：
- 先读 Introduction + Contributions（问题与方案一页抓住）；再扫 Background（为何现有 pruning/retrieval/compaction 不够）；然后直接看实验主表（fault=0、成功率提升、开销）；最后快速浏览 writeback 与 fault model 的小节以理解“为什么能保证”。
summary.authors_note: 作者的核心立场是：状态可靠性不是“更好的检索/更长的上下文/更聪明的摘要”能根治的，而需要像 OS 虚拟内存一样的可执行契约与故障模型；且唯一合适的强制点在 harness（它天然掌控 prompt 组装、工具调用与生命周期事件）。论文贡献更偏系统与工程可验证性：用不变量、写回验证、可观测 fault 与确定性回放，把智能体记忆从启发式调参变成可审计的运行时机制。

institutions: Max Planck Institute for Software SystemsSaarbrücken, Saarland

summary_en.core_problem: Stateful tool-using LLM agents treat the context window as working memory, but today’s agent harnesses manage state residency and durability on a best-effort basis. This causes recurring failures: critical state is lost after compaction, flushes are bypassed on reset, and writeback can be destructive (overwrite instead of merge). The result is repeated tool calls, lost preferences/constraints, broken plans, and failures that are hard to diagnose or reproduce.
summary_en.importance: As agents run for hours/days across multiple context windows and sessions, state management becomes the dominant reliability bottleneck. Improving retrieval quality, tuning compaction, or adding memory plugins does not provide an enforceable contract for what must remain resident, what must be durable, and how losses become observable. The paper argues for an OS-style framing—context as physical memory, external stores as disk—and for enforcing virtual-memory-like guarantees at the harness layer.
summary_en.technical_approach:
ClawVM is a harness-managed virtual memory layer with:
(1) Typed pages: agent state is managed as typed pages rather than free-form text.
(2) Minimum-fidelity invariants: each page declares how far it may degrade under token pressure.
(3) Multi-resolution representations: pages can gracefully degrade (full detail → compressed → structured fields → pointer) instead of all-or-nothing compaction.
(4) Staged, validated writeback: deterministic, non-destructive commits at every lifecycle boundary (compaction/pruning/reset), preventing bypassed flushes and destructive overwrites.
(5) Observable faults + deterministic replay: invariant violations/state loss raise explicit faults, making issues diagnosable and replayable; an offline oracle (with future demand knowledge) is used to assess optimality/headroom.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on synthetic workloads, 12 real-session traces, adversarial stress tests, and OpenClaw-derived workload families. ClawVM eliminates all policy-controllable faults (refetch, duplicate-tool, post-compaction bootstrap, flush-miss): from 67.8 mean faults per workload-budget configuration (retrieval baseline) and 1.5 (practitioner-tuned compaction+retrieval) down to 0. Paging instability is reduced by 77.4% and 11.4% respectively. At the tightest token budget, task-level replay success is 100% vs 76.7% for the practitioner baseline. Median policy-engine overhead is <50 μs per turn. Offline oracle analysis indicates the online policy already achieves the optimal fault count (no remaining headroom).
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep dive):
- Key sections: Introduction (harness as an “agent OS kernel” and failure taxonomy); the formal design of typed pages, minimum-fidelity invariants, and multi-resolution representations; the staged validated writeback protocol across lifecycle boundaries; the fault model and deterministic replay methodology; offline oracle analysis for optimality.
- Key figures/results: Figure 1 (system overview); fault breakdown and the “faults to zero” results; curves across token budgets; overhead measurements (<50 μs/turn).
- Innovation checklist: (i) enforceable memory contract at the harness (not via prompts/plugins); (ii) invariants + multi-resolution pages for controlled degradation; (iii) validated non-destructive writeback at lifecycle boundaries; (iv) observable faults + deterministic replay + oracle upper bound for auditability and regression.

skim (overview):
- Read Introduction + Contributions; skim Background to see why pruning/retrieval/compaction are insufficient; jump to the main experimental tables (fault=0, success gains, overhead); then skim writeback and fault-model sections to understand the guarantees.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper’s thesis is that agent memory reliability cannot be solved by “better retrieval/longer context/smarter summaries” alone; it requires an OS-like, enforceable runtime contract and a fault model. The harness is the natural enforcement point because it already controls prompt assembly, tool mediation, and lifecycle events. The contribution is primarily systems engineering with verifiable guarantees: invariants, validated writeback, observable faults, and deterministic replay turn memory management from heuristic tuning into an auditable runtime mechanism.

recommendation.zh: 值得看其“虚拟内存式契约”定义：把状态丢失从提示工程问题升级为 harness 责任边界；动作是按 residency/durability 做可观测与强制 flush。
recommendation.en: Worth it for the “virtual-memory contract” framing: it shifts state loss from prompt hacks to harness responsibility; actionable takeaway is to enforce observable residency/durability + mandatory flush semantics.

paper.title: UniToolCall: Unifying Tool-Use Representation, Data, and Evaluation for LLM Agents

summary.core_problem: 现有 LLM Agent 的工具学习（tool-use）研究在“表示—数据—评测”三条链路上高度碎片化：不同数据集/框架的 tool-call schema 不兼容导致难以联合训练；训练数据对工具交互“结构分布”（尤其串行/并行、单跳/多跳、单轮/多轮）建模不足；评测基准协议与脚本不统一造成结果不可比、难复现。
summary.importance: 工具调用是 Agent 从“生成文本”走向“可执行行动”的核心能力。碎片化会直接限制：1）跨数据源规模化训练；2）对规划与执行结构的系统性分析与可控提升；3）在真实部署中对鲁棒性（干扰工具、多轮依赖、并行调用）的可靠评估。UniToolCall 试图把工具学习做成“可标准化的工程与科研底座”，降低数据/评测的不可比成本。
summary.technical_approach:
UniToolCall 提出统一框架，核心是把全流程标准化到同一交互表示与评测协议上。
1）统一表示：将不同来源的工具交互统一到 Query–Action–Observation–Answer（QAOA）格式，规范 tool call、参数、观测与最终回答的组织方式，并配套统一匹配规则。
2）工具池构建：聚合学术基准、MCP servers、构造数据集等来源，经过多阶段过滤，得到 22K+ 工具；全部标准化为统一 JSON Schema。并按“功能类别（6 类）×应用领域（13 域）”做语义组织，便于均衡采样与覆盖。
3）混合训练语料：构建 390K+ 训练实例，来源包括（a）10 个公开工具数据集的标准化整合；（b）结构可控的合成交互轨迹。合成部分显式控制单跳/多跳、单轮/多轮，并重点覆盖串行与并行两类执行结构。
4）结构感知合成机制：提出 Anchor Linkage 机制在多轮对话中强制跨轮依赖（例如后续调用必须引用前轮产物/变量/中间结论），避免“轮间松耦合”的伪多轮数据；同时通过结构装配（structural assembly）让轨迹分布可控，从而能分析不同结构对能力的影响。
5）统一评测：把异构 benchmark 转为 QAOA，并提供标准化评测协议与多粒度指标（函数调用级、轮级、对话级），支持在不同任务结构下公平比较。
summary.experiments: 论文报告在统一评测设置下，对轻量模型 Qwen3-8B 进行框架内微调可取得强结果：在 distractor-heavy 的 Hybrid-20 设置下，单轮 Strict Precision 达到 93.0%，并宣称超过 GPT/Gemini/Claude 等商用模型。实验重点体现：统一表示+结构可控数据对“抗干扰工具选择”“多步/多轮执行一致性”“严格匹配的函数调用正确率”等指标的提升，并通过细粒度指标支持对串行/并行结构差异的诊断。
summary.reading_guide:
【skim（泛读）】
- 读 Introduction：抓住三大碎片化痛点（表示不一致/结构欠建模/评测不匹配）与 UniToolCall 的三件套（工具池、混合数据、统一评测）。
- 读 UniToolCall 框架总览段 + Figure 2：理解 QAOA 在流水线中的位置（数据整合、合成、评测的共同接口）。
- 快看工具池来源与分类（提到 Figure 7、6×13 taxonomy）：理解为何需要语义组织来做均衡采样。
- 快看实验主结论：Hybrid-20、Strict Precision 等关键指标与“超过商用模型”的对比口径。

【must_read（精读）】
- 精读 QAOA 表示与匹配规则：这是能否“跨数据集联合训练/统一评测”的关键，建议对照附录中的单跳样例（文中提示 Appendix C.2）。
- 精读合成数据管线：重点看如何显式控制（单/多跳、单/多轮、串行/并行）以及 structural assembly 的实现细节；关注 Anchor Linkage 如何把跨轮变量/实体/中间结果绑定到后续调用。
- 精读统一 benchmark 与指标：函数调用级/轮级/对话级的定义、Strict vs 非 Strict 的判定、以及 distractor-heavy（Hybrid-20）如何构造与为何更贴近真实。
- 精读消融/结构分析（若正文或附录提供）：建议按“仅公共数据→+合成→+结构控制→+Anchor Linkage→+统一评测脚本”顺序验证每个组件的边际贡献。
- 图表优先级：Figure 2（框架总览）、Figure 7（工具池来源与过滤/标准化流程）、以及任何展示串行/并行轨迹分布与性能差异的图表。
summary.authors_note: 作者的核心立场是：工具学习的瓶颈不只在模型或提示，而在数据与评测的“结构化与标准化”。通过统一表示（QAOA）把异构数据与评测对齐，再用结构可控的合成轨迹补齐真实数据难覆盖的交互结构分布，最终让训练可规模化、评测可复现、分析可诊断。

summary_en.core_problem: Tool-use learning for LLM agents is fragmented across the full pipeline: (1) incompatible tool-call schemas prevent joint training across datasets; (2) training data under-models the structural distribution of tool trajectories (notably serial vs. parallel execution, and single-/multi-hop, single-/multi-turn patterns); (3) evaluation benchmarks use mismatched protocols and scripts, making results hard to compare and reproduce.
summary_en.importance: Tool calling is the key capability that turns LLMs from text generators into executable agents. Fragmentation directly limits scalable multi-source training, systematic improvement of planning/execution structures, and reliable evaluation under realistic settings (distractor tools, multi-turn dependencies, parallel calls). UniToolCall aims to provide a standardized research/engineering substrate for tool learning.
summary_en.technical_approach:
UniToolCall unifies representation, data, and evaluation.
1) Unified representation: converts heterogeneous interactions into a shared Query–Action–Observation–Answer (QAOA) format, standardizing tool calls, arguments, observations, and final answers, together with unified matching rules.
2) Tool pool: aggregates tools from academic benchmarks, MCP servers, and constructed datasets; applies multi-stage filtering to obtain 22K+ tools; standardizes all tools into a unified JSON Schema; organizes tools by a 6 (functional categories) × 13 (application domains) taxonomy for balanced sampling.
3) Hybrid training corpus: builds 390K+ instances by integrating 10 standardized public tool-use datasets plus structurally controlled synthetic trajectories.
4) Structure-aware synthesis: explicitly models single-/multi-hop, single-/multi-turn, and crucially serial vs. parallel execution patterns; introduces an Anchor Linkage mechanism to enforce cross-turn dependencies so later turns must reference earlier intermediate results/variables.
5) Unified evaluation: converts benchmarks into QAOA and provides a standardized evaluation protocol with multi-granularity metrics (function-call, turn, conversation) for fair comparisons across task structures.
summary_en.experiments: Under the unified protocol, fine-tuning a lightweight Qwen3-8B within UniToolCall yields strong results. In the distractor-heavy Hybrid-20 setting, it reports 93.0% single-turn Strict Precision, claimed to outperform leading commercial models (GPT/Gemini/Claude). The evaluation emphasizes strict function-call correctness, robustness to distractor tools, and consistency across multi-step/multi-turn structures enabled by the unified metrics.
summary_en.reading_guide:
【skim】
- Read Introduction for the three fragmentation axes and the high-level solution.
- Read the framework overview + Figure 2 to understand how QAOA serves as the common interface for integration, synthesis, and evaluation.
- Skim the tool pool construction and taxonomy (incl. Figure 7) to see how coverage and balanced sampling are achieved.
- Skim the headline results (Hybrid-20, Strict Precision) and the comparison protocol.

【must_read】
- Deep-read QAOA and the matching rules; cross-check with the single-hop example referenced in Appendix C.2.
- Deep-read the synthetic pipeline: how structural controls are implemented for hop/turn and serial/parallel patterns; how structural assembly works; and how Anchor Linkage enforces real cross-turn dependency.
- Deep-read the unified benchmark and metrics: definitions at function/turn/conversation levels, strict vs non-strict criteria, and how Hybrid-20 distractors are constructed.
- Prioritize figures: Figure 2 (end-to-end framework), Figure 7 (tool pool sources/filtering/standardization), and any plots analyzing performance vs trajectory structure (serial vs parallel, hop/turn).
summary_en.authors_note: The paper’s thesis is that progress in tool learning is bottlenecked by standardization and structural coverage, not only by model architecture or prompting. By unifying all data and evaluation under QAOA and adding structure-controlled synthetic trajectories (with enforced cross-turn dependencies), UniToolCall enables scalable training, reproducible evaluation, and diagnosable improvements.

recommendation.zh: 当标准化提案快速扫：只看 schema 设计与评测脚本即可；科研新 insight 有限，但若你在做多源 tool 数据混训，这套规范能立刻降摩擦。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a standardization proposal: read the schema and eval harness only; limited new insight, but if you’re mixing multi-source tool data, adopting the spec can immediately cut integration friction.

paper.title: ClawGuard: A Runtime Security Framework for Tool-Augmented LLM Agents Against Indirect Prompt Injection

summary.core_problem: 论文研究工具增强型 LLM Agent 在运行时遭受“间接提示注入（Indirect Prompt Injection）”的系统性风险：攻击者把恶意指令藏在工具返回内容里（网页/文件/MCP 服务器/技能文件等），而 Agent 会把这些返回当作可信 observation 直接拼进对话历史，从而被诱导进行越权工具调用、数据外泄或危险操作。核心问题是：在不改模型、不改协议、不过度牺牲 Agent 灵活性的前提下，如何在运行时阻断这类注入带来的真实世界副作用。
summary.importance: 工具调用把 LLM 的“语言输出”变成“可执行动作”，间接注入因此从对话层面的越狱升级为可造成文件读写、网络外联、账户操作等实际损害。现有防御三类各有硬伤：模型级对齐需要微调且仍可绕过；协议级指令/数据分离需要跨提供方协同；架构级强约束要么限制开放式 Agent，要么依赖专家手写规则。论文的价值在于提出一种中间件式、可审计、确定性（deterministic）的运行时边界防护。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 ClawGuard：在每个 tool-call 边界实施“用户确认的规则集 + 内容净化 + 风险审计”，把对齐的概率性防护转为可执行的策略约束。
1) 一次性规则归纳（Pre-session Rule Induction）：在会话开始、首次工具调用前，仅基于用户目标自动归纳任务相关访问约束，生成并让用户确认 ℛ_task；强调此阶段不受工具返回内容污染。
2) 每次工具调用的强制执行（Per-tool-call Enforcement）：对后续每个工具调用应用 ℛ = ℛ_base ∪ ℛ_task，并包含四个组件：
- Content Sanitizer：对“出站工具参数”与“入站工具返回内容”做敏感跨度（spans）脱敏/删改，避免秘密被带出或恶意指令被带入上下文；
- Rule Evaluator：对工具调用、文件路径、网络目的地等进行规则判定；
- Skill Inspector：首次执行某个 skill 前做自动风险评估并强制用户确认；
- Approval Mechanism + Audit Log：对判定不明确的调用请求用户授权，并记录审计日志，提升可追责与可复现。
3) 设计取舍：模型无关（不需微调）、协议无关（不要求 MCP/工具提供方改造）、对开放式 Agent 友好（运行时决策仍可进行，但在边界处被约束）。
summary.experiments: 论文在 AgentDojo、SkillInject、MCPSafeBench 等基准与攻击设置上，覆盖 5 个 SOTA 模型进行评测；结论是 ClawGuard 在所有场景显著降低攻击成功率，相比未防护基线提升明显。你提供的全文片段未包含具体指标与表格数值，因此此处总结其评测基准、模型覆盖与总体结论。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读）：
- 重点章节：Introduction（3 类注入通道与现有防御缺陷的系统化梳理）、框架设计章节（规则归纳如何从用户目标生成、规则语言/覆盖面、每个组件的输入输出与插入点）、安全分析（为何能抵御“工具返回内容携带指令”的间接注入）。
- 重点图表/材料：系统架构图（展示 tool-call boundary 的拦截点与数据流）、规则示例（ℛ_base/ℛ_task 的具体形式）、在三大基准上的主结果表、消融（去掉 Sanitizer/Approval/Skill Inspector 的影响）、案例研究（典型注入链路如何被拦截）。
- 创新点抓手：①“会话前、未污染上下文”的任务规则归纳 + 用户确认；②确定性边界执行（而非依赖模型自律）；③对 MCP/skill 生态的现实攻击面覆盖与统一治理。

skim（泛读）：
- 先读 Introduction 把威胁面（web/local、MCP server、skill file）与痛点对齐；
- 看系统总览图 + 四组件列表，理解它是“运行时中间件”；
- 直接看主结果表（各基准 ASR 降幅）与最关键的案例；
- 最后扫一眼部署开销/兼容性讨论（是否影响现有 agent 框架）。
summary.authors_note: 作者强调把安全控制点放在“工具调用边界”，用可审计的规则与用户确认机制，将间接提示注入从“模型是否能抵抗”转化为“系统是否允许执行”，从而在不改模型/协议的情况下获得更强、可落地的防护。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets indirect prompt injection in tool-augmented LLM agents: attackers embed malicious instructions inside tool-returned content (web/local resources, MCP servers, skill files). Agents treat these outputs as trusted observations and append them into conversation history, which can then drive unauthorized tool calls, data exfiltration, or harmful real-world actions. The core problem is how to block such attacks at runtime without modifying the model or protocols and without overly restricting open-ended agents.
summary_en.importance: Tool use turns LLM outputs into executable actions, so indirect injection escalates from jailbreak-style misbehavior to concrete damage (file/network/account operations). Existing defenses are insufficient: model-level alignment needs fine-tuning and remains bypassable; protocol-level separation requires cross-provider coordination; architecture-level enforcement can reduce agent flexibility or require expert-authored rules. The paper’s contribution is a middleware-style, deterministic, auditable runtime defense.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on AgentDojo, SkillInject, and MCPSafeBench across five state-of-the-art models. The reported outcome is a consistent and substantial reduction in attack success compared to unprotected baselines. The provided excerpt does not include exact metrics/tables, so this summarizes scope and claimed conclusions.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors’ stance is to move security control to the tool-call boundary: instead of relying on the model to ignore malicious context, the system deterministically decides what can be executed, with user-confirmed rules and auditability—without requiring model or protocol changes.

recommendation.zh: 看运行时边界与确定性拦截点：它不靠微调改 prior，而是给出可审计的中间件防线；动作是把 tool I/O 当不可信输入做最小权限与策略执行。
recommendation.en: Skim the runtime boundary design and deterministic interception points: no new alignment prior, but an auditable middleware defense; actionable step is to treat tool I/O as untrusted and enforce least-privilege + policy execution.

paper.title: Three Roles, One Model: Role Orchestration at Inference Time to Close the Performance Gap Between Small and Large Agents

summary.core_problem: 论文研究在真实工具使用环境中，小模型 agent（如 8B）在单卡资源约束下表现显著落后于大模型的问题：在长轨迹、多 API、需要持久状态与错误恢复的任务中，原生推理策略常出现状态丢失、认证/凭据处理失败、API schema 违规、以及早期错误后陷入重复修正循环，导致任务完成率极低。
summary.importance: 该问题直接影响可部署性：许多团队无法训练/部署前沿大模型，只能在单张消费级 GPU（24GB）上运行开源小模型。若不增加训练算力，仅靠推理时结构化（scaffolding）就能显著提升成功率，将成为资源受限场景下最现实的杠杆之一。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出一种“诊断优先（diagnostic-first）”的推理时脚手架：不改权重、同一个冻结模型在推理时扮演三种角色，形成三段式流水线。(1) Summarization role：对历史交互做压缩，但强制保留关键工件（tokens、credentials、关键 API 输出、错误解决方案等），以缓解长上下文与状态遗忘；(2) Main agent role：在压缩上下文上进行规划与下一步动作/代码生成；(3) Isolated correction role：在隔离环境中基于执行反馈与相关 API 文档审阅并修正提议代码，但不访问完整对话历史，以减少被噪声/错误轨迹“带偏”，并更聚焦于 schema/调用细节。该方法完全 training-free，改变的是有效策略（policy）而非参数。
summary.experiments: 实验在 AppWorld（9 个应用、457 个 API、强调部署现实性）上评估 Qwen3-8B，硬件预算为单张 24GB GPU。比较两种部署：FP16（12K 上下文）与 4-bit AWQ（32K 上下文）。基线 goal completion 很低：5.4%（FP16）与 3.0%（AWQ）。引入三角色脚手架后提升到 8.9%（FP16）与 5.9%（AWQ），且在难度 1 任务提升更大（FP16：15.8%→26.3%；AWQ：5.3%→14.0%）。作者还指出在 FP16 下该 8B 数值上超过论文 [21] 报告的 DeepSeek-Coder 33B Instruct（7.1%）但在 N=168 下 95% 置信水平不显著。论文同时给出轨迹级失败模式分析，指出认证失败、规划错误、API-schema mismatch 是主因。
summary.reading_guide:
【skim（泛读）】1) Introduction：把握“部署现实性”定义、AppWorld 难点、以及基线失败的类型；2) 方法部分：三角色流水线的输入输出接口（总结器保留哪些工件、纠错器为何隔离历史）；3) 主结果表：FP16 vs AWQ、总体 vs 难度分桶的 goal completion；4) 失败模式分析小节：将提升与具体失败类型对应起来。
【must_read（精读）】1) 失败模式诊断方法：如何从轨迹中归因到 state loss / auth / schema / loop（这决定脚手架是否可迁移）；2) Summarization 机制：保留字段设计（credentials、tokens、关键 API 输出）与压缩策略对长程状态的影响；3) Isolated correction 的“隔离”设计：为何不给全历史反而更好、如何使用执行反馈与文档、如何避免引入新错误；4) 资源约束对比：FP16 12K vs AWQ 32K 的权衡（上下文长度、量化误差、成功率变化）；5) 统计显著性与对比基线：N=168 下的置信区间/显著性讨论，避免过度解读“超过 33B”。
summary.authors_note: 作者强调小模型在 agent 基准上的大量失败并非纯粹来自“能力不足”，而是来自可通过推理时结构化缓解的机械性问题（记忆/状态、认证、schema、纠错循环）。因此在不增加训练计算的前提下，通过角色分工与阶段化推理即可显著改善有效策略。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why small LLM agents (e.g., 8B) perform poorly under realistic deployment constraints on long-horizon tool-use tasks: they frequently lose critical state, mishandle authentication/credentials, violate API schemas, and get stuck in repetitive correction loops, yielding very low task completion rates.
summary_en.importance: This is a deployment-critical gap: many teams cannot fine-tune or serve frontier-scale models and must run open-weight models on a single 24GB GPU. If inference-time scaffolding (without any additional training) can materially improve success rates, it becomes a practical lever for resource-constrained agent deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose a diagnostic-first, training-free inference scaffold that uses the same frozen model in three roles: (1) a summarization role that compresses history while preserving key artifacts (tokens, credentials, intermediate API outputs, error resolutions) to mitigate long-context/state loss; (2) a main agent role that plans and proposes the next action/code from the compressed context; and (3) an isolated correction role that reviews and revises the proposed code using execution feedback and relevant API documentation, but without access to the full conversation history—reducing distraction from noisy trajectories and focusing on schema/tool correctness. The method changes the effective policy via staged conditioning, not the model weights.
summary_en.experiments: They evaluate Qwen3-8B on AppWorld (9 apps, 457 APIs) under a strict single-24GB-GPU budget, comparing FP16 with a truncated 12K context vs 4-bit AWQ with a 32K context. Baseline goal completion is 5.4% (FP16) and 3.0% (AWQ). The three-role scaffold improves this to 8.9% (FP16) and 5.9% (AWQ), with larger gains on difficulty-1 tasks (FP16: 15.8%→26.3%; AWQ: 5.3%→14.0%). Under FP16, the scaffolded 8B numerically exceeds a reported 7.1% for DeepSeek-Coder 33B Instruct on the same split, but the difference is not statistically significant at 95% given N=168. The paper also reports a trajectory-level failure analysis identifying authentication failures, planning errors, and API-schema mismatches as dominant causes.
summary_en.reading_guide:
【Skim】(1) Introduction for “deployment realism,” AppWorld’s challenges, and baseline failure types; (2) the method section for the three-role pipeline and the interfaces (what the summarizer must preserve; why the corrector is isolated); (3) main results tables comparing FP16 vs AWQ and overall vs difficulty buckets; (4) the failure-mode analysis that links gains to specific error categories.
【Must-read】(1) The failure-mode diagnosis methodology (how trajectories are attributed to state loss/auth/schema/loops), which determines transferability; (2) the summarization design—what fields are preserved and how compression affects long-horizon state; (3) the isolated correction design—why excluding full history can help, how execution feedback/docs are used, and how new errors are avoided; (4) the resource trade-off between FP16-12K and AWQ-32K (context length vs quantization effects); (5) statistical significance and baseline comparisons to avoid over-interpreting “beating 33B.”
summary_en.authors_note: The authors argue that much of small-model underperformance on agentic benchmarks stems from mechanical, fixable issues (memory/state, auth handling, schema adherence, recovery loops) rather than pure capability limits—so structured inference-time role orchestration can substantially improve the effective policy without any training.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在 8B 单卡上做工具 agent，这篇直接给推理时编排的可复用配方；只看三角色分工与错误恢复消重策略，别被整体 benchmark 带跑。
recommendation.en: If you run tool agents on single-GPU 8B models, this is a reusable inference-time orchestration recipe; focus on the three-role split and de-looping error recovery, ignore broad benchmark noise.

paper.title: CocoaBench: Evaluating Unified Digital Agents in the Wild

summary.core_problem: 如何在“真实开放环境”的长时程任务中评测统一数字代理（同时需要视觉/搜索/编码等能力）的可靠性与泛化能力。
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献+评测范式推进：把以往割裂的能力评测（GUI/检索/编码等）统一到同一套长地平线任务中，并提供可扩展的自动评测函数与共享scaffold，利于可复现对比与系统性诊断。
summary.technical_approach: 提出CocoaBench：由人工设计的长时程任务组成，仅给指令与最终输出的自动评测函数（避免逐步标注依赖）；提出CocoaAgent作为轻量共享代理脚手架，用于在不同模型backbone上做受控对比，覆盖视觉、搜索与编码的组合使用。
summary.experiments: 在多种代表性agent系统/模型上评测（摘要未列出具体模型清单）；结论为当前系统距离可靠性仍很远，最佳系统在CocoaBench上成功率45.1%。

summary_en.core_problem: How to reliably evaluate unified digital agents on long-horizon tasks in open-world settings that require combining heterogeneous capabilities such as vision/GUI interaction, web search, and coding.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a benchmark and evaluation paradigm that unifies previously siloed agent capabilities into end-to-end, long-horizon tasks with extensible automatic grading and a shared scaffold, enabling reproducible comparisons and more diagnostic analysis of agent failures.
summary_en.technical_approach: Presents CocoaBench, a suite of human-designed long-horizon tasks specified by instructions plus an automatic final-output evaluator (avoiding step-by-step annotation), and CocoaAgent, a lightweight shared agent scaffold to run controlled comparisons across different model backbones while exercising mixed tool use (vision, search, coding).
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates multiple representative agent systems/models (not enumerated in the provided summary) and finds current agents remain far from reliable; the best reported system achieves 45.1% success on CocoaBench.

paper.title: E3-TIR: Enhanced Experience Exploitation for Tool-Integrated Reasoning

summary.core_problem: 论文研究 Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) 代理的早期训练困境：Zero-RL 缺乏先验引导导致探索低效、易退化到过度调用工具的“react mode”；SFT-then-RL 虽有起步优势但依赖昂贵合成数据，且后期易出现能力僵化与低熵坍塌（多样性下降、性能平台期）。核心问题是如何在不大量依赖 SFT 数据的前提下，提高早期探索效率与多样性，并保持后续 RL 的可持续提升。
summary.importance: TIR 是面向真实应用（搜索、代码解释器、规划代理）的关键能力。训练范式若在早期就陷入无效探索或模式退化，会显著抬高算力与数据成本；若后期低熵坍塌，则限制上限。该工作提出“warm-up 但不重 SFT”的中间路线，目标是用更少合成数据获得更高 ROI（数据/训练/性能综合效率），对可扩展 agentic RL 训练具有直接工程价值。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 E3-TIR（Enhanced Experience Exploitation）作为早期 warm-up 范式，将训练视为三类经验的动态融合：Expert Prefixes（专家轨迹前缀作为锚点）、Expert Guided（围绕专家锚点的分支探索）、Self-Exploration（纯自探索）。方法分两部分：
(1) Expert Experience-Based Rollout：从专家轨迹的高熵“anchors”处做 branching sampling，在共享前缀下探索多条推理/工具调用分支；同时也保留一定自探索预算。随后基于梯度有效性（gradient validity）与相对性能优势（relative performance）对混合轨迹进行动态过滤，构造训练集。
(2) Mix Advantage & Policy Optimization：为处理“共享前缀、不同分支”的偏好差异，引入混合优势估计（global advantage + expert-tree internal advantage），并通过 advantage blocking 解决共享前缀上的梯度冲突，提升训练稳定性；同时采用 mix policy optimization（含 off-policy shape）在混合经验上更新策略。论文还给出从专家前缀分支探索优于纯自探索的理论论证（附录E），并用熵与奖励方差实证支持（Figure 4）。
summary.experiments: 作者通过现象分析展示两类基线缺陷：Zero-RL 早期生成有效代码/动作困难且易进入 react mode；SFT+RL 存在分布迁移适应期、后期低熵坍塌与能力僵化。E3-TIR 在使用 <10% 合成数据的情况下优于 SFT 与 RL 基线；以 minimal warm-up 达到 1.46× ROI 提升（综合数据、训练与性能效率）。此外，分支采样相较自探索带来更高策略熵与更大 reward variance（更“梯度有价值”的探索空间）。
summary.reading_guide:
skim（泛读）建议：先看 Introduction 对两种范式痛点的诊断（react mode、低熵坍塌、能力僵化），再看 Methodology 总览（两阶段：rollout + mix optimization），重点扫 Figure 2（现象对比）与 Figure 4（分支采样的熵/方差优势），最后看主结果表与 ROI 定义。
must_read（精读）建议：精读 4.1（expert prefixes 作为 anchors 的 branching sampling、预算 N/M 分配、过滤准则：gradient validity 与 advantage-based filtering）与 4.2（混合优势：global vs tree-internal；advantage-aware gradient blocking 如何在共享前缀上消解冲突；off-policy shape 的作用边界）。同时对照 Appendix E 的理论证明，理解“为何从专家前缀分支能在早期提供更高信息密度的探索”。创新点抓手：把早期训练从“要么纯 RL 盲搜、要么重 SFT”改为“围绕专家锚点的高熵分支探索 + 冲突可控的混合优化”。
summary.authors_note: 作者主张 E3-TIR 是一种面向早期阶段的 warm-up 训练范式：用专家前缀提供结构化先验，但通过分支探索保持高熵与多样性；再用混合优势与梯度阻断机制保证共享前缀下的稳定更新，从而以更少合成数据获得更高综合效率（ROI）。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses early-stage training failures in Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) agents. Zero-RL lacks guidance, leading to inefficient exploration and a degenerate “react mode” that over-calls tools. SFT-then-RL requires costly synthetic data and often suffers from capability rigidity and late-stage low-entropy collapse. The key question is how to improve early exploration efficiency and diversity without heavy SFT, while sustaining later RL gains.
summary_en.importance: TIR underpins practical agents (search, code interpreters, planning). If training collapses into unproductive exploration or reactive tool overuse, compute/data costs explode; if entropy collapses later, performance plateaus. The work proposes a middle-ground warm-up paradigm that reduces synthetic-data dependence and improves overall training ROI, with direct engineering relevance for scalable agentic RL.
summary_en.technical_approach:
E3-TIR (Enhanced Experience Exploitation) treats early training as a dynamic mixture of three experience types: Expert Prefixes (expert trajectory prefixes as anchors), Expert Guided (branching exploration around anchors), and Self-Exploration. The pipeline has two parts:
(1) Expert Experience-Based Rollout: perform branching sampling from high-entropy “anchors” in expert trajectories to explore diverse reasoning/tool-use branches under shared prefixes, alongside a self-exploration budget. Then dynamically filter mixed trajectories by gradient validity and relative performance advantage.
(2) Mix Advantage & Policy Optimization: introduce hybrid advantage estimation (global advantage + expert-tree internal advantage) to capture preferences among branches sharing prefixes; apply advantage-aware gradient blocking to resolve gradient conflicts on shared prefixes for stability; and use mix policy optimization (with off-policy shaping) to update on mixed experiences. A theoretical argument (App. E) supports why branching from expert prefixes is superior to pure self-exploration, corroborated empirically by higher policy entropy and reward variance (Fig. 4).
summary_en.experiments: The paper empirically diagnoses baseline issues: Zero-RL struggles to produce valid early actions/code and tends toward react mode; SFT+RL shows adaptation to distribution shift and later low-entropy collapse/rigidity. E3-TIR outperforms SFT and RL baselines using <10% of synthetic data, and with minimal warm-up achieves a 1.46× improvement in ROI (a composite of data, training, and performance efficiency). Branching from expert prefixes yields higher policy entropy and reward variance than self-generated trajectories, indicating more gradient-valuable exploration.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim: read the Introduction for the failure-mode diagnosis (react mode, low-entropy collapse, rigidity), then the Methodology overview (rollout + mix optimization). Focus on Fig. 2 (phenomena) and Fig. 4 (entropy/variance benefit), then the main results and the ROI definition.
Must-read: dive into Sec. 4.1 (anchor-based branching sampling, N/M budget allocation, filtering via gradient validity and advantage) and Sec. 4.2 (hybrid advantages, how advantage-aware gradient blocking resolves shared-prefix conflicts, and the role/limits of off-policy shaping). Cross-check App. E to understand why expert-prefix branching provides higher-information exploration early on. Key innovation: replacing the binary choice of blind Zero-RL vs heavy SFT with high-entropy branching around expert anchors plus conflict-controlled mixed optimization.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors position E3-TIR as an early-stage warm-up paradigm: expert prefixes provide structured priors, branching preserves entropy/diversity, and hybrid advantages with gradient blocking stabilize updates under shared prefixes—yielding higher overall ROI with far less synthetic data.

recommendation.zh: 作为“少 SFT 的 warm-up”路线图可参考，但收益很可能强依赖工具/任务分布；只看方法段的探索约束设计和主表里早期学习曲线即可。
recommendation.en: Useful as a playbook for low-SFT warm-up, but the gains likely hinge on tool/task distribution; skim the exploration-constraint design and the early-training curves in the main table/figures.

paper.title: SEA-Eval: A Benchmark for Evaluating Self-Evolving Agents Beyond Episodic Assessment

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM agent多停留在“单回合/单任务”评测，难以衡量跨任务持续学习、工具/策略自我演化与长期效率稳定性。
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献：提出自演化Agent（SEA）的更严格定义，并给出首个面向“跨任务连续演化”的评测基准SEA-Eval，补齐仅episodic评测无法暴露的长期瓶颈，对agent研究的评测范式有价值。
summary.technical_approach: SEA-Eval将任务组织为顺序stream，分别评测两维：intra-task执行可靠性与long-term演化表现；用Success Rate与Token Consumption随时间变化来量化“演化增益”和“结构稳定性”，从而区分表面成功率相同但长期效率/策略质量差异巨大的系统。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体任务集规模、参与评测的agent框架/模型清单；报告关键发现：在SOTA框架中存在显著“evolutionary bottleneck”，即成功率相同但token消耗可相差最高31.2倍，说明仅看成功率会严重误判系统能力。

summary_en.core_problem: Evaluate self-evolving agents that learn and adapt across a stream of tasks, since episodic single-task benchmarks cannot capture long-term learning, tool/strategy evolution, or stability of efficiency over time.
summary_en.importance: Defines a stricter notion of self-evolving agents and introduces SEA-Eval as an evaluation benchmark for continual cross-task evolution, exposing long-term bottlenecks that success-rate-only episodic assessments can miss.
summary_en.technical_approach: Organizes tasks into sequential streams and evaluates both intra-task execution reliability and long-term evolution; tracks success rate and token consumption over time to quantify evolutionary gains and structural/efficiency stability, distinguishing agents with similar success but very different long-run efficiency.
summary_en.experiments: Reports a key finding of an 'evolutionary bottleneck' in state-of-the-art frameworks: agents can achieve similar success rates while differing by up to 31.2× in token consumption; the abstract does not specify task scale or the evaluated agent/model roster.

recommendation.zh: 长期自演化评测补了episodic盲区，但容易被任务设计牵着走；只看SEA定义、泄漏控制和长期退化曲线。
recommendation.en: Continuous self-evolution eval fills the episodic blind spot, but is highly task-design sensitive; read the SEA definition, leakage controls, and long-horizon degradation curves.

paper.title: DRBENCHER: Can Your Agent Identify the Entity, Retrieve Its Properties and Do the Math?

summary.core_problem: 如何系统评测“深度研究型agent”在真实链路中同时完成网页/知识检索与多步计算（entity识别→属性检索→数学/程序计算）的能力，而不是把检索与计算割裂评测。
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献：提出可自动生成、可验证的“检索+计算”复合任务基准生成器，覆盖多域并通过难度过滤减少数据泄漏/过易样本；对通用research agent与tool-use评测更贴近真实工作流。
summary.technical_approach: DRBENCHER 采用 answer-first 的合成生成：先从知识图谱取值并用参数化代码执行得到gold，再生成需要多跳实体识别与属性检索的问题；用两阶段验证级联过滤掉能被生成模型直接解出的题；用贪心max-min embedding过滤提升多样性；覆盖生化、金融、地球物理、安全、历史五域。
summary.experiments: 人评有效性76%（剔除陈旧数据后84%）；错误中约35%来自知识图谱条目过时。摘要未提供具体被测agent/LLM、对比基线与分数细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Systematically benchmark deep-research agents on end-to-end tasks that require entity identification, web/knowledge retrieval of properties, and multi-step math/programmatic computation, rather than evaluating retrieval and computation in isolation.
summary_en.importance: Provides an automatically generated, verifiable benchmark generator for composite retrieval-plus-computation workflows across domains, with difficulty filtering to reduce leakage and trivial instances—better matching real research/tool-use pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: DRBENCHER uses an answer-first synthesis pipeline: obtain values from a knowledge graph and compute gold answers via parameterized code, then generate questions requiring multi-hop entity identification and property retrieval; applies a two-stage verification cascade to filter questions solvable directly by a generator model; uses greedy max–min embedding selection to increase diversity; covers five domains (biochemistry, finance, geophysics, security, history).
summary_en.experiments: Human evaluation finds 76% validity (84% after removing outdated data); about 35% of errors stem from outdated knowledge-graph entries. The abstract does not report evaluated agents/LLMs, baselines, or benchmark scores.

recommendation.zh: 把检索+计算链路绑在一起更接近research agent，但主要是数据生成器贡献；只看自动验证机制与难度过滤是否干净。
recommendation.en: Coupling retrieval with math mirrors real research-agent workflows, but the core value is the dataset generator; check the auto-verification and difficulty filtering for cleanliness.
